//
//  PermissionGuide.swift
//  Guided permission grants: opens the exact System Settings pane, docks a small glass
//  helper beside the Settings window with the app to drag into the list, watches for
//  the switch to flip, and closes itself with a check when you're done.
//

import AppKit
import ApplicationServices
import AVFoundation
import EventKit
import os
import SwiftUI

enum PermissionKind: String, CaseIterable {
    case accessibility, screenRecording, microphone, fullDiskAccess, calendars, reminders

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .accessibility: "Accessibility"
        case .screenRecording: "Screen Recording"
        case .microphone: "Microphone"
        case .fullDiskAccess: "Full Disk Access"
        case .calendars: "Calendars"
        case .reminders: "Reminders"
        }
    }
    var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .accessibility: "accessibility"
        case .screenRecording: "rectangle.dashed.badge.record"
        case .microphone: "mic.fill"
        case .fullDiskAccess: "externaldrive.fill"
        case .calendars: "calendar"
        case .reminders: "checklist"
        }
    }
    var settingsURL: URL {
        let anchor: String
        switch self {
        case .accessibility: anchor = "Privacy_Accessibility"
        case .screenRecording: anchor = "Privacy_ScreenCapture"
        case .microphone: anchor = "Privacy_Microphone"
        case .fullDiskAccess: anchor = "Privacy_AllFiles"
        case .calendars: anchor = "Privacy_Calendars"
        case .reminders: anchor = "Privacy_Reminders"
        }
        return URL(string: "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?\(anchor)")!
    }
    /// Lists you add an app to (drag or +); the microphone, calendars and reminders lists
    /// only have switches.
    var isDragList: Bool { ![.microphone, .calendars, .reminders].contains(self) }
    /// macOS only applies a new Screen Recording grant to a fresh process.
    var needsRelaunch: Bool { self == .screenRecording || self == .fullDiskAccess }

    var granted: Bool {
        switch self {
        case .accessibility: AXIsProcessTrusted()
        case .screenRecording: CGPreflightScreenCaptureAccess()
        case .microphone: AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: .audio) == .authorized
        case .calendars: EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .event) == .fullAccess
        case .reminders: EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .reminder) == .fullAccess
        case .fullDiskAccess: FolderAccess.granted
        }
    }
}

/// Desktop, Documents and Downloads. Listing one of them is what makes macOS ask "would like
/// to access files in your Desktop folder", so nothing touches them until it may: with Full
/// Disk Access (the TCC database opens, which never prompts), or after you pressed Allow on
/// a Files ask (`optedIn`), when the per-folder prompts are the answer to your own click.
/// Before that, file search and the index leave them out and the Files card asks.
enum FolderAccess {
    static let protected = ["Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"]
    static let optInKey = "edge.files.protectedFolders"

    static var fullDiskAccess: Bool {
        FileHandle(forReadingAtPath: NSHomeDirectory() + "/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db") != nil
    }
    static var optedIn: Bool { UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: optInKey) }
    /// May list the protected folders without surprising anyone with a system prompt.
    static var mayTouch: Bool { fullDiskAccess || optedIn }
    static func isProtected(_ path: String, home: String = NSHomeDirectory()) -> Bool {
        protected.contains { path == home + "/" + $0 || path.hasPrefix(home + "/" + $0 + "/") }
    }

    /// What file search needs: the folders readable (per-folder consent or Full Disk Access).
    /// Never lists them here (this runs on the main thread, and a listing can wait on a
    /// macOS prompt): per-folder consent counts once the indexer, which does list them on its
    /// own queue, found none blocked.
    static var granted: Bool {
        if fullDiskAccess { return true }
        guard optedIn else { return false }
        return lastBlocked.withLock { $0 } == []
    }
    /// The indexer's latest blocked list (nil: it hasn't looked yet).
    static let lastBlocked = OSAllocatedUnfairLock<[String]?>(initialState: nil)

    /// Builds before this opt-in listed the protected folders at every launch, so on a Mac
    /// that ran one macOS already has your answer, and listing them again asks nothing.
    /// Carried over once: without it an update froze Desktop, Documents and Downloads in the
    /// index (counted blocked, never refreshed) for someone who had allowed them long ago.
    /// A first launch records "not yet". Runs at launch before anything writes defaults.
    static func carryOverEarlierConsent(_ defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) {
        guard defaults.object(forKey: optInKey) == nil else { return }
        // Written at every launch by every earlier build (SpotlightController): present means
        // this app ran before.
        defaults.set(defaults.object(forKey: "option.spotlight.caps-remapped") != nil, forKey: optInKey)
    }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class PermissionGuide {
    static let shared = PermissionGuide()

    private(set) var kind: PermissionKind?
    private(set) var reason = ""
    private(set) var done = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var panel: NSPanel?
    @ObservationIgnored private var poll: Timer?

    /// True if granted already; otherwise walks you through it (once at a time).
    @discardableResult
    func ensure(_ kind: PermissionKind, reason: String) -> Bool {
        // Asking for file access is the go-ahead to look in the protected folders (FolderAccess).
        if kind == .fullDiskAccess, !FolderAccess.optedIn {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(true, forKey: FolderAccess.optInKey)
            FileIndexer.shared.accessChanged()   // lists the folders off the main thread (macOS may ask)
        }
        if kind.granted { return true }
        if kind == .microphone, AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: .audio) == .notDetermined {
            // First time: the system's own prompt is one click; no guide needed.
            AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .audio) { _ in }
            return false
        }
        // Calendars and reminders: the first ask is EventKit's own prompt too.
        if kind == .calendars, EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .event) == .notDetermined {
            EdgeCalendarStore.shared.requestIfNeeded()
            return false
        }
        if kind == .reminders, EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .reminder) == .notDetermined {
            EdgeAgendaLive.shared.requestReminderAccess()
            return false
        }
        if kind == .screenRecording { CGRequestScreenCaptureAccess() }   // registers us in the list
        guard self.kind == nil else { return false }
        self.kind = kind; self.reason = reason; self.done = false
        NSWorkspace.shared.open(kind.settingsURL)
        show()
        poll = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.5, repeats: true) { _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { PermissionGuide.shared.tick() }
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("permissions.guide", params: ["kind": kind.rawValue])
        return false
    }

    func close() {
        poll?.invalidate(); poll = nil
        panel?.orderOut(nil); panel = nil
        kind = nil
    }

    /// Screen Recording only takes effect in a new process: restart the whole app.
    func relaunch() {
        // The outer Nardo.app when this is its helper; otherwise this app itself (Lite).
        let here = Bundle.main.bundleURL.path
        let app = here.range(of: ".app/Contents/Helpers/").map { String(here[..<$0.lowerBound]) + ".app" } ?? here
        let name = (app as NSString).lastPathComponent.replacingOccurrences(of: ".app", with: "")
        let quoted = "'" + app.replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "'\\''") + "'"
        let script = "sleep 0.6; osascript -e 'quit app \"\(name)\"'; sleep 1.2; open \(quoted)"
        let p = Process(); p.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/bin/sh"); p.arguments = ["-c", script]
        try? p.run()
    }

    private func tick() {
        guard let kind else { return }
        dock()
        if !done, kind.granted {
            done = true
            NSSound(named: "Glass")?.play()
            if !kind.needsRelaunch {
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.4) { self.close() }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Panel

    private static let size = NSSize(width: 300, height: 236)

    private func show() {
        let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: Self.size),
                            styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = true
        panel.level = .floating; panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        // Not movable by background: that grabbed the drag meant for the app icon. It docks
        // itself beside Settings anyway.
        panel.isMovableByWindowBackground = false
        panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: PermissionGuideView(guide: self))
        host.sizingOptions = []
        panel.contentView = host
        self.panel = panel
        dock()
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()
    }

    /// Beside the System Settings window (right if there's room, else left).
    private func dock() {
        guard let panel, let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        let settings = Self.settingsWindowFrame()
        var origin: NSPoint
        if let s = settings {
            let x = s.maxX + 12 + Self.size.width <= screen.visibleFrame.maxX ? s.maxX + 12 : s.minX - 12 - Self.size.width
            origin = NSPoint(x: x, y: s.midY - Self.size.height / 2)
        } else {
            origin = NSPoint(x: screen.visibleFrame.midX - Self.size.width / 2, y: screen.visibleFrame.midY)
        }
        let frame = NSRect(origin: origin, size: Self.size)
        if panel.frame.origin.distance(to: frame.origin) > 1 { panel.setFrame(frame, display: true, animate: panel.isVisible) }
    }

    /// System Settings' window, from the window list (bounds need no permission).
    private static func settingsWindowFrame() -> NSRect? {
        guard let list = CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo([.optionOnScreenOnly, .excludeDesktopElements], kCGNullWindowID) as? [[String: Any]],
              let w = list.first(where: { ($0[kCGWindowOwnerName as String] as? String) == "System Settings"
                                          && ($0[kCGWindowLayer as String] as? Int) == 0 }),
              let b = w[kCGWindowBounds as String] as? [String: CGFloat],
              let x = b["X"], let y = b["Y"], let width = b["Width"], let height = b["Height"] else { return nil }
        let primaryHeight = NSScreen.screens.first?.frame.height ?? 0
        return NSRect(x: x, y: primaryHeight - y - height, width: width, height: height)
    }
}

private extension NSPoint {
    func distance(to p: NSPoint) -> CGFloat { hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y) }
}

private struct PermissionGuideView: View {
    let guide: PermissionGuide
    @State private var nudge = false

    /// The app macOS lists for this permission (from tccd's own attribution): the
    /// microphone is charged to the outer Nardo.app; Accessibility and Screen
    /// Recording are judged on this helper itself.
    private var appURL: URL {
        let here = Bundle.main.bundleURL
        guard guide.kind == .microphone, let r = here.path.range(of: ".app/Contents/Helpers/") else { return here }
        return URL(fileURLWithPath: String(here.path[..<r.lowerBound]) + ".app")
    }
    private var appName: String { FileManager.default.displayName(atPath: appURL.path).replacingOccurrences(of: ".app", with: "") }

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 32, style: .continuous)
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: guide.kind?.symbol ?? "lock").font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
                    .frame(width: 32, height: 32).background(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.3), in: Circle())
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                    Text(guide.kind?.title ?? "").font(.system(size: 14, weight: .semibold))
                    Text(guide.reason).font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.6)).lineLimit(2)
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                Button { guide.close() } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark").font(.system(size: 10, weight: .bold)).frame(width: 24, height: 24)
                        .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: Circle())
                }.buttonStyle(.plain).accessibilityLabel("Close")
            }
            if guide.done {
                done
            } else if guide.kind?.isDragList == true {
                dragTile
            } else {
                toggleHint
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .frame(width: 300, height: 236, alignment: .top)
        .glassEffect(.regular, in: shape)
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.4, dampingFraction: 0.7), value: guide.done)
    }

    /// The app itself, to drag into the Settings list.
    private var dragTile: some View {
        let inner = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous)
        return VStack(spacing: 6) {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(nsImage: NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: appURL.path)).resizable().frame(width: 52, height: 52)
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 6, y: 3)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(appName).font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    Text("Drag into the list").font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.65))
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                Image(systemName: guideArrow).font(.system(size: 18, weight: .bold)).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                    .offset(x: nudge ? (arrowPointsLeft ? -6 : 6) : 0)
                    .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.6).repeatForever(autoreverses: true), value: nudge)
            }
            .padding(12)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .background(.white.opacity(0.07), in: inner)
            .overlay(inner.strokeBorder(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.5), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1, dash: [5, 4])))
            .onDrag { NSItemProvider(contentsOf: appURL) ?? NSItemProvider() }
            .onAppear { nudge = true }
            Text("Or press + under the list and pick it from Applications.")
                .font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55)).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            waiting
        }
    }

    private var toggleHint: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(nsImage: NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: appURL.path)).resizable().frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                Text("Turn on \(appName) in the list").font(.system(size: 12.5, weight: .medium))
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                Image(systemName: "switch.2").foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
            }
            .padding(12).frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .background(.white.opacity(0.07), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous))
            waiting
        }
    }

    private var waiting: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
            Text("Waiting for the switch…").font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.6))
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    private var done: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill").font(.system(size: 44)).foregroundStyle(.green)
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: guide.done)
            Text(guide.kind?.needsRelaunch == true ? "Allowed. It takes effect after a relaunch." : "All set.")
                .font(.system(size: 12.5, weight: .medium))
            if guide.kind?.needsRelaunch == true {
                Button { guide.relaunch() } label: {
                    Text("Relaunch \(Edition.name)").font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 14).frame(height: 30)
                        .glassEffect(.regular.tint(.accentColor).interactive(), in: Capsule())
                }.buttonStyle(.plain)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .transition(.scale(scale: 0.8).combined(with: .opacity))
    }

    // Point toward the Settings window (the helper docks to its right when it can).
    private var arrowPointsLeft: Bool {
        guard let p = NSApp.windows.first(where: { $0.contentView is NSHostingView<PermissionGuideView> }) else { return true }
        return p.frame.midX > (NSScreen.main?.frame.midX ?? 0)
    }
    private var guideArrow: String { arrowPointsLeft ? "arrow.left" : "arrow.right" }
}
//
//  NardoMark.swift
//  The Nardo rosette (outputs/surface-edge/Assets/nardo.svg) as a shape, so the bar can
//  wear the app's mark at any size without a raster.
//

import SwiftUI

struct NardoMark: Shape {
    static let tint = Color.white

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        // The rosette is square to within 0.3%; fit it centered.
        let side = min(rect.width, rect.height)
        let origin = CGPoint(x: rect.midX - side / 2, y: rect.midY - side / 2)
        func p(_ x: CGFloat, _ y: CGFloat) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: origin.x + x * side, y: origin.y + y * side) }
        var path = Path()
        path.move(to: p(0.5000, 0.0000))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.6575, 0.2263), control1: p(0.6365, 0.0000), control2: p(0.6610, 0.2203))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.9317, 0.2500), control1: p(0.6610, 0.2203), control2: p(0.8635, 0.1314))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.8151, 0.5000), control1: p(1.0000, 0.3686), control2: p(0.8220, 0.5000))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.9317, 0.7500), control1: p(0.8220, 0.5000), control2: p(1.0000, 0.6314))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.6575, 0.7737), control1: p(0.8635, 0.8686), control2: p(0.6610, 0.7797))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.5000, 1.0000), control1: p(0.6610, 0.7797), control2: p(0.6365, 1.0000))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.3425, 0.7737), control1: p(0.3635, 1.0000), control2: p(0.3390, 0.7797))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.0683, 0.7500), control1: p(0.3390, 0.7797), control2: p(0.1365, 0.8686))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.1849, 0.5000), control1: p(0.0000, 0.6314), control2: p(0.1780, 0.5000))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.0683, 0.2500), control1: p(0.1780, 0.5000), control2: p(0.0000, 0.3686))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.3425, 0.2263), control1: p(0.1365, 0.1314), control2: p(0.3390, 0.2203))
        path.addCurve(to: p(0.5000, 0.0000), control1: p(0.3390, 0.2203), control2: p(0.3635, 0.0000))
        path.closeSubpath()
        return path
    }
}
//
//  Switcher.swift
//  Hold-⌥ sub-tab switching: ⌘Tab semantics scoped to one megatab.
//
//  ⌥` opens a session on the focused megatab. Each further ` press (hold for
//  key-repeat to scan) moves the selection WITHOUT activating anything — no
//  engine dispatch, no layout churn mid-cycle — and releasing Option commits
//  the selected tab in one go. Esc cancels. Plain typing fuzzy-filters.
//
//  There is no floating panel: the session renders inside the megatab card
//  itself (see BentoSidebar) — the card opens up, the selected tab's row
//  expands with context while its siblings compress, and the live query shows
//  in the workspace header. The web area previews the selection live.
//

import SwiftUI

@MainActor
@Observable
final class SubTabSwitcher {
    private(set) var allTabs: [Tab] = []
    private(set) var host: String = ""
    private(set) var groupId: String = ""
    private(set) var index: Int = 0
    /// Live fuzzy filter — fed by plain typing while the switcher is open.
    private(set) var query: String = ""

    var isOpen: Bool { !allTabs.isEmpty }

    /// The tab the session would commit right now. Index clamps rather than
    /// nils: a filter or mid-session tab close that shrinks the list keeps a
    /// valid selection instead of a dead Return key.
    var selectedId: String? { selectedTab?.id }

    private var selectedTab: Tab? {
        let matches = tabs
        guard !matches.isEmpty else { return nil }
        return matches[min(index, matches.count - 1)]
    }

    /// What the panel shows and ` cycles: everything, or the fuzzy matches
    /// ranked by match quality when a query is typed.
    var tabs: [Tab] {
        guard !query.isEmpty else { return allTabs }
        return allTabs
            .compactMap { tab in
                fuzzyScore(needle: query, haystack: tab.displayName + " " + tab.url)
                    .map { (tab, $0) }
            }
            .sorted { $0.1 > $1.1 }
            .map(\.0)
    }

    /// Open on a group, selection starting just past the currently active tab.
    func open(_ group: TabGroup, activeTabId: String?) {
        allTabs = group.switcherTabs
        host = group.host
        groupId = group.id
        query = ""
        let current = allTabs.firstIndex { $0.id == activeTabId } ?? 0
        index = allTabs.count > 1 ? (current + 1) % allTabs.count : 0
    }

    func advance(_ delta: Int) {
        let count = tabs.count
        guard count > 0 else { return }
        index = ((index + delta) % count + count) % count
    }

    func appendQuery(_ ch: Character) {
        query.append(ch)
        index = 0 // best match selected
    }

    func deleteQueryChar() {
        guard !query.isEmpty else { return }
        query.removeLast()
        index = 0
    }

    /// The selected tab; closes the switcher. Nil when the filter matched nothing.
    func commit() -> Tab? {
        let tab = selectedTab
        cancel()
        return tab
    }

    /// Drop tabs that no longer exist (closed mid-session) so the session
    /// tracks reality; selection stays valid via clamping.
    func prune(existing: Set<String>) {
        guard isOpen else { return }
        allTabs.removeAll { !existing.contains($0.id) }
    }

    func cancel() {
        allTabs = []
        host = ""
        groupId = ""
        query = ""
        index = 0
    }
}

/// Case-insensitive subsequence match. Consecutive hits and word-start hits
/// score higher; shorter haystacks win ties. `nil` = no match.
func fuzzyScore(needle: String, haystack: String) -> Double? {
    if needle.isEmpty { return 0 }
    let n = Array(needle.lowercased())
    let h = Array(haystack.lowercased())
    var score = 0.0
    var hi = 0
    var streak = 0.0
    for ch in n {
        var found = false
        while hi < h.count {
            if h[hi] == ch {
                streak += 1
                let wordStart = hi == 0 || h[hi - 1] == " " || h[hi - 1] == "." || h[hi - 1] == "/"
                score += 1 + streak * 0.5 + (wordStart ? 2 : 0)
                hi += 1
                found = true
                break
            }
            streak = 0
            hi += 1
        }
        if !found { return nil }
    }
    return score / Double(h.count + 1)
}
//
//  HistoryPanel.swift
//  Browsing-history management: a dimmed overlay (⌘Y, or Tools → History)
//  with search, per-entry delete, and clear-all. Rows open via the normal
//  create-tab path, so the duplicate-tab rule focuses an already-open copy.
//

import SwiftUI

@MainActor
@Observable
final class HistoryModel {
    static let shared = HistoryModel()
    var isOpen = false
    func toggle() { isOpen.toggle() }
}

struct HistoryOverlay: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @State private var model = HistoryModel.shared
    @State private var query = ""
    @State private var entries: [HistoryEntry] = []
    @State private var confirmingClear = false
    @FocusState private var searchFocused: Bool

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black.opacity(0.45).ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { model.isOpen = false }

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                header
                Divider().opacity(0.4)
                if entries.isEmpty {
                    VStack(spacing: 8) {
                        Icon("magnifying-glass", size: 22).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.25))
                        Text(query.isEmpty ? "No history yet" : "No matches")
                            .font(.pp(12.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                } else {
                    ScrollView(showsIndicators: false) {
                        VStack(spacing: 0) {
                            ForEach(entries) { entry in
                                HistoryRow(entry: entry, open: { open(entry) }) {
                                    HistoryStore.shared.delete(url: entry.url)
                                    refresh()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        .padding(.vertical, 6)
                    }
                    .thinOverlayScroller()
                }
                Divider().opacity(0.4)
                footer
            }
            .frame(width: 560, height: 480)
            .background(GlassPanel(material: .popover))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous)
                    .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 1)
            )
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.4), radius: 30, y: 12)
        }
        .task(id: query) { refresh() }
        .onExitCommand { model.isOpen = false }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Icon("magnifying-glass", size: 13).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
            TextField("Search history", text: $query)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain).font(.pp(14))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.92))
                .focused($searchFocused)
                .onAppear { searchFocused = true }
            Spacer()
            Text("⌘Y").font(.pp(11, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35))
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16).padding(.vertical, 13)
    }

    private var footer: some View {
        HStack {
            Text("\(entries.count) shown")
                .font(.pp(11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35))
            Spacer()
            if confirmingClear {
                Button("Really clear all history?") {
                    HistoryStore.shared.clear()
                    confirmingClear = false
                    refresh()
                }
                .font(.pp(11.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.red.opacity(0.9))
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
            } else {
                Button("Clear history") { confirmingClear = true }
                    .font(.pp(11.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16).padding(.vertical, 10)
    }

    private func refresh() {
        entries = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty
            ? HistoryStore.shared.recent(limit: 200)
            : HistoryStore.shared.search(query, limit: 200)
    }

    private func open(_ entry: HistoryEntry) {
        engine.dispatch(.createTab(
            spaceId: engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.id,
            url: entry.url, activate: true))
        model.isOpen = false
    }
}

private struct HistoryRow: View {
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    let entry: HistoryEntry
    let open: () -> Void
    let delete: () -> Void
    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            FaviconView(host: entry.host, accent: .gray, size: 16)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                Text(entry.title.isEmpty ? entry.url : entry.title)
                    .font(.pp(12.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                    .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
                Text(entry.host)
                    .font(.pp(10.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4))
                    .lineLimit(1)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 8)
            Text(entry.lastVisit, style: .relative)
                .font(.pp(10.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.3))
            if hovering {
                Button(action: delete) {
                    Icon("x-mark", size: 10).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.5))
                        .frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                        .background(Circle().fill(.white.opacity(0.08)))
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .help("Remove from history")
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 14).padding(.vertical, 7)
        .background(hovering ? Color.white.opacity(0.06) : .clear)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture(perform: open)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .task { favicons.ensure(host: entry.host, faviconURL: nil) }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeBarWords.swift
//  Small words the bar understands (docs/features/bar-words.md): `timer 25m`, `pomodoro`,
//  `mute`, `airpods` / `output <name>`, `define`, `translate`, `color`, `:fire`, `kill :3000`.
//  This file is only the reading of the query (pure Foundation, so tools/bar-words-test can
//  compile it alone); the cards and what ↵ does live in EdgeBarWordCards.swift.
//

import Foundation

enum BarWord: Equatable {
    /// `timer 25m tea`, `pomodoro`: a timer to start (↵), plus the running ones.
    case timer(TimerRequest)
    /// `timer`, `timers`: presets and the running timers.
    case timers
    case mic(MicRequest)
    /// `airpods`, `speakers`, `output`, `output <name>`: output devices, matches first.
    case output(String)
    case define(String)
    case translate(TranslateRequest)
    case colorPick
    /// `:fire`, `emoji fire`, `emoji` (empty term: the common ones).
    case emoji(String)
    /// `:3000`, `port 3000`, `kill :3000`.
    case port(Int)
    /// `battery`, `bluetooth`, `connect sony`, `disconnect airpods` (EdgeSystemWords.swift).
    case devices(DevicesRequest)
    /// `cpu`, `memory`, `top`, `quit slack`, `force quit chrome`.
    case activity(ActivityRequest)
    /// `eject`, `eject all`, `eject sandisk`.
    case eject(EjectRequest)

    struct TimerRequest: Equatable {
        var seconds: Int
        var label: String
        /// Pomodoro focus: a break of this length starts when it ends.
        var breakSeconds: Int? = nil
    }

    enum MicRequest: Equatable { case mute, unmute, toggle }

    struct TranslateRequest: Equatable {
        /// Empty: translate what's on the clipboard (`translate`, `translate to french`), so a
        /// text grab (Caps+S, T) followed by `translate` reads a sign or a subtitle.
        var text: String
        /// BCP-47 ("es", "zh-Hans"); nil = pick a default (the card does).
        var target: String?
    }

    /// Stable card id suffix.
    var id: String {
        switch self {
        case .timer, .timers: "timer"
        case .mic: "mic"
        case .output: "output"
        case .define: "define"
        case .translate: "translate"
        case .colorPick: "colorpick"
        case .emoji: "emoji"
        case .port: "port"
        case .devices: "devices"
        case .activity: "activity"
        case .eject: "eject"
        }
    }

    static func parse(_ raw: String) -> BarWord? {
        let q = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !q.isEmpty, q.count <= 500 else { return nil }
        let l = q.lowercased().replacingOccurrences(of: #"\s+"#, with: " ", options: .regularExpression)
        if let w = readTimer(l) { return w }
        if let w = readMic(l) { return w }
        if let w = readOutput(l) { return w }
        if let w = readPort(l) { return w }
        if let w = readSystem(l) { return w }
        if let w = readEmoji(q, l) { return w }
        if ["color", "colour", "pick color", "pick colour", "color picker", "colour picker", "eyedropper", "pipette", "sample color", "pick a color"].contains(l) {
            return .colorPick
        }
        if let w = readDefine(q, l) { return w }
        if let w = readTranslate(q, l) { return w }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Timer

    static let pomodoroFocus = 25 * 60
    static let pomodoroBreak = 5 * 60

    private static func readTimer(_ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        if ["timer", "timers", "set timer", "set a timer"].contains(l) { return .timers }
        if l == "pomodoro" || l == "pomo" || l == "focus timer" {
            return .timer(TimerRequest(seconds: pomodoroFocus, label: "Focus", breakSeconds: pomodoroBreak))
        }
        for p in ["pomodoro ", "pomo "] where l.hasPrefix(p) {
            // `pomodoro 50`, `pomodoro 50 10` (focus, break; bare numbers are minutes).
            let parts = l.dropFirst(p.count).split(separator: " ").map(String.init)
            guard let focus = parts.first.flatMap({ duration($0) }), parts.count <= 2 else { return nil }
            let rest = parts.count == 2 ? duration(parts[1]) : pomodoroBreak
            guard let rest else { return nil }
            return .timer(TimerRequest(seconds: focus, label: "Focus", breakSeconds: rest))
        }
        var body: Substring?
        for p in ["set a timer for ", "set a timer ", "set timer for ", "set timer ", "timer for ", "timer "] where l.hasPrefix(p) {
            body = l.dropFirst(p.count); break
        }
        if body == nil, l.hasSuffix(" timer"), !l.hasPrefix("timer") { body = l.dropLast(6) }
        // "tea timer 4m"
        if body == nil, let r = l.range(of: " timer "), !l.hasPrefix("timer") { body = Substring(l[..<r.lowerBound] + " " + l[r.upperBound...]) }
        guard let body else { return nil }
        guard let (seconds, label) = durationAndLabel(String(body)) else { return nil }
        return .timer(TimerRequest(seconds: seconds, label: label))
    }

    /// "1h30m tea", "5 min", "tea 90s", "1:30", "25" (minutes). Words that aren't part of
    /// the duration are the label. Nil when there's no duration or it's over 24 hours.
    static func durationAndLabel(_ text: String) -> (Int, String)? {
        let tokens = text.split(separator: " ").map(String.init)
        var total = 0
        var found = false
        var label: [String] = []
        var i = 0
        while i < tokens.count {
            let t = tokens[i]
            // "5 min": a number, then a unit word.
            if let n = Double(t), i + 1 < tokens.count, let unit = unitSeconds(tokens[i + 1]) {
                total += Int((n * Double(unit)).rounded()); found = true; i += 2; continue
            }
            if let s = duration(t, bareMinutes: !found) { total += s; found = true; i += 1; continue }
            if ["and", "for", "a", "an"].contains(t), found || i + 1 < tokens.count { i += 1; continue }
            label.append(t); i += 1
        }
        guard found, total > 0, total <= 24 * 3600 else { return nil }
        let name = label.joined(separator: " ")
        return (total, name.isEmpty ? "Timer" : name.prefix(1).uppercased() + name.dropFirst())
    }

    /// One token: "25m", "1h30m", "90s", "1.5h", "1:30" (m:ss), "1:02:03", "25" (minutes).
    static func duration(_ token: String, bareMinutes: Bool = true) -> Int? {
        let t = token.lowercased()
        if t.contains(":") {
            let parts = t.split(separator: ":", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).map { Int($0) }
            guard parts.allSatisfy({ $0 != nil }), (2...3).contains(parts.count) else { return nil }
            let v = parts.map { $0! }
            guard v.dropFirst().allSatisfy({ $0 < 60 }) else { return nil }
            let s = v.count == 2 ? v[0] * 60 + v[1] : v[0] * 3600 + v[1] * 60 + v[2]
            return s > 0 ? s : nil
        }
        if bareMinutes, let n = Double(t), n > 0 { return Int((n * 60).rounded()) }
        // Runs of <number><unit>: "1h30m", "2m30s".
        var total = 0.0, number = "", unit = "", matched = false
        func flush() -> Bool {
            guard let n = Double(number), let u = unitSeconds(unit) else { return false }
            total += n * Double(u); number = ""; unit = ""; matched = true
            return true
        }
        for c in t {
            if c.isNumber || c == "." {
                if !unit.isEmpty { guard flush() else { return nil } }
                number.append(c)
            } else if c.isLetter {
                guard !number.isEmpty else { return nil }
                unit.append(c)
            } else { return nil }
        }
        guard !number.isEmpty, !unit.isEmpty, flush(), matched, total > 0 else { return nil }
        return Int(total.rounded())
    }

    static func unitSeconds(_ u: String) -> Int? {
        switch u {
        case "s", "sec", "secs", "second", "seconds": 1
        case "m", "min", "mins", "minute", "minutes": 60
        case "h", "hr", "hrs", "hour", "hours": 3600
        default: nil
        }
    }

    // MARK: Mic

    private static func readMic(_ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        switch l {
        case "mute", "mute mic", "mute microphone", "mic off", "microphone off": .mic(.mute)
        case "unmute", "unmute mic", "unmute microphone", "mic on", "microphone on": .mic(.unmute)
        case "mic", "microphone", "toggle mic", "mic mute": .mic(.toggle)
        default: nil
        }
    }

    // MARK: Output

    private static func readOutput(_ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        switch l {
        case "output", "outputs", "sound output", "audio output", "audio", "sound", "output device", "audio devices": return .output("")
        case "airpods", "airpod": return .output("airpods")
        case "speakers", "speaker": return .output("speaker")
        case "headphones", "headphone": return .output("headphone")
        default: break
        }
        for p in ["output ", "sound output ", "audio output ", "play through ", "switch to "] where l.hasPrefix(p) {
            let name = String(l.dropFirst(p.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            if !name.isEmpty { return .output(name) }
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Port

    private static func readPort(_ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        var t = l
        for p in ["kill ", "free "] where t.hasPrefix(p) { t = String(t.dropFirst(p.count)); break }
        if t.hasPrefix("port ") { t = String(t.dropFirst(5)) }
        else if t.hasPrefix(":") { t = String(t.dropFirst()) }
        else { return nil }
        t = t.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        if t.hasPrefix(":") { t = String(t.dropFirst()) }
        guard !t.isEmpty, t.count <= 5, t.allSatisfy(\.isASCII), t.allSatisfy(\.isNumber),
              let n = Int(t), (1...65535).contains(n) else { return nil }
        return .port(n)
    }

    // MARK: Emoji

    private static func readEmoji(_ q: String, _ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        if l == "emoji" || l == "emojis" { return .emoji("") }
        for p in ["emoji ", "emojis "] where l.hasPrefix(p) {
            return .emoji(String(l.dropFirst(p.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces))
        }
        // ":fire", ":thumbs up" (letters after the colon; ":3000" is a port).
        if l.hasPrefix(":"), l.count >= 2, l.count <= 40 {
            let term = String(l.dropFirst()).trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: ": "))
            guard let first = term.first, first.isLetter else { return nil }
            return .emoji(term)
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Define

    private static func readDefine(_ q: String, _ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        for p in ["define ", "definition of ", "meaning of ", "dict "] where l.hasPrefix(p) {
            let word = String(q.dropFirst(p.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines.union(CharacterSet(charactersIn: "?.!")))
            guard !word.isEmpty, word.count <= 60 else { return nil }
            return .define(word)
        }
        if l.hasPrefix("what does "), l.hasSuffix(" mean") || l.hasSuffix(" mean?") {
            let inner = String(q.dropFirst(10)).replacingOccurrences(of: #"\s+mean\??$"#, with: "", options: [.regularExpression, .caseInsensitive])
            let word = inner.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            if !word.isEmpty, word.count <= 60 { return .define(word) }
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Translate

    private static func readTranslate(_ q: String, _ l: String) -> BarWord? {
        if ["translate", "translate clipboard", "translate this", "translate that", "translate it"].contains(l) {
            return .translate(TranslateRequest(text: "", target: nil))
        }
        guard l.hasPrefix("translate ") else { return nil }
        var words = q.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).dropFirst(10).split(separator: " ", omittingEmptySubsequences: true).map(String.init)
        var target: String?
        // "translate to french hello" / "translate into ja: hello"
        if let first = words.first?.lowercased(), first == "to" || first == "into" {
            for n in [2, 1] where words.count > n {
                let name = words[1...n].joined(separator: " ").trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: ":,"))
                if let code = BarWordLanguage.code(for: name) {
                    target = code; words.removeFirst(n + 1); break
                }
            }
        }
        // "translate hello to french" / "… into brazilian portuguese"
        if target == nil {
            for n in [2, 1] where words.count > n + 1 {
                let marker = words[words.count - n - 1].lowercased()
                guard marker == "to" || marker == "into" || marker == "in" else { continue }
                let name = words.suffix(n).joined(separator: " ")
                if let code = BarWordLanguage.code(for: name) {
                    target = code; words.removeLast(n + 1); break
                }
            }
        }
        var text = words.joined(separator: " ").trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        // "translate clipboard to french", "translate this into ja"
        if ["clipboard", "this", "that", "it"].contains(text.lowercased()) { text = "" }
        guard !text.isEmpty || target != nil else { return nil }
        return .translate(TranslateRequest(text: text, target: target))
    }
}

/// Language names → BCP-47 codes for `translate … to <language>`.
enum BarWordLanguage {
    /// The languages Apple's on-device translation offers (macOS 26), in chip order.
    static let common = ["en", "es", "fr", "de", "it", "pt", "ar", "zh-Hans", "ja", "ko", "ru", "tr", "nl", "pl", "uk", "hi", "id", "th", "vi", "zh-Hant"]

    private static let aliases: [String: String] = [
        "chinese": "zh-Hans", "mandarin": "zh-Hans", "simplified chinese": "zh-Hans", "traditional chinese": "zh-Hant",
        "cantonese": "yue", "farsi": "fa", "persian": "fa", "brazilian": "pt-BR", "brazilian portuguese": "pt-BR",
        "european portuguese": "pt-PT", "mexican spanish": "es-MX", "british english": "en-GB", "american english": "en-US",
        "egyptian": "ar", "egyptian arabic": "ar", "filipino": "fil", "tagalog": "fil",
    ]

    private static let table: [String: String] = {
        var t: [String: String] = [:]
        let en = Locale(identifier: "en")
        let codes = Set(Locale.availableIdentifiers.compactMap { Locale(identifier: $0).language.languageCode?.identifier })
        for code in codes {
            if let name = en.localizedString(forLanguageCode: code)?.lowercased() { t[name] = t[name] ?? code }
            if let native = Locale(identifier: code).localizedString(forLanguageCode: code)?.lowercased() { t[native] = t[native] ?? code }
        }
        for (k, v) in aliases { t[k] = v }
        return t
    }()

    static func code(for raw: String) -> String? {
        let name = raw.lowercased().trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines.union(CharacterSet(charactersIn: ":,.")))
        guard !name.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if let code = table[name] { return code }
        // Bare codes: "es", "ja", "zh-hans", "pt-br".
        let canonical = Locale.canonicalLanguageIdentifier(from: name)
        if common.contains(where: { $0.lowercased() == name }) { return common.first { $0.lowercased() == name } }
        if name.count == 2 || (name.count == 3 && !name.contains("-")),
           Locale(identifier: "en").localizedString(forLanguageCode: canonical) != nil,
           Locale.LanguageCode(name).isISOLanguage { return canonical }
        if name.contains("-"), let base = name.split(separator: "-").first, Locale.LanguageCode(String(base)).isISOLanguage { return canonical }
        return nil
    }

    /// "Spanish" for "es", in the user's language.
    static func name(_ code: String) -> String {
        Locale.current.localizedString(forIdentifier: code)?.capitalized(with: Locale.current) ?? code
    }
}
//
//  EdgeTerminal.swift
//  A terminal in the edge stack: the third size of bottom-attached sheet (bar → cards →
//  terminal), much wider and taller, running off the bottom of the screen like the bar.
//  Caps+T toggles it; the bar, dictation and cards stack on top of it.
//  libghostty-vt understands the shell (EdgeVT); everything you see is drawn here.
//

import AppKit
import Carbon
import os
import SwiftUI

/// The terminal's sessions. Their shells live in edge-ptyd, so they outlive the app: on
/// launch the host gets every one back from a snapshot. One is on the sheet at a time;
/// Caps+T brings up whichever wants you (a long command done, a bell, a notification),
/// else the one you used last.
@MainActor final class EdgeTerminalHost {
    static let shared = EdgeTerminalHost()
    let look = EdgeTermLook()
    /// Sessions in the order they were made (their numbers: ⌘1…⌘9).
    private(set) var sessions: [EdgeTermView] = []
    /// Most recently used first.
    private var recent: [EdgeTermView] = []
    private(set) var active: EdgeTermView?
    private lazy var placeholder = EdgeTermView()
    /// What the sheet shows: the active session's view, swapped in place.
    let container = EdgeTermContainer()
    /// The sheet's slot (the window has its own); the container moves between them.
    weak var sheetSlot: EdgeTermSlot?
    private var started = false
    /// Views waiting for edge-ptyd to make their shell (answers come in order).
    private var pendingNew: [EdgeTermView] = []
    /// Sessions edge-ptyd still had, coming back from snapshots.
    private var restoring: [String: Date] = [:]
    private var restoringIDs: Set<String> = []
    private let log = Logger(subsystem: "com.hashawn.nardo.perf", category: "terminal")

    /// The session on the sheet (or a blank one before any exists).
    var view: EdgeTermView { active ?? placeholder }
    var status: EdgeTermStatus { view.status }

    /// First use: reach edge-ptyd and bring every live shell back, or start one.
    func startIfNeeded() {
        guard !started else { return }
        started = true
        let client = EdgePtydClient.shared
        client.onHello = { [weak self] infos in
            guard let self else { return }
            let note = "ptyd hello: " + String(infos.count) + " sessions, have " + String(self.sessions.count)
            self.log.info("\(note, privacy: .public)")
            if infos.isEmpty { if self.sessions.isEmpty { self.newSession() }; return }
            for info in infos {
                // Sessions already on screen come back too (after edge-ptyd upgraded itself).
                if self.sessions.contains(where: { $0.sessionID == info.id }) { client.attach(info.id); continue }
                self.restoringIDs.insert(info.id)
                if let at = info.attentionAt { self.restoring[info.id] = at }
                client.attach(info.id)
            }
        }
        client.onAttached = { [weak self] shell, attached, snapshot in
            self?.attached(shell, attached, snapshot)
        }
        client.onLost = { [weak self] in
            // edge-ptyd died: its shells went with it. Start over (a new one is spawned).
            guard let self else { return }
            self.started = false
            DispatchQueue.main.async { if SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true { self.startIfNeeded() } }
        }
        if !client.connect() {
            // No edge-ptyd (missing or blocked): a local shell, which ends with the app.
            let v = EdgeTermView()
            add(v)
            v.startLocal()
        }
    }

    private func attached(_ shell: EdgeRemoteShell, _ a: EdgePtyd.Attached, _ snapshot: [UInt8]) {
        let view: EdgeTermView
        var attention: Date?
        let note = "ptyd attached " + shell.id + " restoring=" + String(restoringIDs.contains(shell.id)) + " pending=" + String(pendingNew.count)
        log.info("\(note, privacy: .public)")
        if let existing = sessions.first(where: { $0.sessionID == shell.id }) {
            existing.adopt(shell, snapshot: snapshot, blocks: a.blocks, id: shell.id)
            if existing === active, SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true { focus() }
            return
        }
        if restoringIDs.remove(shell.id) != nil {
            view = EdgeTermView()
            attention = restoring.removeValue(forKey: shell.id)
            add(view, activate: active == nil)
        } else if !pendingNew.isEmpty {
            view = pendingNew.removeFirst()
        } else {
            view = EdgeTermView()
            add(view, activate: false)
        }
        view.frame = container.bounds
        view.adopt(shell, snapshot: snapshot, blocks: a.blocks, id: shell.id)
        if let attention { view.needsYouAt = attention }
        if view === active, SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true { focus() }
    }

    private func add(_ view: EdgeTermView, activate: Bool = true) {
        sessions.append(view)
        recent.append(view)
        view.frame = container.bounds
        if activate { show(view) }
    }

    /// ⌘T: a new shell, in the folder you're in.
    func newSession() {
        let note = "terminal new session, have " + String(sessions.count) + " connected=" + String(EdgePtydClient.shared.connected)
        log.info("\(note, privacy: .public)")
        let view = EdgeTermView()
        let directory = active?.directory ?? FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path
        add(view)
        if EdgePtydClient.shared.connected {
            pendingNew.append(view)
            let (cols, rows) = view.gridForSize(container.bounds.size)
            EdgePtydClient.shared.create(cols: cols, rows: rows, directory: directory)
        } else {
            view.startLocal()
        }
        focus()
    }

    /// Scripted checks: end-to-end throughput in a hidden session of its own (yours are
    /// untouched): `cat` a file through shell → edge-ptyd → app, timed until the app has
    /// read the last byte off its terminal. Writes Caches/com.hashawn.nardo/termthroughput.json.
    func benchThroughput(_ path: String) {
        startIfNeeded()   // connected to edge-ptyd first (the terminal may not have been opened yet)
        guard EdgePtydClient.shared.connected else { return }
        let view = EdgeTermView()
        view.frame = container.bounds
        sessions.append(view)
        pendingNew.append(view)
        EdgePtydClient.shared.create(cols: 200, rows: 50, directory: "/tmp")
        func wait(_ tries: Int) {
            guard view.isLive else {
                if tries > 0 { DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) { wait(tries - 1) } }
                return
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.8) {   // let the shell reach its prompt
                view.benchCat(path) { result in
                    let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
                    if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: result, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]) {
                        try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termthroughput.json"))
                    }
                    view.hangUp()
                }
            }
        }
        wait(50)
    }

    /// ⌘W: hang up the session's shell (the sheet moves to the next one).
    func close(_ view: EdgeTermView) { view.hangUp() }

    /// A shell ended (exit, ⌘W, or it was lost).
    func ended(_ view: EdgeTermView) {
        sessions.removeAll { $0 === view }
        recent.removeAll { $0 === view }
        pendingNew.removeAll { $0 === view }
        guard active === view else { return }
        active = nil
        if let next = recent.first {
            show(next)
            focus()
        } else {
            container.show(placeholder)
            started = false
            SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen = false   // the last one: the sheet goes away
            if EdgeTerminalWindow.shared.detached { EdgeTerminalWindow.shared.hide() }
        }
    }

    func select(_ index: Int) {
        guard sessions.indices.contains(index) else { return }
        show(sessions[index]); focus()
    }

    /// ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab through sessions in order.
    func cycle(_ step: Int) {
        guard let active, let i = sessions.firstIndex(where: { $0 === active }), sessions.count > 1 else { return }
        select((i + step + sessions.count) % sessions.count)
    }

    func select(id: String) {
        if let v = sessions.first(where: { $0.sessionID == id }) { show(v) }
    }

    /// Caps+T is about to open the terminal: put the session that wants you on the sheet.
    func prepareToOpen() {
        startIfNeeded()
        if let wanted = sessions.filter({ $0.needsYouAt != nil }).max(by: { $0.needsYouAt! < $1.needsYouAt! }) {
            show(wanted)
        } else if active == nil, let last = recent.first {
            show(last)
        }
    }

    private func show(_ view: EdgeTermView) {
        active = view
        recent.removeAll { $0 === view }
        recent.insert(view, at: 0)
        container.show(view)
        view.needsYouAt = nil
        reportFocus()
    }

    func focus() {
        if EdgeTermConfig.reloadIfChanged() {
            look.config = EdgeTermConfig.current
            sessions.forEach { $0.applyConfig() }
        }
        startIfNeeded()
        view.window?.makeFirstResponder(view)
        reportFocus()
    }

    /// Tells edge-ptyd which session you're looking at (it records no attention for that one).
    func reportFocus() {
        let looking = SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true && view.window?.isKeyWindow == true
        EdgePtydClient.shared.focus(looking ? active?.sessionID : nil)
        if looking, let id = active?.sessionID { EdgeTermPeek.shared.seen(session: id) }
    }

    /// Sessions for the hold-⌘ line: number, active, wants you.
    var roster: [(number: Int, active: Bool, wanted: Bool)] {
        sessions.enumerated().map { ($0.offset + 1, $0.element === active, $0.element.needsYouAt != nil) }
    }
}

/// Holds whichever session is on the sheet; the views keep their size when swapped out.
final class EdgeTermContainer: NSView {
    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }
    func show(_ view: EdgeTermView) {
        guard view.superview !== self else { return }
        subviews.forEach { $0.removeFromSuperview() }
        view.frame = bounds
        view.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
        addSubview(view)
    }
    override func setFrameSize(_ newSize: NSSize) {
        super.setFrameSize(newSize)
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.sessions.forEach { if $0.superview == nil { $0.frame = bounds } } }
    }
}

/// Your terminal config, observed by the sheet (its fill follows your background).
@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeTermLook {
    var config = EdgeTermConfig.current
}

private struct EdgeTerminalViewRep: NSViewRepresentable {
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> EdgeTermSlot {
        let slot = EdgeTermSlot()
        EdgeTerminalHost.shared.sheetSlot = slot
        if !EdgeTerminalWindow.shared.detached { slot.adopt() }
        return slot
    }
    func updateNSView(_ slot: EdgeTermSlot, context: Context) {
        if !EdgeTerminalWindow.shared.detached { slot.adopt() }
    }
}

/// A place the terminal can be: the sheet under the bar, or its own window. Only one
/// holds the container at a time; SwiftUI tearing a slot down never takes the
/// terminal with it (it was adopted by the other slot first).
final class EdgeTermSlot: NSView {
    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }
    func adopt() {
        MainActor.assumeIsolated {
            let container = EdgeTerminalHost.shared.container
            guard container.superview !== self else { return }
            container.removeFromSuperview()
            container.frame = bounds
            container.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
            addSubview(container)
        }
    }
}

/// The terminal you see: a cell grid drawn with Core Text, a cursor that glides between
/// cells instead of jumping, selection, scrollback, and the Mac keymap.
final class EdgeTermView: NSView {
    fileprivate var vt: EdgeVT?
    private var pty: EdgeShell = EdgePTY()
    /// edge-ptyd's name for this session ("" for a local shell).
    private(set) var sessionID = ""
    /// What this session's shell is up to (folder, git, ports, what's running).
    let status = EdgeTermStatus()
    /// When something here last wanted you while you weren't looking (nil: nothing).
    var needsYouAt: Date?
    var directory: String? { vt.map { $0.pwd }.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 } }

    private var config = EdgeTermConfig.current
    private var fontSize = EdgeTermConfig.current.fontSize
    private var fonts: [NSFont] = []          // regular, bold, italic, bold italic
    private var cellWidth: CGFloat = 8
    private var cellHeight: CGFloat = 17
    private var textInset: CGFloat = 0        // top of the line box → top of the glyphs' box
    private var glyphKern: CGFloat = 0        // pads each glyph's advance to the cell width
    /// The grid sits inside the sheet with your padding (never so little that the sheet's
    /// rounded top corners cut into the first row); edge cells' backgrounds extend into it.
    fileprivate var padding: NSEdgeInsets {
        let x = max(config.paddingX, 16), y = max(config.paddingY, 12)
        return NSEdgeInsets(top: y, left: x, bottom: y, right: x)
    }
    private var origin: CGPoint { CGPoint(x: padding.left, y: padding.top) }

    // The cursor glides: drawn at `cursorDrawn`, springing toward the real cell.
    private var cursorDrawn = CGPoint.zero
    private var cursorVelocity = CGPoint.zero
    private var cursorPlaced = false
    private var link: CADisplayLink?
    private var lastTick: CFTimeInterval?

    // Hold ⌘: links underline, command edges show, a one-line context appears.
    private var xray = false
    private var xrayWork: DispatchWorkItem?
    private var linkSpans: [Int: [(range: Range<Int>, target: String)]] = [:]
    private var pendingLink: String?
    // ⌘F: the bottom row becomes a query line.
    private var searching = false
    private var query = ""
    private var matches: [Int: [(Range<Int>, Bool)]] = [:]
    // Mouse: a press either goes to the program (it asked for mouse reports) or selects.
    private var mouseReported = false
    private var autoscrollTimer: Timer?
    private var lastDrag = NSPoint.zero
    private var secureInput = false
    private var scrollRemainder: CGFloat = 0
    /// Smooth scrolling: `scrollPixels` is how far the view sits above the bottom, in
    /// points. The terminal is scrolled ceil(pixels / row) rows and the grid drawn shifted
    /// up by the rest, with the row below the screen filling the gap.
    private var scrollPixels: CGFloat = 0
    private var scrollTarget: CGFloat?        // mouse wheels glide here; trackpads follow the finger
    private var scrollVelocity: CGFloat = 0
    private var scrollShift: CGFloat = 0
    /// Row y's top edge, scroll shift included.
    private func rowTop(_ y: Int) -> CGFloat { origin.y - scrollShift + CGFloat(y) * cellHeight }
    private var refreshQueued = false

    // Command blocks (shell integration): drawn as rails in the left padding.
    let blocks = EdgeTermBlocks()
    private var hoveredBlock: Int?
    private var selectedBlock: Int?
    /// Blocks on screen as of the last refresh/scroll: viewport rows (may run past the edges).
    private var visibleBlocks: [(block: EdgeTermBlock, top: Int, bottom: Int)] = []
    private var gutterPress: (block: EdgeTermBlock, at: NSPoint)?
    private var trackingArea: NSTrackingArea?
    fileprivate var vtCursor: EdgeCursor? { vt?.cursor }
    fileprivate var cellSize: CGSize { CGSize(width: cellWidth, height: cellHeight) }

    override init(frame: NSRect) {
        super.init(frame: frame)
        wantsLayer = true
        layer?.backgroundColor = .clear
        rebuildFonts()
    }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError() }

    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }
    override var acceptsFirstResponder: Bool { true }
    override func acceptsFirstMouse(for event: NSEvent?) -> Bool { true }
    override func becomeFirstResponder() -> Bool {
        needsDisplay = true
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.updateSecureInput(); MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.reportFocus() } }
        return true
    }
    override func resignFirstResponder() -> Bool {
        needsDisplay = true
        cancelXray()
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.updateSecureInput(); MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.reportFocus() } }
        return true
    }

    /// A password prompt (the program turned echo off): macOS secure keyboard entry while
    /// the terminal has the keyboard, so no other process can read the keystrokes.
    private func updateSecureInput() {
        let want = pty.echoDisabled && window?.firstResponder === self && window?.isKeyWindow == true
        guard want != secureInput else { return }
        secureInput = want
        if want { EnableSecureEventInput() } else { DisableSecureEventInput() }
    }

    // MARK: Shell

    /// Grid size for a sheet of `size` (before the view is laid out).
    func gridForSize(_ size: NSSize) -> (Int, Int) {
        (max(10, Int((size.width - padding.left - padding.right) / cellWidth)),
         max(3, Int((size.height - padding.top - padding.bottom) / cellHeight)))
    }

    /// A shell in this process (no edge-ptyd): it ends with the app.
    func startLocal() {
        let (cols, rows) = gridSize()
        guard let vt = EdgeVT(cols: cols, rows: rows) else { return }
        let local = EdgePTY()
        let shell = EdgeShellIntegration.defaultShell
        let launch = EdgeShellIntegration.launch(shell: shell)
        guard local.start(shell: shell, directory: FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path,
                          environment: launch.environment, arguments: launch.arguments, login: launch.login,
                          cols: cols, rows: rows) else { return }
        connect(local, vt: vt, replies: true)
    }

    /// A shell edge-ptyd owns, picked up from its snapshot (or brand new).
    func adopt(_ shell: EdgeRemoteShell, snapshot: [UInt8], blocks records: [EdgeTermBlocks.Record], id: String) {
        sessionID = id
        let (cols, rows) = gridSize()
        guard let vt = EdgeVT(snapshot: snapshot, cols: cols, rows: rows) ?? EdgeVT(cols: cols, rows: rows) else { return }
        blocks.restore(records, vt: vt)
        // edge-ptyd answers the shell's queries; this copy only draws.
        connect(shell, vt: vt, replies: false)
    }

    private func connect(_ shell: EdgeShell, vt: EdgeVT, replies: Bool) {
        self.vt = vt
        pty = shell
        vt.apply(config)
        if replies { vt.onReply = { [weak self] bytes in self?.pty.write(bytes) } }
        vt.onMark = { [weak self, weak vt] mark in
            guard let self, let vt else { return }
            self.blocks.handle(mark, vt: vt)
            let status = self.status
            switch mark {
            case .promptStart: let dir = vt.pwd; MainActor.assumeIsolated { status.prompt(in: dir) }
            case .outputStart(let command): MainActor.assumeIsolated { status.started(command) }
            case .commandEnd: break
            }
        }
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { status.attach { [weak self] in self?.pty.pid ?? 0 } }
        blocks.onFinished = { [weak self] block in self?.commandFinished(block) }
        vt.onRenderRelease = { [weak self] in self?.queueRefresh() }
        vt.onAttention = { [weak self] title, body in
            guard let self else { return }
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                self.status.attention()
                self.wantsYou()
                EdgeTermPeek.shared.attention(title: title, body: body, sessionID: self.sessionID, terminalVisible: self.onScreen)
            }
        }
        vt.onBell = { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            let line = self.lastScreenLine()
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                self.status.attention()
                self.wantsYou()
                EdgeTermPeek.shared.bell(lastLine: line, sessionID: self.sessionID, terminalVisible: self.onScreen)
            }
        }
        shell.onOutput = { [weak self] bytes in
            guard let self else { return }
            if self.probeKeyAt != nil, self.probeEchoAt == nil { self.probeEchoAt = CACurrentMediaTime() }
            if let w = self.benchWatch, Self.contains(bytes, w.sentinel) {
                self.vt?.write(bytes); _ = self.vt?.refresh()   // the last bytes, on the model
                w.done([:])
                return
            }
            self.vt?.write(bytes)
            self.queueRefresh()
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self.status.output() }
        }
        shell.onExit = { [weak self] _ in
            guard let self else { return }
            self.vt = nil
            self.needsDisplay = true
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                self.status.shellEnded()
                EdgeTerminalHost.shared.ended(self)
            }
        }
        relayoutGrid()
        if let dir = Optional(vt.pwd), !dir.isEmpty { MainActor.assumeIsolated { status.prompt(in: dir) } }
        updateVisibleBlocks()
        queueRefresh()
    }

    func hangUp() { pty.terminate() }
    private static func contains(_ hay: [UInt8], _ needle: [UInt8]) -> Bool {
        guard let first = needle.first, hay.count >= needle.count else { return false }
        var i = 0
        while i <= hay.count - needle.count {
            if hay[i] == first, Array(hay[i..<(i + needle.count)]) == needle { return true }
            i += 1
        }
        return false
    }
    var isLive: Bool { vt != nil }

    private var benchWatch: (sentinel: [UInt8], started: CFTimeInterval, bytes: Int, done: ([String: Any]) -> Void)?

    /// Runs `cat path` three times and times each until its sentinel has been read off the
    /// app's terminal (everything before it parsed and on the screen model).
    fileprivate func benchCat(_ path: String, done: @escaping ([String: Any]) -> Void) {
        var runs: [Double] = []
        func one() {
            guard runs.count < 3 else {
                let sorted = runs.sorted()
                let size = (try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: path)[.size] as? Int) ?? 0
                done(["runsSeconds": runs, "medianSeconds": sorted[1], "MBps": Double(size) / sorted[1] / 1e6, "bytes": size])
                return
            }
            let tag = "EDGE-BENCH-\(runs.count)-\(Int.random(in: 1000...9999))"
            benchWatch = (Array(tag.utf8), CACurrentMediaTime(), 0, { _ in })
            benchWatch?.done = { [weak self] _ in
                guard let self, let w = self.benchWatch else { return }
                runs.append(CACurrentMediaTime() - w.started)
                self.benchWatch = nil
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.5) { one() }
            }
            // The tag is printed split so the echoed command line can't match it.
            let half = tag.count / 2
            pty.write(Array("cat \(path); printf '%s%s\\n' '\(tag.prefix(half))' '\(tag.dropFirst(half))'\r".utf8))
        }
        one()
    }

    /// Something here wants you and you're not looking at this session.
    private func wantsYou() {
        let looking = MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.active === self } && onScreen
        if !looking { needsYouAt = Date() }
    }

    /// Scripted checks: types a line into the shell as if from the keyboard.
    func debugType(_ line: String) { pty.write(Array(line.utf8)) }

    /// Scripted checks: real key events through keyDown (input system included); the
    /// screen's text and the path taken land in Caches/com.hashawn.nardo/termkeys.json.
    func debugKeys(_ text: String) {
        var trace: [String] = []
        for ch in text {
            let s = String(ch)
            let code: UInt16 = s == "\r" ? 36 : 0
            guard let e = NSEvent.keyEvent(with: .keyDown, location: .zero, modifierFlags: [], timestamp: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime,
                                           windowNumber: window?.windowNumber ?? 0, context: nil, characters: s,
                                           charactersIgnoringModifiers: s, isARepeat: false, keyCode: code) else { continue }
            committed = nil
            keyDown(with: e)
            trace.append("\(s.debugDescription) marked=\(hasMarkedText())")
        }
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.5) { [weak self] in
            guard let self, let vt = self.vt else { return }
            vt.refresh()
            let screen = vt.lines.map { $0.map { $0.text.isEmpty ? " " : $0.text }.joined().trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }.filter { !$0.isEmpty }
            let out: [String: Any] = ["trace": trace, "screen": Array(screen.suffix(4)), "responder": self.window?.firstResponder === self,
                                      "inputContext": self.inputContext != nil]
            let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.prettyPrinted]) { try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termkeys.json")) }
        }
    }

    /// The terminal is up and in sight (not just alive under the screen edge).
    private var onScreen: Bool {
        guard let window, SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true else { return false }
        return window.isVisible && window.alphaValue > 0.5 && window.occlusionState.contains(.visible)
    }

    private func lastScreenLine() -> String {
        (vt?.lines ?? []).lazy.reversed()
            .map { $0.filter { !$0.spacer }.map { $0.text.isEmpty ? " " : $0.text }.joined().trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
            .first { !$0.isEmpty } ?? ""
    }

    private func commandFinished(_ block: EdgeTermBlock) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        var lastLine = ""
        if let first = block.output?.screenRow, let rows = blocks.rows(of: block, vt: vt), first <= rows.upperBound {
            let tail = vt.text(rows: max(first, rows.upperBound - 3)...rows.upperBound)
            lastLine = tail.split(separator: "\n").last { !$0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty }.map(String.init) ?? ""
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.log(surface: "terminal", event: "command", payload: [
            "command": block.command, "cwd": block.directory, "exit": block.exit.map { Int($0) } ?? -1,
            "ms": Int((block.duration ?? 0) * 1000)])
        let visible = onScreen && MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.active === self }
        if !visible, (block.duration ?? 0) >= EdgeTermPeek.longCommand { needsYouAt = Date() }
        let id = sessionID
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTermPeek.shared.commandFinished(block, lastLine: lastLine, sessionID: id, terminalVisible: visible) }
        updateVisibleBlocks()
    }

    /// Recomputes which blocks are on screen (after output or scrolling, not every frame).
    private func updateVisibleBlocks() {
        guard let vt, !vt.alternateScreen else {
            if !visibleBlocks.isEmpty { visibleBlocks = []; needsDisplay = true }
            return
        }
        let top = vt.viewportTopRow, bottom = top + vt.rows
        var out: [(EdgeTermBlock, Int, Int)] = []
        for block in blocks.all.reversed() where block.started != nil {
            guard let rows = blocks.rows(of: block, vt: vt) else { continue }
            if rows.upperBound < top { break }
            if rows.lowerBound > bottom { continue }
            out.append((block, rows.lowerBound - top, rows.upperBound - top))
        }
        visibleBlocks = out
    }

    /// Scripted checks: "find <text>", "xray", "plain" (Caches/com.hashawn.nardo/termdebug.txt).
    func debugCommand(_ command: String) {
        cancelXray(); if searching { endSearch() }
        if command.hasPrefix("find ") { beginSearch(); appendQuery(String(command.dropFirst(5))) }
        if command == "xray" { xray = true; scanLinks(); needsDisplay = true }
        if command == "bench" { benchTyping = false; debugBench() }
        if command.hasPrefix("throughput ") { MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.benchThroughput(String(command.dropFirst(11))) } }
        if command == "bench typing" { benchTyping = true; debugBench() }
        if command == "new" { MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.newSession() } }
        if command.hasPrefix("select "), let n = Int(command.dropFirst(7)) { MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.select(n) } }
        if command.hasPrefix("find "), let vt {
            let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: vt.interact.debugSearch(), options: [.prettyPrinted]) {
                try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termsearch.json"))
            }
        }
    }

    private var probing = false
    var benchTyping = false

    /// Scripted checks: measures this terminal. Parse throughput (a throwaway terminal fed
    /// 16 MB of colored output in 64 KB chunks, refreshed after each, like live output),
    /// full-frame draw cost of a dense colored screen (offscreen), and typing latency
    /// (40 real key events into the shell: key → echo arrives → drawn). Results in
    /// Caches/com.hashawn.nardo/termbench.json.
    func debugBench() {
        var out: [String: Any] = [:]
        // 1. Parse + snapshot throughput.
        var line = ""
        for i in 0..<120 { line += "\u{1b}[38;5;\(i % 256)m" + "word\(i) " }
        let chunk = Array(String(repeating: line + "\r\n", count: 64 * 1024 / (line.utf8.count + 2) + 1).utf8.prefix(64 * 1024))
        if let bench = EdgeVT(cols: 200, rows: 60) {
            let t0 = CACurrentMediaTime()
            for _ in 0..<256 { bench.write(chunk); _ = bench.refresh() }
            let dt = CACurrentMediaTime() - t0
            out["parseMBps"] = Double(256 * chunk.count) / dt / 1_000_000
        }
        // 2. Full-frame draw of a dense screen, offscreen at this sheet's size.
        let view = EdgeTermView(frame: bounds.isEmpty ? NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1160, height: 504) : bounds)
        let (cols, rows) = view.gridSize()
        if let vt = EdgeVT(cols: cols, rows: rows) {
            vt.apply(config)
            var screen = ""
            for r in 0..<(rows - 4) { for c in 0..<cols { screen += "\u{1b}[38;5;\((r * 7 + c) % 256)m" + String(UnicodeScalar(65 + (r + c) % 26)!) }; screen += "\r\n" }
            screen += "\u{1b}[0mplain \u{1b}[1mbold\u{1b}[0m \u{1b}[3mitalic\u{1b}[0m \u{1b}[4munderline\u{1b}[0m \u{1b}[9mstrike\u{1b}[0m \u{1b}[2mfaint\u{1b}[0m \u{1b}[7minverse\u{1b}[0m\r\n"
            screen += "emoji 🚀👍🏽 cjk 漢字テスト accents éñü combining e\u{301} ╭──╮ ▀▄█ \u{e0b0}\r\n"
            screen += "\u{1b}[48;5;24m background run \u{1b}[0m and \u{1b}[38;2;255;120;40mtruecolor\u{1b}[0m\r\n"
            vt.write(Array(screen.utf8)); _ = vt.refresh()
            view.vt = vt
            if let rep = view.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: view.bounds) {
                view.drawTimes = []
                for _ in 0..<(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EDGE_BENCH_LONG"] != nil || FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: "/tmp/edge-bench-long") ? 600 : 30) { view.cacheDisplay(in: view.bounds, to: rep) }
                let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
                try? rep.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])?.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termbench.png"))
                let t = view.drawTimes.sorted()
                out["fullFrameMs"] = ["median": t[t.count / 2], "p90": t[t.count * 9 / 10], "cells": cols * rows]
            }
        }
        // 3. Typing latency only on request ("bench typing"): it types into the active session.
        guard benchTyping else {
            let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]) {
                try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termbench.json"))
            }
            return
        }
        probing = true
        probeSamples = []
        var i = 0
        func next() {
            guard i < 40 else {
                self.probing = false
                let echo = self.probeSamples.map(\.echo).sorted(), drawn = self.probeSamples.map(\.drawn).sorted()
                if !echo.isEmpty {
                    out["typing"] = ["samples": echo.count, "echoMedianMs": echo[echo.count / 2], "echoP90Ms": echo[echo.count * 9 / 10],
                                     "drawnMedianMs": drawn[drawn.count / 2], "drawnP90Ms": drawn[drawn.count * 9 / 10]]
                }
                for _ in 0..<40 { self.pty.write([0x7f]) }   // erase what was typed
                let d = self.drawTimes.sorted()
                if !d.isEmpty { out["liveDrawMs"] = ["median": d[d.count / 2], "p90": d[d.count * 9 / 10], "n": d.count] }
                let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
                if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]) {
                    try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termbench.json"))
