                }
                return
            }
            i += 1
            if let e = NSEvent.keyEvent(with: .keyDown, location: .zero, modifierFlags: [], timestamp: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime,
                                        windowNumber: self.window?.windowNumber ?? 0, context: nil, characters: "x",
                                        charactersIgnoringModifiers: "x", isARepeat: false, keyCode: 7) {
                self.committed = nil
                self.keyDown(with: e)
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.08) { next() }
        }
        drawTimes = []
        next()
    }

    /// Scripted checks: the command blocks as the terminal sees them, in
    /// Caches/com.hashawn.nardo/termblocks.json.
    func debugBlocks() {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let list: [[String: Any]] = blocks.commands.suffix(8).map { b in
            let rows = blocks.rows(of: b, vt: vt)
            return ["id": b.id, "command": b.command, "cwd": b.directory, "exit": b.exit.map { Int($0) } ?? -999,
                    "running": b.running, "rows": rows.map { [$0.lowerBound, $0.upperBound] } ?? [],
                    "output": String(blocks.output(of: b, vt: vt).prefix(300))]
        }
        let roster = MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.roster.map { "\($0.number)\($0.active ? "*" : "")\($0.wanted ? "!" : "")" } }
        let out: [String: Any] = ["blocks": list, "visible": visibleBlocks.map { [$0.block.id, $0.top, $0.bottom] }, "sessions": roster,
                                  "viewportTop": vt.viewportTopRow, "cursorRow": vt.cursorScreenRow, "onScreen": onScreen,
                                  "terminalOpen": SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOpen == true, "terminalOnly": SpotlightModel.shared?.terminalOnly == true,
                                  "windowAlpha": Double(window?.alphaValue ?? -1)]
        let dir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("com.hashawn.nardo")
        if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.prettyPrinted]) { try? data.write(to: dir.appendingPathComponent("termblocks.json")) }
    }

    private var heldSince: Date?
    private var lastRefreshAt: CFTimeInterval = 0
    private func queueRefresh() {
        // Synchronized output: the program is mid-frame; draw when it says it's done (or after
        // a second, if it never does).
        if let vt, vt.renderHeld {
            if heldSince == nil { heldSince = Date() }
            if Date().timeIntervalSince(heldSince!) < 1 {
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) { [weak self] in self?.queueRefresh() }
                return
            }
        }
        heldSince = nil
        guard !refreshQueued else { return }
        refreshQueued = true
        // At most once a frame: a flood of output is read off the terminal once per display
        // refresh, not once per chunk. After a quiet spell (an echoed key) it's immediate.
        let wait = max(0, lastRefreshAt + 1.0 / 120 - CACurrentMediaTime())
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + wait) { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            self.refreshQueued = false
            self.lastRefreshAt = CACurrentMediaTime()
            if self.vt?.refresh() == true { self.cursorMoved(); self.needsDisplay = true }
            self.syncScroll()
            self.updateVisibleBlocks()
            if self.searching { self.refreshMatches() }
            if self.xray { self.scanLinks() }
            self.updateSecureInput()
        }
    }

    /// The terminal moved its own viewport (typing jumps to the bottom, new output): adopt it.
    private func syncScroll() {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let up = vt.scrollPosition.up
        if up != Int((scrollPixels / cellHeight).rounded(.up)) {
            scrollPixels = CGFloat(up) * cellHeight
            scrollTarget = nil; scrollVelocity = 0
            if scrollShift != 0 { scrollShift = 0; needsDisplay = true }
        }
    }

    /// Puts the view `pixels` above the bottom: whole rows through the terminal, the rest
    /// as a shift of the drawn grid.
    private func applyScroll(_ pixels: CGFloat) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let limit = CGFloat(vt.scrollPosition.max) * cellHeight
        scrollPixels = min(max(0, pixels), limit)
        let rows = Int((scrollPixels / cellHeight - 0.0001).rounded(.up))
        let up = vt.scrollPosition.up
        if rows != up { vt.scroll(rows: -(rows - up)) }
        _ = vt.refresh()
        scrollShift = vt.below == nil ? 0 : CGFloat(rows) * cellHeight - scrollPixels
        updateVisibleBlocks()
        if searching { refreshMatches() }
        if xray { scanLinks() }
        cursorDrawn = CGPoint(x: CGFloat(vt.cursor.x), y: CGFloat(vt.cursor.y))
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    // MARK: Metrics

    private func rebuildFonts() {
        var sized = config
        sized.fontSize = fontSize
        fonts = sized.fonts()
        let base = fonts[0]
        // Cells are whole device pixels wide (crisp edges, exact mouse math); each glyph's
        // advance is padded to the cell with kerning so runs never drift off the grid.
        let advance = ("M" as NSString).size(withAttributes: [.font: base]).width
        let px = window?.backingScaleFactor ?? NSScreen.main?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2
        cellWidth = ceil(advance * px) / px
        glyphKern = cellWidth - advance
        glyphCache = Array(repeating: [:], count: 4)
        asciiGlyphs = []
        // The font's own line height, like Ghostty: no extra air of ours.
        let glyphHeight = ceil(base.ascender - base.descender)
        cellHeight = ceil(glyphHeight + max(0, base.leading))
        textInset = floor((cellHeight - glyphHeight) / 2)
    }

    /// Your config changed on disk: colors, font and padding follow it.
    func applyConfig() {
        config = EdgeTermConfig.current
        fontSize = config.fontSize
        vt?.apply(config)
        rebuildFonts()
        cursorPlaced = false
        relayoutGrid()
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    fileprivate func gridSize() -> (Int, Int) {
        (max(10, Int((bounds.width - padding.left - padding.right) / cellWidth)),
         max(3, Int((bounds.height - padding.top - padding.bottom) / cellHeight)))
    }

    override func setFrameSize(_ newSize: NSSize) {
        super.setFrameSize(newSize)
        relayoutGrid()
    }

    private func relayoutGrid() {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let (cols, rows) = gridSize()
        vt.resize(cols: cols, rows: rows, cellWidth: Int(cellWidth), cellHeight: Int(cellHeight))
        pty.resize(cols: cols, rows: rows, cellWidth: Int(cellWidth), cellHeight: Int(cellHeight))
        queueRefresh()
    }

    private func zoom(_ step: Int) {
        fontSize = step == 0 ? config.fontSize : min(32, max(8, fontSize + CGFloat(step)))
        rebuildFonts()
        cursorPlaced = false
        relayoutGrid()
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    // MARK: Drawing

    // Perf probes: key press → its echo arriving → drawn (scripted checks read them).
    private var probeKeyAt: CFTimeInterval?
    private var probeEchoAt: CFTimeInterval?
    private(set) var probeSamples: [(echo: Double, drawn: Double)] = []
    fileprivate(set) var drawTimes: [Double] = []

    override func draw(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
        let started = CACurrentMediaTime()
        defer {
            let now = CACurrentMediaTime()
            drawTimes.append((now - started) * 1000)
            if drawTimes.count > 600 { drawTimes.removeFirst(300) }
            if let key = probeKeyAt, let echo = probeEchoAt {
                probeSamples.append(((echo - key) * 1000, (now - key) * 1000))
                probeKeyAt = nil; probeEchoAt = nil
            }
        }
        drawGrid(dirtyRect)
    }

    private func drawGrid(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let lines = vt.lines
        NSBezierPath(rect: bounds).addClip()
        drawPaddingExtension(lines)
        // Rows scroll under the grid's top and bottom edges.
        NSRect(x: 0, y: origin.y, width: bounds.width, height: CGFloat(lines.count) * cellHeight).clip()
        var rows = Array(lines.enumerated())
        if scrollShift > 0, let below = vt.below { rows.append((lines.count, below)) }
        for (y, row) in rows {
            let top = rowTop(y)
            guard top < dirtyRect.maxY, top + cellHeight > dirtyRect.minY else { continue }
            drawBackgrounds(row, top: top)
            drawSelection(y: y, top: top)
        }
        drawBlocks(lines.count)
        drawCursor(vt.cursor, lines: lines, beforeText: true)
        for (y, row) in rows {
            let top = rowTop(y)
            guard top < dirtyRect.maxY, top + cellHeight > dirtyRect.minY else { continue }
            let selected = y < lines.count ? (y < vt.selections.count ? vt.selections[y] : nil) : vt.belowSelection
            let picked = matches[y]?.first { $0.1 }?.0
            drawText(row, top: top) { i in selected?.contains(i) == true || picked?.contains(i) == true }
        }
        flushText()
        drawCursor(vt.cursor, lines: lines, beforeText: false)
        drawMarkedText(vt.cursor)
        if xray { drawXray(lines) }
        if searching { drawSearchLine(lines.count) }
    }

    /// Commands stay invisible: a failed one gets a hairline tick in the margin at its
    /// prompt (your palette's red), hovering the margin shows a block's extent, and a picked
    /// block wears a wash of your selection color.
    private func drawBlocks(_ rowCount: Int) {
        let scale = window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2
        for (block, top, bottom) in visibleBlocks {
            let a = max(top, -1), b = min(bottom, rowCount)
            guard a <= b else { continue }
            let y0 = rowTop(a), y1 = rowTop(b) + cellHeight
            if selectedBlock == block.id {
                config.selectionBG.color.withAlphaComponent(0.13).setFill()
                NSRect(x: 0, y: y0, width: bounds.width, height: y1 - y0).fill()
            } else if hoveredBlock == block.id {
                (vt?.foreground ?? config.foreground).color.withAlphaComponent(0.05).setFill()
                NSRect(x: 0, y: y0, width: bounds.width, height: y1 - y0).fill()
            }
            if block.failed, top >= 0, top < rowCount {
                (vt?.color(1) ?? EdgeRGB(r: 204, g: 102, b: 102)).color.setFill()
                let w = (1.5 * scale).rounded() / scale
                NSRect(x: origin.x - 8, y: rowTop(top) + 3, width: w, height: cellHeight - 6).fill()
            }
        }
    }

    private func block(atViewportRow y: Int) -> EdgeTermBlock? {
        visibleBlocks.first { y >= $0.top && y <= $0.bottom }?.block
    }

    /// ⌘↑ / ⌘↓: pick the previous or next command and glide it to the top of the view.
    private func jumpBlock(_ step: Int) {
        guard let vt, !vt.alternateScreen else { return }
        let list = blocks.commands
        guard !list.isEmpty else { return }
        let current = selectedBlock.flatMap { id in list.firstIndex { $0.id == id } }
        let index: Int
        if let current { index = current + step }
        else { index = step < 0 ? list.count - 1 : list.count }
        guard index >= 0, index < list.count else {
            if index >= list.count { selectedBlock = nil; scrollTarget = 0; startLink(); needsDisplay = true }
            return
        }
        reveal(list[index])
    }

    /// Your palette's color `i` as the terminal has it now.
    func paletteColor(_ i: Int) -> EdgeRGB? { vt?.color(i) }

    /// Back to the live end of the output (the running command's chip).
    func jumpToEnd() {
        selectedBlock = nil
        scrollTarget = 0
        startLink()
        window?.makeFirstResponder(self)
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    /// Picks the block and scrolls it to the top of the view (or as far as it goes).
    func reveal(blockID: Int?) {
        guard let blockID, let block = blocks.all.first(where: { $0.id == blockID }) else { return }
        reveal(block)
    }

    private func reveal(_ block: EdgeTermBlock) {
        guard let vt, let top = block.prompt.screenRow else { return }
        selectedBlock = block.id
        vt.interact.clearSelection()
        let maxUp = vt.scrollPosition.max
        let up = min(max(0, maxUp - top), maxUp)
        scrollTarget = CGFloat(up) * cellHeight
        startLink()
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    private func copyBlock(includingCommand: Bool) -> Bool {
        guard let vt, let id = selectedBlock, let block = blocks.all.first(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return false }
        let text = includingCommand ? blocks.text(of: block, vt: vt) : blocks.output(of: block, vt: vt)
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return true }
        NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
        NSPasteboard.general.setString(text, forType: .string)
        return true
    }

    /// Edge cells' backgrounds stretched into the padding (Ghostty's "extend"): a program
    /// that paints the whole screen fills the whole sheet instead of sitting in a frame.
    private func drawPaddingExtension(_ lines: [[EdgeCell]]) {
        guard let first = lines.first, let last = lines.last, !first.isEmpty else { return }
        let gridRight = origin.x + CGFloat(first.count) * cellWidth
        let gridBottom = origin.y + CGFloat(lines.count) * cellHeight
        for (y, row) in lines.enumerated() {
            let top = origin.y + CGFloat(y) * cellHeight
            let h = y == 0 ? cellHeight + origin.y : (y == lines.count - 1 ? bounds.maxY - top : cellHeight)
            let rowTop = y == 0 ? 0 : top
            if let bg = row.first?.bg { bg.color.setFill(); NSRect(x: 0, y: rowTop, width: origin.x, height: h).fill() }
            if let bg = row.last?.bg { bg.color.setFill(); NSRect(x: gridRight, y: rowTop, width: bounds.maxX - gridRight, height: h).fill() }
        }
        for (x, cell) in first.enumerated() {
            guard let bg = cell.bg else { continue }
            bg.color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: 0, width: cellWidth, height: origin.y).fill()
        }
        for (x, cell) in last.enumerated() {
            guard let bg = cell.bg else { continue }
            bg.color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: gridBottom, width: cellWidth, height: bounds.maxY - gridBottom).fill()
        }
    }

    private func drawBackgrounds(_ row: [EdgeCell], top: CGFloat) {
        var x = 0
        while x < row.count {
            guard let bg = row[x].bg else { x += 1; continue }
            var end = x + 1
            while end < row.count, row[end].bg == bg { end += 1 }
            bg.color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: top, width: CGFloat(end - x) * cellWidth, height: cellHeight).fill()
            x = end
        }
    }

    /// The selection and search matches, under the text: picked ones in your selection
    /// colors, other matches as a faint wash of your foreground.
    private func drawSelection(y: Int, top: CGFloat) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        func fill(_ r: Range<Int>, _ color: NSColor) {
            color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(r.lowerBound) * cellWidth, y: top, width: CGFloat(r.count) * cellWidth, height: cellHeight).fill()
        }
        for (r, picked) in matches[y] ?? [] { fill(r, picked ? config.selectionBG.color : vt.foreground.color.withAlphaComponent(0.22)) }
        let range = y < vt.selections.count ? vt.selections[y] : (y == vt.lines.count ? vt.belowSelection : nil)
        if let range { fill(range, config.selectionBG.color) }
    }

    private struct RunStyle: Equatable {
        var fg: EdgeRGB?, bold: Bool, italic: Bool, faint: Bool, underline: Bool, strike: Bool
        var selected = false
    }

    // Glyphs, looked up once per font and code point (0: the font has none, use fallback).
    private var glyphCache: [[UInt32: CGGlyph]] = Array(repeating: [:], count: 4)
    private struct GlyphRun: Hashable { var font: Int; var color: EdgeRGB; var faint: Bool }
    private var runIndex: [GlyphRun: Int] = [:]
    private var runKeys: [GlyphRun] = []
    private var runGlyphs: [[CGGlyph]] = []
    private var runPositions: [[CGPoint]] = []

    private var asciiGlyphs: [[CGGlyph]] = []   // per font, code points 0..<128, filled on first use

    private func glyph(_ scalar: UInt32, font i: Int) -> CGGlyph {
        if scalar < 128 {
            if asciiGlyphs.isEmpty {
                asciiGlyphs = fonts.map { f in
                    var chars = (0..<128).map { UniChar($0) }, glyphs = [CGGlyph](repeating: 0, count: 128)
                    _ = CTFontGetGlyphsForCharacters(f as CTFont, &chars, &glyphs, 128)
                    return glyphs
                }
            }
            return asciiGlyphs[i][Int(scalar)]
        }
        if let g = glyphCache[i][scalar] { return g }
        var g: CGGlyph = 0
        if scalar <= 0xFFFF {
            var c = UniChar(scalar)
            if !CTFontGetGlyphsForCharacters(fonts[i] as CTFont, &c, &g, 1) { g = 0 }
        }
        glyphCache[i][scalar] = g
        return g
    }

    /// A row's text: glyphs grouped by font and color, one Core Text call per group (a
    /// dense, many-colored screen used to be thousands of string draws). Box/powerline
    /// shapes are drawn to the cell; clusters, emoji and glyphs the font lacks go through
    /// the string path (system font fallback).
    private var textMarks: [(NSRect, NSColor)] = []
    private var textFallback: [(Int, EdgeCell, Bool, CGFloat)] = []

    /// Queues a row's text; `flushText` draws the whole screen's queued glyphs, one Core
    /// Text call per font and color.
    private func drawText(_ row: [EdgeCell], top: CGFloat, picked: (Int) -> Bool) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let defaultFG = vt.foreground
        let baseline = top + textInset + fonts[0].ascender
        let scale = window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2
        func px(_ v: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { (v * scale).rounded() / scale }

        for x in row.indices {
            let cell = row[x]
            if cell.spacer || cell.invisible || cell.isBlank { continue }
            let selected = picked(x)
            let rgb = selected ? config.selectionFG : (cell.fg ?? defaultFG)
            // Box drawing, blocks and powerline shapes: exact to the cell, no seams.
            if cell.extra == nil, EdgeGlyphs.handles(cell.scalar) {
                let left = px(origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth)
                let right = px(origin.x + CGFloat(x + (cell.wide ? 2 : 1)) * cellWidth)
                let color = rgb.color
                EdgeGlyphs.draw(cell.scalar, in: NSRect(x: left, y: px(top), width: right - left, height: px(top + cellHeight) - px(top)),
                                color: cell.faint ? color.withAlphaComponent(0.55) : color, scale: scale)
                continue
            }
            let font = (cell.bold ? 1 : 0) + (cell.italic ? 2 : 0)
            let g = cell.extra == nil ? glyph(cell.scalar, font: font) : 0
            if g == 0 { textFallback.append((x, cell, selected, top)); continue }
            let key = GlyphRun(font: font, color: rgb, faint: cell.faint)
            let slot: Int
            if let i = runIndex[key] { slot = i } else {
                slot = runKeys.count
                runIndex[key] = slot; runKeys.append(key); runGlyphs.append([]); runPositions.append([])
            }
            runGlyphs[slot].append(g)
            // Positions are in text space, which the flip below also flips: y goes in negated.
            runPositions[slot].append(CGPoint(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: -baseline))
            if cell.underline || cell.strike {
                let w = CGFloat(cell.wide ? 2 : 1) * cellWidth
                let color = cell.faint ? rgb.color.withAlphaComponent(0.55) : rgb.color
                if cell.underline { textMarks.append((NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: px(baseline + 2), width: w, height: 1 / scale * 2), color)) }
                if cell.strike { textMarks.append((NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(x) * cellWidth, y: px(baseline - fonts[0].xHeight / 2), width: w, height: 1 / scale * 2), color)) }
            }
        }
    }

    private func flushText() {
        defer {
            for i in 0..<runKeys.count { runGlyphs[i].removeAll(keepingCapacity: true); runPositions[i].removeAll(keepingCapacity: true) }
            textMarks.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
            textFallback.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        }
        guard let ctx = NSGraphicsContext.current?.cgContext else { return }
        ctx.saveGState()
        ctx.textMatrix = CGAffineTransform(scaleX: 1, y: -1)   // the view is flipped
        if config.thicken {
            // font-thicken the way Ghostty does it: font smoothing (glyphs stay cached;
            // outlining them with a stroke rasterized every glyph from scratch, every frame).
            ctx.setAllowsFontSmoothing(true)
            ctx.setShouldSmoothFonts(true)
        }
        let thickenShift: CGFloat = config.thicken ? 0.5 / (window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2) : 0
        for (i, key) in runKeys.enumerated() where !runGlyphs[i].isEmpty {
            let color = key.color.color.withAlphaComponent(key.faint ? 0.55 : 1).cgColor
            ctx.setFillColor(color)
            ctx.setStrokeColor(color)
            runGlyphs[i].withUnsafeBufferPointer { g in
                runPositions[i].withUnsafeBufferPointer { p in
                    CTFontDrawGlyphs(fonts[key.font] as CTFont, g.baseAddress!, p.baseAddress!, g.count, ctx)
                    if thickenShift != 0 {   // font-thicken: a second pass half a pixel over (still cached)
                        ctx.translateBy(x: thickenShift, y: 0)
                        CTFontDrawGlyphs(fonts[key.font] as CTFont, g.baseAddress!, p.baseAddress!, g.count, ctx)
                        ctx.translateBy(x: -thickenShift, y: 0)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ctx.restoreGState()
        // Keep the run table small when a screen had unusually many colors.
        if runKeys.count > 512 { runIndex = [:]; runKeys = []; runGlyphs = []; runPositions = [] }
        for (rect, color) in textMarks { color.setFill(); rect.fill() }
        for (x, cell, selected, top) in textFallback {
            draw(cell.text, style: RunStyle(fg: cell.fg, bold: cell.bold, italic: cell.italic, faint: cell.faint,
                                            underline: cell.underline, strike: cell.strike, selected: selected), column: x, top: top)
        }
    }

    private func draw(_ text: String, style: RunStyle, column: Int, top: CGFloat, color: NSColor? = nil) {
        let font = fonts[(style.bold ? 1 : 0) + (style.italic ? 2 : 0)]
        var fg = color ?? (style.selected ? config.selectionFG : (style.fg ?? vt?.foreground ?? config.foreground)).color
        if style.faint { fg = fg.withAlphaComponent(0.55) }
        var attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [.font: font, .foregroundColor: fg, .ligature: 0, .kern: glyphKern]

        if style.underline { attrs[.underlineStyle] = NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue }
        if style.strike { attrs[.strikethroughStyle] = NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue }
        (text as NSString).draw(at: NSPoint(x: origin.x + CGFloat(column) * cellWidth, y: top + textInset), withAttributes: attrs)
    }

    private func cellRect(x: CGFloat, y: CGFloat) -> NSRect {
        NSRect(x: origin.x + x * cellWidth, y: origin.y - scrollShift + y * cellHeight, width: cellWidth, height: cellHeight)
    }

    /// Your cursor: your color and style, square like a terminal's. Unfocused, a hollow box.
    private func drawCursor(_ cursor: EdgeCursor, lines: [[EdgeCell]], beforeText: Bool) {
        guard cursor.visible else { return }
        let focused = window?.firstResponder === self && window?.isKeyWindow == true
        let rect = cellRect(x: cursorDrawn.x, y: cursorDrawn.y)
        let color = config.cursor.color
        let shape = focused ? cursor.shape : .hollow
        let scale = window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2
        if beforeText {
            switch shape {
            case .block:
                color.setFill(); rect.fill()
            case .hollow:
                color.setStroke()
                let path = NSBezierPath(rect: rect.insetBy(dx: 0.5, dy: 0.5))
                path.lineWidth = 1; path.stroke()
            default: break
            }
            return
        }
        switch shape {
        case .block:
            // The character under a settled block takes your cursor-text color.
            let settled = abs(cursorDrawn.x - CGFloat(cursor.x)) < 0.1 && abs(cursorDrawn.y - CGFloat(cursor.y)) < 0.1
            if settled, cursor.y < lines.count, cursor.x < lines[cursor.y].count {
                let cell = lines[cursor.y][cursor.x]
                if !cell.text.isEmpty, cell.text != " " {
                    draw(cell.text, style: RunStyle(fg: nil, bold: cell.bold, italic: cell.italic, faint: false, underline: false, strike: false),
                         column: cursor.x, top: rowTop(cursor.y), color: (config.cursorText ?? vt?.background ?? config.background).color)
                }
            }
        case .bar:
            color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY, width: (1.5 * scale).rounded() / scale, height: rect.height).fill()
        case .underline:
            color.setFill()
            NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY - 1.5, width: rect.width, height: 1.5).fill()
        case .hollow:
            break
        }
    }

    // MARK: Cursor glide

    private func cursorMoved() {
        guard let cursor = vt?.cursor else { return }
        let target = CGPoint(x: CGFloat(cursor.x), y: CGFloat(cursor.y))
        // Glides only along a row. A new line (Return, wrap, clear) is a jump: sweeping
        // diagonally across the whole line tore.
        if !cursorPlaced || target.y != cursorDrawn.y.rounded() || abs(target.y - cursorDrawn.y) > 0.01 {
            invalidateCursor()
            cursorPlaced = true
            cursorDrawn = target; cursorVelocity = .zero
            invalidateCursor()
            return
        }
        guard target != cursorDrawn else { return }
        startLink()
    }

    private func startLink() {
        guard link == nil else { return }
        let l = displayLink(target: self, selector: #selector(tick(_:)))
        // Ask for ProMotion ourselves; without another app holding the display high it idles at 60Hz.
        l.preferredFrameRateRange = CAFrameRateRange(minimum: 80, maximum: 120, preferred: 120)
        l.add(to: .main, forMode: .common)
        link = l; lastTick = nil
    }

    @objc private func tick(_ l: CADisplayLink) {
        guard let cursor = vt?.cursor else { stopLink(); return }
        let target = CGPoint(x: CGFloat(cursor.x), y: CGFloat(cursor.y))
        let now = l.targetTimestamp
        let dt = min(1.0 / 30, now - (lastTick ?? now - 1.0 / 120))
        lastTick = now
        if let goal = scrollTarget {
            // Wheel notches glide (critically damped, quick).
            let response = 0.16, k = pow(2 * .pi / response, 2), c = 4 * .pi / response
            var x = scrollPixels
            for _ in 0..<4 { let h = dt / 4; scrollVelocity += (-k * (x - goal) - c * scrollVelocity) * h; x += scrollVelocity * h }
            if abs(x - goal) < 0.3, abs(scrollVelocity) < 5 { x = goal; scrollTarget = nil; scrollVelocity = 0 }
            applyScroll(x)
            if cursorDrawn == target, scrollTarget == nil { stopLink() }
            return
        }
        // Critically damped and quick: it trails your typing by a frame or two, no wobble.
        let response = 0.075, k = pow(2 * .pi / response, 2), c = 4 * .pi / response
        for _ in 0..<4 {
            let h = dt / 4
            cursorVelocity.x += (-k * (cursorDrawn.x - target.x) - c * cursorVelocity.x) * h
            cursorVelocity.y += (-k * (cursorDrawn.y - target.y) - c * cursorVelocity.y) * h
            cursorDrawn.x += cursorVelocity.x * h
            cursorDrawn.y += cursorVelocity.y * h
        }
        if abs(cursorDrawn.x - target.x) < 0.01, abs(cursorDrawn.y - target.y) < 0.01 {
            cursorDrawn = target; cursorVelocity = .zero
            if scrollTarget == nil { stopLink() }
        }
        invalidateCursor()
    }

    /// Repaints where the cursor was last drawn and where it is now (missing the old spot
    /// left pieces of it behind).
    private var lastCursorRect = NSRect.zero
    private func invalidateCursor() {
        let now = cellRect(x: cursorDrawn.x, y: cursorDrawn.y).insetBy(dx: -2, dy: -2)
        setNeedsDisplay(lastCursorRect.union(now))
        lastCursorRect = now
    }

    private func stopLink() { link?.invalidate(); link = nil; lastTick = nil; needsDisplay = true }

    // MARK: Keyboard

    override func performKeyEquivalent(with event: NSEvent) -> Bool {
        cancelXray()
        guard event.type == .keyDown, window?.firstResponder === self, shortcut(event) else {
            return super.performKeyEquivalent(with: event)
        }
        return true
    }

    override func keyDown(with event: NSEvent) {
        if probing { probeKeyAt = CACurrentMediaTime(); probeEchoAt = nil }
        guard vt != nil else { return }
        if shortcut(event) { return }
        if searching { searchKey(event); return }
        if event.keyCode == 53, selectedBlock != nil {   // Esc lets go of a picked block
            selectedBlock = nil; needsDisplay = true; return
        }
        // Through the input system first: dead keys (⌥e e → é) and input methods compose
        // here. What it commits arrives in insertText; keys it doesn't type (arrows,
        // Return, ⌃C) come back through doCommand and are encoded below.
        let wasComposing = hasMarkedText()
        committed = []
        interpretKeyEvents([event])
        let texts = committed ?? []
        committed = nil
        if hasMarkedText() || (wasComposing && texts.isEmpty) { needsDisplay = true; return }
        if texts.isEmpty {
            send(event, text: event.characters.map(Self.printable))
        } else {
            for text in texts { send(event, text: text) }
        }
    }

    private func send(_ event: NSEvent, text: String?) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let unshifted = event.characters(byApplyingModifiers: [])?.unicodeScalars.first?.value ?? 0
        var bytes = vt.encodeKey(keyCode: event.keyCode, mods: event.modifierFlags, text: text,
                                 unshifted: unshifted, release: false, repeating: event.isARepeat)
        if bytes.isEmpty, let text, !text.isEmpty { bytes = Array(text.utf8) }
        guard !bytes.isEmpty else { return }
        vt.interact.clearSelection()
        if selectedBlock != nil { selectedBlock = nil; needsDisplay = true }
        if config.mouseHideWhileTyping { NSCursor.setHiddenUntilMouseMoves(true) }
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { status.typed() }
        vt.scrollToBottom()
        pty.write(bytes)
    }

    // MARK: Input methods

    /// Text the input system committed during the current keyDown (nil outside one).
    private var committed: [String]?
    /// What an input method is composing, drawn at the cursor until it commits.
    private var marked = NSAttributedString()

    private func drawMarkedText(_ cursor: EdgeCursor) {
        guard marked.length > 0 else { return }
        let rect = cellRect(x: CGFloat(cursor.x), y: CGFloat(cursor.y))
        let fg = (vt?.foreground ?? config.foreground).color
        let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [.font: fonts[0], .foregroundColor: fg,
                                                     .underlineStyle: NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue, .underlineColor: fg]
        let text = NSAttributedString(string: marked.string, attributes: attrs)
        let size = text.size()
        (vt?.background ?? config.background).color.setFill()
        NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY, width: max(cellWidth, size.width) + 2, height: cellHeight).fill()
        text.draw(at: NSPoint(x: rect.minX + 1, y: rect.minY + textInset))
    }

    override func keyUp(with event: NSEvent) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let bytes = vt.encodeKey(keyCode: event.keyCode, mods: event.modifierFlags, text: nil,
                                 unshifted: event.characters(byApplyingModifiers: [])?.unicodeScalars.first?.value ?? 0,
                                 release: true, repeating: false)
        if !bytes.isEmpty { pty.write(bytes) }   // only programs that asked for releases get any
    }

    /// What a key types, minus control characters and AppKit's private-use function keys.
    private static func printable(_ s: String) -> String {
        String(String.UnicodeScalarView(s.unicodeScalars.filter { $0.value >= 0x20 && $0.value != 0x7f && !(0xF700...0xF8FF).contains($0.value) }))
    }

    /// The Mac terminal keymap (Terminal.app / iTerm line editing).
    private func shortcut(_ e: NSEvent) -> Bool {
        let mods = e.modifierFlags.intersection([.command, .option, .control])
        let key = e.charactersIgnoringModifiers?.lowercased() ?? ""
        if mods == [.control], e.keyCode == 48 {   // ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab: next / previous session
            let step = e.modifierFlags.contains(.shift) ? -1 : 1
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.cycle(step) }
            return true
        }
        switch mods {
        case [.command]:
            switch (e.keyCode, key) {
            case (_, "c"):
                if let text = vt?.interact.selectionText(), !text.isEmpty {
                    NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
                    NSPasteboard.general.setString(text, forType: .string)
                } else { _ = copyBlock(includingCommand: e.modifierFlags.contains(.shift)) }
            case (_, "f"): beginSearch()
            case (_, "t"): MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.newSession() }
            case (_, "w"): hangUp()
            case (_, let k) where k.count == 1 && ("1"..."9").contains(k):
                let n = Int(k)! - 1
                MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.select(n) }
            case (_, "g"): if searching || !(vt?.interact.needle.isEmpty ?? true) { vt?.interact.step(older: !e.modifierFlags.contains(.shift)); afterSearchMove() }
            case (_, "v"): if searching { appendQuery(NSPasteboard.general.string(forType: .string) ?? "") } else { paste() }
            case (_, "a"): selectAll()
            case (_, "k"): clearBuffer()
            case (_, "="), (_, "+"): zoom(1)
            case (_, "-"): zoom(-1)
            case (_, "0"): zoom(0)
            case (126, _): jumpBlock(-1)               // ⌘↑ previous command
            case (125, _): jumpBlock(1)                // ⌘↓ next command
            case (123, _): pty.write([0x01])           // ⌘← line start
            case (124, _): pty.write([0x05])           // ⌘→ line end
            case (51, _): pty.write([0x15])            // ⌘⌫ delete to line start
            default: return false
            }
            return true
        case [.option]:
            switch e.keyCode {
            case 123: pty.write([0x1b, 0x62])          // ⌥← word back
            case 124: pty.write([0x1b, 0x66])          // ⌥→ word forward
            case 51: pty.write([0x1b, 0x7f])           // ⌥⌫ delete word
            default: return false
            }
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    private func paste() {
        guard let vt, let text = NSPasteboard.general.string(forType: .string), !text.isEmpty else { return }
        vt.scrollToBottom()
        pty.write(vt.encodePaste(text))
    }

    /// ⌘K: wipe the screen and scrollback, then let the shell redraw its prompt.
    private func clearBuffer() {
        vt?.write(Array("\u{1b}[H\u{1b}[2J\u{1b}[3J".utf8))
        pty.write([0x0c])
        vt?.interact.clearSelection()
        queueRefresh()
    }

    // MARK: Mouse (selection through libghostty, or reports to programs that ask)

    private var pixelScale: CGFloat { window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2 }
    private func point(_ event: NSEvent) -> NSPoint { convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil) }
    private func cell(at p: NSPoint) -> (x: Int, y: Int) {
        (max(0, min((vt?.cols ?? 1) - 1, Int(((p.x - origin.x) / cellWidth).rounded(.down)))),
         max(0, min((vt?.rows ?? 1) - 1, Int(((p.y - origin.y + scrollShift) / cellHeight).rounded(.down)))))
    }
    /// Surface pixels, the unit libghostty's gesture and mouse math use.
    private func surface(_ p: NSPoint) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: p.x * pixelScale, y: p.y * pixelScale) }
    private var geometry: EdgeVTInteract.Geometry {
        .init(columns: vt?.cols ?? 1, cellWidth: cellWidth * pixelScale, paddingLeft: origin.x * pixelScale, height: bounds.height * pixelScale)
    }
    private var mouseSize: GhosttyMouseEncoderSize {
        let s = pixelScale, rows = CGFloat(vt?.rows ?? 1), cols = CGFloat(vt?.cols ?? 1)
        var size = GhosttyMouseEncoderSize()
        size.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttyMouseEncoderSize>.size
        size.screen_width = UInt32(bounds.width * s); size.screen_height = UInt32(bounds.height * s)
        size.cell_width = UInt32((cellWidth * s).rounded()); size.cell_height = UInt32((cellHeight * s).rounded())
        size.padding_left = UInt32(origin.x * s); size.padding_top = UInt32(origin.y * s)
        size.padding_right = UInt32(max(0, bounds.width - origin.x - cols * cellWidth) * s)
        size.padding_bottom = UInt32(max(0, bounds.height - origin.y - rows * cellHeight) * s)
        return size
    }

    /// The program asked for mouse reports (vim, htop…); Shift still selects.
    private func reportsMouse(_ event: NSEvent) -> Bool {
        (vt?.mouseTracking ?? false) && !event.modifierFlags.contains(.shift)
    }

    private func sendMouse(_ action: EdgeVTInteract.MouseAction, button: Int?, _ event: NSEvent) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let bytes = vt.interact.encodeMouse(action, button: button, mods: event.modifierFlags, position: surface(point(event)),
                                            size: mouseSize, anyPressed: NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons != 0)
        if !bytes.isEmpty { pty.write(bytes) }
    }

    override func updateTrackingAreas() {
        super.updateTrackingAreas()
        if let trackingArea { removeTrackingArea(trackingArea) }
        let area = NSTrackingArea(rect: .zero, options: [.mouseMoved, .mouseEnteredAndExited, .activeAlways, .inVisibleRect, .cursorUpdate], owner: self)
        addTrackingArea(area)
        trackingArea = area
    }

    override func cursorUpdate(with event: NSEvent) { updatePointer(event) }

    private func updatePointer(_ event: NSEvent) {
        let p = point(event)
        if xray, p.x >= origin.x, link(at: cell(at: p)) != nil { NSCursor.pointingHand.set() }
        else if p.x < origin.x { NSCursor.arrow.set() }
        else { NSCursor.iBeam.set() }
    }

    /// The rail's hit area: the left padding, where nothing else lives.
    private func gutterBlock(_ event: NSEvent) -> EdgeTermBlock? {
        let p = point(event)
        guard p.x < origin.x else { return nil }
        return block(atViewportRow: Int(((p.y - origin.y + scrollShift) / cellHeight).rounded(.down)))
    }

    override func mouseMoved(with event: NSEvent) {
        let id = gutterBlock(event)?.id
        if id != hoveredBlock { hoveredBlock = id; needsDisplay = true }
        if reportsMouse(event) { sendMouse(.motion, button: nil, event) }
        updatePointer(event)
    }

    override func mouseExited(with event: NSEvent) {
        if hoveredBlock != nil { hoveredBlock = nil; needsDisplay = true }
    }

    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
        window?.makeFirstResponder(self)
        guard let vt else { return }
        if let block = gutterBlock(event) {
            gutterPress = (block, point(event))
            return
        }
        if selectedBlock != nil { selectedBlock = nil; needsDisplay = true }
        let p = point(event), c = cell(at: p)
        if event.modifierFlags.contains(.command), let target = link(at: c) { pendingLink = target; return }
        if reportsMouse(event) { mouseReported = true; sendMouse(.press, button: 1, event); return }
        mouseReported = false
        lastDrag = p
        vt.interact.press(x: c.x, y: c.y, at: surface(p), time: event.timestamp)
        queueRefresh()
    }

    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
        if let press = gutterPress {
            let p = point(event)
            guard hypot(p.x - press.at.x, p.y - press.at.y) > 4 else { return }
            gutterPress = nil
            dragOut(press.block, event: event)
            return
        }
        guard let vt, pendingLink == nil else { return }
        if mouseReported { sendMouse(.motion, button: 1, event); return }
        let p = point(event), c = cell(at: p)
        lastDrag = p
        let auto = vt.interact.drag(x: c.x, y: c.y, at: surface(p), geometry: geometry, rectangle: event.modifierFlags.contains(.option))
        setAutoscroll(auto != .none)
        queueRefresh()
    }

    override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) {
        if let press = gutterPress {   // a click in the margin picks the block (again: lets go)
            gutterPress = nil
            selectedBlock = selectedBlock == press.block.id ? nil : press.block.id
            vt?.interact.clearSelection()
            queueRefresh()
            return
        }
        if let target = pendingLink { pendingLink = nil; open(target); return }
        guard let vt else { return }
        if mouseReported { mouseReported = false; sendMouse(.release, button: 1, event); return }
        setAutoscroll(false)
        let c = cell(at: point(event))
        vt.interact.release(x: c.x, y: c.y)
        if !vt.interact.dragged, vt.interact.clickCount <= 1 { clickToMove(c) }
        queueRefresh()
    }

    override func rightMouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
        if reportsMouse(event) { sendMouse(.press, button: 2, event) } else { super.rightMouseDown(with: event) }
    }
    override func rightMouseUp(with event: NSEvent) {
        if reportsMouse(event) { sendMouse(.release, button: 2, event) } else { super.rightMouseUp(with: event) }
    }
    override func otherMouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { if reportsMouse(event) { sendMouse(.press, button: 3, event) } }
    override func otherMouseUp(with event: NSEvent) { if reportsMouse(event) { sendMouse(.release, button: 3, event) } }

    /// Dragging a selection past the top or bottom edge keeps scrolling and extending it.
    private func setAutoscroll(_ on: Bool) {
        guard on != (autoscrollTimer != nil) else { return }
        autoscrollTimer?.invalidate(); autoscrollTimer = nil
        guard on else { return }
        let timer = Timer(timeInterval: 0.05, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, let vt = self.vt else { return }
                let dir = vt.interact.autoscroll
                guard dir != .none else { self.setAutoscroll(false); return }
                vt.scroll(rows: dir == .up ? -1 : 1)
                let c = self.cell(at: self.lastDrag)
                vt.interact.autoscrollTick(x: c.x, y: c.y, at: self.surface(self.lastDrag), geometry: self.geometry, rectangle: false)
                self.queueRefresh()
            }
        }
        RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common)
        autoscrollTimer = timer
    }

    /// A click on the line you're typing moves the cursor there (arrow keys to the shell).
    private func clickToMove(_ c: (x: Int, y: Int)) {
        guard let vt, !vt.mouseTracking, !vt.alternateScreen, vt.scrollPosition.up == 0,
              c.y == vt.cursor.y, vt.interact.cursorAtPrompt, c.y < vt.lines.count else { return }
        let row = vt.lines[c.y]
        let end = (row.lastIndex { !$0.isBlank } ?? 0) + 1
        let target = min(c.x, max(end, vt.cursor.x))
        let delta = target - vt.cursor.x
        guard delta != 0 else { return }
        let app = vt.mode(1)
        let key: [UInt8] = delta > 0 ? (app ? [0x1b, 0x4f, 0x43] : [0x1b, 0x5b, 0x43]) : (app ? [0x1b, 0x4f, 0x44] : [0x1b, 0x5b, 0x44])
        pty.write(Array(repeating: key, count: abs(delta)).flatMap { $0 })
    }

    private func selectAll() {
        vt?.interact.selectAll()
        queueRefresh()
    }

    // MARK: Hold ⌘ (links, command edges, context)

    override func flagsChanged(with event: NSEvent) {
        let mods = event.modifierFlags.intersection([.command, .option, .control, .shift])
        if mods == .command {
            if !xray, xrayWork == nil {
                let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
                    guard let self else { return }
                    self.xrayWork = nil
                    self.xray = true
                    self.scanLinks()
                    self.needsDisplay = true
                    if let e = NSApp.currentEvent { self.updatePointer(e) }
                }
                xrayWork = work
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.18, execute: work)   // a quick ⌘C never flashes it
            }
        } else {
            cancelXray()
        }
        super.flagsChanged(with: event)
    }

    private func cancelXray() {
        xrayWork?.cancel(); xrayWork = nil
        if xray { xray = false; needsDisplay = true; NSCursor.iBeam.set() }
    }

    private static let urlPattern = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: #"(?:https?|file)://[^\s<>"'`]+|\b(?:localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|0\.0\.0\.0):\d{2,5}(?:/[^\s<>"'`]*)?"#)
    private static let pathPattern = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: #"(?:~|\.{1,2})?/?[A-Za-z0-9_@%+\-.~]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_@%+\-.~]+)*(?::\d+){0,2}"#)

    /// Finds URLs, localhost ports and paths that exist, on the rows in view.
    private func scanLinks() {
        guard let vt else { linkSpans = [:]; return }
        let cwd = vt.pwd.isEmpty ? FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path : vt.pwd
        var spans: [Int: [(Range<Int>, String)]] = [:]
        for (y, row) in vt.lines.enumerated() {
            var text = "", columns: [Int] = []   // utf16 offset → column
            for (x, cell) in row.enumerated() where !cell.spacer {
                let t = cell.text.isEmpty ? " " : cell.text
                text += t
                columns += Array(repeating: x, count: t.utf16.count)
            }
            guard text.contains(where: { $0 != " " }) else { continue }
            let ns = text as NSString
            func add(_ r: NSRange, _ target: String) {
                guard r.location < columns.count, NSMaxRange(r) - 1 < columns.count else { return }
                let a = columns[r.location], b = columns[NSMaxRange(r) - 1] + 1
                if !(spans[y]?.contains { $0.0.overlaps(a..<b) } ?? false) { spans[y, default: []].append((a..<b, target)) }
            }
            for m in Self.urlPattern.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: ns.length)) {
                var r = m.range
                while r.length > 0, ".,;:)]}>!?".contains(ns.substring(with: NSRange(location: NSMaxRange(r) - 1, length: 1))) { r.length -= 1 }
                let s = ns.substring(with: r)
                add(r, s.contains("://") ? s : "http://" + s)
            }
            for m in Self.pathPattern.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: ns.length)) {
                let token = ns.substring(with: m.range)
                guard token.contains("/") || token.contains("."), token.count > 1 else { continue }
                let bare = token.split(separator: ":").first.map(String.init) ?? token
                var path = bare.hasPrefix("~") ? (bare as NSString).expandingTildeInPath : bare
                if !path.hasPrefix("/") { path = cwd + "/" + path }
                guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path) else { continue }
                add(m.range, URL(fileURLWithPath: path).absoluteString)
            }
        }
        linkSpans = spans.mapValues { $0.map { (range: $0.0, target: $0.1) } }
    }

    private func link(at c: (x: Int, y: Int)) -> String? {
        guard let vt else { return nil }
        if c.y < vt.lines.count, c.x < vt.lines[c.y].count, vt.lines[c.y][c.x].link, let uri = vt.interact.hyperlink(x: c.x, y: c.y) { return uri }
        return linkSpans[c.y]?.first { $0.range.contains(c.x) }?.target
    }

    /// Web links open in the edge browser; files open in their app.
    private func open(_ target: String) {
        guard let url = URL(string: target) else { return }
        if url.scheme == "http" || url.scheme == "https" {
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { BrowserWindow.shared.open(target) }
        } else {
            NSWorkspace.shared.open(url)
        }
    }

    private func drawXray(_ lines: [[EdgeCell]]) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        let fg = vt.foreground.color
        // Links: underlined in place.
        fg.withAlphaComponent(0.8).setFill()
        for (y, row) in lines.enumerated() {
            var ranges = linkSpans[y]?.map(\.range) ?? []
            var x = 0
            while x < row.count {
                guard row[x].link else { x += 1; continue }
                var end = x + 1
                while end < row.count, row[end].link { end += 1 }
                ranges.append(x..<end); x = end
            }
            for r in ranges {
                NSRect(x: origin.x + CGFloat(r.lowerBound) * cellWidth, y: rowTop(y) + cellHeight - 2,
                       width: CGFloat(r.count) * cellWidth, height: 1).fill()
            }
        }
        // Command edges: a hairline above each command.
        fg.withAlphaComponent(0.14).setFill()
        for (_, top, _) in visibleBlocks where top > 0 && top < lines.count {
            NSRect(x: 0, y: rowTop(top) - 0.5, width: bounds.width, height: 1 / pixelScale).fill()
        }
        // Context: one dim line at the right of the cursor's row.
        let status = self.status
        var parts: [String] = []
        let dir = status.directory.isEmpty ? vt.pwd : status.directory
        if !dir.isEmpty { parts.append(dir == FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path ? "~" : (dir as NSString).lastPathComponent) }
        if let git = status.git {
            parts.append(git.branch + (git.dirty ? "*" : "") + (git.ahead > 0 ? " ↑\(git.ahead)" : "") + (git.behind > 0 ? " ↓\(git.behind)" : ""))
        }
        parts += status.ports.map { ":\($0)" }
        if let run = status.running {
            let t = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(run.started))
            parts.append("\(run.name) \(t / 60):" + String(format: "%02d", t % 60) + (status.needsYou ? " •" : ""))
        }
        guard !parts.isEmpty else { return }
        let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [.font: fonts[0], .foregroundColor: fg.withAlphaComponent(0.45), .kern: glyphKern]
        let line = NSMutableAttributedString(string: parts.joined(separator: "   "), attributes: attrs)
        // More than one session: their numbers, yours bright, ones that want you marked.
        let roster = MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeTerminalHost.shared.roster }
        if roster.count > 1 {
            line.append(NSAttributedString(string: "   ", attributes: attrs))
            for s in roster {
                var a = attrs
                if s.active { a[.foregroundColor] = fg }
                line.append(NSAttributedString(string: "\(s.number)" + (s.wanted ? "•" : "") + " ", attributes: a))
            }
        }
        let width = line.size().width
        let y = min(max(vt.cursor.y, 0), lines.count - 1)
        let used = (lines[y].lastIndex { !$0.isBlank } ?? -1) + 1
        let x = bounds.width - padding.right - width
        guard x > origin.x + CGFloat(max(used, vt.cursor.x + 1)) * cellWidth + cellWidth * 2 else { return }
        line.draw(at: NSPoint(x: x, y: rowTop(y) + textInset))
    }

    // MARK: Search (⌘F: the bottom row becomes the query; ⏎ older, ⇧⏎ newer, esc done)

    private func beginSearch() {
        searching = true
        query = vt?.interact.needle ?? ""
        refreshMatches()
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    private func endSearch() {
        searching = false
        vt?.interact.endSearch()
        matches = [:]
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    private func searchKey(_ e: NSEvent) {
        switch e.keyCode {
        case 53: endSearch()
        case 36, 76: vt?.interact.step(older: !e.modifierFlags.contains(.shift)); afterSearchMove()
        case 51:
            if !query.isEmpty { query.removeLast(); runQuery() }
        default:
            appendQuery(Self.printable(e.characters ?? ""))
        }
    }

    private func appendQuery(_ text: String) {
        let line = text.components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? ""
        guard !line.isEmpty else { return }
        query += line
        runQuery()
    }

    private func runQuery() {
        vt?.interact.find(query)
        afterSearchMove()
    }

    /// The search may have scrolled to its pick: adopt the viewport, re-read matches.
    private func afterSearchMove() {
        guard let vt else { return }
        _ = vt.refresh()
        syncScroll()
        refreshMatches()
        updateVisibleBlocks()
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    private func refreshMatches() {
        guard let vt, searching || !vt.interact.needle.isEmpty, !query.isEmpty else { if !matches.isEmpty { matches = [:] }; return }
        vt.interact.feedSearch()
        matches = vt.interact.visibleMatches()
    }

    /// The query, right-aligned on the bottom row in your font (`/text  3/17`): only its own
    /// width is covered, so the prompt and the newest matches stay visible.
    private func drawSearchLine(_ rowCount: Int) {
        guard let vt, rowCount > 0 else { return }
        let top = rowTop(rowCount - 1)
        let fg = vt.foreground.color
        let total = vt.interact.totalMatches
        let count = query.isEmpty ? "" : (total == 0 ? "  none" : "  \((vt.interact.selectedIndex ?? 0) + 1)/\(total)")
        let line = NSMutableAttributedString(string: "/" + query, attributes: [.font: fonts[0], .foregroundColor: fg, .kern: glyphKern])
        let caret = line.length
        line.append(NSAttributedString(string: " " + count, attributes: [.font: fonts[0], .kern: glyphKern,
            .foregroundColor: total == 0 && !query.isEmpty ? (vt.color(1) ?? EdgeRGB(r: 204, g: 102, b: 102)).color : fg.withAlphaComponent(0.45)]))
        let width = CGFloat(line.length) * cellWidth
        let x = max(origin.x, bounds.width - padding.right - width)
        vt.background.color.setFill()
        NSRect(x: x - cellWidth, y: top, width: bounds.width - x + cellWidth, height: cellHeight).fill()
        line.draw(at: NSPoint(x: x, y: top + textInset))
        fg.setFill()
        NSRect(x: x + CGFloat(caret) * cellWidth, y: top + 1, width: (1.5 * pixelScale).rounded() / pixelScale, height: cellHeight - 2).fill()
    }

    // MARK: Scrolling

    override func scrollWheel(with event: NSEvent) {
        guard let vt else { return }
        if reportsMouse(event) {
            // The program takes the wheel (button 4 up, 5 down), a report per row.
            let delta = event.hasPreciseScrollingDeltas ? event.scrollingDeltaY : event.scrollingDeltaY * cellHeight
            scrollRemainder += delta
            let rows = Int(scrollRemainder / cellHeight)
            guard rows != 0 else { return }
            scrollRemainder -= CGFloat(rows) * cellHeight
            for _ in 0..<abs(rows) { sendMouse(.press, button: rows > 0 ? 4 : 5, event) }
            return
        }
        if vt.mode(1049) || vt.mode(47) {
            // Full-screen programs (less, vim): the wheel moves through them with arrow keys.
            let delta = event.hasPreciseScrollingDeltas ? event.scrollingDeltaY : event.scrollingDeltaY * cellHeight
            scrollRemainder += delta
            let rows = Int(scrollRemainder / cellHeight)
            guard rows != 0 else { return }
            scrollRemainder -= CGFloat(rows) * cellHeight
            let arrow: [UInt8] = rows > 0 ? (vt.mode(1) ? [0x1b, 0x4f, 0x41] : [0x1b, 0x5b, 0x41])
                                          : (vt.mode(1) ? [0x1b, 0x4f, 0x42] : [0x1b, 0x5b, 0x42])
            for _ in 0..<abs(rows) { pty.write(arrow) }
            return
        }
        if event.hasPreciseScrollingDeltas {
            // Trackpad (and its momentum): the text follows the finger point for point.
            scrollTarget = nil; scrollVelocity = 0
            applyScroll(scrollPixels + event.scrollingDeltaY)
        } else {
            // Wheel notches: three rows each, gliding there.
            let limit = CGFloat(vt.scrollPosition.max) * cellHeight
            scrollTarget = min(max(0, (scrollTarget ?? scrollPixels) + event.scrollingDeltaY * cellHeight * 3), limit)
            startLink()
        }
    }
}

extension EdgeTermView: NSDraggingSource {
    /// Pulling a block out by its rail: the whole command (prompt, command, output) goes
    /// wherever it's dropped, and the image under the pointer is the block itself.
    fileprivate func dragOut(_ block: EdgeTermBlock, event: NSEvent) {
        guard let vt, let entry = visibleBlocks.first(where: { $0.block.id == block.id }) else { return }
        let text = blocks.text(of: block, vt: vt)
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
        let rows = vt.lines.count
        let y0 = rowTop(max(entry.top, 0)), y1 = rowTop(min(entry.bottom, rows - 1)) + cellHeight
        let rect = NSRect(x: 0, y: y0, width: bounds.width, height: max(cellHeight, y1 - y0)).intersection(bounds)
        guard !rect.isEmpty, let rep = bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: rect) else { return }
        cacheDisplay(in: rect, to: rep)
        let image = NSImage(size: rect.size)
        image.addRepresentation(rep)
        let item = NSDraggingItem(pasteboardWriter: text as NSString)
        item.setDraggingFrame(rect, contents: image)
        selectedBlock = block.id
        needsDisplay = true
        beginDraggingSession(with: [item], event: event, source: self)
    }

    func draggingSession(_ session: NSDraggingSession, sourceOperationMaskFor context: NSDraggingContext) -> NSDragOperation {
        .copy
    }
}

extension EdgeTermView: NSTextInputClient {
    func insertText(_ string: Any, replacementRange: NSRange) {
        let text = (string as? NSAttributedString)?.string ?? (string as? String) ?? ""
        marked = NSAttributedString()
        needsDisplay = true
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
        if committed != nil { committed?.append(text); return }
        // From outside a key press (emoji picker, dictation): paste it as typed text.
        vt?.scrollToBottom()
        pty.write(Array(text.utf8))
    }

    func setMarkedText(_ string: Any, selectedRange: NSRange, replacementRange: NSRange) {
        marked = (string as? NSAttributedString) ?? NSAttributedString(string: (string as? String) ?? "")
        needsDisplay = true
    }

    func unmarkText() { marked = NSAttributedString(); needsDisplay = true }
    func hasMarkedText() -> Bool { marked.length > 0 }
    func markedRange() -> NSRange { marked.length > 0 ? NSRange(location: 0, length: marked.length) : NSRange(location: NSNotFound, length: 0) }
    func selectedRange() -> NSRange { NSRange(location: NSNotFound, length: 0) }
    func validAttributesForMarkedText() -> [NSAttributedString.Key] { [] }
    func attributedSubstring(forProposedRange range: NSRange, actualRange: NSRangePointer?) -> NSAttributedString? { nil }
    func characterIndex(for point: NSPoint) -> Int { 0 }

    /// Where the candidate window goes: under the cursor.
    func firstRect(forCharacterRange range: NSRange, actualRange: NSRangePointer?) -> NSRect {
        guard let cursor = vtCursor, let window else { return .zero }
        let local = NSRect(x: padding.left + CGFloat(cursor.x) * cellSize.width,
                           y: padding.top + CGFloat(cursor.y + 1) * cellSize.height,
                           width: cellSize.width, height: cellSize.height)
        return window.convertToScreen(convert(local, to: nil))
    }

    /// Keys the input system doesn't type (arrows, Return, ⌃C) are encoded by keyDown.
    override func doCommand(by selector: Selector) {}
}

/// The sheet: your terminal's background, solid (your background-opacity, if you set one),
/// 32pt top corners so it sits in the edge stack, its bottom 64pt past the screen edge.
/// No glass, no chrome: the grid is the whole interface.
struct EdgeTerminalSheet: View {
    static let width: CGFloat = 1160
    static let height: CGFloat = 440   // visible, above the screen edge

    var body: some View {
        let look = EdgeTerminalHost.shared.look.config
        let r = EdgeLayout.outerRadius
        let shape = UnevenRoundedRectangle(topLeadingRadius: r, topTrailingRadius: r, style: .continuous)
        EdgeTerminalViewRep()
            .frame(width: Self.width, height: Self.height)
            .padding(.bottom, 64)
            .background(Color(nsColor: look.backgroundColor), in: shape)
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay(OpenBottomOutline(radius: r).stroke(Color(nsColor: look.foreground.color).opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 0.75))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.3), radius: 12, y: -2)
            .padding(.bottom, -64)
    }
}
//
//  EdgeWindowSwitcher.swift
//  Caps+Tab: every other app's window as one mosaic on the screen you're on. Tab steps
//  (Shift+Tab back, arrows too), a letter jumps to its tile, releasing Caps raises the
//  selected window, Esc puts it away. The keys arrive from SpotlightController's Caps
//  chord routing; the state machine is WindowSwitchState (EdgeWindowsCore).
//  Also here: the bar's Windows card, the same mosaic for what you typed.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeWindowSwitcher {
    static let shared = EdgeWindowSwitcher()

    private(set) var state = WindowSwitchState()
    private(set) var windows: [EdgeWindow] = []
    private(set) var hints: [UInt32: Character] = [:]
    private(set) var wobbles: [UInt32: Int] = [:]
    private(set) var layout = WindowMosaic.Layout(frames: [], size: .zero, rows: [])

    /// SpotlightController registers the hint letters and arrows as Carbon hot keys while
    /// the switcher is open (true) and drops them when it closes (false).
    @ObservationIgnored var claimKeys: (Bool) -> Void = { _ in }
    @ObservationIgnored private var panel: NSPanel?
    @ObservationIgnored private var showWork: DispatchWorkItem?
    @ObservationIgnored private var shown = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var screen: NSScreen?
    /// Opened by a click (no Caps to release): stays until a click, ↵, a letter or Esc.
    @ObservationIgnored private var latched = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var outsideClick: Any?

    var active: Bool { state.active }

    /// A quick Caps+Tab (released inside this) switches without drawing anything.
    private static let showDelay: TimeInterval = 0.12

    // MARK: Keys

    func tab(backward: Bool) {
        guard EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.tiling) else {
            ToastCenter.shared.show(.info, "Tiling is off — type settings to turn it on")
            return
        }
        guard state.active else { open(backward: backward); return }
        state.tab(windows.map(\.id), frontIsFirst: false, backward: backward)
        showNow()
    }

    func step(_ delta: Int) {
        guard state.active else { return }
        state.step(delta)
        showNow()
    }

    /// ↑↓: a row's worth of tiles.
    func row(_ delta: Int) { step(delta * max(1, layout.rows.first ?? 1)) }

    /// ↵ (latched), or the shelf: raise what's selected.
    func commitSelection() { finish(state.release()) }

    /// From a click on the Caps hints: open without a held Caps.
    func openLatched() {
        guard !state.active else { return }
        tab(backward: false)
        guard state.active else { return }
        latched = true
        showNow()
        outsideClick = NSEvent.addGlobalMonitorForEvents(matching: [.leftMouseDown, .rightMouseDown]) { _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeWindowSwitcher.shared.cancel() }
        }
    }

    /// Letter down: jump (and wobble). True if it was a hint.
    func hintDown(_ letter: Character) -> Bool {
        guard state.active, let id = hints.first(where: { $0.value == letter })?.key else { return false }
        if state.hintDown(id) { wobbles[id, default: 0] += 1; showNow() }
        return true
    }

    /// Letter up: commit that window.
    func hintUp(_ letter: Character) -> Bool {
        guard state.active, let id = hints.first(where: { $0.value == letter })?.key else { return false }
        finish(state.hintUp(id))
        return true
    }

    func capsReleased() { if !latched { finish(state.release()) } }
    func cancel() { finish(state.cancel()) }

    private func click(_ id: UInt32) { finish(state.click(id)) }

    // MARK: Open / close

    private func open(backward: Bool) {
        let source = EdgeWindows.shared
        guard !source.windows.isEmpty else {
            source.refreshIfStale(0)
            ToastCenter.shared.show(.info, "No other windows open")
            return
        }
        state.tab(source.windows.map(\.id), frontIsFirst: source.frontIsFirst, backward: backward)
        guard state.active else { return }
        screen = Self.pointerScreen()
        setWindows(source.windows)
        claimKeys(true)
        EdgeWindowThumbs.shared.request(windows)
        // The list is warm but can be a few seconds old: re-read now. A quick tap that
        // hasn't shown anything yet re-picks "the window behind" from the fresh list.
        source.refreshIfStale(0) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, self.state.active else { return }
                let fresh = EdgeWindows.shared.windows
                self.state.refresh(fresh.map(\.id), reopen: self.shown ? nil : EdgeWindows.shared.frontIsFirst)
                self.setWindows(fresh)
                EdgeWindowThumbs.shared.request(fresh)
                if self.shown { self.place() }
            }
        }
        let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.showNow() } }
        showWork = work
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + Self.showDelay, execute: work)
    }

    private func setWindows(_ list: [EdgeWindow]) {
        let byID = Dictionary(list.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        windows = state.ids.compactMap { byID[$0] }
        // Each window keeps its letter for the whole hold; windows that appear get the
        // letter they'd have had if it's free, else any free one (26 at most).
        let preferred = WindowHints.assign(windows.map { ($0.app, $0.title) })
        var next = hints.filter { byID[$0.key] != nil }
        var used = Set(next.values)
        for (w, want) in zip(windows, preferred) where next[w.id] == nil {
            let pick = want.flatMap { used.contains($0) ? nil : $0 } ?? WindowHints.fallback.first { !used.contains($0) }
            if let pick { next[w.id] = pick; used.insert(pick) }
        }
        hints = next
    }

    private func showNow() {
        showWork?.cancel(); showWork = nil
        guard state.active else { return }
        if !shown { shown = true; place() }
    }

    private func finish(_ outcome: WindowSwitchState.Outcome?) {
        guard let outcome else { return }
        showWork?.cancel(); showWork = nil
        latched = false
        if let outsideClick { NSEvent.removeMonitor(outsideClick); self.outsideClick = nil }
        panel?.orderOut(nil)
        shown = false
        claimKeys(false)
        let list = windows
        windows = []; hints = [:]; wobbles = [:]
        switch outcome {
        case let .commit(id, via, steps):
            guard let i = list.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return }
            EdgeWindows.shared.focus(list[i], action: "windows.switch",
                                     params: ["via": via.rawValue, "steps": steps, "position": i, "count": list.count])
        case let .cancel(steps):
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("windows.switch_cancel", params: ["steps": steps, "count": list.count])
        }
    }

    // MARK: Panel

    private static func pointerScreen() -> NSScreen {
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        return NSScreen.screens.first { $0.frame.contains(mouse) } ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens[0]
    }

    /// Size the mosaic to the screen, then the panel to the mosaic (8pt all round).
    private func place() {
        let screen = screen ?? Self.pointerScreen()
        let visible = screen.visibleFrame
        let gap = EdgeLayout.gap
        let maxWidth = min(visible.width - 128, 1240) - 2 * gap
        let maxHeight = visible.height * 0.72 - 2 * gap
        let maxTile: CGFloat = 220
        var l = WindowMosaic.layout(count: windows.count, width: maxWidth, maxHeight: maxHeight, gap: gap, maxTileHeight: maxTile)
        // Few windows: shrink the panel so tiles keep a window's shape instead of stretching.
        if l.rows.count == 1, let k = l.rows.first, let h = l.frames.first?.height {
            let snug = CGFloat(k) * h * 1.6 + CGFloat(k - 1) * gap
            if snug < maxWidth - 1 {
                l = WindowMosaic.layout(count: windows.count, width: snug, maxHeight: maxHeight, gap: gap, maxTileHeight: maxTile)
            }
        }
        layout = l
        let size = NSSize(width: l.size.width + 2 * gap, height: l.size.height + 2 * gap)
        let frame = NSRect(x: visible.midX - size.width / 2, y: visible.midY - size.height / 2, width: size.width, height: size.height).integral
        let panel = self.panel ?? makePanel()
        panel.setFrame(frame, display: false)
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()
    }

    private func makePanel() -> NSPanel {
        let p = NSPanel(contentRect: .zero, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        p.isOpaque = false; p.backgroundColor = .clear; p.hasShadow = true
        p.hidesOnDeactivate = false
        p.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 6)   // above the bar and its sheets
        p.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .transient, .ignoresCycle]
        p.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: WindowSwitcherView(model: self, onCommit: { [weak self] id in self?.click(id) }))
        host.sizingOptions = []
        p.contentView = host
        panel = p
        return p
    }

    // MARK: Tiles

    func items(for list: [EdgeWindow]) -> [WindowTileItem] {
        let thumbs = EdgeWindowThumbs.shared
        let pictures = thumbs.enabled
        return list.map { w in
            WindowTileItem(id: w.id, title: w.label, icon: EdgeWindowIcons.icon(w.pid),
                           thumbnail: pictures ? thumbs.image(w.id) : nil, dimmed: w.minimized || w.appHidden)
        }
    }
}

/// App icons by process, cached for the session.
@MainActor enum EdgeWindowIcons {
    private static var icons: [pid_t: NSImage] = [:]
    static func icon(_ pid: pid_t) -> NSImage {
        if let icon = icons[pid] { return icon }
        let icon = NSRunningApplication(processIdentifier: pid)?.icon ?? NSWorkspace.shared.icon(for: .applicationBundle)
        icons[pid] = icon
        return icon
    }
}

private struct WindowSwitcherView: View {
    let model: EdgeWindowSwitcher
    var onCommit: (UInt32) -> Void

    var body: some View {
        WindowMosaicView(items: model.items(for: model.windows), layout: model.layout, selected: model.state.selectedID,
                         hints: model.hints, radius: EdgeLayout.outerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, wobbles: model.wobbles,
                         onCommit: onCommit)
            .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
            .glassEffect(.regular, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.outerRadius, style: .continuous))
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

/// The bar's Windows card: the same mosaic, at most two rows, for what you typed.
struct EdgeWindowsBarCard: View {
    let windows: [EdgeWindow]
    let selection: Int
    var onCommit: (Int) -> Void

    static let maxTileHeight: CGFloat = 124
    static let maxHeight: CGFloat = 2 * maxTileHeight + EdgeLayout.gap

    static func layout(_ count: Int) -> WindowMosaic.Layout {
        WindowMosaic.layout(count: count, width: EdgeLayout.contentWidth, maxHeight: maxHeight,
                            gap: EdgeLayout.gap, maxTileHeight: maxTileHeight)
    }

    var body: some View {
        WindowMosaicView(items: EdgeWindowSwitcher.shared.items(for: windows), layout: Self.layout(windows.count),
                         selected: windows.indices.contains(selection) ? windows[selection].id : nil,
                         radius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap,
                         onCommit: { id in if let i = windows.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) { onCommit(i) } })
            .onAppear { EdgeWindowThumbs.shared.request(windows) }
            .onChange(of: windows.map(\.id)) { _, _ in EdgeWindowThumbs.shared.request(windows) }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeWindowsCore.swift
//  The window switcher's logic with no AppKit in it, so tools/window-switcher-test can
//  compile and check it on its own: title/app ranking, letter hints, the Caps+Tab
//  state machine, the thumbnail cache rules and the mosaic layout.
//  The AppKit side is EdgeWindows.swift (enumerate, raise) and EdgeWindowSwitcher.swift.
//

import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

// MARK: Ranking

/// Window titles and app names, ranked the way the bar ranks apps (SpotlightAppIndex):
/// exact, prefix, word prefix, acronym, contains. Lower is better. Titles edge out app
/// names at the same tier; multi-word queries can split across both ("safari github");
/// a subsequence that starts on a word is the fuzzy last resort.
enum WindowRanking {
    /// One window's searchable text, normalized once per window-list refresh so a
    /// keystroke only compares strings.
    struct Candidate {
        let app: Field
        let title: Field
        let allWords: [Substring]

        init(app: String, title: String) {
            self.app = Field(WindowRanking.normalize(app))
            self.title = Field(WindowRanking.normalize(title))
            allWords = self.app.words + self.title.words
        }
    }

    struct Field {
        let text: String
        let compact: String
        let words: [Substring]
        let acronym: String
        let chars: [Character]

        init(_ text: String) {
            self.text = text
            compact = text.replacingOccurrences(of: " ", with: "")
            words = text.split(separator: " ")
            acronym = String(words.compactMap(\.first))
            chars = Array(text)
        }
    }

    static func normalize(_ text: String) -> String {
        text.folding(options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive, .widthInsensitive], locale: .current)
            .components(separatedBy: CharacterSet.alphanumerics.inverted)
            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
            .joined(separator: " ")
    }

    /// One field against the whole needle; `base` shifts the tier (0 title, 5 app).
    private static func tier(_ needle: String, compactNeedle: String, in f: Field, base: Int) -> Int? {
        guard !f.text.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if f.text == needle || f.compact == compactNeedle { return base }
        if f.text.hasPrefix(needle) || f.compact.hasPrefix(compactNeedle) { return base + 10 }
        if f.words.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(needle) }) { return base + 20 }
        if compactNeedle.count >= 2, f.acronym.hasPrefix(compactNeedle) { return base + 30 }
        if f.text.contains(needle) || f.compact.contains(compactNeedle) { return base + 40 }
        return nil
    }

    /// Characters of `needle` in order inside the field, the first one at a word start.
    private static func subsequence(_ want: [Character], in f: Field) -> Bool {
        let hay = f.chars
        guard let first = want.first else { return false }
        for start in hay.indices where hay[start] == first && (start == 0 || hay[start - 1] == " ") {
            var j = 1, i = start + 1
            while i < hay.count && j < want.count {
                if hay[i] == want[j] { j += 1 }
                i += 1
            }
            if j == want.count { return true }
        }
        return false
    }

    /// The typed query, prepared once per keystroke.
    struct Needle {
        let text: String
        let compact: String
        let tokens: [Substring]
        let chars: [Character]
        init(normalized text: String) {
            self.text = text
            compact = text.replacingOccurrences(of: " ", with: "")
            tokens = text.split(separator: " ")
            chars = Array(compact)
        }
    }

    /// Score of one window; nil means no match.
    static func score(_ n: Needle, _ c: Candidate) -> Int? {
        guard !n.text.isEmpty else { return nil }
        var best: Int?
        if let t = tier(n.text, compactNeedle: n.compact, in: c.title, base: 0) { best = t }
        if best != 0, let a = tier(n.text, compactNeedle: n.compact, in: c.app, base: 5) { best = min(best ?? .max, a) }
        if n.tokens.count > 1 {
            if n.tokens.allSatisfy({ t in c.allWords.contains { $0.hasPrefix(t) } }) {
                best = min(best ?? .max, 22)
            } else if n.tokens.allSatisfy({ c.app.text.contains($0) || c.title.text.contains($0) }) {
                best = min(best ?? .max, 48)
            }
        } else if best == nil, n.chars.count >= 3 {
            if subsequence(n.chars, in: c.title) || subsequence(n.chars, in: c.app) { best = 60 }
        }
        return best
    }

    /// Indices of matching candidates with their scores, best first; ties keep list order
    /// (the list is most recently used first).
    static func rank(_ query: String, _ candidates: [Candidate], limit: Int = .max) -> [(index: Int, score: Int)] {
        let needle = Needle(normalized: normalize(query))
        guard needle.text.count >= 2 else { return [] }
        var hits: [(index: Int, score: Int)] = []
        for (i, c) in candidates.enumerated() {
            if let s = score(needle, c) { hits.append((i, s)) }
        }
        hits.sort { $0.score != $1.score ? $0.score < $1.score : $0.index < $1.index }
        return Array(hits.prefix(limit))
    }

    /// Where the Windows card sits among the bar's cards (SpotCard.rank, lower first).
    /// A title that clearly names a window is "take me there", like an open tab (2).
    /// An app-name hit sits right behind the Apps card (1 exact, 2 promoted).
    static func cardRank(bestScore: Int) -> Int {
        switch bestScore {
        case 5, 15: 3                 // app name exact / prefix
        case ...22: 2                 // title exact / prefix / word prefix, or words split across both
