        case ...48: 14                // acronyms, contains
        default: 30                   // fuzzy subsequence
        }
    }
}

// MARK: Letter hints

/// One letter per tile, from the app's name first (Safari → s, a second Safari → a),
/// then the title's word initials, then whatever is left. Stable for a given order.
enum WindowHints {
    static let fallback = Array("asdfghjklqwertyuiopzxcvbnm")

    static func assign(_ items: [(app: String, title: String)]) -> [Character?] {
        var used = Set<Character>()
        return items.map { item in
            let app = WindowRanking.normalize(item.app), title = WindowRanking.normalize(item.title)
            let initials = app.split(separator: " ").compactMap(\.first)
            let titleInitials = title.split(separator: " ").compactMap(\.first)
            let candidates = initials + Array(app) + titleInitials + fallback
            guard let pick = candidates.first(where: { ("a"..."z").contains($0) && !used.contains($0) }) else { return nil }
            used.insert(pick)
            return pick
        }
    }
}

// MARK: Caps+Tab state machine

/// Hold Caps, press Tab: the switcher opens on the previous window. Each Tab steps on
/// (Shift+Tab back); releasing Caps commits; Esc cancels. A hint letter jumps on key-down
/// and commits on key-up. Window ids stay the identity across list refreshes.
struct WindowSwitchState: Equatable {
    enum Via: String { case tab, hint, click }
    enum Outcome: Equatable {
        case commit(id: UInt32, via: Via, steps: Int)
        case cancel(steps: Int)
    }

    private(set) var active = false
    private(set) var ids: [UInt32] = []
    private(set) var selected = 0
    private(set) var steps = 0
    private(set) var pressedHint: UInt32?
    private var openedBackward = false

    var selectedID: UInt32? { active && ids.indices.contains(selected) ? ids[selected] : nil }

    /// `frontIsFirst`: the first window is the one you're in, so the first Tab means the one behind it.
    mutating func tab(_ windows: [UInt32], frontIsFirst: Bool, backward: Bool) {
        guard active else {
            guard !windows.isEmpty else { return }
            active = true; ids = windows; steps = 0; pressedHint = nil; openedBackward = backward
            selected = Self.start(windows.count, frontIsFirst: frontIsFirst, backward: backward)
            return
        }
        step(backward ? -1 : 1)
    }

    /// Arrow keys and Tab after the first.
    mutating func step(_ delta: Int) {
        guard active, !ids.isEmpty else { return }
        let n = ids.count
        selected = ((selected + delta) % n + n) % n
        steps += 1
    }

    private static func start(_ count: Int, frontIsFirst: Bool, backward: Bool) -> Int {
        backward ? count - 1 : (frontIsFirst && count > 1 ? 1 : 0)
    }

    /// A fresher window list landed while open: keep the same window selected. With
    /// `reopen` (nothing shown or chosen yet: a quick Caps+Tab), pick the starting window
    /// again from the fresh list instead, so a quick tap always means "the one behind".
    mutating func refresh(_ windows: [UInt32], reopen frontIsFirst: Bool? = nil) {
        guard active else { return }
        if let frontIsFirst, steps == 0, pressedHint == nil, !windows.isEmpty {
            ids = windows
            selected = Self.start(windows.count, frontIsFirst: frontIsFirst, backward: openedBackward)
            return
        }
        let keep = selectedID
        ids = windows
        if let keep, let i = windows.firstIndex(of: keep) { selected = i }
        else { selected = windows.isEmpty ? 0 : min(selected, windows.count - 1) }
        if let hint = pressedHint, !windows.contains(hint) { pressedHint = nil }
    }

    mutating func hintDown(_ id: UInt32) -> Bool {
        guard active, let i = ids.firstIndex(of: id) else { return false }
        selected = i; pressedHint = id
        return true
    }

    mutating func hintUp(_ id: UInt32) -> Outcome? {
        guard active, pressedHint == id, ids.contains(id) else { return nil }
        return finish(.commit(id: id, via: .hint, steps: steps))
    }

    mutating func click(_ id: UInt32) -> Outcome? {
        guard active, ids.contains(id) else { return nil }
        return finish(.commit(id: id, via: .click, steps: steps))
    }

    /// Caps up.
    mutating func release() -> Outcome? {
        guard active else { return nil }
        guard let id = selectedID else { return finish(.cancel(steps: steps)) }
        return finish(.commit(id: id, via: pressedHint == id ? .hint : .tab, steps: steps))
    }

    mutating func cancel() -> Outcome? {
        guard active else { return nil }
        return finish(.cancel(steps: steps))
    }

    private mutating func finish(_ outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome {
        self = WindowSwitchState()
        return outcome
    }
}

// MARK: Thumbnail cache rules

/// Stale-while-revalidate: a cached thumbnail always shows; it's recaptured when it's
/// older than `maxAge`, when the window changed size, or never while a capture is in
/// flight. Closed windows are pruned; past `capacity` the least recently shown go.
struct WindowThumbCache<Image> {
    struct Entry {
        var image: Image
        var captured: TimeInterval
        var size: CGSize
        var lastUsed: TimeInterval
    }

    let maxAge: TimeInterval
    let capacity: Int
    private(set) var entries: [UInt32: Entry] = [:]
    private(set) var inFlight: Set<UInt32> = []

    init(maxAge: TimeInterval, capacity: Int) { self.maxAge = maxAge; self.capacity = capacity }

    func image(_ id: UInt32) -> Image? { entries[id]?.image }

    func needsCapture(_ id: UInt32, size: CGSize, now: TimeInterval) -> Bool {
        guard !inFlight.contains(id) else { return false }
        guard let e = entries[id] else { return true }
        if abs(e.size.width - size.width) > 2 || abs(e.size.height - size.height) > 2 { return true }
        return now - e.captured > maxAge
    }

    /// Marks a capture as started; false if one is already running.
    mutating func begin(_ id: UInt32) -> Bool { inFlight.insert(id).inserted }

    mutating func store(_ id: UInt32, _ image: Image, size: CGSize, now: TimeInterval) {
        // A capture that finishes after its window closed (pruned meanwhile) is dropped.
        guard inFlight.remove(id) != nil else { return }
        entries[id] = Entry(image: image, captured: now, size: size, lastUsed: entries[id]?.lastUsed ?? now)
        evict()
    }

    mutating func fail(_ id: UInt32) { inFlight.remove(id) }

    mutating func touch(_ id: UInt32, now: TimeInterval) { entries[id]?.lastUsed = now }

    mutating func prune(keeping live: Set<UInt32>) {
        entries = entries.filter { live.contains($0.key) }
        inFlight = inFlight.filter(live.contains)
    }

    mutating func removeAll() { entries.removeAll(); inFlight.removeAll() }

    private mutating func evict() {
        guard entries.count > capacity else { return }
        let drop = entries.sorted { $0.value.lastUsed < $1.value.lastUsed }.prefix(entries.count - capacity).map(\.key)
        drop.forEach { entries.removeValue(forKey: $0) }
    }
}

// MARK: Mosaic

/// Justified rows: every row spans the full width with exact gaps, so there's never a
/// hole or centered leftover. Fuller rows go first; a shorter row's tiles get wider.
/// Picks the row count that makes the smallest tile biggest within the height limits.
enum WindowMosaic {
    struct Layout: Equatable {
        var frames: [CGRect]
        var size: CGSize
        var rows: [Int]   // tiles per row, top first
    }

    static func layout(count: Int, width: CGFloat, maxHeight: CGFloat, gap: CGFloat,
                       aspect: CGFloat = 1.6, maxTileHeight: CGFloat) -> Layout {
        guard count > 0, width > 0 else { return Layout(frames: [], size: .zero, rows: []) }
        var best: (area: CGFloat, rows: [Int], height: CGFloat)?
        for r in 1...count {
            let full = (count + r - 1) / r
            let rows = rowCounts(count, rows: r)
            guard rows.count == r else { continue }
            let narrowest = (width - CGFloat(full - 1) * gap) / CGFloat(full)
            let h = min(narrowest / aspect, maxTileHeight, (maxHeight - CGFloat(r - 1) * gap) / CGFloat(r))
            guard h > 0 else { continue }
            // Area of the biggest window-shaped picture the narrowest tile can show: a wide
            // strip only shows a sliver, so it can't win on raw area.
            let area = min(narrowest, h * aspect) * min(h, narrowest / aspect)
            if best == nil || area > best!.area + 0.5 { best = (area, rows, h) }
        }
        guard let best else { return Layout(frames: [], size: .zero, rows: []) }
        var frames: [CGRect] = []
        let h = best.height.rounded(.down)
        for (row, k) in best.rows.enumerated() {
            let y = CGFloat(row) * (h + gap)
            let w = (width - CGFloat(k - 1) * gap) / CGFloat(k)
            for i in 0..<k { frames.append(CGRect(x: CGFloat(i) * (w + gap), y: y, width: w, height: h)) }
        }
        let total = CGFloat(best.rows.count) * h + CGFloat(best.rows.count - 1) * gap
        return Layout(frames: frames, size: CGSize(width: width, height: total), rows: best.rows)
    }

    /// `count` split into `rows` rows differing by at most one, fuller rows first.
    static func rowCounts(_ count: Int, rows: Int) -> [Int] {
        guard rows > 0, count >= rows else { return [] }
        let base = count / rows, extra = count % rows
        return (0..<rows).map { $0 < extra ? base + 1 : base }
    }
}
//
//  ShortcutMap.swift
//  The shortcut translation layer (Orion-style).
//
//  Every browser action lives in one registry with a default key chord, and
//  every chord is user-remappable. Key events are no longer compared against
//  hardcoded key codes scattered through the keyboard handler — they are
//  *translated* through this map into a `BrowserAction`, and the handler only
//  knows how to perform actions. Rebinding therefore changes behavior
//  everywhere at once: the handler, the ⌘/ cheat sheet, and the settings pane
//  all read the same map.
//
//  Overrides persist in UserDefaults (they are app-layer input plumbing, not
//  renderable state, so they deliberately don't ride the core snapshot).
//  Assigning a chord that another action already uses steals it — the other
//  action becomes unbound, shown as "—" until rebound or reset.
//

import AppKit
import Observation

// MARK: - Actions

/// Everything the keyboard can do, independent of what keys trigger it.
enum BrowserAction: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    // Tabs & spaces
    case newTab, closeTab, closeTabAlternate, reopenClosedTab, nextTab, previousTab
    case cycleMegatab, subTabSwitcher, newTabInSite
    case workspace1, workspace2, workspace3, workspace4, workspace5, workspace6, workspace7, workspace8, workspace9
    // Navigation
    case editAddress, reload, hardReload, stopLoading, back, forward
    // View
    case zoomIn, zoomOut, zoomReset, toggleSidebar
    // Input
    case voiceDictation
    // Find & search
    case findInPage, history
    // Help
    case cheatSheet

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .newTab: "New tab"
        case .closeTab: "Close tab"
        case .closeTabAlternate: "Close tab (alternate)"
        case .reopenClosedTab: "Reopen closed tab"
        case .nextTab: "Next tab"
        case .previousTab: "Previous tab"
        case .cycleMegatab: "Cycle megatabs"
        case .subTabSwitcher: "Sub-tab switcher (hold modifier, tap key)"
        case .newTabInSite: "New tab in focused site"
        case .workspace1: "Switch to workspace 1"
        case .workspace2: "Switch to workspace 2"
        case .workspace3: "Switch to workspace 3"
        case .workspace4: "Switch to workspace 4"
        case .workspace5: "Switch to workspace 5"
        case .workspace6: "Switch to workspace 6"
        case .workspace7: "Switch to workspace 7"
        case .workspace8: "Switch to workspace 8"
        case .workspace9: "Switch to workspace 9"
        case .editAddress: "Edit address"
        case .reload: "Reload page"
        case .hardReload: "Reload, ignoring cache"
        case .stopLoading: "Stop loading"
        case .back: "Back"
        case .forward: "Forward"
        case .zoomIn: "Zoom in"
        case .zoomOut: "Zoom out"
        case .zoomReset: "Reset zoom"
        case .toggleSidebar: "Toggle sidebar"
        case .voiceDictation: "Voice dictation"
        case .findInPage: "Find in page"
        case .history: "History"
        case .cheatSheet: "Keyboard shortcuts overlay"
        }
    }

    var group: String {
        switch self {
        case .newTab, .closeTab, .closeTabAlternate, .reopenClosedTab, .nextTab, .previousTab,
             .cycleMegatab, .subTabSwitcher, .newTabInSite,
             .workspace1, .workspace2, .workspace3, .workspace4, .workspace5,
             .workspace6, .workspace7, .workspace8, .workspace9:
            "Tabs & Spaces"
        case .editAddress, .reload, .hardReload, .stopLoading, .back, .forward:
            "Navigation"
        case .zoomIn, .zoomOut, .zoomReset, .toggleSidebar:
            "View"
        case .voiceDictation:
            "Input"
        case .findInPage, .history, .cheatSheet:
            "Find & Help"
        }
    }

    /// Adding ⇧ to the chord runs the action in reverse (cycle backwards,
    /// switcher steps back). Matching tolerates the extra shift for these.
    var shiftReversible: Bool {
        switch self {
        case .cycleMegatab, .subTabSwitcher: true
        default: false
        }
    }

    var isRemappable: Bool {
        self != .voiceDictation
    }

    /// Display order inside the settings pane / cheat sheet.
    static let groupOrder = ["Tabs & Spaces", "Navigation", "View", "Input", "Find & Help"]
}

// MARK: - Chords

/// One concrete key combination. `keyCode` does the matching; `key` is the
/// human label for the base key (captured at record time, so it shows what
/// the user actually pressed).
struct KeyChord: Codable, Hashable {
    var keyCode: Int
    var modifiers: UInt
    var key: String

    var flags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags { NSEvent.ModifierFlags(rawValue: modifiers) }

    init(keyCode: Int, flags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags, key: String) {
        self.keyCode = keyCode
        self.modifiers = flags.intersection([.command, .option, .shift, .control]).rawValue
        self.key = key
    }

    var display: String {
        var s = ""
        if flags.contains(.control) { s += "⌃" }
        if flags.contains(.option) { s += "⌥" }
        if flags.contains(.shift) { s += "⇧" }
        if flags.contains(.command) { s += "⌘" }
        return s + key
    }

    /// The base-key label for an event, preferring readable names for the
    /// invisible keys.
    static func keyLabel(for event: NSEvent) -> String {
        switch Int(event.keyCode) {
        case 48: return "Tab"
        case 49: return "Space"
        case 36, 76: return "⏎"
        case 51: return "⌫"
        case 53: return "Esc"
        case 123: return "←"
        case 124: return "→"
        case 125: return "↓"
        case 126: return "↑"
        default:
            let s = event.charactersIgnoringModifiers ?? "?"
            return s.count == 1 ? s.uppercased() : s
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - The map

@MainActor
@Observable
final class ShortcutMap {
    /// Current binding per action. A key that maps to `nil` is unbound (its
    /// default was stolen by another action).
    private(set) var bindings: [BrowserAction: KeyChord?] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored var onBindingsChanged: (() -> Void)?

    static let defaults: [BrowserAction: KeyChord] = [
        .newTab: KeyChord(keyCode: 17, flags: .command, key: "T"),
        .closeTab: KeyChord(keyCode: 13, flags: .command, key: "W"),
        .closeTabAlternate: KeyChord(keyCode: 13, flags: .option, key: "W"),
        .reopenClosedTab: KeyChord(keyCode: 17, flags: [.command, .shift], key: "T"),
        .nextTab: KeyChord(keyCode: 48, flags: .control, key: "Tab"),
        .previousTab: KeyChord(keyCode: 48, flags: [.control, .shift], key: "Tab"),
        .cycleMegatab: KeyChord(keyCode: 48, flags: .option, key: "Tab"),
        .subTabSwitcher: KeyChord(keyCode: 50, flags: .option, key: "`"),
        .newTabInSite: KeyChord(keyCode: 17, flags: .option, key: "T"),
        .workspace1: KeyChord(keyCode: 18, flags: .command, key: "1"),
        .workspace2: KeyChord(keyCode: 19, flags: .command, key: "2"),
        .workspace3: KeyChord(keyCode: 20, flags: .command, key: "3"),
        .workspace4: KeyChord(keyCode: 21, flags: .command, key: "4"),
        .workspace5: KeyChord(keyCode: 23, flags: .command, key: "5"),
        .workspace6: KeyChord(keyCode: 22, flags: .command, key: "6"),
        .workspace7: KeyChord(keyCode: 26, flags: .command, key: "7"),
        .workspace8: KeyChord(keyCode: 28, flags: .command, key: "8"),
        .workspace9: KeyChord(keyCode: 25, flags: .command, key: "9"),
        .editAddress: KeyChord(keyCode: 37, flags: .command, key: "L"),
        .reload: KeyChord(keyCode: 15, flags: .command, key: "R"),
        .hardReload: KeyChord(keyCode: 15, flags: [.command, .shift], key: "R"),
        .stopLoading: KeyChord(keyCode: 47, flags: .command, key: "."),
        .back: KeyChord(keyCode: 33, flags: .command, key: "["),
        .forward: KeyChord(keyCode: 30, flags: .command, key: "]"),
        .zoomIn: KeyChord(keyCode: 24, flags: .command, key: "+"),
        .zoomOut: KeyChord(keyCode: 27, flags: .command, key: "−"),
        .zoomReset: KeyChord(keyCode: 29, flags: .command, key: "0"),
        .toggleSidebar: KeyChord(keyCode: 1, flags: .command, key: "S"),
        .voiceDictation: KeyChord(keyCode: 49, flags: .option, key: "Space"),
        .findInPage: KeyChord(keyCode: 3, flags: .command, key: "F"),
        .history: KeyChord(keyCode: 16, flags: .command, key: "Y"),
        .cheatSheet: KeyChord(keyCode: 44, flags: .command, key: "/"),
    ]

    private static let storageKey = "shortcuts.overrides.v1"

    /// The persisted diff against the defaults. `chord == nil` means unbound.
    private struct Override: Codable {
        let action: String
        let chord: KeyChord?
    }

    init() {
        for action in BrowserAction.allCases {
            bindings[action] = Self.defaults[action]
        }
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.storageKey),
           let overrides = try? JSONDecoder().decode([Override].self, from: data) {
            for o in overrides {
                guard let action = BrowserAction(rawValue: o.action) else { continue }
                guard action.isRemappable else { continue }
                bindings[action] = o.chord
            }
        }
        bindings[.voiceDictation] = Self.defaults[.voiceDictation]
    }

    func chord(for action: BrowserAction) -> KeyChord? {
        if action == .voiceDictation { return Self.defaults[.voiceDictation] }
        return bindings[action] ?? nil
    }

    func isDefault(_ action: BrowserAction) -> Bool {
        chord(for: action) == Self.defaults[action]
    }

    /// Bind `chord` to `action`, stealing it from any other action that holds
    /// the same combination (Orion's behavior — the old owner goes unbound).
    func set(_ chord: KeyChord, for action: BrowserAction) {
        guard action.isRemappable else {
            bindings[.voiceDictation] = Self.defaults[.voiceDictation]
            save()
            return
        }
        guard chord != Self.defaults[.voiceDictation] else { return }
        for other in BrowserAction.allCases where other != action {
            guard other.isRemappable else { continue }
            if let existing = self.chord(for: other),
               existing.keyCode == chord.keyCode, existing.modifiers == chord.modifiers {
                bindings[other] = KeyChord?.none
            }
        }
        bindings[action] = chord
        save()
    }

    /// Remove the binding entirely (the action becomes unreachable by key).
    func clear(_ action: BrowserAction) {
        guard action.isRemappable else {
            bindings[.voiceDictation] = Self.defaults[.voiceDictation]
            save()
            return
        }
        bindings[action] = KeyChord?.none
        save()
    }

    func reset(_ action: BrowserAction) {
        bindings[action] = Self.defaults[action]
        save()
    }

    func resetAll() {
        for action in BrowserAction.allCases {
            bindings[action] = Self.defaults[action]
        }
        save()
    }

    /// The translation: a key-down event → the action it triggers, plus
    /// whether the shift-reverse variant was used. Exact modifier match, so
    /// ⌘F and ⌘⇧F stay distinct bindings.
    func match(_ event: NSEvent) -> (action: BrowserAction, reversed: Bool)? {
        let code = Int(event.keyCode)
        let flags = event.modifierFlags
            .intersection(.deviceIndependentFlagsMask)
            .intersection([.command, .option, .shift, .control])
        for action in BrowserAction.allCases {
            guard let chord = chord(for: action), chord.keyCode == code else { continue }
            if flags == chord.flags { return (action, false) }
            if action.shiftReversible, flags == chord.flags.union(.shift) { return (action, true) }
        }
        return nil
    }

    private func save() {
        let overrides: [Override] = BrowserAction.allCases.compactMap { action in
            guard action.isRemappable else { return nil }
            let current = chord(for: action)
            guard current != Self.defaults[action] else { return nil }
            return Override(action: action.rawValue, chord: current)
        }
        if overrides.isEmpty {
            UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: Self.storageKey)
        } else if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(overrides) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.storageKey)
        }
        onBindingsChanged?()
    }
}
//
//  TileEngine.swift
//  Grid tiling for other apps' windows (Caps+W with another app in front). The edge
//  workspaces themselves tile automatically: see AutoTiler (dwindle).
//
//  The screen's usable area is a 6×4 grid. A tiled workspace owns a rectangle of
//  cells; its frame is that rectangle with 8pt gaps. Ways in:
//    • drag any workspace: a small screen-shaped grid fades in at the center; moving
//      over it paints a region (the real target ghosts on screen); drop to snap.
//      Option-drop, or dropping away from the grid, is a free (untiled) move.
//    • Caps+W: the same grid, interactive, for the focused workspace.
//  No overlap unless intended: a placed tile carves its cells out of any tile it
//  covers (that tile keeps its largest remaining rectangle, or moves to the largest
//  free one). A workspace that appears while others are tiled takes the largest free
//  region. Surface lives in the other process; it relays drags over distributed
//  notifications and receives frames through WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct TileRegion: Codable, Equatable, Hashable {
    var c0: Int, r0: Int, c1: Int, r1: Int   // inclusive; row 0 is the top row
    init(_ a: TileCell, _ b: TileCell) {
        c0 = min(a.c, b.c); c1 = max(a.c, b.c); r0 = min(a.r, b.r); r1 = max(a.r, b.r)
    }
    init(c0: Int, r0: Int, c1: Int, r1: Int) { self.c0 = c0; self.r0 = r0; self.c1 = c1; self.r1 = r1 }
    var cells: Int { (c1 - c0 + 1) * (r1 - r0 + 1) }
    func intersects(_ o: TileRegion) -> Bool { c0 <= o.c1 && o.c0 <= c1 && r0 <= o.r1 && o.r0 <= r1 }
    func contains(_ cell: TileCell) -> Bool { (c0...c1).contains(cell.c) && (r0...r1).contains(cell.r) }
}
struct TileCell: Equatable, Hashable { var c: Int, r: Int }

@MainActor @Observable final class TileGridModel {
    var anchor: TileCell?
    var current: TileCell?
    var interactive = false
    var targetTitle = ""
    var occupied: [(region: TileRegion, title: String, isTarget: Bool)] = []
    var selection: TileRegion? {
        guard let anchor, let current else { return nil }
        return TileRegion(anchor, current)
    }
}

@MainActor final class TileEngine {
    static let shared = TileEngine()
    static var columns: Int { EdgeSettings.tilingGrid.columns }
    static var rows: Int { EdgeSettings.tilingGrid.rows }
    static var gap: CGFloat { EdgeSettings.tilingGap }
    private static let dragNote = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.tile.drag")
    private static let gridNote = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.tile.grid")
    private static let storeKey = "edge.tiles.v1"

    let model = TileGridModel()
    private var tiles: [String: TileRegion] = [:]
    private var placedThisSession: Set<String> = []
    private var overlay: NSPanel?
    private let ghost = WorkspaceSnapPreview()
    private var dragKey: String?
    private var pickerKey: String?
    private var observers: [NSObjectProtocol] = []
    private var keyMonitor: Any?

    private init() {
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.storeKey),
           let saved = try? JSONDecoder().decode([String: TileRegion].self, from: data) { tiles = saved }
    }

    /// Wire up drag relays from Surface and visibility-driven auto-tiling.
    func start() {
        // Workspace drags (ours and Surface's relayed ones) belong to the dwindle tiler.
        WorkspacePlacement.dragHook = { key, phase, point, option in
            AutoTiler.shared.drag(key: key, phase: phase, point: point, option: option)
        }
        observers.append(DistributedNotificationCenter.default().addObserver(forName: Self.dragNote, object: nil, queue: .main) { note in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let info = note.userInfo, let key = info["key"] as? String,
                      let phase = info["phase"] as? Int, let x = info["x"] as? Double, let y = info["y"] as? Double else { return }
                _ = AutoTiler.shared.drag(key: key, phase: phase, point: NSPoint(x: x, y: y), option: info["option"] as? Bool ?? false)
            }
        })
        WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared.onPeerState = { peer in
            AutoTiler.shared.peerChanged(peer)
            UnifiedTiling.shared.refresh()   // the shared layout hears every open, close and move
        }
        AutoTiler.shared.start()
        // Other apps' windows: the same grid by dragging them, and the auto-tiler
        // (inert, no observers, until a display is turned on). docs/features/windows.md
        ForeignDragGrid.shared.start()
        AutoTileController.shared.refresh()
        EdgeModules.shared.onChange.append { module, _ in
            if module == .tiling { AutoTileController.shared.refresh() }
        }
        EdgeSettingsStore.shared.onChange.append { key in
            if key == EdgeSettings.tilingGapKey || key == ForeignWindowManager.layoutKey || key == ForeignWindowManager.floatKey {
                AutoTileController.shared.refresh()
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Geometry

    /// Another app's window: the grid (and its frames) on the screen it's being placed on.
    private var targetScreen: NSScreen?
    private func screen() -> NSScreen { targetScreen ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens[0] }
    private func pickScreen(for key: String) {
        guard ForeignWindows.bundle(of: key) != nil else { targetScreen = nil; return }
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        targetScreen = NSScreen.screens.first { NSMouseInRect(mouse, $0.frame, false) }
    }
    private func area() -> NSRect { WorkspaceTiling.area(screen()) }

    func frame(for region: TileRegion) -> NSRect {
        // Tiles saved on a bigger grid (Settings → Tiling) clamp to the current one.
        var r = region
        r.c0 = min(r.c0, Self.columns - 1); r.c1 = min(r.c1, Self.columns - 1)
        r.r0 = min(r.r0, Self.rows - 1); r.r1 = min(r.r1, Self.rows - 1)
        let a = area(), g = Self.gap
        let w = (a.width - CGFloat(Self.columns - 1) * g) / CGFloat(Self.columns)
        let h = (a.height - CGFloat(Self.rows - 1) * g) / CGFloat(Self.rows)
        let x = a.minX + CGFloat(r.c0) * (w + g)
        let width = CGFloat(r.c1 - r.c0 + 1) * w + CGFloat(r.c1 - r.c0) * g
        let height = CGFloat(r.r1 - r.r0 + 1) * h + CGFloat(r.r1 - r.r0) * g
        let top = a.maxY - CGFloat(r.r0) * (h + g)
        return NSRect(x: x, y: top - height, width: width, height: height)
    }

    // MARK: Layout rules

    /// Places `key` at `region`; tiles it covers keep their largest uncovered part.
    func assign(_ key: String, to region: TileRegion) {
        tiles[key] = region
        placedThisSession.insert(key)
        var changed: Set<String> = [key]
        for (other, r) in tiles where other != key && r.intersects(region) {
            if let rest = largestRemainder(of: r, excluding: region) {
                tiles[other] = rest
            } else if let free = largestFree(excluding: other) {
                tiles[other] = free
            } else {
                tiles[other] = nil   // nowhere left: it floats where it is
            }
            changed.insert(other)
        }
        save()
        // Another app's tile from an earlier session is only a record: its app's focused
        // window today may be anything, so it isn't moved (no surprise moves).
        for k in changed where ForeignWindows.bundle(of: k) == nil || placedThisSession.contains(k) {
            if let r = tiles[k] { apply(k, r) }
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("workspace.tile_region", params: ["workspace": key, "c0": region.c0, "r0": region.r0, "c1": region.c1, "r1": region.r1])
    }

    func untile(_ key: String) {
        guard tiles[key] != nil else { return }
        tiles[key] = nil; save()
    }

    private func largestRemainder(of r: TileRegion, excluding cut: TileRegion) -> TileRegion? {
        var options: [TileRegion] = []
        if cut.c0 > r.c0 { options.append(TileRegion(c0: r.c0, r0: r.r0, c1: min(r.c1, cut.c0 - 1), r1: r.r1)) }
        if cut.c1 < r.c1 { options.append(TileRegion(c0: max(r.c0, cut.c1 + 1), r0: r.r0, c1: r.c1, r1: r.r1)) }
        if cut.r0 > r.r0 { options.append(TileRegion(c0: r.c0, r0: r.r0, c1: r.c1, r1: min(r.r1, cut.r0 - 1))) }
        if cut.r1 < r.r1 { options.append(TileRegion(c0: r.c0, r0: max(r.r0, cut.r1 + 1), c1: r.c1, r1: r.r1)) }
        return options.filter { !$0.intersects(cut) }.max { $0.cells < $1.cells }
    }

    /// The biggest rectangle of cells no other visible tile uses.
    private func largestFree(excluding key: String? = nil, minimumCells: Int = 1) -> TileRegion? {
        let taken = tiles.filter { $0.key != key && isVisible($0.key) }.map(\.value)
        var best: TileRegion?
        for c0 in 0..<Self.columns { for c1 in c0..<Self.columns {
            for r0 in 0..<Self.rows { for r1 in r0..<Self.rows {
                let r = TileRegion(c0: c0, r0: r0, c1: c1, r1: r1)
                guard r.cells >= minimumCells, !taken.contains(where: { $0.intersects(r) }) else { continue }
                if best == nil || r.cells > best!.cells { best = r }
            }}
        }}
        return best
    }

    private func isVisible(_ key: String) -> Bool {
        if let bundle = ForeignWindows.bundle(of: key) { return ForeignWindows.isRunning(bundle) }
        return WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared.peer(key)?.visible ?? false
    }

    private func apply(_ key: String, _ region: TileRegion) {
        let target = frame(for: region)
        if let bundle = ForeignWindows.bundle(of: key) { ForeignWindows.move(bundle, to: target); return }
        let coordinator = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        if let placement = coordinator.localPlacement(key) {
            placement.enterFloatingMode()
            placement.move(target)
        } else if let peer = coordinator.peer(key) {
            coordinator.movePeer(peer, to: target, floating: true)
        }
    }

    private func save() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(tiles) { UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.storeKey) }
    }

    // MARK: Drag trigger

    /// Called for every workspace drag phase (0 begin, 1 move, 2 end). Returns true at
    /// the end when the drop landed on the grid and the engine placed the window.
    func drag(key: String, phase: Int, point: NSPoint, option: Bool) -> Bool {
        switch phase {
        case 0:
            dragKey = key
            pickScreen(for: key)
            model.anchor = nil; model.current = nil
            showOverlay(interactive: false, target: key)
            return false
        case 1:
            guard dragKey == key else { return false }
            track(point)
            return false
        default:
            guard dragKey == key else { return false }
            defer { dragKey = nil; hideOverlay(); targetScreen = nil }
            if !option, let region = model.selection, overlay?.frame.contains(point) == true {
                assign(key, to: region); return true
            }
            untile(key)   // a free move (or Option-drop) leaves the grid
            return false
        }
    }

    private func track(_ point: NSPoint) {
        guard let cell = cell(at: point) else { model.current = nil; model.anchor = nil; ghost.hide(); return }
        if model.anchor == nil { model.anchor = cell }
        model.current = cell
        if let r = model.selection { ghost.show(frame(for: r)) }
    }

    private func cell(at point: NSPoint) -> TileCell? {
        guard let overlay, let grid = gridRect(in: overlay.frame), grid.contains(point) else { return nil }
        let c = Int((point.x - grid.minX) / grid.width * CGFloat(Self.columns))
        let rFromBottom = Int((point.y - grid.minY) / grid.height * CGFloat(Self.rows))
        return TileCell(c: min(max(0, c), Self.columns - 1), r: min(max(0, Self.rows - 1 - rFromBottom), Self.rows - 1))
    }

    // MARK: Caps+W picker

    func showPicker(for key: String) {
        pickerKey = key
        pickScreen(for: key)
        model.anchor = nil; model.current = nil
        showOverlay(interactive: true, target: key)
    }

    fileprivate func pickerDrag(_ point: NSPoint, began: Bool) {
        guard pickerKey != nil, let cell = cell(at: point) else { return }
        if began || model.anchor == nil { model.anchor = cell }
        model.current = cell
        if let r = model.selection { ghost.show(frame(for: r)) }
    }

    fileprivate func pickerCommit() {
        guard let key = pickerKey else { return }
        let region = model.selection
        pickerKey = nil; hideOverlay()
        if let region { assign(key, to: region) }
        targetScreen = nil
    }

    func pickerCancel() { pickerKey = nil; hideOverlay(); targetScreen = nil }

    // MARK: Overlay

    private static let overlayWidth: CGFloat = 320
    private func overlaySize() -> NSSize {
        let s = screen().frame
        return NSSize(width: Self.overlayWidth + 32, height: Self.overlayWidth * s.height / s.width + 64)
    }
    /// The cell grid inside the overlay panel, in screen coordinates.
    private func gridRect(in panelFrame: NSRect) -> NSRect? {
        let s = screen().frame
        let h = Self.overlayWidth * s.height / s.width
        // Grid sits at the top of the panel (hint text below); AppKit's origin is bottom-left.
        return NSRect(x: panelFrame.minX + 16, y: panelFrame.maxY - 16 - h, width: Self.overlayWidth, height: h)
    }

    private func showOverlay(interactive: Bool, target: String) {
        let peers = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        model.interactive = interactive
        model.targetTitle = ForeignWindows.bundle(of: target).flatMap(ForeignWindows.name)
            ?? peers.peer(target)?.title.replacingOccurrences(of: "Nardo · ", with: "") ?? target
        model.occupied = tiles.filter { isVisible($0.key) || $0.key == target }.map {
            (region: $0.value, title: Self.shortTitle(peers.peer($0.key)?.title ?? $0.key), isTarget: $0.key == target)
        }
        if overlay == nil {
            let panel = TileOverlayPanel(contentRect: .zero, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
            panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false; panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
            panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 4)
            panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
            panel.contentView = NSHostingView(rootView: TileGridView(model: model))
            overlay = panel
        }
        guard let overlay else { return }
        let size = overlaySize(), s = screen().frame
        overlay.setFrame(NSRect(x: s.midX - size.width / 2, y: s.midY - size.height / 2, width: size.width, height: size.height), display: true)
        // Drag mode passes the mouse through to the window being dragged.
        overlay.ignoresMouseEvents = !interactive
        overlay.alphaValue = 0
        overlay.orderFrontRegardless()
        if interactive { overlay.makeKey() }
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { $0.duration = 0.12; overlay.animator().alphaValue = 1 }
        DistributedNotificationCenter.default().postNotificationName(Self.gridNote, object: nil,
            userInfo: ["x": overlay.frame.minX, "y": overlay.frame.minY, "w": overlay.frame.width, "h": overlay.frame.height, "visible": true],
            deliverImmediately: true)
        if interactive, keyMonitor == nil {
            keyMonitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .keyDown) { [weak self] e in
                guard self?.pickerKey != nil else { return e }
                if e.keyCode == 53 { self?.pickerCancel(); return nil }
                return e
            }
        }
    }

    private func hideOverlay() {
        ghost.hide()
        guard let overlay else { return }
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup({ $0.duration = 0.1; overlay.animator().alphaValue = 0 }) { [weak overlay] in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { if overlay?.alphaValue == 0 { overlay?.orderOut(nil) } }
        }
        DistributedNotificationCenter.default().postNotificationName(Self.gridNote, object: nil, userInfo: ["visible": false], deliverImmediately: true)
        if let keyMonitor { NSEvent.removeMonitor(keyMonitor); self.keyMonitor = nil }
    }

    private static func shortTitle(_ t: String) -> String {
        t.replacingOccurrences(of: "Nardo · ", with: "").replacingOccurrences(of: "Option Browser · Edge", with: "Browser").replacingOccurrences(of: "Nardo Browser", with: "Browser")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "Surface · ", with: "")
    }
}

private final class TileOverlayPanel: NSPanel {
    override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { TileEngine.shared.pickerDrag(NSEvent.mouseLocation, began: true) }
    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) { TileEngine.shared.pickerDrag(NSEvent.mouseLocation, began: false) }
    override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) { TileEngine.shared.pickerCommit() }
}

/// The small screen-shaped 6×4 grid: existing tiles faintly, the painted region in accent.
private struct TileGridView: View {
    let model: TileGridModel
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            GeometryReader { geo in TileCells(model: model, size: geo.size) }
            .frame(width: 320)
            Text(model.interactive ? "Drag across the grid to place \(model.targetTitle) · Esc to cancel"
                                   : "Drop on the grid to tile · ⌥ to place freely")
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.6))
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background { Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 22, style: .continuous)) }
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 22, style: .continuous).strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

private struct TileCells: View {
    let model: TileGridModel
    let size: CGSize
    private let g: CGFloat = 4
    private var cw: CGFloat { (size.width - CGFloat(TileEngine.columns - 1) * g) / CGFloat(TileEngine.columns) }
    private var ch: CGFloat { (size.height - CGFloat(TileEngine.rows - 1) * g) / CGFloat(TileEngine.rows) }
    private func rect(_ r: TileRegion) -> CGRect {
        CGRect(x: CGFloat(r.c0) * (cw + g), y: CGFloat(r.r0) * (ch + g),
               width: CGFloat(r.c1 - r.c0 + 1) * cw + CGFloat(r.c1 - r.c0) * g,
               height: CGFloat(r.r1 - r.r0 + 1) * ch + CGFloat(r.r1 - r.r0) * g)
    }
    var body: some View {
        let cols = TileEngine.columns
        ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
            ForEach(0..<TileEngine.rows * cols, id: \.self) { i in
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(.white.opacity(0.07))
                    .frame(width: cw, height: ch)
                    .offset(x: CGFloat(i % cols) * (cw + g), y: CGFloat(i / cols) * (ch + g))
            }
            ForEach(Array(model.occupied.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, o in
                let r = rect(o.region)
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(.white.opacity(o.isTarget ? 0.10 : 0.16))
                    .overlay(Text(o.title).font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7)).lineLimit(1).padding(4))
                    .frame(width: r.width, height: r.height)
                    .offset(x: r.minX, y: r.minY)
            }
            if let sel = model.selection {
                let r = rect(sel)
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(BentoPalette.accent.opacity(0.35))
                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6, style: .continuous).strokeBorder(BentoPalette.accent, lineWidth: 1.5))
                    .frame(width: r.width, height: r.height)
                    .offset(x: r.minX, y: r.minY)
                    .animation(.spring(response: 0.18, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: sel)
            }
        }
    }
}


/// Other apps' windows on the tile grid, moved through the Accessibility API. A foreign
/// tile's key is "app.<bundle id>" and means that app's focused window.
enum ForeignWindows {
    static func key(for bundle: String) -> String { "app." + bundle }
    static func bundle(of key: String) -> String? { key.hasPrefix("app.") ? String(key.dropFirst(4)) : nil }
    static func isRunning(_ bundle: String) -> Bool {
        NSRunningApplication.runningApplications(withBundleIdentifier: bundle).contains { !$0.isTerminated }
    }
    static func name(_ bundle: String) -> String? {
        NSRunningApplication.runningApplications(withBundleIdentifier: bundle).first?.localizedName
    }

    /// True when we may move windows; otherwise asks for Accessibility in the bar (EdgePermissionAsk).
    @MainActor @discardableResult static func ensureTrusted(for module: EdgeModule = .tiling,
                                                            reason: String = "so it can arrange other apps' windows") -> Bool {
        EdgePermissionAsk.shared.request(.accessibility, for: module, reason: reason)
    }

    /// A drag of one exact window (ForeignDragGrid): `move` places that one, not the app's
    /// focused window.
    @MainActor static var pinned: [String: CGWindowID] = [:]

    /// Moves the app's focused window to `frame` (AppKit screen coordinates). The move itself
    /// runs on the AX thread (ForeignWindowManager): one frame change, minimum sizes fitted,
    /// never blocking the main thread on a slow app.
    @MainActor static func move(_ bundle: String, to frame: NSRect) {
        guard ensureTrusted(), let app = NSRunningApplication.runningApplications(withBundleIdentifier: bundle).first else { return }
        // AX positions are top-left based, measured from the top of the primary screen.
        let primaryHeight = NSScreen.screens.first?.frame.height ?? frame.maxY
        let target = CGRect(x: frame.minX, y: primaryHeight - frame.maxY, width: frame.width, height: frame.height)
        ForeignWindowManager.shared.run(.place(target), pid: app.processIdentifier, bundle: bundle, window: pinned[bundle])
    }
}
//
//  BentoSidebar.swift
//  A spatial, weighted tab dashboard.
//
//  Hierarchy corresponds to VALUE: every tab carries a frecency score
//  (how often you switch to it × how recently), groups rank by their best
//  tab, and megatabs/singles interleave in that order — the things you
//  actually use live at the top, the long tail sinks. Scores only move when
//  you switch tabs, so layout still never reshuffles under an idle pointer.
//  A megatab's "hero" stays the tab you last used in that group; the cells
//  below it order by value.
//
//  A megatab is ONE rounded container divided by hairlines — not little rounded
//  tiles floating inside it:
//    • 2 tabs      → a single full-width row split by one vertical line.
//    • 3+ tabs     → terraced bento: hero band, then two tall full-width
//                    "major" rows (value-ranked, titles fully legible), then
//                    the tail as short dim "minor" cells two-up — composed
//                    width-slicing returns only where truncation is cheap.
//                    Capped with a "+n more" expander.
//  Cards are tinted by the favicon's dominant color; hairlines inside a
//  megatab take the site accent so the card reads as one object.
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Value (frecency)

extension Tab {
    /// Frequency × recency. The log damps heavy hitters so they can be
    /// overtaken; the decay floor (0.3) keeps a habitually-used tab from being
    /// dethroned by one stray click on something new.
    var frecency: Double {
        let ageSeconds = max(0, Date.now.timeIntervalSince1970 - Double(lastActiveAt) / 1000)
        let decay = exp(-ageSeconds / (48 * 3600))
        return log(1 + Double(activatedCount)) * (0.3 + 0.7 * decay)
    }
}

// MARK: - Grouping (shared with keyboard commands)

struct TabGroup: Identifiable {
    let scopeId: String
    let host: String
    let tabs: [Tab] // STABLE order (position / first-appearance)
    var id: String { "\(scopeId)::\(host)" }

    /// The tab last interacted with here — sticky until you click another in it.
    var heroTab: Tab { tabs.max { $0.lastActiveAt < $1.lastActiveAt } ?? tabs[0] }

    /// A group is worth its most-valued tab.
    var score: Double { tabs.map(\.frecency).max() ?? 0 }

    /// Everyone but the hero, most-valued first (ties: stable position order).
    var rankedOthers: [Tab] {
        let hero = heroTab
        return tabs.filter { $0.id != hero.id }
            .sorted { a, b in
                a.frecency != b.frecency ? a.frecency > b.frecency : a.position < b.position
            }
    }

    /// Order the ⌥` switcher walks: hero first, then by value — matches what
    /// the megatab card shows top-to-bottom.
    var switcherTabs: [Tab] { [heroTab] + rankedOthers }
}

extension Tab {
    /// Stable identity for the megatab this tab belongs to. Host alone is not
    /// enough: shielded/free tabs and container tabs can share a domain but are
    /// separate sidebar objects.
    var megatabHost: String { host ?? url }

    var megatabScopeId: String {
        if let containerId { return "container-\(containerId)" }
        return shielded ? "free-shielded" : "free-normal"
    }

    var megatabId: String { "\(megatabScopeId)::\(megatabHost)" }
}

func flattenTabs(_ nodes: [TabNode]) -> [Tab] {
    var out: [Tab] = []
    func walk(_ ns: [TabNode]) { for n in ns { out.append(n.tab); walk(n.children) } }
    walk(nodes)
    return out
}

private struct TabGroupKey: Hashable {
    let scopeId: String
    let host: String
}

func groupTabs(_ tabs: [Tab]) -> [TabGroup] {
    var byKey: [TabGroupKey: [Tab]] = [:]
    var order: [TabGroupKey] = []
    for tab in tabs {
        let key = TabGroupKey(scopeId: tab.megatabScopeId, host: tab.megatabHost)
        if byKey[key] == nil { order.append(key) }
        byKey[key, default: []].append(tab)
    }
    return order.compactMap { key in
        guard let tabs = byKey[key], !tabs.isEmpty else { return nil }
        return TabGroup(scopeId: key.scopeId, host: key.host, tabs: tabs)
    }
}

/// Top-to-bottom order: groups ranked by age (oldest first) with frecency
/// as tiebreaker. Age gives a stable grid position so ⌥Tab never teleports;
/// frecency breaks ties so heavily-used groups float above same-age ones.
func displayGroups(_ tabs: [Tab]) -> [TabGroup] {
    groupTabs(tabs).enumerated()
        .sorted { a, b in
            let ageA = a.element.tabs.map(\.createdAt).min() ?? 0
            let ageB = b.element.tabs.map(\.createdAt).min() ?? 0
            if ageA != ageB { return ageA < ageB }
            if a.element.score != b.element.score { return a.element.score > b.element.score }
            return a.offset < b.offset
        }
        .map(\.element)
}

// MARK: - Shared chrome

/// Hairline — soft divider inside glass containers.
private let hairline = Color.white.opacity(0.12)

private struct VLine: View {
    var color: Color = hairline
    var body: some View { Rectangle().fill(color).frame(width: 1) }
}

private struct HLine: View {
    var color: Color = hairline
    var body: some View { Rectangle().fill(color).frame(height: 1) }
}

/// `glanced` keeps the hover wash pinned on the cell while its tab is the
/// glance-session target, even after the pointer moves off it.
private func cellFill(active: Bool, hovering: Bool, glanced: Bool = false, accent: Color) -> Color {
    // Neutral highlight, same language as single tabs (bentoCard): the favicon
    // carries the colour, the surface stays white-opacity. Active = accent rim.
    if active { return Color.white.opacity(0.16) }
    if hovering || glanced { return Color.white.opacity(0.10) }
    return .clear
}

/// Liquid glass focus ring — a glowing rim that simulates light catching the glass edge.
private func focusOverlay(_ focused: Bool, cornerRadius: CGFloat) -> some View {
    // Outward ring: sits just outside the card edge so it never eats interior space.
    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius + 2, style: .continuous)
        .inset(by: -2)
        .strokeBorder(Color.white.opacity(focused ? 0.85 : 0), lineWidth: 2)
        .shadow(color: .white.opacity(focused ? 0.15 : 0), radius: 4, y: 0)
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
}

// MARK: - Sidebar

struct BentoSidebar: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(FocusModel.self) private var focus
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    @Environment(SubTabSwitcher.self) private var switcher
    @Environment(SpotlightModel.self) private var spotlight
    let web: WebContentManager
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @Binding var sidebarVisible: Bool
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    @State private var workspacePendingDeletion: Space?
    @State private var showWorkspaceRename = false
    @State private var workspaceRenameText = ""

	    var body: some View {
	        ZStack {
	            if let snapshot = engine.snapshot {
                VStack(spacing: 0) {
                    chromeRow(snapshot)
                    workspaceBar(snapshot)
                    ScrollViewReader { proxy in
	                        Group {
		                            if let space = snapshot.activeSpaceSnapshot {
		                                WorkspaceSection(
	                                    space: space.space,
	                                    tabs: flattenTabs(space.tabs),
	                                    containers: space.containers,
	                                    activeTabId: space.space.activeTab,
	                                    focusedGroupId: focus.focusedGroupId,
	                                    splitState: $splitState)
	                            }
	                        }
	                        .animation(DesignTokens.springAnimation, value: structureSignature(snapshot))
	                        .task(id: snapshot.rev) { ensureFavicons(snapshot) }
                        .onChange(of: snapshot.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.activeTab) { _, _ in glance.close() }
                        .onChange(of: switcher.groupId) { _, groupId in
                            guard !groupId.isEmpty else { return }
                            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) {
                                proxy.scrollTo("m-\(groupId)", anchor: .center)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                    SidebarWidgetStack(web: web, downloads: downloads)
                }
            } else {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
            }
        }
        // No own glass surface — the sidebar rides the single window glass so
        // there's no material seam between it and the toolbar/detail.
        .onHover { hovering in
            if hovering { glance.cancelClose() } else { glance.scheduleClose() }
        }
        .confirmationDialog(
            workspacePendingDeletion.map { "Delete “\($0.name)” workspace?" } ?? "Delete workspace?",
            isPresented: Binding(
                get: { workspacePendingDeletion != nil },
                set: { if !$0 { workspacePendingDeletion = nil } }
            ),
            titleVisibility: .visible
        ) {
            Button("Delete Workspace", role: .destructive) {
                guard let space = workspacePendingDeletion else { return }
                engine.dispatch(.closeSpace(spaceId: space.id))
                workspacePendingDeletion = nil
            }
            Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { workspacePendingDeletion = nil }
        } message: {
            Text("Its tabs and containers will be permanently removed.")
        }
        .alert("Name Workspace", isPresented: $showWorkspaceRename) {
            TextField("Name", text: $workspaceRenameText)
            Button("Save") {
                if let id = engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.id,
                   !workspaceRenameText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty {
                    engine.dispatch(.renameSpace(spaceId: id, name: workspaceRenameText))
                }
            }
            Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) {}
        }
    }

    // Chrome-level row: traffic lights ride the leading inset, with the global
    // command surface and sidebar toggle immediately available.
    private func chromeRow(_ snapshot: Snapshot) -> some View {
        return HStack(spacing: 2) {
            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            // Sidebar toggle — on the right (⌘S also toggles it).
            Button {
                withAnimation(DesignTokens.sidebarAnimation) { sidebarVisible.toggle() }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "sidebar.left").font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7)).frame(width: BentoMetrics.iconChip, height: BentoMetrics.addressBarHeight)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .help("Toggle sidebar (⌘S)")
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 8).frame(height: 24)
    }

    /// The active workspace must remain visible and switchable. Hiding this
    /// state made every non-active workspace effectively unreachable.
    private func workspaceBar(_ snapshot: Snapshot) -> some View {
        let active = snapshot.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space
        let ordered = snapshot.spaces.sorted {
            $0.space.position != $1.space.position
                ? $0.space.position < $1.space.position
                : $0.space.id < $1.space.id
        }
        let activeNumber = active.flatMap { current in
            ordered.firstIndex(where: { $0.space.id == current.id }).flatMap { index in
                index < 9 ? index + 1 : nil
            }
        }
        return HStack(spacing: 4) {
            Menu {
                ForEach(Array(ordered.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, spaceSnapshot in
                    let space = spaceSnapshot.space
                    let shortcut = index < 9 ? "  ⌘\(index + 1)" : ""
                    Button {
                        engine.dispatch(.setActiveSpace(spaceId: space.id))
                    } label: {
                        if space.id == active?.id {
                            Label("\(space.name)\(shortcut)", systemImage: "checkmark")
                        } else {
                            Text("\(space.name)\(shortcut)")
                        }
                    }
                }
                Divider()
                Button("New Workspace", systemImage: "plus") {
                    // Create activates the space immediately; naming it is part
                    // of the same gesture — no hunting for the new entry.
                    engine.dispatch(.createSpace(name: "New Workspace"))
                    workspaceRenameText = ""
                    showWorkspaceRename = true
                }
                if let active {
                    Button("Rename “\(active.name)”…", systemImage: "pencil") {
                        workspaceRenameText = active.name
                        showWorkspaceRename = true
                    }
                    // Isolated cookie jar per workspace: separate logins,
                    // separate storage — e.g. a "Work" Google account.
                    Toggle(isOn: Binding(
                        get: { snapshot.isIsolated(active) },
                        set: { engine.dispatch(.setSpaceIsolation(spaceId: active.id, isolated: $0)) }
                    )) {
                        Label("Separate Logins & Cookies", systemImage: "person.crop.circle.badge.checkmark")
                    }
                }
                if let active, snapshot.spaces.count > 1 {
                    Button("Delete “\(active.name)”", systemImage: "trash", role: .destructive) {
                        workspacePendingDeletion = active
                    }
                }
            } label: {
                HStack(spacing: 5) {
                    Text(active?.name ?? "Workspace")
                        .font(.pp(11.5, .medium))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                    if let activeNumber {
                        Text("⌘\(activeNumber)")
                            .font(.pp(10, .medium))
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                    }
                    Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                        .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.62))
                .padding(.horizontal, 3)
                .frame(height: 22)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
            .menuStyle(.borderlessButton)
            .menuIndicator(.hidden)
            .help("Switch workspace")
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 8)
    }

    private func structureSignature(_ snapshot: Snapshot) -> Int {
        var hasher = Hasher()
        for space in snapshot.spaces {
            hasher.combine(space.space.id)
            hasher.combine(space.space.collapsed)
            for tab in flattenTabs(space.tabs) { hasher.combine(tab.id) }
        }
        return hasher.finalize()
    }



    private func ensureFavicons(_ snapshot: Snapshot) {
        for space in snapshot.spaces {
            for tab in flattenTabs(space.tabs) {
                favicons.ensure(host: tab.host, faviconURL: tab.faviconUrl)
            }
        }
    }

}

// MARK: - Workspace

private struct WorkspaceSection: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Namespace private var ns
    let space: Space
    let tabs: [Tab]
    let containers: [Container]
    let activeTabId: String?
    let focusedGroupId: String?
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @State private var renamingContainer: Container?
    @State private var renameText = ""
    @State private var dropTargetId: String?
    @State private var shieldRegionTargeted = false

    private var containerIdSet: Set<String> { Set(containers.map(\.id)) }

    /// Apply a shielded state to a dropped id, whether it's a whole container or
    /// a loose tab — this is what makes dragging a container in/out of the shield
    /// behave exactly like dragging an individual tab.
    private func applyShield(_ id: String, shielded: Bool) {
        if containerIdSet.contains(id) {
            engine.dispatch(.setContainerShielded(containerId: id, shielded: shielded))
        } else {
            engine.dispatch(.setTabShielded(tabId: id, shielded: shielded))
        }
    }

    private enum Row: Identifiable {
        case mega(TabGroup), fullSingle(Tab), pairSingle(Tab, Tab), split(SplitLayout, [Tab])
        var id: String {
            switch self {
            case .split(let l, _): return "s-\(l.id)"
            case .mega(let g): return "m-\(g.id)"
            case .fullSingle(let t): return "f-\(t.id)"
            case .pairSingle(let a, let b): return "p-\(a.id)-\(b.id)"
            }
        }
    }

    /// Rows in value order. Megatabs sit at their rank; singles pair up with
    /// their nearest-ranked neighbor as the list is walked. The top-ranked
    /// item being a single means it's the most valued thing in the workspace,
    /// so it gets a full-width row; a trailing odd single also goes full-width.
    private func rows(for tabs: [Tab]) -> [Row] {
        // Clean uniform tiling: multi-tab hosts become a megatab container, every
        // single tab gets its own full-width row (no terraced two-up pairs).
        // Splits are their own cards: their tabs leave the host groups, and the card sits
        // where its left tab lives, in age order with everything else.
        let store = SplitStore.shared
        let everyTab = Dictionary(self.tabs.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        let here = Set(tabs.map(\.id))
        let splitIds = store.splitTabIds
        var aged: [(age: Double, row: Row)] = store.layouts.compactMap { l in
            let members = l.tabs.compactMap { everyTab[$0] }
            guard let first = l.tabs.first, here.contains(first), members.count == l.tabs.count else { return nil }
            return (Double(members.map(\.createdAt).min() ?? 0), .split(l, members))
        }
        let remaining = tabs.filter { !splitIds.contains($0.id) }
        aged += displayGroups(remaining).map { group in
            (Double(group.tabs.map(\.createdAt).min() ?? 0), group.tabs.count >= 2 ? .mega(group) : .fullSingle(group.heroTab))
        }
        return aged.enumerated().sorted { a, b in a.element.age != b.element.age ? a.element.age < b.element.age : a.offset < b.offset }
            .map(\.element.row)
    }

	    var body: some View {
	        let freeTabs = tabs.filter { $0.containerId == nil }
	        let shieldedContainers = containers.filter { $0.shielded }
	        let normalContainers = containers.filter { !$0.shielded }
	        let shieldedTabs = freeTabs.filter { $0.shielded }
	        let normalTabs = freeTabs.filter { !$0.shielded }
	        let hasShielded = !shieldedContainers.isEmpty || !shieldedTabs.isEmpty
	
	        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
	            // No workspace header anymore — the sidebar's chrome row owns the
	            // toggle + search. Shielded content is fixed; normal content scrolls.
	            if tabs.isEmpty && containers.isEmpty {
	                EmptyStateView()
	                    .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.top, 4).padding(.bottom, 8)
	            } else {
	                if hasShielded {
	                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
	                        ForEach(shieldedContainers) { containerCard($0) }
	                        ForEach(rows(for: shieldedTabs)) { row in rowView(row) }
	                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.top, 4).padding(.bottom, 6)
	                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
	                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
	                    .background(
	                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous)
	                            .fill(.white.opacity(shieldRegionTargeted ? 0.06 : 0))
	                            .padding(.horizontal, 4)
	                    )
	                    // Drop a tab OR a whole container here to shield it.
	                    .dropDestination(for: String.self) { ids, _ in
	                        shieldRegionTargeted = false
	                        for id in ids { applyShield(id, shielded: true) }
	                        return !ids.isEmpty
	                    } isTargeted: { t in
	                        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12)) { shieldRegionTargeted = t }
	                    }
	                    .zIndex(2)

	                    Rectangle().fill(.white.opacity(0.12)).frame(height: 1)
	                        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
	                        .padding(.bottom, 2)
	                        .zIndex(2)
	                }
	
		                ScrollView(showsIndicators: false) {
		                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
	                        ForEach(normalContainers) { container in
	                            containerCard(container)
	                        }
	                        ForEach(rows(for: normalTabs)) { row in
	                            rowView(row)
	                        }
	                        if normalContainers.isEmpty && normalTabs.isEmpty && !hasShielded {
	                            EmptyStateView()
	                        }
	                    }
	                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
		                    .padding(.top, 2)   // 24 + 22 + 2 = 48: level with the page card
		                    .padding(.bottom, 8)
			                }
                        .verticalScrollFade(height: 24)
                        .thinOverlayScroller()
                        // Drop a shielded tab or container into the normal list to unshield it.
                        .dropDestination(for: String.self) { ids, _ in
                            for id in ids { applyShield(id, shielded: false) }
                            return !ids.isEmpty
                        }
		            }
		        }
	        .animation(.snappy(duration: 0.3), value: activeTabId)
	        .alert("Rename Container", isPresented: Binding(
	            get: { renamingContainer != nil },
            set: { if !$0 { renamingContainer = nil } })) {
            TextField("Name", text: $renameText)
            Button("Rename") {
                if let c = renamingContainer {
                    let name = renameText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                    if !name.isEmpty {
                        engine.dispatch(.renameContainer(containerId: c.id, name: name))
                    }
                }
                renamingContainer = nil
            }
            Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { renamingContainer = nil }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func rowView(_ row: Row) -> some View {
        switch row {
        case .mega(let g):
            MegaTabCard(group: g, activeTabId: activeTabId, focused: focusedGroupId == g.id, splitState: $splitState)
                .id("m-\(g.id)")
        case .fullSingle(let t):
            SmallTabCard(tab: t, active: t.id == activeTabId, focused: focusedGroupId == t.megatabId, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
        case .split(let l, let members):
            SplitTabCard(layout: l, tabs: members, activeTabId: activeTabId, splitState: $splitState)
        case .pairSingle(let a, let b):
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                SmallTabCard(tab: a, active: a.id == activeTabId, focused: focusedGroupId == a.megatabId, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                SmallTabCard(tab: b, active: b.id == activeTabId, focused: focusedGroupId == b.megatabId, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
            }
        }
    }

    /// A container ("mega-mega tab"): an accent-rimmed rectangle that wraps the
    /// megatabs/singles of the tabs assigned to it. Collapsible.
    @ViewBuilder private func containerCard(_ container: Container) -> some View {
        let cTabs = tabs.filter { $0.containerId == container.id }
        let targeted = dropTargetId == container.id
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            containerHeader(container, count: cTabs.count)
            if !container.collapsed {
                containerBody(tabs: cTabs)
            }
        }
        .padding(8)
        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous).fill(containerFill(container)))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
            .strokeBorder(targeted ? Color.white.opacity(0.65)
                          : (container.shielded ? Color.white.opacity(0.22) : Color.white.opacity(0.12)),
                          lineWidth: targeted ? 1.5 : 1))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous))
        // Whole card is the drop zone, with a clear highlight while a tab hovers.
        .contentShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous))
        // Drag a whole container like a tab — into/out of the shield, or onto
        // another container to nest it stays a container, never a loose tab.
        .draggable(container.id) { containerDragPreview(container) }
        .dropDestination(for: String.self) { ids, _ in
            dropTargetId = nil
            // Only loose tabs move *into* a container; a dropped container id is a
            // reshuffle handled by the region drop zones, not a tab move.
            let tabIds = ids.filter { !containerIdSet.contains($0) }
            for id in tabIds { engine.dispatch(.moveTabToContainer(tabId: id, containerId: container.id)) }
            return !tabIds.isEmpty
        } isTargeted: { t in
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12)) {
                if t { dropTargetId = container.id }
                else if dropTargetId == container.id { dropTargetId = nil }
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.16), value: container.collapsed)
    }

    private func containerFill(_ container: Container) -> Color {
        // No auto-coloring: one calm slate fill (domain coloring already supplies
        // plenty of hue). Only a user-set color overrides it.
        container.color.flatMap { Color(hexString: $0) }
            ?? Color(red: 0.15, green: 0.16, blue: 0.21)
    }

    private func containerHeader(_ container: Container, count: Int) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            Icon("chevron-down", size: 9)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.5))
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(container.collapsed ? -90 : 0))
            Text(container.name).font(.pp(11.5, .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(container.shielded ? 0.92 : 0.82))
                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Text("\(count)").font(.pp(10, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 4)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture {
            withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.26)) {
                _ = engine.dispatch(.setContainerCollapsed(containerId: container.id, collapsed: !container.collapsed))
            }
        }
        .contextMenu {
            Button("Rename…") {
                renameText = container.name
                renamingContainer = container
            }
            Button(container.shielded ? "Unshield" : "Shield") {
                engine.dispatch(.setContainerShielded(
                    containerId: container.id, shielded: !container.shielded))
            }
            Button(role: .destructive) {
                engine.dispatch(.deleteContainer(containerId: container.id))
            } label: { Text("Ungroup Container") }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func containerBody(tabs cTabs: [Tab]) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            ForEach(rows(for: cTabs)) { row in
                rowView(row)
            }
        }
        .clipped()
        .transition(.opacity)
    }

    private func containerDragPreview(_ container: Container) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            Text(container.name).font(.pp(12, .semibold))
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(.horizontal, 10).padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(Capsule().fill(Color(red: 0.15, green: 0.16, blue: 0.21)))
    }

}

// MARK: - Single tab pill

private struct SmallTabCard: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(FocusModel.self) private var focus
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    let tab: Tab
    let active: Bool
    let focused: Bool
    let ns: Namespace.ID
    @State private var hovering = false
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState

    var body: some View {
        let accent = favicons.accent(for: tab)
        let washed = hovering || glance.isGlancing(tab.id)
        HStack(spacing: 5) {
            FaviconView(host: tab.host, accent: accent, size: 16)
            Text(tab.displayName).font(.pp(12, .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            if tab.loadState == .loading, !hovering {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 7)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 30, maxHeight: 30, alignment: .leading)
        // The X floats OVER the row instead of joining the HStack — inserting
        // it reflowed a truncated title and shoved the ellipsis around.
        .hoverClose(hovering, trailing: 7) { engine.dispatch(.closeTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
        .bentoCard(accent: accent, active: active, cornerRadius: 9)
        .overlay(Color.white.opacity(washed ? 0.06 : 0).clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9, style: .continuous)).allowsHitTesting(false))
        .overlay(focusOverlay(focused, cornerRadius: 9))
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture { activate(cmd: NSEvent.modifierFlags.contains(.command)) }
        .tabCardAccessibility(tab.displayName, selected: active) { activate(cmd: false) }
        .onHover { h in withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.14)) { hovering = h } }
        .glanceHover(tab.id, isActive: active)
        .tabDraggable(tab, accent: accent)
        .contextMenu { TabContextMenu(tab: tab) }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.18), value: active)
    }

    private func activate(cmd: Bool) {
        focus.focus(tab)
        if cmd {
            handleSplitActivation(tabId: tab.id)
        } else {
            engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id))
        }
    }

    private func handleSplitActivation(tabId: String) {
        SplitStore.shared.toggle(tabId: tabId, engine: engine, splitState: &splitState)
    }
}

// MARK: - Megatab (one container, hairline-divided)

private struct MegaTabCard: View {
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(SubTabSwitcher.self) private var switcher
    @Namespace private var ns
    let group: TabGroup
    let activeTabId: String?
    let focused: Bool
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @State private var expanded = false

    /// Full-width tall rows under the hero; everything after goes minor.
    private static let majorCount = 2
    /// Minor cells shown (two-up) before the "+n more" expander takes over.
    private static let minorCap = 4

    var body: some View {
        let hero = group.heroTab
        let others = group.rankedOthers
        let accent = favicons.accent(for: hero)
        let isActive = group.tabs.contains { $0.id == activeTabId }
        let radius: CGFloat = 9
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: radius, style: .continuous)
        let line = accent.opacity(0.16)
        // A hold-⌥ session on this group takes over the card: it opens fully
        // (cap ignored), the selected candidate's row expands with context,
        // and the rows around it compress — no floating panel.
        let switching = switcher.isOpen && switcher.groupId == group.id
        let selectedId = switching ? switcher.selectedId : nil

        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if switching {
                MegaHeroCell(group: group, hero: hero, accent: accent,
                             active: hero.id == activeTabId,
                             switcherSelected: selectedId == hero.id, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                ForEach(switcher.tabs.filter { $0.id != hero.id }) { tab in
                    HLine(color: line)
                    SwitcherRow(tab: tab, selected: tab.id == selectedId, ns: ns)
                }
            } else if group.tabs.count == 2 {
                // Single full-width row split by one line (toward the right).
                GeometryReader { geo in
                    let avail = geo.size.width - 1
                    HStack(spacing: 0) {
                        MegaCell(tab: hero, host: group.host, active: hero.id == activeTabId,
                                 iconSize: 16, titleSize: 12, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                            .frame(width: avail * 0.62)
                        VLine(color: accent.opacity(0.16))
                        MegaCell(tab: others[0], host: group.host, active: others[0].id == activeTabId,
                                 iconSize: 16, titleSize: 12, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                            .frame(width: avail * 0.38)
                    }
                }
                .frame(height: 30)
            } else {
                MegaHeroCell(group: group, hero: hero, accent: accent, active: hero.id == activeTabId, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                // Terraces shrink as value drops: first major taller and
                // brighter than the second.
                ForEach(Array(others.prefix(Self.majorCount).enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { i, tab in
                    HLine(color: line)
                    MegaSubRow(tab: tab, host: group.host, active: tab.id == activeTabId,
                               tier: i == 0 ? .major : .majorSecond, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                }
                let minors = Array(others.dropFirst(Self.majorCount))
                let shown = expanded ? minors : Array(minors.prefix(Self.minorCap))
                // Minor mosaic zigzags: split leans left, then right, then
                // left — asymmetric on purpose.
                ForEach(Array(Self.pairs(of: shown).enumerated()), id: \.element.0.id) { rowIndex, pair in
                    HLine(color: line)
                    if let second = pair.1 {
                        GeometryReader { geo in
                            let avail = geo.size.width - 1
