                            let lead = rowIndex.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 0.58 : 0.42
                            HStack(spacing: 0) {
                                MegaSubRow(tab: pair.0, host: group.host, active: pair.0.id == activeTabId, tier: .minor, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                                    .frame(width: avail * lead)
                                VLine(color: line)
                                MegaSubRow(tab: second, host: group.host, active: second.id == activeTabId, tier: .minor, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                                    .frame(width: avail * (1 - lead))
                            }
                        }
                        .frame(height: 25)
                    } else {
                        MegaSubRow(tab: pair.0, host: group.host, active: pair.0.id == activeTabId, tier: .minor, ns: ns, splitState: $splitState)
                    }
                }
                if minors.count > Self.minorCap {
                    HLine(color: line)
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.25)) { expanded.toggle() }
                    } label: {
                        Text(expanded ? "show less" : "+\(minors.count - Self.minorCap) more")
                            .font(.pp(10.5, .medium))
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 22)
                            .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        // Same neutral base as single tabs (bentoCard) so backdrops match.
        .background(shape.fill(.white.opacity(0.05)))
        .clipShape(shape)
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: radius, style: .continuous).inset(by: -1)
                .strokeBorder(accent.opacity(isActive ? 0.9 : 0.0), lineWidth: 1.5)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        )
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: radius, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(isActive ? 0.0 : 0.07), lineWidth: 0.5)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        )
        // No host-keyed focus ring: two same-host megatabs (e.g. one inside a
        // container) must not both light up. Active accent rim is per-group.
        // One clean highlight fade + a snappy switcher open/close. No morph.
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.15), value: activeTabId)
        .animation(.snappy(duration: 0.26), value: switching)
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.15), value: selectedId)
    }

    /// Two-up pairing for minor cells; a trailing odd tab spans the row alone.
    private static func pairs(of tabs: [Tab]) -> [(Tab, Tab?)] {
        stride(from: 0, to: tabs.count, by: 2).map { i in
            (tabs[i], i + 1 < tabs.count ? tabs[i + 1] : nil)
        }
    }
}

/// A terraced row inside a megatab. Major = tall, bright, full-width — value
/// you read. Minor = short, dim, packed two-up — the composed bento tail where
/// truncation is cheap. Hover is just the wash fade plus the X over whatever's
/// in the corner.
private struct MegaSubRow: View {
    enum Tier { case major, majorSecond, minor }

    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(FocusModel.self) private var focus
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    let tab: Tab
    let host: String
    let active: Bool
    let tier: Tier
    let ns: Namespace.ID
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @State private var hovering = false

    private var height: CGFloat {
        switch tier {       case .major: 30; case .majorSecond: 26; case .minor: 24 }
    }
    private var iconSize: CGFloat {
        switch tier { case .major: 16; case .majorSecond: 13; case .minor: 11 }
    }
    private var fontSize: CGFloat {
        switch tier { case .major: 12.5; case .majorSecond: 11.5; case .minor: 10.5 }
    }
    private var textOpacity: Double {
        switch tier { case .major: 0.95; case .majorSecond: 0.8; case .minor: 0.62 }
    }

    var body: some View {
        let accent = favicons.accent(for: tab)
        HStack(spacing: tier == .minor ? 5 : 6) {
            FaviconView(host: tab.host, accent: accent, size: iconSize)
            Text(tab.displayName).font(.pp(fontSize, .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(textOpacity)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            if tab.loadState == .loading, !hovering {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 8)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: height, maxHeight: height, alignment: .leading)
        .hoverClose(hovering, trailing: 8) { engine.dispatch(.closeTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
        .background(cellFill(active: active, hovering: hovering, glanced: glance.isGlancing(tab.id), accent: accent))
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture {
            let cmd = NSEvent.modifierFlags.contains(.command)
            focus.focusedHost = host
            focus.focusedGroupId = tab.megatabId
            if cmd { handleSplitActivation(tabId: tab.id) }
            else { engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
        }
        .tabCardAccessibility(tab.displayName, selected: active) {
            focus.focusedHost = host
            focus.focusedGroupId = tab.megatabId
            engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id))
        }
        .onHover { h in withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.14)) { hovering = h } }
        .glanceHover(tab.id, isActive: active)
        .tabDraggable(tab, accent: accent)
        .contextMenu { TabContextMenu(tab: tab) }
    }

    private func handleSplitActivation(tabId: String) {
        SplitStore.shared.toggle(tabId: tabId, engine: engine, splitState: &splitState)
    }
}

private struct MegaHeroCell: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(FocusModel.self) private var focus
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    let group: TabGroup
    let hero: Tab
    let accent: Color
    let active: Bool
    var switcherSelected: Bool = false
    let ns: Namespace.ID
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 7) {
            FaviconView(host: hero.host, accent: accent, size: 26)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                Text(hero.displayName).font(.pp(14, .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
                Text("\(group.host) · \(group.tabs.count) tabs").font(.pp(10))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.58)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(8)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .hoverClose(hovering, trailing: 8) { engine.dispatch(.closeTab(tabId: hero.id)) }
        .background(cellFill(active: active, hovering: hovering,
                             glanced: glance.isGlancing(hero.id) || switcherSelected, accent: accent))
        .background(Color.white.opacity(switcherSelected ? 0.05 : 0))
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture {
            let cmd = NSEvent.modifierFlags.contains(.command)
            focus.focus(group)
            if cmd { handleSplitActivation(tabId: hero.id) }
            else { engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: hero.id)) }
        }
        .tabCardAccessibility(hero.displayName, selected: active) {
            focus.focus(group)
            engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: hero.id))
        }
        .onHover { h in withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.14)) { hovering = h } }
        .glanceHover(hero.id, isActive: active)
        .tabDraggable(hero, accent: accent)
        .contextMenu { TabContextMenu(tab: hero) }
    }

    private func handleSplitActivation(tabId: String) {
        SplitStore.shared.toggle(tabId: tabId, engine: engine, splitState: &splitState)
    }
}

/// A row inside a megatab during a hold-⌥ switching session: the selected
/// candidate expands (highlight wash, bigger type, URL for context) while the
/// rows around it compress. Keyboard-driven — no hover or tap targets.
private struct SwitcherRow: View {
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    let tab: Tab
    let selected: Bool
    let ns: Namespace.ID

    var body: some View {
        let accent = favicons.accent(for: tab)
        HStack(spacing: 7) {
            FaviconView(host: tab.host, accent: accent, size: selected ? 16 : 11)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                Text(tab.displayName).font(.pp(selected ? 12.5 : 10.5, .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(selected ? 0.98 : 0.55))
                    .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
                if selected {
                    Text(tab.url).font(.pp(10))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                        .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                }
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: selected ? 42 : 24, maxHeight: selected ? 42 : 24, alignment: .leading)
        .background(Color.white.opacity(selected ? 0.1 : 0))
    }
}

/// A favicon + title cell with no rounded background (lives inside the megatab
/// container and is separated from siblings by hairlines).
private struct MegaCell: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(FocusModel.self) private var focus
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    let tab: Tab
    let host: String
    let active: Bool
    var iconSize: CGFloat = 15
    var titleSize: CGFloat = 11
    let ns: Namespace.ID
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        let accent = favicons.accent(for: tab)
        HStack(spacing: 5) {
            FaviconView(host: tab.host, accent: accent, size: iconSize)
            Text(tab.displayName).font(.pp(titleSize, .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.88)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 6)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .hoverClose(hovering, trailing: 6) { engine.dispatch(.closeTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
        .background(cellFill(active: active, hovering: hovering, glanced: glance.isGlancing(tab.id), accent: accent))
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture {
            let cmd = NSEvent.modifierFlags.contains(.command)
            focus.focusedHost = host
            focus.focusedGroupId = tab.megatabId
            if cmd { handleSplitActivation(tabId: tab.id) }
            else { engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
        }
        .tabCardAccessibility(tab.displayName, selected: active) {
            focus.focusedHost = host
            focus.focusedGroupId = tab.megatabId
            engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id))
        }
        .onHover { h in withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.14)) { hovering = h } }
        .glanceHover(tab.id, isActive: active)
        .tabDraggable(tab, accent: accent)
        .contextMenu { TabContextMenu(tab: tab) }
    }

    private func handleSplitActivation(tabId: String) {
        SplitStore.shared.toggle(tabId: tabId, engine: engine, splitState: &splitState)
    }
}

/// A classy drag chip — a tinted pill that reads as the tab, not a file icon.
struct TabDragPreview: View {
    let title: String
    let host: String?
    let accent: Color
    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            FaviconView(host: host, accent: accent, size: 14)
            Text(title).font(.pp(12, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white)
                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 11).padding(.vertical, 7)
        .background(Capsule().fill(accent.opacity(0.92)))
        .overlay(Capsule().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.25), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .frame(maxWidth: 220)
    }
}

/// Shared right-click menu for any tab cell. Lives in one place so single tabs,
/// hero cells and mega rows all expose the same actions (e.g. Pin site).
private struct TabContextMenu: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    let tab: Tab
    var body: some View {
        Button(tab.shielded ? "Unshield" : "Shield") {
            engine.dispatch(.setTabShielded(tabId: tab.id, shielded: !tab.shielded))
        }
        Button(tab.pinned ? "Unpin Tab" : "Pin Tab") {
            engine.dispatch(.pinTab(tabId: tab.id, pinned: !tab.pinned))
        }
        Menu("Container") {
            ForEach(engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.containers ?? []) { c in
                Button(c.name) { engine.dispatch(.moveTabToContainer(tabId: tab.id, containerId: c.id)) }
            }
            Divider()
            Button("New Container") {
                engine.dispatch(.createContainer(name: "New Container", tabIds: [tab.id]))
            }
            if tab.containerId != nil {
                Button("Remove from Container") {
                    engine.dispatch(.moveTabToContainer(tabId: tab.id, containerId: nil))
                }
            }
        }
        Divider()
        Button("New Tab Above") { insertTab(above: true) }
        Button("New Tab Below") { insertTab(above: false) }
        Button("Duplicate Tab") { insertTab(above: false, url: tab.url) }
        Button("Copy Link") {
            NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
            NSPasteboard.general.setString(tab.url, forType: .string)
        }
        Divider()
        Button("Close Tab") { engine.dispatch(.closeTab(tabId: tab.id)) }
    }

    /// Where this tab sits in the tree: its parent node and the sibling after
    /// it, so inserted tabs can land next to it instead of at the list's end.
    private func siblingContext() -> (parentId: String?, nextId: String?) {
        guard let nodes = engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.tabs else { return (nil, nil) }
        var result: (String?, String?) = (nil, nil)
        func walk(_ list: [TabNode], parent: String?) -> Bool {
            for (i, node) in list.enumerated() {
                if node.tab.id == tab.id {
                    result = (parent, i + 1 < list.count ? list[i + 1].tab.id : nil)
                    return true
                }
                if walk(node.children, parent: node.tab.id) { return true }
            }
            return false
        }
        _ = walk(nodes, parent: nil)
        return result
    }

    private func insertTab(above: Bool, url: String? = nil) {
        let ctx = siblingContext()
        guard engine.dispatch(.createTab(url: url, activate: true)),
              let newId = engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.activeTab,
              newId != tab.id else { return }
        let before = above ? tab.id : ctx.nextId
        if before != nil || ctx.parentId != nil {
            engine.dispatch(.moveTab(tabId: newId, parentId: ctx.parentId, before: before))
        }
    }
}

/// The close lane does not reflow the row. Its alpha mask gently dissolves
/// text/icons before the trailing X, which sits directly on the tab without a
/// circle or painted wash.
private struct HoverClose: ViewModifier {
    let hovering: Bool
    let trailing: CGFloat
    let close: () -> Void

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .mask {
                HStack(spacing: 0) {
                    Color.white
                    LinearGradient(colors: [.white, .white.opacity(0)],
                                   startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing)
                        .frame(width: hovering ? 48 : 0)
                }
                .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.16), value: hovering)
            }
            .overlay(alignment: .trailing) {
                if hovering {
                    CloseButton(action: close)
                        .padding(.trailing, trailing)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
    }
}

private extension View {
    func hoverClose(_ hovering: Bool, trailing: CGFloat, close: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        modifier(HoverClose(hovering: hovering, trailing: trailing, close: close))
    }

    /// Tab cells are tap-gesture stacks, not Buttons: expose them to
    /// VoiceOver as one button named after the tab, with a default action.
    func tabCardAccessibility(_ title: String, selected: Bool,
                              activate: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
            .accessibilityLabel(title)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(selected ? [.isButton, .isSelected] : .isButton)
            .accessibilityAction(.default, activate)
    }
}

private struct CloseButton: View {
    let action: () -> Void
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Icon("x-mark", size: 9)
                .frame(width: 22, height: 22)
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle())
        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.72))
        .help("Close tab")
        .accessibilityLabel("Close tab")
    }
}

/// Minimal empty-state placeholder for a workspace with no tabs.
private struct EmptyStateView: View {
    var body: some View {
        Text("No tabs yet")
            .font(.pp(11))
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.vertical, 18)
            .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .top)))
    }
}
//
//  SpotlightCommands.swift
//  The omni-app command registry behind Spotlight's ">" mode.
//
//  Typing ">" turns Spotlight into a command palette: every feature that
//  doesn't deserve standalone chrome lives here, reachable when you look for
//  it and INVISIBLE to normal ranking the rest of the time. Adding a feature
//  is appending one item — no new UI surface, no ranking fights.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct SpotlightCommandItem: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let subtitle: String
    let keywords: [String]
    let run: @MainActor () -> Void
}

@MainActor
enum SpotlightCommands {
    static func all(web: WebContentManager, engine: CoreEngine) -> [SpotlightCommandItem] {
        var items: [SpotlightCommandItem] = [
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.settings",
                title: "Open Settings",
                subtitle: "General · Downloads · Passwords · Shortcuts · Extensions · Voice · Privacy",
                keywords: ["settings", "preferences", "options", "config"]
            ) {
                NSApp.sendAction(Selector(("showSettingsWindow:")), to: nil, from: nil)
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.newWorkspace",
                title: "New Workspace",
                subtitle: "Create and switch to a fresh workspace",
                keywords: ["workspace", "space", "new"]
            ) {
                engine.dispatch(.createSpace(name: "New Workspace"))
                BrowserWindow.shared.show()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.clearHistory",
                title: "Clear Browsing History",
                subtitle: "Removes all history entries. Cookies and tabs stay",
                keywords: ["history", "clear", "erase", "delete"]
            ) {
                HistoryStore.shared.clear()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.clearCaches",
                title: "Clear Web Caches",
                subtitle: "Frees cached page resources; sign-ins stay",
                keywords: ["cache", "clear", "storage"]
            ) {
                web.clearWebCaches {}
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.toggleShield",
                title: ContentBlocker.shared.enabled ? "Disable Ad Blocking" : "Enable Ad Blocking",
                subtitle: "Content blocker + YouTube protection",
                keywords: ["shield", "adblock", "ads", "blocker", "protection", "toggle"]
            ) {
                ContentBlocker.shared.enabled.toggle()
                web.reloadProtectionPolicy()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.downloadsFolder",
                title: "Open Downloads Folder",
                subtitle: "Reveal your downloads in Finder",
                keywords: ["downloads", "folder", "finder", "files"]
            ) {
                NSWorkspace.shared.open(web.downloads.directory)
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.screenshot",
                title: "Copy Page Screenshot",
                subtitle: "Snapshot of the current page onto the clipboard",
                keywords: ["screenshot", "capture", "copy", "snap", "image"]
            ) {
                web.copyCurrentPageScreenshot()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.print",
                title: "Print Page…",
                subtitle: "Print the current page",
                keywords: ["print", "printer", "pdf"]
            ) {
                web.printCurrentPage()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.canvas",
                title: "Open Canvas",
                subtitle: "Surface, your notes canvas  ·  Caps N",
                keywords: ["notes", "notebook", "canvas", "surface"]
            ) {
                SurfaceCanvas.open()
            },
            SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.games",
                title: "Open Games",
                subtitle: "Switch to the Games workspace",
                keywords: ["games", "library", "play"]
            ) {
                GamesRuntime.shared()?.showWindow()
            },
        ]

        if EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.capture) {
            items.append(SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.grabText",
                title: "Grab Text from Screen",
                subtitle: "Drag over any text; it lands on the clipboard  ·  Caps S, T",
                keywords: ["ocr", "text", "grab", "screen", "copy", "recognize"]
            ) {
                CaptureController.shared.begin(mode: .text, via: "bar")
            })
        }

        // Per-workspace isolation as a command, phrased for the ACTIVE space.
        if let snapshot = engine.snapshot, let space = snapshot.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space {
            let isolated = snapshot.isIsolated(space)
            items.append(SpotlightCommandItem(
                id: "cmd.isolation",
                title: isolated
                    ? "Share Logins for “\(space.name)”"
                    : "Separate Logins for “\(space.name)”",
                subtitle: isolated
                    ? "Return this workspace to the shared cookie jar"
                    : "Give this workspace its own cookies and sign-ins",
                keywords: ["isolation", "cookies", "profile", "logins", "separate", "container"]
            ) {
                engine.dispatch(.setSpaceIsolation(spaceId: space.id, isolated: !isolated))
            })
        }

        return items
    }

    /// Empty term → the whole registry, registration order. Otherwise prefix
    /// beats contains, title beats keyword.
    static func matching(_ term: String, web: WebContentManager, engine: CoreEngine) -> [SpotlightCommandItem] {
        let all = all(web: web, engine: engine).filter { !Edition.lite || !Edition.appCommandIDs.contains($0.id) }
        let needle = term.lowercased()
        guard !needle.isEmpty else { return all }
        func score(_ item: SpotlightCommandItem) -> Int {
            let title = item.title.lowercased()
            if title.hasPrefix(needle) { return 0 }
            if title.split(separator: " ").contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(needle) }) { return 1 }
            if item.keywords.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(needle) }) { return 2 }
            if title.contains(needle) { return 3 }
            if item.keywords.contains(where: { $0.contains(needle) }) { return 4 }
            return .max
        }
        return all
            .map { ($0, score($0)) }
            .filter { $0.1 != .max }
            .sorted { $0.1 < $1.1 }
            .map(\.0)
    }
}
//
//  StripCore.swift
//  The bottom strip's pure parts: where it sits on a display, how its sections lay out
//  (pinned apps | running apps | live sliver | workspace dots), what's under the
//  pointer, the reveal/hide and hover-peek state machines, the bar's name filter, the
//  Dock's pinned apps parsed from its persistent-apps plist, and Replace Dock / Restore
//  Dock as plans over a defaults domain. No AppKit windows and no app models here:
//  tools/strip-test compiles this file (with EdgeIsland.swift for the live items) on its
//  own. Window and wiring: StripController.swift; drawing: StripView.swift.
//  docs/features/strip.md.
//

import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

// MARK: - Metrics

/// Card-derived sizes on the 8pt rule (EdgeLayout.gap).
enum StripMetrics {
    static let gap: CGFloat = 8
    /// An app tile (its icon). Shrinks when the strip would be wider than the display.
    static let tile: CGFloat = 44
    static let minTile: CGFloat = 28
    /// Visible height above the screen edge: gap, tile, gap. The running dot sits in the
    /// lower gap, the way the bar's text sits in what shows above the edge.
    static func visibleHeight(tile: CGFloat = tile) -> CGFloat { gap + tile + gap }
    /// Glass under the screen edge (like the bar's 64pt): the in-spring's overshoot never
    /// shows a bottom edge, and the outline has none to show.
    static let below: CGFloat = 40
    /// Top corners: the bar's 26 rim + gap reads too round at this height; concentric with
    /// the 12pt tile corners at an 8pt inset.
    static let radius: CGFloat = 20
    static let tileRadius: CGFloat = 12
    static let divider: CGFloat = 1
    /// Workspace dots: a dot every `dotPitch`, a drop target every `dropPitch` while a tile
    /// is being dragged (they grow so a drop can aim).
    static let workspaces = 9
    static let dot: CGFloat = 6
    static let dotPitch: CGFloat = 12
    static let dropPitch: CGFloat = 30
    static let maxTicks = 3
    /// Room above the strip for the peek sheet and its overshoot.
    static let peekRoom: CGFloat = 300
    static let maxLive = 4
}

// MARK: - Displays

/// What the strip reads from a display (an NSScreen, or a mock in the checks).
struct StripScreen: Equatable {
    var frame: CGRect          // global AppKit coordinates (y up)
    var visibleFrame: CGRect
}

/// One strip lives on one display at a time: the one whose bottom edge you touched (like
/// the Dock, it follows you), or while the bar is up the bar's display. Panel coordinates
/// are y down from the panel's top; the screen edge is at `edgeY`.
struct StripGeometry: Equatable {
    var screen: CGRect

    var panelFrame: CGRect {
        let h = StripMetrics.visibleHeight() + StripMetrics.peekRoom + StripMetrics.below
        return CGRect(x: screen.minX, y: screen.minY - StripMetrics.below, width: screen.width, height: h)
    }
    var panelSize: CGSize { panelFrame.size }
    /// The screen's bottom edge in panel coordinates.
    var edgeY: CGFloat { panelFrame.height - StripMetrics.below }

    /// Panel point (y down) → global point (y up), and back.
    func global(_ p: CGPoint) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: panelFrame.minX + p.x, y: panelFrame.maxY - p.y) }
    func local(_ p: CGPoint) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: p.x - panelFrame.minX, y: panelFrame.maxY - p.y) }
    func global(_ r: CGRect) -> CGRect { CGRect(x: panelFrame.minX + r.minX, y: panelFrame.maxY - r.maxY, width: r.width, height: r.height) }

    /// The display a pointer is pressing the bottom edge of: within `slop` of its bottom,
    /// and no display continues below it there (the pointer would just cross over).
    static func edgeScreen(_ screens: [StripScreen], pointer p: CGPoint, slop: CGFloat = 1.5) -> Int? {
        for (i, s) in screens.enumerated() where p.x >= s.frame.minX && p.x < s.frame.maxX && p.y >= s.frame.minY - 0.5 && p.y <= s.frame.minY + slop {
            let below = CGPoint(x: p.x, y: s.frame.minY - 2)
            if screens.contains(where: { $0.frame.contains(below) }) { continue }
            return i
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// Display under a point (for the bar's display, or the pointer's).
    static func screen(_ screens: [StripScreen], containing p: CGPoint) -> Int? {
        screens.firstIndex { $0.frame.insetBy(dx: 0, dy: -1).contains(p) }
    }
}

// MARK: - Layout

/// A live thing in the sliver: what kind (for its width) and its id.
struct StripLiveSpec: Equatable {
    enum Kind: Equatable { case caps, dictation, terminal, timer, media, count }
    var id: String
    var kind: Kind

    /// Chip widths: the icon tile's height, plus the readout each kind needs.
    var width: CGFloat {
        switch kind {
        case .caps: 64          // tile + ⇪T
        case .dictation: 80     // tile + 4-bar waveform
        case .terminal: 60      // tile + ✓
        case .timer: 88         // tile + 12:34
        case .media: 44         // the artwork with its progress ring
        case .count: 64         // tile + 3
        }
    }
}

enum StripSlotKind: Hashable {
    case pinned(String)
    case running(String)
    /// The hairline before a section, named by that section ("running", "live", "dots").
    case divider(String)
    case live(String)
    case dots
}

extension StripSlotKind {
    var isDivider: Bool { if case .divider = self { true } else { false } }
    /// The app tile's id, if it is one.
    var tileID: String? {
        switch self { case .pinned(let id), .running(let id): id; default: nil }
    }
}

struct StripSlot: Equatable {
    var kind: StripSlotKind
    /// Strip-local x range (0 = the strip's left edge).
    var minX: CGFloat
    var width: CGFloat
    /// Space before it (the left padding for the first; one gap for the rest).
    var lead: CGFloat = StripMetrics.gap
    var maxX: CGFloat { minX + width }
    var midX: CGFloat { minX + width / 2 }
}

struct StripLayout: Equatable {
    var slots: [StripSlot]
    var width: CGFloat
    var tile: CGFloat
    var height: CGFloat { StripMetrics.visibleHeight(tile: tile) }

    /// Pinned | running | live | dots, with a hairline between sections. Tiles shrink
    /// (never below 28pt) when it would run wider than `maxWidth`; the sliver and dots don't.
    static func make(pinned: [String], running: [String], live: [StripLiveSpec], dropTargets: Bool = false,
                     maxWidth: CGFloat = .greatestFiniteMagnitude) -> StripLayout {
        let g = StripMetrics.gap
        let lives = Array(live.prefix(StripMetrics.maxLive))
        let dotsW = dotsWidth(dropTargets)
        // Sections in order; each is a list of items separated by `gap`.
        var sections: [(name: String, items: [(StripSlotKind, CGFloat?)])] = []   // nil width = an app tile
        if !pinned.isEmpty { sections.append(("pinned", pinned.map { (.pinned($0), nil) })) }
        if !running.isEmpty { sections.append(("running", running.map { (.running($0), nil) })) }
        if !lives.isEmpty { sections.append(("live", lives.map { (.live($0.id), $0.width) })) }
        sections.append(("dots", [(.dots, dotsW)]))
        // Everything but the tiles, then whatever tile fits.
        let apps = CGFloat(pinned.count + running.count)
        let items = sections.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.items.count }
        let fixed = 2 * g + CGFloat(sections.count - 1) * (StripMetrics.divider + 2 * g) + CGFloat(items - sections.count) * g
            + sections.flatMap(\.items).reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.1 ?? 0) }
        var tile = StripMetrics.tile
        if apps > 0, fixed + apps * tile > maxWidth {
            tile = max(StripMetrics.minTile, ((maxWidth - fixed) / apps).rounded(.down))
        }
        var x = g, out: [StripSlot] = []
        for (i, section) in sections.enumerated() {
            if i > 0 {
                out.append(StripSlot(kind: .divider(section.name), minX: x, width: StripMetrics.divider))
                x += StripMetrics.divider + g
            }
            for (j, (kind, w)) in section.items.enumerated() {
                if j > 0 { x += g }
                out.append(StripSlot(kind: kind, minX: x, width: w ?? tile))
                x += w ?? tile
            }
            x += g
        }
        return StripLayout(slots: out, width: x, tile: tile)
    }

    static func dotsWidth(_ dropTargets: Bool) -> CGFloat {
        CGFloat(StripMetrics.workspaces) * (dropTargets ? StripMetrics.dropPitch : StripMetrics.dotPitch)
    }

    /// The strip body in panel coordinates (centered on the display, up from the edge by
    /// `presence` of its height; it runs `below` past the edge).
    func rect(_ g: StripGeometry, presence: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        let h = height * presence
        return CGRect(x: ((g.panelSize.width - width) / 2).rounded(), y: g.edgeY - h, width: width, height: h + StripMetrics.below)
    }
    /// Where the strip is when fully up (for hit-testing and the peek).
    func restingRect(_ g: StripGeometry) -> CGRect { rect(g, presence: 1) }

    /// A slot's rect in panel coordinates (tile-height row, centered in the strip).
    func slotRect(_ s: StripSlot, _ g: StripGeometry, presence: CGFloat = 1) -> CGRect {
        let r = rect(g, presence: presence)
        let rowH = s.kind.isDivider ? tile * 0.55 : tile
        return CGRect(x: r.minX + s.minX, y: r.minY + StripMetrics.gap + (tile - rowH) / 2, width: s.width, height: rowH)
    }

    /// Which slot is under a strip-local x (dividers and gaps count as nothing).
    func slot(atX x: CGFloat) -> StripSlot? {
        slots.first { !$0.kind.isDivider && x >= $0.minX - StripMetrics.gap / 2 && x < $0.maxX + StripMetrics.gap / 2 }
    }

    func slot(_ kind: StripSlotKind) -> StripSlot? { slots.first { $0.kind == kind } }

    /// Workspace (1…9) under a strip-local x inside the dots slot.
    func workspace(atX x: CGFloat, dropTargets: Bool) -> Int? {
        guard let d = slot(.dots), x >= d.minX - StripMetrics.gap / 2, x < d.maxX + StripMetrics.gap / 2 else { return nil }
        let pitch = dropTargets ? StripMetrics.dropPitch : StripMetrics.dotPitch
        return min(StripMetrics.workspaces, max(1, Int(((x - d.minX) / pitch).rounded(.down)) + 1))
    }
    /// Center x (strip-local) of workspace `n`'s dot.
    func dotX(_ n: Int, dropTargets: Bool) -> CGFloat? {
        guard let d = slot(.dots) else { return nil }
        let pitch = dropTargets ? StripMetrics.dropPitch : StripMetrics.dotPitch
        return d.minX + (CGFloat(n) - 0.5) * pitch
    }

    /// Where a pinned tile dragged to strip-local x would land among the pinned (0…count).
    func pinnedInsertion(atX x: CGFloat) -> Int {
        let pins = slots.filter { if case .pinned = $0.kind { true } else { false } }
        guard !pins.isEmpty else { return 0 }
        return pins.firstIndex { x < $0.midX } ?? pins.count
    }
}

// MARK: - Motion between layouts

/// A slot as drawn mid-change: where it is and how present (1 = there, 0 = gone).
struct StripDrawnSlot: Equatable {
    var kind: StripSlotKind
    var minX: CGFloat
    var width: CGFloat
    var alpha: CGFloat
    /// A slot on its way out where it was (a reordered tile also grows in where it goes).
    var leaving = false
    var midX: CGFloat { minX + width / 2 }
    var id: String { "\(kind)" + (leaving ? ".out" : "") }
}

extension StripLayout {
    /// One value moves everything when apps launch or quit. Slots in both layouts (in the
    /// same order) keep their place in line; new ones grow in where they land, gone ones
    /// shrink where they were, a moved one shrinks out of its old place and grows into its
    /// new one. Then the row is laid out again, left to right, with every width and gap
    /// mixed by `t`: neighbours can never overlap, and the body's width is always exactly
    /// the row's, so tiles never leave the glass. `t` is unclamped (the spring overshoots).
    static func blend(_ from: StripLayout, _ to: StripLayout, _ t: CGFloat) -> (slots: [StripDrawnSlot], width: CGFloat, tile: CGFloat) {
        func mix(_ a: CGFloat, _ b: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { a + (b - a) * t }
        let a = clamp(t)
        var x: CGFloat = 0, out: [StripDrawnSlot] = []
        for m in merge(from.slots, to.slots) {
            let width: CGFloat, lead: CGFloat, alpha: CGFloat
            switch (m.from, m.to) {
            case let (f?, s?): width = mix(f.width, s.width); lead = mix(f.lead, s.lead); alpha = 1
            case let (nil, s?): width = s.width * a; lead = s.lead * a; alpha = a
            case let (f?, nil): width = f.width * (1 - a); lead = f.lead * (1 - a); alpha = 1 - a
            default: continue
            }
            x += lead
            out.append(StripDrawnSlot(kind: (m.to ?? m.from!).kind, minX: x, width: max(0, width), alpha: alpha, leaving: m.to == nil))
            x += max(0, width)
        }
        return (out, x + StripMetrics.gap, mix(from.tile, to.tile))
    }

    private static func clamp(_ t: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { min(1, max(0, t)) }

    /// Both rows in one sequence: the longest common run of kinds (in order) is shared;
    /// everything else is only in one of them.
    static func merge(_ a: [StripSlot], _ b: [StripSlot]) -> [(from: StripSlot?, to: StripSlot?)] {
        let n = a.count, m = b.count
        var l = Array(repeating: Array(repeating: 0, count: m + 1), count: n + 1)
        for i in stride(from: n - 1, through: 0, by: -1) {
            for j in stride(from: m - 1, through: 0, by: -1) {
                l[i][j] = a[i].kind == b[j].kind ? l[i + 1][j + 1] + 1 : max(l[i + 1][j], l[i][j + 1])
            }
        }
        var i = 0, j = 0, out: [(from: StripSlot?, to: StripSlot?)] = []
        while i < n || j < m {
            if i < n, j < m, a[i].kind == b[j].kind { out.append((a[i], b[j])); i += 1; j += 1 }
            else if i < n, j == m || l[i + 1][j] >= l[i][j + 1] { out.append((a[i], nil)); i += 1 }
            else { out.append((nil, b[j])); j += 1 }
        }
        return out
    }

    /// Freezes a blend as a layout to start the next change from (retargeting mid-motion):
    /// what's still on its way in keeps its partial width and gap; what was leaving goes.
    static func frozen(_ from: StripLayout, _ to: StripLayout, _ t: CGFloat) -> StripLayout {
        let b = blend(from, to, t)
        var slots: [StripSlot] = [], x: CGFloat = 0
        var prevEnd: CGFloat = 0
        for d in b.slots where !d.leaving {
            let lead = d.minX - prevEnd
            prevEnd = d.minX + d.width
            slots.append(StripSlot(kind: d.kind, minX: x + lead, width: d.width, lead: lead))
            x += lead + d.width
        }
        return StripLayout(slots: slots, width: x + StripMetrics.gap, tile: b.tile)
    }
}

/// One of an app's windows, as the peek and the right-click card show it.
struct StripWindow: Equatable, Identifiable {
    var id: UInt32
    var title: String
    var minimized: Bool
    var hidden: Bool
}

// MARK: - Pointer regions

enum StripHit {
    /// Has the pointer left the strip? It counts as over the strip from the screen edge
    /// up to the strip's top (+4pt slop) across its width, plus whatever sheet is open.
    static func inside(_ p: CGPoint, strip: CGRect, sheet: CGRect?) -> Bool {
        let s = strip.insetBy(dx: -4, dy: -4)
        if s.contains(p) { return true }
        if let sheet, sheet.insetBy(dx: -6, dy: -6).contains(p) { return true }
        // The gap between the sheet and the strip (the goo neck) counts too.
        if let sheet, p.x >= sheet.minX, p.x <= sheet.maxX, p.y >= sheet.maxY, p.y <= strip.minY { return true }
        return false
    }

    /// The bottom-edge band the pointer touches to reveal: the strip's width plus a little,
    /// never the corners (hot corners and the far ends stay the system's).
    static func revealBand(_ g: StripGeometry, layout: StripLayout) -> ClosedRange<CGFloat> {
        let r = layout.restingRect(g)
        let pad: CGFloat = 48
        return (g.panelFrame.minX + max(24, r.minX - pad))...(g.panelFrame.minX + min(g.panelSize.width - 24, r.maxX + pad))
    }
}

// MARK: - Peek and context sheets

/// The sheet that rises out of the strip over a hovered tile (its windows) or a
/// right-clicked one (its windows and actions). Cards on the sheet's 8pt rule.
enum StripSheetLayout {
    static let cardWidth: CGFloat = 168
    static let thumbHeight: CGFloat = 105   // 16:10
    static let titleHeight: CGFloat = 22
    static var cardHeight: CGFloat { StripMetrics.gap + thumbHeight + titleHeight }
    static let maxCards = 5
    static let cardRadius: CGFloat = 16
    static let sheetRadius = cardRadius + StripMetrics.gap
    static let rowHeight: CGFloat = 32
    static let actionHeight: CGFloat = 36
    static let menuWidth: CGFloat = 264
    static let maxRows = 6

    /// Peek: `n` window cards in a row (at most 5; more shows as a +N chip in the last
    /// card's place), centered over the tile and kept on the display.
    static func peek(cards n: Int, over tileMidX: CGFloat, stripTop: CGFloat, panelWidth: CGFloat) -> (sheet: CGRect, cards: [CGRect]) {
        let k = max(1, min(maxCards, n)), g = StripMetrics.gap
        let w = CGFloat(k) * cardWidth + CGFloat(k + 1) * g
        let h = cardHeight + 2 * g
        let x = min(max(g, tileMidX - w / 2), panelWidth - g - w).rounded()
        let sheet = CGRect(x: x, y: stripTop - g - h, width: w, height: h)
        let cards = (0..<k).map { CGRect(x: sheet.minX + g + CGFloat($0) * (cardWidth + g), y: sheet.minY + g, width: cardWidth, height: cardHeight) }
        return (sheet, cards)
    }

    /// Right-click: one row per window (at most 6), then the actions row.
    static func menu(rows n: Int, over tileMidX: CGFloat, stripTop: CGFloat, panelWidth: CGFloat) -> (sheet: CGRect, rows: [CGRect], actions: CGRect) {
        let g = StripMetrics.gap, k = min(maxRows, max(0, n))
        let h = g + CGFloat(k) * (rowHeight + 2) + (k > 0 ? g : 0) + actionHeight + g
        let x = min(max(g, tileMidX - menuWidth / 2), panelWidth - g - menuWidth).rounded()
        let sheet = CGRect(x: x, y: stripTop - g - h, width: menuWidth, height: h)
        let rows = (0..<k).map { CGRect(x: sheet.minX + g, y: sheet.minY + g + CGFloat($0) * (rowHeight + 2), width: menuWidth - 2 * g, height: rowHeight) }
        let actions = CGRect(x: sheet.minX + g, y: sheet.maxY - g - actionHeight, width: menuWidth - 2 * g, height: actionHeight)
        return (sheet, rows, actions)
    }

    /// The sheet as it rises: anchored at its bottom, `open` (0…1, overshoots) of its height.
    static func rising(_ sheet: CGRect, open: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        let h = max(0, sheet.height * open)
        return CGRect(x: sheet.minX, y: sheet.maxY - h, width: sheet.width, height: h)
    }

    /// The goo neck between the strip's top and the sheet, over the tile.
    static func neck(tileMidX: CGFloat, tile: CGFloat, sheetBottom: CGFloat, stripTop: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        let w = tile + StripMetrics.gap
        return CGRect(x: tileMidX - w / 2, y: sheetBottom - 2, width: w, height: max(0, stripTop - sheetBottom) + 4)
    }
}

// MARK: - Reveal / hide

/// When the strip is up. Auto-hide (default): it slides up when the pointer presses the
/// bottom edge under it and slides away a moment after the pointer leaves (never mid-press
/// or mid-drag). Always: it stays. Either way it's the floor of the Caps stack while the
/// bar is up or Caps is held. While Apple's Dock still owns the bottom edge (not
/// replaced), touching the edge belongs to the Dock: the strip shows only with Caps, the
/// bar, or Always.
struct StripVisibility: Equatable {
    enum Mode: String, Equatable, CaseIterable { case autoHide, always }
    enum Reason: String, Equatable { case edge, floor, always, sheet }
    struct Input: Equatable {
        var mode: Mode = .autoHide
        var dockOwnsEdge = false
        var floor = false          // bar up or Caps held
        var atEdge = false         // pointer pressing the bottom edge inside the reveal band
        var inside = false         // pointer over the strip or its sheet
        var pressed = false        // a button down / a drag in flight
        var sheetOpen = false      // peek or right-click card
        var now: TimeInterval = 0
    }

    static let dwell: TimeInterval = 0.06
    static let grace: TimeInterval = 0.35

    private(set) var shown = false
    private(set) var reason: Reason?
    private(set) var edgeSince: TimeInterval?
    private(set) var leftAt: TimeInterval?

    mutating func update(_ i: Input) {
        if !i.atEdge { edgeSince = nil }
        if i.floor { show(.floor); return }
        if i.mode == .always { show(.always); return }
        if shown {
            if i.inside || i.pressed { leftAt = nil; if reason == .floor || reason == .always { reason = .edge }; return }
            if i.atEdge, !i.dockOwnsEdge { leftAt = nil; return }
            // Just lost its floor (bar closed, Caps up) with the pointer elsewhere: go now.
            if reason == .floor || reason == .always { hide(); return }
            if let left = leftAt {
                if i.now - left >= Self.grace - 1e-6 { hide() }
            } else { leftAt = i.now }
            return
        }
        guard i.atEdge, !i.dockOwnsEdge else { return }
        if let since = edgeSince {
            if i.now - since >= Self.dwell - 1e-6 { show(.edge) }
        } else { edgeSince = i.now }
    }

    /// When the next timed step can happen (edge dwell or leave grace).
    var deadline: TimeInterval? {
        if shown { return leftAt.map { $0 + Self.grace } }
        return edgeSince.map { $0 + Self.dwell }
    }

    private mutating func show(_ r: Reason) { shown = true; reason = r; leftAt = nil; edgeSince = nil }
    private mutating func hide() { shown = false; reason = nil; leftAt = nil; edgeSince = nil }
}

// MARK: - Hover peek

/// Hovering a tile shows its windows above it after a short dwell; once a peek is open,
/// moving along the strip switches it at once (like the Dock's labels). It closes a moment
/// after the pointer leaves both the tile row and the sheet, on a click, or on Escape.
struct StripHover: Equatable {
    static let dwell: TimeInterval = 0.32
    static let grace: TimeInterval = 0.3

    private(set) var hovered: String?
    private(set) var peek: String?
    private(set) var since: TimeInterval?
    private(set) var leftAt: TimeInterval?
    /// After a click on a tile: no peek until the pointer moves to another tile.
    private(set) var suppressed: String?

    /// `tile`: the app tile under the pointer (nil elsewhere); `overSheet`: on the peek.
    mutating func update(tile: String?, overSheet: Bool, now: TimeInterval) {
        if tile != suppressed { suppressed = nil }
        if tile != hovered { hovered = tile; since = tile == nil ? nil : now }
        if let p = peek {
            if overSheet || tile == p { leftAt = nil; return }
            if let t = tile, t != suppressed { peek = t; leftAt = nil; return }   // slide along: switch at once
            if let left = leftAt {
                if now - left >= Self.grace - 1e-6 { peek = nil; leftAt = nil }
            } else { leftAt = now }
            return
        }
        guard let t = tile, t != suppressed, let s = since else { return }
        if now - s >= Self.dwell - 1e-6 { peek = t; leftAt = nil }
    }

    /// A click (or a scroll cycling windows): the peek closes and stays shut over this tile.
    mutating func clicked() { suppressed = hovered; peek = nil; leftAt = nil; since = nil }
    mutating func close() { peek = nil; leftAt = nil; suppressed = hovered }
    mutating func reset() { self = StripHover() }

    var deadline: TimeInterval? {
        if peek != nil { return leftAt.map { $0 + Self.grace } }
        guard hovered != nil, hovered != suppressed else { return nil }
        return since.map { $0 + Self.dwell }
    }
}

// MARK: - The bar's filter

/// While the bar is up, what you type dims the tiles whose app name doesn't match: a
/// prefix of the name or of a word in it, or (three letters or more) the letters in order
/// starting on a word. Empty: nothing dims.
enum StripMatch {
    static func normalize(_ s: String) -> [Character] {
        Array(s.folding(options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive, .widthInsensitive], locale: nil).lowercased())
    }

    static func matches(_ query: String, name: String) -> Bool {
        let q = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard !q.isEmpty else { return true }
        let n = String(normalize(name)), needle = String(normalize(q))
        if n.hasPrefix(needle) { return true }
        let words = n.split(whereSeparator: { !$0.isLetter && !$0.isNumber })
        if words.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(needle) }) { return true }
        let compact = needle.filter { $0 != " " }
        if words.map(String.init).joined().hasPrefix(compact) { return true }
        guard compact.count >= 3 else { return false }
        // Letters in order, the first one at a word start.
        let hay = Array(n), want = Array(compact)
        for start in hay.indices where hay[start] == want[0] && (start == 0 || !hay[start - 1].isLetter) {
            var j = 1, i = start + 1
            while i < hay.count, j < want.count { if hay[i] == want[j] { j += 1 }; i += 1 }
            if j == want.count { return true }
        }
        return false
    }
}

// MARK: - Live sliver

/// A count-shaped live thing from another feature (the paste stack: how many items are
/// queued). Nothing on this branch makes one; a feature registers a source with
/// `EdgeStrip.addCountSource` and the sliver shows it after the island's items.
struct StripCount: Equatable {
    var id: String
    var title: String
    var count: Int
    var icon = "solar-clipboard-text"
    var accentHex = "#ffb340"
}

enum StripLive {
    /// The island's live items in its own priority order (IslandSelection, collapsed: only
    /// live ones), then counts; at most four chips.
    static func specs(_ items: [IslandItem], counts: [StripCount]) -> [StripLiveSpec] {
        let shown = IslandSelection.shown(items, expanded: false, pinned: [])
        var out = shown.map { StripLiveSpec(id: $0.id, kind: kind($0.kind)) }
        out += counts.filter { $0.count > 0 }.map { StripLiveSpec(id: "count." + $0.id, kind: .count) }
        return Array(out.prefix(StripMetrics.maxLive))
    }
    static func kind(_ k: IslandKind) -> StripLiveSpec.Kind {
        switch k { case .caps: .caps; case .dictation: .dictation; case .terminal: .terminal; case .timer: .timer; case .media: .media }
    }
}

// MARK: - Workspace dots

struct StripWorkspaces: Equatable {
    var current: Int = 1
    /// Windows each workspace holds (1…9); missing = empty.
    var counts: [Int: Int] = [:]

    /// Ticks under a dot: one per window, at most three.
    func ticks(_ n: Int) -> Int { min(StripMetrics.maxTicks, max(0, counts[n] ?? 0)) }
}

// MARK: - Pinned apps from the Dock

/// One pinned app: by bundle id when it has one (that survives the app moving), else by path.
struct StripPin: Equatable, Codable, Hashable {
    var bundleID: String?
    var path: String?
    var name: String
    var key: String { bundleID ?? path ?? name }
}

enum DockPins {
    /// The Dock's `persistent-apps` (com.apple.dock): app tiles in order. Spacers, folders
    /// and URL tiles are skipped; an app pinned twice counts once.
    static func parse(_ persistentApps: [[String: Any]]) -> [StripPin] {
        var out: [StripPin] = [], seen = Set<String>()
        for tile in persistentApps {
            let type = tile["tile-type"] as? String ?? "file-tile"
            guard type == "file-tile" || type == "app-tile", let data = tile["tile-data"] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
            let bundle = (data["bundle-identifier"] as? String).flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
            var path: String?
            if let file = data["file-data"] as? [String: Any], let s = file["_CFURLString"] as? String {
                path = URL(string: s).map(\.path) ?? (s.hasPrefix("/") ? s : nil)
                if let p = path, p.hasSuffix("/") , p.count > 1 { path = String(p.dropLast()) }
            }
            // Only apps: a folder or document tile has no bundle id and isn't a .app.
            guard bundle != nil || path?.hasSuffix(".app") == true else { continue }
            let label = (data["file-label"] as? String) ?? path.map { URL(fileURLWithPath: $0).deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent } ?? bundle ?? "?"
            let pin = StripPin(bundleID: bundle, path: path, name: label)
            guard seen.insert(pin.key).inserted else { continue }
            out.append(pin)
        }
        return out
    }
}

// MARK: - Replace Dock / Restore Dock

/// A defaults domain the strip can read and write: com.apple.dock through CFPreferences in
/// the app, a throwaway domain in the checks. `nil` removes the key.
protocol DockDefaultsDomain: AnyObject {
    func value(_ key: String) -> Any?
    func set(_ key: String, _ value: Any?)
    func synchronize()
}

/// What a Dock key held before we touched it: a value, or nothing at all (most Macs have
/// no autohide-delay key; restoring must delete it, not write a default).
enum DockStoredValue: Equatable, Codable {
    case absent
    case bool(Bool)
    case double(Double)
    case int(Int)
    case string(String)

    init(_ any: Any?) {
        switch any {
        case nil: self = .absent
        case let n as NSNumber where CFGetTypeID(n) == CFBooleanGetTypeID(): self = .bool(n.boolValue)
        case let n as NSNumber where CFNumberIsFloatType(n): self = .double(n.doubleValue)
        case let n as NSNumber: self = .int(n.intValue)
        case let s as String: self = .string(s)
        default: self = .absent
        }
    }
    var any: Any? {
        switch self {
        case .absent: nil
        case .bool(let b): b
        case .double(let d): d
        case .int(let i): i
        case .string(let s): s
        }
    }
}

/// Apple's Dock keeps running (Mission Control, Spaces, app switching, notifications'
/// badges all need it); it just never comes up: auto-hide on and a reveal delay of 1000s.
enum DockReplace {
    static let keys = ["autohide", "autohide-delay"]
    static let delay: Double = 1000

    struct Backup: Equatable, Codable { var values: [String: DockStoredValue] }

    /// Whether the domain looks replaced (by us, or someone with the same trick).
    static func isReplaced(_ d: DockDefaultsDomain) -> Bool {
        let autohide = (d.value("autohide") as? NSNumber)?.boolValue ?? false
        let delay = (d.value("autohide-delay") as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue ?? 0
        return autohide && delay >= Self.delay - 1
    }

    /// Writes the replaced values. Returns the backup to keep: the existing one if there is
    /// one (applying twice must never record our own values as "before").
    @discardableResult
    static func apply(_ d: DockDefaultsDomain, existing: Backup?) -> Backup {
        let backup: Backup
        if let existing { backup = existing }
        else if isReplaced(d) {
            // Replaced but our record is gone (a reinstall): "before" is Apple's defaults.
            backup = Backup(values: Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: keys.map { ($0, DockStoredValue.absent) }))
        } else {
            backup = Backup(values: Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: keys.map { ($0, DockStoredValue(d.value($0))) }))
        }
        d.set("autohide", true)
        d.set("autohide-delay", delay)
        d.synchronize()
        return backup
    }

    /// Puts back exactly what was there, deleting keys that weren't.
    static func restore(_ d: DockDefaultsDomain, backup: Backup) {
        for key in keys { d.set(key, (backup.values[key] ?? .absent).any) }
        d.synchronize()
    }

    /// Apple's Dock is at the bottom edge and not replaced: the edge is its.
    static func ownsBottomEdge(_ d: DockDefaultsDomain) -> Bool {
        let orientation = d.value("orientation") as? String ?? "bottom"
        return orientation == "bottom" && !isReplaced(d)
    }
}

/// A defaults domain through CFPreferences: `com.apple.dock` in the app (only ever after
/// you accept Replace Dock), a throwaway id in tools/strip-test.
final class CFPrefsDomain: DockDefaultsDomain {
    let id: String
    init(_ id: String) { self.id = id }
    func value(_ key: String) -> Any? { CFPreferencesCopyAppValue(key as CFString, id as CFString) }
    func set(_ key: String, _ value: Any?) {
        CFPreferencesSetAppValue(key as CFString, value.map { $0 as AnyObject }, id as CFString)
    }
    func synchronize() { CFPreferencesAppSynchronize(id as CFString) }
}
//
//  EdgeMedia.swift
//  The media card: whatever is playing on the Mac (Music, Spotify, a browser tab…) and
//  Edge's own player for your audio and video files. "music", "now playing", "pause",
//  "next" show it; "play <name>" finds a file and plays it here. Pull it off for a mini
//  player (or a video window).
//
//  System now playing comes from EdgeMediaAdapter running inside /usr/bin/perl (see
//  MediaAdapter/EdgeMediaAdapter.m for why).
//

import AppKit
import AVFoundation
import AVKit
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - System now playing

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeNowPlaying {
    static let shared = EdgeNowPlaying()

    private(set) var title = ""
    private(set) var artist = ""
    private(set) var album = ""
    private(set) var bundle: String?
    private(set) var playing = false
    private(set) var duration: Double = 0
    private(set) var artwork: NSImage?
    /// Elapsed at `stamp`, advancing at `rate` while playing.
    @ObservationIgnored private var elapsedAt: Double = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var stamp = Date()
    @ObservationIgnored private var rate: Double = 1
    @ObservationIgnored private var process: Process?
    @ObservationIgnored private var buffer = Data()

    var hasItem: Bool { !title.isEmpty }
    func elapsed(at now: Date = Date()) -> Double {
        let e = elapsedAt + (playing ? now.timeIntervalSince(stamp) * rate : 0)
        return duration > 0 ? min(max(0, e), duration) : max(0, e)
    }
    var appName: String? {
        guard let bundle, let url = NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier: bundle) else { return nil }
        return FileManager.default.displayName(atPath: url.path).replacingOccurrences(of: ".app", with: "")
    }
    var appIcon: NSImage? {
        guard let bundle, let url = NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier: bundle) else { return nil }
        return NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: url.path)
    }

    private static var adapterPath: String? { Bundle.main.path(forResource: "EdgeMediaAdapter", ofType: "dylib") }
    private static let loader = #"use DynaLoader; my $l = DynaLoader::dl_load_file($ARGV[0], 0) or die DynaLoader::dl_error(); my $s = DynaLoader::dl_find_symbol($l, $ARGV[1]) or die "symbol"; DynaLoader::dl_install_xsub("main::run", $s); run();"#

    /// Starts listening (first time the card shows); the stream lives for the session.
    func start() {
        guard process == nil, let adapter = Self.adapterPath else { return }
        let p = Process()
        p.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/perl")
        p.arguments = ["-e", Self.loader, adapter, "adapter_stream"]
        let out = Pipe()
        p.standardOutput = out
        p.standardInput = Pipe()   // closed when we quit: the adapter exits with us
        p.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
        out.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { [weak self] handle in
            let data = handle.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.receive(data) }
        }
        p.terminationHandler = { [weak self] _ in DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.process = nil } }
        do { try p.run(); process = p } catch { process = nil }
    }

    private func receive(_ data: Data) {
        buffer.append(data)
        while let newline = buffer.firstIndex(of: 0x0A) {
            let line = buffer[buffer.startIndex..<newline]
            buffer.removeSubrange(buffer.startIndex...newline)
            guard let object = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: line) as? [String: Any] else { continue }
            apply(object)
        }
    }

    private func apply(_ o: [String: Any]) {
        title = o["title"] as? String ?? ""
        artist = o["artist"] as? String ?? ""
        album = o["album"] as? String ?? ""
        bundle = o["bundle"] as? String
        playing = o["playing"] as? Bool ?? false
        duration = o["duration"] as? Double ?? 0
        rate = (o["rate"] as? Double).flatMap { $0 > 0 ? $0 : nil } ?? 1
        elapsedAt = o["elapsed"] as? Double ?? 0
        stamp = (o["timestamp"] as? Double).map { Date(timeIntervalSince1970: $0) } ?? Date()
        if let art = o["artwork"] as? String {
            artwork = art.isEmpty ? nil : Data(base64Encoded: art).flatMap(NSImage.init(data:))
        }
    }

    func send(_ command: String) {
        guard let adapter = Self.adapterPath else { return }
        let p = Process()
        p.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/perl")
        p.arguments = ["-e", Self.loader, adapter, "adapter_send"]
        p.environment = ["EDGE_MR_CMD": command]
        p.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice; p.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
        try? p.run()
        // Feels instant: flip locally, the stream confirms.
        switch command {
        case "toggle": elapsedAt = elapsed(); stamp = Date(); playing.toggle()
        case "pause": elapsedAt = elapsed(); stamp = Date(); playing = false
        case "play": stamp = Date(); playing = true
        default:
            if command.hasPrefix("seek:"), let t = Double(command.dropFirst(5)) { elapsedAt = t; stamp = Date() }
        }
    }

    func stop() { process?.terminate(); process = nil }
}

// MARK: - Edge's own player

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeMediaPlayer {
    static let shared = EdgeMediaPlayer()
    static let audioTypes: Set<String> = ["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "aiff", "aif", "flac", "alac", "ogg", "opus", "caf"]
    static let videoTypes: Set<String> = ["mp4", "mov", "m4v", "webm", "mkv", "avi"]
    static func playable(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        let ext = (path as NSString).pathExtension.lowercased()
        return audioTypes.contains(ext) || videoTypes.contains(ext)
    }

    let player = AVPlayer()
    private(set) var url: URL?
    private(set) var queue: [URL] = []
    private(set) var playing = false
    private(set) var duration: Double = 0
    private(set) var artwork: NSImage?
    private(set) var title = ""
    private(set) var artist = ""
    private(set) var isVideo = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var endObserver: NSObjectProtocol?
    @ObservationIgnored private var rateObserver: NSKeyValueObservation?

    var hasItem: Bool { url != nil }
    var elapsed: Double { player.currentTime().seconds.isFinite ? player.currentTime().seconds : 0 }

    private init() {
        rateObserver = player.observe(\.rate) { [weak self] p, _ in
            let rate = p.rate
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.playing = rate > 0 }
        }
    }

    /// Plays a file; the rest of its folder (same kind) queues behind it.
    func play(_ file: URL) {
        let ext = file.pathExtension.lowercased()
        isVideo = Self.videoTypes.contains(ext)
        let dir = file.deletingLastPathComponent()
        let siblings = ((try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(at: dir, includingPropertiesForKeys: nil)) ?? [])
            .filter { (isVideo ? Self.videoTypes : Self.audioTypes).contains($0.pathExtension.lowercased()) }
            .sorted { $0.lastPathComponent.localizedStandardCompare($1.lastPathComponent) == .orderedAscending }
        queue = siblings.isEmpty ? [file] : siblings
        load(file)
        player.play()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("media.play", params: ["path": file.path])
    }

    private func load(_ file: URL) {
        url = file
        title = file.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent
        artist = ""; artwork = nil; duration = 0
        let item = AVPlayerItem(url: file)
        player.replaceCurrentItem(with: item)
        if let endObserver { NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(endObserver) }
        endObserver = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(forName: .AVPlayerItemDidPlayToEndTime, object: item, queue: .main) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.step(1, autoplay: true) }
        }
        Task { [weak self] in
            let asset = AVURLAsset(url: file)
            let seconds = (try? await asset.load(.duration))?.seconds ?? 0
            let metadata = (try? await asset.load(.commonMetadata)) ?? []
            var title: String?, artist: String?, art: NSImage?
            for item in metadata {
                switch item.commonKey {
                case .commonKeyTitle?: title = try? await item.load(.stringValue)
                case .commonKeyArtist?: artist = try? await item.load(.stringValue)
                case .commonKeyArtwork?: art = (try? await item.load(.dataValue)).flatMap(NSImage.init(data:))
                default: break
                }
            }
            await MainActor.run {
                guard let self, self.url == file else { return }
                self.duration = seconds.isFinite ? seconds : 0
                if let title, !title.isEmpty { self.title = title }
                self.artist = artist ?? ""
                self.artwork = art
            }
        }
    }

    func toggle() { playing ? player.pause() : player.play() }
    func seek(_ t: Double) { player.seek(to: CMTime(seconds: t, preferredTimescale: 600)) }
    func step(_ d: Int, autoplay: Bool = true) {
        guard let url, let i = queue.firstIndex(of: url) else { return }
        // Back on the first seconds of a track restarts it, like every player.
        if d < 0, elapsed > 3 { seek(0); return }
        let next = i + d
        guard queue.indices.contains(next) else { if d > 0 { player.pause(); seek(0) }; return }
        load(queue[next])
        if autoplay { player.play() }
    }
    func close() { player.pause(); player.replaceCurrentItem(with: nil); url = nil; queue = [] }
}

// MARK: - What the card controls

/// The card drives one source: Edge's player when it has something (and the Mac's isn't
/// playing over it), else whatever the Mac is playing.
@MainActor enum EdgeMedia {
    static var usesOwnPlayer: Bool {
        let own = EdgeMediaPlayer.shared, sys = EdgeNowPlaying.shared
        return own.hasItem && (own.playing || !sys.playing)
    }
    /// `source` says which surface pressed it (the card, the notch island) for the journal.
    static func toggle(source: String = "card") {
        journal("media.toggle", source)
        usesOwnPlayer ? EdgeMediaPlayer.shared.toggle() : EdgeNowPlaying.shared.send("toggle")
    }
    static func next(source: String = "card") {
        journal("media.next", source)
        usesOwnPlayer ? EdgeMediaPlayer.shared.step(1) : EdgeNowPlaying.shared.send("next")
    }
    static func previous(source: String = "card") {
        journal("media.previous", source)
        usesOwnPlayer ? EdgeMediaPlayer.shared.step(-1) : EdgeNowPlaying.shared.send("prev")
    }
    private static func journal(_ name: String, _ source: String) {
        InteractionJournal.shared.action(name, params: ["player": usesOwnPlayer ? "own" : "system", "source": source])
    }
    static func seek(_ t: Double) { usesOwnPlayer ? EdgeMediaPlayer.shared.seek(t) : EdgeNowPlaying.shared.send("seek:" + String(t)) }
}

/// What a query asks of the media card.
struct EdgeMediaIntent: Equatable {
    enum Action: Equatable { case show, toggle, pause, next, previous, find(String) }
    var action: Action

    static func parse(_ raw: String) -> EdgeMediaIntent? {
        let q = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
        switch q {
        case "music", "media", "now playing", "np", "player", "song", "what's playing", "whats playing": return .init(action: .show)
        case "play", "resume": return .init(action: .toggle)
        case "pause", "stop": return .init(action: .pause)
        case "next", "skip", "next song", "next track": return .init(action: .next)
        case "previous", "prev", "back", "previous song": return .init(action: .previous)
        default: break
        }
        if q.hasPrefix("play "), q.count > 6 { return .init(action: .find(String(raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).dropFirst(5)))) }
        return nil
    }
}

// MARK: - The card

struct EdgeMediaCard: View {
    let intent: EdgeMediaIntent
    /// Files "play <name>" found (already filtered to audio/video).
    let files: [FileSearchEngine.Hit]
    let selection: Int
    let tall: Bool
    let onPlayFile: (String) -> Void

    private var own: EdgeMediaPlayer { .shared }
    private var system: EdgeNowPlaying { .shared }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            if !files.isEmpty { fileRow }
            if own.hasItem && own.isVideo && tall && EdgeMedia.usesOwnPlayer {
                VideoPlayer(player: own.player)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous))
                    .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
            }
            nowPlaying
        }
        .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
        .frame(maxHeight: tall ? .infinity : nil, alignment: .bottom)
        .onAppear { system.start() }
    }

    private var fileRow: some View {
        FollowingScroll(selection: selection, horizontal: true, resetKey: files.first?.path ?? "") {
            LazyHStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
                ForEach(Array(files.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { i, f in
                    HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
                        Image(nsImage: NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: f.path)).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 22, height: 22)
                        Text((f.name as NSString).deletingPathExtension).font(.pp(12.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, EdgeLayout.gap)
                    .frame(width: 200, height: 40, alignment: .leading)
                    .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous)
                        .fill(.white.opacity(i == selection ? 0.16 : 0.06)))
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .id(i)
                    .onTapGesture { onPlayFile(f.path) }
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(height: 40)
        .horizontalScrollFade(width: 46)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var nowPlaying: some View {
        let ownSource = EdgeMedia.usesOwnPlayer
        let title = ownSource ? own.title : system.title
        let artist = ownSource ? own.artist : [system.artist, system.album].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: " · ")
        let art = ownSource ? own.artwork : system.artwork
        let playing = ownSource ? own.playing : system.playing
        let has = ownSource ? own.hasItem : system.hasItem
        HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            ZStack {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.08))
                if let art { Image(nsImage: art).resizable().scaledToFill() }
                else if !ownSource, let icon = system.appIcon { Image(nsImage: icon).resizable().scaledToFit().padding(14) }
                else { Image(systemName: ownSource && own.isVideo ? "film" : "music.note").font(.system(size: 26, weight: .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4)) }
            }
            .frame(width: 96, height: 96)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous))
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                Text(has ? title : "Nothing playing").font(.pp(17, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(has ? 1 : 0.4)).lineLimit(1)
                if !artist.isEmpty { Text(artist).font(.pp(12.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55)).lineLimit(1) }
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                if has { scrubber(ownSource: ownSource) }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                control("backward.fill", size: 15) { EdgeMedia.previous() }
                control(playing ? "pause.fill" : "play.fill", size: 22, primary: true) { EdgeMedia.toggle() }
                control("forward.fill", size: 15) { EdgeMedia.next() }
            }
            .disabled(!has)
            .opacity(has ? 1 : 0.35)
        }
        .frame(height: 96)
    }

    private func scrubber(ownSource: Bool) -> some View {
        TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 0.5)) { context in
            let duration = ownSource ? own.duration : system.duration
            let elapsed = ownSource ? own.elapsed : system.elapsed(at: context.date)
            EdgeScrubber(elapsed: elapsed, duration: duration, accent: Color(hexString: ToolKind.media.accentHex) ?? .pink) { EdgeMedia.seek($0) }
        }
        .frame(height: 22)
    }

    private func control(_ symbol: String, size: CGFloat, primary: Bool = false, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: size, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(primary ? .black : .white)
                .frame(width: primary ? 52 : 40, height: primary ? 52 : 40)
                .background(Circle().fill(primary ? .white : .white.opacity(0.08)))
                .contentShape(Circle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressWobble())
    }
}

/// A bar you drag: the knob follows the pointer exactly; release seeks.
private struct EdgeScrubber: View {
    let elapsed: Double
    let duration: Double
    let accent: Color
    let seek: (Double) -> Void
    @State private var dragging: Double?

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let shown = dragging ?? elapsed
            let f = duration > 0 ? CGFloat(min(1, max(0, shown / duration))) : 0
            VStack(spacing: 3) {
                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.14))
                    Capsule().fill(accent).frame(width: max(4, geo.size.width * f))
                }
                .frame(height: dragging == nil ? 4 : 6)
                HStack {
                    Text(Self.time(shown)); Spacer(); Text(duration > 0 ? "-" + Self.time(duration - shown) : "")
                }
                .font(.pp(10, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45)).monospacedDigit()
            }
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
            .gesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
                .onChanged { v in
                    guard duration > 0 else { return }
                    dragging = Double(min(1, max(0, v.location.x / geo.size.width))) * duration
                }
                .onEnded { _ in if let t = dragging { seek(t) }; dragging = nil })
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.2, dampingFraction: 0.8), value: dragging == nil)
        }
    }

    static func time(_ s: Double) -> String {
        let t = Int(max(0, s.isFinite ? s : 0))
        return t >= 3600 ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", t / 3600, t / 60 % 60, t % 60) : String(format: "%d:%02d", t / 60, t % 60)
    }
}

/// Press: squish with a slight off-axis tilt, spring back (the "clunky" press).
struct EdgePressWobble: ButtonStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.86 : 1)
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(configuration.isPressed ? -4 : 0))
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.22, dampingFraction: configuration.isPressed ? 0.9 : 0.42), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}
//
//  DictationStrip.swift
//  Dictation as a card module, like the clipboard's: an inner card (8pt inset, 24pt
//  corners) on the edge sheet. With the Caps layer closed it's a small sheet rising from
//  the bottom edge; with the layer open the sheet grows, the bar takes the bottom and the
//  card sits above it, under anything else opened. Hover to read the text.
//

import SwiftUI

struct DictationStrip: View {
    let model: VoiceFlowModel

    static let collapsedHeight: CGFloat = 44

    private var text: String { model.displayTranscript }

    var body: some View {
        // An inner card on the sheet, like a clipboard item: no glass of its own. Just the
        // words (a fixed height, so the window never has to chase it).
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: min(EdgeLayout.innerRadius, Self.collapsedHeight / 2), style: .continuous)
        status
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .frame(width: EdgeLayout.contentWidth, height: Self.collapsedHeight)
        .background(.white.opacity(0.06), in: shape)
        .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .contentShape(shape)
        // No animation on status changes: "Starting…" cross-fading into "Listening…" was a ghost line.
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var status: some View {
        HStack(spacing: hasIndicator ? 10 : 0) {
            indicator
            switch model.phase {
            case .failed(let message):
                Text(message).font(.system(size: 12.5, weight: .medium)).foregroundStyle(.orange).lineLimit(1)
            default:
                TranscriptTicker(text: text, placeholder: model.phase == .recording ? "Listening…" : model.phase.title)
            }
        }
    }

    private var hasIndicator: Bool {
        switch model.phase { case .recording, .requestingPermission: false; default: true }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var indicator: some View {
        switch model.phase {
        case .recording, .requestingPermission:
            EmptyView()
        case .failed:
            Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill").foregroundStyle(.orange)
        case .inserted:
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill").foregroundStyle(.green)
        case .preparing(_, let fraction) where fraction > 0:
            // The language download: a ring that fills in dictation's green, not a spinner
            // (AppKit's determinate ring ignores tint and greys out in a non-key panel).
            ZStack {
                Circle().stroke(.white.opacity(0.14), lineWidth: 2.5)
                Circle().trim(from: 0, to: fraction).stroke(.green, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2.5, lineCap: .round))
