                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
            }
            .frame(width: 14, height: 14)
        default:
            ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
        }
    }
}

/// The words as they come, on one line: scrolls to keep the newest word in view,
/// with soft fades at both ends like the app's other scrolling rows.
/// The notch island's dictation card reads through the same ticker.
struct TranscriptTicker: View {
    let text: String
    let placeholder: String
    private let fade: CGFloat = 28

    var body: some View {
        let label = Text(text.isEmpty ? placeholder : text)
            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(text.isEmpty ? 0.5 : 0.92))
            .lineLimit(1)
        // Fits: plain, from the left edge (no fade gutter). Overflows: scroll to the newest
        // word with fades at both ends.
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            label.fixedSize().frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            ScrollViewReader { proxy in
                ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
                    HStack(spacing: 0) {
                        Color.clear.frame(width: fade)
                        label.fixedSize().contentTransition(.opacity)
                        Color.clear.frame(width: 4).id("end")
                    }
                }
                .frame(height: 20)   // one line: centered in the card like the plain label, not pinned to the top
                .mask(LinearGradient(stops: [.init(color: .clear, location: 0), .init(color: .black, location: 0.06),
                                             .init(color: .black, location: 0.94), .init(color: .clear, location: 1)],
                                     startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
                .onChange(of: text) { _, _ in
                    withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) { proxy.scrollTo("end", anchor: .trailing) }
                }
                .onAppear { proxy.scrollTo("end", anchor: .trailing) }
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }
}

/// The sheet the dictation card sits on when no other card sheet is up: the cards'
/// sheet shape (glass, 32pt top corners, running off the bottom edge).
struct DictationSheetBackdrop: View {
    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.outerRadius, style: .continuous)
        Color.white.opacity(0.001)
            .glassEffect(.regular, in: shape)
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.24), lineWidth: 0.75))
            .frame(width: EdgeLayout.resultWidth)
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}

/// Caps layer closed: the dictation card on its own small sheet at the bottom edge.
struct DictationSheet: View {
    let model: VoiceFlowModel
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            DictationStrip(model: model)
                .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
                .padding(.bottom, EdgeLayout.bottomCrop)            // runs off the bottom edge
                .background(alignment: .bottom) { DictationSheetBackdrop() }
        }
        .frame(width: EdgeLayout.resultWidth)
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}
//
//  EdgeLiveStatus.swift
//  What Surface is doing right now, read in one place for both homes of live status:
//  the bottom strip's live sliver (StripController) and the notch island when it's
//  mirrored there (EdgeIslandController). It owns no state: it reads the dictation model,
//  the terminal's waiting notice, now playing, the Caps chord in progress and registered
//  timer sources into an IslandSnapshot; the priority is IslandSnapshot.items /
//  IslandSelection (EdgeIsland.swift). Call `read()` inside withObservationTracking to be
//  told when any of it changes. docs/features/strip.md, docs/features/notch.md.
//

import AppKit
import Observation

@MainActor final class EdgeLiveStatus {
    static let shared = EdgeLiveStatus()

    /// The terminal's font and colors as of the last read with a notice in it.
    private(set) var look = IslandTermLook()
    private var sources: [@MainActor () -> [IslandTimer]] = []
    private var appIcons: [String: NSImage] = [:]
    /// Readers re-read when a source is added (a feature installed after they started).
    var onSourcesChanged: [() -> Void] = []

    /// Timers (or anything countdown-shaped) from other features (the bar's timer words).
    /// A source is read inside observation tracking: if it reads an @Observable model, every
    /// reader updates when that model does.
    func addSource(_ source: @escaping @MainActor () -> [IslandTimer]) {
        sources.append(source)
        onSourcesChanged.forEach { $0() }
    }

    func read() -> IslandSnapshot {
        var s = IslandSnapshot()
        let modules = EdgeModules.shared
        if let pending = EdgeFolderShelfState.shared.pending { s.caps = Self.caps(pending) }
        if modules.isOn(.dictation), let m = BrowserWindow.shared.dictation, m.phase.isVisible {
            let voice: IslandVoice
            switch m.phase {
            case .recording: voice = .listening
            case .inserted: voice = .inserted
            case .failed(let message): voice = .failed(message)
            default: voice = .working(m.phase.title)
            }
            s.dictation = .init(voice: voice, level: m.level, transcript: m.displayTranscript)
        }
        if modules.isOn(.terminal), let n = EdgeTermPeek.shared.waiting {
            let look = termLook()
            if self.look != look { self.look = look }
            let kind: IslandNoticeKind = switch n.kind { case .done: .done; case .failed: .failed; case .attention: .attention }
            s.notice = .init(kind: kind, title: n.title, detail: n.detail, session: n.sessionID, block: n.blockID,
                             duration: n.duration, tintHex: Self.hex(look.tint(kind)))
        }
        s.timers = sources.flatMap { $0() }
        if modules.isOn(.media) {
            let own = EdgeMediaPlayer.shared, system = EdgeNowPlaying.shared
            if EdgeMedia.usesOwnPlayer {
                s.media = .init(title: own.title, artist: own.artist, playing: own.playing, elapsed: own.elapsed,
                                duration: own.duration, asOf: Date(), art: own.artwork.map(AnyHashable.init))
            } else if system.hasItem {
                let artist = [system.artist, system.album].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: " · ")
                s.media = .init(title: system.title, artist: artist, playing: system.playing, elapsed: system.elapsed(),
                                duration: system.duration, asOf: Date(),
                                art: (system.artwork ?? appIcon(system.bundle)).map(AnyHashable.init))
            }
        }
        return s
    }

    /// Now playing streams once something shows it (the card, the island, the strip); idempotent.
    func listenToMedia() {
        if EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.media) { EdgeNowPlaying.shared.start() }
    }

    /// The chord being held: Caps+letter shows that module (its icon and color), Caps+digit the workspace.
    static func caps(_ index: Int) -> IslandSnapshot.Caps {
        if index < SpotlightController.firstToolChordIndex {
            return .init(letter: String((index + 1) % 10), icon: EdgeModule.tiling.icon, accentHex: EdgeModule.tiling.accentHex,
                         title: "Workspace \((index + 1) % 10)")
        }
        let letter = SpotlightController.chordLetter(forChordIndex: index)
        let i = index - SpotlightController.firstToolChordIndex
        let chord = SpotlightController.toolChordKeys.indices.contains(i) ? SpotlightController.toolChordKeys[i].action : nil
        let module = EdgeModules.module(forChordLetter: SpotlightController.chordID(forChordIndex: index))
        return .init(letter: letter == "Space" ? "␣" : letter, icon: module?.icon ?? "solar-keyboard",
                     accentHex: module?.accentHex ?? "#e5e5ea", title: chord?.title ?? module?.title ?? letter)
    }

    private func termLook() -> IslandTermLook {
        let host = EdgeTerminalHost.shared, config = host.look.config
        let fallback: [Int: EdgeRGB] = [1: EdgeRGB(r: 204, g: 102, b: 102), 2: EdgeRGB(r: 181, g: 189, b: 104), 3: EdgeRGB(r: 240, g: 198, b: 116)]
        func color(_ i: Int) -> NSColor { (host.view.paletteColor(i) ?? config.palette[i] ?? fallback[i]!).color }
        return IslandTermLook(font: config.fonts()[0], foreground: config.foreground.color, background: config.backgroundColor,
                              done: color(2), failed: color(1), attention: color(3))
    }

    func appIcon(_ bundle: String?) -> NSImage? {
        guard let bundle else { return nil }
        if let cached = appIcons[bundle] { return cached }
        guard let url = NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier: bundle) else { return nil }
        let icon = NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: url.path)
        appIcons[bundle] = icon
        return icon
    }

    static func hex(_ c: NSColor) -> String {
        let s = c.usingColorSpace(.sRGB) ?? c
        return String(format: "#%02x%02x%02x", Int(s.redComponent * 255), Int(s.greenComponent * 255), Int(s.blueComponent * 255))
    }
}

// MARK: - General

private struct GeneralPane: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @State private var template = ""
    @State private var homeUrl = ""
    @State private var isDefaultBrowser = false
    @State private var settingDefaultBrowser = false
    @State private var defaultBrowserError: String?

    /// The presets we offer; `{query}` is the core's placeholder.
    private static let engines: [(String, String)] = [
        ("DuckDuckGo", "https://duckduckgo.com/?q={query}"),
        ("Google", "https://www.google.com/search?q={query}"),
        ("Bing", "https://www.bing.com/search?q={query}"),
        ("Kagi", "https://kagi.com/search?q={query}"),
        ("Brave", "https://search.brave.com/search?q={query}"),
    ]

    private var settings: Settings? { engine.snapshot?.settings }

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section("Search") {
                Picker("Search engine", selection: Binding(
                    get: { Self.engines.first { $0.1 == template }?.0 ?? "Custom" },
                    set: { name in
                        guard let tmpl = Self.engines.first(where: { $0.0 == name })?.1 else { return }
                        template = tmpl
                        engine.dispatch(.setSearchTemplate(template: tmpl))
                    }
                )) {
                    ForEach(Self.engines, id: \.0) { name, _ in Text(name).tag(name) }
                    if !Self.engines.contains(where: { $0.1 == template }) {
                        Text("Custom").tag("Custom")
                    }
                }
                TextField("Custom template", text: $template, prompt: Text("https://…/?q={query}"))
                    .onSubmit { engine.dispatch(.setSearchTemplate(template: template)) }
                Text("{query} is replaced with your search.")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Text("Native bangs work with every engine: !g, !ddg, !b, !brave, !kagi, !yt, !w, !gh, !r, !so, !mdn, !npm, !crates, !maps, and !images.")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Section("Home") {
                TextField("New tab page", text: $homeUrl, prompt: Text("https://…"))
                    .onSubmit { engine.dispatch(.setHomeUrl(url: homeUrl)) }
            }
            Section("Default Browser") {
                LabeledContent("Status") {
                    Label(
                        isDefaultBrowser ? "Default" : "Not Default",
                        systemImage: isDefaultBrowser ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "globe"
                    )
                    .foregroundStyle(isDefaultBrowser ? .green : .secondary)
                }
                HStack {
                    Button {
                        makeDefaultBrowser()
                    } label: {
                        Label("Make Default", systemImage: "globe")
                    }
                    .disabled(isDefaultBrowser || settingDefaultBrowser)

                    if settingDefaultBrowser {
                        ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                    }
                }
                if let defaultBrowserError {
                    Text(defaultBrowserError)
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.red)
                }
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .onAppear {
            syncFields()
            refreshDefaultBrowserStatus()
        }
        .onDisappear { persistFields() }
    }

    private func syncFields() {
        template = settings?.searchTemplate ?? template
        homeUrl = settings?.homeUrl ?? homeUrl
    }

    private func persistFields() {
        engine.dispatch(.setSearchTemplate(template: template))
        engine.dispatch(.setHomeUrl(url: homeUrl))
    }

    private func refreshDefaultBrowserStatus() {
        isDefaultBrowser = DefaultBrowserManager.isDefaultBrowser()
    }

    private func makeDefaultBrowser() {
        settingDefaultBrowser = true
        defaultBrowserError = nil
        DefaultBrowserManager.makeDefaultBrowser { result in
            settingDefaultBrowser = false
            refreshDefaultBrowserStatus()
            if case let .failure(error) = result {
                defaultBrowserError = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Downloads

private struct DownloadsPane: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    private var settings: Settings? { engine.snapshot?.settings }

    private var folderName: String {
        let dir = settings?.downloadDirectory ?? ""
        if dir.isEmpty {
            return FileManager.default.urls(for: .downloadsDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first?.lastPathComponent ?? "Downloads"
        }
        return URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).lastPathComponent
    }

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section {
                LabeledContent("Save files to") {
                    Button {
                        if let url = pickFolder() {
                            engine.dispatch(.setDownloadDirectory(path: url.path))
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Label(folderName, systemImage: "folder")
                    }
                }
                Toggle("Ask for each download", isOn: Binding(
                    get: { settings?.askWhereToDownload ?? false },
                    set: { engine.dispatch(.setAskWhereToDownload(ask: $0)) }
                ))
            } footer: {
                Text("With \"Ask for each download\" on, a save panel is shown every time instead of saving silently.")
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
    }

    private func pickFolder() -> URL? {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.canChooseFiles = false
        panel.canChooseDirectories = true
        panel.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        panel.prompt = "Choose"
        return panel.runModal() == .OK ? panel.url : nil
    }
}

/// Click → capture the next keystroke as the binding. Requires ⌘, ⌥, or ⌃
/// so plain typing can never be swallowed by a shortcut.
private struct ShortcutRecorderButton: View {
    @Environment(ShortcutMap.self) private var map
    let action: BrowserAction
    @State private var recording = false
    @State private var monitor: Any?

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            recording ? stop() : start()
        } label: {
            Text(recording ? "Press keys…" : (map.chord(for: action)?.display ?? "Unbound"))
                .monospaced()
                .frame(minWidth: 76)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(recording ? .secondary : .primary)
        .onDisappear { stop() }
    }

    private func start() {
        recording = true
        monitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .keyDown) { event in
            nonisolated(unsafe) let event = event
            let handled = MainActor.assumeIsolated { handle(event) }
            return handled ? nil : event
        }
    }

    private func stop() {
        if let monitor { NSEvent.removeMonitor(monitor) }
        monitor = nil
        recording = false
    }

    private func handle(_ event: NSEvent) -> Bool {
        let code = Int(event.keyCode)
        if code == 53 { stop(); return true }            // Esc cancels
        if code == 51 {                                   // ⌫ unbinds
            map.clear(action)
            stop()
            return true
        }
        let flags = event.modifierFlags.intersection([.command, .option, .shift, .control])
        guard !flags.intersection([.command, .option, .control]).isEmpty else { return true }
        map.set(KeyChord(keyCode: code, flags: flags, key: KeyChord.keyLabel(for: event)), for: action)
        stop()
        return true
    }
}

// MARK: - Voice

private struct VoicePane: View {
    @Environment(VoiceFlowSettings.self) private var settings
    @State private var testResult: String?
    @State private var testing = false

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section {
                TextField("Command", text: Binding(
                    get: { settings.command },
                    set: { settings.command = $0 }
                ), prompt: Text("parakeet-mlx"))
                TextField("Model", text: Binding(
                    get: { settings.model },
                    set: { settings.model = $0 }
                ), prompt: Text("mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3"))
                LabeledContent("Cache") {
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        Text(cacheLabel)
                            .foregroundStyle(settings.cacheDirectory.isEmpty ? .secondary : .primary)
                            .lineLimit(1)
                            .truncationMode(.middle)
                        Button {
                            chooseCache()
                        } label: {
                            Label("Choose", systemImage: "folder")
                        }
                    }
                }
                LabeledContent("Connection") {
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        if let testResult {
                            Text(testResult)
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                                .lineLimit(2)
                                .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                        }
                        if testing { ProgressView().controlSize(.small) }
                        Button(testing ? "Testing…" : "Test") { test() }
                            .disabled(testing)
                    }
                }
            } header: {
                Text("Parakeet-MLX")
            } footer: {
                Text("Install with `uv tool install parakeet-mlx -U`; the CLI also needs ffmpeg available on PATH.")
            }

            Section {
                Toggle("Context-aware cleanup", isOn: Binding(
                    get: { settings.smartFormatting },
                    set: { settings.smartFormatting = $0 }
                ))
                Toggle("Use local AI cleanup", isOn: Binding(
                    get: { settings.aiPolishing },
                    set: { settings.aiPolishing = $0 }
                ))
                .disabled(!settings.smartFormatting)
                Toggle("Restore clipboard after paste", isOn: Binding(
                    get: { settings.restoreClipboard },
                    set: { settings.restoreClipboard = $0 }
                ))
            } header: {
                Text("Insertion")
            } footer: {
                Text("Voice always shows the recognizer's words as spoken. With a local AI endpoint configured, context-aware cleanup removes disfluencies, honors corrections, and formats for the focused field without turning spoken words into Markdown commands.")
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
    }

    private var cacheLabel: String {
        settings.cacheDirectory.isEmpty ? "Default Hugging Face cache" : settings.cacheDirectory
    }

    private func chooseCache() {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.canChooseFiles = false
        panel.canChooseDirectories = true
        panel.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        panel.prompt = "Choose"
        if panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url {
            settings.cacheDirectory = url.path
        }
    }

    private func test() {
        testing = true
        testResult = nil
        let config = settings.snapshot()
        Task {
            do {
                testResult = try await ParakeetMLXTranscriber.version(configuration: config)
            } catch {
                testResult = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? error.localizedDescription
            }
            testing = false
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Privacy

private struct PrivacyPane: View {
    let web: WebContentManager

    @State private var blockAds = ContentBlocker.shared.enabled
    @State private var confirmation: ClearAction?
    @State private var clearing = false
    @State private var result: String?

    private enum ClearAction: String, Identifiable {
        case history, websiteData
        var id: String { rawValue }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section {
                Toggle("Block ads & trackers", isOn: $blockAds)
                    .onChange(of: blockAds) { _, on in
                        ContentBlocker.shared.enabled = on
                        web.reloadProtectionPolicy()
                    }
            } header: {
                Text("Protection")
            } footer: {
                Text("Nardo downloads public filter lists from EasyList, uBlock Origin, and AdGuard. Browsing history and page contents are not sent with those requests.")
            }

            Section {
                LabeledContent("Browsing history") {
                    Button("Clear…") { confirmation = .history }
                }
                LabeledContent("Web caches") {
                    Button("Clear Cache") { clearCache() }
                        .disabled(clearing)
                }
                LabeledContent("Cookies & website data") {
                    Button("Clear…") { confirmation = .websiteData }
                        .disabled(clearing)
                }
                if clearing {
                    HStack { ProgressView().controlSize(.small); Text("Clearing browser data…") }
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                } else if let result {
                    Text(result).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            } header: {
                Text("Browser Data")
            } footer: {
                Text("Website data includes cookies, caches, local storage, and IndexedDB. Clearing it signs you out of websites. Saved Keychain passwords and open tabs are not removed.")
            }

            Section {
                LabeledContent("Telemetry", value: "None")
                LabeledContent("Account or cloud sync", value: "None")
                LabeledContent("Voice-polish sharing", value: "Only when enabled")
                LabeledContent("Password storage", value: "macOS Keychain")
            } header: {
                Text("Data Practices")
            } footer: {
                Text("Voice polishing goes only to the endpoint you configure. Browser sign-ins are imported only after you explicitly approve an import.")
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .confirmationDialog(
            confirmationTitle,
            isPresented: Binding(
                get: { confirmation != nil },
                set: { if !$0 { confirmation = nil } }
            ),
            titleVisibility: .visible
        ) {
            if confirmation == .history {
                Button("Clear Browsing History", role: .destructive) { clearHistory() }
            } else if confirmation == .websiteData {
                Button("Clear Cookies & Website Data", role: .destructive) { clearWebsiteData() }
            }
            Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { confirmation = nil }
        } message: {
            Text(confirmationMessage)
        }
    }

    private var confirmationTitle: String {
        confirmation == .history ? "Clear all browsing history?" : "Clear all website data?"
    }

    private var confirmationMessage: String {
        confirmation == .history
            ? "This cannot be undone. Open tabs, cookies, and downloads are not affected."
            : "This signs you out of websites. History, downloads, open tabs, and saved passwords are not affected."
    }

    private func clearHistory() {
        confirmation = nil
        HistoryStore.shared.clear()
        result = "Browsing history cleared."
    }

    private func clearCache() {
        clearing = true
        result = nil
        web.clearWebCaches {
            clearing = false
            result = "Web caches cleared."
        }
    }

    private func clearWebsiteData() {
        confirmation = nil
        clearing = true
        result = nil
        web.clearAllWebsiteData {
            clearing = false
            result = "Cookies and website data cleared."
        }
    }
}

//
//  Capture.swift
//  Caps+S: freeze the screen, drag a region (or click to pick a color). The result
//  pops up from the bottom edge as one card: the image and its text, already read.
//  T switches to text grab (also `ocr` / `grab text` in the bar): the region's text
//  goes straight onto the clipboard and a small card confirms it.
//

import AppKit
import ScreenCaptureKit
import SwiftUI
import Vision

@MainActor final class CaptureController {
    static let shared = CaptureController()

    /// What a drag does: capture the region (the card), or copy the text in it.
    enum Mode { case region, text }

    private var overlay: CaptureOverlayWindow?
    private var model: CaptureOverlayModel?
    private var frozen: CGImage?
    private var screen: NSScreen?
    private var keyMonitor: Any?
    private var startMode: Mode = .region
    /// How the capture started ("caps", "bar"), for the journal.
    private var via = "caps"
    /// The app you were in, to hand the keyboard back after a text grab.
    private var previousApp: NSRunningApplication?
    let card = CaptureCardPresenter()

    /// Freeze the screen under the pointer and start selecting.
    func begin(mode: Mode = .region, via: String = "caps") {
        guard overlay == nil else { return }
        startMode = mode; self.via = via
        // With the bar up we're frontmost; then the app on top of the screen is the one you were in.
        let front = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication
        previousApp = front?.bundleIdentifier?.hasPrefix("com.hashawn.nardo") == true ? Self.app(at: nil) : front
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        guard let screen = NSScreen.screens.first(where: { $0.frame.contains(mouse) }) ?? NSScreen.main else { return }
        card.dismiss()
        guard EdgePermissionAsk.shared.request(.screenRecording, for: .capture, reason: "so Caps+S can see your screen") else { return }
        Task { @MainActor in
            guard let image = await Self.snapshot(screen) else { return }
            self.present(image, on: screen)
        }
    }

    /// The whole display, without Nardo's own windows.
    private static func snapshot(_ screen: NSScreen) async -> CGImage? {
        guard let displayID = screen.deviceDescription[NSDeviceDescriptionKey("NSScreenNumber")] as? CGDirectDisplayID else { return nil }
        do {
            let content = try await SCShareableContent.excludingDesktopWindows(false, onScreenWindowsOnly: true)
            guard let display = content.displays.first(where: { $0.displayID == displayID }) else { return nil }
            let own = content.applications.filter { $0.bundleIdentifier.hasPrefix("com.hashawn.nardo") }
            let filter = SCContentFilter(display: display, excludingApplications: own, exceptingWindows: [])
            let config = SCStreamConfiguration()
            config.width = Int(screen.frame.width * screen.backingScaleFactor)
            config.height = Int(screen.frame.height * screen.backingScaleFactor)
            config.showsCursor = EdgeSettings.captureShowsCursor
            return try await SCScreenshotManager.captureImage(contentFilter: filter, configuration: config)
        } catch {
            ToastCenter.shared.show(.error, "Capture needs Screen Recording permission")
            return nil
        }
    }

    private func present(_ image: CGImage, on screen: NSScreen) {
        frozen = image; self.screen = screen
        let model = CaptureOverlayModel(image: image, screenSize: screen.frame.size, mode: startMode) { [weak self] result in self?.finish(result) }
        let window = CaptureOverlayWindow(screen: screen, model: model)
        overlay = window; self.model = model
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
        NSCursor.crosshair.push()
        keyMonitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .keyDown) { [weak self] event in
            if event.keyCode == 53 { self?.finish(nil); return nil }   // Esc
            if event.keyCode == 17, event.modifierFlags.intersection([.command, .control, .option]).isEmpty {   // T
                self?.model?.mode = self?.model?.mode == .text ? .region : .text
                return nil
            }
            return event
        }
    }

    private func finish(_ result: CaptureOverlayWindow.Result?) {
        if let keyMonitor { NSEvent.removeMonitor(keyMonitor) }
        keyMonitor = nil
        NSCursor.pop()
        let mode = model?.mode ?? .region
        overlay?.orderOut(nil); overlay = nil; model = nil
        defer { frozen = nil }
        if result == nil, mode == .text { handBack() }   // Esc: straight back where you were
        guard let result, let image = frozen, let screen else { return }
        switch result {
        case .region(let rect) where mode == .text:
            guard let crop = Self.crop(image, to: rect, in: screen) else { return }
            grabText(crop, rect: rect, on: screen)
        case .region(let rect):
            guard let crop = Self.crop(image, to: rect, in: screen) else { return }
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("capture.region", params: ["w": Int(rect.width), "h": Int(rect.height)])
            let capture = CaptureResult(image: crop, scale: screen.backingScaleFactor)
            card.show(.image(capture), on: screen)
            Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
                let text = Self.recognizeText(crop)
                let codes = Self.readCodes(crop)
                await MainActor.run { capture.text = text; capture.codes = codes; capture.reading = false }
            }
        case .color(let point):
            guard let color = Self.color(in: image, at: point, on: screen) else { return }
            let hex = PickedColor(color).hex
            NSPasteboard.general.clearContents(); NSPasteboard.general.setString(hex, forType: .string)
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("capture.color", params: ["hex": hex])
            card.show(.color(PickedColor(color)), on: screen)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Text grab

    /// The region's text onto the clipboard (a clipboard card, credited to the app under
    /// it), confirmed by a small card; the keyboard goes back to the app you were in.
    private func grabText(_ crop: CGImage, rect: CGRect, on screen: NSScreen) {
        let source = Self.app(under: rect, on: screen) ?? previousApp
        let grab = TextGrab()
        let via = self.via
        card.show(.text(grab), on: screen)
        handBack()
        Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
            let text = EdgeOCR.recognize(crop)
            await MainActor.run {
                if !text.isEmpty {
                    ClipboardStore.shared.copyAndRecord(text, source: (source?.bundleIdentifier, source?.localizedName))
                }
                let lines = text.isEmpty ? 0 : text.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).count
                InteractionJournal.shared.action("capture.text", params: ["w": Int(rect.width), "h": Int(rect.height), "lines": lines, "chars": text.count, "via": via])
                grab.text = text; grab.reading = false
            }
        }
    }

    /// The keyboard back to the app you were in (we took it for the overlay).
    private func handBack() {
        guard let previousApp, !previousApp.isTerminated else { return }
        NSApp.yieldActivation(to: previousApp)
        previousApp.activate(from: .current, options: [])
    }

    /// The topmost other app's window under the middle of `rect` (screen points, origin top-left).
    private static func app(under rect: CGRect, on screen: NSScreen) -> NSRunningApplication? {
        guard let primary = NSScreen.screens.first else { return nil }
        // Window bounds are global, origin at the top-left of the primary display.
        return app(at: CGPoint(x: screen.frame.minX + rect.midX, y: primary.frame.maxY - screen.frame.maxY + rect.midY))
    }

    /// The app owning the frontmost normal window (containing `point`, when given; global
    /// coordinates, origin top-left of the primary display), ours left out.
    private static func app(at point: CGPoint?) -> NSRunningApplication? {
        let own = ProcessInfo.processInfo.processIdentifier
        guard let windows = CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo([.optionOnScreenOnly, .excludeDesktopElements], kCGNullWindowID) as? [[String: Any]] else { return nil }
        for w in windows {   // front to back
            guard (w[kCGWindowLayer as String] as? Int) == 0,
                  let pid = w[kCGWindowOwnerPID as String] as? pid_t, pid != own,
                  let bounds = w[kCGWindowBounds as String] as? NSDictionary,
                  let frame = CGRect(dictionaryRepresentation: bounds), point.map(frame.contains) ?? true,
                  let app = NSRunningApplication(processIdentifier: pid),
                  app.bundleIdentifier?.hasPrefix("com.hashawn.nardo") != true else { continue }
            return app
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// `rect` is in the screen's points, origin top-left.
    nonisolated static func crop(_ image: CGImage, to rect: CGRect, in screen: NSScreen) -> CGImage? {
        let s = CGFloat(image.width) / screen.frame.width
        let pixels = CGRect(x: rect.minX * s, y: rect.minY * s, width: rect.width * s, height: rect.height * s).integral
        return image.cropping(to: pixels)
    }

    nonisolated static func color(in image: CGImage, at point: CGPoint, on screen: NSScreen) -> NSColor? {
        let s = CGFloat(image.width) / screen.frame.width
        guard let pixel = image.cropping(to: CGRect(x: (point.x * s).rounded(.down), y: (point.y * s).rounded(.down), width: 1, height: 1)) else { return nil }
        var rgba = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 4)
        guard let ctx = CGContext(data: &rgba, width: 1, height: 1, bitsPerComponent: 8, bytesPerRow: 4,
                                  space: CGColorSpace(name: CGColorSpace.sRGB)!, bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue) else { return nil }
        ctx.draw(pixel, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1, height: 1))
        return NSColor(srgbRed: CGFloat(rgba[0]) / 255, green: CGFloat(rgba[1]) / 255, blue: CGFloat(rgba[2]) / 255, alpha: 1)
    }

    /// QR codes and barcodes in the image, as their payloads.
    nonisolated static func readCodes(_ image: CGImage) -> [String] {
        let request = VNDetectBarcodesRequest()
        try? VNImageRequestHandler(cgImage: image).perform([request])
        var seen = Set<String>()
        return (request.results ?? []).compactMap(\.payloadStringValue).filter { seen.insert($0).inserted }
    }

    // MARK: Pinned captures

    private var pins: [NSPanel] = []

    /// Float a capture above everything: drag it anywhere, close it from its corner.
    func pin(_ capture: CaptureResult) {
        let image = capture.nsImage
        let maxSide: CGFloat = 520
        let scale = min(1, maxSide / max(image.size.width, image.size.height))
        let size = NSSize(width: image.size.width * scale, height: image.size.height * scale)
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: NSRect(x: mouse.x - size.width / 2, y: mouse.y - size.height / 2, width: size.width, height: size.height),
                            styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = true
        panel.level = .floating; panel.isMovableByWindowBackground = true
        panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: PinnedCaptureView(image: image) { [weak self, weak panel] in
            guard let panel else { return }
            panel.orderOut(nil); self?.pins.removeAll { $0 === panel }
        })
        host.sizingOptions = []
        panel.contentView = host
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()
        pins.append(panel)
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("capture.pin")
    }

    /// On-device OCR, lines in reading order with their breaks.
    nonisolated static func recognizeText(_ image: CGImage) -> String { EdgeOCR.recognize(image) }
}

/// A text grab in flight: reading, then the text (empty when there was none).
@MainActor @Observable final class TextGrab {
    var text = ""
    var reading = true
}

/// A finished region capture; its text arrives a moment later.
@MainActor @Observable final class CaptureResult {
    let image: CGImage
    let scale: CGFloat
    var text = ""
    var codes: [String] = []
    var reading = true
    init(image: CGImage, scale: CGFloat) { self.image = image; self.scale = scale }

    var nsImage: NSImage { NSImage(cgImage: image, size: NSSize(width: CGFloat(image.width) / scale, height: CGFloat(image.height) / scale)) }
    var pngData: Data? { NSBitmapImageRep(cgImage: image).representation(using: .png, properties: [:]) }

    /// A PNG on disk, for dragging out or saving.
    func writePNG(to directory: URL) -> URL? { write(to: directory, format: .png) }

    /// Saved in the format chosen in Settings → Capture.
    func write(to directory: URL, format: EdgeSettings.CaptureFormat) -> URL? {
        let rep = NSBitmapImageRep(cgImage: image)
        let data: Data?
        switch format {
        case .png: data = rep.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])
        case .jpeg: data = rep.representation(using: .jpeg, properties: [.compressionFactor: 0.9])
        case .heic:
            let out = NSMutableData()
            if let dest = CGImageDestinationCreateWithData(out, "public.heic" as CFString, 1, nil) {
                CGImageDestinationAddImage(dest, image, [kCGImageDestinationLossyCompressionQuality: 0.85] as CFDictionary)
                data = CGImageDestinationFinalize(dest) ? out as Data : nil
            } else { data = nil }
        }
        guard let data else { return nil }
        let url = directory.appendingPathComponent("Capture " + Self.stamp.string(from: Date()) + "." + format.rawValue)
        do { try data.write(to: url); return url } catch { return nil }
    }
    private static let stamp: DateFormatter = { let f = DateFormatter(); f.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd 'at' HH.mm.ss"; return f }()
}

struct PickedColor {
    let r: Int, g: Int, b: Int
    init(_ c: NSColor) {
        let s = c.usingColorSpace(.sRGB) ?? c
        r = Int((s.redComponent * 255).rounded()); g = Int((s.greenComponent * 255).rounded()); b = Int((s.blueComponent * 255).rounded())
    }
    var color: Color { Color(.sRGB, red: Double(r) / 255, green: Double(g) / 255, blue: Double(b) / 255) }
    var hex: String { String(format: "#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b) }
    var rgb: String { "rgb(\(r), \(g), \(b))" }
    var hsl: String {
        let R = Double(r) / 255, G = Double(g) / 255, B = Double(b) / 255
        let mx = max(R, G, B), mn = min(R, G, B), l = (mx + mn) / 2, d = mx - mn
        var h = 0.0, s = 0.0
        if d > 0 {
            s = d / (1 - abs(2 * l - 1))
            switch mx {
            case R: h = 60 * ((G - B) / d).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 6)
            case G: h = 60 * ((B - R) / d + 2)
            default: h = 60 * ((R - G) / d + 4)
            }
            if h < 0 { h += 360 }
        }
        return "hsl(\(Int(h.rounded())), \(Int((s * 100).rounded()))%, \(Int((l * 100).rounded()))%)"
    }
    var swiftUI: String { String(format: "Color(red: %.3f, green: %.3f, blue: %.3f)", Double(r) / 255, Double(g) / 255, Double(b) / 255) }
}

// MARK: - Overlay

/// The frozen screen. Drag selects a region; a click without a drag picks the pixel.
final class CaptureOverlayWindow: NSPanel {
    enum Result { case region(CGRect), color(CGPoint) }

    init(screen: NSScreen, model: CaptureOverlayModel) {
        super.init(contentRect: screen.frame, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        level = .screenSaver; isOpaque = true; backgroundColor = .black; hasShadow = false
        collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: CaptureOverlayView(model: model))
        host.sizingOptions = []
        contentView = host
        setFrame(screen.frame, display: true)
    }
    override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class CaptureOverlayModel {
    let image: CGImage
    let screenSize: CGSize
    let done: (CaptureOverlayWindow.Result?) -> Void
    var mode: CaptureController.Mode
    var start: CGPoint?
    var current: CGPoint?
    var pointer: CGPoint = .zero
    init(image: CGImage, screenSize: CGSize, mode: CaptureController.Mode, done: @escaping (CaptureOverlayWindow.Result?) -> Void) {
        self.image = image; self.screenSize = screenSize; self.mode = mode; self.done = done
    }
    var selection: CGRect? {
        guard let start, let current else { return nil }
        let r = CGRect(x: min(start.x, current.x), y: min(start.y, current.y), width: abs(current.x - start.x), height: abs(current.y - start.y))
        return r.width >= 4 || r.height >= 4 ? r : nil
    }
}

private struct CaptureOverlayView: View {
    let model: CaptureOverlayModel

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
            Image(decorative: model.image, scale: CGFloat(model.image.width) / model.screenSize.width)
                .resizable().frame(width: model.screenSize.width, height: model.screenSize.height)
            // Dim everything but the selection.
            Rectangle().fill(.black.opacity(0.32))
                .mask {
                    Rectangle().overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                        if let r = model.selection {
                            Rectangle().frame(width: r.width, height: r.height).offset(x: r.minX, y: r.minY).blendMode(.destinationOut)
                        }
                    }.compositingGroup()
                }
            if let r = model.selection {
                // Text grab draws its selection in Capture's yellow.
                Rectangle().strokeBorder(model.mode == .text ? EdgeModule.capture.accent : .white.opacity(0.9), lineWidth: model.mode == .text ? 1.5 : 1)
                    .frame(width: r.width, height: r.height).offset(x: r.minX, y: r.minY)
            }
            CaptureLoupe(model: model)
        }
        .frame(width: model.screenSize.width, height: model.screenSize.height, alignment: .topLeading)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onContinuousHover(coordinateSpace: .local) { phase in
            if case .active(let p) = phase { model.pointer = p }
        }
        .gesture(
            DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0, coordinateSpace: .local)
                .onChanged { v in
                    if model.start == nil { model.start = v.startLocation }
                    model.current = v.location; model.pointer = v.location
                }
                .onEnded { v in
                    if let r = model.selection { model.done(.region(r)) }
                    else if model.mode == .text { model.start = nil; model.current = nil }   // a click grabs nothing; drag again
                    else { model.done(.color(v.location)) }
                }
        )
        .ignoresSafeArea()
    }
}

/// Pixel magnifier beside the pointer: the frozen frame at 8×, with the center pixel ringed.
private struct CaptureLoupe: View {
    let model: CaptureOverlayModel
    private let size: CGFloat = 112, zoom: CGFloat = 8

    var body: some View {
        let p = model.pointer
        let scale = CGFloat(model.image.width) / model.screenSize.width
        let span = size / zoom   // points of screen shown
        let source = CGRect(x: (p.x - span / 2) * scale, y: (p.y - span / 2) * scale, width: span * scale, height: span * scale).integral
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous)
        let total = size + EdgeLayout.gap + Self.chipHeight
        let x = p.x + 24 + size > model.screenSize.width ? p.x - 24 - size : p.x + 24
        let y = p.y + 24 + total > model.screenSize.height ? p.y - 24 - total : p.y + 24
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            Group {
                if let crop = model.image.cropping(to: source) {
                    Image(decorative: crop, scale: 1).resizable().interpolation(.none)
                } else { Color.black }
            }
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .overlay { Rectangle().strokeBorder(.white, lineWidth: 1.5).frame(width: zoom + 2, height: zoom + 2) }
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.5), lineWidth: 1))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.4), radius: 8, y: 3)
            CaptureModeChip(mode: model.mode)
        }
        .offset(x: x, y: y)
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }

    static let chipHeight: CGFloat = 32
}

/// Under the loupe: which mode a drag is in, and T to switch. Text grab lights up in
/// Capture's yellow.
private struct CaptureModeChip: View {
    let mode: CaptureController.Mode
    var body: some View {
        let text = mode == .text
        let ink: Color = text ? .black : .white
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            Image(text ? "solar-text-square" : "solar-camera")
                .renderingMode(.template).resizable().scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
            Text("T")
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous).fill(ink.opacity(0.16)))
        }
        .foregroundStyle(ink)
        .padding(.horizontal, 7)
        .frame(height: CaptureLoupe.chipHeight)
        .background(Capsule(style: .continuous).fill(text ? EdgeModule.capture.accent : .black.opacity(0.6)))
        .overlay(Capsule(style: .continuous).strokeBorder(.white.opacity(text ? 0 : 0.3), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 6, y: 2)
    }
}

// MARK: - Result card

/// The card that rises from the bottom edge after a capture.
@MainActor final class CaptureCardPresenter {
    enum Content { case image(CaptureResult), color(PickedColor), text(TextGrab) }
    private var panel: NSPanel?
    private var keyMonitor: Any?

    func show(_ content: Content, on screen: NSScreen) {
        dismiss()
        let size: NSSize
        switch content {
        case .text(let grab):
            size = TextGrabCard.size(for: grab)
        case .image(let c):
            let w = CGFloat(c.image.width) / c.scale, h = CGFloat(c.image.height) / c.scale
            let fit = min(1, 220 / max(h, 1), 300 / max(w, 1))
            size = NSSize(width: max(560, w * fit + 340), height: 220 + 2 * EdgeLayout.gap + 52)
        case .color:
            size = NSSize(width: 420, height: 196)
        }
        let frame = NSRect(x: screen.frame.midX - size.width / 2, y: screen.frame.minY + 96, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: frame, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
        panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 1)
        panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false; panel.becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded = true
        panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        if case .text(let grab) = content {
            let host = NSHostingView(rootView: TextGrabCard(
                grab: grab,
                resize: { [weak self, weak panel] in if let panel { self?.fit(panel, to: TextGrabCard.size(for: grab)) } },
                close: { [weak self, weak panel] in if let panel { self?.dismiss(panel) } }))
            host.sizingOptions = []
            panel.contentView = host
        } else {
            let host = NSHostingView(rootView: CaptureCard(content: content, close: { [weak self] in self?.dismiss() }))
            host.sizingOptions = []
            panel.contentView = host
        }
        // Rises from below the edge.
        panel.alphaValue = 0
        panel.setFrame(frame.offsetBy(dx: 0, dy: -40), display: false)
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { ctx in
            ctx.duration = 0.28; ctx.timingFunction = CAMediaTimingFunction(controlPoints: 0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1)
            panel.animator().setFrame(frame, display: true); panel.animator().alphaValue = 1
        }
        self.panel = panel
        keyMonitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .keyDown) { [weak self] e in
            if e.keyCode == 53 { self?.dismiss(); return nil }
            return e
        }
    }

    /// Regrows a card in place, keeping its bottom edge and center.
    private func fit(_ panel: NSPanel, to size: NSSize) {
        guard panel === self.panel else { return }
        let f = panel.frame
        let target = NSRect(x: f.midX - size.width / 2, y: f.minY, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { ctx in
            ctx.duration = 0.18; ctx.timingFunction = CAMediaTimingFunction(controlPoints: 0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1)
            panel.animator().setFrame(target, display: true)
        }
    }

    /// Dismisses `panel` only if it's still the one showing (a later card stays).
    private func dismiss(_ panel: NSPanel) { if panel === self.panel { dismiss() } }

    func dismiss() {
        if let keyMonitor { NSEvent.removeMonitor(keyMonitor) }
        keyMonitor = nil
        guard let panel else { return }
        self.panel = nil
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup({ ctx in
            ctx.duration = 0.18
            panel.animator().setFrame(panel.frame.offsetBy(dx: 0, dy: -30), display: true); panel.animator().alphaValue = 0
        }, completionHandler: { panel.orderOut(nil) })
    }
}

private struct CaptureCard: View {
    let content: CaptureCardPresenter.Content
    let close: () -> Void
    @State private var flashed: String?

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.outerRadius, style: .continuous)
        VStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            switch content {
            case .image(let c): imageBody(c)
            case .color(let c): colorBody(c)
            case .text: EmptyView()   // TextGrabCard shows these
            }
        }
        .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background { Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape) }
        .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.24), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func imageBody(_ c: CaptureResult) -> some View {
        let inner = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius, style: .continuous)
        HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            Image(nsImage: c.nsImage).resizable().aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)
                .frame(maxWidth: 300, maxHeight: .infinity)
                .clipShape(inner)
                .overlay(inner.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 0.75))
                .onDrag {
                    ShelfEdge.shared.ownDragBegan()
                    let url = c.writePNG(to: FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory)
                    return url.map { NSItemProvider(contentsOf: $0) ?? NSItemProvider() } ?? NSItemProvider()
                }
                .help("Drag out")
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                    ForEach(c.codes, id: \.self) { code in CodeChip(code: code) }
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.top, c.codes.isEmpty ? 0 : 12)
                Group {
                    if c.reading { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading) }
                    else if c.text.isEmpty { Image(systemName: "text.page.slash").foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35)) }
                    else { Text(c.text).font(.system(size: 13)).textSelection(.enabled).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9)) }
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(12)
            }
            .background(.white.opacity(0.06), in: inner)
            .overlay(inner.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 0.75))
        }
        HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            action("photo.on.rectangle", "Copy image", id: "img") {
                NSPasteboard.general.clearContents(); NSPasteboard.general.writeObjects([c.nsImage])
            }
            action("text.quote", "Copy text", id: "txt", disabled: c.text.isEmpty) {
                NSPasteboard.general.clearContents(); NSPasteboard.general.setString(c.text, forType: .string)
            }
            action("pin", "Pin on screen", id: "pin") {
                CaptureController.shared.pin(c); close()
            }
            action("tray.and.arrow.down", "Send to shelf", id: "shelf") {
                ShelfStore.shared.add(capture: c)
            }
            action("arrow.down.to.line", "Save to " + EdgeSettings.captureDirectory.lastPathComponent, id: "save") {
                if let url = c.write(to: EdgeSettings.captureDirectory, format: EdgeSettings.captureFormat) {
                    NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([url])
                }
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            action("xmark", "Close", id: "close") { close() }
        }
        .frame(height: 36)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func colorBody(_ c: PickedColor) -> some View {
        let inner = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius, style: .continuous)
        HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            inner.fill(c.color).frame(width: 164)
                .overlay(inner.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.18), lineWidth: 0.75))
            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                ForEach([c.hex, c.rgb, c.hsl, c.swiftUI], id: \.self) { value in
                    Button {
                        NSPasteboard.general.clearContents(); NSPasteboard.general.setString(value, forType: .string)
                        flash(value)
                    } label: {
                        HStack {
                            Text(value).font(.system(size: 12, design: .monospaced)).lineLimit(1)
                            Spacer(minLength: 4)
                            Image(systemName: flashed == value ? "checkmark" : "doc.on.doc").font(.system(size: 11))
                                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(flashed == value ? 0.95 : 0.4))
                        }
                        .padding(.horizontal, 12).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                        .background(.white.opacity(0.06), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous))
                        .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    }.buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func action(_ symbol: String, _ help: String, id: String, disabled: Bool = false, _ run: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button { run(); flash(id) } label: {
            Image(systemName: flashed == id ? "checkmark" : symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .medium))
                .frame(width: 44, height: 36)
                .background(.white.opacity(0.08), in: Capsule())
                .contentShape(Capsule())
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: flashed == id)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain).disabled(disabled).opacity(disabled ? 0.35 : 1).help(help)
    }

    private func flash(_ id: String) {
        flashed = id
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.9) { if flashed == id { flashed = nil } }
    }
}

/// A text grab's confirmation: Capture's yellow tile and the text that went onto the
/// clipboard (first lines). Sized to its text; leaves on its own unless hovered.
/// Click dismisses, drag pulls the text out.
struct TextGrabCard: View {
    let grab: TextGrab
    let resize: () -> Void
    let close: () -> Void
    @State private var hovering = false
    @State private var wobble = 0

    static let font = NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13)
    static let maxLines = 4
    static let tile: CGFloat = 36
    static let lineHeight: CGFloat = 17
    static let textWidth: ClosedRange<CGFloat> = 120...520

    /// Shown lines (blank lines dropped) and how many more there are.
    static func preview(_ text: String) -> (lines: [String], more: Int) {
        let all = text.split(separator: "\n").map { $0.replacingOccurrences(of: "\t", with: "  ") }
        return (Array(all.prefix(maxLines)), max(0, all.count - maxLines))
    }

    static func size(for grab: TextGrab) -> NSSize {
        let gap = EdgeLayout.gap
        let empty = !grab.reading && grab.text.isEmpty
        var textW: CGFloat = 20, textH: CGFloat = tile
        if empty {
            textW = ceil(NSAttributedString(string: "No text", attributes: [.font: font]).size().width)
        } else if !grab.reading {
            let p = preview(grab.text)
            let widest = p.lines.map { NSAttributedString(string: $0, attributes: [.font: font]).size().width }.max() ?? 0
            textW = min(max(ceil(widest) + 2, textWidth.lowerBound), textWidth.upperBound)
            textH = max(tile, CGFloat(p.lines.count + (p.more > 0 ? 1 : 0)) * lineHeight)
        }
        return NSSize(width: gap + tile + gap + textW + 4 + gap, height: gap + textH + gap)
    }

    var body: some View {
        let gap = EdgeLayout.gap
        let size = Self.size(for: grab)
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: min(EdgeLayout.outerRadius, size.height / 2), style: .continuous)
        let empty = !grab.reading && grab.text.isEmpty
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: gap) {
            ZStack {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: min(EdgeLayout.outerRadius, size.height / 2) - gap, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(empty ? Color.white.opacity(0.08) : EdgeModule.capture.accent)
                Image("solar-text-square").renderingMode(.template).resizable().scaledToFit()
                    .frame(width: 22, height: 22)
                    .foregroundStyle(empty ? Color.white.opacity(0.35) : .black)
            }
            .frame(width: Self.tile, height: Self.tile)
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: GrabWobble(), trigger: wobble) { view, w in
                view.scaleEffect(w.scale).rotationEffect(.degrees(w.tilt))
            } keyframes: { _ in
                KeyframeTrack(\.scale) {
                    SpringKeyframe(0.86, duration: 0.07)
                    SpringKeyframe(1.06, duration: 0.12, spring: .snappy)
                    SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.16, spring: .bouncy)
                }
                KeyframeTrack(\.tilt) {
                    SpringKeyframe(-5, duration: 0.07)
                    SpringKeyframe(3, duration: 0.1)
                    SpringKeyframe(0, duration: 0.18, spring: .bouncy)
                }
            }
            Group {
                if grab.reading {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small).frame(width: 20, height: Self.tile)
                } else if empty {
                    Text("No text").font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.5))
                        .frame(height: Self.tile)
                } else {
                    let p = Self.preview(grab.text)
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                        ForEach(Array(p.lines.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, line in
                            Text(line).font(Font(Self.font)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.92))
                                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail).frame(height: Self.lineHeight)
                        }
                        if p.more > 0 {
                            Text("+\(p.more)").font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold)).foregroundStyle(EdgeModule.capture.accent)
                                .frame(height: Self.lineHeight)
                        }
                    }
                    .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .padding(gap)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background { Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape) }
        .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.24), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .contentShape(shape)
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .onTapGesture(perform: close)
        .onDrag { NSItemProvider(object: grab.text as NSString) }
        .onChange(of: grab.reading) { _, reading in
            guard !reading else { return }
            resize()
            if !grab.text.isEmpty { wobble += 1 }   // landed on the clipboard
        }
        .task(id: grab.reading) {
            guard !grab.reading else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(grab.text.isEmpty ? 1.6 : 2.4))
            while hovering, !Task.isCancelled { try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.3)) }
            if !Task.isCancelled { close() }
        }
    }
}

private struct GrabWobble {
    var scale: CGFloat = 1
    var tilt: Double = 0
}

/// A QR/barcode found in a capture: its payload, open if it's a link, copy.
private struct CodeChip: View {
    let code: String
    var body: some View {
        let url = URL(string: code).flatMap { $0.scheme == nil ? nil : $0 }
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: "qrcode").font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
            Text(code).font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium)).lineLimit(2).textSelection(.enabled)
            Spacer(minLength: 4)
            if let url {
                Button { NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) } label: { Image(systemName: "arrow.up.right").frame(width: 26, height: 22) }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain).help("Open")
            }
            Button {
                NSPasteboard.general.clearContents(); NSPasteboard.general.setString(code, forType: .string)
            } label: { Image(systemName: "doc.on.doc").frame(width: 26, height: 22) }
            .buttonStyle(.plain).help("Copy")
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10).padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.22), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous))
    }
}

/// A capture floating on screen: rounded, a hairline rim, ✕ on hover, double-click closes.
private struct PinnedCaptureView: View {
    let image: NSImage
    let close: () -> Void
    @State private var hover = false
    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
        Image(nsImage: image).resizable().aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.28), lineWidth: 0.75))
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                if hover {
                    Button(action: close) {
                        Image(systemName: "xmark").font(.system(size: 10, weight: .bold)).frame(width: 22, height: 22)
                            .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: Circle())
                    }.buttonStyle(.plain).padding(6).transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .onHover { h in withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.7)) { hover = h } }
            .onTapGesture(count: 2, perform: close)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}
//
//  DictationInserter.swift
//  The live side of dictation into other apps: Accessibility, keyboard events and the
//  general pasteboard behind the protocols in DictationInsertPolicy.swift, plus the app
//  you were last in (for when one of our own windows is in front at Caps+D).
//

import AppKit
import ApplicationServices

@MainActor final class DictationEverywhere {
    static let shared = DictationEverywhere()

    let engine = DictationInsertEngine(ax: LiveDictationAccessibility(), system: LiveDictationSystem(),
                                       clipboard: LiveDictationClipboard())
    private(set) var lastExternal: NSRunningApplication?
    private var activationObserver: Any?
    private let ownPID = NSRunningApplication.current.processIdentifier

    private init() {
        let front = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication
        if front?.processIdentifier != ownPID { lastExternal = front }
        activationObserver = NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.addObserver(
            forName: NSWorkspace.didActivateApplicationNotification, object: nil, queue: .main
        ) { note in
            let app = note.userInfo?[NSWorkspace.applicationUserInfoKey] as? NSRunningApplication
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let app, app.processIdentifier != DictationEverywhere.shared.ownPID else { return }
                DictationEverywhere.shared.lastExternal = app
            }
        }
    }

    /// Who gets the text when dictation starts. `ownFieldFocused`: one of our own text
    /// destinations (the browser page, the terminal) has the keyboard.
    func chooseTarget(ownFieldFocused: Bool) -> NSRunningApplication? {
        let front = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication
        let external = lastExternal.flatMap { $0.isTerminated ? nil : $0 }
        let chosen = DictationTargetChooser.choose(frontmost: front.map(Self.target), ownPID: ownPID,
                                                   ownFieldFocused: ownFieldFocused, lastExternal: external.map(Self.target))
        guard let chosen else { return nil }
        return chosen.pid == front?.processIdentifier ? front : external
    }

    /// Captures the focused window and field (kept until insertion) and reads the text
    /// around the cursor for the editing pass.
    func context(for app: NSRunningApplication?) -> VoiceFlowInsertionContext {
        var context = VoiceFlowInsertionContext(app: app)
        guard let app else { return context }
        context.tone = DictationTone.current(bundleID: app.bundleIdentifier)
        let capture = engine.capture(Self.target(app), electron: Self.isElectron(app))
        guard let element = capture.element else { return context }
        let ax = engine.ax
        let description = (ax as? LiveDictationAccessibility)?.label(of: element) ?? ""
        let selected = ax.selectedText(of: element) ?? ""
        guard capture.traits?.isSecure != true, let value = ax.value(of: element), !value.isEmpty else {
            context.fieldDescription = description
            if capture.traits?.isSecure != true { context.selectedText = selected }
            return context
        }
        let ns = value as NSString
        let range = ax.selectedRange(of: element) ?? NSRange(location: ns.length, length: 0)
        let location = max(0, min(range.location, ns.length))
        let length = max(0, min(range.length, ns.length - location))
        var merged = context.merging(VoiceFlowInsertionContext(
            fieldDescription: description,
            textBefore: ns.substring(to: location),
            selectedText: selected.isEmpty && length > 0 ? ns.substring(with: NSRange(location: location, length: length)) : selected,
            textAfter: ns.substring(from: location + length)))
        merged.tone = context.tone
        return merged
    }

    /// Puts the text into the captured field. Journals the method used.
    func insert(_ text: String, into app: NSRunningApplication?, restoreClipboard: Bool) async -> Bool {
        guard let app else { return false }
        let result = await engine.insert(text, into: Self.target(app), restoreClipboard: restoreClipboard)
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("voice.insert", params: [
            "bundle": app.bundleIdentifier ?? "", "method": result.method?.rawValue ?? "none",
            "failure": result.failure ?? "", "chars": text.count,
        ], source: "app")
        return result.inserted
    }

    func cancel(_ app: NSRunningApplication?) {
        if let app { engine.forget(app.processIdentifier) }
    }

    static func target(_ app: NSRunningApplication) -> DictationTarget {
        DictationTarget(pid: app.processIdentifier, bundleID: app.bundleIdentifier, appName: app.localizedName ?? "")
    }

    private static var electronCache: [String: Bool] = [:]
    static func isElectron(_ app: NSRunningApplication) -> Bool {
        guard let url = app.bundleURL else { return false }
        if let known = electronCache[url.path] { return known }
        let found = FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.appendingPathComponent("Contents/Frameworks/Electron Framework.framework").path)
        electronCache[url.path] = found
        return found
    }
}

// MARK: - Live system layers

@MainActor final class LiveDictationAccessibility: DictationAccessibility {
    var trusted: Bool { AXIsProcessTrusted() }

    private func ref(_ e: DictationElement) -> AXUIElement { e.ref as! AXUIElement }   // only ever wraps AXUIElements

    private func copy<T>(_ attribute: String, _ element: AXUIElement) -> T? {
        var value: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(element, attribute as CFString, &value) == .success else { return nil }
        return value as? T
    }
    private func settable(_ attribute: String, _ element: AXUIElement) -> Bool {
        var ok = DarwinBoolean(false)
        return AXUIElementIsAttributeSettable(element, attribute as CFString, &ok) == .success && ok.boolValue
    }

    func focusedElement(pid: pid_t) -> DictationElement? {
        let app = AXUIElementCreateApplication(pid)
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(app, 0.25)   // a hung app must not hang dictation
        guard let element: AXUIElement = copy(kAXFocusedUIElementAttribute, app) else { return nil }
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(element, 1)   // a write that times out may still land: keep it generous
        return DictationElement(element)
    }

    func focusedWindow(pid: pid_t) -> DictationElement? {
        let app = AXUIElementCreateApplication(pid)
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(app, 0.25)
        let window: AXUIElement? = copy(kAXFocusedWindowAttribute, app)
        return window.map(DictationElement.init)
    }

    func traits(of e: DictationElement) -> DictationFieldTraits {
        let el = ref(e)
        return DictationFieldTraits(
            role: copy(kAXRoleAttribute, el) ?? "",
            subrole: copy(kAXSubroleAttribute, el) ?? "",
            selectedTextSettable: settable(kAXSelectedTextAttribute, el),
            valueReadable: (copy(kAXValueAttribute, el) as String?) != nil,
            rangeReadable: selectedRange(of: e) != nil,
            valueSettable: settable(kAXValueAttribute, el))
    }

    func label(of e: DictationElement) -> String {
        let el = ref(e)
        return copy(kAXDescriptionAttribute, el) ?? copy(kAXTitleAttribute, el) ?? copy(kAXRoleDescriptionAttribute, el) ?? ""
    }

    func value(of e: DictationElement) -> String? { copy(kAXValueAttribute, ref(e)) }
    func selectedText(of e: DictationElement) -> String? { copy(kAXSelectedTextAttribute, ref(e)) }

    func selectedRange(of e: DictationElement) -> NSRange? {
        guard let raw: AnyObject = copy(kAXSelectedTextRangeAttribute, ref(e)),
              CFGetTypeID(raw) == AXValueGetTypeID() else { return nil }
        var range = CFRange(location: 0, length: 0)
        guard AXValueGetValue(raw as! AXValue, .cfRange, &range) else { return nil }
        return NSRange(location: range.location, length: range.length)
    }

    func setSelectedText(_ text: String, on e: DictationElement) -> Bool {
        AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(ref(e), kAXSelectedTextAttribute as CFString, text as CFString) == .success
    }

    func setValue(_ text: String, on e: DictationElement) -> Bool {
        AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(ref(e), kAXValueAttribute as CFString, text as CFString) == .success
    }

    func setSelectedRange(_ range: NSRange, on e: DictationElement) {
        var cf = CFRange(location: range.location, length: range.length)
        guard let value = AXValueCreate(.cfRange, &cf) else { return }
        AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(ref(e), kAXSelectedTextRangeAttribute as CFString, value)
    }

    func focus(_ e: DictationElement) {
        AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(ref(e), kAXFocusedAttribute as CFString, kCFBooleanTrue)
    }

    func raise(_ window: DictationElement) {
        AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(ref(window), kAXMainAttribute as CFString, kCFBooleanTrue)
        AXUIElementPerformAction(ref(window), kAXRaiseAction as CFString)
    }

    func same(_ a: DictationElement, _ b: DictationElement) -> Bool { CFEqual(ref(a), ref(b)) }
}

@MainActor final class LiveDictationSystem: DictationSystem {
    var frontmostPID: pid_t? { NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication?.processIdentifier }

    func activate(pid: pid_t) {
        guard let app = NSRunningApplication(processIdentifier: pid) else { return }
        // macOS 14+ activation is cooperative: if we're the active app, hand it over.
        if NSApp.isActive { NSApp.yieldActivation(to: app) }
        app.activate()
    }

    func resignOwnKeyWindows() {
        for w in NSApp.windows where w.isKeyWindow { w.resignKey() }
    }

    func postPaste() {
        let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
        let keyV: CGKeyCode = 9
        let down = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: keyV, keyDown: true)
        down?.flags = .maskCommand
        let up = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: keyV, keyDown: false)
        up?.flags = .maskCommand
        down?.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
        up?.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
    }

    /// The text as unicode key events, 20 UTF-16 units per event (the event's limit), no
    /// modifiers (Caps may still be held from the chord).
    func type(_ text: String) {
        let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
        for chunk in DictationKeys.chunks(text) {
            for keyDown in [true, false] {
                guard let event = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: 0, keyDown: keyDown) else { continue }
                event.flags = []
                chunk.withUnsafeBufferPointer { event.keyboardSetUnicodeString(stringLength: $0.count, unicodeString: $0.baseAddress) }
                event.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
            }
            usleep(1500)   // some apps drop events that arrive in one burst
        }
    }

    func sleep(_ seconds: TimeInterval) async {
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(Int(seconds * 1000)))
    }
}

@MainActor final class LiveDictationClipboard: DictationClipboard {
    private var pb: NSPasteboard { .general }
    var changeCount: Int { pb.changeCount }
    var holdsConcealed: Bool { pb.types?.contains(NSPasteboard.PasteboardType(DictationPasteboardMarkers.concealed)) == true }
    func snapshot() -> PasteboardSnapshot { PasteboardSnapshot.capture(pb) }
    func writeTransient(_ text: String, marked: Bool) -> Int { DictationPasteboardMarkers.writeTransient(text, to: pb, marked: marked) }
    func restore(_ snapshot: PasteboardSnapshot) -> Int { snapshot.restore(to: pb) }
}
//
//  UnifiedTiling.swift
//  One layout per display for every window: Nardo's own (terminal, browser, canvas, cards
//  you tiled) share the auto-tiler's order with other apps' windows. ForeignWindowManager
//  plans every slot; this is the main-thread side that tells it which of our windows tile
//  and moves them through their placements (the springs they always had, never AX).
//
//  While auto-tiling can't run (no Accessibility yet, or no display has it on) AutoTiler
//  keeps tiling our windows on their own, as before; it takes them back when this stops.
//  A tiled window stays put when Caps hides the layer, like any app's window.
//

import AppKit

@MainActor final class UnifiedTiling {
    static let shared = UnifiedTiling()
    private static let chosenKey = "edge.unified.chosen"

    /// Is the shared layout running (auto-tiling on, Accessibility granted)?
    var active: Bool { AutoTileController.shared.running }
    /// Our windows the shared layout tiles right now (reported after each reflow).
    private(set) var tiledKeys: Set<String> = []
    /// Cards (tools, keyboard) float by default; these you tiled on purpose.
    private var chosen: Set<String>
    private var pushed: [CGWindowID: ForeignWindowManager.OwnWindow] = [:]
    /// The own window under your hand: frozen out of updates until it's let go.
    private var dragging: String?

    private init() {
        chosen = Set(UserDefaults.standard.stringArray(forKey: Self.chosenKey) ?? [])
    }

    func holds(_ key: String?) -> Bool { key.map { active && tiledKeys.contains($0) } ?? false }

    // MARK: Feeding the tiler

    /// Which of our windows tile, and where they are: sent whenever a window opens, closes,
    /// moves on its own or changes what it is. Cheap when nothing changed (no send).
    func refresh() {
        guard active else { return }
        guard dragging == nil else { return }
        let coordinator = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        var out: [CGWindowID: ForeignWindowManager.OwnWindow] = [:]
        for peer in coordinator.allPeers where peer.visible && tiles(peer.id) {
            if let (id, window) = entry(peer) { out[id] = window }
        }
        guard out != pushed else { return }
        pushed = out
