        // Tall enough for the strip to expand upward on hover; only the strip has pixels.
        let size = NSSize(width: EdgeLayout.resultWidth, height: 240)
        let panel = KeyableVoicePanel(
            contentRect: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
            styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel],
            backing: .buffered,
            defer: false
        )
        panel.level = .statusBar
        panel.isOpaque = false
        panel.backgroundColor = .clear
        panel.hasShadow = false
        panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        panel.worksWhenModal = true
        panel.acceptsMouseMovedEvents = true
        panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .stationary, .ignoresCycle]

        let root = DictationSheet(model: model)
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: root)
        host.frame = NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size)
        host.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
        panel.contentView = host
        self.panel = panel
        installPanelKeyMonitor(for: panel)
        position(panel)
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()   // shown, not key: a key panel caught the ⌘V paste meant for your app (beep)
    }

    private func hidePanel() {
        if let keyMonitor {
            NSEvent.removeMonitor(keyMonitor)
            self.keyMonitor = nil
        }
        panel?.orderOut(nil)
        panel = nil
    }

    private func installPanelKeyMonitor(for panel: NSPanel) {
        if let keyMonitor {
            NSEvent.removeMonitor(keyMonitor)
        }
        keyMonitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: [.keyDown]) { [weak self, weak panel] event in
            guard let self, let panel, event.window === panel else { return event }
            switch Int(event.keyCode) {
            case 53:
                self.model.cancel()
                return nil
            case 36, 76:
                self.model.stopAndTranscribe()
                return nil
            default:
                return event
            }
        }
    }

    private func position(_ panel: NSPanel) {
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        let screenFrame = NSScreen.screens.first { $0.frame.contains(mouse) }?.visibleFrame
            ?? NSScreen.main?.visibleFrame
            ?? NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1440, height: 900)
        // Rising from the bottom edge like the card sheets (its bottom runs off-screen).
        let size = panel.frame.size
        let full = NSScreen.screens.first { $0.visibleFrame == screenFrame }?.frame ?? screenFrame
        let x = full.midX - size.width / 2
        let y = full.minY - EdgeLayout.bottomCrop
        panel.setFrameOrigin(NSPoint(x: x, y: y))
    }

    private func registerGlobalHotKey() {
        unregisterGlobalHotKey()
        let chord = Self.fixedHotKey

        var spec = EventTypeSpec(
            eventClass: OSType(kEventClassKeyboard),
            eventKind: OSType(kEventHotKeyPressed)
        )
        let selfPtr = Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque()
        InstallEventHandler(
            GetEventDispatcherTarget(),
            { _, event, userData -> OSStatus in
                guard let userData, let event else { return OSStatus(eventNotHandledErr) }
                var hotKeyID = EventHotKeyID()
                let status = GetEventParameter(
                    event,
                    EventParamName(kEventParamDirectObject),
                    EventParamType(typeEventHotKeyID),
                    nil,
                    MemoryLayout<EventHotKeyID>.size,
                    nil,
                    &hotKeyID
                )
                guard status == noErr,
                      hotKeyID.signature == 0x4F504643,
                      hotKeyID.id == 2 else {
                    return OSStatus(eventNotHandledErr)
                }
                let controller = Unmanaged<VoiceFlowController>.fromOpaque(userData).takeUnretainedValue()
                Task { @MainActor in controller.model.toggle() }
                return noErr
            },
            1, &spec, selfPtr, &hotKeyHandler
        )

        let hotKeyID = EventHotKeyID(signature: OSType(0x4F504643), id: 2) // OPFC
        RegisterEventHotKey(
            UInt32(chord.keyCode),
            carbonModifiers(from: chord.flags),
            hotKeyID,
            GetEventDispatcherTarget(),
            0,
            &hotKeyRef
        )
    }

    private func unregisterGlobalHotKey() {
        if let hotKeyRef { UnregisterEventHotKey(hotKeyRef) }
        hotKeyRef = nil
        if let hotKeyHandler { RemoveEventHandler(hotKeyHandler) }
        hotKeyHandler = nil
    }

    private func carbonModifiers(from flags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags) -> UInt32 {
        var modifiers: UInt32 = 0
        if flags.contains(.command) { modifiers |= UInt32(cmdKey) }
        if flags.contains(.option) { modifiers |= UInt32(optionKey) }
        if flags.contains(.control) { modifiers |= UInt32(controlKey) }
        if flags.contains(.shift) { modifiers |= UInt32(shiftKey) }
        return modifiers
    }
}

struct VoiceFlowFloatingOverlay: View {
    let model: VoiceFlowModel

    private let glassBorderWidth: CGFloat = 7
    @State private var isHovering = false
    @State private var editorFocused = false
    @State private var appeared = false

    private var contentCornerRadius: CGFloat {
        isExpanded ? 22 : contentSize.height / 2
    }

    private var glassCornerRadius: CGFloat {
        isExpanded ? contentCornerRadius + glassBorderWidth : surfaceSize.height / 2
    }

    private var isExpanded: Bool {
        isHovering || editorFocused
    }

    var body: some View {
        Color.clear
            .frame(width: 900, height: 520)
            .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                surface
                    .frame(width: surfaceSize.width, height: surfaceSize.height)
                    .scaleEffect(appeared ? 1 : 0.82, anchor: .bottom)
                    .opacity(appeared ? 1 : 0)
                    .animation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.72, stiffness: 520, damping: 29), value: appeared)
                    .animation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.82, stiffness: 430, damping: 32), value: surfaceSize)
                    .animation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.82, stiffness: 430, damping: 32), value: isExpanded)
                    .padding(.bottom, 16)
            }
            .onAppear {
                appeared = false
                DispatchQueue.main.async {
                    withAnimation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.72, stiffness: 520, damping: 29)) {
                        appeared = true
                    }
                }
            }
    }

    private var surface: some View {
        ZStack {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: glassCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .fill(Color.white.opacity(0.001))
                .glassEffect(.regular, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: glassCornerRadius, style: .continuous))

            surfaceContent
                .frame(width: contentSize.width, height: contentSize.height)
        }
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: glassCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.38), lineWidth: 1)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: contentCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.16), lineWidth: 0.75)
                .frame(width: contentSize.width, height: contentSize.height)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
        .onHover { hovering in
            withAnimation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.82, stiffness: 430, damping: 32)) {
                isHovering = hovering
            }
        }
    }

    private var surfaceContent: some View {
        Group {
            // Do not keep the transcript editor alive behind a transparent
            // compact pill. Long live transcripts otherwise force AppKit text
            // layout and SwiftUI word-count work even when none of it is shown.
            if isExpanded {
                expandedContent
                    .transition(.opacity)
            } else {
                compactContent
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: contentSize.width, height: contentSize.height)
        .clipped()
        .background(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: contentCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .fill(Color.black.opacity(0.94))
        )
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: contentCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.10), lineWidth: 0.75)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: contentCornerRadius, style: .continuous))
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.14), value: isExpanded)
    }

    private var compactContent: some View {
        VoiceWaveformView(level: model.level, active: waveformIsActive, barCount: 48)
            .padding(.horizontal, 18)
            .padding(.vertical, 9)
            .accessibilityLabel(model.phase.title)
            .accessibilityValue(model.subtitle)
    }

    private var expandedContent: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                VoiceWaveformView(level: model.level, active: waveformIsActive, barCount: 11)
                    .frame(width: 76, height: 30)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(model.phase.title)
                        .font(.pp(13.5, .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.94))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                    Text(expandedDetail)
                        .font(.pp(11.5, .medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.52))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        .truncationMode(.tail)
                }

                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }

            TranscriptEditorView(
                text: Binding(
                    get: { model.transcriptDraft },
                    set: { model.userEditedTranscript($0) }
                ),
                isEditable: editorIsEditable,
                onFocusChange: { focused in
                    withAnimation(.interpolatingSpring(mass: 0.82, stiffness: 430, damping: 32)) {
                        editorFocused = focused
                    }
                }
            )
            .frame(height: editorHeight)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.top, 14)
        .padding(.bottom, 16)
    }

    private var editorIsEditable: Bool {
        switch model.phase {
        case .requestingPermission, .preparing, .failed:
            false
        default:
            true
        }
    }

    private var transcriptLength: Int {
        model.transcriptDraft.count
    }

    private var waveformIsActive: Bool {
        if case .recording = model.phase { return true }
        return false
    }

    private var expandedDetail: String {
        let detail = model.subtitle
        return detail.isEmpty ? "Ready" : detail
    }

    private var surfaceSize: CGSize {
        CGSize(
            width: contentSize.width + glassBorderWidth * 2,
            height: contentSize.height + glassBorderWidth * 2
        )
    }

    private var contentSize: CGSize {
        guard isExpanded else {
            return CGSize(width: 390, height: 68)
        }
        let editorSize = editorContentSize
        return CGSize(width: editorSize.width, height: editorSize.height + 70)
    }

    private var editorContentSize: CGSize {
        let length = transcriptLength
        let width: CGFloat
        if length < 80 {
            width = 430 + CGFloat(length) * 2.2
        } else {
            width = 700 + min(CGFloat(length - 80) * 0.35, 130)
        }
        let clampedWidth = min(max(width, 430), 830)
        let charsPerLine = max(34, Int((clampedWidth - 54) / 8.2))
        let explicitLines = max(1, model.transcriptDraft.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).count)
        let wrappedLines = max(1, Int(ceil(Double(max(length, 1)) / Double(charsPerLine))))
        let lineCount = max(explicitLines, wrappedLines)
        let textHeight = min(max(CGFloat(lineCount) * 23 + 18, 54), 330)
        return CGSize(width: clampedWidth, height: textHeight)
    }

    private var editorHeight: CGFloat {
        editorContentSize.height
    }
}

private final class FocusReportingTextView: NSTextView {
    var onFocusChange: ((Bool) -> Void)?

    override func becomeFirstResponder() -> Bool {
        let accepted = super.becomeFirstResponder()
        if accepted {
            onFocusChange?(true)
        }
        return accepted
    }

    override func resignFirstResponder() -> Bool {
        let accepted = super.resignFirstResponder()
        if accepted {
            onFocusChange?(false)
        }
        return accepted
    }
}

private struct TranscriptEditorView: NSViewRepresentable {
    @Binding var text: String
    var isEditable: Bool
    var onFocusChange: (Bool) -> Void = { _ in }

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator {
        Coordinator(text: $text, onFocusChange: onFocusChange)
    }

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> NSScrollView {
        let scroll = NSScrollView()
        scroll.drawsBackground = false
        scroll.hasVerticalScroller = true
        scroll.autohidesScrollers = true
        scroll.borderType = .noBorder
        scroll.scrollerStyle = .overlay

        let textView = FocusReportingTextView()
        textView.drawsBackground = false
        textView.isRichText = false
        textView.importsGraphics = false
        textView.allowsUndo = true
        textView.isEditable = isEditable
        textView.isSelectable = true
        textView.textContainerInset = NSSize(width: 3, height: 4)
        textView.font = NSFont.monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 18, weight: .regular)
        textView.textColor = NSColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.92)
        textView.insertionPointColor = NSColor.white
        textView.selectedTextAttributes = [
            .backgroundColor: NSColor.controlAccentColor.withAlphaComponent(0.42)
        ]
        textView.delegate = context.coordinator
        textView.textContainer?.widthTracksTextView = true
        textView.textContainer?.lineFragmentPadding = 0
        textView.minSize = .zero
        textView.maxSize = NSSize(width: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude, height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        textView.isVerticallyResizable = true
        textView.isHorizontallyResizable = false
        textView.autoresizingMask = [.width]
        textView.onFocusChange = { [weak coordinator = context.coordinator] focused in
            coordinator?.onFocusChange(focused)
        }

        scroll.documentView = textView
        context.coordinator.textView = textView
        context.coordinator.scrollView = scroll
        context.coordinator.observeScroll()
        return scroll
    }

    func updateNSView(_ scroll: NSScrollView, context: Context) {
        guard let textView = context.coordinator.textView else { return }
        context.coordinator.parentText = $text
        context.coordinator.onFocusChange = onFocusChange
        if let textView = textView as? FocusReportingTextView {
            textView.onFocusChange = { [weak coordinator = context.coordinator] focused in
                coordinator?.onFocusChange(focused)
            }
        }
        textView.isEditable = isEditable
        if textView.string != text {
            let selected = textView.selectedRange()
            context.coordinator.isApplyingProgrammaticText = true
            textView.string = text
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                context.coordinator.isApplyingProgrammaticText = false
            }
            let location = min(selected.location, (text as NSString).length)
            let length = min(selected.length, max(0, (text as NSString).length - location))
            textView.setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: location, length: length))
            if context.coordinator.shouldAutoScroll {
                DispatchQueue.main.async {
                    textView.scrollToEndOfDocument(nil)
                    context.coordinator.shouldAutoScroll = true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    final class Coordinator: NSObject, NSTextViewDelegate {
        var parentText: Binding<String>
        var onFocusChange: (Bool) -> Void
        weak var textView: NSTextView?
        weak var scrollView: NSScrollView?
        var shouldAutoScroll = true
        var isApplyingProgrammaticText = false
        private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?

        init(text: Binding<String>, onFocusChange: @escaping (Bool) -> Void) {
            self.parentText = text
            self.onFocusChange = onFocusChange
        }

        deinit {
            if let observer {
                NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(observer)
            }
        }

        func textDidChange(_ notification: Notification) {
            guard let textView else { return }
            guard !isApplyingProgrammaticText else { return }
            parentText.wrappedValue = textView.string
            if shouldAutoScroll {
                DispatchQueue.main.async { textView.scrollToEndOfDocument(nil) }
            }
        }

        func observeScroll() {
            guard let scrollView else { return }
            scrollView.contentView.postsBoundsChangedNotifications = true
            observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
                forName: NSView.boundsDidChangeNotification,
                object: scrollView.contentView,
                queue: .main
            ) { [weak self] _ in
                self?.updateAutoScrollState()
            }
        }

        private func updateAutoScrollState() {
            guard let scrollView, let document = scrollView.documentView else { return }
            let visible = scrollView.contentView.bounds
            let bottomGap = document.bounds.maxY - visible.maxY
            shouldAutoScroll = bottomGap < 24
        }
    }
}

/// Older entry points (the standalone app entry) for dictation into other apps; the work
/// is DictationEverywhere's (DictationInserter.swift).
enum SystemTextInserter {
    @MainActor
    static func context(for targetApp: NSRunningApplication?) -> VoiceFlowInsertionContext {
        DictationEverywhere.shared.context(for: targetApp)
    }

    @MainActor
    static func insert(_ text: String, targetApp: NSRunningApplication?, restoreClipboard: Bool) async -> Bool {
        guard AXIsProcessTrusted() else {
            let options = [kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt.takeUnretainedValue() as String: true] as CFDictionary
            AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions(options)
            return false
        }
        return await DictationEverywhere.shared.insert(text, into: targetApp, restoreClipboard: restoreClipboard)
    }
}
//
//  ToolWindows.swift
//  Spotlight cards that pop out into their own edge-layer workspaces ("tools").
//
//  A tool is a workspace like Browser and Surface: same borderless glass shell and
//  WorkspaceChrome, same WorkspacePlacement (dock / float / tile / link / resize),
//  and it hides and returns with the Caps layer. It has no search field of its own:
//  the Spotlight bar, scoped by a chip, types into it — filtering live, arrows move
//  its selection, Return acts on it.
//
//  First tool: Clipboard, shown as the same horizontal shelf of square cards as its
//  Spotlight card.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

enum ToolKind: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case clipboard, apps, files, tabs, calculator, color, web, games, downloads, answer, calendar, media, mail, windows

    var id: String { rawValue }
    var title: String { rawValue.capitalized }
    var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .clipboard: "doc.on.clipboard"
        case .apps: "square.grid.2x2"
        case .files: "folder"
        case .tabs: "rectangle.stack"
        case .calculator: "plus.forwardslash.minus"
        case .color: "paintpalette"
        case .web: "globe"
        case .games: "gamecontroller"
        case .downloads: "arrow.down.circle"
        case .answer: "text.bubble"
        case .calendar: "calendar"
        case .media: "play.circle"
        case .mail: "envelope"
        case .windows: "macwindow.on.rectangle"
        }
    }
    var accentHex: String {
        switch self {
        case .clipboard: "#f2a33a"
        case .apps: "#5ac8fa"
        case .files: "#64d2a0"
        case .tabs: "#8e8cff"
        case .calculator: "#ff9f0a"
        case .color: "#ff6fae"
        case .web: "#4aa3ff"
        case .games: "#b07cff"
        case .downloads: "#30d158"
        case .answer: "#e5e5ea"
        case .calendar: "#ff453a"
        case .media: "#ff375f"
        case .mail: "#0a84ff"
        case .windows: "#64d2ff"   // Tiling's color: the switcher is part of that module
        }
    }
    var accent: Color { Color(hexString: accentHex) ?? BentoPalette.accent }
}

/// What the bar is feeding a tool: its filter text and selection.
@MainActor @Observable final class ToolQuery {
    var text = ""
    var selection = 0
    var columns = 1   // cards per row as laid out (1 row = horizontal shelf)
    var flashItemID: Int64?   // brief "copied" confirmation
    var count = 0             // items in a card window (set by the card as it draws)
    var activations = 0       // Return in the bar, for a card window to act on
    var size: CGSize?         // the card's footprint when it was torn off
}

/// One tool's edge workspace: panel, placement and layer state (mirrors BrowserWindow).
@MainActor final class ToolWorkspace {
    let kind: ToolKind
    let placement = WorkspacePlacement()
    private(set) var window: EdgeBrowserPanel?
    private(set) var presented = false
    private var restoreAfterToggle = false
    private var generation = 0
    private var makeContent: () -> AnyView

    init(kind: ToolKind, content: @escaping () -> AnyView) {
        self.kind = kind; self.makeContent = content
    }

    /// Exactly the Spotlight sheet's footprint for this card, just above the bar.
    static let size = NSSize(width: EdgeLayout.resultWidth, height: 180 + 2 * EdgeLayout.gap)
    var size: NSSize {
        guard let s = ToolWindowManager.shared.query(kind).size else { return Self.size }
        return NSSize(width: EdgeLayout.resultWidth, height: max(84, s.height + 2 * EdgeLayout.gap))
    }
    private func defaultFrame(_ screen: NSScreen) -> NSRect {
        NSRect(x: screen.frame.midX - size.width / 2, y: screen.frame.minY + 128,
               width: size.width, height: size.height)
    }


    /// Tear-off: appear right under the cursor (no slide), grabbed near its top edge.
    func showUnder(_ point: NSPoint) {
        guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        ensureWindow(screen)
        guard let window else { return }
        generation += 1; presented = true
        let size = self.size
        let frame = NSRect(x: point.x - size.width / 2, y: point.y - size.height + 24, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        window.setFrame(frame, display: true)
        placement.present(frame, animated: false)
        window.orderFrontRegardless()
    }

    func show(focus: Bool = false) {
        guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        ensureWindow(screen)
        guard let window else { return }
        generation += 1; presented = true
        placement.present(placement.presentationFrame(fallback: defaultFrame(screen)))
        if focus { window.orderFrontRegardless(); window.makeKey() } else { window.orderFront(nil) }
    }

    private func ensureWindow(_ screen: NSScreen) {
        if window == nil {
            let panel = EdgeBrowserPanel(contentRect: .zero, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded = false
            panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false; panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear
            panel.title = "Nardo · " + kind.title; panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
            panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 1); panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false; panel.hasShadow = false
            panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
            let host = WorkspaceHostingView(rootView: makeContent()); host.sizingOptions = []
            let viewport = EdgeBrowserViewport(); viewport.host = host; viewport.addSubview(host)
            viewport.fullHeight = screen.frame.height - 60
            panel.contentView = viewport
            window = panel
            placement.window = panel
            // Always floating; never a bottom sheet.
            placement.alwaysFloating = true
            placement.configurePersistence("tool." + kind.rawValue)
            placement.onCollapse = { [weak self] in self?.hide() }
            // Always the card's shape: fully rounded, 32pt, whatever the dock state.
            func round() { viewport.layer?.cornerRadius = 32; viewport.layer?.cornerCurve = .continuous; viewport.layer?.maskedCorners = [.layerMinXMinYCorner, .layerMaxXMinYCorner, .layerMinXMaxYCorner, .layerMaxXMaxYCorner] }
            placement.onGeometry = { _ in round() }
            round()
        }
    }

    func hide() {
        restoreAfterToggle = false
        presented = false
        slideOut()
    }
    func hideForLayer() {
        // Tiled with every other window: it keeps its tile when the layer goes, like an app's.
        guard !UnifiedTiling.shared.holds(placement.layoutKey) else { return }
        restoreAfterToggle = presented; presented = false; slideOut()
    }
    func restoreForLayer() { if restoreAfterToggle { restoreAfterToggle = false; show() } }

    private func slideOut() {
        guard let window else { return }
        if window.isKeyWindow { window.resignKey() }
        generation += 1; let token = generation
        placement.collapse { [weak self, weak window] in
            guard let self, self.generation == token else { return }
            // Park, don't orderOut: an ordered-out window loses its drawn contents, so the next
            // show slid up an empty window that only appeared once redrawn (looked like a snap).
            window?.alphaValue = 0; window?.ignoresMouseEvents = true
        }
    }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class ToolWindowManager {
    static let shared = ToolWindowManager()

    /// The tool the Spotlight bar is scoped to, if any. A scope can exist without a
    /// popped-out tool (Caps+C first): Spotlight then shows only that card.
    private(set) var scoped: ToolKind?
    private(set) var queries: [ToolKind: ToolQuery] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var workspaces: [ToolKind: ToolWorkspace] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private weak var clipboard: ClipboardStore?
    /// The torn strand's nub on the new window's bottom edge, springing home (1 → 0).
    let tearNub = GooSpring(0)
    private(set) var tearNubKind: ToolKind?
    private(set) var tearNubX: CGFloat = EdgeLayout.resultWidth / 2
    @ObservationIgnored private let nubWindow = ToolNubWindow()

    func query(_ kind: ToolKind) -> ToolQuery {
        if let q = queries[kind] { return q }
        let q = ToolQuery(); queries[kind] = q; return q
    }

    func hasWindow(_ kind: ToolKind) -> Bool { workspaces[kind]?.presented == true }

    /// Draws a card window's content: the Spotlight card itself, live on the tool's query
    /// (set by the controller; the card renderer lives with Spotlight).
    @ObservationIgnored var cardContent: ((ToolKind, ToolQuery) -> AnyView)?

    /// Brings a tool window back as it was (workspaces): same query, same place.
    func reopen(_ kind: ToolKind, clipboard: ClipboardStore) {
        self.clipboard = clipboard
        let workspace = workspaces[kind] ?? makeWorkspace(kind, clipboard: clipboard)
        workspace.show()
    }

    func setScope(_ kind: ToolKind?) {
        guard scoped != kind else { return }
        scoped = kind
        if let kind { InteractionJournal.shared.action("tools.scope", params: ["tool": kind.rawValue]) }
    }

    /// Pops the tool out as an edge workspace (or brings it back) and scopes the bar to it.
    func popOut(_ kind: ToolKind, clipboard: ClipboardStore, seed: String, size: CGSize? = nil) {
        self.clipboard = clipboard
        let q = query(kind)
        q.text = seed; q.selection = 0
        if let size, workspaces[kind] == nil { q.size = size }
        let workspace = workspaces[kind] ?? makeWorkspace(kind, clipboard: clipboard)
        if !workspace.presented { InteractionJournal.shared.action("tools.pop_out", params: ["tool": kind.rawValue]) }
        workspace.show()
        setScope(kind)
    }

    /// Tear a card out of the Spotlight sheet: its workspace appears under the cursor
    /// and the caller keeps dragging it through the returned placement.
    func tearOff(_ kind: ToolKind, clipboard: ClipboardStore, seed: String, at point: NSPoint, nubX: CGFloat, size: CGSize? = nil) -> WorkspacePlacement {
        self.clipboard = clipboard
        let q = query(kind)
        q.text = seed; q.selection = 0
        if let size, workspaces[kind] == nil { q.size = size }
        let workspace = workspaces[kind] ?? makeWorkspace(kind, clipboard: clipboard)
        workspace.showUnder(point)
        setScope(kind)
        // The window's half of the parted strand hangs from its bottom edge (drawn by a
        // small attached panel, since a window can't draw outside itself) and springs home.
        if let window = workspace.window {
            tearNubKind = kind; tearNubX = nubX
            tearNub.set(1)
            nubWindow.show(below: window, x: nubX, kind: kind, manager: self)
            tearNub.onSettled = { [weak self] in self?.nubWindow.close(); self?.tearNubKind = nil }
            tearNub.go(0, response: 0.34, damping: 0.45)
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("tools.pop_out", params: ["tool": kind.rawValue, "gesture": "tear"])
        return workspace.placement
    }

    func hide(_ kind: ToolKind) {
        workspaces[kind]?.hide()
        if scoped == kind { setScope(nil) }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("tools.close", params: ["tool": kind.rawValue])
    }

    /// The Caps layer hides every workspace together and brings back the ones that were up.
    func hideForLayer() { workspaces.values.forEach { $0.hideForLayer() } }
    func restoreForLayer() { workspaces.values.forEach { $0.restoreForLayer() } }

    private func makeWorkspace(_ kind: ToolKind, clipboard: ClipboardStore) -> ToolWorkspace {
        let q = query(kind)
        var placementRef: WorkspacePlacement?
        let workspace = ToolWorkspace(kind: kind) { [unowned self] in
            AnyView(ToolShell(kind: kind, placement: placementRef!, manager: self) {
                if kind == .clipboard {
                    ClipboardShelf(store: clipboard, query: q, manager: self)
                } else {
                    self.cardContent?(kind, q) ?? AnyView(Color.clear)
                }
            })
        }
        placementRef = workspace.placement
        workspaces[kind] = workspace
        return workspace
    }

    // MARK: Bar → tool

    func clipboardItems() -> [ClipboardStore.Item] {
        let q = query(.clipboard).text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        return clipboard?.search(query: q.isEmpty ? nil : q, limit: 200) ?? []
    }

    func moveSelection(_ delta: Int) {
        guard let kind = scoped else { return }
        let q = query(kind)
        let count = kind == .clipboard ? clipboardItems().count : q.count
        guard count > 0 else { return }
        q.selection = min(max(0, q.selection + delta), count - 1)
    }

    /// Return in the bar: copy the selected clipboard item back to the pasteboard.
    func activateSelection() {
        if let kind = scoped, kind != .clipboard { query(kind).activations += 1; return }
        guard scoped == .clipboard, let store = clipboard else { return }
        let q = query(.clipboard)
        let items = clipboardItems()
        guard items.indices.contains(q.selection) else { return }
        let item = items[q.selection]
        store.putOnPasteboard(item)
        q.flashItemID = item.id
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.9) { if q.flashItemID == item.id { q.flashItemID = nil } }
    }
}

// MARK: - Views

/// The torn nub below a tool window: a small click-through panel attached under the
/// window's bottom edge. It draws the same outline as the window (window + nub), shifted
/// so only the part below the edge shows — the two halves meet without a seam.
@MainActor final class ToolNubWindow {
    private var panel: NSPanel?
    private static let width: CGFloat = 112

    func show(below window: NSWindow, x: CGFloat, kind: ToolKind, manager: ToolWindowManager) {
        close()
        let w = Self.width, h = GooTear.nubLength + 14
        let frame = NSRect(x: window.frame.minX + GooTear.clampGrab(x, width: window.frame.width) - w / 2,
                           y: window.frame.minY - h, width: w, height: h)
        let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: frame, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
        panel.ignoresMouseEvents = true; panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        panel.level = window.level; panel.collectionBehavior = window.collectionBehavior
        panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: ToolNubView(manager: manager, kind: kind, windowSize: window.frame.size,
                                                       originX: GooTear.clampGrab(x, width: window.frame.width) - w / 2,
                                                       size: CGSize(width: w, height: h)))
        host.sizingOptions = []
        panel.contentView = host
        window.addChildWindow(panel, ordered: .above)
        panel.orderFront(nil)
        self.panel = panel
    }

    func close() {
        guard let panel else { return }
        panel.parent?.removeChildWindow(panel)
        panel.orderOut(nil)
        self.panel = nil
    }
}

private struct ToolNubView: View {
    let manager: ToolWindowManager
    let kind: ToolKind
    let windowSize: CGSize
    let originX: CGFloat
    let size: CGSize

    var body: some View {
        let scopedHere = manager.scoped == kind
        let shape = GooEdgeNubShape(nub: manager.tearNub.value, x: manager.tearNubX)
        ZStack {
            Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape)
            shape.strokeBorder(scopedHere ? kind.accent.opacity(0.8) : .white.opacity(0.24), lineWidth: scopedHere ? 1.25 : 0.75)
        }
        .frame(width: windowSize.width, height: windowSize.height)
        // The window's bottom edge sits on this panel's top edge.
        .offset(x: -originX, y: -windowSize.height)
        .frame(width: size.width, height: size.height, alignment: .topLeading)
        .clipped()
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

/// The Spotlight sheet's look, as a window: same glass, 32pt corners, faint outline,
/// 8pt inset. No chrome strip — a tool doesn't need dock/fullscreen/park buttons.
private struct ToolShell<Content: View>: View {
    let kind: ToolKind
    var placement: WorkspacePlacement
    let manager: ToolWindowManager
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content

    var body: some View {
        let scopedHere = manager.scoped == kind
        let shape = GooEdgeNubShape(nub: manager.tearNubKind == kind ? manager.tearNub.value : 0, x: manager.tearNubX)
        content()
            .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            // Drag the background (not a card) to move it — through the placement, so
            // the tile grid appears like for every other workspace.
            .background(ToolDragCatcher(placement: placement))
            .background { Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape) }
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(scopedHere ? kind.accent.opacity(0.8) : .white.opacity(0.24),
                                        lineWidth: scopedHere ? 1.25 : 0.75))
            .clipShape(shape)
            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.18), value: scopedHere)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark).environment(\.appearsActive, true)
    }
}

/// The Clipboard card's cards, filling whatever space the workspace has: one
/// horizontal row of square cards when it's short (the Spotlight card), a wrapping
/// grid of the same square cards when it's taller.
private struct ClipboardShelf: View {
    let store: ClipboardStore
    let query: ToolQuery
    let manager: ToolWindowManager
    private static let side: CGFloat = 180

    @State private var cache = ItemsCache()
    /// Body runs on every frame of a window move/resize; the database must not. The
    /// search reruns only when the clipboard (revision) or the query changes.
    private var items: [ClipboardStore.Item] {
        let revision = store.revision   // @Observable: refresh when the clipboard changes
        let q = query.text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        if cache.revision == revision, cache.query == q, let items = cache.items { return items }
        let items = store.search(query: q.isEmpty ? nil : q, limit: 200)
        cache.revision = revision; cache.query = q; cache.items = items
        return items
    }
    private final class ItemsCache {
        var revision: Int?
        var query = ""
        var items: [ClipboardStore.Item]?
    }

    var body: some View {
        // The shell insets this view by exactly 8pt on every side (the Spotlight sheet's
        // inset). Cards then size themselves so every gutter is 8pt too, at any window
        // size: one row fills the height; a grid solves the side from the width.
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let gap = EdgeLayout.gap
            let multiRow = geo.size.height >= Self.side * 2 + gap
            let columns = multiRow ? max(1, Int((geo.size.width + gap) / (Self.side + gap))) : 1
            let side = multiRow
                ? (geo.size.width - CGFloat(columns - 1) * gap) / CGFloat(columns)
                : geo.size.height
            Group {
                if multiRow {
                    FollowingScroll(selection: query.selection, resetKey: query.text) {
                        LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.fixed(side), spacing: gap), count: columns),
                                  alignment: .leading, spacing: gap) {
                            cards(side: side)
                        }
                    }
                    .verticalScrollFade(height: 24)
                } else {
                    FollowingScroll(selection: query.selection, horizontal: true, resetKey: query.text) {
                        LazyHStack(spacing: gap) { cards(side: side) }
                    }
                    .horizontalScrollFade(width: 46)
                }
            }
            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height, alignment: .topLeading)
            .onAppear { query.columns = columns }
            .onChange(of: columns) { _, value in query.columns = value }
        }
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15), value: query.flashItemID)
        .onChange(of: query.text) { _, _ in query.selection = 0 }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func cards(side: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let scopedHere = manager.scoped == .clipboard
        ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { i, item in
            ClipCard(item: item, store: store, onCopy: {
                query.selection = i; manager.activateSelection()
            }, compact: false, cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius, side: side)
            .id(i)
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius)
                .strokeBorder(i == query.selection && scopedHere ? .white.opacity(0.6) : .clear, lineWidth: 1))
            .overlay {
                if query.flashItemID == item.id {
                    Text("Copied").font(.pp(12, .semibold))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 10).padding(.vertical, 5)
                        .background(Capsule().fill(.black.opacity(0.7)))
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


/// Invisible background that turns a drag on empty space into a workspace drag.
private struct ToolDragCatcher: NSViewRepresentable {
    var placement: WorkspacePlacement
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> CatcherView { let v = CatcherView(); v.placement = placement; return v }
    func updateNSView(_ view: CatcherView, context: Context) { view.placement = placement }
    final class CatcherView: NSView {
        var placement: WorkspacePlacement?
        override func acceptsFirstMouse(for event: NSEvent?) -> Bool { true }
        override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { placement?.beginDrag() }
        override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
            let point = NSEvent.mouseLocation
            placement?.queueInteraction { [weak placement] in placement?.updateDrag(at: point) }
        }
        override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) { placement?.endDrag() }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeTermInteract.swift
//  What you do *to* the terminal, done the way Ghostty does it, through libghostty-vt:
//  selection gestures (cell / word / line, through scrollback, auto-scrolling, rectangles),
//  scrollback search that stays in sync with new output, mouse reporting for programs
//  that ask for it, and hyperlinks under the pointer. The view turns AppKit events into
//  calls here; nothing here draws.
//

import AppKit

final class EdgeVTInteract {
    private unowned let vt: EdgeVT
    private var gesture: GhosttySelectionGesture?
    private var events: [UInt32: GhosttySelectionGestureEvent] = [:]
    private var search: GhosttySearch?
    private var mouseEncoder: GhosttyMouseEncoder?
    private var mouseEvent: GhosttyMouseEvent?
    /// The terminal holds a selection (ours to draw and copy).
    private(set) var hasSelection = false

    init(vt: EdgeVT) { self.vt = vt }

    /// Frees everything libghostty holds for this terminal (before the terminal goes).
    func release() {
        events.values.forEach { ghostty_selection_gesture_event_free($0) }
        events = [:]
        if let gesture { ghostty_selection_gesture_free(gesture, vt.terminal) }
        gesture = nil
        if let search { ghostty_search_free(search) }
        search = nil
        if let mouseEvent { ghostty_mouse_event_free(mouseEvent) }
        if let mouseEncoder { ghostty_mouse_encoder_free(mouseEncoder) }
        mouseEvent = nil; mouseEncoder = nil
    }

    // MARK: Cells

    /// The grid reference at a viewport cell (valid until the terminal next changes).
    func ref(x: Int, y: Int) -> GhosttyGridRef? {
        var point = GhosttyPoint()
        point.tag = GHOSTTY_POINT_TAG_VIEWPORT
        point.value.coordinate = GhosttyPointCoordinate(x: UInt16(max(0, min(vt.cols - 1, x))), y: UInt32(max(0, min(vt.rows - 1, y))))
        var r = GhosttyGridRef()
        r.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttyGridRef>.size
        return ghostty_terminal_grid_ref(vt.terminal, point, &r) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS ? r : nil
    }

    /// The OSC 8 hyperlink at a viewport cell, if it has one.
    func hyperlink(x: Int, y: Int) -> String? {
        guard var r = ref(x: x, y: y) else { return nil }
        var len = 0
        _ = ghostty_grid_ref_hyperlink_uri(&r, nil, 0, &len)
        guard len > 0 else { return nil }
        var buf = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: len)
        guard ghostty_grid_ref_hyperlink_uri(&r, &buf, len, &len) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS else { return nil }
        return String(decoding: buf.prefix(len), as: UTF8.self)
    }

    // MARK: Selection

    struct Geometry {
        var columns: Int, cellWidth: CGFloat, paddingLeft: CGFloat, height: CGFloat
        var c: GhosttySelectionGestureGeometry {
            GhosttySelectionGestureGeometry(columns: UInt32(max(1, columns)), cell_width: UInt32(max(1, cellWidth.rounded())),
                                            padding_left: UInt32(max(0, paddingLeft.rounded())), screen_height: UInt32(max(1, height.rounded())))
        }
    }

    enum Autoscroll { case none, up, down }

    private func event(_ type: GhosttySelectionGestureEventType) -> GhosttySelectionGestureEvent? {
        if let e = events[type.rawValue] { return e }
        var e: GhosttySelectionGestureEvent?
        guard ghostty_selection_gesture_event_new(nil, &e, type) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS, let e else { return nil }
        events[type.rawValue] = e
        return e
    }

    private func ensureGesture() -> GhosttySelectionGesture? {
        if gesture == nil { _ = ghostty_selection_gesture_new(nil, &gesture) }
        return gesture
    }

    /// Mouse down at a cell. Clicks in quick succession become word, then line selections.
    func press(x: Int, y: Int, at position: CGPoint, time: TimeInterval) {
        guard let gesture = ensureGesture(), let e = event(GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_TYPE_PRESS), var r = ref(x: x, y: y) else { return }
        var pos = GhosttySurfacePosition(x: position.x, y: position.y)
        var ns = UInt64(max(0, time) * 1_000_000_000)
        var interval = UInt64(NSEvent.doubleClickInterval * 1_000_000_000)
        var distance = 6.0
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REF, &r)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_POSITION, &pos)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_TIME_NS, &ns)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REPEAT_INTERVAL_NS, &interval)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REPEAT_DISTANCE, &distance)
        var sel = GhosttySelection()
        sel.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        if ghostty_selection_gesture_event(gesture, vt.terminal, e, &sel) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS, clickCount >= 2 {
            install(&sel)
        } else {
            clearSelection()
        }
    }

    /// The pointer moved with the button down.
    func drag(x: Int, y: Int, at position: CGPoint, geometry: Geometry, rectangle: Bool) -> Autoscroll {
        guard let gesture, let e = event(GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_TYPE_DRAG), var r = ref(x: x, y: y) else { return .none }
        var pos = GhosttySurfacePosition(x: position.x, y: position.y)
        var geo = geometry.c
        var rect = rectangle
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REF, &r)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_POSITION, &pos)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_GEOMETRY, &geo)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_RECTANGLE, &rect)
        var sel = GhosttySelection()
        sel.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        if ghostty_selection_gesture_event(gesture, vt.terminal, e, &sel) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS { install(&sel) }
        return autoscroll
    }

    /// While dragging past the top or bottom edge: one step of scrolling + extending.
    func autoscrollTick(x: Int, y: Int, at position: CGPoint, geometry: Geometry, rectangle: Bool) {
        guard let gesture, let e = event(GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_TYPE_AUTOSCROLL_TICK) else { return }
        var viewport = GhosttyPointCoordinate(x: UInt16(max(0, min(vt.cols - 1, x))), y: UInt32(max(0, min(vt.rows - 1, y))))
        var pos = GhosttySurfacePosition(x: position.x, y: position.y)
        var geo = geometry.c
        var rect = rectangle
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_VIEWPORT, &viewport)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_POSITION, &pos)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_GEOMETRY, &geo)
        ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_RECTANGLE, &rect)
        var sel = GhosttySelection()
        sel.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        if ghostty_selection_gesture_event(gesture, vt.terminal, e, &sel) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS { install(&sel) }
    }

    func release(x: Int, y: Int) {
        guard let gesture, let e = event(GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_TYPE_RELEASE) else { return }
        if var r = ref(x: x, y: y) { ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REF, &r) }
        else { ghostty_selection_gesture_event_set(e, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_EVENT_OPT_REF, nil) }
        _ = ghostty_selection_gesture_event(gesture, vt.terminal, e, nil)
    }

    var clickCount: Int {
        guard let gesture else { return 0 }
        var n: UInt8 = 0
        _ = ghostty_selection_gesture_get(gesture, vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_DATA_CLICK_COUNT, &n)
        return Int(n)
    }

    var dragged: Bool {
        guard let gesture else { return false }
        var d = false
        _ = ghostty_selection_gesture_get(gesture, vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_DATA_DRAGGED, &d)
        return d
    }

    var autoscroll: Autoscroll {
        guard let gesture else { return .none }
        var a = GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_AUTOSCROLL_NONE
        _ = ghostty_selection_gesture_get(gesture, vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_DATA_AUTOSCROLL, &a)
        switch a {
        case GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_AUTOSCROLL_UP: return .up
        case GHOSTTY_SELECTION_GESTURE_AUTOSCROLL_DOWN: return .down
        default: return .none
        }
    }

    func install(_ sel: inout GhosttySelection) {
        ghostty_terminal_set(vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_OPT_SELECTION, &sel)
        hasSelection = true
        vt.selectionDirty = true
    }

    func clearSelection() {
        guard hasSelection else { return }
        ghostty_terminal_set(vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_OPT_SELECTION, nil)
        hasSelection = false
        vt.selectionDirty = true
    }

    func selectAll() {
        var sel = GhosttySelection()
        sel.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        if ghostty_terminal_select_all(vt.terminal, &sel) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS { install(&sel) }
    }

    /// The selection as text (soft wraps joined, trailing space trimmed), like Ghostty's copy.
    func selectionText(_ selection: UnsafePointer<GhosttySelection>? = nil) -> String? {
        guard hasSelection || selection != nil else { return nil }
        var options = GhosttyTerminalSelectionFormatOptions()
        options.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttyTerminalSelectionFormatOptions>.size
        options.emit = GHOSTTY_FORMATTER_FORMAT_PLAIN
        options.unwrap = true
        options.trim = true
        options.selection = selection
        var out: UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>?
        var len = 0
        guard ghostty_terminal_selection_format_alloc(vt.terminal, nil, options, &out, &len) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS else { return nil }
        guard let out else { return "" }
        defer { ghostty_free(nil, out, len) }
        return String(decoding: UnsafeBufferPointer(start: out, count: len), as: UTF8.self)
    }

    // MARK: Search

    private(set) var needle = ""

    /// Starts (or changes, or with "" ends) a search of the whole scrollback.
    func find(_ text: String) {
        if search == nil { _ = ghostty_search_new(nil, &search, vt.terminal) }
        guard let search else { return }
        needle = text
        if text.isEmpty {
            ghostty_search_set(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_OPT_NEEDLE, nil)
        } else {
            let bytes = Array(text.utf8)
            bytes.withUnsafeBufferPointer { buf in
                var s = GhosttyString(ptr: buf.baseAddress, len: buf.count)
                _ = ghostty_search_set(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_OPT_NEEDLE, &s)
            }
            _ = ghostty_search_run(search)
            if selectedIndex == nil { step(older: true) }   // jump to the newest match
        }
    }

    /// Next match toward older output (or newer), scrolling it into view.
    func step(older: Bool) {
        guard let search, !needle.isEmpty else { return }
        _ = ghostty_search_set(search, older ? GHOSTTY_SEARCH_OPT_SELECT_NEXT : GHOSTTY_SEARCH_OPT_SELECT_PREV, nil)
    }

    /// Catch up with new output (call before reading matches).
    func feedSearch() {
        guard let search, !needle.isEmpty else { return }
        _ = ghostty_search_run(search)
    }

    var totalMatches: Int {
        guard let search else { return 0 }
        var n = 0
        _ = ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_TOTAL_MATCHES, &n)
        return n
    }

    var selectedIndex: Int? {
        guard let search else { return nil }
        var i = 0
        return ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_SELECTED_INDEX, &i) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS ? i : nil
    }

    /// Matches in view, per viewport row: column ranges, and whether it's the picked one.
    func visibleMatches() -> [Int: [(Range<Int>, Bool)]] {
        guard let search, !needle.isEmpty else { return [:] }
        var buffer = GhosttySelectionBuffer(ptr: nil, cap: 0, len: 0)
        _ = ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_VIEWPORT_MATCHES, &buffer)
        guard buffer.len > 0 else { return [:] }
        var matches = [GhosttySelection](repeating: GhosttySelection(), count: buffer.len)
        let got: Int = matches.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { p in
            var b = GhosttySelectionBuffer(ptr: p.baseAddress, cap: p.count, len: 0)
            return ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_VIEWPORT_MATCHES, &b) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS ? b.len : 0
        }
        var picked: (Int, Int, Int, Int)?
        var current = GhosttySelection()
        current.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        if ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_SELECTED_MATCH, &current) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS,
           let a = viewport(current.start), let b = viewport(current.end) { picked = (a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y) }
        var rows: [Int: [(Range<Int>, Bool)]] = [:]
        for m in matches.prefix(got) {
            guard var a = viewport(m.start), var b = viewport(m.end) else { continue }
            if (a.y, a.x) > (b.y, b.x) { swap(&a, &b) }
            let isPicked = picked.map { $0 == (a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y) || $0 == (b.x, b.y, a.x, a.y) } ?? false
            for y in a.y...b.y where y >= 0 && y < vt.rows {
                let lo = y == a.y ? a.x : 0, hi = y == b.y ? b.x + 1 : vt.cols
                if lo < hi { rows[y, default: []].append((lo..<hi, isPicked)) }
            }
        }
        return rows
    }

    private func viewport(_ ref: GhosttyGridRef) -> (x: Int, y: Int)? {
        var r = ref, p = GhosttyPointCoordinate()
        guard ghostty_terminal_point_from_grid_ref(vt.terminal, &r, GHOSTTY_POINT_TAG_VIEWPORT, &p) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS else { return nil }
        return (Int(p.x), Int(p.y))
    }

    /// Scripted checks: what the search reports.
    func debugSearch() -> [String: Any] {
        guard let search else { return ["search": "none"] }
        var current = GhosttySelection()
        current.size = MemoryLayout<GhosttySelection>.size
        let r = ghostty_search_get(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_DATA_SELECTED_MATCH, &current)
        var out: [String: Any] = ["selectedMatchResult": Int(r.rawValue), "selectedIndex": selectedIndex ?? -1, "total": totalMatches]
        if r == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS {
            out["start"] = viewport(current.start).map { [$0.x, $0.y] } ?? []
            out["end"] = viewport(current.end).map { [$0.x, $0.y] } ?? []
        }
        out["visible"] = visibleMatches().map { "\($0.key): \($0.value.map { "\($0.0) \($0.1)" })" }
        return out
    }

    func endSearch() {
        if let search { ghostty_search_set(search, GHOSTTY_SEARCH_OPT_NEEDLE, nil) }
        needle = ""
    }

    // MARK: Mouse reporting

    enum MouseAction { case press, release, motion }

    /// The bytes a mouse event becomes for a program that turned on mouse reporting
    /// (empty when it didn't, or doesn't want this kind of event).
    func encodeMouse(_ action: MouseAction, button: Int?, mods: NSEvent.ModifierFlags, position: CGPoint,
                     size: GhosttyMouseEncoderSize, anyPressed: Bool) -> [UInt8] {
        if mouseEncoder == nil { _ = ghostty_mouse_encoder_new(nil, &mouseEncoder) }
        if mouseEvent == nil { _ = ghostty_mouse_event_new(nil, &mouseEvent) }
        guard let mouseEncoder, let mouseEvent else { return [] }
        ghostty_mouse_encoder_setopt_from_terminal(mouseEncoder, vt.terminal)
        var s = size
        ghostty_mouse_encoder_setopt(mouseEncoder, GHOSTTY_MOUSE_ENCODER_OPT_SIZE, &s)
        var pressed = anyPressed
        ghostty_mouse_encoder_setopt(mouseEncoder, GHOSTTY_MOUSE_ENCODER_OPT_ANY_BUTTON_PRESSED, &pressed)
        switch action {
        case .press: ghostty_mouse_event_set_action(mouseEvent, GHOSTTY_MOUSE_ACTION_PRESS)
        case .release: ghostty_mouse_event_set_action(mouseEvent, GHOSTTY_MOUSE_ACTION_RELEASE)
        case .motion: ghostty_mouse_event_set_action(mouseEvent, GHOSTTY_MOUSE_ACTION_MOTION)
        }
        if let button { ghostty_mouse_event_set_button(mouseEvent, GhosttyMouseButton(rawValue: UInt32(button))) }
        else { ghostty_mouse_event_clear_button(mouseEvent) }
        var m: GhosttyMods = 0
        if mods.contains(.shift) { m |= GhosttyMods(GHOSTTY_MODS_SHIFT) }
        if mods.contains(.control) { m |= GhosttyMods(GHOSTTY_MODS_CTRL) }
        if mods.contains(.option) { m |= GhosttyMods(GHOSTTY_MODS_ALT) }
        ghostty_mouse_event_set_mods(mouseEvent, m)
        ghostty_mouse_event_set_position(mouseEvent, GhosttyMousePosition(x: Float(position.x), y: Float(position.y)))
        var buf = [CChar](repeating: 0, count: 64)
        var len = 0
        guard ghostty_mouse_encoder_encode(mouseEncoder, mouseEvent, &buf, buf.count, &len) == GHOSTTY_SUCCESS else { return [] }
        return buf.prefix(len).map { UInt8(bitPattern: $0) }
    }

    /// The shell is sitting at its prompt (so a click on the input line can move the cursor).
    var cursorAtPrompt: Bool {
        var at = false
        _ = ghostty_terminal_get(vt.terminal, GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_CURSOR_AT_PROMPT, &at)
        return at
    }
}
//
//  DictationInsertPolicy.swift
//  Dictation into other apps: which way to put the text in (Accessibility, paste, typed
//  keys), how to get focus back to the field you started in, how to borrow the clipboard
//  without losing it or recording it, and the per-app tone. No app dependencies: the
//  system calls sit behind protocols (live versions in DictationInserter.swift), so
//  tools/dictation-test runs all of this headless against mocks.
//

import AppKit

// MARK: - Methods and policy

enum DictationInsertMethod: String, Sendable {
    /// Set the focused element's selected text through Accessibility, then read it back.
    case accessibility
    /// Borrow the clipboard, post ⌘V, put the clipboard back.
    case paste
    /// Post the characters as keyboard events (never touches the clipboard).
    case typing
}

/// What Accessibility says about the focused element.
struct DictationFieldTraits: Equatable, Sendable {
    var role = ""
    var subrole = ""
    var selectedTextSettable = false
    var valueReadable = false
    var rangeReadable = false
    var valueSettable = false

    var isSecure: Bool { role == "AXSecureTextField" || subrole == "AXSecureTextField" }
    var isTextRole: Bool { ["AXTextField", "AXTextArea", "AXComboBox", "AXSearchField"].contains(role) }
    /// AX insertion is only used where it can be checked: an unverifiable "success" loses text.
    var verifiableAX: Bool { isTextRole && selectedTextSettable && valueReadable && rangeReadable }
}

enum DictationAppFamily: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// AppKit text: Accessibility edits are reliable and undoable.
    case native
    /// Chromium, Electron, Java: AX writes often report success and do nothing, or skip
    /// the editor's own model (VS Code, Slack). Paste goes through the app's paste path.
    case web
    /// Typed keys would run a command at every newline; paste is bracketed.
    case terminal
    /// Screen sharing and VMs: their clipboard is the remote one, so keys only.
    case remote
}

enum DictationInsertPolicy {
    static let terminals: Set<String> = [
        "com.apple.Terminal", "com.googlecode.iterm2", "com.mitchellh.ghostty", "net.kovidgoyal.kitty",
        "io.alacritty", "org.alacritty", "dev.warp.Warp-Stable", "dev.warp.Warp", "co.zeit.hyper",
        "com.github.wez.wezterm", "org.tabby", "com.raphaelamorim.rio",
    ]
    static let remote: Set<String> = [
        "com.apple.ScreenSharing", "com.microsoft.rdc.macos", "com.parallels.desktop.console",
        "com.vmware.fusion", "com.realvnc.vncviewer", "com.citrix.receiver.icaviewer.mac", "com.utmapp.UTM",
        "com.teamviewer.TeamViewer", "com.anydesk.anydeskmac",
    ]
    static let web: Set<String> = [
        "com.google.Chrome", "com.google.Chrome.canary", "org.chromium.Chromium", "company.thebrowser.Browser",
        "com.brave.Browser", "com.microsoft.edgemac", "com.vivaldi.Vivaldi", "com.operasoftware.Opera",
        "org.mozilla.firefox", "app.zen-browser.zen", "com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap", "com.hnc.Discord",
        "com.microsoft.VSCode", "com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92", "notion.id", "md.obsidian", "com.figma.Desktop",
        "com.linear", "com.spotify.client", "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp", "org.whispersystems.signal-desktop",
        "com.microsoft.teams2", "dev.zed.Zed",
    ]

    /// `electron`: the live layer found Electron Framework inside the app bundle.
    static func family(bundleID: String?, electron: Bool = false) -> DictationAppFamily {
        guard let id = bundleID else { return electron ? .web : .native }
        if terminals.contains(id) { return .terminal }
        if remote.contains(id) { return .remote }
        if electron || web.contains(id) || id.hasPrefix("com.jetbrains.") || id.hasPrefix("com.google.Chrome") { return .web }
        return .native
    }

    /// The methods to try, in order; the first one that can be performed is used. Paste and
    /// typing can't be checked afterwards, so only AX falls through to the next.
    /// `clipboardConcealed`: the clipboard holds a password-manager secret. Borrowing it would
    /// copy the secret and put it back after the manager meant to clear it, so keys go first.
    static func plan(family: DictationAppFamily, traits: DictationFieldTraits?, text: String,
                     clipboardConcealed: Bool = false) -> [DictationInsertMethod] {
        // Keys can't carry a newline safely: in chat apps it sends, in terminals it runs.
        let typeable = !text.contains(where: \.isNewline)
        if let traits, traits.isSecure { return typeable ? [.typing] : [] }   // a secret field never sees the clipboard
        let keysOrPaste: [DictationInsertMethod] = clipboardConcealed && typeable ? [.typing, .paste] : [.paste]
        switch family {
        case .remote: return typeable ? [.typing] : [.paste]
        case .terminal, .web: return keysOrPaste
        case .native:
            return (traits?.verifiableAX == true ? [.accessibility] : []) + keysOrPaste
        }
    }

    /// Paste and typing go to whichever app is in front; only AX can write to a background app.
    static func needsFrontmost(_ method: DictationInsertMethod) -> Bool { method != .accessibility }

    /// `unknown`: the write was accepted but the field can't be read back.
    enum AXOutcome: Equatable { case inserted, unchanged, unexpected, unknown }

    /// Read back after setting the selection's text: the field should be exactly the old
    /// value with the selection replaced.
    static func verify(before: String, range: NSRange, inserted: String, after: String?) -> AXOutcome {
        guard let after else { return .unknown }
        let old = before as NSString
        let location = min(max(0, range.location), old.length)
        let length = min(max(0, range.length), old.length - location)
        let expected = old.replacingCharacters(in: NSRange(location: location, length: length), with: inserted)
        if after == expected { return .inserted }
        if after == before { return .unchanged }
        // Same prefix and suffix, text in between (the field normalized quotes or spacing).
        let prefix = old.substring(to: location), suffix = old.substring(from: location + length)
        if after.hasPrefix(prefix), after.hasSuffix(suffix), after.count >= prefix.count + suffix.count { return .inserted }
        return .unexpected
    }
}

// MARK: - Where to insert

/// The field dictation started in, kept until it ends.
struct DictationTarget: Equatable, Sendable {
    var pid: pid_t
    var bundleID: String?
    var appName: String
}

enum DictationTargetChooser {
    /// Who gets the text. The bar and strip never activate the app, so the app in front is
    /// normally the one you were typing in. When one of our own windows is in front but has
    /// no text field of its own focused (a card, the settings card), the text goes to the
    /// last other app you used.
    static func choose(frontmost: DictationTarget?, ownPID: pid_t, ownFieldFocused: Bool,
                       lastExternal: DictationTarget?) -> DictationTarget? {
        guard let frontmost else { return lastExternal }
        if frontmost.pid != ownPID { return frontmost }
        if ownFieldFocused { return frontmost }
        return lastExternal ?? frontmost
    }
}

/// Getting the keyboard back to the captured field before inserting. Each call to `next`
/// takes what's true now and returns one thing to do; the driver does it and asks again.
struct DictationFocusMachine: Equatable {
    struct Observation: Equatable {
        var frontmostPID: pid_t?
        /// nil = not known (no window or element was captured, or AX can't tell).
        var windowMatches: Bool?
        var elementMatches: Bool?
        var elapsed: TimeInterval
    }
    enum Action: Equatable {
        case activate
        case wait
        case raiseWindow
        case focusElement
        /// Give the app a moment to move its caret after a focus change.
        case settle
        /// Insert now; `frontmost` false means only AX may be used.
        case proceed(frontmost: Bool)
    }

    let target: pid_t
    var activationTimeout: TimeInterval = 0.6
    private(set) var activated = false
    private(set) var raised = false
    private(set) var focused = false
    private(set) var settled = false
    private(set) var done = false

    init(target: pid_t, activationTimeout: TimeInterval = 0.6) {
        self.target = target
        self.activationTimeout = activationTimeout
    }

    mutating func next(_ now: Observation) -> Action {
        if done { return .proceed(frontmost: now.frontmostPID == target) }
        guard now.frontmostPID == target else {
            if !activated { activated = true; return .activate }
            if now.elapsed < activationTimeout { return .wait }
            done = true
            return .proceed(frontmost: false)
        }
        if now.windowMatches == false, !raised { raised = true; return .raiseWindow }
        if now.elementMatches == false, !focused { focused = true; return .focusElement }
        if (raised || focused), !settled { settled = true; return .settle }
        done = true
        return .proceed(frontmost: true)
    }
}

enum DictationKeys {
    /// UTF-16 chunks for unicode key events (20 units is the event's limit), never splitting
    /// a surrogate pair or a composed character.
    static func chunks(_ text: String, limit: Int = 20) -> [[UniChar]] {
        var out: [[UniChar]] = [], current: [UniChar] = []
        for character in text {
            let units = Array(String(character).utf16)
            if current.count + units.count > limit, !current.isEmpty { out.append(current); current = [] }
            current.append(contentsOf: units)
        }
        if !current.isEmpty { out.append(current) }
        return out
    }
}

// MARK: - Clipboard borrowing

/// Everything on the clipboard, every item and every type in order, as bytes.
struct PasteboardSnapshot: Equatable, Sendable {
    struct Item: Equatable, Sendable {
        var types: [String]
        var data: [Data]
    }
    var items: [Item]
    var isEmpty: Bool { items.isEmpty }

    static func capture(_ pasteboard: NSPasteboard) -> PasteboardSnapshot {
        PasteboardSnapshot(items: (pasteboard.pasteboardItems ?? []).map { item in
            var types: [String] = [], data: [Data] = []
            for type in item.types {
                guard let bytes = item.data(forType: type) else { continue }
                types.append(type.rawValue); data.append(bytes)
            }
            return Item(types: types, data: data)
        })
    }

    @discardableResult func restore(to pasteboard: NSPasteboard) -> Int {
        pasteboard.clearContents()
        let objects = items.map { item -> NSPasteboardItem in
            let out = NSPasteboardItem()
            for (type, bytes) in zip(item.types, item.data) { out.setData(bytes, forType: NSPasteboard.PasteboardType(type)) }
            return out
        }
        if !objects.isEmpty { pasteboard.writeObjects(objects) }
        return pasteboard.changeCount
    }
}

enum DictationPasteboardMarkers {
    /// nspasteboard.org: clipboard managers (ours included) don't record these.
    static let transient = "org.nspasteboard.TransientType"
    static let autoGenerated = "org.nspasteboard.AutoGeneratedType"
    static let concealed = "org.nspasteboard.ConcealedType"

    /// The dictated text, marked as not-a-copy.
    @discardableResult static func writeTransient(_ text: String, to pasteboard: NSPasteboard, marked: Bool) -> Int {
        pasteboard.clearContents()
        let item = NSPasteboardItem()
        item.setString(text, forType: .string)
        if marked {
            item.setData(Data(), forType: NSPasteboard.PasteboardType(transient))
            item.setData(Data(), forType: NSPasteboard.PasteboardType(autoGenerated))
        }
        pasteboard.writeObjects([item])
        return pasteboard.changeCount
    }
}

/// Pasteboard changes this app made on purpose (dictation's borrowed paste and the restore
/// after it). The clipboard history skips them: the restore is what was already there.
final class PasteboardOwnWrites: @unchecked Sendable {
    static let shared = PasteboardOwnWrites()
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var counts: [Int] = []

    func note(_ changeCount: Int) {
        lock.withLock {
            counts.append(changeCount)
            if counts.count > 32 { counts.removeFirst(counts.count - 32) }
        }
    }

    /// True (once) if this change was ours.
    func consume(_ changeCount: Int) -> Bool {
        lock.withLock {
            guard let i = counts.firstIndex(of: changeCount) else { return false }
            counts.removeSubrange(...i)   // older ones were never seen; drop them too
            return true
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Per-app tone

/// How the editing pass should sound in the app the text goes to. Measured on s1-mini with
/// the same prompt with and without each line (tools/dictation-test/tone-eval.py): an email
/// line puts greeting and sign-off on their own lines and finishes sentences, with no
/// regressions; a code line gained nothing over the "Target app:" line alone and lost one
/// case ("+ 1" became "plus 1"); a casual line made it keep fillers and drop capitals and
/// apostrophes. So only email instructs the model. Code and chat act after it: code gets
/// no sentence capitals and no final period, chat loses a lone final period.
enum DictationTone: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
    case plain, chat, email, code

    static let overridesKey = "voice.tone.apps"

    static let builtIn: [String: DictationTone] = {
        var map: [String: DictationTone] = [:]
        for id in ["com.apple.MobileSMS", "com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap", "com.hnc.Discord", "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp",
                   "ru.keepcoder.Telegram", "org.whispersystems.signal-desktop", "com.facebook.archon",
                   "com.microsoft.teams2", "com.beeper.beeper-desktop"] { map[id] = .chat }
        for id in ["com.apple.mail", "com.microsoft.Outlook", "com.readdle.smartemail-Mac", "com.mimestream.Mimestream",
                   "com.superhuman.electron", "it.bloop.airmail2", "com.freron.MailMate"] { map[id] = .email }
        for id in DictationInsertPolicy.terminals { map[id] = .code }
        for id in ["com.apple.dt.Xcode", "com.microsoft.VSCode", "com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92", "dev.zed.Zed",
                   "com.sublimetext.4", "com.sublimetext.3", "com.panic.Nova", "com.barebones.bbedit"] { map[id] = .code }
        return map
    }()

    static func resolve(bundleID: String?, overrides: [String: String]) -> DictationTone {
        guard let id = bundleID, !id.isEmpty else { return .plain }
        if let raw = overrides[id], let tone = DictationTone(rawValue: raw) { return tone }
        if let tone = builtIn[id] { return tone }
        if id.hasPrefix("com.jetbrains.") { return .code }
        return .plain
    }

    static func current(bundleID: String?) -> DictationTone {
        resolve(bundleID: bundleID, overrides: UserDefaults.standard.dictionary(forKey: overridesKey) as? [String: String] ?? [:])
    }

    var next: DictationTone {
        let all = Self.allCases
        return all[(all.firstIndex(of: self)! + 1) % all.count]
    }

    /// The line added to the editing pass's instructions, if any.
    var instruction: String? {
        switch self {
        case .plain, .chat, .code: nil
        case .email: "This is an email: polished, complete sentences; greeting and sign-off on their own lines."
        }
    }

    /// Sentence capitals are added after the model; never to a command or code.
    var capitalizes: Bool { self != .code }

    /// Last touches after the editing pass (and on the no-model path).
    func finish(_ text: String) -> String {
        switch self {
        case .plain, .email: return text
        case .code: return Self.droppingFinalPeriod(text)
        case .chat:
            // One sentence, no other sentence ends: a chat line, sent without its period.
            let body = text.dropLast()
            guard text.hasSuffix("."), !text.hasSuffix(".."), !body.contains(where: { ".!?\n".contains($0) }) else { return text }
            return String(body)
        }
    }

    private static func droppingFinalPeriod(_ text: String) -> String {
        guard text.hasSuffix("."), !text.hasSuffix("..") else { return text }
        return String(text.dropLast())
    }
}

// MARK: - The insertion engine (system calls behind protocols)

/// An Accessibility element (AXUIElement live, anything in tests).
final class DictationElement {
    let ref: AnyObject
    init(_ ref: AnyObject) { self.ref = ref }
}

@MainActor protocol DictationAccessibility: AnyObject {
    var trusted: Bool { get }
    func focusedElement(pid: pid_t) -> DictationElement?
    func focusedWindow(pid: pid_t) -> DictationElement?
    func traits(of element: DictationElement) -> DictationFieldTraits
    func value(of element: DictationElement) -> String?
    func selectedRange(of element: DictationElement) -> NSRange?
    func selectedText(of element: DictationElement) -> String?
    func setSelectedText(_ text: String, on element: DictationElement) -> Bool
    func setValue(_ text: String, on element: DictationElement) -> Bool
    func setSelectedRange(_ range: NSRange, on element: DictationElement)
    func focus(_ element: DictationElement)
    func raise(_ window: DictationElement)
    func same(_ a: DictationElement, _ b: DictationElement) -> Bool
}

@MainActor protocol DictationSystem: AnyObject {
    var frontmostPID: pid_t? { get }
    func activate(pid: pid_t)
    /// None of our windows may hold the keyboard when keys go out.
    func resignOwnKeyWindows()
    func postPaste()
    func type(_ text: String)
    func sleep(_ seconds: TimeInterval) async
}

@MainActor protocol DictationClipboard: AnyObject {
    var changeCount: Int { get }
    /// A password manager's secret is on it (nspasteboard.org ConcealedType).
    var holdsConcealed: Bool { get }
    func snapshot() -> PasteboardSnapshot
    func writeTransient(_ text: String, marked: Bool) -> Int
    func restore(_ snapshot: PasteboardSnapshot) -> Int
}

struct DictationCapture {
    var target: DictationTarget
    var family: DictationAppFamily
    var window: DictationElement?
    var element: DictationElement?
    var traits: DictationFieldTraits?
}

struct DictationInsertResult: Equatable {
    var method: DictationInsertMethod?
    var failure: String?
    var inserted: Bool { method != nil }
}

@MainActor final class DictationInsertEngine {
    let ax: DictationAccessibility
    let system: DictationSystem
    let clipboard: DictationClipboard
    let ownWrites: PasteboardOwnWrites
    /// How long the borrowed text stays on the clipboard: slow apps read it late.
    var restoreDelay: TimeInterval = 1.2
    private(set) var captures: [pid_t: DictationCapture] = [:]
    /// The pending clipboard restore (tests await it).
    private(set) var pendingRestore: Task<Void, Never>?

    init(ax: DictationAccessibility, system: DictationSystem, clipboard: DictationClipboard,
         ownWrites: PasteboardOwnWrites = .shared) {
        self.ax = ax; self.system = system; self.clipboard = clipboard; self.ownWrites = ownWrites
    }

    /// Remember the focused window and field now, before the strip or bar can move focus.
    @discardableResult func capture(_ target: DictationTarget, electron: Bool = false) -> DictationCapture {
        var c = DictationCapture(target: target, family: DictationInsertPolicy.family(bundleID: target.bundleID, electron: electron))
        if ax.trusted {
            c.window = ax.focusedWindow(pid: target.pid)
            c.element = ax.focusedElement(pid: target.pid)
            c.traits = c.element.map { ax.traits(of: $0) }
        }
        captures[target.pid] = c
        return c
    }

    func forget(_ pid: pid_t) { captures.removeValue(forKey: pid) }
    func capture(for pid: pid_t) -> DictationCapture? { captures[pid] }

    func insert(_ text: String, into target: DictationTarget, restoreClipboard: Bool) async -> DictationInsertResult {
        guard ax.trusted else { return DictationInsertResult(failure: "accessibility") }
        let c = captures.removeValue(forKey: target.pid) ?? capture(target)
        let frontmost = await restoreFocus(c)
        let element = c.element ?? ax.focusedElement(pid: target.pid)
        let traits = element.map { ax.traits(of: $0) } ?? c.traits
        let plan = DictationInsertPolicy.plan(family: c.family, traits: traits, text: text,
                                              clipboardConcealed: clipboard.holdsConcealed)
        for method in plan {
            if DictationInsertPolicy.needsFrontmost(method), !frontmost { continue }
            switch method {
