            case .accessibility:
                guard let element, insertByAX(text, into: element) else { continue }
                return DictationInsertResult(method: .accessibility)
            case .paste:
                await paste(text, restoreClipboard: restoreClipboard)
                return DictationInsertResult(method: .paste)
            case .typing:
                system.resignOwnKeyWindows()
                system.type(text)
                return DictationInsertResult(method: .typing)
            }
        }
        return DictationInsertResult(failure: frontmost ? "no method" : "not frontmost")
    }

    /// Back to the captured app, window and field. True when the app is in front.
    func restoreFocus(_ c: DictationCapture) async -> Bool {
        var machine = DictationFocusMachine(target: c.target.pid)
        let started = Date()
        for _ in 0..<64 {
            let observation = DictationFocusMachine.Observation(
                frontmostPID: system.frontmostPID,
                windowMatches: c.window.flatMap { w in ax.focusedWindow(pid: c.target.pid).map { ax.same($0, w) } },
                elementMatches: c.element.flatMap { e in ax.focusedElement(pid: c.target.pid).map { ax.same($0, e) } },
                elapsed: Date().timeIntervalSince(started))
            switch machine.next(observation) {
            case .activate: system.activate(pid: c.target.pid); await system.sleep(0.05)
            case .wait: await system.sleep(0.05)
            case .raiseWindow: if let w = c.window { ax.raise(w) }
            case .focusElement: if let e = c.element { ax.focus(e) }
            case .settle: await system.sleep(0.055)
            case .proceed(let front): return front
            }
        }
        return system.frontmostPID == c.target.pid
    }

    /// Replace the selection through Accessibility and check it took. A field that changed
    /// in some other way is put back so the paste after it doesn't double up.
    func insertByAX(_ text: String, into element: DictationElement) -> Bool {
        guard let before = ax.value(of: element), let range = ax.selectedRange(of: element) else { return false }
        guard ax.setSelectedText(text, on: element) else { return false }
        switch DictationInsertPolicy.verify(before: before, range: range, inserted: text, after: ax.value(of: element)) {
        case .inserted:
            // Caret after the new words (most fields do this themselves).
            ax.setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location + (text as NSString).length, length: 0), on: element)
            return true
        case .unchanged:
            return false
        case .unknown:
            return true   // accepted and probably in; pasting too would likely double it
        case .unexpected:
            // Put it back if we can; if we can't, the text is in (somehow): don't paste it again.
            if ax.setValue(before, on: element), ax.value(of: element) == before {
                ax.setSelectedRange(range, on: element)
                return false
            }
            return true
        }
    }

    /// Borrow the clipboard: the dictated text goes on marked transient, ⌘V, and the
    /// previous contents come back unless something else was copied meanwhile.
    func paste(_ text: String, restoreClipboard: Bool) async {
        let saved = restoreClipboard ? clipboard.snapshot() : nil
        let ours = clipboard.writeTransient(text, marked: restoreClipboard)
        if restoreClipboard { ownWrites.note(ours) }
        system.resignOwnKeyWindows()
        system.postPaste()
        guard let saved else { return }
        let delay = restoreDelay
        pendingRestore = Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            await self.system.sleep(delay)
            guard self.clipboard.changeCount == ours else { return }   // you copied something: keep it
            let restored = self.clipboard.restore(saved)
            self.ownWrites.note(restored)
        }
    }
}
//
//  SidebarWidgetStack.swift
//  The sidebar's bottom area: a liquid-glass widget card ABOVE the downloads
//  strip. The card is a pager — scroll over it to flip between widgets (media
//  today; more slot in later without new chrome). Downloads keep their own
//  strip below, untouched.
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Media model

/// Tracks which tabs carry playing (or recently paused) media, newest first.
/// Fed by WebContentManager's media watcher; entries die with their tab.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class MediaWidgetModel {
    struct Entry: Identifiable, Equatable {
        let id: String      // tab id
        var playing: Bool
        var currentTime: Double = 0
        var duration: Double = 0
        var volume: Double = 1

        var progress: Double {
            guard duration > 0 else { return 0 }
            return min(1, max(0, currentTime / duration))
        }
    }

    private(set) var entries: [Entry] = []

    var current: Entry? { entries.first }

    func update(
        tabId: String,
        playing: Bool,
        currentTime: Double? = nil,
        duration: Double? = nil,
        volume: Double? = nil
    ) {
        if let i = entries.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == tabId }) {
            var updated = entries[i]
            updated.playing = playing
            if let currentTime { updated.currentTime = max(0, currentTime) }
            if let duration { updated.duration = max(0, duration) }
            if let volume { updated.volume = min(1, max(0, volume)) }
            if playing, i != 0 {
                entries.remove(at: i)
                entries.insert(updated, at: 0)
            } else if entries[i] != updated {
                entries[i] = updated
            }
        } else if playing {
            entries.insert(Entry(
                id: tabId,
                playing: true,
                currentTime: max(0, currentTime ?? 0),
                duration: max(0, duration ?? 0),
                volume: min(1, max(0, volume ?? 1))
            ), at: 0)
        }
    }

    func remove(tabId: String) {
        // Observation publishes a mutation even when `removeAll` finds
        // nothing. During tab hibernation that no-op notification can make
        // SwiftUI re-enter WebHostView.updateNSView before the asynchronous
        // snapshot finishes, creating an unbounded layout/update loop.
        guard let index = entries.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == tabId }) else { return }
        entries.remove(at: index)
    }
}

// MARK: - Stack

struct SidebarWidgetStack: View {
    let web: WebContentManager
    let downloads: DownloadsModel

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            if !web.mediaWidget.entries.isEmpty {
                WidgetPager(web: web)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                    .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
            DownloadsStrip(downloads: downloads)
        }
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.85),
                   value: web.mediaWidget.entries.isEmpty)
    }
}

// MARK: - Pager

/// One tall glass card; scrolling over it flips between the media entries
/// (and any future widget pages). Dots show position when there are several.
private struct WidgetPager: View {
    let web: WebContentManager
    @State private var page = 0

    var body: some View {
        let entries = web.mediaWidget.entries
        let count = max(entries.count, 1)
        let shown = min(page, count - 1)

        VStack(spacing: 5) {
            if entries.indices.contains(shown) {
                MediaWidgetCard(web: web, entry: entries[shown])
                    .id(entries[shown].id)
                    .transition(.asymmetric(
                        insertion: .move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity),
                        removal: .opacity
                    ))
            }
            if count > 1 {
                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    ForEach(0..<count, id: \.self) { i in
                        Circle()
                            .fill(.white.opacity(i == shown ? 0.65 : 0.2))
                            .frame(width: 4, height: 4)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.bottom, 2)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .glassEffect(
            .regular.tint(Color(white: 0.06).opacity(0.5)),
            in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
        )
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous))
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.08), lineWidth: 0.75)
        )
        .background(WidgetScrollCatcher { step in
            guard count > 1 else { return }
            withAnimation(.spring(duration: 0.24, bounce: 0.2)) {
                page = ((shown + step) % count + count) % count
            }
        })
        .animation(.spring(duration: 0.24, bounce: 0.2), value: shown)
        .onChange(of: entries.count) { _, n in
            if page >= n { page = max(0, n - 1) }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Media card

private struct MediaWidgetCard: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    let web: WebContentManager
    let entry: MediaWidgetModel.Entry

    var body: some View {
        if let tab = findTab(entry.id) {
            let piped = web.pip.tabId == entry.id
            VStack(spacing: 9) {
                // Identity row — click anywhere on it to jump to the tab.
                Button {
                    engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id))
                } label: {
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        FaviconView(host: tab.host, accent: favicons.accent(for: tab), size: 20)
                        VStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 1) {
                            Text(tab.displayName)
                                .font(.pp(12, .semibold))
                                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                                .lineLimit(1)
                                .truncationMode(.tail)
                            Text(tab.host ?? "")
                                .font(.pp(10, .medium))
                                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                                .lineLimit(1)
                        }
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .center)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .help("Go to tab")
                .accessibilityLabel("Go to \(tab.displayName)")

                MediaTimelineWaveform(entry: entry)
                    .frame(height: 32)

                // A centered transport cluster reads as one player instead of
                // unrelated controls pinned to opposite edges.
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    transportButton(
                        icon: entry.playing ? "pause.fill" : "play.fill",
                        help: entry.playing ? "Pause" : "Play"
                    ) {
                        web.toggleMediaPlayback(tabId: tab.id)
                    }
                    transportButton(
                        icon: piped ? "pip.exit" : "pip.enter",
                        help: piped ? "Return video to tab" : "Pop out just the video"
                    ) {
                        if piped {
                            engine.dispatch(.activateTab(tabId: tab.id))
                        } else {
                            web.requestPiP(tabId: tab.id)
                        }
                    }
                    Text(piped ? "PiP" : (entry.playing ? "Playing" : "Paused"))
                        .font(.pp(10, .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                        .frame(minWidth: 42)
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .center)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.top, 10)
            .padding(.bottom, 8)
        }
    }

    private func transportButton(icon: String, help: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: icon)
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                .frame(width: 32, height: 24)
                .background(Capsule(style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.08)))
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle())
        .help(help)
        .accessibilityLabel(help)
    }

    /// Media can play in any workspace, not just the active one.
    private func findTab(_ id: String) -> Tab? {
        guard let snapshot = engine.snapshot else { return nil }
        for space in snapshot.spaces {
            if let tab = Snapshot.findTab(id, in: space.tabs) { return tab }
        }
        return nil
    }
}

/// A rounded playback waveform tied to the page's real media clock, duration,
/// and volume. The played portion advances with the actual element instead of
/// running a decorative looping animation.
private struct MediaTimelineWaveform: View {
    let entry: MediaWidgetModel.Entry

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let count = max(20, Int(geo.size.width / 5.5))
            HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 2) {
                ForEach(0..<count, id: \.self) { index in
                    let position = Double(index) / Double(max(1, count - 1))
                    Capsule(style: .continuous)
                        .fill(.white.opacity(position <= entry.progress ? 0.76 : 0.20))
                        .frame(width: 2.8, height: height(at: index, count: count, available: geo.size.height))
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .center)
        }
        .animation(.linear(duration: 0.24), value: entry.currentTime)
    }

    private func height(at index: Int, count: Int, available: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let x = Double(index) / Double(max(1, count - 1))
        let clock = entry.currentTime
        let envelope = 0.34
            + abs(sin(x * 15.7 + clock * 0.19)) * 0.34
            + abs(sin(x * 41.3 - clock * 0.07)) * 0.18
        let volume = 0.55 + entry.volume * 0.45
        return max(4, min(available, available * CGFloat(envelope * volume)))
    }
}

// MARK: - Scroll catcher

/// Accumulates wheel/trackpad deltas and emits ±1 page steps.
private struct WidgetScrollCatcher: NSViewRepresentable {
    let onStep: (Int) -> Void

    final class CatcherView: NSView {
        var onStep: ((Int) -> Void)?
        private var acc: CGFloat = 0
        override func scrollWheel(with event: NSEvent) {
            acc += event.scrollingDeltaY
            let detent: CGFloat = 24
            while acc >= detent { acc -= detent; onStep?(1) }
            while acc <= -detent { acc += detent; onStep?(-1) }
            if event.phase == .ended || event.momentumPhase == .ended { acc = 0 }
        }
    }

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> CatcherView {
        let v = CatcherView()
        v.onStep = onStep
        return v
    }

    func updateNSView(_ v: CatcherView, context: Context) {
        v.onStep = onStep
    }
}
import Foundation

/// Cheap local matches stay immediate. Enrichment starts after a short typing
/// pause, and cancelled requests never enter a serial worker queue.
///
/// Local enrichment (indexed files ~5ms, apps, Surface content) only needs to skip
/// keystrokes that arrive in a burst; network lookups (Hydra) keep the longer pause
/// so they don't fire on every letter.
enum SpotlightSearchTiming {
    static let localPause = 35
    static let networkPause = 140

    static func waitForPause(milliseconds: Int = localPause) async -> Bool {
        do { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(milliseconds)); return !Task.isCancelled }
        catch { return false }
    }
}
//
//  EdgePtydClient.swift
//  The app's side of edge-ptyd: connects (starting it, detached, if it isn't running),
//  learns which shells are still alive, and gets each one back as a snapshot plus its pty.
//  A remote shell is typed into directly through that pty; its output comes back here.
//

import AppKit
import Darwin

/// What a terminal view drives: a shell, here or in edge-ptyd.
protocol EdgeShell: AnyObject {
    var pid: pid_t { get }
    var isRunning: Bool { get }
    /// A password prompt is up (echo off): time for secure keyboard entry.
    var echoDisabled: Bool { get }
    var onOutput: (([UInt8]) -> Void)? { get set }
    var onExit: ((Int32) -> Void)? { get set }
    func write(_ bytes: [UInt8])
    func resize(cols: Int, rows: Int, cellWidth: Int, cellHeight: Int)
    func terminate()
}

extension EdgePTY: EdgeShell {}

/// A shell edge-ptyd owns: keys go straight into its pty, everything else by message.
final class EdgeRemoteShell: EdgeShell {
    let id: String
    let pid: pid_t
    private let fd: Int32
    private weak var client: EdgePtydClient?
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.hashawn.nardo.pty.remote", qos: .userInteractive)
    private(set) var isRunning = true
    var onOutput: (([UInt8]) -> Void)?
    var onExit: ((Int32) -> Void)?

    init(id: String, pid: pid_t, fd: Int32, client: EdgePtydClient) {
        self.id = id; self.pid = pid; self.fd = fd; self.client = client
    }
    deinit { close(fd) }

    var echoDisabled: Bool {
        var t = termios()
        guard isRunning, tcgetattr(fd, &t) == 0 else { return false }
        return t.c_lflag & tcflag_t(ECHO) == 0 && t.c_lflag & tcflag_t(ICANON) != 0
    }

    func write(_ bytes: [UInt8]) {
        guard isRunning, !bytes.isEmpty else { return }
        let fd = self.fd
        queue.async {
            var offset = 0
            while offset < bytes.count {
                let n = bytes[offset...].withUnsafeBufferPointer { Darwin.write(fd, $0.baseAddress, $0.count) }
                if n > 0 { offset += n } else if errno != EAGAIN && errno != EINTR { return } else { usleep(1000) }
            }
        }
    }

    func resize(cols: Int, rows: Int, cellWidth: Int, cellHeight: Int) {
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { client?.resize(id, cols: cols, rows: rows, cellWidth: cellWidth, cellHeight: cellHeight) }
    }

    func terminate() { MainActor.assumeIsolated { client?.close(id) } }

    fileprivate func exited() {
        guard isRunning else { return }
        isRunning = false
        onExit?(0)
    }
}

@MainActor final class EdgePtydClient {
    static let shared = EdgePtydClient()

    private var wire: EdgeWire?
    private var shells: [String: EdgeRemoteShell] = [:]

    /// The sessions edge-ptyd still has (on connect).
    var onHello: (([EdgePtyd.SessionInfo]) -> Void)?
    /// A session arrived: from `create`, or back from a snapshot after `attach`.
    var onAttached: ((EdgeRemoteShell, EdgePtyd.Attached, [UInt8]) -> Void)?
    /// edge-ptyd went away (it crashed or was killed): its shells are gone.
    var onLost: (() -> Void)?

    var connected: Bool { wire != nil }

    /// Connects, starting edge-ptyd if needed. False if it can't be reached at all.
    @discardableResult
    func connect(spawning: Bool = true) -> Bool {
        if wire != nil { return true }
        var fd = Self.dial()
        // Mid-upgrade the new build is coming up in the same process: never start another
        // edge-ptyd then (it could take the lock and the upgrading one would exit, shells and all).
        if fd < 0, !spawning { return false }
        if fd < 0 {
            guard spawnDaemon() else { return false }
            for _ in 0..<40 where fd < 0 {   // up to ~2s for it to start listening
                usleep(50_000)
                fd = Self.dial()
            }
        }
        guard fd >= 0 else { return false }
        let w = EdgeWire(fd: fd, queue: .main)
        w.onFrame = { [weak self] kind, id, body, handle in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.handle(kind, id: id, body: body, handle: handle) }
        }
        w.onClose = { [weak self] in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self else { return }
                self.wire = nil
                if self.upgrading {
                    // edge-ptyd is becoming the new build in place: the shells live on. Drop the
                    // old handles quietly and come back for them.
                    self.upgrading = false
                    self.shells = [:]
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { self.reconnect(tries: 30) }
                    return
                }
                let lost = self.shells.values
                self.shells = [:]
                lost.forEach { $0.exited() }
                self.onLost?()
            }
        }
        wire = w
        w.start()
        w.send(.hello)
        return true
    }

    private var upgrading = false

    private func reconnect(tries: Int) {
        if connect(spawning: false) { return }
        guard tries > 0 else { onLost?(); return }
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) { [weak self] in self?.reconnect(tries: tries - 1) }
    }

    func create(cols: Int, rows: Int, directory: String) {
        wire?.send(.create, body: EdgePtyd.json(EdgePtyd.Create(cols: cols, rows: rows, directory: directory)))
    }
    func attach(_ id: String) { wire?.send(.attach, id: id) }
    func resize(_ id: String, cols: Int, rows: Int, cellWidth: Int, cellHeight: Int) {
        wire?.send(.resize, id: id, body: EdgePtyd.json(EdgePtyd.Resize(cols: cols, rows: rows, cellWidth: cellWidth, cellHeight: cellHeight)))
    }
    func close(_ id: String) { wire?.send(.close, id: id) }
    func focus(_ id: String?) { wire?.send(.focus, id: id ?? "") }

    private func handle(_ kind: EdgePtyd.Kind, id: String, body: [UInt8], handle: Int32?) {
        switch kind {
        case .hello:
            guard let hello = EdgePtyd.decode(EdgePtyd.Hello.self, body), hello.protocolVersion == EdgePtyd.protocolVersion else {
                wire?.shutdown(); return
            }
            // An older edge-ptyd (one that can upgrade): it becomes this app's build in place.
            if let running = hello.build, let mine = Self.installedDaemon(),
               running != (mine as NSString).lastPathComponent {
                upgrading = true
                wire?.send(.upgrade, body: EdgePtyd.json(EdgePtyd.Upgrade(path: mine)))
                return
            }
            onHello?(hello.sessions)
        case .attached:
            guard let fd = handle, let (info, snapshot) = EdgePtyd.unpackAttached(body) else { if let handle { Darwin.close(handle) }; return }
            let shell = EdgeRemoteShell(id: id, pid: info.info.pid, fd: fd, client: self)
            shells[id] = shell
            onAttached?(shell, info, snapshot)
        case .output:
            shells[id]?.onOutput?(body)
        case .exited:
            shells.removeValue(forKey: id)?.exited()
        default:
            break
        }
    }

    private static func dial() -> Int32 {
        let fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0)
        guard fd >= 0 else { return -1 }
        var addr = sockaddr_un()
        addr.sun_family = sa_family_t(AF_UNIX)
        _ = withUnsafeMutableBytes(of: &addr.sun_path) { raw in
            EdgePtyd.socketPath.withCString { strncpy(raw.baseAddress!.assumingMemoryBound(to: CChar.self), $0, raw.count - 1) }
        }
        let ok = withUnsafePointer(to: &addr) {
            $0.withMemoryRebound(to: sockaddr.self, capacity: 1) { Darwin.connect(fd, $0, socklen_t(MemoryLayout<sockaddr_un>.size)) }
        }
        if ok != 0 { Darwin.close(fd); return -1 }
        return fd
    }

    /// edge-ptyd runs from a copy outside the app bundle, named for the build it came from:
    /// rebuilding the app rewrites the bundle, and a running binary must never change under it.
    static func installedDaemon() -> String? {
        guard let bundled = Bundle.main.url(forAuxiliaryExecutable: "edge-ptyd")?.path,
              let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: bundled),
              let size = attrs[.size] as? Int, let date = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else { return nil }
        let dir = EdgePtyd.directory + "/ptyd"
        let path = dir + "/edge-ptyd-\(Int(date.timeIntervalSince1970))-\(size)"
        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path) {
            try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            guard (try? FileManager.default.copyItem(atPath: bundled, toPath: path)) != nil else { return nil }
            // Older copies: keep the newest few (one of them may still be running).
            let old = ((try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: dir)) ?? []).filter { $0.hasPrefix("edge-ptyd-") }
                .sorted { (dir + "/" + $0).modified > (dir + "/" + $1).modified }.dropFirst(3)
            old.forEach { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: dir + "/" + $0) }
        }
        return path
    }

    /// Starts edge-ptyd in its own session, so it lives on when the app quits.
    private func spawnDaemon() -> Bool {
        guard let path = Self.installedDaemon() else { return false }
        var attr: posix_spawnattr_t?
        posix_spawnattr_init(&attr)
        defer { posix_spawnattr_destroy(&attr) }
        posix_spawnattr_setflags(&attr, Int16(POSIX_SPAWN_SETSID | POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT))
        var actions: posix_spawn_file_actions_t?
        posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&actions)
        defer { posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&actions) }
        for target in [STDIN_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO, STDERR_FILENO] {
            posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&actions, target, "/dev/null", target == STDIN_FILENO ? O_RDONLY : O_WRONLY, 0)
        }
        let home = FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path
        posix_spawn_file_actions_addchdir_np(&actions, home)
        var pid: pid_t = 0
        let argv: [UnsafeMutablePointer<CChar>?] = [strdup(path), nil]
        defer { argv.forEach { free($0) } }
        return posix_spawn(&pid, path, &actions, &attr, argv, environ) == 0
    }
}

private extension String {
    var modified: Date { ((try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: self))?[.modificationDate] as? Date) ?? .distantPast }
}
//
//  WindowMotionCore.swift
//  The math behind other apps' windows in motion (docs/features/windows.md, Animation): one
//  spring per window frame that can be retargeted mid-flight without a jump, an overshoot
//  bound that keeps a window off the menu bar and inside its display, where to draw a frame
//  whose size the app hasn't caught up with, how often a slow app gets a new size, and how
//  an app's minimum size is learned from what it refuses. Pure: no AppKit, no AX. Tested
//  offline by tools/window-anim-test; driven by WindowAnimator.
//

import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

/// How windows move: the spring's response (seconds, its undamped period) and damping ratio.
/// Below 1 lands with a slight overshoot; fast launch either way.
struct WindowMotionFeel: Equatable {
    var response: Double
    var damping: Double

    static let quick = WindowMotionFeel(response: 0.24, damping: 0.80)
    /// The probe's spring (2026-10-18), the one that looked right.
    static let snappy = WindowMotionFeel(response: 0.30, damping: 0.78)
    static let smooth = WindowMotionFeel(response: 0.42, damping: 0.86)
    static let all: [(id: String, feel: WindowMotionFeel)] = [("quick", .quick), ("snappy", .snappy), ("smooth", .smooth)]
    static func named(_ id: String?) -> WindowMotionFeel { all.first { $0.id == id }?.feel ?? .snappy }
}

/// A window frame on a spring: four axes (x, y, width, height) with the same stiffness and
/// damping, so every edge is itself the same spring and an edge that isn't meant to move (the
/// right edge of a window growing leftward) doesn't. A new target keeps position and velocity.
struct WindowSpring {
    private(set) var pos: [Double]      // x, y, w, h
    private(set) var vel: [Double]
    private(set) var goal: [Double]
    private(set) var damping: Double
    let feel: WindowMotionFeel
    /// Per edge (minX, minY, maxX, maxY): which side of its goal the edge approaches from
    /// (+1 above, -1 below, 0 already there) and how far past the goal it may go.
    private(set) var side: [Double] = [0, 0, 0, 0]
    private(set) var allow: [Double] = [0, 0, 0, 0]
    /// How a size difference splits between the two edges of an axis (0: all at max, keeping
    /// minX; 1: all at min, keeping maxX), by how far each edge travels this flight.
    private(set) var anchor: (x: Double, y: Double) = (0.5, 0.5)
    private var bounds: CGRect?

    /// Past its goal an edge never goes further than this (points), nor out of `bounds`.
    static let maxOvershoot: Double = 12
    static let minSide: Double = 40

    var omega: Double { 2 * .pi / feel.response }

    init(from: CGRect, to: CGRect, feel: WindowMotionFeel, bounds: CGRect? = nil) {
        self.feel = feel
        pos = [from.minX, from.minY, from.width, from.height].map(Double.init)
        vel = [0, 0, 0, 0]
        goal = pos
        damping = feel.damping
        retarget(to, bounds: bounds)
    }

    var rect: CGRect { CGRect(x: pos[0], y: pos[1], width: pos[2], height: pos[3]) }
    var target: CGRect { CGRect(x: goal[0], y: goal[1], width: goal[2], height: goal[3]) }
    var velocity: [Double] { vel }

    static func edges(_ p: [Double]) -> [Double] { [p[0], p[1], p[0] + p[2], p[1] + p[3]] }
    var edgePos: [Double] { Self.edges(pos) }
    var edgeVel: [Double] { Self.edges(vel) }
    var edgeGoal: [Double] { Self.edges(goal) }

    /// Fly somewhere else from wherever (and however fast) the window is now.
    mutating func retarget(_ to: CGRect, bounds: CGRect? = nil) {
        // The same target again (an arrow held down, a reflow that changed nothing): no change.
        if bounds == self.bounds, abs(Double(to.minX) - goal[0]) < 0.01, abs(Double(to.minY) - goal[1]) < 0.01,
           abs(max(Self.minSide, Double(to.width)) - goal[2]) < 0.01, abs(max(Self.minSide, Double(to.height)) - goal[3]) < 0.01,
           pos != goal || vel != [0, 0, 0, 0] { return }
        self.bounds = bounds
        goal = [Double(to.minX), Double(to.minY), max(Self.minSide, Double(to.width)), max(Self.minSide, Double(to.height))]
        let e = edgePos, g = edgeGoal, v = edgeVel
        // Room past each goal edge before the display's edge (the menu bar, the Dock side).
        var room = [Double](repeating: Self.maxOvershoot, count: 8)   // [i] going down, [i+4] going up
        if let b = bounds {
            room[0] = Double(to.minX - b.minX); room[1] = Double(to.minY - b.minY)        // min edges past their goal downward
            room[6] = Double(b.maxX - to.maxX); room[7] = Double(b.maxY - to.maxY)        // max edges past their goal upward
        }
        for i in 0..<4 {
            let d = e[i] - g[i]
            side[i] = abs(d) < 0.5 ? 0 : (d > 0 ? 1 : -1)
            let down = max(0, min(Self.maxOvershoot, room[i])), up = max(0, min(Self.maxOvershoot, room[i + 4]))
            allow[i] = side[i] > 0 ? down : side[i] < 0 ? up : min(down, up)
        }
        let dx0 = abs(g[0] - e[0]), dx1 = abs(g[2] - e[2]), dy0 = abs(g[1] - e[1]), dy1 = abs(g[3] - e[3])
        anchor = (dx0 + dx1 < 0.5 ? 0.5 : dx0 / (dx0 + dx1), dy0 + dy1 < 0.5 ? 0.5 : dy0 / (dy0 + dy1))
        // The least damping (from the feel up to critical) that keeps every edge's overshoot
        // inside its allowance; long flights get a touch more, short ones keep the feel's.
        let w = omega
        func fits(_ z: Double) -> Bool {
            (0..<4).allSatisfy { Self.overshoot(e0: e[$0] - g[$0], v0: v[$0], omega: w, zeta: z) <= allow[$0] + 0.25 }
        }
        if fits(feel.damping) { damping = feel.damping; return }
        var lo = feel.damping, hi = 1.0
        if !fits(hi) { damping = hi; return }
        for _ in 0..<14 { let m = (lo + hi) / 2; if fits(m) { hi = m } else { lo = m } }
        damping = hi
    }

    /// How far a damped spring released at displacement e0 with velocity v0 swings past its
    /// goal on the far side (both sides when it starts at the goal). Closed form, sampled.
    static func overshoot(e0: Double, v0: Double, omega w: Double, zeta z: Double) -> Double {
        let s: Double = abs(e0) < 0.5 ? 0 : (e0 > 0 ? 1 : -1)
        var worst = 0.0
        let settle = min(3.0, 8 / (max(0.2, z) * w))
        var t = 0.002
        while t < settle {
            let e: Double
            if z < 0.999 {
                let wd = w * sqrt(1 - z * z)
                e = exp(-z * w * t) * (e0 * cos(wd * t) + (v0 + z * w * e0) / wd * sin(wd * t))
            } else {
                e = exp(-w * t) * (e0 + (v0 + w * e0) * t)
            }
            worst = max(worst, s == 0 ? abs(e) : -s * e)
            t += 0.002
        }
        return worst
    }

    /// Semi-implicit Euler in ≤1 ms substeps (stable for any frame time).
    mutating func step(_ dt: Double) {
        guard dt > 0 else { return }
        let w = omega, k = w * w, c = 2 * damping * w
        let n = max(1, Int((dt / 0.001).rounded(.up))), h = dt / Double(n)
        for _ in 0..<n {
            for i in 0..<4 {
                vel[i] += (-k * (pos[i] - goal[i]) - c * vel[i]) * h
                pos[i] += vel[i] * h
            }
            holdEdges()
        }
    }

    /// The overshoot allowance as a wall the state itself stops at (the damping chosen at the
    /// retarget almost always keeps it clear): what's drawn is the spring, so a later retarget
    /// starts from exactly what's on screen.
    private mutating func holdEdges() {
        var e = edgePos, v = edgeVel
        let g = edgeGoal
        var hit = false
        for i in 0..<4 {
            if side[i] >= 0, e[i] < g[i] - allow[i] { e[i] = g[i] - allow[i]; v[i] = max(0, v[i]); hit = true }
            if side[i] <= 0, e[i] > g[i] + allow[i] { e[i] = g[i] + allow[i]; v[i] = min(0, v[i]); hit = true }
        }
        guard hit else { return }
        pos = [e[0], e[1], e[2] - e[0], e[3] - e[1]]
        vel = [v[0], v[1], v[2] - v[0], v[3] - v[1]]
    }

    /// Close enough to stop and land on the exact target (half a point, a few points a second).
    var settled: Bool { (0..<4).allSatisfy { abs(pos[$0] - goal[$0]) < 0.5 && abs(vel[$0]) < 6 } }

    /// The frame to draw: the spring, never smaller than `minSize` (the extra goes where the
    /// anchor says).
    func output(minSize: CGSize? = nil) -> CGRect {
        var r = CGRect(x: pos[0], y: pos[1], width: max(Self.minSide, pos[2]), height: max(Self.minSide, pos[3]))
        if let m = minSize, m.width > r.width || m.height > r.height {
            r = Self.place(CGSize(width: max(r.width, m.width), height: max(r.height, m.height)), in: r, anchor: anchor)
        }
        return r
    }

    /// A frame of `size` standing in for `r` (an app still at its last size, or one that won't
    /// go smaller): the edges that travel absorb the difference, the ones that stay keep still.
    static func place(_ size: CGSize, in r: CGRect, anchor: (x: Double, y: Double)) -> CGRect {
        CGRect(x: r.minX + (r.width - size.width) * anchor.x, y: r.minY + (r.height - size.height) * anchor.y,
               width: size.width, height: size.height)
    }
}

enum WindowMotionMath {
    /// How many frames apart an app gets a new size so its writes fit the frame: every frame
    /// when it keeps up, otherwise every 2nd, 3rd… (position still every frame), at most 6.
    static func sizeEvery(resizeMs: Double, moveMs: Double, windows: Int, frameMs: Double) -> Int {
        let budget = frameMs * 0.9, n = Double(max(1, windows))
        for k in 1...6 where n * (moveMs + resizeMs / Double(k)) <= budget { return k }
        return 6
    }

    /// Exponentially weighted moving average that a lone spike (an Electron app's 80 ms
    /// relayout) can't throw: a sample counts for at most 4× the average. A real slowdown
    /// still gets through in a few frames.
    static func ewma(_ old: Double?, _ sample: Double, weight: Double = 0.25) -> Double {
        guard let old else { return min(sample, 8) }
        return old + (min(sample, max(4 * old, 1)) - old) * weight
    }
}

/// An app's minimum window size, learned from shrinking writes it refuses: twice in a row
/// asked for less, twice the same size back, more than a terminal cell short. Smaller
/// refusals are resize increments (a terminal rounding to its cell grid).
struct MinSizeLearner {
    private var last: (requested: CGSize, actual: CGSize)?
    /// Bigger than any terminal's cell.
    static let beyondIncrements: CGFloat = 24
    private(set) var minWidth: CGFloat?
    private(set) var minHeight: CGFloat?

    var learned: CGSize? {
        guard minWidth != nil || minHeight != nil else { return nil }
        return CGSize(width: minWidth ?? 0, height: minHeight ?? 0)
    }

    /// True when this observation taught something new.
    @discardableResult
    mutating func observe(requested: CGSize, actual: CGSize) -> Bool {
        defer { last = (requested, actual) }
        guard let last else { return false }
        var changed = false
        if actual.width > requested.width + Self.beyondIncrements, last.actual.width > last.requested.width + 1,
           abs(actual.width - last.actual.width) <= 0.5, last.requested.width > requested.width + 0.5,
           minWidth.map({ abs($0 - actual.width) > 0.5 }) ?? true {
            minWidth = actual.width; changed = true
        }
        if actual.height > requested.height + Self.beyondIncrements, last.actual.height > last.requested.height + 1,
           abs(actual.height - last.actual.height) <= 0.5, last.requested.height > requested.height + 0.5,
           minHeight.map({ abs($0 - actual.height) > 0.5 }) ?? true {
            minHeight = actual.height; changed = true
        }
        return changed
    }
}
//
//  EdgeWindowTiles.swift
//  The window mosaic both the Caps+Tab switcher and the bar's Windows card draw: justified
//  rows of thumbnails (WindowMosaic), each with its app icon as the color chip. Text only
//  where a picture can't tell windows apart (the selected tile, or icon-only tiles).
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct WindowTileItem: Identifiable {
    let id: UInt32
    let title: String
    let icon: NSImage
    let thumbnail: CGImage?
    /// Minimized, or its app is hidden.
    let dimmed: Bool
}

struct WindowMosaicView: View {
    let items: [WindowTileItem]
    let layout: WindowMosaic.Layout
    let selected: UInt32?
    var hints: [UInt32: Character] = [:]
    var radius: CGFloat
    /// Bumped per window to wobble it from outside (a hint key going down).
    var wobbles: [UInt32: Int] = [:]
    var onPress: (UInt32) -> Void = { _ in }
    var onCommit: (UInt32) -> Void

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
            ForEach(Array(items.prefix(layout.frames.count).enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { i, item in
                let f = layout.frames[i]
                WindowTile(item: item, selected: item.id == selected, hint: hints[item.id], radius: radius,
                           wobble: wobbles[item.id] ?? 0, onPress: { onPress(item.id) }, onCommit: { onCommit(item.id) })
                    .frame(width: f.width, height: f.height)
                    .offset(x: f.minX, y: f.minY)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: layout.size.width, height: layout.size.height, alignment: .topLeading)
    }
}

struct WindowTile: View {
    let item: WindowTileItem
    let selected: Bool
    let hint: Character?
    let radius: CGFloat
    var wobble: Int
    var onPress: () -> Void
    var onCommit: () -> Void

    @State private var pressed = false
    @State private var presses = 0

    static let ring = Color(red: 0.27, green: 0.52, blue: 1)

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: radius, style: .continuous)
        GeometryReader { geo in
            ZStack(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                if let thumb = item.thumbnail {
                    Image(decorative: thumb, scale: 2)
                        .resizable().interpolation(.medium)
                        .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)
                        // Top-aligned crop: a window's title bar and toolbar say the most.
                        .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height, alignment: .top)
                        .clipped()
                        .opacity(item.dimmed ? 0.45 : 1)
                    if selected { titleChip }
                    else { icon(22).padding(8) }
                } else {
                    // No picture: the app's own icon is the tile, its title under it.
                    VStack(spacing: 6) {
                        icon(min(64, geo.size.height * 0.46))
                        Text(item.title).font(.pp(11.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(item.dimmed ? 0.5 : 0.9))
                            .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle).padding(.horizontal, 8)
                    }
                    .opacity(item.dimmed ? 0.55 : 1)
                    .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height)
                }
            }
            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height, alignment: .bottomLeading)
            .background(shape.fill(Color(white: 0.16)))
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                if let hint {
                    Text(String(hint).uppercased())
                        .font(.pp(12, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.black)
                        .frame(width: 22, height: 22)
                        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6, style: .continuous).fill(.white))
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 3, y: 1)
                        .padding(8)
                }
            }
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(selected ? Self.ring : .clear, lineWidth: 2.5))
            .contentShape(shape)
        }
        // Clunky press like the module tiles: squash and tip, then spring back.
        .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: TileWobble(), trigger: wobble + presses) { view, w in
            view.scaleEffect(w.scale).rotationEffect(.degrees(w.tilt))
        } keyframes: { _ in
            KeyframeTrack(\.scale) {
                SpringKeyframe(0.92, duration: 0.07)
                SpringKeyframe(1.03, duration: 0.12, spring: .snappy)
                SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.16, spring: .bouncy)
            }
            KeyframeTrack(\.tilt) {
                SpringKeyframe(-2.5, duration: 0.07)
                SpringKeyframe(1.5, duration: 0.1)
                SpringKeyframe(0, duration: 0.18, spring: .bouncy)
            }
        }
        .gesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
            .onChanged { _ in
                guard !pressed else { return }
                pressed = true; presses += 1; onPress()
            }
            .onEnded { v in
                pressed = false
                // A press that slides off the tile is a cancel.
                if abs(v.translation.width) < 24, abs(v.translation.height) < 24 { onCommit() }
            })
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel(item.title)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
    }

    private func icon(_ size: CGFloat) -> some View {
        Image(nsImage: item.icon).resizable().interpolation(.high).scaledToFit()
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.45), radius: 3, y: 1)
    }

    /// Selected thumbnail: icon chip and the window's title on a dark capsule.
    private var titleChip: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            icon(20)
            Text(item.title).font(.pp(11.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white)
                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
        }
        .padding(.leading, 4).padding(.trailing, 10).padding(.vertical, 4)
        .background(Capsule().fill(.black.opacity(0.62)))
        .padding(6)
    }
}

private struct TileWobble {
    var scale: CGFloat = 1
    var tilt: Double = 0
}
//
//  EdgeTimeZones.swift
//  Time-zone quick answers: "time in tokyo", "tokyo time", "3pm london in my time",
//  "9:30am pst to cet", "3pm in tokyo tomorrow", "1:30am new york on 2026-11-01".
//  Pure Foundation (tools/calendar-test runs it headless). Wall-clock times are resolved
//  in the source zone on that zone's date, so DST gaps and repeats are handled there.
//

import Foundation

struct EdgeTimeAnswer: Equatable {
    var title: String
    var subtitle: String
    /// The instant answered (for tests and copy).
    var date: Date
    var zone: TimeZone
}

enum EdgeTimeZones {
    struct Place: Equatable {
        var zone: TimeZone
        var name: String
        var isHere: Bool
    }

    // MARK: Answer

    static func answer(_ raw: String, now: Date = Date(), here: TimeZone = .current, locale: Locale = .current) -> EdgeTimeAnswer? {
        var q = raw.lowercased().trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines.union(CharacterSet(charactersIn: "?")))
        q = q.replacingOccurrences(of: #"\s+"#, with: " ", options: .regularExpression)
        q = q.replacingOccurrences(of: "’", with: "'")
        guard q.count >= 6, q.count <= 80 else { return nil }
        for lead in ["what's ", "whats ", "what is ", "convert "] where q.hasPrefix(lead) { q = String(q.dropFirst(lead.count)) }

        // "time in tokyo", "what time is it in tokyo", "tokyo time", "now in tokyo".
        for pattern in [#"^(?:the )?(?:current |local )?time(?: is it)?(?: now)? (?:in|at) (.+)$"#, #"^(?:what )?time (?:is it )?(?:in|at) (.+)$"#,
                        #"^now in (.+)$"#, #"^time (.+)$"#, #"^(.+?) time(?: now)?$"#] {
            if let place = capture(pattern, in: q), let target = self.place(place, here: here), !target.isHere {
                return nowAnswer(target, now: now, here: here, locale: locale)
            }
        }

        // "<time> [date] [source] [date] (in|to) <target>", or "<time> <source>" (to here).
        var rest = q.hasPrefix("at ") ? String(q.dropFirst(3)) : q
        guard let clock = leadingClock(&rest) else { return nil }
        let day = takeDay(&rest)
        rest = rest.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard !rest.isEmpty else { return nil }
        var source: Place, target: Place
        if let m = groups(#"^(?:(.+?) )?(?:in|to|into|as) (.+)$"#, in: rest) {
            let src = m[0] ?? ""
            guard let t = place(m[1] ?? "", here: here) else { return nil }
            target = t
            if src.isEmpty { source = Place(zone: here, name: "here", isHere: true) }
            else if let s = place(src, here: here) { source = s } else { return nil }
        } else if let s = place(rest, here: here) {
            source = s; target = Place(zone: here, name: "here", isHere: true)
        } else { return nil }
        guard source.zone.identifier != target.zone.identifier || source.zone.secondsFromGMT(for: now) != target.zone.secondsFromGMT(for: now) else { return nil }
        return convert(clock, day: day, from: source, to: target, now: now, here: here, locale: locale)
    }

    private static func nowAnswer(_ target: Place, now: Date, here: TimeZone, locale: Locale) -> EdgeTimeAnswer {
        var title = format(now, in: target.zone, locale: locale)
        if !sameDay(now, target.zone, now, here) { title += " " + weekday(now, in: target.zone, locale: locale) }
        return EdgeTimeAnswer(title: title, subtitle: target.name + " · " + offsetText(target.zone, here, at: now), date: now, zone: target.zone)
    }

    private static func convert(_ clock: (h: Int, m: Int), day: DayWord?, from source: Place, to target: Place, now: Date, here: TimeZone, locale: Locale) -> EdgeTimeAnswer? {
        let cal = calendar(source.zone)
        // The date is the source zone's: "3pm london" means today in London.
        var base = cal.startOfDay(for: now)
        switch day {
        case .offset(let n)?: base = cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: n, to: base)!
        case .date(let y, let mo, let d)?:
            guard let b = cal.date(from: DateComponents(year: y, month: mo, day: d)) else { return nil }
            base = b
        case .monthDay(let mo, let d)?:
            let year = cal.component(.year, from: now)
            guard var b = cal.date(from: DateComponents(year: year, month: mo, day: d)) else { return nil }
            // "mar 8" in November means next March.
            if b < cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: -1, to: base)! { b = cal.date(byAdding: .year, value: 1, to: b)! }
            base = b
        case nil: break
        }
        // Wall clock → instant in the source zone. A time the clocks skip (spring forward)
        // lands just after the gap; a repeated hour (fall back) takes the first pass.
        guard let instant = cal.nextDate(after: base.addingTimeInterval(-1), matching: DateComponents(hour: clock.h, minute: clock.m, second: 0),
                                         matchingPolicy: .nextTimePreservingSmallerComponents, repeatedTimePolicy: .first, direction: .forward)
        else { return nil }
        let got = cal.dateComponents([.hour, .minute], from: instant)
        var notes: [String] = []
        if got.hour != clock.h || got.minute != clock.m {
            notes.append(clockText(clock.h, clock.m, locale) + " skipped (DST)")
        } else if let later = cal.date(byAdding: .hour, value: 1, to: instant),
                  cal.dateComponents([.hour, .minute], from: later) == got {
            notes.append("first of two")
        }
        var title = format(instant, in: target.zone, locale: locale)
        if !sameDay(instant, target.zone, instant, source.zone) {
            title += " " + weekday(instant, in: target.zone, locale: locale)
        }
        var from = format(instant, in: source.zone, locale: locale)
        if day != nil || !sameDay(instant, source.zone, now, here) { from += " " + weekday(instant, in: source.zone, locale: locale) }
        let subtitle = ([from + " " + source.name + " → " + target.name] + notes).joined(separator: " · ")
        return EdgeTimeAnswer(title: title, subtitle: subtitle, date: instant, zone: target.zone)
    }

    // MARK: Pieces

    private static func leadingClock(_ s: inout String) -> (h: Int, m: Int)? {
        for (word, h) in [("noon", 12), ("midday", 12), ("midnight", 0)] where s.hasPrefix(word + " ") {
            s = String(s.dropFirst(word.count + 1)); return (h, 0)
        }
        guard let m = groups(#"^(\d{1,2})(?:[:.](\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a\.m\.|p\.m\.)?(?= |$)"#, in: s) else { return nil }
        let full = matchLength(#"^(\d{1,2})(?:[:.](\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a\.m\.|p\.m\.)?(?= |$)"#, in: s)
        guard var h = Int(m[0] ?? ""), m[1] != nil || m[2] != nil else { return nil }   // "3" alone isn't a time
        let minute = Int(m[1] ?? "0") ?? 0
        guard minute < 60 else { return nil }
        if let ampm = m[2] {
            guard (1...12).contains(h) else { return nil }
            let pm = ampm.hasPrefix("p")
            if h == 12 { h = pm ? 12 : 0 } else if pm { h += 12 }
        } else {
            guard h < 24 else { return nil }
        }
        s = String(s.dropFirst(full)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        return (h, minute)
    }

    enum DayWord: Equatable { case offset(Int), date(Int, Int, Int), monthDay(Int, Int) }

    private static let months = ["jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec"]

    /// Pulls a day out of anywhere in the phrase: today/tomorrow/yesterday, 2026-03-08,
    /// "mar 8", "8 march" (optionally after "on").
    private static func takeDay(_ s: inout String) -> DayWord? {
        func cut(_ pattern: String) -> [String?]? {
            let re = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern)
            let ns = s as NSString
            guard let m = re.firstMatch(in: s, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: ns.length)) else { return nil }
            let parts = (1..<m.numberOfRanges).map { m.range(at: $0).location == NSNotFound ? nil : ns.substring(with: m.range(at: $0)) }
            s = ns.replacingCharacters(in: m.range, with: " ").replacingOccurrences(of: #"\s+"#, with: " ", options: .regularExpression)
                .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            return parts
        }
        if let p = cut(#"(?:^| )(?:on )?(today|tonight|tomorrow|yesterday)(?= |$)"#) {
            return .offset(["tomorrow": 1, "yesterday": -1][p[0] ?? ""] ?? 0)
        }
        if let p = cut(#"(?:^| )(?:on )?(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})(?= |$)"#), let y = Int(p[0] ?? ""), let mo = Int(p[1] ?? ""), let d = Int(p[2] ?? "") {
            return .date(y, mo, d)
        }
        let month = #"(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?"#
        if let p = cut(#"(?:^| )(?:on )?"# + month + #" (\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?(?= |$)"#), let mo = months.firstIndex(of: p[0] ?? ""), let d = Int(p[1] ?? "") {
            return .monthDay(mo + 1, d)
        }
        if let p = cut(#"(?:^| )(?:on )?(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)? "# + month + #"(?= |$)"#), let d = Int(p[0] ?? ""), let mo = months.firstIndex(of: p[1] ?? "") {
            return .monthDay(mo + 1, d)
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// A place, abbreviation, offset or "my time" → its zone.
    static func place(_ raw: String, here: TimeZone) -> Place? {
        var s = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces.union(.punctuationCharacters))
        if s.hasPrefix("the ") { s = String(s.dropFirst(4)) }
        for tail in [" time zone", " timezone", " local time", " time", " tz"] where s.hasSuffix(tail) && s.count > tail.count {
            s = String(s.dropLast(tail.count))
        }
        guard !s.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if ["my time", "my timezone", "my time zone", "my zone", "local", "here", "me", "mine", "my place", "my clock"].contains(s) || s == "my" {
            return Place(zone: here, name: "here", isHere: true)
        }
        if ["utc", "gmt", "z", "zulu"].contains(s) { return Place(zone: TimeZone(identifier: "UTC")!, name: "UTC", isHere: false) }
        if let m = groups(#"^(?:utc|gmt) ?([+-]) ?(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?$"#, in: s), let h = Int(m[1] ?? ""), h <= 14 {
            let mins = Int(m[2] ?? "0") ?? 0
            let secs = (h * 3600 + mins * 60) * (m[0] == "-" ? -1 : 1)
            guard let zone = TimeZone(secondsFromGMT: secs) else { return nil }
            return Place(zone: zone, name: "UTC" + (m[0] ?? "+") + String(h) + (mins > 0 ? String(format: ":%02d", mins) : ""), isHere: false)
        }
        if let (id, name) = aliases[s], let zone = TimeZone(identifier: id) {
            return Place(zone: zone, name: name, isHere: zone.identifier == here.identifier)
        }
        if let id = cities[s], let zone = TimeZone(identifier: id) {
            return Place(zone: zone, name: s.split(separator: " ").map { $0.prefix(1).uppercased() + $0.dropFirst() }.joined(separator: " "),
                         isHere: zone.identifier == here.identifier)
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// Every tz database city ("new york", "kolkata", "sao paulo") and full id ("asia/tokyo").
    private static let cities: [String: String] = {
        var out: [String: String] = [:]
        for id in TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers where id.contains("/") && !id.hasPrefix("Etc/") {
            out[id.lowercased()] = id
            let city = id.split(separator: "/").last!.replacingOccurrences(of: "_", with: " ").lowercased()
            if out[city] == nil { out[city] = id }
        }
        return out
    }()
