    // MARK: Formatting

    private static func calendar(_ zone: TimeZone) -> Calendar {
        var c = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian); c.timeZone = zone; return c
    }

    private static func sameDay(_ a: Date, _ za: TimeZone, _ b: Date, _ zb: TimeZone) -> Bool {
        calendar(za).dateComponents([.year, .month, .day], from: a) == calendar(zb).dateComponents([.year, .month, .day], from: b)
    }

    private static func format(_ d: Date, in zone: TimeZone, locale: Locale) -> String {
        let f = DateFormatter(); f.locale = locale; f.timeZone = zone
        f.dateStyle = .none; f.timeStyle = .short
        return f.string(from: d)
    }

    private static func weekday(_ d: Date, in zone: TimeZone, locale: Locale) -> String {
        let f = DateFormatter(); f.locale = locale; f.timeZone = zone
        f.setLocalizedDateFormatFromTemplate("EEE")
        return f.string(from: d)
    }

    private static func clockText(_ h: Int, _ m: Int, _ locale: Locale) -> String {
        var c = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian); c.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "UTC")!
        let d = c.date(from: DateComponents(year: 2000, month: 1, day: 1, hour: h, minute: m))!
        return format(d, in: c.timeZone, locale: locale)
    }

    /// "+6h", "−2h 30m", "same time" (target relative to here).
    static func offsetText(_ target: TimeZone, _ here: TimeZone, at d: Date) -> String {
        let diff = target.secondsFromGMT(for: d) - here.secondsFromGMT(for: d)
        if diff == 0 { return "same time" }
        let mins = abs(diff) / 60
        let body = mins % 60 == 0 ? "\(mins / 60)h" : "\(mins / 60)h \(mins % 60)m"
        return (diff > 0 ? "+" : "−") + body
    }

    // MARK: Regex helpers

    private static func groups(_ pattern: String, in s: String) -> [String?]? {
        let re = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern)
        let ns = s as NSString
        guard let m = re.firstMatch(in: s, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: ns.length)) else { return nil }
        return (1..<m.numberOfRanges).map { m.range(at: $0).location == NSNotFound ? nil : ns.substring(with: m.range(at: $0)) }
    }

    private static func matchLength(_ pattern: String, in s: String) -> Int {
        let re = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern)
        return re.firstMatch(in: s, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: (s as NSString).length))?.range.length ?? 0
    }

    private static func capture(_ pattern: String, in s: String) -> String? {
        groups(pattern, in: s)?.first ?? nil
    }
}
//
//  ForeignSpacesCore.swift
//  Caps+digit workspaces holding other apps' windows (docs/features/windows.md#workspaces):
//  which workspace each window belongs to, what a switch does (park the leaving ones off
//  screen, bring the arriving ones back), where a window parks, and how every parked window
//  comes back on quit, crash, switch-off or a relaunch. Pure: no AppKit, no AX, no globals,
//  so tools/spaces-test runs it offline. The AX side is ForeignSpaces.swift.
//
//  Coordinates are the Accessibility API's, as in WindowLayoutCore: global points, origin at
//  the top-left of the primary display, y grows downward.
//

import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

/// One window while its app runs. CGWindowIDs are unique per window server session and the
/// pid pins the app instance, so a relaunched app's windows are new windows: unassigned.
struct SpaceWindowKey: Hashable, Codable, Comparable {
    var pid: Int32
    var id: UInt32
    static func < (a: Self, b: Self) -> Bool { (a.pid, a.id) < (b.pid, b.id) }
}

/// How a window was put away. Off screen is the normal way; minimize is the fallback for a
/// window that won't stay in a corner (or a display layout with no free corner).
enum ParkMethod: String, Codable { case offscreen, minimized }

struct SpaceWindow: Codable, Equatable {
    var key: SpaceWindowKey
    var bundle: String
    var title: String
    var workspace: Int
    /// The frame it had when it was parked: where it goes back to.
    var home: CGRect?
    var parked: ParkMethod?
}

/// Everything that's persisted (`edge.spaces.v1`). Written before any window is parked, so a
/// crash mid-switch still knows where every window belongs.
struct SpacesState: Codable, Equatable {
    var current = 1
    var windows: [SpaceWindow] = []
    /// Per workspace, the window that had focus when you left it.
    var focused: [Int: SpaceWindowKey] = [:]
    /// Parked windows whose app quit before they came back: if the app relaunches with a window
    /// still off screen (state restoration puts it where it was), it's brought back here.
    var rescue: [Rescue] = []

    struct Rescue: Codable, Equatable {
        var bundle: String
        var title: String
        var home: CGRect
        var at: Double
    }

    var parkedCount: Int { windows.filter { $0.parked != nil }.count }
}

/// A display as AX sees it.
struct SpaceDisplay: Equatable {
    var frame: CGRect
    var visible: CGRect
}

/// A window as it is now (CGWindowList for what's on screen, AX for what it is).
struct SeenWindow: Equatable {
    var key: SpaceWindowKey
    var bundle: String
    var title: String
    var frame: CGRect
    /// On this Space, not minimized, app not hidden (on-screen layer-0 window).
    var visible: Bool
    /// An ordinary window or dialog that can move and isn't full screen. Panels, palettes and
    /// full-screen windows are never parked.
    var eligible: Bool
}

enum SpacesStep: Equatable {
    /// Park at the first spot the window accepts; none accepted (or no spots) → minimize.
    case park(SpaceWindowKey, spots: [CGPoint])
    case restore(SpaceWindowKey, to: CGRect, method: ParkMethod)
}

/// What happened to a park step, reported back by the AX side.
enum ParkOutcome: Equatable { case offscreen, minimized, stayed, gone }

enum SpacesCore {
    /// Caps+1…9, 0 (0 is workspace 10).
    static let numbers = 1...10
    /// A rescue entry is kept this long for its app to come back.
    static let rescueLifetime: Double = 3 * 24 * 3600

    struct Plan: Equatable {
        var state: SpacesState
        /// Restores first (the arriving workspace shows before the leaving one goes), then parks.
        var steps: [SpacesStep]
        /// The window to focus afterwards, if any.
        var focus: SpaceWindowKey?
    }

    // MARK: Geometry

    static func displayIndex(for frame: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> Int? {
        var best: (Int, CGFloat)?
        for (i, d) in displays.enumerated() {
            let r = d.frame.intersection(frame)
            let a = r.isNull ? 0 : r.width * r.height
            if a > 0, a > (best?.1 ?? 0) { best = (i, a) }
        }
        return best?.0
    }

    /// The display nearest to `frame`'s center (for frames that are on none).
    static func nearestDisplay(to frame: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> Int? {
        let c = CGPoint(x: frame.midX, y: frame.midY)
        func distance(_ r: CGRect) -> CGFloat {
            let dx = max(r.minX - c.x, 0, c.x - r.maxX), dy = max(r.minY - c.y, 0, c.y - r.maxY)
            return dx * dx + dy * dy
        }
        return displays.indices.min { distance(displays[$0].frame) < distance(displays[$1].frame) }
    }

    /// Points of `frame` that are on any display.
    static func onDisplayArea(_ frame: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> CGFloat {
        displays.reduce(0) { sum, d in
            let r = d.frame.intersection(frame)
            return sum + (r.isNull ? 0 : r.width * r.height)
        }
    }

    /// Next to nothing of it on any display: a parked corner sliver, or nowhere at all.
    static func isOffscreen(_ frame: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> Bool {
        onDisplayArea(frame, displays: displays) < min(40 * 40, max(1, frame.width * frame.height) * 0.25)
    }

    /// Where a window of `size` that lives at `home` can park: a display corner with the window
    /// hanging off it and one point left on (AeroSpace's trick; macOS keeps windows that are
    /// entirely off every display from staying there). Its own display's corners first, the full
    /// frame's before the visible frame's (those sit above the Dock), then other displays'. A
    /// spot that would put any of the window on another display is left out, so a parked window
    /// never shows up on a neighbouring display; with no spot left it gets minimized instead.
    static func parkSpots(size: CGSize, home: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> [CGPoint] {
        guard !displays.isEmpty, size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return [] }
        let own = displayIndex(for: home, displays: displays) ?? nearestDisplay(to: home, displays: displays) ?? 0
        var spots: [CGPoint] = []
        for i in [own] + displays.indices.filter({ $0 != own }) {
            let f = displays[i].frame, v = displays[i].visible
            let candidates = [CGPoint(x: f.maxX - 1, y: f.maxY - 1), CGPoint(x: f.minX + 1 - size.width, y: f.maxY - 1),
                              CGPoint(x: v.maxX - 1, y: v.maxY - 1), CGPoint(x: v.minX + 1 - size.width, y: v.maxY - 1)]
            for p in candidates where !spots.contains(p) {
                let r = CGRect(origin: p, size: size)
                let onOthers = displays.indices.contains { j in
                    guard j != i else { return false }
                    let x = displays[j].frame.intersection(r)
                    return !x.isNull && x.width > 0.01 && x.height > 0.01
                }
                let mine = f.intersection(r)
                let sliver = mine.isNull || mine.width <= 1.01 || mine.height <= 1.01
                if !onOthers && sliver { spots.append(p) }
            }
        }
        return spots
    }

    /// Where a parked window goes back to: its own frame while its title bar is still on a
    /// display; otherwise (that display is gone) the same size, centered on the nearest one.
    static func homeFrame(_ home: CGRect, displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> CGRect {
        guard !displays.isEmpty else { return home }
        let bar = CGRect(x: home.minX, y: home.minY, width: home.width, height: min(28, home.height))
        let reachable = displays.contains { d in
            let r = d.frame.intersection(bar)
            return !r.isNull && r.width >= min(60, home.width) && r.height >= min(10, bar.height)
        }
        if reachable { return home }
        let v = displays[nearestDisplay(to: home, displays: displays) ?? 0].visible
        let w = min(home.width, v.width), h = min(home.height, v.height)
        return CGRect(x: (v.midX - w / 2).rounded(), y: (v.midY - h / 2).rounded(), width: w, height: h)
    }

    // MARK: Bookkeeping

    /// Bring the records in line with what exists now. A window whose app quit is dropped (if it
    /// was parked, its app gets a rescue entry); a closed one is dropped; a parked one that's
    /// back on a display by other means (the Dock, the app, a display change) belongs to the
    /// workspace you're in now. `alive` maps running pids to their bundle ids; `exists` holds the
    /// windows known to exist; `unsure` pids didn't answer AX, so their records are kept as is.
    static func reconcile(_ s: SpacesState, seen: [SeenWindow], exists: Set<SpaceWindowKey>, alive: [Int32: String],
                          unsure: Set<Int32> = [], displays: [SpaceDisplay], now: Double) -> SpacesState {
        var out = s
        out.windows = []
        let seenBy = Dictionary(seen.map { ($0.key, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        for var w in s.windows {
            guard let bundle = alive[w.key.pid], bundle == w.bundle else {
                if w.parked != nil, let home = w.home {
                    out.rescue.append(.init(bundle: w.bundle, title: w.title, home: home, at: now))
                }
                continue
            }
            let v = seenBy[w.key]
            if !unsure.contains(w.key.pid), v == nil, !exists.contains(w.key) { continue }   // closed
            if w.parked != nil, let v, v.visible, !isOffscreen(v.frame, displays: displays) {
                w.parked = nil; w.home = nil; w.workspace = s.current
            }
            if let v, !v.title.isEmpty { w.title = v.title }
            out.windows.append(w)
        }
        out.rescue = out.rescue.filter { now - $0.at < rescueLifetime && now >= $0.at - 60 }
        out.focused = out.focused.filter { _, k in out.windows.contains { $0.key == k } }
        return out
    }

    /// Caps+digit. Every ordinary window on screen that isn't anyone's yet belongs to the
    /// workspace you're leaving (an empty workspace is a clear desk); the target's parked
    /// windows come back where they were; everything else on screen parks.
    static func switchPlan(_ s: SpacesState, to target: Int, seen: [SeenWindow], focused: SpaceWindowKey?,
                           displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> Plan {
        guard target != s.current else { return Plan(state: s, steps: [], focus: nil) }
        var st = adopt(s, seen: seen, displays: displays)
        if let f = focused, let w = st.windows.first(where: { $0.key == f }), w.workspace == s.current, w.parked == nil {
            st.focused[s.current] = f
        }
        let seenBy = Dictionary(seen.map { ($0.key, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        var restores: [SpacesStep] = [], parks: [SpacesStep] = []
        for i in st.windows.indices {
            var w = st.windows[i]
            if w.workspace == target {
                if let m = w.parked {
                    if let home = w.home { restores.append(.restore(w.key, to: homeFrame(home, displays: displays), method: m)) }
                    w.parked = nil; w.home = nil
                }
            } else if w.parked == nil, let v = seenBy[w.key], v.visible, v.eligible, !isOffscreen(v.frame, displays: displays) {
                let spots = parkSpots(size: v.frame.size, home: v.frame, displays: displays)
                parks.append(.park(w.key, spots: spots))
                w.home = v.frame; w.parked = spots.isEmpty ? .minimized : .offscreen
            }
            st.windows[i] = w
        }
        st.current = target
        let mine = Set(st.windows.filter { $0.workspace == target }.map(\.key))
        // Focus on arrival: the one you left focused there, else its frontmost window.
        let focus = st.focused[target].flatMap { mine.contains($0) ? $0 : nil }
            ?? seen.first { mine.contains($0.key) && $0.eligible }?.key
        return Plan(state: st, steps: restores + parks, focus: focus)
    }

    /// Caps+Shift+digit: this window belongs to workspace `number` now. Leaving for another
    /// workspace, it parks and focus goes to the frontmost window still here; it'll be the
    /// focused one when you get there. Nil when it isn't a window workspaces hold.
    static func sendPlan(_ s: SpacesState, window v: SeenWindow, to number: Int, seen: [SeenWindow],
                         displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> Plan? {
        guard v.eligible, numbers.contains(number) else { return nil }
        var st = s
        let i: Int
        if let found = st.windows.firstIndex(where: { $0.key == v.key }) { i = found }
        else { st.windows.append(SpaceWindow(key: v.key, bundle: v.bundle, title: v.title, workspace: number)); i = st.windows.count - 1 }
        st.windows[i].workspace = number
        var steps: [SpacesStep] = []
        if number != s.current {
            if st.windows[i].parked == nil, v.visible, !isOffscreen(v.frame, displays: displays) {
                let spots = parkSpots(size: v.frame.size, home: v.frame, displays: displays)
                steps = [.park(v.key, spots: spots)]
                st.windows[i].home = v.frame
                st.windows[i].parked = spots.isEmpty ? .minimized : .offscreen
            }
            st.focused[number] = v.key
            if st.focused[s.current] == v.key { st.focused[s.current] = nil }
        } else if let m = st.windows[i].parked, let home = st.windows[i].home {
            steps = [.restore(v.key, to: homeFrame(home, displays: displays), method: m)]
            st.windows[i].parked = nil; st.windows[i].home = nil
        }
        guard number != s.current else { return Plan(state: st, steps: steps, focus: nil) }
        let theirs = Dictionary(st.windows.map { ($0.key, $0.workspace) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        let next = seen.first { w in
            w.key != v.key && w.visible && w.eligible && (theirs[w.key] ?? s.current) == s.current
                && st.windows.first { $0.key == w.key }?.parked == nil
        }?.key
        return Plan(state: st, steps: steps, focus: next)
    }

    /// Every parked window back where it was: quit, switch-off, Settings → Bring all back,
    /// and the first thing at launch. `forget` drops the assignments too (switching it off).
    static func restoreAllPlan(_ s: SpacesState, displays: [SpaceDisplay], forget: Bool) -> Plan {
        var st = s
        var steps: [SpacesStep] = []
        for i in st.windows.indices {
            guard let m = st.windows[i].parked else { continue }
            if let home = st.windows[i].home { steps.append(.restore(st.windows[i].key, to: homeFrame(home, displays: displays), method: m)) }
            st.windows[i].parked = nil; st.windows[i].home = nil
        }
        if forget { st.windows = []; st.focused = [:] }
        return Plan(state: st, steps: steps, focus: nil)
    }

    /// What to persist before a plan runs: the plan's state, except that a window stays
    /// recorded as parked (with its home) until its restore has actually happened. A crash at
    /// any point of the plan then still knows how to bring back every window that's away.
    static func writeAhead(old: SpacesState, new: SpacesState) -> SpacesState {
        var st = new
        let before = Dictionary(old.windows.map { ($0.key, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
        for i in st.windows.indices where st.windows[i].parked == nil {
            if let o = before[st.windows[i].key], o.parked != nil, o.home != nil {
                st.windows[i].parked = o.parked; st.windows[i].home = o.home
            }
        }
        let kept = Set(st.windows.map(\.key))
        st.windows += old.windows.filter { $0.parked != nil && $0.home != nil && !kept.contains($0.key) }
        return st
    }

    /// What a park step actually did. A window that refused every spot and minimize stays where
    /// it is (on screen, so nothing is lost); a gone one is forgotten.
    static func record(_ s: SpacesState, _ key: SpaceWindowKey, _ outcome: ParkOutcome) -> SpacesState {
        var st = s
        guard let i = st.windows.firstIndex(where: { $0.key == key }) else { return st }
        switch outcome {
        case .offscreen: st.windows[i].parked = .offscreen
        case .minimized: st.windows[i].parked = .minimized
        case .stayed: st.windows[i].parked = nil; st.windows[i].home = nil
        case .gone: st.windows.remove(at: i)
        }
        return st
    }

    /// A restore that found no window: forget it.
    static func forget(_ s: SpacesState, _ key: SpaceWindowKey) -> SpacesState {
        var st = s
        st.windows.removeAll { $0.key == key }
        st.focused = st.focused.filter { $0.value != key }
        return st
    }

    /// An app came back after quitting with windows parked: its windows that are still off
    /// screen go back to the parked windows' homes (same title first, then in order). Only apps
    /// with rescue entries are looked at, so apps that keep windows off screen on purpose are
    /// left alone.
    static func rescuePlan(_ s: SpacesState, bundle: String, windows: [(key: SpaceWindowKey, title: String, frame: CGRect)],
                           displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> (state: SpacesState, moves: [(SpaceWindowKey, CGRect)]) {
        var st = s
        var moves: [(SpaceWindowKey, CGRect)] = []
        for w in windows where isOffscreen(w.frame, displays: displays) {
            let mine = st.rescue.indices.filter { st.rescue[$0].bundle == bundle }
            guard let pick = mine.first(where: { st.rescue[$0].title == w.title }) ?? mine.first else { break }
            moves.append((w.key, homeFrame(st.rescue[pick].home, displays: displays)))
            st.rescue.remove(at: pick)
        }
        return (st, moves)
    }

    /// Visible, ordinary windows nobody has yet join the current workspace. One some app keeps
    /// off screen on purpose isn't one of yours.
    static func adopt(_ s: SpacesState, seen: [SeenWindow], displays: [SpaceDisplay]) -> SpacesState {
        var st = s
        var known = Set(st.windows.map(\.key))
        for v in seen where v.visible && v.eligible && !known.contains(v.key) && !isOffscreen(v.frame, displays: displays) {
            st.windows.append(SpaceWindow(key: v.key, bundle: v.bundle, title: v.title, workspace: s.current))
            known.insert(v.key)
        }
        return st
    }
}
//
//  EdgeTermPeek.swift
//  A command that finishes while the terminal is out of sight, or a program asking for
//  you (OSC 9/777, the bell), peeks up from the screen edge as one line of your terminal.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Peek ("needs you")

/// What peeks up from the screen edge when the terminal is out of sight.
struct EdgeTermNotice: Equatable {
    enum Kind { case done, failed, attention }
    var kind: Kind
    var title: String          // the command, or the program's notification title
    var detail: String         // the output's last line, or the notification body
    var duration: TimeInterval?
    var blockID: Int?
    var sessionID: String = ""
}

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeTermPeekModel {
    var notice: EdgeTermNotice?
    /// The last notice you haven't looked at yet: it outlives the peek (which sinks after
    /// 6s) until that session is in front of you. The notch island shows it.
    var waiting: EdgeTermNotice?
    var hovering = false
    /// Above the open edge stack (a card) rather than rising from the screen edge (a sheet).
    var floating = false
}

/// A small sheet that rises from the bottom edge with the result, without taking the
/// keyboard. Click it to bring the terminal up at that command; it sinks back on its own.
@MainActor final class EdgeTermPeek {
    static let shared = EdgeTermPeek()
    /// Brings the terminal up (set by the edge controller), scrolled to the block.
    var openTerminal: ((_ session: String, _ block: Int?) -> Void)?
    /// How tall the open edge stack stands above the screen edge (nil: the layer is closed).
    var stackHeight: (() -> CGFloat?)?

    private let model = EdgeTermPeekModel()
    /// The notice still waiting for you (observable), until you look at its session.
    var waiting: EdgeTermNotice? { model.waiting }
    private var waitingExpiry: DispatchWorkItem?
    /// A finished command stops waiting after this long; a program asking for you doesn't.
    static let doneLingers: TimeInterval = 300
    private var panel: NSPanel?
    private var hideWork: DispatchWorkItem?
    private var lastBell = Date.distantPast
    private let motion: WorkspacePlacement = {
        let m = WorkspacePlacement()
        m.snappy = true
        m.managesMouse = false
        return m
    }()

    static let size = CGSize(width: 620, height: 38)
    private static let overscan: CGFloat = 40   // glass below the edge, so the overshoot never shows its bottom

    /// Commands at least this long announce themselves when they finish out of sight.
    static let longCommand: TimeInterval = 8

    func commandFinished(_ block: EdgeTermBlock, lastLine: String, sessionID: String, terminalVisible: Bool) {
        guard !terminalVisible, let duration = block.duration, duration >= Self.longCommand else { return }
        show(EdgeTermNotice(kind: block.failed ? .failed : .done, title: block.command, detail: lastLine,
                            duration: duration, blockID: block.id, sessionID: sessionID))
    }

    func attention(title: String, body: String, sessionID: String, terminalVisible: Bool) {
        guard !terminalVisible else { return }
        show(EdgeTermNotice(kind: .attention, title: title.isEmpty ? body : title, detail: title.isEmpty ? "" : body, sessionID: sessionID))
    }

    func bell(lastLine: String, sessionID: String, terminalVisible: Bool) {
        guard !terminalVisible, Date().timeIntervalSince(lastBell) > 5 else { return }
        lastBell = Date()
        show(EdgeTermNotice(kind: .attention, title: lastLine, detail: "", sessionID: sessionID))
    }

    private func show(_ notice: EdgeTermNotice) {
        let p = preparePanel()
        model.notice = notice
        model.waiting = notice
        waitingExpiry?.cancel()
        if notice.kind != .attention {
            let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
                if self?.model.waiting == notice { self?.model.waiting = nil }
            }
            waitingExpiry = work
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + Self.doneLingers, execute: work)
        }
        guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        let above = stackHeight?()
        let wasUp = p.isVisible && p.alphaValue > 0
        model.floating = above != nil
        let target = restingFrame(on: screen, above: above)
        if !wasUp {
            if above != nil {
                // Over the open stack: a card that rises a little and fades in.
                p.setFrame(target.offsetBy(dx: 0, dy: -14), display: false)
                p.alphaValue = 0
                p.orderFrontRegardless()
                NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { $0.duration = 0.14; p.animator().alphaValue = 1 }
            } else {
                p.setFrame(target.offsetBy(dx: 0, dy: -(Self.size.height + 12)), display: false)
                p.alphaValue = 1
                p.orderFrontRegardless()
            }
        }
        motion.window = p
        motion.move(target)
        scheduleHide(after: 6)
    }

    /// You're looking at this session now (the terminal is up and key on it).
    func seen(session: String) {
        guard let w = model.waiting, w.sessionID == session else { return }
        model.waiting = nil
        waitingExpiry?.cancel()
    }

    /// Brings the terminal up at the notice's session and command (the peek's click, the
    /// island's card): one route, journaled with where it came from.
    func open(_ notice: EdgeTermNotice, source: String) {
        let kind = switch notice.kind { case .done: "done"; case .failed: "failed"; case .attention: "attention" }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("edge.open_notice", params: ["kind": kind, "source": source])
        if model.notice != nil { dismiss() }
        model.waiting = nil
        openTerminal?(notice.sessionID, notice.blockID)
    }

    func dismiss() {
        hideWork?.cancel()
        guard let p = panel, p.isVisible else { return }
        motion.window = p
        if model.floating { NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { $0.duration = 0.14; p.animator().alphaValue = 0 } }
        motion.move(p.frame.offsetBy(dx: 0, dy: -(model.floating ? 14 : Self.size.height + 12)), transient: true) { [weak self] in
            p.alphaValue = 0
            p.orderOut(nil)
            self?.model.notice = nil
        }
    }

    private func scheduleHide(after seconds: TimeInterval) {
        hideWork?.cancel()
        let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            if self.model.hovering { self.scheduleHide(after: 1.5) } else { self.dismiss() }
        }
        hideWork = work
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + seconds, execute: work)
    }

    private func restingFrame(on screen: NSScreen, above stack: CGFloat?) -> NSRect {
        let f = screen.frame
        if let stack {
            return NSRect(x: f.midX - Self.size.width / 2, y: f.minY + stack + EdgeLayout.gap,
                          width: Self.size.width, height: Self.size.height)
        }
        return NSRect(x: f.midX - Self.size.width / 2, y: f.minY - Self.overscan,
                      width: Self.size.width, height: Self.size.height + Self.overscan)
    }

    private func preparePanel() -> NSPanel {
        if let panel { return panel }
        let p = NSPanel(contentRect: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: Self.size), styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel],
                        backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        p.isFloatingPanel = true
        p.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 4)
        p.backgroundColor = .clear
        p.isOpaque = false
        p.hasShadow = false
        p.hidesOnDeactivate = false
        p.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .stationary, .ignoresCycle]
        let view = EdgeTermPeekView(model: model, overscan: Self.overscan) { [weak self] in
            guard let self, let notice = self.model.notice else { return }
            self.open(notice, source: "peek")
        } onHover: { [weak self] inside in
            self?.model.hovering = inside
        }
        p.contentView = NSHostingView(rootView: view)
        panel = p
        return p
    }
}

/// One line of your terminal, in your font and colors: a mark (✓ ✗ •), the command, its
/// last line, how long it took. Nothing else.
private struct EdgeTermPeekView: View {
    let model: EdgeTermPeekModel
    let overscan: CGFloat
    let onOpen: () -> Void
    let onHover: (Bool) -> Void
    @State private var pressed = false

    var body: some View {
        let config = EdgeTerminalHost.shared.look.config
        let font = Font(config.fonts()[0])
        let fg = Color(nsColor: config.foreground.color)
        let shape = UnevenRoundedRectangle(topLeadingRadius: 14, bottomLeadingRadius: model.floating ? 14 : 0,
                                           bottomTrailingRadius: model.floating ? 14 : 0, topTrailingRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            if let n = model.notice {
                Text(Self.mark(n.kind)).foregroundStyle(tint(n.kind, config))
                Text(" " + n.title).foregroundStyle(fg)
                if !n.detail.isEmpty { Text("  " + n.detail).foregroundStyle(fg.opacity(0.5)) }
                Spacer(minLength: 12)
                if let d = n.duration { Text(Self.format(d)).foregroundStyle(fg.opacity(0.5)) }
            }
        }
        .font(font)
        .lineLimit(1)
        .truncationMode(.middle)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .frame(height: EdgeTermPeek.size.height)
        .padding(.bottom, model.floating ? 0 : overscan)
        .background(Color(nsColor: config.backgroundColor), in: shape)
        .overlay(shape.stroke(fg.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.3), radius: 10, y: -2)
        .offset(y: pressed ? 2 : 0)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.16, dampingFraction: 0.6), value: pressed)
        .contentShape(shape)
        .onHover(perform: onHover)
        .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0, pressing: { pressed = $0 }, perform: onOpen)
    }

    private static func mark(_ kind: EdgeTermNotice.Kind) -> String {
        switch kind { case .done: "✓"; case .failed: "✗"; case .attention: "•" }
    }

    /// Your palette's green, red and yellow.
    private func tint(_ kind: EdgeTermNotice.Kind, _ config: EdgeTermConfig) -> Color {
        let fallback: [Int: EdgeRGB] = [1: EdgeRGB(r: 204, g: 102, b: 102), 2: EdgeRGB(r: 181, g: 189, b: 104), 3: EdgeRGB(r: 240, g: 198, b: 116)]
        let index = kind == .failed ? 1 : kind == .done ? 2 : 3
        let rgb = EdgeTerminalHost.shared.view.paletteColor(index) ?? config.palette[index] ?? fallback[index]!
        return Color(nsColor: rgb.color)
    }

    static func format(_ d: TimeInterval) -> String {
        let s = Int(d.rounded())
        if s < 60 { return "\(s)s" }
        if s < 3600 { return "\(s / 60)m \(s % 60)s" }
        return "\(s / 3600)h \(s % 3600 / 60)m"
    }
}
//
//  EdgeCalendarCore.swift
//  The calendar card's brain, shared by the Mac layer and the iPhone app: EventKit access
//  and what a query means ("friday", "add lunch with sam tomorrow 1pm").
//

#if os(macOS)
import AppKit
#else
import UIKit
#endif
import EventKit
import Foundation

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeCalendarStore {
    static let shared = EdgeCalendarStore()
    @ObservationIgnored let store = EKEventStore()
    private(set) var revision = 0
    private(set) var status = EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .event)
    @ObservationIgnored private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?
    @ObservationIgnored private var requesting = false

    var hasAccess: Bool { status == .fullAccess }

    private init() {
        observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(forName: .EKEventStoreChanged, object: store, queue: .main) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.revision += 1 }
        }
    }

    /// The first calendar query asks once; afterwards the card says what's missing.
    func requestIfNeeded() {
        guard status == .notDetermined, !requesting else { return }
        requesting = true
        store.requestFullAccessToEvents { [weak self] _, _ in
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                guard let self else { return }
                self.requesting = false
                self.status = EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .event)
                self.store.refreshSourcesIfNecessary()
                self.revision += 1
            }
        }
    }

    func events(from start: Date, to end: Date) -> [EKEvent] {
        guard hasAccess else { return [] }
        let predicate = store.predicateForEvents(withStart: start, end: end, calendars: nil)
        return store.events(matching: predicate).sorted { ($0.isAllDay ? 0 : 1, $0.startDate) < ($1.isAllDay ? 0 : 1, $1.startDate) }
    }

    func events(on day: Date) -> [EKEvent] {
        let cal = Calendar.current
        let start = cal.startOfDay(for: day)
        return events(from: start, to: cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: start)!)
    }

    @discardableResult
    func add(_ draft: EdgeCalendarIntent.Draft) -> Bool {
        let chosen = EdgeSettings.calendarTarget.flatMap { store.calendar(withIdentifier: $0) }
        guard hasAccess, let calendar = chosen?.allowsContentModifications == true ? chosen : store.defaultCalendarForNewEvents else { return false }
        let event = EKEvent(eventStore: store)
        event.title = draft.title; event.startDate = draft.start; event.endDate = draft.end
        event.isAllDay = draft.allDay; event.calendar = calendar
        do { try store.save(event, span: .thisEvent); revision += 1; return true } catch { return false }
    }

    /// Opens the event in Calendar.app (the app itself when there's no event).
    func open(_ event: EKEvent?) {
        #if os(macOS)
        if let id = event?.calendarItemExternalIdentifier?.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed),
           let url = URL(string: "ical://ekevent/" + id + "?method=show&options=more"), NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) { return }
        if let app = NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier: "com.apple.iCal") {
            NSWorkspace.shared.openApplication(at: app, configuration: .init())
        }
        #else
        let at = event?.startDate ?? Date()
        if let url = URL(string: "calshow:\(at.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate)") { UIApplication.shared.open(url) }
        #endif
    }
}

/// What a query means for the calendar: a day to show, maybe an event or reminder to add,
/// and what the card should put first (the meeting to join, the reminders).
struct EdgeCalendarIntent: Equatable {
    struct Draft: Equatable { var title: String; var start: Date; var end: Date; var allDay: Bool }
    /// A reminder to add ("remind me to call mom at 5pm"). No time said = due today, no alarm.
    struct ReminderDraft: Equatable { var title: String; var due: Date; var hasTime: Bool }
    enum Focus: Equatable {
        case day
        /// "join", "join zoom": the meeting under way or next (service name, lowercased).
        case join(String?)
        /// "reminders", "todo", or a reminder to add.
        case reminders
    }
    var day: Date
    var draft: Draft?
    var focus: Focus = .day
    var reminder: ReminderDraft? = nil

    private static let words = ["cal", "calendar", "agenda", "schedule", "events"]
    private static let addPrefixes = ["add ", "new event ", "event "]
    private static let joinWords = ["join", "join meeting", "join call", "join the meeting", "join the call", "join my meeting",
                                    "join next", "join next meeting", "join the next meeting", "join now"]
    private static let joinServices = ["zoom", "meet", "teams", "webex", "facetime", "huddle", "whereby", "chime", "jitsi", "skype", "goto"]
    private static let reminderWords = ["reminders", "reminder", "my reminders", "todo", "todos", "to do", "to-do", "to dos", "todo list", "tasks", "my tasks"]
    private static let reminderPrefixes = ["remind me ", "remind ", "reminder ", "new reminder ", "todo ", "to-do "]

    /// The words beyond plain calendar queries (Mac bar): "join", "reminders",
    /// "remind me to call mom at 5pm".
    static func parseAgenda(_ raw: String, now: Date = Date()) -> EdgeCalendarIntent? {
        let q = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let lower = q.lowercased().replacingOccurrences(of: #"\s+"#, with: " ", options: .regularExpression)
        guard !lower.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if joinWords.contains(lower) { return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now, focus: .join(nil)) }
        if lower.hasPrefix("join "), let service = joinServices.first(where: { lower == "join " + $0 || lower == "join " + $0 + " call" || lower == "join " + $0 + " meeting" }) {
            return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now, focus: .join(service))
        }
        if reminderWords.contains(lower) { return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now, focus: .reminders) }
        guard let prefix = reminderPrefixes.first(where: { lower.hasPrefix($0) }) else { return nil }
        var rest = String(q.dropFirst(prefix.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        if rest.lowercased().hasPrefix("me ") { rest = String(rest.dropFirst(3)) }   // "remind me me"… and "reminder me"
        if rest.lowercased().hasPrefix("to ") { rest = String(rest.dropFirst(3)) }
        rest = rest.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard !rest.isEmpty, !["to", "me"].contains(rest.lowercased()) else { return nil }
        let cal = Calendar.current
        var title = rest
        var due = cal.startOfDay(for: now)
        var hasTime = false
        if let found = split(rest, now: now) {
            title = found.title
            due = found.date
            hasTime = found.hasTime
            if !hasTime { due = cal.startOfDay(for: due) }
            // "remind me at 9am" said at 3pm means tomorrow's 9am.
            if hasTime, due < now, cal.isDate(due, inSameDayAs: now), !found.matched.lowercased().contains("today") {
                due = cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: due)!
            }
        }
        if title.lowercased().hasPrefix("to ") { title = String(title.dropFirst(3)) }
        title = title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines.union(.punctuationCharacters))
        guard !title.isEmpty else { return nil }
        let draft = ReminderDraft(title: title.prefix(1).uppercased() + title.dropFirst(), due: due, hasTime: hasTime)
        return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: due, focus: .reminders, reminder: draft)
    }

    /// Splits "lunch with sam tomorrow 1pm" into a title and the date it names.
    /// The detector reads meal words as times ("lunch" = midday), so "lunch tomorrow
    /// 1pm" can be all date and no title. Then the leading words are the title and the
    /// date is found in what follows.
    static func split(_ rest: String, now: Date) -> (title: String, date: Date, duration: TimeInterval, hasTime: Bool, matched: String)? {
        let words = rest.split(separator: " ").map(String.init)
        for lead in 0..<max(1, words.count) {
            let head = words.prefix(lead).joined(separator: " ")
            let tail = words.dropFirst(lead).joined(separator: " ")
            guard let match = detectDate(in: tail) else { continue }
            var name = (tail as NSString).replacingCharacters(in: match.range, with: "").trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            name = [head, name].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: " ")
            for joiner in [" at", " on", " from", " for", " by"] where name.lowercased().hasSuffix(joiner) {
                name = String(name.dropLast(joiner.count))
            }
            name = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines.union(.punctuationCharacters))
            guard !name.isEmpty else { continue }
            return (name, match.date, match.duration, match.hasTime, (tail as NSString).substring(with: match.range))
        }
        return nil
    }

    static func parse(_ raw: String, now: Date = Date()) -> EdgeCalendarIntent? {
        let q = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let lower = q.lowercased()
        guard !lower.isEmpty else { return nil }
        let cal = Calendar.current

        if let prefix = addPrefixes.first(where: { lower.hasPrefix($0) }) {
            let rest = String(q.dropFirst(prefix.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            guard !rest.isEmpty else { return nil }
            var title = rest
            var start = cal.nextDate(after: now, matching: DateComponents(minute: 0), matchingPolicy: .nextTime) ?? now
            var duration = TimeInterval(EdgeSettings.calendarDefaultMinutes * 60)
            var allDay = false
            if let found = split(rest, now: now) {
                title = found.title
                start = found.date
                if found.duration > 0 { duration = found.duration }
                // A date with no clock time ("friday") is an all-day event.
                allDay = !found.hasTime
                if allDay { start = cal.startOfDay(for: start) }
            }
            guard !title.isEmpty else { return nil }
            let end = allDay ? cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: start)! : start.addingTimeInterval(duration)
            return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: start, draft: Draft(title: title.prefix(1).uppercased() + title.dropFirst(), start: start, end: end, allDay: allDay))
        }

        var term = lower
        var named = false
        for word in words where term == word || term.hasPrefix(word + " ") {
            term = String(term.dropFirst(word.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces); named = true; break
        }
        if term.isEmpty { return named ? EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now) : nil }
        switch term {
        case "today": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now)
        case "tomorrow": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: now)!)
        case "yesterday": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: -1, to: now)!)
        case "this week", "week": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: now)
        case "next week": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: cal.date(byAdding: .weekOfYear, value: 1, to: now)!)
        case "last week": return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: cal.date(byAdding: .weekOfYear, value: -1, to: now)!)
        default: break
        }
        if let weekday = cal.weekdaySymbols.firstIndex(where: { $0.lowercased() == term || $0.lowercased().prefix(3) == term && term.count == 3 && named }) {
            let next = cal.nextDate(after: cal.startOfDay(for: now).addingTimeInterval(-1), matching: DateComponents(weekday: weekday + 1), matchingPolicy: .nextTime)
            return next.map { EdgeCalendarIntent(day: $0) }
        }
        // "cal oct 20": a date after the word.
        if named, let match = detectDate(in: term), match.range.length >= (term as NSString).length - 1 {
            return EdgeCalendarIntent(day: match.date)
        }
        return nil
    }

    private static let relative = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: #"(?i)\bin (\d+|an?|half an) (minutes?|mins?|hours?|hrs?)\b"#)

    /// The first date in the text (NSDataDetector, which reads relative to the clock, not
    /// to a `now` argument), and whether it names a clock time ("5pm", "at 9", "in 20
    /// minutes") or only a day.
    static func detectDate(in text: String) -> (date: Date, duration: TimeInterval, range: NSRange, hasTime: Bool)? {
        // "in 20 minutes", "in an hour", "in 2 hrs": the detector doesn't read these.
        let ns = text as NSString
        if let m = relative.firstMatch(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: ns.length)) {
            let amount = ns.substring(with: m.range(at: 1)).lowercased()
            let n = amount == "half an" ? 0.5 : amount == "a" || amount == "an" ? 1 : Double(amount) ?? 0
            let unit = ns.substring(with: m.range(at: 2)).lowercased()
            let seconds = n * (unit.hasPrefix("h") ? 3600 : 60)
            if seconds > 0 { return (Date().addingTimeInterval(seconds), 0, m.range, true) }
        }
        guard let detector = try? NSDataDetector(types: NSTextCheckingResult.CheckingType.date.rawValue),
              let m = detector.firstMatch(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: (text as NSString).length)),
              let date = m.date else { return nil }
        let matched = (text as NSString).substring(with: m.range).lowercased()
        let hasTime = matched.range(of: #"\d\s*(am|pm|a\.m\.|p\.m\.|:\d\d)|noon|midnight|\bat\s+\d|\b\d+\s*(min|mins|minutes?|hours?|hrs?)\b|\b(an?|half an)\s+hour\b"#, options: .regularExpression) != nil
        return (date, m.duration, m.range, hasTime)
    }
}
//
//  EdgeHeldCards.swift
//  The card the bar shows for a verb on what's held: squeeze (each file against the
//  target), mail (the compose card), undo and done (what ↵ will do). Reads EdgeHeld
//  directly, so it follows the model, not view parameters.
//

import SwiftUI

struct EdgeHeldCard: View {
    let model: EdgeHeld

    var body: some View {
        switch model.command?.verb {
        case "squeeze": SqueezeCard(model: model, target: model.command?.target ?? .fraction(0.5))
        case "mail": EdgeComposeCard(model: EdgeCompose.shared)
        case "undo": UndoCard(model: model)
        case "done": DoneCard(model: model)
        case let verb? where FileActionVerbs.ids.contains(verb):
            FileActionCard(items: model.items, command: model.command!)
        default:
            // Nothing typed: jobs, results and the actions that fit. Nothing held: Finder's selection.
            if let c = EdgeHeldActions.shared.finderCommand, !model.hasItems {
                FileActionCard(items: EdgeHeldActions.shared.finderItems, command: c, finder: true)
            } else {
                HeldActionsCard(actions: EdgeHeldActions.shared)
            }
        }
    }
}

/// One row per held file: its size now, a bar against the target, what ↵ will do.
private struct SqueezeCard: View {
    let model: EdgeHeld
    let target: FileSqueeze.Target

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            ForEach(model.items) { item in row(item) }
        }
        .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
    }

    private func row(_ item: HeldItem) -> some View {
        let limit = target.bytes(for: item.originalBytes)
        let fits = item.currentBytes < limit
        // Over the target reads amber (work to do), under it green.
        let tint = fits ? Color(hexString: "#30d158") ?? .green : Color(hexString: "#ff9f0a") ?? .orange
        return HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(item.current.path)).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 26, height: 26)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text(item.original.lastPathComponent).font(.pp(12.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.92))
                        .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                    Spacer(minLength: 4)
                    Text(FileSqueeze.format(item.currentBytes)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.right").font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4))
                    Text("< " + FileSqueeze.format(limit)).foregroundStyle(tint)
                }
                .font(.system(size: 11.5, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
                SizeBar(current: item.currentBytes, original: item.originalBytes, limit: limit, tint: tint)
            }
            Image(systemName: fits ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : method(item.noun))
                .font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(tint)
                .frame(width: 26)
                .help(fits ? "Already fits" : methodHelp(item.noun))
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10).frame(height: 52)
        .background(.white.opacity(0.05), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous))
    }

    private func method(_ noun: HeldNoun) -> String {
        switch noun {
        case .image: "photo"
        case .video: "film"
        case .audio: "waveform"
        case .pdf: "doc.richtext"
        case .document, .folder: "doc.zipper"
        }
    }

    private func methodHelp(_ noun: HeldNoun) -> String {
        switch noun {
        case .image: "↵ re-encodes the image (quality first, then size). The original stays."
        case .video: "↵ re-encodes the video at the bitrate that fits. The original stays."
        case .audio: "↵ re-encodes the audio at the bitrate that fits. The original stays."
        case .pdf: "↵ downsamples the PDF's images (flattens pages if needed). The original stays."
        case .document, .folder: "↵ zips it (there's no smaller version of this format). The original stays."
        }
    }
}

/// Original size as the full width; the target as a tick; the current size as the fill.
private struct SizeBar: View {
    let current: Int64
    let original: Int64
    let limit: Int64
    let tint: Color

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { g in
            let w = g.size.width
            let scale = Double(max(original, limit, current, 1))
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.08))
                Capsule().fill(tint.opacity(0.75)).frame(width: max(4, w * Double(current) / scale))
                Rectangle().fill(.white.opacity(0.85)).frame(width: 1.5, height: 9)
                    .offset(x: min(w - 1.5, w * Double(limit) / scale))
            }
        }
        .frame(height: 5)
    }
}

private struct UndoCard: View {
    let model: EdgeHeld
    var body: some View {
        let item = model.items.last(where: \.canUndo)
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: "arrow.uturn.backward.circle.fill").font(.system(size: 22)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
            if let item, let v = item.versions.last {
                Text(item.original.lastPathComponent).font(.pp(13, .semibold)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                // A rename steps back to the old name; a version to the size before it.
                Text(v.renamedFrom.map { v.url.lastPathComponent + "  →  " + $0.lastPathComponent }
                     ?? FileSqueeze.format(v.bytes) + "  →  " + FileSqueeze.format(item.versions.dropLast().last?.bytes ?? item.originalBytes))
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
                    .foregroundStyle(HeldVerbs.heldTint)
                    .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
            } else if let item, item.produced {
                Text(item.original.lastPathComponent).font(.pp(13, .semibold)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                Text("→  \(item.madeFrom.count) back")
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
                    .foregroundStyle(HeldVerbs.heldTint)
            } else {
                Text("Nothing to step back").font(.pp(13, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.5))
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(.horizontal, 14).frame(height: 52)
    }
}

private struct DoneCard: View {
    let model: EdgeHeld
    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill").font(.system(size: 22)).foregroundStyle(Color(hexString: "#30d158") ?? .green)
            HStack(spacing: -6) {
                ForEach(model.items.prefix(6)) { item in
                    Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(item.current.path)).resizable().frame(width: 24, height: 24)
                }
            }
            Text(model.items.count == 1 ? model.items[0].original.lastPathComponent : "\(model.items.count) held")
                .font(.pp(13, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            let versions = model.items.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.versions.count }
            if versions > 0 {
                Image(systemName: "doc.on.doc").font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
                Text("\(versions)").font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
                    .help("Versions stay on disk")
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 14).frame(height: 52)
    }
}
import Foundation

/// Caps alone toggles the layer. Chords commit once when either key releases.
struct CapsWorkspaceChord {
    enum Action: Equatable { case toggleLayer, workspace(Int) }
    private(set) var held = false
    private var numbers: Set<Int> = []
    private var usedNumber = false
    private var cancelled = false
    private var pending: [Int] = []
    private var previewShown = false
    var awaitingChoice: Bool { held && !usedNumber && !cancelled }
    var awaitingNumberRelease: Bool { !numbers.isEmpty }
    func isNumberPressed(_ index: Int) -> Bool { numbers.contains(index) }
    mutating func press() -> Bool {
        guard !held else { return false }
        held = true; pending.removeAll(); usedNumber = !numbers.isEmpty; cancelled = false; previewShown = false
        return true
    }
    mutating func showPreview() { if awaitingChoice { previewShown = true } }
    mutating func select(_ index: Int) {
        guard held, numbers.insert(index).inserted else { return }
        usedNumber = true
        pending.append(index)
    }
    mutating func releaseNumber(_ index: Int) -> Action? {
        guard numbers.remove(index) != nil else { return nil }
        guard let choice = pending.firstIndex(of: index) else { return nil }
        pending.remove(at: choice)
        guard held, !cancelled else { return nil }
        return .workspace(index)
    }
    mutating func cancel() { if held { cancelled = true } }
    mutating func release() -> Action? {
        guard held else { return nil }
        held = false
        defer { pending.removeAll() }
        guard !cancelled else { return nil }
        if let choice = pending.last { return .workspace(choice) }
        // A hold without a number is a slow tap, not a cancelled peek: it toggles too.
        // (Before, a press held past the hint delay slid Spotlight up and straight back down.)
        return !usedNumber ? .toggleLayer : nil
    }
}

import SwiftUI

/// Selection IDs are row positions, shared with Spotlight's keyboard navigation.
struct FollowingScroll<Content: View>: View {
    let selection: Int
    var horizontal = false
    var resetKey = ""
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content
    var body: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            ScrollView(horizontal ? .horizontal : .vertical, showsIndicators: false, content: content)
                .onChange(of: selection) { _, value in
                    withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12)) { proxy.scrollTo(value, anchor: horizontal ? .center : nil) }
                }
                .onChange(of: resetKey) { _, _ in proxy.scrollTo(selection, anchor: horizontal ? .leading : .top) }
        }
    }
}

/// What kind of preview a path gets. Decided from the extension alone, so the
/// first frame never waits on disk.
enum FilePreviewKind {
    case folder, app, image, model, text(code: Bool), media(video: Bool), thumbnail

    static let imageExts: Set<String> = ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "tiff", "tif", "heic", "bmp", "svg", "ico", "icns"]
    static let modelExts: Set<String> = ["obj", "dae", "scn", "usdz", "usd", "usdc", "ply", "stl"]
    static let codeExts: Set<String> = ["swift", "py", "js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "rs", "go", "c", "h", "cpp", "hpp", "m", "mm",
                                        "java", "kt", "rb", "php", "sh", "zsh", "bash", "lua", "sql", "css", "scss", "html",
                                        "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "plist", "mjs", "cjs", "ini", "conf", "env"]
    static let textExts: Set<String> = ["txt", "md", "markdown", "csv", "tsv", "log", "rtf"]
    static let videoExts: Set<String> = ["mov", "mp4", "m4v", "mkv", "webm", "avi"]
    static let audioExts: Set<String> = ["mp3", "wav", "m4a", "aiff", "aif", "flac", "ogg", "caf"]

    static func of(path: String, isDirectory: Bool) -> FilePreviewKind {
        let ext = URL(fileURLWithPath: path).pathExtension.lowercased()
        if ext == "app" { return .app }
        if isDirectory && !["pages", "key", "numbers", "rtfd", "bundle", "photoslibrary"].contains(ext) { return .folder }
        if imageExts.contains(ext) { return .image }
        if modelExts.contains(ext) { return .model }
        if codeExts.contains(ext) { return .text(code: true) }
        if textExts.contains(ext) { return .text(code: false) }
        if videoExts.contains(ext) { return .media(video: true) }
        if audioExts.contains(ext) { return .media(video: false) }
        return .thumbnail
    }
}

/// Small shared caches: icons and folder listings are re-requested on every arrow press.
enum FilePreviewCache {
    private static let icons = NSCache<NSString, NSImage>()
    static func icon(_ path: String) -> NSImage {
        if let hit = icons.object(forKey: path as NSString) { return hit }
        let image = NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: path)
        icons.setObject(image, forKey: path as NSString)
        return image
    }
}

/// Everything a preview needs, loaded off the main thread in one pass.
private struct FilePreviewData {
    var isDirectory = false
    var size: Int64?
    var modified: Date?
    var image: NSImage?
    var scene: SCNScene?
    var text: String?
    var detail: String?            // "1920×1080", "12 pages", "3:42", "v2.1", "23 items · 4 folders"
    var children: [URL] = []

    static func load(path: String, pixelSize: CGFloat) async -> FilePreviewData {
        var d = FilePreviewData()
        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isDirectoryKey, .fileSizeKey, .contentModificationDateKey])
        d.isDirectory = values?.isDirectory == true
        d.size = values?.fileSize.map(Int64.init)
        d.modified = values?.contentModificationDate
        switch FilePreviewKind.of(path: path, isDirectory: d.isDirectory) {
        case .folder:
            d.children = FileBrowse.list(path)
            let folders = d.children.filter { FileBrowse.isFolder($0.path) }.count
            d.detail = "\(d.children.count) items" + (folders > 0 ? " · \(folders) folders" : "")
        case .app:
            d.image = FilePreviewCache.icon(path)
            let info = Bundle(path: path)?.infoDictionary
            d.detail = (info?["CFBundleShortVersionString"] as? String).map { "Version \($0)" }
        case .image:
            if url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "svg" {
                d.image = NSImage(contentsOf: url)
            } else if let src = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url as CFURL, nil) {
                // Decode at display size: a 12MP photo shouldn't be fully decoded for a 400pt pane.
                let opts: [CFString: Any] = [kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
                                             kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
                                             kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: pixelSize]
                if let cg = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(src, 0, opts as CFDictionary) {
                    d.image = NSImage(cgImage: cg, size: .zero)
                }
                if let props = CGImageSourceCopyPropertiesAtIndex(src, 0, nil) as? [CFString: Any],
                   let w = props[kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth] as? Int, let h = props[kCGImagePropertyPixelHeight] as? Int {
                    d.detail = "\(w)×\(h)"
                }
            }
        case .model:
            d.scene = try? SCNScene(url: url, options: nil)
        case .text:
            if let handle = try? FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url) {
                let head = (try? handle.read(upToCount: 12_000)) ?? Data()
                try? handle.close()
                d.text = String(decoding: head, as: UTF8.self)
            }
        case .media:
            let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
            if let duration = try? await asset.load(.duration), duration.seconds.isFinite {
                let s = Int(duration.seconds.rounded())
                d.detail = s >= 3600 ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", s / 3600, s / 60 % 60, s % 60)
                                     : String(format: "%d:%02d", s / 60, s % 60)
            }
            d.image = await quickLookThumbnail(url, pixelSize: pixelSize)
        case .thumbnail:
            if url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "pdf", let pdf = CGPDFDocument(url as CFURL) {
                d.detail = pdf.numberOfPages == 1 ? "1 page" : "\(pdf.numberOfPages) pages"
            }
            d.image = await quickLookThumbnail(url, pixelSize: pixelSize)
        }
        return d
    }

    private static func quickLookThumbnail(_ url: URL, pixelSize: CGFloat) async -> NSImage? {
        let side = pixelSize / 2
        let request = QLThumbnailGenerator.Request(fileAt: url, size: CGSize(width: side, height: side),
                                                   scale: 2, representationTypes: .thumbnail)
        let rep = try? await QLThumbnailGenerator.shared.generateBestRepresentation(for: request)
        return rep?.nsImage
    }
}

/// Folder listing for previews and ←/→ browsing: visible items, folders first.
enum FileBrowse {
    static func isFolder(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        var dir: ObjCBool = false
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path, isDirectory: &dir), dir.boolValue else { return false }
        return !NSWorkspace.shared.isFilePackage(atPath: path)
    }

    static func list(_ path: String, limit: Int = 400) -> [URL] {
        let items = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
            at: URL(fileURLWithPath: path), includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey, .isPackageKey],
            options: [.skipsHiddenFiles])) ?? []
        func folder(_ u: URL) -> Bool {
            let v = try? u.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isDirectoryKey, .isPackageKey])
            return v?.isDirectory == true && v?.isPackage != true
        }
        return Array(items.sorted { a, b in
            let fa = folder(a), fb = folder(b)
            if fa != fb { return fa }
            return a.lastPathComponent.localizedStandardCompare(b.lastPathComponent) == .orderedAscending
        }.prefix(limit))
    }
}

struct InteractiveFilePreview: View {
    let path: String
    let name: String
    @State private var data: FilePreviewData?
    @State private var loadedPath: String?
    @State private var liveQuickLook = false
    /// Shown in an image's header beside the zoom buttons (the bar passes copy-text).
    var imageAccessory: AnyView? = nil
    @State private var zoom: CGFloat = 1

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(path)).resizable().frame(width: 24, height: 24)
                Text(name).font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold)).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                if case .image = kind, data?.image != nil {
                    if let imageAccessory { imageAccessory }
                    Button { zoom = max(0.25, zoom / 1.5) } label: { Image(systemName: "minus.magnifyingglass") }.help("Zoom out")
                    Button { zoom = 1 } label: { Text("Fit").font(.system(size: 10)) }.help("Fit image")
                    Button { zoom = min(8, zoom * 1.5) } label: { Image(systemName: "plus.magnifyingglass") }.help("Zoom in")
                }
            }.buttonStyle(.plain)
            content.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text(kindLabel)
                if let detail = data?.detail { Text(detail) }
                if data?.isDirectory == false, let size = data?.size {
                    Text(ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: size, countStyle: .file))
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                if let date = data?.modified { Text(date, style: .date) }
            }.font(.system(size: 9)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).lineLimit(1)
            Text((path as NSString).abbreviatingWithTildeInPath).font(.system(size: 9)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle).textSelection(.enabled)
        }.padding(10)
            .task(id: path) {
                data = nil; loadedPath = nil; liveQuickLook = false; zoom = 1
                // Short settle so holding an arrow key doesn't decode every file it passes.
                do { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(45)) } catch { return }
                let filePath = path
                let loaded = await Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
                    await FilePreviewData.load(path: filePath, pixelSize: 900)
                }.value
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                data = loaded; loadedPath = filePath
                // Documents: thumbnail first, then the live (scrollable) Quick Look if you stay.
                if case .thumbnail = kind {
                    do { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(450)) } catch { return }
                    liveQuickLook = true
                }
            }
    }

    private var kind: FilePreviewKind {
        FilePreviewKind.of(path: path, isDirectory: data?.isDirectory ?? FileBrowse.isFolder(path))
    }

    private var kindLabel: String {
        switch kind {
        case .folder: return "Folder"
        case .app: return "Application"
        default: return URL(fileURLWithPath: path).pathExtension.uppercased()
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var content: some View {
        if loadedPath != path || data == nil {
            // Instant placeholder: the file's own icon, not a spinner.
            Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(path)).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 72, height: 72)
                .opacity(0.5).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        } else if let data {
            switch kind {
            case .folder:
                FolderContents(children: data.children)
            case .app:
                if let image = data.image {
                    Image(nsImage: image).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 128, height: 128)
                }
            case .model:
                if let scene = data.scene {
                    SceneView(scene: scene, options: [.allowsCameraControl, .autoenablesDefaultLighting])
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
                        .help("Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · Shift-drag to pan")
                } else { NativeFileQuickLook(path: path) }
            case .image:
                if let image = data.image {
                    ZoomableFileImage(image: image, zoom: $zoom)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
                } else { NativeFileQuickLook(path: path) }
            case .text(let code):
                TextHeadPreview(text: data.text ?? "", markdown: !code && ["md", "markdown"].contains(URL(fileURLWithPath: path).pathExtension.lowercased()))
            case .media, .thumbnail:
                if liveQuickLook, case .thumbnail = kind {
                    NativeFileQuickLook(path: path)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
                } else if let image = data.image {
                    Image(nsImage: image).resizable().scaledToFit()
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous))
                } else {
                    NativeFileQuickLook(path: path)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// First lines of a text file — rendered directly, no Quick Look spin-up.
private struct TextHeadPreview: View {
    let text: String
    let markdown: Bool
    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            Group {
                if markdown, let attributed = try? AttributedString(
                    markdown: text, options: .init(interpretedSyntax: .inlineOnlyPreservingWhitespace)) {
                    Text(attributed).font(.system(size: 11))
                } else {
                    Text(text).font(.system(size: 10.5, design: .monospaced))
                }
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
            .textSelection(.enabled)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        }
        .padding(8)
        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.05)))
    }
}

private struct FolderContents: View {
    let children: [URL]
    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 7) {
                if children.isEmpty { Text("No visible items").foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                ForEach(children.prefix(120), id: \.path) { url in
                    HStack(spacing: 6) {
                        Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(url.path)).resizable().frame(width: 16, height: 16)
                        Text(url.lastPathComponent).lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.middle)
                    }
                }
            }.font(.system(size: 11)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
    }
}

struct NativeFileQuickLook: NSViewRepresentable {
    let path: String
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> QLPreviewView {
        let view = QLPreviewView(frame: .zero, style: .normal)!
        // SwiftUI owns teardown. The default YES closes on removal from the
        // window, making the explicit close below deactivate a closed view.
        view.shouldCloseWithWindow = false
        view.autostarts = false
        view.previewItem = NSURL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        return view
    }
    func updateNSView(_ view: QLPreviewView, context: Context) {
        let url = NSURL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        if view.previewItem?.previewItemURL != url as URL { view.previewItem = url }
    }
    static func dismantleNSView(_ view: QLPreviewView, coordinator: ()) { view.close() }
}

private struct ZoomableFileImage: NSViewRepresentable {
    let image: NSImage
    @Binding var zoom: CGFloat
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> ImagePreviewScroll {
        let view = ImagePreviewScroll(); view.imageView.image = image
        view.onZoom = { value in zoom = value }
        return view
    }
    func updateNSView(_ view: ImagePreviewScroll, context: Context) {
        view.imageView.image = image
        if view.requestedZoom != zoom { view.requestedZoom = zoom; view.setMagnification(zoom, centeredAt: NSPoint(x: view.documentVisibleRect.midX, y: view.documentVisibleRect.midY)) }
        view.fitImage()
    }
}
private final class ImagePreviewScroll: NSScrollView {
    let imageView = PannablePreviewImage()
    var onZoom: ((CGFloat) -> Void)?
    private var zoomObserver: NSObjectProtocol?
    var requestedZoom: CGFloat = 1
    override init(frame: NSRect) {
        super.init(frame: frame)
        drawsBackground = false; hasHorizontalScroller = true; hasVerticalScroller = true
        autohidesScrollers = true; allowsMagnification = true; minMagnification = 0.25; maxMagnification = 8
        imageView.imageScaling = .scaleProportionallyUpOrDown; documentView = imageView
        zoomObserver = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(forName: NSScrollView.didEndLiveMagnifyNotification, object: self, queue: .main) { [weak self] _ in
            guard let self else { return }; self.requestedZoom = self.magnification; self.onZoom?(self.magnification)
        }
    }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { nil }
    deinit { if let zoomObserver { NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(zoomObserver) } }
    override func layout() { super.layout(); fitImage() }
    func fitImage() {
        // A viewport-sized document provides Fit at 1×; native magnification
        // supplies pinch zoom and two-axis scrolling without rerasterizing SVG.
        let size = NSSize(width: max(1, bounds.width), height: max(1, bounds.height))
        if imageView.frame.size != size { imageView.frame = NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size) }
    }
}

private final class PannablePreviewImage: NSImageView {
    private var origin = NSPoint.zero
    private var start = NSPoint.zero
    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
        origin = enclosingScrollView?.contentView.bounds.origin ?? .zero
        start = event.locationInWindow
    }
    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
        guard let scroll = enclosingScrollView else { return }
        let point = event.locationInWindow
        var proposed = scroll.contentView.bounds
        proposed.origin = NSPoint(x: origin.x - (point.x - start.x) / scroll.magnification,
                                 y: origin.y - (point.y - start.y) / scroll.magnification)
        scroll.contentView.scroll(to: scroll.contentView.constrainBoundsRect(proposed).origin)
        scroll.reflectScrolledClipView(scroll.contentView)
    }
}
//
//  AutoTiler.swift
//  Hyprland-style dwindle tiling for the edge workspaces (Surface, Browser, tools).
//
//  Every open workspace is a leaf of a binary split tree. A window that opens splits
//  the focused one along its longer side (new one right/below); one that closes hands
//  its space to its sibling. Gaps: 14pt to the screen, 10pt between windows.
//    • Drag a window onto another: the half under the pointer previews where it lands;
//      drop to move it there. Near a screen edge, it takes that whole side instead.
//    • Option-drop floats it (out of the tree); dropping a floating window onto
//      another tiles it. Caps+W toggles tiled/floating for the focused window.
//    • Drag a tiled window's edge: the split it sits on moves 1:1 with the pointer and
//      the neighbours give way.
//  Hiding the whole layer is not closing: the tree keeps everyone's place.
//

import AppKit

indirect enum DwindleNode: Codable, Equatable {
    case leaf(String)
    /// `first` is the left (side by side) or top (stacked) child; `ratio` is its share.
    case split(sideBySide: Bool, ratio: Double, first: DwindleNode, second: DwindleNode)

    var keys: [String] {
        switch self {
        case .leaf(let k): return [k]
        case let .split(_, _, a, b): return a.keys + b.keys
        }
    }
    func contains(_ key: String) -> Bool { keys.contains(key) }

    func removing(_ key: String) -> DwindleNode? {
        switch self {
        case .leaf(let k): return k == key ? nil : self
        case let .split(s, r, a, b):
            let na = a.removing(key), nb = b.removing(key)
            guard let na else { return nb }
            guard let nb else { return na }
            return .split(sideBySide: s, ratio: r, first: na, second: nb)
        }
    }

    /// Splits the leaf `target` in two; `before` puts the new key left/above it.
    func inserting(_ key: String, at target: String, sideBySide: Bool, before: Bool) -> DwindleNode {
        switch self {
        case .leaf(let k):
            guard k == target else { return self }
            return Self.pair(key, self, sideBySide: sideBySide, before: before)
        case let .split(s, r, a, b):
            return .split(sideBySide: s, ratio: r, first: a.inserting(key, at: target, sideBySide: sideBySide, before: before),
                          second: b.inserting(key, at: target, sideBySide: sideBySide, before: before))
        }
    }
    static func pair(_ key: String, _ node: DwindleNode, sideBySide: Bool, before: Bool) -> DwindleNode {
        before ? .split(sideBySide: sideBySide, ratio: 0.5, first: .leaf(key), second: node)
               : .split(sideBySide: sideBySide, ratio: 0.5, first: node, second: .leaf(key))
    }

    func pruned(to keep: Set<String>) -> DwindleNode? {
        switch self {
        case .leaf(let k): return keep.contains(k) ? self : nil
        case let .split(s, r, a, b):
            let na = a.pruned(to: keep), nb = b.pruned(to: keep)
            guard let na else { return nb }
            guard let nb else { return na }
            return .split(sideBySide: s, ratio: r, first: na, second: nb)
        }
    }

    static func children(of rect: NSRect, sideBySide: Bool, ratio: Double, gap: CGFloat) -> (NSRect, NSRect) {
        if sideBySide {
            let w = rect.width - gap, wa = (w * ratio).rounded()
            return (NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY, width: wa, height: rect.height),
                    NSRect(x: rect.minX + wa + gap, y: rect.minY, width: w - wa, height: rect.height))
        }
        let h = rect.height - gap, ha = (h * ratio).rounded()   // first is on top (AppKit: high y)
        return (NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY - ha, width: rect.width, height: ha),
                NSRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY, width: rect.width, height: h - ha))
    }

    func layout(in rect: NSRect, gap: CGFloat, into frames: inout [String: NSRect]) {
        switch self {
        case .leaf(let k): frames[k] = rect
        case let .split(s, r, a, b):
            let (ra, rb) = Self.children(of: rect, sideBySide: s, ratio: r, gap: gap)
            a.layout(in: ra, gap: gap, into: &frames)
            b.layout(in: rb, gap: gap, into: &frames)
        }
    }

    /// Moves the divider under one edge of `key` (1 left, 2 right, 4 bottom, 8 top) so
    /// that edge lands where `frame` puts it. The innermost split on that edge wins.
    func resizing(_ key: String, edge: Int, to frame: NSRect, in rect: NSRect, gap: CGFloat, minimum: CGFloat) -> (DwindleNode, Bool) {
        guard case let .split(s, r, a, b) = self, contains(key) else { return (self, false) }
        let (ra, rb) = Self.children(of: rect, sideBySide: s, ratio: r, gap: gap)
        let inFirst = a.contains(key)
        let (child, handled) = inFirst ? a.resizing(key, edge: edge, to: frame, in: ra, gap: gap, minimum: minimum)
