                                       : b.resizing(key, edge: edge, to: frame, in: rb, gap: gap, minimum: minimum)
        if handled {
            return (.split(sideBySide: s, ratio: r, first: inFirst ? child : a, second: inFirst ? b : child), true)
        }
        let span = (s ? rect.width : rect.height) - gap
        guard span > 2 * minimum else { return (self, false) }
        var share: CGFloat?
        if s {
            if inFirst, edge == 2 { share = frame.maxX - rect.minX }
            if !inFirst, edge == 1 { share = frame.minX - gap - rect.minX }
        } else {
            if inFirst, edge == 4 { share = rect.maxY - frame.minY }
            if !inFirst, edge == 8 { share = rect.maxY - frame.maxY - gap }
        }
        guard let share else { return (self, false) }
        let ratio = Double(min(max(share, minimum), span - minimum) / span)
        return (.split(sideBySide: s, ratio: ratio, first: a, second: b), true)
    }
}

@MainActor final class AutoTiler {
    static let shared = AutoTiler()
    /// Settings → Tiling gap; the outer margin is a little wider, as before (10 / 14).
    static var gapIn: CGFloat { EdgeSettings.tilingGap * 1.25 }
    static var gapOut: CGFloat { EdgeSettings.tilingGap * 1.75 }
    private static let storeKey = "edge.dwindle.v1"
    private static let stateNote = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.tile.state")
    private static let resizeNote = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.tile.resize")

    private struct Saved: Codable { var tree: DwindleNode?; var floating: Set<String> }
    private(set) var tree: DwindleNode?
    /// Windows you floated on purpose (Option-drop, Caps+W); they stay out until you tile them.
    private var floating: Set<String> = []
    private var visible: [String: Bool] = [:]
    private var layerVisible = false
    private var focused: String?
    private var dragKey: String?
    private var dropTarget: (target: String?, side: NSRectEdge)?
    private let ghost = TileGhost()
    private var reconcile: DispatchWorkItem?
    private var observers: [NSObjectProtocol] = []

    private init() {
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.storeKey),
           let saved = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Saved.self, from: data) { tree = saved.tree; floating = saved.floating }
    }

    func start() {
        WorkspacePlacement.focusHook = { [weak self] key in self?.focused = key; UnifiedTiling.shared.focused(key) }
        WorkspacePlacement.resizeHook = { [weak self] key, edge, frame in self?.resize(key, edge: edge, to: frame) ?? false }
        observers.append(DistributedNotificationCenter.default().addObserver(forName: Self.resizeNote, object: nil, queue: .main) { [weak self] note in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, let i = note.userInfo, let key = i["key"] as? String, let edge = i["edge"] as? Int,
                      let x = i["x"] as? Double, let y = i["y"] as? Double, let w = i["w"] as? Double, let h = i["h"] as? Double else { return }
                _ = self.resize(key, edge: edge, to: NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: w, height: h))
            }
        })
        broadcast()
    }

    private var screen: NSScreen { NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens[0] }
    private var area: NSRect { screen.visibleFrame.insetBy(dx: Self.gapOut, dy: Self.gapOut) }
    private static func tiles(_ key: String) -> Bool { !key.hasPrefix("app.") }
    func isTiled(_ key: String) -> Bool {
        UnifiedTiling.shared.active ? UnifiedTiling.shared.holds(key) : tree?.contains(key) == true
    }

    /// Frames for every tiled window. The tree holds exactly the open ones (hidden with
    /// the layer still counts as open), so the layout never flickers while the layer's
    /// windows come back one by one.
    func frames() -> [String: NSRect] {
        var out: [String: NSRect] = [:]
        tree?.layout(in: area, gap: Self.gapIn, into: &out)
        return out
    }

    // MARK: Open / close

    /// The whole layer showing or hiding is not windows opening or closing.
    func layerChanged(_ shown: Bool) {
        layerVisible = shown
        reconcile?.cancel(); reconcile = nil
        guard shown else { return }
        // After the layer's windows are back: drop leaves that didn't return, adopt new ones.
        let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in self?.reconcileNow() }
        reconcile = work; DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.6, execute: work)
    }

    private func reconcileNow() {
        reconcile = nil
        guard layerVisible, dragKey == nil else { return }
        let peers = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        for key in tree?.keys ?? [] where peers.peer(key)?.visible != true { tree = tree?.removing(key) }
        for (key, isOpen) in visible where isOpen && !isTiled(key) && shouldAutoTile(key) { insert(key) }
        save(); relayout()
    }

    func peerChanged(_ peer: WorkspacePeer) {
        guard Self.tiles(peer.id) else { return }
        let was = visible[peer.id] ?? false
        visible[peer.id] = peer.visible
        guard was != peer.visible, layerVisible, dragKey != peer.id else { return }
        if peer.visible {
            focused = peer.id
            if !isTiled(peer.id), shouldAutoTile(peer.id) { insert(peer.id); save() }
            if isTiled(peer.id) { relayout() }
        } else if isTiled(peer.id) {
            tree = tree?.removing(peer.id); save()
            if focused == peer.id { focused = nil }
            relayout()
        }
    }

    private func shouldAutoTile(_ key: String) -> Bool {
        // Tools (and the keyboard) are cards with a natural size: they float until you drop
        // them on a window.
        !floating.contains(key) && !key.hasPrefix("tool.") && !key.hasPrefix("keyboard")
    }

    /// Splits the focused window (or the biggest one) along its longer side.
    private func insert(_ key: String) {
        tree = tree?.removing(key)
        guard let current = tree else { tree = .leaf(key); return }
        let frames = frames()
        let target = [focused].compactMap { $0 }.first { $0 != key && frames[$0] != nil }
            ?? frames.filter { $0.key != key }.max { $0.value.width * $0.value.height < $1.value.width * $1.value.height }?.key
            ?? current.keys.last!
        let rect = frames[target] ?? area
        tree = current.inserting(key, at: target, sideBySide: rect.width >= rect.height, before: false)
    }

    private func relayout(animated: Bool = true, except: String? = nil) {
        // The shared layout (every app's windows) places ours while it runs.
        if UnifiedTiling.shared.active { UnifiedTiling.shared.refresh(); broadcast(); return }
        let coordinator = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        for (key, frame) in frames() where key != except {
            guard let peer = coordinator.peer(key), peer.visible else { continue }
            if peer.floating && peer.frame == frame { continue }
            coordinator.movePeer(peer, to: frame, floating: true, animated: animated)
        }
        broadcast()
    }

    private func save() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(Saved(tree: tree, floating: floating)) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.storeKey)
        }
        broadcast()
    }

    /// Surface (other process) asks before moving itself: is it tiled, is a drop target lit?
    private func broadcast() {
        DistributedNotificationCenter.default().postNotificationName(Self.stateNote, object: nil,
            userInfo: ["tiled": tree?.keys ?? [], "hover": dropTarget != nil], deliverImmediately: true)
    }

    // MARK: The shared layout (UnifiedTiling)

    func floats(_ key: String) -> Bool { floating.contains(key) }
    func setFloats(_ key: String, _ on: Bool) {
        if on { floating.insert(key); tree = tree?.removing(key) } else { floating.remove(key) }
        save()
    }
    /// The shared layout stopped: our windows go back to this tree's tiles.
    func retake() {
        for (key, isOpen) in visible where isOpen && !isTiled(key) && shouldAutoTile(key) { insert(key) }
        save(); relayout()
    }

    // MARK: Caps+W

    /// Keep a window out of the tree when it next appears (the terminal leaving its sheet).
    func float(_ key: String) {
        guard !floating.contains(key) || isTiled(key) else { return }
        tree = tree?.removing(key); floating.insert(key); save()
    }

    /// Out of the tree without moving it (it's about to go somewhere of its own); the
    /// rest close the gap.
    func release(_ key: String) {
        tree = tree?.removing(key); floating.insert(key); save()
        if focused == key { focused = nil }
        relayout(except: key)
    }

    // MARK: Workspaces (Caps+digit)

    struct Layout: Codable { var tree: DwindleNode?; var floating: Set<String> }
    var layout: Layout { Layout(tree: tree, floating: floating) }

    /// A workspace's layout comes back: windows that are open get their tiles now, the
    /// rest as they appear (peerChanged sees them already in the tree).
    func restore(_ layout: Layout, open: Set<String>) {
        tree = layout.tree; floating = layout.floating
        for key in tree?.keys ?? [] where !open.contains(key) { tree = tree?.removing(key) }
        save(); relayout()
    }

    func toggleFloating(_ key: String) {
        let coordinator = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator.shared
        if UnifiedTiling.shared.active {
            let tiled = UnifiedTiling.shared.holds(key)
            UnifiedTiling.shared.setTiled(key, !tiled)
            if tiled, let peer = coordinator.peer(key) {
                let a = screen.visibleFrame.insetBy(dx: 16, dy: 16)
                let size = NSSize(width: min(800, a.width * 0.65), height: min(560, a.height * 0.65))
                coordinator.movePeer(peer, to: NSRect(x: a.midX - size.width / 2, y: a.midY - size.height / 2,
                                                      width: size.width, height: size.height), floating: true, animated: true)
            }
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("workspace.toggle_floating", params: ["workspace": key, "tiled": !tiled])
            return
        }
        if isTiled(key) {
            tree = tree?.removing(key); floating.insert(key); save()
            let a = screen.visibleFrame.insetBy(dx: 16, dy: 16)
            let size = NSSize(width: min(800, a.width * 0.65), height: min(560, a.height * 0.65))
            if let peer = coordinator.peer(key) {
                coordinator.movePeer(peer, to: NSRect(x: a.midX - size.width / 2, y: a.midY - size.height / 2,
                                                      width: size.width, height: size.height), floating: true, animated: true)
            }
            relayout(except: key)
        } else {
            floating.remove(key); insert(key); save(); relayout()
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("workspace.toggle_floating", params: ["workspace": key, "tiled": isTiled(key)])
    }

    // MARK: Resize

    private func resize(_ key: String, edge: Int, to frame: NSRect) -> Bool {
        if UnifiedTiling.shared.active { return UnifiedTiling.shared.resize(key: key, to: frame) }
        guard var node = tree, isTiled(key) else { return false }
        var changed = false
        for bit in [1, 2, 4, 8] where edge & bit != 0 {
            let (next, handled) = node.resizing(key, edge: bit, to: frame, in: area, gap: Self.gapIn, minimum: 240)
            if handled { node = next; changed = true }
        }
        guard changed else { return true }   // an outer edge: tiled windows don't leave their slot
        tree = node; save()
        relayout(animated: false)
        return true
    }

    // MARK: Drag

    /// Workspace drag phases (0 begin, 1 move, 2 end). Phase 1 returns true while the
    /// engine owns the window (no edge snapping); phase 2 returns true when it placed it.
    func drag(key: String, phase: Int, point: NSPoint, option: Bool) -> Bool {
        guard Self.tiles(key) else { return false }
        if UnifiedTiling.shared.active { return UnifiedTiling.shared.drag(key: key, phase: phase, point: point, option: option) }
        switch phase {
        case 0:
            dragKey = key; dropTarget = nil
            return false
        case 1:
            guard dragKey == key else { return false }
            updateTarget(key, point)
            return isTiled(key) || dropTarget != nil
        default:
            guard dragKey == key else { return false }
            defer { dragKey = nil; dropTarget = nil; ghost.hide(); broadcast() }
            if option {
                if isTiled(key) { tree = tree?.removing(key); floating.insert(key); save(); relayout(except: key) }
                return false
            }
            if let drop = dropTarget {
                floating.remove(key)
                tree = tree?.removing(key)
                if let target = drop.target, let current = tree {
                    tree = current.inserting(key, at: target, sideBySide: drop.side == .minX || drop.side == .maxX,
                                             before: drop.side == .minX || drop.side == .maxY)
                } else if let current = tree {
                    tree = DwindleNode.pair(key, current, sideBySide: drop.side == .minX || drop.side == .maxX,
                                            before: drop.side == .minX || drop.side == .maxY)
                } else { tree = .leaf(key) }
                focused = key
                save(); relayout()
                InteractionJournal.shared.action("workspace.tile_drop", params: ["workspace": key, "target": drop.target ?? "screen"])
                return true
            }
            if isTiled(key) { relayout(); return true }   // let go nowhere: back to its slot
            return false
        }
    }

    private func updateTarget(_ key: String, _ point: NSPoint) {
        let others = frames().filter { $0.key != key }
        let a = area, edgeBand: CGFloat = 28
        var next: (target: String?, side: NSRectEdge)?
        var preview: NSRect?
        // Hugging a screen edge with other windows present: take that whole side.
        if !others.isEmpty, let side = Self.edge(near: point, of: a, within: edgeBand) {
            next = (nil, side); preview = Self.half(of: a, side: side)
        } else if let (target, rect) = others.first(where: { $0.value.contains(point) }) {
            let side = Self.nearestEdge(point, in: rect)
            next = (target, side); preview = Self.half(of: rect, side: side)
        }
        let changed = next?.target != dropTarget?.target || next?.side != dropTarget?.side
        dropTarget = next
        if let preview { ghost.show(preview) } else { ghost.hide() }
        if changed { broadcast() }
    }

    private static func edge(near p: NSPoint, of r: NSRect, within band: CGFloat) -> NSRectEdge? {
        let d: [(NSRectEdge, CGFloat)] = [(.minX, p.x - r.minX), (.maxX, r.maxX - p.x), (.minY, p.y - r.minY), (.maxY, r.maxY - p.y)]
        guard let best = d.min(by: { $0.1 < $1.1 }), best.1 <= band else { return nil }
        return best.0
    }
    private static func nearestEdge(_ p: NSPoint, in r: NSRect) -> NSRectEdge {
        // Normalized, so a wide window still offers top/bottom halves.
        let fx = (p.x - r.minX) / max(1, r.width), fy = (p.y - r.minY) / max(1, r.height)
        let d: [(NSRectEdge, CGFloat)] = [(.minX, fx), (.maxX, 1 - fx), (.minY, fy), (.maxY, 1 - fy)]
        return d.min { $0.1 < $1.1 }!.0
    }
    private static func half(of r: NSRect, side: NSRectEdge) -> NSRect {
        let sideBySide = side == .minX || side == .maxX
        let (first, second) = DwindleNode.children(of: r, sideBySide: sideBySide, ratio: 0.5, gap: gapIn)
        return (side == .minX || side == .maxY) ? first : second
    }
}

/// Where a dragged window will land: a soft accent glass slab with the active-rim colours.
@MainActor final class TileGhost {
    private var panel: NSPanel?
    private var shown: NSRect?
    func show(_ frame: NSRect) {
        if panel == nil {
            let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: frame, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
            panel.ignoresMouseEvents = true; panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false
            panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 2)
            panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
            let view = NSView(); view.wantsLayer = true
            view.layer?.backgroundColor = NSColor(srgbRed: 0.45, green: 0.62, blue: 1, alpha: 0.14).cgColor
            view.layer?.borderColor = NSColor(srgbRed: 0.55, green: 0.6, blue: 1, alpha: 0.75).cgColor
            view.layer?.borderWidth = 1.5; view.layer?.cornerRadius = 24; view.layer?.cornerCurve = .continuous
            panel.contentView = view; self.panel = panel
        }
        guard let panel else { return }
        let wasHidden = shown == nil
        guard shown != frame else { return }
        shown = frame
        if wasHidden {
            panel.alphaValue = 0; panel.setFrame(frame, display: true); panel.orderFront(nil)
            NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { $0.duration = 0.1; panel.animator().alphaValue = 1 }
        } else {
            // Target changes glide (not tracking the finger, so easing is fine).
            NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { ctx in
                ctx.duration = 0.14; ctx.timingFunction = CAMediaTimingFunction(name: .easeOut)
                panel.animator().setFrame(frame, display: true)
            }
        }
    }
    func hide() {
        guard let panel, shown != nil else { return }
        shown = nil
        NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup({ $0.duration = 0.1; panel.animator().alphaValue = 0 }) { [weak self, weak panel] in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { if self?.shown == nil { panel?.orderOut(nil) } }
        }
    }
}
import AppKit

enum WorkspaceTile: String, CaseIterable {
    case left, right, top, bottom, topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight
    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .left: return "Left half"
        case .right: return "Right half"
        case .top: return "Top half"
        case .bottom: return "Bottom half"
        case .topLeft: return "Top left"
        case .topRight: return "Top right"
        case .bottomLeft: return "Bottom left"
        case .bottomRight: return "Bottom right"
        }
    }
    func frame(in area: NSRect) -> NSRect {
        let halfWidth = (area.width - WorkspaceTiling.gap) / 2
        let halfHeight = (area.height - WorkspaceTiling.gap) / 2
        switch self {
        case .left: return NSRect(x: area.minX, y: area.minY, width: halfWidth, height: area.height)
        case .right: return NSRect(x: area.maxX - halfWidth, y: area.minY, width: halfWidth, height: area.height)
        case .top: return NSRect(x: area.minX, y: area.maxY - halfHeight, width: area.width, height: halfHeight)
        case .bottom: return NSRect(x: area.minX, y: area.minY, width: area.width, height: halfHeight)
        case .topLeft: return NSRect(x: area.minX, y: area.maxY - halfHeight, width: halfWidth, height: halfHeight)
        case .topRight: return NSRect(x: area.maxX - halfWidth, y: area.maxY - halfHeight, width: halfWidth, height: halfHeight)
        case .bottomLeft: return NSRect(x: area.minX, y: area.minY, width: halfWidth, height: halfHeight)
        case .bottomRight: return NSRect(x: area.maxX - halfWidth, y: area.minY, width: halfWidth, height: halfHeight)
        }
    }
}

enum WorkspaceLinkAxis: String, Codable { case horizontal, vertical }
enum WorkspaceExitEdge { case left, right, top, bottom }
struct WorkspaceLink: Codable, Equatable {
    var peer: String
    var axis: WorkspaceLinkAxis
    /// Is the peer to the right / above this window?
    var peerAfter: Bool
}

enum WorkspaceTiling {
    static let gap: CGFloat = 8
    static func exitEdge(for frame: NSRect, in screen: NSRect) -> WorkspaceExitEdge {
        let horizontal: [(WorkspaceExitEdge, CGFloat)] = [
            (.right, max(0, screen.maxX - frame.maxX)), (.left, max(0, frame.minX - screen.minX))]
        let vertical: [(WorkspaceExitEdge, CGFloat)] = [
            (.bottom, max(0, frame.minY - screen.minY)), (.top, max(0, screen.maxY - frame.maxY))]
        // A one-point tolerance avoids changing direction over pixel rounding.
        // Travel along the shorter dimension: wide windows exit vertically.
        let candidates = frame.width > frame.height + 1 ? vertical
            : frame.height > frame.width + 1 ? horizontal : horizontal + vertical
        return candidates.min { $0.1 < $1.1 }!.0
    }
    static func offscreenFrame(for frame: NSRect, edge: WorkspaceExitEdge, in screen: NSRect) -> NSRect {
        var result = frame
        // Include the shadow, so ordering out at the end has no visible pop.
        switch edge {
        case .left: result.origin.x = screen.minX - frame.width - 24
        case .right: result.origin.x = screen.maxX + 24
        case .bottom: result.origin.y = screen.minY - frame.height - 24
        case .top: result.origin.y = screen.maxY + 24
        }
        return result
    }
    static func area(_ screen: NSScreen) -> NSRect { screen.visibleFrame.insetBy(dx: 12, dy: 12) }
    static func tile(at point: NSPoint, in area: NSRect) -> WorkspaceTile? {
        let left = point.x <= area.minX + 18, right = point.x >= area.maxX - 18
        let top = point.y >= area.maxY - 18, bottom = point.y <= area.minY + 18
        if left || right {
            if point.y >= area.maxY - 80 { return left ? .topLeft : .topRight }
            if point.y <= area.minY + 80 { return left ? .bottomLeft : .bottomRight }
            return left ? .left : .right
        }
        if top { return .top }; if bottom { return .bottom }
        return nil
    }
    static func snapped(_ frame: NSRect, to peers: [NSRect], in area: NSRect, distance: CGFloat = 16) -> NSRect {
        var xs = [area.minX, area.maxX - frame.width]
        var ys = [area.minY, area.maxY - frame.height]
        for peer in peers {
            let beside = abs(frame.maxX + gap - peer.minX) <= distance || abs(frame.minX - gap - peer.maxX) <= distance
            let stacked = abs(frame.maxY + gap - peer.minY) <= distance || abs(frame.minY - gap - peer.maxY) <= distance
            if min(frame.maxY, peer.maxY) - max(frame.minY, peer.minY) > 40 {
                xs += [peer.minX - gap - frame.width, peer.maxX + gap, peer.minX, peer.maxX - frame.width]
            }
            if beside { ys += [peer.minY, peer.maxY - frame.height] }
            if min(frame.maxX, peer.maxX) - max(frame.minX, peer.minX) > 40 {
                ys += [peer.minY - gap - frame.height, peer.maxY + gap, peer.minY, peer.maxY - frame.height]
            }
            if stacked { xs += [peer.minX, peer.maxX - frame.width] }
        }
        var result = frame
        if let x = xs.min(by: { abs($0 - frame.minX) < abs($1 - frame.minX) }), abs(x - frame.minX) <= distance { result.origin.x = x }
        if let y = ys.min(by: { abs($0 - frame.minY) < abs($1 - frame.minY) }), abs(y - frame.minY) <= distance { result.origin.y = y }
        return result
    }
    /// A shared divider changes the two sizes while preserving the outer edge.
    /// The orthogonal dimension stays aligned for both rows or columns.
    static func linkedPeer(for frame: NSRect, peer: NSRect, link: WorkspaceLink) -> NSRect {
        var result = peer
        if link.axis == .horizontal {
            result.origin.y = frame.minY; result.size.height = frame.height
            if link.peerAfter { result.origin.x = frame.maxX + gap; result.size.width = peer.maxX - result.minX }
            else { result.size.width = frame.minX - gap - peer.minX }
        } else {
            result.origin.x = frame.minX; result.size.width = frame.width
            if link.peerAfter { result.origin.y = frame.maxY + gap; result.size.height = peer.maxY - result.minY }
            else { result.size.height = frame.minY - gap - peer.minY }
        }
        return result
    }
    static func limiting(_ frame: NSRect, peer: NSRect, link: WorkspaceLink, minimum: NSSize) -> NSRect {
        var result = frame
        if link.axis == .horizontal {
            if link.peerAfter, result.maxX > peer.maxX - gap - minimum.width { result.size.width = peer.maxX - gap - minimum.width - result.minX }
            else if !link.peerAfter, result.minX < peer.minX + gap + minimum.width {
                let right = result.maxX; result.origin.x = peer.minX + gap + minimum.width; result.size.width = right - result.minX
            }
        } else {
            if link.peerAfter, result.maxY > peer.maxY - gap - minimum.height { result.size.height = peer.maxY - gap - minimum.height - result.minY }
            else if !link.peerAfter, result.minY < peer.minY + gap + minimum.height {
                let top = result.maxY; result.origin.y = peer.minY + gap + minimum.height; result.size.height = top - result.minY
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}

struct WorkspacePeer: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: String
    var owner: UUID
    var pid: Int32
    var title: String
    var frame: NSRect
    var floating: Bool
    var visible: Bool
    /// Its window number (the window server's id): the shared auto-tiler orders by it.
    var windowID: UInt32? = nil
}

/// The two workspaces live in separate processes. Exchange logical destination
/// frames, never individual animation frames or the user's document contents.
@MainActor @Observable final class WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator {
    static let shared = WorkspaceLayoutCoordinator()
    private struct Command: Codable {
        var target: UUID
        var key: String
        var frame: NSRect?
        var link: WorkspaceLink?
        var unlink = false
        var floating = false
        var animated: Bool?   // tile engine placements animate; partner resizes don't
    }
    private static let stateName = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.layout.state.v1")
    private static let commandName = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.layout.command.v1")
    private static let requestName = Notification.Name("com.hashawn.nardo.layout.request.v1")
    private let center: DistributedNotificationCenter
    @ObservationIgnored private var observers: [NSObjectProtocol] = []
    private var local: [String: WeakPlacement] = [:]
    private struct WeakPlacement { weak var value: WorkspacePlacement? }
    private var peers: [String: WorkspacePeer] = [:]
    /// Every peer state, local or from the other process (tile engine auto-tiling).
    @ObservationIgnored var onPeerState: ((WorkspacePeer) -> Void)?
    init(center: DistributedNotificationCenter = .default()) {
        self.center = center
        observers.append(center.addObserver(forName: Self.stateName, object: nil, queue: .main) { [weak self] note in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, let data = note.userInfo?["data"] as? Data,
                      let state = try? JSONDecoder().decode(WorkspacePeer.self, from: data), Self.valid(state.frame) else { return }
                self.peers[state.id] = state
                self.onPeerState?(state)
            }
        })
        observers.append(center.addObserver(forName: Self.requestName, object: nil, queue: .main) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.local.values.forEach { if let value = $0.value { self?.publish(value) } } }
        })
        observers.append(center.addObserver(forName: Self.commandName, object: nil, queue: .main) { [weak self] note in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, let data = note.userInfo?["data"] as? Data,
                      let command = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Command.self, from: data),
                      let placement = self.local[command.key]?.value, placement.layoutOwner == command.target else { return }
                self.apply(command, to: placement)
            }
        })
    }
    deinit { observers.forEach { center.removeObserver($0) } }
    private static func valid(_ frame: NSRect) -> Bool {
        [frame.minX, frame.minY, frame.width, frame.height].allSatisfy { $0.isFinite } && frame.width > 0 && frame.height > 0
    }
    func register(_ placement: WorkspacePlacement, key: String) {
        placement.layoutKey = key; local[key] = WeakPlacement(value: placement)
        publish(placement)
        center.postNotificationName(Self.requestName, object: nil, userInfo: nil, deliverImmediately: true)
    }
    func publish(_ placement: WorkspacePlacement) {
        guard let state = placement.peerState else { return }
        peers[state.id] = state
        onPeerState?(state)
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(state) {
            center.postNotificationName(Self.stateName, object: nil, userInfo: ["data": data], deliverImmediately: true)
        }
    }
    func peer(_ key: String) -> WorkspacePeer? { peers[key] }
    var allPeers: [WorkspacePeer] { Array(peers.values) }
    func localPlacement(_ key: String) -> WorkspacePlacement? { local[key]?.value }
    func neighbors(of placement: WorkspacePlacement) -> [WorkspacePeer] {
        peers.values.filter { $0.id != placement.layoutKey && $0.visible && $0.frame.intersects(placement.screen.visibleFrame)
            && NSRunningApplication(processIdentifier: $0.pid)?.isTerminated == false }
            .sorted { $0.title < $1.title }
    }
    private func apply(_ command: Command, to placement: WorkspacePlacement) {
        if command.unlink { placement.relationship = nil }
        if let link = command.link { placement.relationship = link }
        if let frame = command.frame, Self.valid(frame) {
            if command.floating { placement.enterFloatingMode() }
            if command.animated == true { placement.move(frame) } else { placement.receiveLayoutFrame(frame) }
        }
        if command.unlink || command.link != nil { placement.saveLayout() }
        if command.frame == nil { publish(placement) }
    }
    private func send(_ command: Command) {
        // Local delivery is also useful for native verification and future
        // workspaces hosted in the same process.
        if let placement = local[command.key]?.value, placement.layoutOwner == command.target {
            apply(command, to: placement); return
        }
        if let frame = command.frame { peers[command.key]?.frame = frame }
        guard let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(command) else { return }
        center.postNotificationName(Self.commandName, object: nil, userInfo: ["data": data], deliverImmediately: true)
    }
    func movePeer(_ peer: WorkspacePeer, to frame: NSRect, floating: Bool = false, animated: Bool? = nil) {
        send(Command(target: peer.owner, key: peer.id, frame: frame, floating: floating, animated: animated ?? (floating ? true : nil)))
    }
    func unlink(_ placement: WorkspacePlacement) {
        guard let link = placement.relationship else { return }
        placement.relationship = nil
        if let peer = peers[link.peer] { send(Command(target: peer.owner, key: peer.id, unlink: true)) }
        placement.saveLayout(); publish(placement)
    }
    func link(_ placement: WorkspacePlacement, to peer: WorkspacePeer, axis: WorkspaceLinkAxis) {
        guard let key = placement.layoutKey, peer.id != key else { return }
        unlink(placement)
        let area = WorkspaceTiling.area(placement.screen)
        let first = (axis == .horizontal ? WorkspaceTile.left : .bottom).frame(in: area)
        let second = (axis == .horizontal ? WorkspaceTile.right : .top).frame(in: area)
        placement.enterFloatingMode()
        placement.relationship = WorkspaceLink(peer: peer.id, axis: axis, peerAfter: true)
        send(Command(target: peer.owner, key: peer.id, frame: second,
                     link: WorkspaceLink(peer: key, axis: axis, peerAfter: false), floating: true))
        placement.move(first, animated: true, propagate: false)
        placement.saveLayout(); publish(placement)
    }
}

@MainActor final class WorkspaceSnapPreview {
    private var panel: NSPanel?
    func show(_ frame: NSRect) {
        if panel == nil {
            let panel = NSPanel(contentRect: frame, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
            panel.ignoresMouseEvents = true; panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false
            panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 2)
            panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
            let view = NSView(); view.wantsLayer = true
            view.layer?.backgroundColor = NSColor.controlAccentColor.withAlphaComponent(0.12).cgColor
            view.layer?.borderColor = NSColor.controlAccentColor.withAlphaComponent(0.5).cgColor
            view.layer?.borderWidth = 1; view.layer?.cornerRadius = 18
            panel.contentView = view; self.panel = panel
        }
        panel?.setFrame(frame, display: true); panel?.orderFront(nil)
    }
    func hide() { panel?.orderOut(nil) }
}
//
//  BentoTheme.swift
//  Adaptive color for the bento sidebar.
//
//  A card's accent comes from the page's <meta name="theme-color"> when we have
//  it, and otherwise from a hue deterministically derived from the host — so
//  every site gets a stable, distinct color even before (or without) a
//  theme-color. Colors are applied muted/desaturated over a dark surface with a
//  soft same-hue glow, per the spec.
//

import SwiftUI

extension Color {
    /// Parse `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa`. Returns nil for anything else
    /// (e.g. `rgb(...)` or named colors) so callers can fall back.
    init?(hexString raw: String) {
        var s = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard s.hasPrefix("#") else { return nil }
        s.removeFirst()
        if s.count == 3 { s = s.map { "\($0)\($0)" }.joined() }
        guard let value = UInt64(s, radix: 16) else { return nil }

        let r, g, b, a: Double
        switch s.count {
        case 6:
            r = Double((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16) / 255
            g = Double((value & 0x00FF00) >> 8) / 255
            b = Double(value & 0x0000FF) / 255
            a = 1
        case 8:
            r = Double((value & 0xFF00_0000) >> 24) / 255
            g = Double((value & 0x00FF_0000) >> 16) / 255
            b = Double((value & 0x0000_FF00) >> 8) / 255
            a = Double(value & 0x0000_00FF) / 255
        default:
            return nil
        }
        self = Color(.sRGB, red: r, green: g, blue: b, opacity: a)
    }
}

enum BentoPalette {
    /// The dark surface the cards sit on.
    static let surface = Color(white: 0.09)
    static let surfaceRaised = Color(white: 0.13)
    /// The neutral, slightly-raised surface of the floating web content card —
    /// kept calm and untinted so the page itself, not the chrome, draws the eye.
    static let canvas = Color(white: 0.07)
    /// Product accent (violet).
    static let accent = Color(red: 0.62, green: 0.55, blue: 0.98)



    /// Stable hue in [0,1) from an arbitrary string (FNV-1a → degrees).
    static func hue(for key: String) -> Double {
        var hash: UInt64 = 1_469_598_103_934_665_603
        for byte in key.utf8 {
            hash ^= UInt64(byte)
            hash = hash &* 1_099_511_628_211
        }
        return Double(hash % 360) / 360.0
    }

    /// The accent for a tab: explicit theme-color if present and parseable,
    /// else a hue derived from its host (or URL).
    static func accent(for tab: Tab) -> Color {
        if let hex = tab.themeColor, let color = Color(hexString: hex) {
            return color.calmedAccent
        }
        let key = tab.host ?? tab.url
        return Color(hue: hue(for: key), saturation: 0.42, brightness: 0.78)
    }
}

extension Color {
    /// Rein in neon accents: cap saturation and brightness so per-site colors
    /// read as identity, not glare. Every chrome accent routes through this;
    /// raw favicon pixels stay untouched.
    var calmedAccent: Color {
        let ns = NSColor(self).usingColorSpace(.sRGB) ?? .white
        var h: CGFloat = 0, s: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0
        ns.getHue(&h, saturation: &s, brightness: &b, alpha: &a)
        return Color(hue: h, saturation: min(s, 0.48), brightness: min(b, 0.82), opacity: a)
    }
}

/// A one-letter monogram for a host, used as a lightweight favicon stand-in.
func monogram(forHost host: String?) -> String {
    guard let host else { return "•" }
    let trimmed = host.hasPrefix("www.") ? String(host.dropFirst(4)) : host
    return trimmed.first.map { String($0).uppercased() } ?? "•"
}

/// The muted-fill + same-hue glow treatment shared by every bento card.
struct BentoCard: ViewModifier {
    let accent: Color
    var active: Bool = false
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 14

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius, style: .continuous)
        // Spotlight vibe: dark, glassy, minimal. Colour identity comes from the
        // favicon; the surface stays neutral white-opacity. Active = accent rim.
        content
            .background(shape.fill(Color.white.opacity(active ? 0.12 : 0.05)))
            .clipShape(shape)
            // Outward active rim (drawn after the clip so it never eats interior).
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius + 1.5, style: .continuous).inset(by: -1.5)
                    .strokeBorder(accent.opacity(active ? 0.5 : 0.0), lineWidth: 1.5)
            )
            .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(active ? 0.0 : 0.06), lineWidth: 0.5))
    }
}

extension View {
    func bentoCard(accent: Color, active: Bool = false, cornerRadius: CGFloat = 14) -> some View {
        modifier(BentoCard(accent: accent, active: active, cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
    }
}
//
//  EdgeHeld.swift
//  Held items: hold the noun, type the verb. ⌘↑ on a file result (or a drop on the
//  bar or the slot above it) floats it above the whole stack; what you type
//  next is read as a verb on it first (EdgeHeldVerbs). Every verb that changes a file
//  writes a new version and never touches the original; ⌘Z steps back one. Done (or
//  Esc on an empty query) lets go. Spotlight.swift only hosts this: the strip's slot,
//  ⌘↑ / ⌘Z / Esc / ↵, and the held card.
//

import AppKit
import QuickLookThumbnailing
import SwiftUI

struct HeldVersion: Equatable {
    var url: URL
    var bytes: Int64
    var label: String
    var method: String
    var note: String?
    /// This step renamed the file at `renamedFrom` to `url` (rename): undo moves it back
    /// instead of discarding anything.
    var renamedFrom: URL? = nil
}

@MainActor @Observable final class HeldItem: Identifiable {
    let id = UUID()
    /// The file that was held. Changes only when a rename moves it (and moves back on undo).
    private(set) var original: URL
    let noun: HeldNoun
    let originalBytes: Int64
    let heldAt = Date()
    private(set) var versions: [HeldVersion] = []
    /// An operation is running on it (squeezed look + progress).
    var busy = false
    var progress: Double = 0
    /// A short-lived message on the chip ("already under", "got it to 31 MB").
    var flash: String?
    var flashIsError = false

    /// Made by an action from other held things (zip, pdf): undo trashes it and brings them back.
    let produced: Bool
    private(set) var madeFrom: [HeldItem]

    init(url: URL, produced: Bool = false, madeFrom: [HeldItem] = []) {
        original = url
        noun = HeldNoun.of(url)
        originalBytes = FileSqueeze.size(url)
        self.produced = produced
        self.madeFrom = madeFrom
    }

    var current: URL { versions.last?.url ?? original }
    var currentBytes: Int64 { versions.last?.bytes ?? originalBytes }
    var name: String { current.lastPathComponent }
    var canUndo: Bool { !versions.isEmpty || produced }

    /// "612 → 94 MB" (the original, then each version, at most three numbers).
    var sizeChain: String {
        let sizes = [originalBytes] + versions.filter { $0.renamedFrom == nil }.map(\.bytes)
        let shown = sizes.count > 3 ? [sizes[0]] + sizes.suffix(2) : sizes
        guard shown.count > 1 else { return FileSqueeze.format(originalBytes) }
        // One unit at the end when they share it: "612 → 94 MB".
        let parts = shown.map { FileSqueeze.format($0) }
        let units = Set(parts.map { $0.split(separator: " ").last.map(String.init) ?? "" })
        if units.count == 1, let unit = units.first {
            return parts.map { String($0.split(separator: " ").first ?? "") }.joined(separator: " → ") + " " + unit
        }
        return parts.joined(separator: " → ")
    }

    func push(_ v: HeldVersion) { versions.append(v) }
    func pop() -> HeldVersion? { versions.popLast() }
    func setOriginal(_ url: URL) { original = url }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeHeld {
    static let shared = EdgeHeld()
    /// Objects (48pt) floating above the stack, each with its size line under it.
    static let labelHeight: CGFloat = 13
    static let stripHeight: CGFloat = 48 + 4 + labelHeight

    private(set) var items: [HeldItem] = []
    /// The strip is in the hierarchy / risen out of the bar (moved by layout, like dictation).
    private(set) var stripPresent = false
    private(set) var stripRisen = false
    /// Done was pressed: chips slide away before the strip sinks.
    private(set) var releasing = false
    /// A file is being dragged out of a card: the slot opens as a drop target.
    private(set) var cardDragging = false
    var dropTargeted = false
    var barDropTargeted = false
    /// The command the bar's current text spells (the held card reads it).
    private(set) var command: HeldCommand?
    /// Asks the bar to type (verb chips, the debug hook). `id` changes per request.
    struct QueryRequest: Equatable { var id: Int; var text: String; var run: Bool }
    private(set) var queryRequest: QueryRequest?

    @ObservationIgnored private var undoOrder: [UUID] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var dragTimer: Timer?
    @ObservationIgnored private var requestCounter = 0
    /// Where an undone version goes: the Trash (never deleted outright). Tests swap it.
    @ObservationIgnored var discard: (URL) -> Void = { NSWorkspace.shared.recycle([$0]) { _, _ in } }

    var hasItems: Bool { !items.isEmpty }
    var canUndo: Bool { items.contains(where: \.canUndo) }
    /// Room the strip takes above the bar (its height + the gap) while it shows.
    var space: CGFloat { stripRisen ? Self.stripHeight + EdgeLayout.gap : 0 }

    private static let rise = Animation.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.78)
    private static let sink = Animation.spring(response: 0.28, dampingFraction: 1)
    static let chipSpring = Animation.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.62)

    private init() {}

    // MARK: Holding

    /// Holds files (deduplicated by original or current version). Returns true if any were added.
    @discardableResult
    func hold(_ urls: [URL], source: String) -> Bool {
        var added = 0
        for url in urls where url.isFileURL && FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) {
            let path = url.standardizedFileURL.path
            guard !items.contains(where: { $0.original.standardizedFileURL.path == path || $0.current.standardizedFileURL.path == path }) else { continue }
            let item = HeldItem(url: url.standardizedFileURL)
            withAnimation(Self.chipSpring) { items.append(item) }
            added += 1
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.add", params: [
                "kind": item.noun.rawValue, "bytes": item.originalBytes, "source": source, "count": items.count,
            ])
        }
        if added > 0 { updateStrip() }
        return added > 0
    }

    func remove(_ item: HeldItem, source: String = "chip") {
        guard let i = items.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == item.id }) else { return }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.remove", params: ["kind": item.noun.rawValue, "versions": item.versions.count, "source": source])
        withAnimation(Self.chipSpring) { _ = items.remove(at: i) }
        undoOrder.removeAll { $0 == item.id }
        EdgeCompose.shared.forget(item)
        updateStrip()
    }

    /// Lets go of everything: chips slide away, then the strip sinks. Versions stay on disk.
    func done(source: String) {
        guard hasItems, !releasing else { return }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.done", params: [
            "count": items.count, "versions": items.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.versions.count },
            "ms": Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(items.map(\.heldAt).min() ?? Date()) * 1000), "source": source,
        ])
        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85)) { releasing = true }
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2 + 0.04 * Double(min(items.count, 6))) { [self] in
            withAnimation(Self.sink) { stripRisen = false } completion: { [self] in
                items = []
                undoOrder = []
                releasing = false
                command = nil
                EdgeCompose.shared.reset()
                EdgeHeldActions.shared.reset()
                updateStrip()
            }
        }
    }

    /// The slot shows while something is held or a card's file is being dragged.
    private func updateStrip() {
        let wants = hasItems || (cardDragging && EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files))
        if wants, !stripPresent {
            stripPresent = true
            DispatchQueue.main.async { [self] in withAnimation(Self.rise) { stripRisen = true } }
        } else if wants, !stripRisen, !releasing {
            withAnimation(Self.rise) { stripRisen = true }
        } else if !wants, stripPresent, !releasing {
            withAnimation(Self.sink) { stripRisen = false } completion: { [self] in
                if !(hasItems || cardDragging) { stripPresent = false }
            }
        }
    }

    /// A file row in a card started dragging (Spotlight's drag source calls this): the
    /// slot above the bar opens as a hold target until the mouse button comes up.
    func cardDragBegan() {
        guard EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files) else { return }
        cardDragging = true
        updateStrip()
        dragTimer?.invalidate()
        dragTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1.0 / 30, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self, NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons & 1 == 0 else { return }
                self.dragTimer?.invalidate(); self.dragTimer = nil
                // Let a drop land (and hold) before the empty slot decides to sink.
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.15) {
                    self.cardDragging = false
                    self.dropTargeted = false
                    self.updateStrip()
                }
            }
        }
        RunLoop.main.add(dragTimer!, forMode: .common)
    }

    // MARK: The bar

    /// What the bar's text means with things held (nil = search as usual). Remembered for the card.
    func command(for query: String) -> HeldCommand? {
        let c = HeldVerbs.match(query, items: items)
        if c != command { command = c }
        if c?.verb == "mail" { EdgeCompose.shared.update(argument: c?.argument ?? "", held: items) }
        return c
    }

    /// ↵ on the held card. Returns true when the bar should clear its query.
    func perform(_ query: String, source: String = "key") -> Bool {
        guard let c = command(for: query) else { return false }
        switch c.verb {
        case "squeeze":
            if let target = c.target { squeeze(target, source: source) }
            return true
        case "undo":
            undo(source: source)
            return true
        case "done":
            done(source: source)
            return true
        case "mail":
            EdgeCompose.shared.focusBody()
            return false
        default:
            // File actions (EdgeHeldActions): convert, resize, pdf, zip, rename.
            return EdgeHeldActions.shared.perform(c, items: items, source: source)
        }
    }

    /// Verb chips and the debug hook type into the bar through this.
    func type(_ text: String, run: Bool = false) {
        requestCounter += 1
        queryRequest = QueryRequest(id: requestCounter, text: text, run: run)
    }

    func tapVerb(_ spec: HeldVerbSpec) {
        switch spec.id {
        case "done": done(source: "chip")
        case "undo": undo(source: "chip")
        default: type(spec.seed)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Squeeze

    /// Squeezes every held file to the target, one at a time, from its original.
    func squeeze(_ target: FileSqueeze.Target, only: [HeldItem]? = nil, source: String) {
        let queue = (only ?? items).filter { $0.noun.isFile && !$0.busy }
        guard !queue.isEmpty else { return }
        for item in queue {
            withAnimation(Self.chipSpring) { item.busy = true; item.progress = 0; item.flash = nil }
        }
        Task { @MainActor in
            for item in queue { await squeezeOne(item, target: target, source: source) }
        }
    }

    private func squeezeOne(_ item: HeldItem, target: FileSqueeze.Target, source: String) async {
        let start = Date()
        let from = item.currentBytes
        let limit = target.bytes(for: item.originalBytes)
        var params: [String: Any] = ["kind": item.noun.rawValue, "from": from, "target": limit, "source": source]
        // Already fits as it is now: nothing to make.
        if item.currentBytes < limit, item.canUndo || item.originalBytes < limit {
            params["result"] = "already"
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.squeeze", params: params)
            settle(item, flash: "already under " + FileSqueeze.format(limit), error: false)
            return
        }
        do {
            let r = try await FileSqueeze.squeeze(item.original, target: target) { p in
                Task { @MainActor in item.progress = p }
            }
            params["ms"] = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(start) * 1000)
            params["method"] = r.method
            params["to"] = r.bytes
            guard let url = r.url else {
                params["result"] = "already"
                InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.squeeze", params: params)
                settle(item, flash: "already under " + FileSqueeze.format(limit), error: false)
                return
            }
            params["result"] = "ok"
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.squeeze", params: params)
            item.push(HeldVersion(url: url, bytes: r.bytes, label: target.label, method: r.method, note: r.note))
            undoOrder.append(item.id)
            settle(item, flash: r.note, error: false)
        } catch {
            params["ms"] = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(start) * 1000)
            params["result"] = "failed"
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.squeeze", params: params)
            settle(item, flash: (error as? SqueezeError)?.description ?? "Couldn't squeeze it.", error: true)
        }
    }

    /// The chip springs back (with a little overshoot) and shows what happened for a moment.
    func settle(_ item: HeldItem, flash: String?, error: Bool) {
        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.34, dampingFraction: 0.5)) {
            item.busy = false
            item.progress = 1
            item.flash = flash
            item.flashIsError = error
        }
        guard flash != nil else { return }
        let shown = flash
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + (error ? 5 : 3.5)) {
            if item.flash == shown { withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2)) { item.flash = nil } }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Undo

    /// One step back: the newest version (of `item`, or of whatever changed last) goes to
    /// the Trash; a rename is moved back; a zip/pdf made from held things goes to the Trash
    /// and they come back. The original is never touched.
    @discardableResult
    func undo(_ item: HeldItem? = nil, source: String) -> Bool {
        let target = item ?? undoOrder.reversed().lazy.compactMap { id in self.items.first { $0.id == id && $0.canUndo } }.first
            ?? items.last(where: \.canUndo)
        guard let target, !target.busy, target.canUndo else { return false }
        if target.versions.isEmpty, target.produced { return unmake(target, source: source) }
        guard let v = target.pop() else { return false }
        if let from = v.renamedFrom {
            do {
                try FileActions.renameBack(v.url, to: from)
            } catch {
                target.push(v)
                settle(target, flash: (error as? FileActionError)?.description ?? "Couldn't rename it back.", error: true)
                return false
            }
            if target.original.standardizedFileURL.path == v.url.standardizedFileURL.path { target.setOriginal(from) }
        } else if v.url.standardizedFileURL.path != target.original.standardizedFileURL.path {
            discard(v.url)
        }
        if let i = undoOrder.lastIndex(of: target.id) { undoOrder.remove(at: i) }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.undo", params: ["kind": target.noun.rawValue, "from": v.bytes, "to": target.currentBytes,
                                                              "step": v.renamedFrom == nil ? "version" : "rename", "source": source])
        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.34, dampingFraction: 0.55)) { target.flash = nil }
        return true
    }

    /// Undoes a made thing: its file goes to the Trash and what it was made from is held again, in its place.
    private func unmake(_ made: HeldItem, source: String) -> Bool {
        guard let i = items.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == made.id }) else { return false }
        discard(made.current)
        if let j = undoOrder.lastIndex(of: made.id) { undoOrder.remove(at: j) }
        withAnimation(Self.chipSpring) {
            items.remove(at: i)
            items.insert(contentsOf: made.madeFrom, at: min(i, items.count))
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.undo", params: ["kind": made.noun.rawValue, "from": made.originalBytes, "to": 0,
                                                              "step": "made", "source": source])
        updateStrip()
        return true
    }

    // MARK: File actions (EdgeHeldActions runs them; these keep the model's books)

    /// A new version of `item` (a converted or resized copy).
    func addVersion(_ v: HeldVersion, to item: HeldItem) {
        item.push(v)
        undoOrder.append(item.id)
    }

    /// `item`'s current file was renamed from `old` to `new`.
    func renamed(_ item: HeldItem, from old: URL, to new: URL) {
        if item.original.standardizedFileURL.path == old.standardizedFileURL.path { item.setOriginal(new) }
        item.push(HeldVersion(url: new, bytes: item.currentBytes, label: "renamed", method: "rename", renamedFrom: old))
        undoOrder.append(item.id)
    }

    /// `inputs` became one new file (zip, pdf): it takes their place in the strip.
    func collapse(_ inputs: [HeldItem], into made: HeldItem) {
        let first = items.firstIndex { i in inputs.contains { $0.id == i.id } } ?? items.count
        withAnimation(Self.chipSpring) {
            items.removeAll { i in inputs.contains { $0.id == i.id } }
            items.insert(made, at: min(first, items.count))
        }
        undoOrder.removeAll { id in inputs.contains { $0.id == id } }
        undoOrder.append(made.id)
        updateStrip()
    }

    // MARK: Out

    func reveal(_ item: HeldItem) {
        NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([item.current])
    }

    // MARK: Debug hook (com.hashawn.nardo.held)

    /// `path` holds a file; `query` types into the bar; `run` = "1" performs it as ↵ would;
    /// `done` = "1" lets go.
    func debugHook(_ info: [AnyHashable: Any]) {
        if let path = info["path"] as? String {
            hold([URL(fileURLWithPath: (path as NSString).expandingTildeInPath)], source: "debug")
        }
        if let query = info["query"] as? String {
            type(query, run: (info["run"] as? String) == "1")
        }
        if (info["done"] as? String) == "1" { done(source: "debug") }
    }
}

// MARK: - Held row

/// Above the whole stack (cards, dictation, bar), on nothing: the held things as real objects (their thumbnail: the image, a video frame, a PDF's first page, an
/// app's icon), each with its size under it. The verbs that fit what's held float at the
/// right end. While a card's file is dragged with nothing held, a ghost slot takes the drop.
struct EdgeHeldStrip: View {
    let model: EdgeHeld

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 0) {
                if model.items.isEmpty {
                    slot
                } else {
                    // Objects stand plainly while they fit; a long row scrolls sideways.
                    ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                        objects.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) { objects }
                            .scrollEdgeEffectHidden(true, for: .horizontal)
                    }
                    verbs
                }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .frame(width: EdgeLayout.contentWidth, height: EdgeHeld.stripHeight, alignment: .bottom)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .dropDestination(for: URL.self) { urls, _ in
            model.hold(urls, source: "drop")
        } isTargeted: { targeted in
            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2, dampingFraction: 0.7)) { model.dropTargeted = targeted }
        }
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }

    private var objects: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 12) {
            ForEach(Array(model.items.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { i, item in
                HeldObject(item: item, model: model, index: i)
                    // Set down from above with a little bounce; lifted off when let go of.
                    .transition(.asymmetric(insertion: .offset(y: -26).combined(with: .opacity),
                                            removal: .offset(y: -18).combined(with: .opacity)))
            }
        }
        .padding(.leading, 2)
    }

    /// Empty: a ghost object, saying "set it here" without words.
    private var slot: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 7, style: .continuous)
        return shape
            .strokeBorder(HeldVerbs.heldTint.opacity(model.dropTargeted ? 1 : 0.55), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.25, dash: [4, 3]))
            .overlay(Image(systemName: "arrow.down").font(.system(size: 13, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(HeldVerbs.heldTint.opacity(model.dropTargeted ? 1 : 0.6)))
            .frame(width: 42, height: 42)
            .scaleEffect(model.dropTargeted ? 1.12 : 1, anchor: .bottom)
            .padding(.bottom, EdgeHeld.labelHeight)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .help("Drop to hold")
    }

    private var verbs: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 4) {
            ForEach(HeldVerbs.offered(for: model.items)) { spec in
                verbButton(spec)
            }
            if let done = HeldVerbs.spec("done") { verbButton(done) }
        }
        .padding(.bottom, EdgeHeld.labelHeight + 8)
    }

    private func verbButton(_ spec: HeldVerbSpec) -> some View {
        Button { model.tapVerb(spec) } label: {
            Image(systemName: spec.symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 12.5, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(spec.tint)
                .frame(width: 30, height: 30)
                .background(spec.tint.opacity(0.16), in: Circle())
                .contentShape(Circle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(HeldPressStyle())
        .help(spec.help)
        .accessibilityLabel(spec.help)
    }
}

/// Presses squash a little and spring back (the app's wobble).
struct HeldPressStyle: ButtonStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.86 : 1)
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.22, dampingFraction: 0.5), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

/// One held thing, floating: its real thumbnail (drag it out to use the
/// current version; drags copy, never move), a contact shadow, and its size chain
/// under it. Hover lifts it a little (its shadow grows) and shows
/// ✕ (and ↶ / reveal once it has versions). A squeeze presses it flat.
struct HeldObject: View {
    let item: HeldItem
    let model: EdgeHeld
    let index: Int
    @State private var hovering = false
    @State private var thumb: NSImage?
    @State private var thumbFor: URL?

    private static let maxSide: CGFloat = 48

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            object
                .offset(y: hovering && !item.busy ? -3 : 0)
                .frame(height: Self.maxSide + 4, alignment: .bottom)
            label
                .frame(height: EdgeHeld.labelHeight)
        }
        .fixedSize()
        // Done: each one tips and slides away, one after another.
        .rotationEffect(.degrees(model.releasing ? 10 : 0), anchor: .bottomTrailing)
        .offset(x: model.releasing ? 90 : 0)
        .opacity(model.releasing ? 0 : 1)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.8).delay(0.05 * Double(index)), value: model.releasing)
        .onHover { h in withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.22, dampingFraction: 0.62)) { hovering = h } }
        .contextMenu {
            if item.canUndo {
                Button("One step back") { model.undo(item, source: "menu") }
                Button("Show in Finder") { model.reveal(item) }
            }
            Button("Let go of this one") { model.remove(item, source: "menu") }
        }
        .task(id: item.current) { await loadThumb() }
    }

    private var objectSize: CGSize {
        guard let t = thumb, t.size.width > 0, t.size.height > 0, !showsIcon else { return CGSize(width: 44, height: 44) }
        let scale = Self.maxSide / max(t.size.width, t.size.height)
        return CGSize(width: max(26, t.size.width * scale), height: max(26, t.size.height * scale))
    }

    /// Apps, folders and things with no picture stand as their icon (no frame).
    private var showsIcon: Bool { thumb == nil || item.noun == .folder || item.current.pathExtension == "app" }

    @ViewBuilder private var object: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous)
        Group {
            if showsIcon {
                Image(nsImage: FilePreviewCache.icon(item.current.path))
                    .resizable().scaledToFit()
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.45), radius: hovering ? 6 : 3, y: hovering ? 4 : 2)
            } else if let thumb {
                Image(nsImage: thumb).resizable().scaledToFill()
                    .clipShape(shape)
                    .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.22), lineWidth: 0.75))
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.5), radius: hovering ? 7 : 4, y: hovering ? 5 : 2.5)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: objectSize.width, height: objectSize.height)
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            if item.busy {
                // Progress fills up the object from its base while it's pressed.
                GeometryReader { g in
                    shape.fill(HeldVerbs.heldTint.opacity(0.35))
                        .frame(height: max(2, g.size.height * item.progress))
                        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .bottom)
                }
                .clipShape(shape)
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            if item.flash != nil, item.flashIsError {
                shape.strokeBorder(Color.orange.opacity(0.9), lineWidth: 1.25)
            }
        }
        // The AppKit drag source sits on top, so it carries the tooltip too.
        .overlay(HeldDragSource(item: item, tooltip: tooltip))
        .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
            if hovering && !item.busy {
                HStack(spacing: 2) {
                    if item.canUndo {
                        badge("arrow.uturn.backward", help: "One step back (⌘Z)") { model.undo(item, source: "chip") }
                        badge("magnifyingglass", help: "Show in Finder") { model.reveal(item) }
                    }
                    badge("xmark", help: "Let go of this one") { model.remove(item) }
                }
                .offset(x: 8, y: -8)
                .transition(.scale(scale: 0.5, anchor: .bottomLeading).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        // The squeeze: pressed flat while it works, springs back up when it lands.
        .scaleEffect(x: item.busy ? 1.08 : 1, y: item.busy ? 0.72 : 1, anchor: .bottom)
    }

    /// The size chain under the object ("612 → 94 MB"), or what just happened.
    @ViewBuilder private var label: some View {
        Group {
            if let flash = item.flash {
                Text(flash).foregroundStyle(item.flashIsError ? Color.orange : HeldVerbs.heldTint)
            } else {
                Text(item.sizeChain).foregroundStyle(item.canUndo ? HeldVerbs.heldTint : .white.opacity(0.55))
            }
        }
        .font(.system(size: 9, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
        // Over whatever's behind the layer (it floats on nothing): a shadow keeps it legible.
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.9), radius: 1.5)
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.6), radius: 4)
        .lineLimit(1)
        .fixedSize()
    }

    private var tooltip: String {
        var lines = [item.current.path]
        if let v = item.versions.last {
            lines.append(FileSqueeze.format(item.originalBytes) + " → " + FileSqueeze.format(v.bytes) + " · " + v.method)
            if let note = v.note { lines.append(note) }
            lines.append("Original untouched: " + item.original.lastPathComponent)
        }
        lines.append("Drag to use it anywhere (copies)")
        return lines.joined(separator: "\n")
    }

    private func badge(_ symbol: String, help: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                .frame(width: 17, height: 17)
                .background(Circle().fill(Color(white: 0.18)))
                .overlay(Circle().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 0.5))
                .contentShape(Circle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(HeldPressStyle())
        .help(help)
        .accessibilityLabel(help)
    }

    /// The real picture of the current version, decoded at object size off the main thread.
    private func loadThumb() async {
        let url = item.current
        guard thumbFor != url else { return }
        let image = await HeldThumbs.load(url)
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15)) { thumb = image; thumbFor = url }
    }
}

/// Thumbnails for held objects: ImageIO for images (fast, exact), Quick Look for the rest.
enum HeldThumbs {
    private static let cache = NSCache<NSURL, NSImage>()

    static func load(_ url: URL) async -> NSImage? {
        if let hit = cache.object(forKey: url as NSURL) { return hit }
        let px: CGFloat = 160
        var image: NSImage?
        if let src = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url as CFURL, nil), CGImageSourceGetCount(src) > 0,
           let type = CGImageSourceGetType(src) as String?, !type.contains("pdf") {
            let opts: [CFString: Any] = [kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
                                         kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
                                         kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: px]
            if let cg = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(src, 0, opts as CFDictionary) {
                image = NSImage(cgImage: cg, size: NSSize(width: cg.width, height: cg.height))
            }
        }
        if image == nil {
            let request = QLThumbnailGenerator.Request(fileAt: url, size: CGSize(width: px / 2, height: px / 2),
                                                       scale: 2, representationTypes: .thumbnail)
            image = (try? await QLThumbnailGenerator.shared.generateBestRepresentation(for: request))?.nsImage
        }
        if let image { cache.setObject(image, forKey: url as NSURL) }
        return image
    }
}

// MARK: - Drag out (copy only)

/// An AppKit drag source over the chip's icon and name: the current version as a file
/// URL, offered for copying only, so Finder copies even on the same volume (a held file
/// is never moved out from under you).
struct HeldDragSource: NSViewRepresentable {
    let item: HeldItem
    let tooltip: String

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> SourceView { SourceView() }
    func updateNSView(_ view: SourceView, context: Context) {
        view.item = item
        if view.toolTip != tooltip { view.toolTip = tooltip }
    }

    final class SourceView: NSView, NSDraggingSource {
        var item: HeldItem?
        private var downEvent: NSEvent?

        override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { downEvent = event }
        override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) { downEvent = nil }

        override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
            guard let down = downEvent, let item else { return }
            let d = hypot(event.locationInWindow.x - down.locationInWindow.x, event.locationInWindow.y - down.locationInWindow.y)
            guard d > 3 else { return }
            downEvent = nil
            let url = item.current
            guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else { return }
            let dragItem = NSDraggingItem(pasteboardWriter: url as NSURL)
            let icon = NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: url.path)
            let p = convert(down.locationInWindow, from: nil)
            dragItem.setDraggingFrame(NSRect(x: p.x - 16, y: p.y - 16, width: 32, height: 32), contents: icon)
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("held.drag_out", params: ["kind": item.noun.rawValue, "version": item.canUndo])
            ShelfEdge.shared.ownDragBegan()
            beginDraggingSession(with: [dragItem], event: down, source: self)
        }

        func draggingSession(_ session: NSDraggingSession, sourceOperationMaskFor context: NSDraggingContext) -> NSDragOperation {
            .copy
        }

        override func acceptsFirstMouse(for event: NSEvent?) -> Bool { true }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeAgendaLive.swift
//  The calendar card's real source: EventKit events (through EdgeCalendarStore) and
//  reminders, meeting joins through the service's app when it has one, and the journal.
//

import AppKit
import EventKit

@MainActor enum EdgeAgenda {
    /// What the card reads; tools/calendar-test swaps in an in-memory one.
    static var source: any EdgeAgendaSource = EdgeAgendaLive.shared
}

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeAgendaLive: EdgeAgendaSource {
    static let shared = EdgeAgendaLive()

    private var calendars: EdgeCalendarStore { .shared }
    private var store: EKEventStore { calendars.store }
    private(set) var reminderStatus = EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .reminder)
    private var reminderRevision = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var cached: [EdgeReminderItem] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var fetchedKey = ""
    @ObservationIgnored private var fetching = false
    /// Checked off just now: kept on the card (checked) until the wobble has played.
    @ObservationIgnored private var lingering: [String: (item: EdgeReminderItem, until: Date)] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var links: [String: EdgeMeetingLink?] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var requestingReminders = false

    private init() {}

    var revision: Int { calendars.revision &+ reminderRevision }
    var calendarAccess: EdgeAccess { Self.access(calendars.status) }
    var reminderAccess: EdgeAccess { Self.access(reminderStatus) }

    private static func access(_ s: EKAuthorizationStatus) -> EdgeAccess {
        switch s {
        case .fullAccess: .granted
        case .notDetermined: .unknown
        default: .denied
        }
    }

    // MARK: Events

    func events(on day: Date) -> [EdgeAgendaEvent] {
        calendars.events(on: day).map(value)
    }

    private func value(_ e: EKEvent) -> EdgeAgendaEvent {
        let id = (e.eventIdentifier ?? e.calendarItemIdentifier) + "@" + String(Int(e.startDate.timeIntervalSince1970))
        // Link extraction reads the notes with regexes: once per event edit, not per frame.
        let key = id + "#" + String(e.lastModifiedDate?.timeIntervalSince1970 ?? 0)
        let link: EdgeMeetingLink?
        if let hit = links[key] { link = hit } else {
            link = EdgeMeetings.link(url: e.url, location: e.location, notes: e.notes)
            if links.count > 400 { links.removeAll() }
            links[key] = link
        }
        let declined = e.status == .canceled || e.attendees?.first(where: \.isCurrentUser)?.participantStatus == .declined
        return EdgeAgendaEvent(id: id, eventID: e.eventIdentifier, title: e.title ?? "", start: e.startDate, end: e.endDate,
                               allDay: e.isAllDay, color: e.calendar.cgColor, link: link, declined: declined)
    }

    func requestCalendars() {
        if calendars.status == .notDetermined { calendars.requestIfNeeded(); return }
        _ = PermissionGuide.shared.ensure(.calendars, reason: "So the calendar card can show your events.")
    }

    @discardableResult
    func add(_ draft: EdgeCalendarIntent.Draft) -> Bool {
        let ok = calendars.add(draft)
        if ok {
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("calendar.add", params: [
                "all_day": draft.allDay ? "1" : "0",
                "minutes": String(Int(draft.end.timeIntervalSince(draft.start) / 60)),
                "lead_minutes": String(Int(draft.start.timeIntervalSinceNow / 60)),
            ])
        }
        return ok
    }

    func open(_ event: EdgeAgendaEvent?) {
        let ek = event?.eventID.flatMap { store.event(withIdentifier: $0) }
        calendars.open(ek)
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("calendar.open", params: ["has_event": ek == nil ? "0" : "1"])
    }

    /// Opens the meeting in its app (zoommtg:, msteams:) when one is installed, else the link.
    func join(_ event: EdgeAgendaEvent, source: String) {
        guard let link = event.link else { return }
        var target = link.url
        if let app = link.appURL, NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(toOpen: app) != nil { target = app }
        NSWorkspace.shared.open(target)
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("calendar.join", params: [
            "service": link.service.rawValue,
            "source": source,
            "app": target == link.url ? "0" : "1",
            "lead_s": String(Int(event.start.timeIntervalSinceNow)),
        ])
    }

    // MARK: Reminders

    func requestReminders() {
        if reminderStatus == .notDetermined { requestReminderAccess(); return }
        _ = PermissionGuide.shared.ensure(.reminders, reason: "So the calendar card can list and check off reminders.")
    }

    /// EventKit's own prompt, once.
    func requestReminderAccess() {
        guard reminderStatus == .notDetermined, !requestingReminders else { return }
        requestingReminders = true
        store.requestFullAccessToReminders { _, _ in
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                let me = EdgeAgendaLive.shared
                me.requestingReminders = false
                me.reminderStatus = EKEventStore.authorizationStatus(for: .reminder)
                me.fetchedKey = ""
                me.reminderRevision += 1
            }
        }
    }

    func reminders(now: Date) -> [EdgeReminderItem] {
        guard reminderStatus == .fullAccess else { return [] }
        let cal = Calendar.current
        // Refetch when EventKit changed or the day rolled over.
        let key = String(calendars.revision) + "|" + String(Int(cal.startOfDay(for: now).timeIntervalSince1970))
        if key != fetchedKey, !fetching { fetch(key: key, now: now) }
        var items = cached
        for (id, entry) in lingering where entry.until > now && !items.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) { items.append(entry.item) }
        return EdgeReminderItem.ordered(items.map { item in
            var item = item
            if let l = lingering[item.id], l.until > now { item.done = l.item.done }
            return item
        }, now: now)
    }

    private func fetch(key: String, now: Date) {
        fetching = true
        let cal = Calendar.current
        let end = cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: cal.startOfDay(for: now))!
        let predicate = store.predicateForIncompleteReminders(withDueDateStarting: nil, ending: end, calendars: nil)
        store.fetchReminders(matching: predicate) { found in
            let items: [EdgeReminderItem] = (found ?? []).compactMap { r in
                guard let comps = r.dueDateComponents, let due = Calendar.current.date(from: comps) else { return nil }
                return EdgeReminderItem(id: r.calendarItemIdentifier, title: r.title ?? "", due: due,
                                        hasTime: comps.hour != nil, color: r.calendar.cgColor)
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                let me = EdgeAgendaLive.shared
                me.fetching = false
                me.cached = items
                me.fetchedKey = key
                me.reminderRevision += 1
            }
        }
    }

    @discardableResult
    func add(_ reminder: EdgeCalendarIntent.ReminderDraft) -> Bool {
        guard reminderStatus == .fullAccess else { requestReminders(); return false }
        guard let list = store.defaultCalendarForNewReminders() else { return false }
        let r = EKReminder(eventStore: store)
        r.title = reminder.title
        r.calendar = list
        let parts: Set<Calendar.Component> = reminder.hasTime ? [.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute] : [.year, .month, .day]
        r.dueDateComponents = Calendar.current.dateComponents(parts, from: reminder.due)
        // Said a time: it should actually remind you then.
        if reminder.hasTime { r.addAlarm(EKAlarm(absoluteDate: reminder.due)) }
        do { try store.save(r, commit: true) } catch { return false }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("reminders.add", params: [
            "has_time": reminder.hasTime ? "1" : "0",
            "lead_minutes": String(Int(reminder.due.timeIntervalSinceNow / 60)),
        ])
        fetchedKey = ""
        reminderRevision += 1
        return true
    }

    func setDone(_ item: EdgeReminderItem, _ done: Bool, source: String) {
        guard let r = store.calendarItem(withIdentifier: item.id) as? EKReminder else { return }
        r.isCompleted = done
        do { try store.save(r, commit: true) } catch { return }
