        var shown = item; shown.done = done
        // Checked: stays (struck through) long enough to see; unchecked: back for good.
        lingering[item.id] = (shown, Date().addingTimeInterval(done ? 1.6 : 0))
        if !done {
            lingering[item.id] = nil
            if !cached.contains(where: { $0.id == item.id }) { cached.append(shown) }   // before the refetch lands
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("reminders.complete", params: [
            "done": done ? "1" : "0",
            "overdue": item.overdue(now: Date()) ? "1" : "0",
            "has_time": item.hasTime ? "1" : "0",
            "source": source,
        ])
        reminderRevision += 1
        if done {
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.7) {
                let me = EdgeAgendaLive.shared
                me.lingering = me.lingering.filter { $0.value.until > Date() }
                me.reminderRevision += 1
            }
        }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeHeldActions.swift
//  File actions as held verbs: `to png|jpg|heic|avif|tiff`, `resize 50%|1080|1920x1080`,
//  `to mp4|mov|m4a`, `pdf` / `merge`, `zip`, `rename …` (FileActions.swift does the work).
//  Typed at held files, or, with nothing held and Finder in front, at Finder's selection
//  ("zip these"). Per-file actions add a version to each held file (⌘Z trashes it); zip and
//  pdf turn their inputs into one new held file (⌘Z trashes it and brings them back);
//  rename moves names (⌘Z moves them back). Running and finished jobs show on the held
//  card with an empty query, finished ones as result tiles (drag out, reveal, copy).
//  Part of the Files module.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Families: one color and icon each

extension FileAction.Family {
    /// Color role per family (the held card's punctuation).
    var tint: Color {
        switch self {
        case .convert: Color(hexString: "#5ac8fa") ?? .cyan
        case .resize: Color(hexString: "#bf5af2") ?? .purple
        case .pdf: Color(hexString: "#ff6b5a") ?? .red
        case .zip: Color(hexString: "#ffb340") ?? .orange
        case .rename: Color(hexString: "#ffd60a") ?? .yellow
        }
    }

    /// Solar bold-duotone template icons (asset catalog).
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .convert: "solar-refresh-square"
        case .resize: "solar-maximize-square-minimalistic"
        case .pdf: "solar-documents"
        case .zip: "solar-zip-file"
        case .rename: "solar-pen-new-square"
        }
    }

    var journalName: String {
        switch self {
        case .convert: "files.convert"
        case .resize: "files.resize"
        case .pdf: "files.merge_pdf"
        case .zip: "files.zip"
        case .rename: "files.rename"
        }
    }

    /// Which held kinds the family works on (the exact action may narrow it: `to mp4` wants video).
    func accepts(_ noun: HeldNoun) -> Bool {
        switch self {
        case .convert: noun == .image || noun == .video || noun == .audio
        case .resize: noun == .image
        case .pdf: noun == .image || noun == .pdf
        case .zip, .rename: true
        }
    }
}

extension FileAction {
    /// The tile's icon: what it makes.
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .image: "solar-gallery"
        case .media(let f): f == .m4a ? "solar-music-note-2" : "solar-clapperboard-play"
        default: family.icon
        }
    }

    /// The tile's words.
    var tileLabel: String {
        if case .rename = self { return "rename" }
        return phrase
    }
}

/// A Solar template icon by asset name, tinted.
struct SolarIcon: View {
    let name: String
    var size: CGFloat = 18
    var body: some View {
        Image(nsImage: NSImage(named: name) ?? NSImage())
            .renderingMode(.template).resizable().scaledToFit()
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
    }
}

// MARK: - Verbs

@MainActor enum FileActionVerbs {
    static let ids: Set<String> = Set(FileAction.Family.allCases.map(\.rawValue))

    /// One verb per family. Offered as tiles on the held card, not as strip chips.
    static var specs: [HeldVerbSpec] {
        FileAction.Family.allCases.map { family in
            HeldVerbSpec(id: family.rawValue, symbol: "", tint: family.tint, help: family.rawValue,
                         seed: family == .rename ? "rename " : "", inStrip: false,
                         accepts: { family.accepts($0.noun) },
                         available: { EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files) },
                         parse: { q in
                             guard let parsed = FileActions.parse(q), parsed.action.family == family else { return nil }
                             return HeldCommand(verb: family.rawValue, argument: q, action: parsed.action)
                         })
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Jobs

/// One run of an action: a file (or a set, for zip/pdf) on its way to a result.
@MainActor @Observable final class FileActionJob: Identifiable {
    enum State: Equatable { case running, done, skipped(String), failed(String) }

    let id = UUID()
    let action: FileAction
    let inputs: [URL]
    let started = Date()
    var progress: Double = 0
    var state: State = .running
    var output: FileActionOutput?

    init(action: FileAction, inputs: [URL]) {
        self.action = action
        self.inputs = inputs
    }

    var running: Bool { state == .running }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeHeldActions {
    static let shared = EdgeHeldActions()

    /// This session's jobs (oldest first). Cleared on done; finished ones are dropped when
    /// the next action starts.
    private(set) var jobs: [FileActionJob] = []
    /// Nothing held and Finder in front: the selection the bar's action would run on.
    private(set) var finderItems: [HeldItem] = []
    private(set) var finderCommand: HeldCommand?

    /// Where the next perform came from, when it wasn't a key ("tile").
    @ObservationIgnored var nextSource: String?
    /// Finder's selection (Apple Events; asks once for Automation permission). Tests swap these.
    @ObservationIgnored var readFinderSelection: () -> [URL] = { FinderCut.finderSelection() }
    @ObservationIgnored var finderIsFront: () -> Bool = {
        NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication?.bundleIdentifier == "com.apple.finder"
    }
    /// The selection is read once while the bar keeps spelling an action, not per keystroke.
    @ObservationIgnored private var finderCache: [URL]?
    /// Results that can't be written next to their source go here (tests point it at a temp folder).
    @ObservationIgnored var outputRoot: URL?

    private init() {}

    var hasJobs: Bool { !jobs.isEmpty }

    /// The held card shows with an empty query: running/finished jobs and the action tiles.
    var showsIdleCard: Bool {
        let held = EdgeHeld.shared
        return held.hasItems && !held.releasing && EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files)
    }

    /// The actions worth a tile for what's held now.
    var suggestions: [FileAction] {
        EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files) ? FileActions.suggestions(for: EdgeHeld.shared.items.map(\.current)) : []
    }

    func reset() {
        jobs = []
        clearFinder()
    }

    // MARK: Perform

    /// ↵ on a file action. Returns true when the bar should clear its query.
    func perform(_ c: HeldCommand, items: [HeldItem], source: String) -> Bool {
        guard let action = c.action else { return false }
        let source = nextSource ?? source
        nextSource = nil
        jobs.removeAll { !$0.running }
        switch action {
        case .rename(let rule): rename(rule, items: items, source: source)
        case .zip, .pdf: combine(action, items: items, source: source)
        case .image, .resize, .media: transform(action, items: items, source: source)
        }
        return true
    }

    private func transform(_ action: FileAction, items: [HeldItem], source: String) {
        let held = EdgeHeld.shared
        let targets = items.filter { !$0.busy && FileActions.accepts(action, $0.current) }
        guard !targets.isEmpty else {
            for item in items { held.settle(item, flash: "not for " + item.noun.rawValue, error: false) }
            return
        }
        var queue: [(HeldItem, FileActionJob)] = []
        for item in targets {
            let job = FileActionJob(action: action, inputs: [item.current])
            jobs.append(job)
            queue.append((item, job))
            withAnimation(EdgeHeld.chipSpring) { item.busy = true; item.progress = 0; item.flash = nil }
        }
        let root = outputRoot
        Task { @MainActor in
            for (item, job) in queue {
                let source0 = item.current
                var params: [String: Any] = ["kind": item.noun.rawValue, "from": source0.pathExtension.lowercased(),
                                             "to": action.phrase, "bytes_in": item.currentBytes, "source": source]
                do {
                    let out = try await FileActions.transform(source0, action, outputRoot: root) { p in
                        Task { @MainActor in item.progress = p; job.progress = p }
                    }
                    job.output = out
                    job.progress = 1
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.34, dampingFraction: 0.7)) { job.state = .done }
                    held.addVersion(HeldVersion(url: out.url, bytes: out.bytes, label: action.phrase, method: out.method, note: out.note), to: item)
                    held.settle(item, flash: out.note, error: false)
                    params["result"] = "ok"; params["bytes_out"] = out.bytes; params["method"] = out.method
                } catch let e as FileActionError {
                    if case .nothingToDo(let why) = e {
                        job.state = .skipped(why)
                        held.settle(item, flash: why, error: false)
                        params["result"] = "already"
                    } else {
                        job.state = .failed(e.description)
                        held.settle(item, flash: e.description, error: true)
                        if case .unsupported = e { params["result"] = "unsupported" } else { params["result"] = "failed" }
                    }
                } catch {
                    job.state = .failed(error.localizedDescription)
                    held.settle(item, flash: "Couldn't do it.", error: true)
                    params["result"] = "failed"
                }
                params["ms"] = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(job.started) * 1000)
                InteractionJournal.shared.action(action.family.journalName, params: params)
            }
        }
    }

    private func combine(_ action: FileAction, items: [HeldItem], source: String) {
        let held = EdgeHeld.shared
        let inputs = items.filter { !$0.busy && FileActions.accepts(action, $0.current) }
        guard !inputs.isEmpty else {
            for item in items { held.settle(item, flash: "not for " + item.noun.rawValue, error: false) }
            return
        }
        let urls = inputs.map(\.current)
        let job = FileActionJob(action: action, inputs: urls)
        jobs.append(job)
        for item in inputs { withAnimation(EdgeHeld.chipSpring) { item.busy = true; item.progress = 0; item.flash = nil } }
        let root = outputRoot
        Task { @MainActor in
            var params: [String: Any] = ["count": urls.count, "bytes_in": inputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + $1.currentBytes }, "source": source]
            if action == .pdf {
                params["pdfs"] = inputs.filter { $0.noun == .pdf }.count
                params["images"] = inputs.filter { $0.noun == .image }.count
            }
            do {
                let out = try await FileActions.combine(urls, action, outputRoot: root) { p in
                    Task { @MainActor in job.progress = p; for i in inputs { i.progress = p } }
                }
                job.output = out
                job.progress = 1
                for item in inputs { item.busy = false; item.progress = 1 }
                let made = HeldItem(url: out.url, produced: true, madeFrom: inputs)
                held.collapse(inputs, into: made)
                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.34, dampingFraction: 0.7)) { job.state = .done }
                params["result"] = "ok"; params["bytes_out"] = out.bytes; params["method"] = out.method
            } catch let e as FileActionError {
                if case .nothingToDo(let why) = e {
                    job.state = .skipped(why)
                    for item in inputs { held.settle(item, flash: why, error: false) }
                    params["result"] = "already"
                } else {
                    job.state = .failed(e.description)
                    for item in inputs { held.settle(item, flash: e.description, error: true) }
                    params["result"] = "failed"
                }
            } catch {
                job.state = .failed(error.localizedDescription)
                for item in inputs { held.settle(item, flash: "Couldn't do it.", error: true) }
                params["result"] = "failed"
            }
            params["ms"] = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(job.started) * 1000)
            InteractionJournal.shared.action(action.family.journalName, params: params)
        }
    }

    /// Renames now (it's instant): each held file's current file gets its new name.
    private func rename(_ rule: FileAction.Rename, items: [HeldItem], source: String) {
        let held = EdgeHeld.shared
        let targets = items.filter { !$0.busy }
        let names = FileActions.renamePlan(targets.map(\.current), rule)
        var renamed = 0, skipped = 0, failed = 0
        for (item, name) in zip(targets, names) {
            let old = item.current
            guard name != old.lastPathComponent else { skipped += 1; continue }
            do {
                let new = try FileActions.rename(old, to: name)
                held.renamed(item, from: old, to: new)
                held.settle(item, flash: new.lastPathComponent, error: false)
                renamed += 1
            } catch {
                held.settle(item, flash: (error as? FileActionError)?.description ?? "Couldn't rename it.", error: true)
                failed += 1
            }
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("files.rename", params: [
            "count": targets.count, "rule": rule.rule, "renamed": renamed, "skipped": skipped, "failed": failed, "source": source,
        ])
    }

    // MARK: Finder selection

    /// With nothing held, Finder in front and the bar spelling a file action: that action
    /// on Finder's selection (read once, then cached while the bar keeps spelling one).
    /// Words that are also searches (`zip`, `pdf`, `rename trip`) need "these" / "this" /
    /// "selection" to mean Finder; `to png`, `to mp4`, `resize 50%` don't.
    func finderCommand(for query: String) -> HeldCommand? {
        guard !EdgeHeld.shared.hasItems, EdgeModules.shared.isOn(.files), let parsed = FileActions.parse(query),
              parsed.referent || Self.unmistakable(parsed.action), finderIsFront() else {
            clearFinder()
            return nil
        }
        let urls = finderCache ?? readFinderSelection()
        finderCache = urls
        guard !urls.isEmpty else {
            if finderCommand != nil { finderCommand = nil }
            return nil
        }
        if finderItems.map(\.original) != urls { finderItems = urls.map { HeldItem(url: $0) } }
        let c = HeldCommand(verb: parsed.action.family.rawValue, argument: query, action: parsed.action)
        if finderCommand != c { finderCommand = c }
        return c
    }

    /// ↵ on Finder's selection: those files become held and the action runs on them.
    func performFinder(_ query: String) -> Bool {
        guard let c = finderCommand(for: query) else { return false }
        let urls = finderItems.map(\.original)
        let held = EdgeHeld.shared
        held.hold(urls, source: "finder")
        let items = held.items.filter { item in urls.contains { $0.standardizedFileURL.path == item.original.standardizedFileURL.path } }
        clearFinder()
        return perform(c, items: items, source: nextSource ?? "finder")
    }

    /// Phrases nobody types as a search.
    static func unmistakable(_ action: FileAction) -> Bool {
        switch action {
        case .image, .media, .resize: true
        case .zip, .pdf, .rename: false
        }
    }

    func clearFinder() {
        finderCache = nil
        if finderCommand != nil { finderCommand = nil }
        if !finderItems.isEmpty { finderItems = [] }
    }

    // MARK: Results out

    func reveal(_ url: URL) {
        NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([url])
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("files.result_out", params: ["how": "reveal", "ext": url.pathExtension.lowercased()])
    }

    func copy(_ url: URL) {
        let pb = NSPasteboard.general
        pb.clearContents()
        pb.writeObjects([url as NSURL])
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("files.result_out", params: ["how": "copy", "ext": url.pathExtension.lowercased()])
    }

    /// A tile: run its phrase (rename only types "rename " and waits for the pattern).
    func tap(_ action: FileAction) {
        if case .rename = action {
            EdgeHeld.shared.type("rename ")
        } else {
            nextSource = "tile"
            EdgeHeld.shared.type(action.phrase, run: true)
        }
    }
}
//
//  WindowAnimator.swift
//  Other apps' windows in motion (docs/features/windows.md, Animation). Every frame change
//  ForeignWindowManager makes comes through here: the real window's AX position and size are
//  set on every display-link frame along a spring (WindowMotionCore). No snapshots, no
//  stand-in layers, and the size moves continuously all the way to the landing.
//
//  Three kinds of thread. The AX worker asks (`animate`). One clock thread runs the display
//  link and the springs and never touches AX, so no app can make it late. One serial writer
//  per app does that app's AX writes, latest-wins: a writer still busy with frame N gets the
//  newest frame next, never a backlog, and a slow app never delays another. Writers time
//  their resizes; an app that can't resize at the display's rate gets a new size every 2nd,
//  3rd… frame and a position every frame. The landing is always the exact frame, read back
//  and retried once. Nothing runs while nothing moves (the link is paused).
//

import AppKit
import ApplicationServices
import os

/// AX reads and writes on another app's window, callable from any thread.
enum WindowAX {
    static func frame(_ el: AXUIElement) -> CGRect? {
        var p: CFTypeRef?, s: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, kAXPositionAttribute as CFString, &p) == .success,
              AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, kAXSizeAttribute as CFString, &s) == .success,
              let p, let s else { return nil }
        var origin = CGPoint.zero, size = CGSize.zero
        guard CFGetTypeID(p) == AXValueGetTypeID(), CFGetTypeID(s) == AXValueGetTypeID(),
              AXValueGetValue(p as! AXValue, .cgPoint, &origin), AXValueGetValue(s as! AXValue, .cgSize, &size) else { return nil }
        return CGRect(origin: origin, size: size)
    }

    static func size(_ el: AXUIElement) -> CGSize? {
        var s: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, kAXSizeAttribute as CFString, &s) == .success, let s,
              CFGetTypeID(s) == AXValueGetTypeID() else { return nil }
        var size = CGSize.zero
        return AXValueGetValue(s as! AXValue, .cgSize, &size) ? size : nil
    }

    static func set(_ el: AXUIElement, origin: CGPoint) {
        var o = origin
        if let v = AXValueCreate(.cgPoint, &o) { AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(el, kAXPositionAttribute as CFString, v) }
    }

    static func set(_ el: AXUIElement, size: CGSize) {
        var s = size
        if let v = AXValueCreate(.cgSize, &s) { AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(el, kAXSizeAttribute as CFString, v) }
    }

    static func bool(_ el: AXUIElement, _ attribute: String) -> Bool {
        var v: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, attribute as CFString, &v) == .success else { return false }
        return (v as? Bool) ?? false
    }

    /// One exact frame change: position and size go in the order that can't be clamped by the
    /// display the window is leaving; an app with a minimum size keeps it and is fitted to the
    /// edge the target hugs. Returns where the window ended up. (AXEnhancedUserInterface is the
    /// caller's: it animates every frame change while it's on.)
    @discardableResult
    static func apply(_ el: AXUIElement, to target: CGRect, area: CGRect?, displays: [CGRect]) -> CGRect {
        let current = frame(el) ?? .null
        let crossing = WindowLayoutMath.displayIndex(for: current, displays: displays) != WindowLayoutMath.displayIndex(for: target, displays: displays)
        let moves = current.isNull || abs(current.minX - target.minX) > 0.5 || abs(current.minY - target.minY) > 0.5
        let sizes = current.isNull || abs(current.width - target.width) > 0.5 || abs(current.height - target.height) > 0.5
        if crossing {
            // Onto the new display first, so the size isn't clamped against the old one.
            if moves { set(el, origin: target.origin) }
            if sizes { set(el, size: target.size) }
        } else {
            // Shrink/grow in place, then move: growing at the old origin can't leave the display
            // because the area check below puts it back.
            if sizes { set(el, size: target.size) }
            if moves { set(el, origin: target.origin) }
        }
        guard sizes || crossing, let actual = size(el) else { return target }
        if abs(actual.width - target.width) <= 1, abs(actual.height - target.height) <= 1 { return target }
        // Clamped by the old position: once more where it is now.
        if actual.width < target.width - 1 || actual.height < target.height - 1 {
            set(el, size: target.size)
        }
        guard let after = size(el) else { return target }
        // Bigger than asked: the app's minimum size. Hug the target's edge, stay on screen.
        guard let area, after.width > target.width + 1 || after.height > target.height + 1 else {
            return CGRect(origin: target.origin, size: after)
        }
        let fitted = WindowLayoutMath.fit(actual: after, target: target, in: area)
        if fitted.origin != target.origin { set(el, origin: fitted.origin) }
        return fitted
    }
}

final class WindowAnimator: @unchecked Sendable {
    static let shared = WindowAnimator()
    static let log = Logger(subsystem: "com.hashawn.nardo.perf", category: "windows")

    struct Request {
        var el: AXUIElement
        var pid: pid_t
        var id: CGWindowID
        /// Where the window is now; mid-flight the spring's own state wins.
        var from: CGRect
        /// Where it's going: `aim`, made room for a minimum size it's known to keep.
        var to: CGRect
        /// The frame asked for, before any minimum-size fitting.
        var aim: CGRect
        /// For fitting a learned minimum size (nil: put it back exactly, e.g. a restore).
        var area: CGRect?
        /// The target display's visible frame: overshoot stays inside it.
        var bounds: CGRect?
        var displays: [CGRect]
        /// Nil: land now (animation turned off mid-flight), through the same writer.
        var feel: WindowMotionFeel?
        /// Where it really landed; any thread. Not called for a flight a newer one replaced.
        var landed: (CGRect) -> Void
    }

    /// One flight, measured at its landing (perf log, run-live harness).
    struct Report {
        var pid: pid_t
        var id: CGWindowID
        var ms: Double            // first frame to landed
        var ticks: Int            // display-link frames it was in flight
        var clockOnBeat: Double   // % of those frames that came one refresh after the last
        var started: CFTimeInterval
        var landedAt: CFTimeInterval
        var writes: Int           // AX position writes done
        var sizeWrites: Int
        var coalesced: Int        // frames replaced by a newer one before the app took them
        var onBeat: Double        // % of its display frames whose window frame was written within that frame
        var late: Int             // written, but after the next frame had begun
        var latencyMedianMs: Double // frame tick → its write done
        var worstGapMs: Double    // longest time between two writes
        var refreshMs: Double
        var resizeMedianMs: Double
        var moveMedianMs: Double
        var maxSizeEvery: Int
        var landingError: CGFloat // read back vs where it should be
        var from: CGRect          // where the flight began
        var expected: CGRect
        var actual: CGRect
        var retried: Bool
    }
    /// Every landing (set once, before animating; tests and the perf probe).
    nonisolated(unsafe) static var onReport: ((Report) -> Void)?
    /// Display-link frames handled since launch (the harness checks it stops when idle).
    nonisolated(unsafe) static var ticksHandled = 0

    // Shared between threads, under `lock`.
    private var lock = os_unfair_lock()
    private var active: [CGWindowID: (gen: Int, target: CGRect, pid: pid_t)] = [:]
    private var mins: [CGWindowID: CGSize] = [:]
    private var generation = 0

    // Clock thread only.
    private var runLoop: CFRunLoop!
    private var foundationRunLoop: RunLoop!
    private var link: CADisplayLink?
    private var flights: [CGWindowID: Flight] = [:]
    private var writers: [pid_t: AppWriter] = [:]
    private var lastTarget: CFTimeInterval = 0
    private var lastTickWall: CFTimeInterval = 0
    private var refresh: Double = 1.0 / 120
    private var tickIndex = 0
    private var watchdog: CFRunLoopTimer?

    // Main thread only.
    @MainActor private var linkDisplay: CGDirectDisplayID?
    @MainActor private var screenObserver: NSObjectProtocol?

    private init() {
        let ready = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
        let thread = Thread { [self] in
            runLoop = CFRunLoopGetCurrent()
            foundationRunLoop = RunLoop.current
            RunLoop.current.add(NSMachPort(), forMode: .default)   // alive between frames
            ready.signal()
            while true { _ = RunLoop.current.run(mode: .default, before: .distantFuture) }
        }
        thread.name = "com.hashawn.nardo.windows.motion"
        thread.qualityOfService = .userInteractive
        thread.start()
        ready.wait()
    }

    private func onClock(_ block: @escaping () -> Void) {
        CFRunLoopPerformBlock(runLoop, CFRunLoopMode.defaultMode.rawValue, block)
        CFRunLoopWakeUp(runLoop)
    }

    // MARK: Asking (any thread; the AX worker)

    /// The frame a window is flying to, if it's in flight: a command that arrives mid-flight
    /// thinks from there (← again cycles on from the half it's heading for).
    func target(_ id: CGWindowID) -> CGRect? {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }
        return active[id]?.target
    }

    func isAnimating(_ id: CGWindowID) -> Bool { target(id) != nil }

    /// Any of this app's windows in flight: its moved/resized notifications are ours.
    func isAnimating(pid: pid_t) -> Bool {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }
        return active.values.contains { $0.pid == pid }
    }

    /// The minimum size this window refused to go under, once learned.
    func minSize(_ id: CGWindowID) -> CGSize? {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }
        return mins[id]
    }

    /// Start (or retarget) these flights together: requested in one call, they leave on the
    /// same display-link frame.
    func animate(_ requests: [Request]) {
        guard !requests.isEmpty else { return }
        var gens: [Int] = []
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        for r in requests { generation += 1; gens.append(generation); active[r.id] = (generation, r.to, r.pid) }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
        onClock { [self] in
            for (r, gen) in zip(requests, gens) { start(r, gen: gen) }
            resume()
        }
    }

    /// A window that's gone (closed, its app quit): forget it.
    func forget(pid: pid_t) {
        onClock { [self] in
            let gone = flights.values.filter { $0.pid == pid }.map(\.id)
            gone.forEach { flights[$0] = nil }
            writers[pid] = nil
            os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
            gone.forEach { active[$0] = nil; mins[$0] = nil }
            os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
            idleIfDone()
        }
    }

    // MARK: The display link (main creates it, the clock thread runs it)

    /// Called from the main-thread entry points: a link on the fastest display, ready before
    /// the first flight (made again when displays change).
    @MainActor func prepare() {
        if screenObserver == nil {
            screenObserver = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(forName: NSApplication.didChangeScreenParametersNotification, object: nil, queue: .main) { _ in
                MainActor.assumeIsolated { WindowAnimator.shared.linkDisplay = nil; WindowAnimator.shared.prepare() }
            }
        }
        guard let screen = NSScreen.screens.max(by: { $0.maximumFramesPerSecond < $1.maximumFramesPerSecond }) else { return }
        let display = (screen.deviceDescription[NSDeviceDescriptionKey("NSScreenNumber")] as? NSNumber)?.uint32Value ?? 0
        guard display != linkDisplay else { return }
        linkDisplay = display
        let link = screen.displayLink(target: LinkTarget(), selector: #selector(LinkTarget.tick(_:)))
        // The panel's full rate (ProMotion idles lower unless someone asks).
        link.preferredFrameRateRange = CAFrameRateRange(minimum: 80, maximum: 120, preferred: 120)
        link.isPaused = true
        onClock { [self] in
            self.link?.invalidate()
            link.add(to: foundationRunLoop, forMode: .default)
            self.link = link
            if !flights.isEmpty { resume() }
        }
    }

    private final class LinkTarget: NSObject {
        @objc func tick(_ link: CADisplayLink) { WindowAnimator.shared.tick(link) }
    }

    private func resume() {
        guard !flights.isEmpty else { return }
        if watchdog == nil {
            lastTickWall = CACurrentMediaTime()
            let t = CFRunLoopTimerCreateWithHandler(nil, CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() + 0.1, 0.1, 0, 0) { [self] _ in
                // No frames (display asleep, link gone): land everything now rather than never.
                if CACurrentMediaTime() - lastTickWall > 0.15 { for f in Array(flights.values) { land(f) }; idleIfDone() }
            }
            watchdog = t
            CFRunLoopAddTimer(runLoop, t, .defaultMode)
        }
        if let link {
            if link.isPaused { lastTarget = 0; link.isPaused = false }
        } else {
            DispatchQueue.main.async { WindowAnimator.shared.prepare() }
        }
    }

    private func idleIfDone() {
        guard flights.isEmpty else { return }
        link?.isPaused = true
        lastTarget = 0
        if let t = watchdog { CFRunLoopTimerInvalidate(t); watchdog = nil }
    }

    // MARK: Flights (clock thread)

    private final class Flight {
        let id: CGWindowID, pid: pid_t
        var request: WindowAnimator.Request
        var gen: Int
        var spring: WindowSpring
        var goal: CGRect          // the asked-for frame (Request.aim), before a minimum refits it
        var minSize: CGSize?
        let from: CGRect
        var sentSize: CGSize      // the last size handed to the writer
        var sent: CGRect?
        var ticks = 0
        var offBeat = 0
        var maxSizeEvery = 1
        let phase: Int
        let started = CACurrentMediaTime()
        init(_ r: WindowAnimator.Request, gen: Int, phase: Int) {
            id = r.id; pid = r.pid; request = r; self.gen = gen; self.phase = phase
            spring = WindowSpring(from: r.from, to: r.to, feel: r.feel ?? .snappy, bounds: r.bounds)
            goal = r.aim; from = r.from; sentSize = r.from.size
        }
    }

    private func writer(_ pid: pid_t) -> AppWriter {
        if let w = writers[pid] { return w }
        let w = AppWriter(pid: pid, animator: self)
        writers[pid] = w
        return w
    }

    private func start(_ r: Request, gen: Int) {
        if let f = flights[r.id] {
            f.request = r; f.gen = gen; f.goal = r.aim
            f.spring.retarget(fitted(f, r.aim), bounds: r.bounds)
            setActiveTarget(f)
            if r.feel == nil { land(f) }
            return
        }
        // Already there (a reflow that changed nothing for it): no flight, no writes.
        if WindowLayoutMath.near(r.from, r.to, tolerance: 0.5) {
            finish(id: r.id, gen: gen, at: r.from, r.landed)
            return
        }
        let f = Flight(r, gen: gen, phase: flights.values.filter { $0.pid == r.pid }.count)
        f.minSize = minSize(r.id)
        if f.minSize != nil { f.spring.retarget(fitted(f, r.aim), bounds: r.bounds); setActiveTarget(f) }
        flights[r.id] = f
        if r.feel == nil { land(f) }
    }

    /// The target, made room for a minimum size the app has shown it keeps.
    private func fitted(_ f: Flight, _ to: CGRect) -> CGRect {
        guard let m = f.minSize, let area = f.request.area, m.width > to.width + 1 || m.height > to.height + 1 else { return to }
        return WindowLayoutMath.fit(actual: CGSize(width: max(to.width, m.width), height: max(to.height, m.height)), target: to, in: area)
    }

    private func setActiveTarget(_ f: Flight) {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        if active[f.id]?.gen == f.gen { active[f.id] = (f.gen, f.spring.target, f.pid) }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
    }

    fileprivate func learned(_ id: CGWindowID, min: CGSize?) {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        mins[id] = min
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
    }

    private func tick(_ link: CADisplayLink) {
        let now = link.targetTimestamp
        let r = link.targetTimestamp - link.timestamp
        if r > 1.0 / 250, r < 1.0 / 20 { refresh = r }
        let dt = lastTarget > 0 ? min(0.05, max(0, now - lastTarget)) : refresh
        let late = lastTarget > 0 && abs(now - lastTarget - refresh) > 0.0015
        lastTarget = now
        Self.ticksHandled += 1
        lastTickWall = CACurrentMediaTime()
        tickIndex += 1
        let frameMs = refresh * 1000
        var perApp: [pid_t: Int] = [:]
        for f in flights.values { perApp[f.pid, default: 0] += 1 }
        for f in Array(flights.values) {
            // A minimum size learned mid-flight: aim for where it can actually go.
            if let m = minSize(f.id), m != f.minSize {
                f.minSize = m
                f.spring.retarget(fitted(f, f.goal), bounds: f.request.bounds)
                setActiveTarget(f)
            }
            f.spring.step(dt)
            f.ticks += 1
            if late, f.ticks > 1 { f.offBeat += 1 }
            if f.spring.settled || CACurrentMediaTime() - f.started > 1.5 { land(f); continue }
            let out = f.spring.output(minSize: f.minSize)
            let w = writer(f.pid)
            let every = WindowMotionMath.sizeEvery(resizeMs: w.resizeMs, moveMs: w.moveMs, windows: perApp[f.pid] ?? 1, frameMs: frameMs)
            f.maxSizeEvery = max(f.maxSizeEvery, every)
            let sizeChanged = abs(out.width - f.sentSize.width) >= 0.25 || abs(out.height - f.sentSize.height) >= 0.25
            let sendSize = sizeChanged && (every == 1 || (tickIndex + f.phase) % every == 0)
            // A frame without a new size: the app's current size, placed so the still edges stay still.
            let drawn = sendSize ? out : WindowSpring.place(w.appliedSize(f.id) ?? f.sentSize, in: out, anchor: f.spring.anchor)
            let ds = f.request.displays
            let crossing = f.sent.map { WindowLayoutMath.displayIndex(for: $0, displays: ds) != WindowLayoutMath.displayIndex(for: out, displays: ds) } ?? false
            let growing = out.width > f.sentSize.width + 0.25 || out.height > f.sentSize.height + 0.25
            w.submit(AppWriter.Job(id: f.id, gen: f.gen, el: f.request.el, frame: out, origin: drawn.origin, sendSize: sendSize,
                                   positionFirst: crossing || growing,
                                   watchMin: sendSize && (out.width < f.sentSize.width - 0.25 || out.height < f.sentSize.height - 0.25),
                                   refresh: refresh, tickAt: lastTickWall))
            if sendSize { f.sentSize = out.size }
            f.sent = drawn
        }
        idleIfDone()
    }

    /// Settled (or out of time): the exact frame, through the app's writer like every frame.
    private func land(_ f: Flight) {
        flights[f.id] = nil
        let last = !flights.values.contains { $0.pid == f.pid }
        var job = AppWriter.Job(id: f.id, gen: f.gen, el: f.request.el, frame: f.spring.target, origin: f.spring.target.origin,
                                sendSize: true, positionFirst: false, watchMin: false, refresh: refresh, tickAt: lastTickWall)
        job.final = AppWriter.Landing(area: f.request.area, displays: f.request.displays, ticks: f.ticks,
                                      clockOnBeat: f.ticks > 1 ? 100 * Double(f.ticks - 1 - f.offBeat) / Double(f.ticks - 1) : 100, started: f.started,
                                      maxSizeEvery: f.maxSizeEvery, from: f.from, aim: f.goal, endsSession: last, landed: f.request.landed)
        writer(f.pid).submit(job)
    }

    fileprivate func finish(id: CGWindowID, gen: Int, at frame: CGRect, _ landed: (CGRect) -> Void) {
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        let current = active[id]?.gen == gen
        if current { active[id] = nil }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
        if current { landed(frame) }
    }
}

/// One app's AX writes: a serial queue of its own and a mailbox holding only the newest frame
/// per window.
private final class AppWriter: @unchecked Sendable {
    struct Landing {
        var area: CGRect?
        var displays: [CGRect]
        var ticks: Int
        var clockOnBeat: Double
        var started: CFTimeInterval
        var maxSizeEvery: Int
        var from: CGRect
        var aim: CGRect
        var endsSession: Bool
        var landed: (CGRect) -> Void
    }
    struct Job {
        var id: CGWindowID
        var gen: Int
        var el: AXUIElement
        var frame: CGRect          // the spring's frame (its size is the one sent)
        var origin: CGPoint        // where to put it (differs when the size isn't sent)
        var sendSize: Bool
        var positionFirst: Bool
        var watchMin: Bool
        var refresh: Double
        var tickAt: CFTimeInterval   // when its display frame began
        var final: Landing?
        var replaced = 0
    }
    private struct Stats {
        var gen: Int
        var writes: [CFTimeInterval] = []
        var latency: [Double] = []
        var move: [Double] = []
        var sizeWrites = 0
        var resize: [Double] = []
        var coalesced = 0
    }

    let pid: pid_t
    private unowned let animator: WindowAnimator
    private let queue: DispatchQueue
    private let app: AXUIElement

    private var lock = os_unfair_lock()   // guards the mailbox, `running`, costs, applied sizes
    private var mailbox: [CGWindowID: Job] = [:]
    private var order: [CGWindowID] = []
    private var running = false
    private var endPending = false
    private var resizeCost: Double?
    private var moveCost: Double?
    private var applied: [CGWindowID: CGSize] = [:]

    // Writer queue only.
    private var enhanced: Bool?
    private var learners: [CGWindowID: MinSizeLearner] = [:]
    private var stats: [CGWindowID: Stats] = [:]

    init(pid: pid_t, animator: WindowAnimator) {
        self.pid = pid
        self.animator = animator
        queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.hashawn.nardo.windows.app.\(pid)", qos: .userInteractive)
        app = AXUIElementCreateApplication(pid)
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(app, 0.25)
    }

    /// Typical time this app takes to resize a window / move one (ms); before any, a guess.
    var resizeMs: Double { os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }; return resizeCost ?? 2 }
    var moveMs: Double { os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }; return moveCost ?? 0.1 }
    func appliedSize(_ id: CGWindowID) -> CGSize? { os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); defer { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock) }; return applied[id] }

    func submit(_ job: Job) {
        var job = job
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        if let old = mailbox[job.id] {
            job.replaced = old.replaced + 1
            // Latest wins, but a size the app hasn't had yet isn't lost with the frame carrying it.
            if old.sendSize, !job.sendSize, job.final == nil { job.sendSize = true; job.origin = job.frame.origin }
        } else {
            order.append(job.id)
        }
        mailbox[job.id] = job
        if job.final == nil { endPending = false }
        let kick = !running
        running = true
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
        if kick { queue.async { [self] in drain() } }
    }

    private func drain() {
        while true {
            os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
            if mailbox.isEmpty {
                let end = endPending
                endPending = false
                running = false
                os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
                if end { restoreEnhanced() }
                return
            }
            let jobs = order.compactMap { mailbox[$0] }
            mailbox.removeAll(); order.removeAll()
            os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
            for j in jobs { perform(j) }
        }
    }

    /// AXEnhancedUserInterface (on while VoiceOver-style tools are around) makes apps animate
    /// every frame change themselves: off while this app's windows fly, back on after.
    private func enhancedOff() {
        guard enhanced == nil else { return }
        let on = WindowAX.bool(app, "AXEnhancedUserInterface")
        enhanced = on
        if on { AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(app, "AXEnhancedUserInterface" as CFString, kCFBooleanFalse) }
    }

    private func restoreEnhanced() {
        if enhanced == true { AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(app, "AXEnhancedUserInterface" as CFString, kCFBooleanTrue) }
        enhanced = nil
    }

    private static func ms(_ t: CFTimeInterval) -> Double { (CACurrentMediaTime() - t) * 1000 }
    private static func median(_ a: [Double]) -> Double { let s = a.sorted(); return s.isEmpty ? 0 : s[s.count / 2] }

    private func perform(_ j: Job) {
        enhancedOff()
        if stats[j.id]?.gen != j.gen { stats[j.id] = Stats(gen: j.gen) }
        stats[j.id]?.coalesced += j.replaced
        if let landing = j.final { land(j, landing); return }
        var resized: Double?, moved = 0.0
        func size() { let t = CACurrentMediaTime(); WindowAX.set(j.el, size: j.frame.size); resized = Self.ms(t) }
        func move() { let t = CACurrentMediaTime(); WindowAX.set(j.el, origin: j.origin); moved = Self.ms(t) }
        // Growing: move first (toward the room it grows into); shrinking: size first.
        if j.positionFirst { move(); if j.sendSize { size() } } else { if j.sendSize { size() }; move() }
        let done = CACurrentMediaTime()
        stats[j.id]?.writes.append(done)
        stats[j.id]?.latency.append((done - j.tickAt) * 1000)
        stats[j.id]?.move.append(moved)
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        moveCost = WindowMotionMath.ewma(moveCost, moved)
        if let resized { resizeCost = WindowMotionMath.ewma(resizeCost, resized); applied[j.id] = j.frame.size }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
        if let resized { stats[j.id]?.sizeWrites += 1; stats[j.id]?.resize.append(resized) }
        // Shrinking: does it go there, or has it a minimum it keeps?
        if j.watchMin, let actual = WindowAX.size(j.el) {
            var l = learners[j.id] ?? MinSizeLearner()
            if l.observe(requested: j.frame.size, actual: actual), let m = l.learned { animator.learned(j.id, min: m) }
            learners[j.id] = l
        }
    }

    private func land(_ j: Job, _ landing: Landing) {
        var expected = WindowAX.apply(j.el, to: j.frame, area: landing.area, displays: landing.displays)
        var actual = WindowAX.frame(j.el) ?? expected
        var retried = false
        if !WindowLayoutMath.near(actual, expected, tolerance: 1) {
            // Once more (an app still finishing the previous frame can drop one).
            retried = true
            expected = WindowAX.apply(j.el, to: expected, area: landing.area, displays: landing.displays)
            actual = WindowAX.frame(j.el) ?? expected
        }
        let short = MinSizeLearner.beyondIncrements
        if j.frame.width > landing.aim.width + 1 || j.frame.height > landing.aim.height + 1 {
            // Aimed wider/taller for a minimum it showed before: does it still keep it? Asking
            // for the smaller size changes nothing on screen if it does.
            WindowAX.set(j.el, size: landing.aim.size)
            if let s = WindowAX.size(j.el), s.width < j.frame.width - 1 || s.height < j.frame.height - 1 {
                animator.learned(j.id, min: nil)
                expected = WindowAX.apply(j.el, to: landing.aim, area: landing.area, displays: landing.displays)
                actual = WindowAX.frame(j.el) ?? expected
            }
        }
        // A size it keeps well above the asked one is its minimum (a few points over is a
        // terminal's cell grid): the next flight aims for it.
        if actual.width > landing.aim.width + short || actual.height > landing.aim.height + short {
            let known = animator.minSize(j.id) ?? .zero
            animator.learned(j.id, min: CGSize(width: actual.width > landing.aim.width + short ? actual.width : known.width,
                                               height: actual.height > landing.aim.height + short ? actual.height : known.height))
        }
        let done = CACurrentMediaTime()
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock)
        applied[j.id] = nil
        if landing.endsSession { endPending = true }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock)
        learners[j.id] = nil
        let s = stats.removeValue(forKey: j.id) ?? Stats(gen: j.gen)
        let gaps = zip(s.writes.dropFirst(), s.writes).map { ($0 - $1) * 1000 }
        let r = j.refresh * 1000
        let resize = s.resize.sorted()
        let err = max(abs(actual.minX - expected.minX), abs(actual.minY - expected.minY),
                      abs(actual.width - expected.width), abs(actual.height - expected.height))
        let report = WindowAnimator.Report(
            pid: pid, id: j.id, ms: (done - landing.started) * 1000, ticks: landing.ticks, clockOnBeat: landing.clockOnBeat,
            started: landing.started, landedAt: done, writes: s.writes.count,
            sizeWrites: s.sizeWrites, coalesced: s.coalesced,
            onBeat: 100 * Double(s.latency.filter { $0 < r }.count) / Double(max(1, landing.ticks - 1)),
            late: s.latency.filter { $0 >= r }.count, latencyMedianMs: Self.median(s.latency),
            worstGapMs: gaps.max() ?? 0, refreshMs: r, resizeMedianMs: resize.isEmpty ? 0 : resize[resize.count / 2],
            moveMedianMs: Self.median(s.move),
            maxSizeEvery: landing.maxSizeEvery, landingError: err, from: landing.from, expected: expected, actual: actual, retried: retried)
        WindowAnimator.log.info("windows flight pid=\(self.pid, privacy: .public) \(String(format: "%.0f", report.ms), privacy: .public)ms ticks=\(report.ticks, privacy: .public) clock-onBeat=\(String(format: "%.0f", report.clockOnBeat), privacy: .public)% writes=\(report.writes, privacy: .public) sizes=\(report.sizeWrites, privacy: .public) coalesced=\(report.coalesced, privacy: .public) late=\(report.late, privacy: .public) latency-med=\(String(format: "%.1f", report.latencyMedianMs), privacy: .public)ms onBeat=\(String(format: "%.0f", report.onBeat), privacy: .public)% gap-max=\(String(format: "%.1f", report.worstGapMs), privacy: .public)ms resize-med=\(String(format: "%.2f", report.resizeMedianMs), privacy: .public)ms every=\(report.maxSizeEvery, privacy: .public) landing-err=\(String(format: "%.1f", err), privacy: .public)")
        WindowAnimator.onReport?(report)
        animator.finish(id: j.id, gen: j.gen, at: actual, landing.landed)
    }
}
//
//  EdgeEmoji.swift
//  `:fire` / `emoji fire`: the system's own emoji names (CoreEmoji's AppleName.strings, the
//  names the Character Viewer shows), plus a few everyday words names don't cover.
//  Falls back to Unicode scalar names if that file is ever missing.
//

import Foundation

enum EdgeEmoji {
    struct Entry: Equatable { let char: String; let name: String }

    static let all: [Entry] = {
        let path = "/System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/CoreEmoji.framework/Versions/A/Resources/en.lproj/AppleName.strings"
        var entries: [Entry] = []
        if let dict = NSDictionary(contentsOfFile: path) as? [String: String], !dict.isEmpty {
            entries = dict.map { Entry(char: $0.key, name: $0.value.lowercased()) }
        } else {
            for range in [0x1F300...0x1FAFF, 0x2600...0x27BF] {
                for v in range {
                    guard let s = Unicode.Scalar(v), s.properties.isEmojiPresentation, let n = s.properties.name else { continue }
                    entries.append(Entry(char: String(s), name: n.lowercased()))
                }
            }
        }
        // Stable order: by first scalar (smileys, people, nature… roughly as the picker groups them).
        return entries.sorted { ($0.char.unicodeScalars.first?.value ?? 0, $0.char) < ($1.char.unicodeScalars.first?.value ?? 0, $1.char) }
    }()

    /// Everyday words → emoji the names don't say.
    static let aliases: [String: [String]] = [
        "lol": ["😂", "🤣"], "haha": ["😂", "😆"], "laugh": ["😂", "🤣", "😆"], "lmao": ["🤣"],
        "love": ["❤️", "😍", "🥰"], "heart": ["❤️", "💕", "💖"], "like": ["👍"], "yes": ["👍", "✅"], "no": ["👎", "❌"],
        "ok": ["👌", "👍"], "okay": ["👌"], "sad": ["😢", "😭", "😞"], "cry": ["😭", "😢"], "happy": ["😊", "😄", "😁"],
        "smile": ["😊", "🙂", "😄"], "angry": ["😠", "😡"], "mad": ["😡"], "cool": ["😎"], "think": ["🤔"], "hmm": ["🤔"],
        "shrug": ["🤷"], "wave": ["👋"], "hi": ["👋"], "bye": ["👋"], "clap": ["👏"], "pray": ["🙏"], "thanks": ["🙏"],
        "party": ["🎉", "🥳"], "celebrate": ["🎉", "🥳"], "tada": ["🎉"], "eyes": ["👀"], "look": ["👀"], "100": ["💯"],
        "skull": ["💀"], "dead": ["💀"], "rocket": ["🚀"], "ship": ["🚀"], "check": ["✅", "✔️"], "done": ["✅"],
        "x": ["❌"], "warning": ["⚠️"], "star": ["⭐", "🌟"], "sparkle": ["✨"], "magic": ["✨"], "kiss": ["😘"],
        "wink": ["😉"], "poop": ["💩"], "ghost": ["👻"], "facepalm": ["🤦"], "muscle": ["💪"], "strong": ["💪"],
        "money": ["💰", "💸"], "bug": ["🐛"], "idea": ["💡"], "time": ["⏰"], "coffee": ["☕"], "beer": ["🍺"],
        "sun": ["☀️"], "rain": ["🌧️"], "snow": ["❄️"], "cat": ["🐱"], "dog": ["🐶"], "flex": ["💪"], "sweat": ["😅"],
        "shock": ["😱"], "wow": ["😮", "🤯"], "mindblown": ["🤯"], "sleep": ["😴"], "sick": ["🤒"], "nerd": ["🤓"],
    ]

    /// Shown for `emoji` with nothing after it.
    static let common = ["😂", "❤️", "👍", "🙏", "😭", "😊", "🔥", "🥰", "😍", "🎉", "👀", "✨", "💯", "🤔", "😅", "👏",
                         "🥲", "😎", "🙌", "💀", "✅", "🚀", "😉", "🤣", "😘", "🤯", "🫡", "🤷", "👋", "💪", "😢", "🙂"]

    /// Every term word must start a word of the name (or be an alias). Exact names first,
    /// then names whose words the term hits earliest, then shorter names.
    static func search(_ term: String, limit: Int = 48) -> [Entry] {
        let t = term.lowercased().replacingOccurrences(of: "_", with: " ").trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        if t.isEmpty {
            let byChar = Dictionary(all.map { ($0.char, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { a, _ in a })
            return common.compactMap { byChar[$0] ?? Entry(char: $0, name: "") }.prefix(limit).map { $0 }
        }
        let words = t.split(separator: " ").map(String.init)
        var scored: [(Int, Entry)] = []
        var seen = Set<String>()
        // Aliases lead (they're the everyday words).
        if words.count == 1, let picks = aliases[t] {
            for (i, c) in picks.enumerated() where seen.insert(c).inserted {
                scored.append((-100 + i, all.first { $0.char == c } ?? Entry(char: c, name: t)))
            }
        }
        for e in all where !seen.contains(e.char) {
            let nameWords = e.name.split(whereSeparator: { $0 == " " || $0 == "-" || $0 == ":" }).map(String.init)
            var score = 0
            var ok = true
            for w in words {
                if let i = nameWords.firstIndex(of: w) { score += i }
                else if let i = nameWords.firstIndex(where: { $0.hasPrefix(w) }) { score += 10 + i }
                else { ok = false; break }
            }
            guard ok else { continue }
            if e.name == t { score -= 50 }
            score += nameWords.count * 2
            seen.insert(e.char)
            scored.append((score, e))
        }
        return scored.sorted { $0.0 < $1.0 }.prefix(limit).map(\.1)
    }
}
//
//  WindowLayoutCore.swift
//  The math behind moving other apps' windows (docs/features/windows.md): snap frames
//  for Caps+arrows (halves that cycle ½ → ⅔ → ⅓, quarters from two arrows, maximize,
//  center), display hops, minimum-size fitting, and the auto-tiler's layouts (split /
//  master+stack) with movable dividers and minimum sizes, order and float rules. Pure: no AppKit, no AX, no globals,
//  so tools/autotile-test can run it offline.
//
//  Coordinates are the Accessibility API's: global points, origin at the top-left of
//  the primary display, y grows downward. "top" means the smaller y.
//

import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

// MARK: Snap actions (Caps+arrows, Return, Shift+Return)

enum SnapArrow: Int, CaseIterable { case left, right, up, down }

enum SnapAction: String, CaseIterable, Equatable {
    case left, right, top, bottom
    case topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight
    case centerThird, fullHeight
    case maximize, center

    /// How many sizes pressing it again walks through: halves ½ → ⅔ → ⅓.
    var steps: Int {
        switch self {
        case .left, .right, .top, .bottom: return 3
        default: return 1
        }
    }

    /// The arrows held, in the order they went down → what they mean together.
    /// One arrow is a half; two at right angles are that corner; ←+→ is the middle third;
    /// ↑+↓ is full height. Only the last two count.
    static func combining(_ held: [SnapArrow]) -> SnapAction? {
        guard let last = held.last else { return nil }
        let pair = Set(held.suffix(2))
        if pair.count == 2 {
            switch pair {
            case [.left, .up]: return .topLeft
            case [.right, .up]: return .topRight
            case [.left, .down]: return .bottomLeft
            case [.right, .down]: return .bottomRight
            case [.left, .right]: return .centerThird
            case [.up, .down]: return .fullHeight
            default: break
            }
        }
        switch last {
        case .left: return .left
        case .right: return .right
        case .up: return .top
        case .down: return .bottom
        }
    }
}

enum WindowLayoutMath {
    /// `k` of `n` equal columns along `total`, with `gap` between columns.
    static func span(_ total: CGFloat, n: Int, k: Int, gap: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        ((total - CGFloat(n - 1) * gap) * CGFloat(k) / CGFloat(n) + CGFloat(k - 1) * gap).rounded()
    }

    /// The usable area of a display: its visible frame (no menu bar, no Dock) inset by the gap.
    static func area(visible: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        visible.insetBy(dx: gap, dy: gap).integral
    }

    /// (n, k) for step 0, 1, 2 of a half: ½, ⅔, ⅓.
    static func fraction(step: Int) -> (n: Int, k: Int) {
        switch step % 3 {
        case 1: return (3, 2)
        case 2: return (3, 1)
        default: return (2, 1)
        }
    }

    /// Where `action` (at `step`) puts a window whose frame is now `current`.
    static func frame(_ action: SnapAction, step: Int = 0, current: CGRect, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        let (n, k) = fraction(step: step)
        // Left/top take k of n columns; right/bottom are their complement's exact remainder,
        // so a pair always meets at one gap whatever the rounding.
        let w = span(a.width, n: n, k: k, gap: gap), h = span(a.height, n: n, k: k, gap: gap)
        let rw = a.width - span(a.width, n: n, k: n - k, gap: gap) - gap
        let bh = a.height - span(a.height, n: n, k: n - k, gap: gap) - gap
        let hw = span(a.width, n: 2, k: 1, gap: gap), hh = span(a.height, n: 2, k: 1, gap: gap)
        let rhw = a.width - hw - gap, bhh = a.height - hh - gap
        switch action {
        case .left: return CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.minY, width: w, height: a.height)
        case .right: return CGRect(x: a.maxX - rw, y: a.minY, width: rw, height: a.height)
        case .top: return CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.minY, width: a.width, height: h)
        case .bottom: return CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.maxY - bh, width: a.width, height: bh)
        case .topLeft: return CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.minY, width: hw, height: hh)
        case .topRight: return CGRect(x: a.maxX - rhw, y: a.minY, width: rhw, height: hh)
        case .bottomLeft: return CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.maxY - bhh, width: hw, height: bhh)
        case .bottomRight: return CGRect(x: a.maxX - rhw, y: a.maxY - bhh, width: rhw, height: bhh)
        case .centerThird:
            let t = span(a.width, n: 3, k: 1, gap: gap)
            return CGRect(x: a.minX + t + gap, y: a.minY, width: a.width - 2 * (t + gap), height: a.height)
        case .fullHeight:
            let x = min(max(current.minX, a.minX), max(a.minX, a.maxX - current.width))
            return CGRect(x: x, y: a.minY, width: min(current.width, a.width), height: a.height)
        case .maximize: return a
        case .center:
            let s = CGSize(width: min(current.width, a.width), height: min(current.height, a.height))
            return CGRect(x: (a.midX - s.width / 2).rounded(), y: (a.midY - s.height / 2).rounded(), width: s.width, height: s.height)
        }
    }

    static func near(_ a: CGRect, _ b: CGRect, tolerance: CGFloat = 3) -> Bool {
        abs(a.minX - b.minX) <= tolerance && abs(a.minY - b.minY) <= tolerance
            && abs(a.width - b.width) <= tolerance && abs(a.height - b.height) <= tolerance
    }

    /// Pressing the same arrow again walks the sizes. Stateless: the step comes from where the
    /// window already is, so it survives relaunches and other tools moving windows.
    static func nextStep(_ action: SnapAction, current: CGRect, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> Int {
        guard action.steps > 1 else { return 0 }
        for step in 0..<action.steps where near(current, frame(action, step: step, current: current, in: a, gap: gap)) {
            return (step + 1) % action.steps
        }
        return 0
    }

    /// Which snap (and step) a frame sits at, if any: a display hop keeps the same snap.
    static func matchingSnap(_ current: CGRect, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> (SnapAction, Int)? {
        for action in SnapAction.allCases where action != .center && action != .fullHeight {
            for step in 0..<action.steps where near(current, frame(action, step: step, current: current, in: a, gap: gap)) {
                return (action, step)
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// An app that won't go smaller than `actual` (its minimum size): keep the edge the
    /// target hugs, otherwise center on the target, and stay inside the area.
    static func fit(actual: CGSize, target: CGRect, in a: CGRect) -> CGRect {
        var r = CGRect(origin: target.origin, size: actual)
        if actual.width > target.width + 1 {
            if abs(target.maxX - a.maxX) < 1, abs(target.minX - a.minX) >= 1 { r.origin.x = target.maxX - actual.width }
            else if abs(target.minX - a.minX) >= 1 { r.origin.x = (target.midX - actual.width / 2).rounded() }
        }
        if actual.height > target.height + 1 {
            if abs(target.maxY - a.maxY) < 1, abs(target.minY - a.minY) >= 1 { r.origin.y = target.maxY - actual.height }
            else if abs(target.minY - a.minY) >= 1 { r.origin.y = (target.midY - actual.height / 2).rounded() }
        }
        r.origin.x = min(max(r.minX, a.minX), max(a.minX, a.maxX - r.width))
        r.origin.y = min(max(r.minY, a.minY), max(a.minY, a.maxY - r.height))
        return r
    }

    /// The same place on another display: a snapped window keeps its snap; anything else keeps
    /// its relative position (size kept when it fits, shrunk when it doesn't).
    static func transfer(_ current: CGRect, from: CGRect, to: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> CGRect {
        if let (action, step) = matchingSnap(current, in: from, gap: gap) {
            return frame(action, step: step, current: current, in: to, gap: gap)
        }
        let s = CGSize(width: min(current.width, to.width), height: min(current.height, to.height))
        func place(_ v: CGFloat, _ size: CGFloat, _ lo: CGFloat, _ len: CGFloat, _ nlo: CGFloat, _ nlen: CGFloat, _ nsize: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
            let slack = len - size, nslack = nlen - nsize
            guard slack > 1, nslack > 0 else { return nlo + max(0, nslack) / 2 }
            return nlo + min(max(0, (v - lo) / slack), 1) * nslack
        }
        return CGRect(x: place(current.minX, current.width, from.minX, from.width, to.minX, to.width, s.width).rounded(),
                      y: place(current.minY, current.height, from.minY, from.height, to.minY, to.height, s.height).rounded(),
                      width: s.width, height: s.height)
    }

    /// The display a window belongs to: the one it overlaps most (its center's, if none).
    static func displayIndex(for frame: CGRect, displays: [CGRect]) -> Int? {
        var best: (Int, CGFloat)?
        for (i, d) in displays.enumerated() {
            let r = d.intersection(frame)
            let a = r.isNull ? 0 : r.width * r.height
            if a > 0, a > (best?.1 ?? 0) { best = (i, a) }
        }
        if let best { return best.0 }
        let c = CGPoint(x: frame.midX, y: frame.midY)
        return displays.firstIndex { $0.contains(c) }
    }

    /// The display in that direction from `index` (nearest by center); ←/→ wrap around the
    /// row when there's nothing that way, ↑/↓ don't.
    static func display(_ direction: SnapArrow, from index: Int, displays: [CGRect]) -> Int? {
        guard displays.count > 1, displays.indices.contains(index) else { return nil }
        let o = displays[index]
        let c = CGPoint(x: o.midX, y: o.midY)
        func ahead(_ d: CGRect) -> CGFloat? {
            switch direction {
            // Its center must be past my edge: a taller display beside me isn't "below".
            case .left: return d.midX < o.minX ? c.x - d.midX : nil
            case .right: return d.midX > o.maxX ? d.midX - c.x : nil
            case .up: return d.midY < o.minY ? c.y - d.midY : nil
            case .down: return d.midY > o.maxY ? d.midY - c.y : nil
            }
        }
        var best: (Int, CGFloat)?
        for (i, d) in displays.enumerated() where i != index {
            guard let along = ahead(d) else { continue }
            let across = direction == .left || direction == .right ? abs(d.midY - c.y) : abs(d.midX - c.x)
            let score = along + across * 2
            if best == nil || score < best!.1 { best = (i, score) }
        }
        if let best { return best.0 }
        guard direction == .left || direction == .right else { return nil }
        let row = displays.indices.sorted { displays[$0].midX < displays[$1].midX }
        guard let p = row.firstIndex(of: index) else { return nil }
        return row[(p + (direction == .right ? 1 : row.count - 1)) % row.count]
    }

    /// The window next to `frame` in that direction among `others` (id → frame): the nearest
    /// one past that edge, preferring ones that overlap it across the direction.
    static func neighbour<ID: Hashable>(of frame: CGRect, _ direction: SnapArrow, among others: [ID: CGRect]) -> ID? {
        var best: (ID, CGFloat)?
        for (id, r) in others {
            let along: CGFloat, overlap: CGFloat, offset: CGFloat
            switch direction {
            case .left: along = frame.minX - r.maxX; overlap = min(frame.maxY, r.maxY) - max(frame.minY, r.minY); offset = abs(r.minY - frame.minY)
            case .right: along = r.minX - frame.maxX; overlap = min(frame.maxY, r.maxY) - max(frame.minY, r.minY); offset = abs(r.minY - frame.minY)
            case .up: along = frame.minY - r.maxY; overlap = min(frame.maxX, r.maxX) - max(frame.minX, r.minX); offset = abs(r.minX - frame.minX)
            case .down: along = r.minY - frame.maxY; overlap = min(frame.maxX, r.maxX) - max(frame.minX, r.minX); offset = abs(r.minX - frame.minX)
            }
            guard along > -4 else { continue }   // must be past that edge (gap tolerance)
            let score = max(0, along) + (overlap > 0 ? 0 : 10_000) + offset * 0.01
            if best == nil || score < best!.1 { best = (id, score) }
        }
        return best?.0
    }
}

// MARK: Auto-tiling (per display)

enum AutoTileKind: String, CaseIterable { case split, master }

/// Where one display's dividers sit: what dragging a tile's edge or Caps+Option+arrows
/// changes, and what every reflow keeps. Split: per dwindle cut, the share of what's left that
/// the window at that position takes. Master: the master column's share of the width.
struct AutoTileRatios: Equatable {
    static let even: CGFloat = 0.5
    static let defaultMaster: CGFloat = 0.55
    /// Cut k's share; missing (and trailing) entries are even.
    var split: [CGFloat] = []
    var master: CGFloat = defaultMaster

    init() {}

    func split(_ k: Int) -> CGFloat { split.indices.contains(k) ? split[k] : Self.even }
    func value(_ kind: AutoTileKind, _ k: Int) -> CGFloat { kind == .master ? master : split(k) }
    var isEven: Bool { split.isEmpty && master == Self.defaultMaster }

    mutating func set(_ kind: AutoTileKind, _ k: Int, _ v: CGFloat) {
        guard v.isFinite else { return }
        let v = min(max(v, 0.02), 0.98)
        if kind == .master { master = v; return }
        guard k >= 0 else { return }
        while split.count <= k { split.append(Self.even) }
        split[k] = v
        trim()
    }

    private mutating func trim() {
        while let last = split.last, abs(last - Self.even) < 0.0005 { split.removeLast() }
    }

    /// The window at `i` of `n` left: its cut goes and the later cuts move up with their windows
    /// (the last window's leaving takes the cut before it).
    mutating func removed(at i: Int, count n: Int) {
        guard n >= 2 else { split.removeAll(); return }
        let k = min(i, n - 2)
        if k < split.count { split.remove(at: k) }
        trim()
    }

    /// A window joined at `p` (there were `n`): an even cut of its own there.
    mutating func inserted(at p: Int, count n: Int) {
        guard n >= 1 else { return }
        let k = min(p, n - 1)
        if k < split.count { split.insert(Self.even, at: k) }
    }

    /// For UserDefaults (per display).
    var plist: [String: Any] { ["split": split.map { Double($0) }, "master": Double(master)] }
    init(plist: Any?) {
        guard let d = plist as? [String: Any] else { return }
        split = (d["split"] as? [Double] ?? []).filter(\.isFinite).map { CGFloat(min(max($0, 0.02), 0.98)) }
        if let m = d["master"] as? Double, m.isFinite { master = CGFloat(min(max(m, 0.02), 0.98)) }
        trim()
    }
}

/// One cut of a layout: the line between the part before it (a window) and the rest.
struct AutoTileDivider: Equatable {
    /// Its ratio's index (split: the cut's position in the dwindle; master: 0).
    var index: Int
    /// What it divides.
    var rest: CGRect
    /// A vertical line: left | right.
    var sideBySide: Bool
    /// The rest's length along the cut, less the gap.
    var available: CGFloat
    /// Where the part before it ends (its maxX / maxY); the part after starts a gap later.
    var position: CGFloat

    var start: CGFloat { sideBySide ? rest.minX : rest.minY }
    var ratio: CGFloat { available > 0 ? (position - start) / available : AutoTileRatios.even }
}

struct AutoTileGeometry: Equatable {
    /// One per window, in order. Overflowing windows get their floating frame.
    var frames: [CGRect]
    var dividers: [AutoTileDivider]
    /// Windows whose minimum size can't fit beside the others': they float, centered at their
    /// minimum, until there's room (fewer windows) again.
    var overflow: [Int]
}

/// A tile's edge, for resizing.
enum TileEdge: CaseIterable { case minX, maxX, minY, maxY }

enum AutoTileLayout {
    /// Frames for `count` windows, in order, even splits. Split: each window halves what's left
    /// along its longer side (dwindle). Master: the first takes `ratio` of the width, the rest stack.
    static func frames(count: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind, ratio: CGFloat = AutoTileRatios.defaultMaster) -> [CGRect] {
        var r = AutoTileRatios()
        r.master = ratio
        return geometry(count: count, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: r).frames
    }

    /// The layout with your dividers (`ratios`) and the windows' known minimum sizes (`mins`,
    /// by position; zero where unknown). Every tile gets at least its minimum along each axis
    /// and its siblings shrink for it, down to their own minimums; no tile leaves the area. When
    /// the minimums can't all fit, the window asking most along the axis that overflows floats
    /// (centered at its minimum) and the rest tile without it.
    static func geometry(count n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind,
                         ratios: AutoTileRatios = AutoTileRatios(), mins: [CGSize] = []) -> AutoTileGeometry {
        guard n > 0 else { return AutoTileGeometry(frames: [], dividers: [], overflow: []) }
        func raw(_ i: Int) -> CGSize { mins.indices.contains(i) ? mins[i] : .zero }
        // Once any minimum is in play, nobody gets squeezed under `tileFloor` to make room for it.
        let floor = mins.contains { $0.width > 0 || $0.height > 0 } ? tileFloor : 0
        func m(_ i: Int) -> CGSize { let r = raw(i); return CGSize(width: max(r.width, floor), height: max(r.height, floor)) }
        var tiled = Array(0..<n), overflow: [Int] = []
        while !tiled.isEmpty, let worst = misfit(tiled.map(m), in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind) {
            overflow.append(tiled.remove(at: worst))
        }
        let placed = place(tiled.count, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: tiled.map(m))
        var frames = [CGRect](repeating: .zero, count: n)
        for (k, i) in tiled.enumerated() { frames[i] = placed.frames[k] }
        for i in overflow { frames[i] = floating(raw(i), in: a) }
        return AutoTileGeometry(frames: frames, dividers: placed.dividers, overflow: overflow.sorted())
    }

    /// Where a window that doesn't fit floats: centered, its minimum (or the usual floating
    /// size where it has none), pinned to the area's top-left if it's bigger than the area.
    static func floating(_ minimum: CGSize, in a: CGRect) -> CGRect {
        let w = max(minimum.width, min(1000, (a.width * 0.65).rounded()))
        let h = max(minimum.height, min(720, (a.height * 0.65).rounded()))
        return CGRect(x: max(a.minX, (a.midX - w / 2).rounded()), y: max(a.minY, (a.midY - h / 2).rounded()), width: w, height: h)
    }

    /// Below this a split slot would be a sliver; deep dwindles fall back to equal slices, and
    /// no divider goes closer than this to its rest's edge unless a minimum size needs it to.
    static let minimumSlot: CGFloat = 160
    /// The least any tile gets while another's minimum size is squeezing it.
    static let tileFloor: CGFloat = 80

    /// The dwindle's shape for `n` windows: which way each cut goes and which way the tail's
    /// equal slices run (nil: no tail). Decided on the even layout, so moving a divider never
    /// flips a cut.
    struct Shape: Equatable {
        var cuts: [Bool]
        var sliceSideBySide: Bool?
    }

    static func shape(_ n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat) -> Shape {
        var cuts: [Bool] = [], rest = a
        for _ in 0..<max(0, n - 1) {
            let wide = rest.width >= rest.height
            if ((wide ? rest.width : rest.height) - gap) / 2 < minimumSlot { return Shape(cuts: cuts, sliceSideBySide: wide) }
            cuts.append(wide)
            rest = halves(rest, sideBySide: wide, gap: gap).1
        }
        return Shape(cuts: cuts, sliceSideBySide: nil)
    }

    /// The smallest each rest of the dwindle can be (rest k holds windows k..<n), from minimums.
    static func required(_ mins: [CGSize], _ s: Shape, gap: CGFloat) -> [CGSize] {
        let c = s.cuts.count
        guard mins.count > c else { return [CGSize](repeating: .zero, count: c + 1) }
        var req = [CGSize](repeating: .zero, count: c + 1)
        let tail = Array(mins[c...])
        let side = s.sliceSideBySide ?? true
        let along = tail.reduce(CGFloat(0)) { $0 + (side ? $1.width : $1.height) } + gap * CGFloat(tail.count - 1)
        let across = tail.map { side ? $0.height : $0.width }.max() ?? 0
        req[c] = side ? CGSize(width: along, height: across) : CGSize(width: across, height: along)
        for k in stride(from: c - 1, through: 0, by: -1) {
            let w = mins[k], r = req[k + 1]
            req[k] = s.cuts[k] ? CGSize(width: w.width + gap + r.width, height: max(w.height, r.height))
                               : CGSize(width: max(w.width, r.width), height: w.height + gap + r.height)
        }
        return req
    }

    /// Which window floats when these minimums can't all fit in `a` (nil: they fit): the one
    /// asking the most along the axis that overflows (the later one on a tie).
    static func misfit(_ mins: [CGSize], in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind) -> Int? {
        let n = mins.count
        guard n > 0 else { return nil }
        let need: CGSize
        if n == 1 {
            need = mins[0]
        } else if kind == .master {
            let stack = mins[1...]
            need = CGSize(width: mins[0].width + gap + (stack.map(\.width).max() ?? 0),
                          height: max(mins[0].height, stack.reduce(CGFloat(0)) { $0 + $1.height } + gap * CGFloat(n - 2)))
        } else {
            need = required(mins, shape(n, in: a, gap: gap), gap: gap)[0]
        }
        let wide = need.width > a.width + 0.5, tall = need.height > a.height + 0.5
        guard wide || tall else { return nil }
        var best: (Int, CGFloat)?
        for (i, m) in mins.enumerated() {
            let v = wide ? m.width : m.height
            if v > 0, v >= (best?.1 ?? 0) { best = (i, v) }
        }
        return best?.0
    }

    /// The first part's length along a cut: what the ratio asks for, kept off slivers
    /// (`minimumSlot`) where it can be, and always within the minimums (`lo`...`hi`).
    static func cut(want: CGFloat, available: CGFloat, lo: CGFloat, hi: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let soft = min(minimumSlot, (available / 2).rounded(.down))
        let lo2 = max(lo.rounded(.up), min(soft, hi.rounded(.down)))
        let hi2 = max(lo2, min(hi.rounded(.down), max(available - soft, lo2)))
        return min(max(want.rounded(), lo2), hi2)
    }

    private static func place(_ n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind, ratios: AutoTileRatios,
                              mins: [CGSize]) -> (frames: [CGRect], dividers: [AutoTileDivider]) {
        guard n > 0 else { return ([], []) }
        guard n > 1 else { return ([a], []) }
        switch kind {
        case .split:
            let s = shape(n, in: a, gap: gap)
            let req = required(mins, s, gap: gap)
            var out: [CGRect] = [], dividers: [AutoTileDivider] = []
            var rest = a
            for (k, wide) in s.cuts.enumerated() {
                let avail = (wide ? rest.width : rest.height) - gap
                let first = cut(want: avail * ratios.split(k), available: avail,
                                lo: wide ? mins[k].width : mins[k].height,
                                hi: avail - (wide ? req[k + 1].width : req[k + 1].height))
                let (f, second) = split(rest, sideBySide: wide, first: first, gap: gap)
                dividers.append(AutoTileDivider(index: k, rest: rest, sideBySide: wide, available: avail,
                                                position: (wide ? rest.minX : rest.minY) + first))
                out.append(f)
                rest = second
            }
            if let side = s.sliceSideBySide {
                let tail = mins[s.cuts.count...].map { side ? $0.width : $0.height }
                out += slices(rest, count: n - s.cuts.count, sideBySide: side, gap: gap, mins: Array(tail))
            } else {
                out.append(rest)
            }
            return (out, dividers)
        case .master:
            let avail = a.width - gap
            let stack = mins[1...]
            let mw = cut(want: avail * min(max(ratios.master, 0.1), 0.9), available: avail,
                         lo: mins[0].width, hi: avail - (stack.map(\.width).max() ?? 0))
            let column = CGRect(x: a.minX + mw + gap, y: a.minY, width: a.width - mw - gap, height: a.height)
            let out = [CGRect(x: a.minX, y: a.minY, width: mw, height: a.height)]
                + slices(column, count: n - 1, sideBySide: false, gap: gap, mins: stack.map(\.height))
            return (out, [AutoTileDivider(index: 0, rest: a, sideBySide: true, available: avail, position: a.minX + mw)])
        }
    }

    /// `r` in `n` slices with `gap` between, as even as the minimums (by slice) allow.
    static func slices(_ r: CGRect, count n: Int, sideBySide: Bool, gap: CGFloat, mins: [CGFloat] = []) -> [CGRect] {
        guard n > 0 else { return [] }
        let start = sideBySide ? r.minX : r.minY, end = sideBySide ? r.maxX : r.maxY
        let sizes = shares(end - start - CGFloat(n - 1) * gap, count: n, mins: mins)
        // Edges from exact positions, rounded once each: no drift across slices.
        var edge = start
        return (0..<n).map { i in
            let a = edge.rounded()
            edge += sizes[i]
            let b = i == n - 1 ? end : edge.rounded()
            edge += gap
            return sideBySide ? CGRect(x: a, y: r.minY, width: b - a, height: r.height)
                              : CGRect(x: r.minX, y: a, width: r.width, height: b - a)
        }
    }

    /// `total` shared by `n` as evenly as it goes with nobody under their minimum (water-filling;
    /// minimums that don't fit share it in proportion).
    static func shares(_ total: CGFloat, count n: Int, mins: [CGFloat]) -> [CGFloat] {
        let m = (0..<n).map { mins.indices.contains($0) ? max(0, mins[$0].rounded(.up)) : 0 }
