        let need = m.reduce(0, +)
        if need > total, need > 0 { return m.map { $0 * total / need } }
        var fixed = [Bool](repeating: false, count: n)
        while true {
            let left = total - (0..<n).filter { fixed[$0] }.reduce(CGFloat(0)) { $0 + m[$1] }
            let free = (0..<n).filter { !fixed[$0] }
            let even = free.isEmpty ? 0 : left / CGFloat(free.count)
            let under = free.filter { m[$0] > even }
            if under.isEmpty { return (0..<n).map { fixed[$0] ? m[$0] : even } }
            under.forEach { fixed[$0] = true }
        }
    }

    static func split(_ r: CGRect, sideBySide: Bool, first: CGFloat, gap: CGFloat) -> (CGRect, CGRect) {
        if sideBySide {
            return (CGRect(x: r.minX, y: r.minY, width: first, height: r.height),
                    CGRect(x: r.minX + first + gap, y: r.minY, width: r.width - first - gap, height: r.height))
        }
        return (CGRect(x: r.minX, y: r.minY, width: r.width, height: first),
                CGRect(x: r.minX, y: r.minY + first + gap, width: r.width, height: r.height - first - gap))
    }

    static func halves(_ r: CGRect, sideBySide: Bool, gap: CGFloat) -> (CGRect, CGRect) {
        split(r, sideBySide: sideBySide, first: (((sideBySide ? r.width : r.height) - gap) / 2).rounded(), gap: gap)
    }

    // MARK: Resizing tiles

    /// The divider a tile's edge sits on (nil: that edge is the area's, or between two stacked
    /// or sliced tiles, which no ratio controls).
    static func divider(at edge: TileEdge, of frame: CGRect, in g: AutoTileGeometry, gap: CGFloat) -> AutoTileDivider? {
        let vertical = edge == .minX || edge == .maxX
        let tol: CGFloat = 1.5
        return g.dividers.filter { d in
            guard d.sideBySide == vertical else { return false }
            let r = d.rest.insetBy(dx: -tol, dy: -tol)
            guard frame.minX >= r.minX, frame.minY >= r.minY, frame.maxX <= r.maxX, frame.maxY <= r.maxY else { return false }
            switch edge {
            case .maxX, .maxY: return abs((vertical ? frame.maxX : frame.maxY) - d.position) <= tol
            case .minX, .minY: return abs((vertical ? frame.minX : frame.minY) - d.position - gap) <= tol
            }
        }.max { $0.index < $1.index }
    }

    /// Divider `index` moved so the part before it ends at `position`. Every later divider
    /// stays where it is on screen, so only the tiles on either side of this one change; all
    /// within minimums. Returns the ratios as the layout really applies them.
    static func moving(_ index: Int, to position: CGFloat, count n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind,
                       ratios: AutoTileRatios, mins: [CGSize] = []) -> AutoTileRatios {
        let before = geometry(count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: mins)
        guard let d = before.dividers.first(where: { $0.index == index }), d.available > 0 else { return ratios }
        var r = ratios
        r.set(kind, index, (position - d.start) / d.available)
        for later in before.dividers where later.index > index {
            let now = geometry(count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: r, mins: mins)
            guard let l = now.dividers.first(where: { $0.index == later.index }), l.available > 0 else { continue }
            r.set(kind, later.index, (later.position - l.start) / l.available)
        }
        // A ratio past a limit (a minimum, a sliver) is stored at the limit: nothing hidden to
        // drag back through.
        for d in geometry(count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: r, mins: mins).dividers where d.available > 0 {
            if abs((d.available * r.value(kind, d.index)).rounded() - (d.position - d.start)) > 0.5 { r.set(kind, d.index, d.ratio) }
        }
        return r
    }

    /// Tile `i` resized by its edges (you dragged one): the dividers under the edges that moved
    /// follow them. Edges on the area's border or between stacked tiles don't move anything.
    static func resized(_ i: Int, to frame: CGRect, count n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind,
                        ratios: AutoTileRatios, mins: [CGSize] = []) -> AutoTileRatios {
        let g = geometry(count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: mins)
        guard g.frames.indices.contains(i), !g.overflow.contains(i) else { return ratios }
        let slot = g.frames[i]
        var moves: [(index: Int, to: CGFloat)] = []
        func follow(_ e: TileEdge, _ now: CGFloat, _ was: CGFloat, to position: CGFloat) {
            guard abs(now - was) > 1, let d = divider(at: e, of: slot, in: g, gap: gap),
                  !moves.contains(where: { $0.index == d.index }) else { return }
            moves.append((d.index, position))
        }
        follow(.maxX, frame.maxX, slot.maxX, to: frame.maxX)
        follow(.minX, frame.minX, slot.minX, to: frame.minX - gap)
        follow(.maxY, frame.maxY, slot.maxY, to: frame.maxY)
        follow(.minY, frame.minY, slot.minY, to: frame.minY - gap)
        var r = ratios
        for m in moves.sorted(by: { $0.index < $1.index }) {
            r = moving(m.index, to: m.to, count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: r, mins: mins)
        }
        return r
    }

    /// Caps+Option+arrow: tile `i`'s border in that direction moves `step` that way (it grows);
    /// a tile with no divider on that side moves its other one that way instead (it shrinks).
    /// Nil: neither edge is a divider (one window, or stacked tiles going up/down).
    static func nudged(_ i: Int, _ direction: SnapArrow, step: CGFloat, count n: Int, in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat,
                       kind: AutoTileKind, ratios: AutoTileRatios, mins: [CGSize] = []) -> AutoTileRatios? {
        let g = geometry(count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: mins)
        guard g.frames.indices.contains(i), !g.overflow.contains(i) else { return nil }
        let slot = g.frames[i]
        let near: TileEdge, far: TileEdge
        switch direction {
        case .left: (near, far) = (.minX, .maxX)
        case .right: (near, far) = (.maxX, .minX)
        case .up: (near, far) = (.minY, .maxY)
        case .down: (near, far) = (.maxY, .minY)
        }
        guard let d = divider(at: near, of: slot, in: g, gap: gap) ?? divider(at: far, of: slot, in: g, gap: gap) else { return nil }
        let delta = direction == .left || direction == .up ? -step : step
        return moving(d.index, to: d.position + delta, count: n, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: mins)
    }

    /// One keyboard step: 5% of the area along that axis.
    static func step(_ direction: SnapArrow, in a: CGRect) -> CGFloat {
        ((direction == .left || direction == .right ? a.width : a.height) * 0.05).rounded()
    }
}

/// One display's tiling order and dividers. New windows slot in after the focused one (the end
/// if none); closed ones leave and the rest reflow; swaps trade places (the dividers stay put).
/// Windows that don't fit beside the others (their minimums) don't float: they stack with the
/// roomiest tile as a deck. The front card fills most of that tile; the cards behind sit a few
/// points up and to the right, one step each, so their top and right edges peek out (click one,
/// or focus it any way, and it comes to the front). Nothing hides, nothing floats over the rest.
enum AutoTileDeck {
    /// How far each card behind steps up and right (points); smaller on a small tile.
    static func peek(for slot: CGRect, behind: Int) -> CGFloat {
        guard behind > 0 else { return 0 }
        return min(10, max(4, (min(slot.width, slot.height) * 0.12 / CGFloat(behind)).rounded()))
    }

    /// `g` with its overflow stacked: (frames for every window, the deck's members front first).
    /// `front` (an index) is the card to show when it's a member; otherwise the host tile.
    static func stack(_ g: AutoTileGeometry, mins: [CGSize], front: Int?) -> (frames: [CGRect], members: [Int]) {
        var frames = g.frames
        guard !g.overflow.isEmpty else { return (frames, []) }
        let tiled = frames.indices.filter { !g.overflow.contains($0) }
        guard let host = tiled.max(by: { frames[$0].width * frames[$0].height < frames[$1].width * frames[$1].height }) else {
            // Nothing fits at all (one window bigger than the display): it keeps its pinned frame.
            return (frames, [])
        }
        var members = [host] + g.overflow
        if let front, let i = members.firstIndex(of: front), i > 0 { members.remove(at: i); members.insert(front, at: 0) }
        let slot = frames[host], behind = members.count - 1
        let step = peek(for: slot, behind: behind)
        let card = CGSize(width: slot.width - step * CGFloat(behind), height: slot.height - step * CGFloat(behind))
        for (k, i) in members.enumerated() {
            let m = mins.indices.contains(i) ? mins[i] : .zero
            // Window-server coordinates (y down): the front card sits lowest-left, each one
            // behind a step up and right.
            frames[i] = CGRect(x: slot.minX + step * CGFloat(k), y: slot.minY + step * CGFloat(behind - k),
                               width: max(card.width, m.width), height: max(card.height, m.height))
        }
        return (frames, members)
    }
}

struct AutoTileOrder: Equatable {
    var ids: [UInt32] = []
    var ratios = AutoTileRatios()

    /// Bring the order in line with the windows present now. Returns true when it changed.
    @discardableResult
    mutating func sync(present: [UInt32], focused: UInt32?) -> Bool {
        let live = Set(present)
        var changed = false
        for i in stride(from: ids.count - 1, through: 0, by: -1) where !live.contains(ids[i]) {
            ratios.removed(at: i, count: ids.count)
            ids.remove(at: i)
            changed = true
        }
        for id in present where !ids.contains(id) {
            if let f = focused, f != id, let i = ids.firstIndex(of: f) { insert(id, at: i + 1) } else { insert(id, at: ids.count) }
            changed = true
        }
        return changed
    }

    @discardableResult
    mutating func swap(_ a: UInt32, _ b: UInt32) -> Bool {
        guard let i = ids.firstIndex(of: a), let j = ids.firstIndex(of: b), i != j else { return false }
        ids.swapAt(i, j)
        return true
    }

    mutating func insert(_ id: UInt32, at p: Int) {
        guard !ids.contains(id) else { return }
        let p = min(max(0, p), ids.count)
        ratios.inserted(at: p, count: ids.count)
        ids.insert(id, at: p)
    }

    mutating func append(_ id: UInt32) { insert(id, at: ids.count) }

    mutating func remove(_ id: UInt32) {
        while let i = ids.firstIndex(of: id) {
            ratios.removed(at: i, count: ids.count)
            ids.remove(at: i)
        }
    }

    func geometry(in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind, mins: [UInt32: CGSize] = [:]) -> AutoTileGeometry {
        AutoTileLayout.geometry(count: ids.count, in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, ratios: ratios, mins: ids.map { mins[$0] ?? .zero })
    }

    func frames(in a: CGRect, gap: CGFloat, kind: AutoTileKind, mins: [UInt32: CGSize] = [:]) -> [UInt32: CGRect] {
        let f = geometry(in: a, gap: gap, kind: kind, mins: mins).frames
        return Dictionary(zip(ids, f), uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })   // a doubled id must not trap
    }

    /// A workspace switch on one display: the arriving workspace's own tiling (order and
    /// dividers, kept while it was away) if it has one, else what's here; windows that stay
    /// (not parked, not in it) keep tiling after it; parked ones leave through the ratio
    /// bookkeeping, so the cuts stay with their windows. Parked isn't gone: nothing here is
    /// dropped for being off screen.
    static func arriving(saved: AutoTileOrder?, current: AutoTileOrder, parked: Set<UInt32>) -> AutoTileOrder {
        var order = saved ?? current
        for id in current.ids where !parked.contains(id) && !order.ids.contains(id) { order.append(id) }
        for id in order.ids where parked.contains(id) { order.remove(id) }
        return order
    }

    /// The safety net's question: tiled windows no longer on screen (closed, minimized, hidden,
    /// their app quit, their last tab closed) whose leaving no notification reported.
    static func gone(_ orders: [String: AutoTileOrder], onScreen: Set<UInt32>) -> Set<UInt32> {
        Set(orders.values.flatMap { $0.ids }.filter { !onScreen.contains($0) })
    }
}

/// What the auto-tiler knows about a window when it decides whether to tile it.
struct WindowTraits: Equatable {
    var bundle: String
    var role: String?
    var subrole: String?
    /// AXSize is settable (fixed-size windows can't be tiled).
    var resizable: Bool
    var minimized: Bool
    var fullscreen: Bool
    var size: CGSize
}

enum AutoTilePolicy {
    /// Apps whose windows float by default: utilities with a natural size.
    static let defaultFloating: Set<String> = [
        "com.apple.systempreferences", "com.apple.calculator", "com.apple.archiveutility",
        "com.apple.PhotoBooth", "com.apple.ScreenSharing", "com.apple.FaceTime",
        "com.apple.Stickies", "com.apple.DigitalColorMeter", "com.apple.SystemProfiler",
    ]
    static let minimumSize = CGSize(width: 320, height: 220)

    /// Only ordinary document windows tile; dialogs, sheets, panels, palettes, fixed-size and
    /// small windows, minimized and full-screen ones, and apps on the float list float.
    static func tiles(_ t: WindowTraits, floatList: Set<String>) -> Bool {
        guard t.role == nil || t.role == "AXWindow" else { return false }
        guard t.subrole == "AXStandardWindow" else { return false }
        guard t.resizable, !t.minimized, !t.fullscreen else { return false }
        guard t.size.width >= minimumSize.width, t.size.height >= minimumSize.height else { return false }
        return !floatList.contains(t.bundle)
    }
}
//
//  EdgeSound.swift
//  `mute` / `unmute` (the default input device) and `airpods` / `speakers` / `output <name>`
//  (the default output device), straight through CoreAudio.
//
//  Mute uses the device's own mute switch (kAudioDevicePropertyMute, input scope). Inputs
//  without one (some USB mics) are muted by setting their input volume to 0 and putting the
//  previous volume back on unmute.
//

import CoreAudio
import Foundation
import Observation

enum EdgeAudio {
    struct Device: Identifiable, Equatable {
        let id: AudioObjectID
        let uid: String
        let name: String
        let transport: UInt32

        enum Kind { case builtIn, bluetooth, airpods, headphones, usb, display, airplay, virtual, other }
        var kind: Kind {
            let n = name.lowercased()
            if n.contains("airpods") || n.contains("beats") { return .airpods }
            switch transport {
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeBuiltIn: return n.contains("headphone") ? .headphones : .builtIn
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeBluetooth, kAudioDeviceTransportTypeBluetoothLE: return n.contains("headphone") || n.contains("buds") ? .airpods : .bluetooth
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeUSB: return .usb
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeHDMI, kAudioDeviceTransportTypeDisplayPort, kAudioDeviceTransportTypeThunderbolt: return .display
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeAirPlay: return .airplay
            case kAudioDeviceTransportTypeVirtual, kAudioDeviceTransportTypeAggregate, kAudioDeviceTransportTypeAutoAggregate: return .virtual
            default: return n.contains("headphone") ? .headphones : .other
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Property plumbing

    private static func address(_ selector: AudioObjectPropertySelector, _ scope: AudioObjectPropertyScope = kAudioObjectPropertyScopeGlobal,
                                _ element: AudioObjectPropertyElement = kAudioObjectPropertyElementMain) -> AudioObjectPropertyAddress {
        AudioObjectPropertyAddress(mSelector: selector, mScope: scope, mElement: element)
    }

    private static func get<T>(_ object: AudioObjectID, _ addr: AudioObjectPropertyAddress, _ initial: T) -> T? {
        var a = addr
        guard AudioObjectHasProperty(object, &a) else { return nil }
        var value = initial
        var size = UInt32(MemoryLayout<T>.size)
        let status = withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &value) { AudioObjectGetPropertyData(object, &a, 0, nil, &size, $0) }
        return status == noErr ? value : nil
    }

    private static func set<T>(_ object: AudioObjectID, _ addr: AudioObjectPropertyAddress, _ value: T) -> Bool {
        var a = addr
        var settable: DarwinBoolean = false
        guard AudioObjectHasProperty(object, &a), AudioObjectIsPropertySettable(object, &a, &settable) == noErr, settable.boolValue else { return false }
        var v = value
        let size = UInt32(MemoryLayout<T>.size)
        return withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &v) { AudioObjectSetPropertyData(object, &a, 0, nil, size, $0) } == noErr
    }

    private static func string(_ object: AudioObjectID, _ selector: AudioObjectPropertySelector) -> String? {
        var a = address(selector)
        var size = UInt32(MemoryLayout<CFString?>.size)
        var value: Unmanaged<CFString>?
        guard AudioObjectGetPropertyData(object, &a, 0, nil, &size, &value) == noErr, let s = value?.takeRetainedValue() else { return nil }
        return s as String
    }

    private static func device(_ id: AudioObjectID) -> Device? {
        guard id != kAudioObjectUnknown else { return nil }
        return Device(id: id, uid: string(id, kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceUID) ?? "\(id)",
                      name: string(id, kAudioObjectPropertyName) ?? "Device \(id)",
                      transport: get(id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyTransportType), UInt32(0)) ?? 0)
    }

    private static func channels(_ id: AudioObjectID, _ scope: AudioObjectPropertyScope) -> Int {
        var a = address(kAudioDevicePropertyStreamConfiguration, scope)
        var size: UInt32 = 0
        guard AudioObjectGetPropertyDataSize(id, &a, 0, nil, &size) == noErr, size > 0 else { return 0 }
        let raw = UnsafeMutableRawPointer.allocate(byteCount: Int(size), alignment: MemoryLayout<AudioBufferList>.alignment)
        defer { raw.deallocate() }
        guard AudioObjectGetPropertyData(id, &a, 0, nil, &size, raw) == noErr else { return 0 }
        let list = UnsafeMutableAudioBufferListPointer(raw.assumingMemoryBound(to: AudioBufferList.self))
        return list.reduce(0) { $0 + Int($1.mNumberChannels) }
    }

    // MARK: Devices

    static func allDeviceIDs() -> [AudioObjectID] {
        var a = address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDevices)
        var size: UInt32 = 0
        guard AudioObjectGetPropertyDataSize(AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject), &a, 0, nil, &size) == noErr else { return [] }
        var ids = [AudioObjectID](repeating: 0, count: Int(size) / MemoryLayout<AudioObjectID>.size)
        guard AudioObjectGetPropertyData(AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject), &a, 0, nil, &size, &ids) == noErr else { return [] }
        return ids
    }

    /// Visible devices that can play sound, in the system's order.
    static func outputDevices() -> [Device] {
        allDeviceIDs().filter { id in
            channels(id, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeOutput) > 0 && (get(id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyIsHidden), UInt32(0)) ?? 0) == 0
        }.compactMap(device)
    }

    static func defaultOutputID() -> AudioObjectID {
        get(AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject), address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice), AudioObjectID(0)) ?? 0
    }

    static func defaultInput() -> Device? {
        device(get(AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject), address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultInputDevice), AudioObjectID(0)) ?? 0)
    }

    /// Makes `id` the default output; system sounds follow when they were on the old default.
    @discardableResult
    static func setDefaultOutput(_ id: AudioObjectID) -> Bool {
        let system = AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject)
        let old = defaultOutputID()
        guard set(system, address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice), id) else { return false }
        if get(system, address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultSystemOutputDevice), AudioObjectID(0)) == old {
            _ = set(system, address(kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultSystemOutputDevice), id)
        }
        return true
    }

    /// The outputs for a filter: matching names first (system order inside each group).
    static func ranked(_ devices: [Device], filter: String) -> [Device] {
        devices.filter { matches($0, filter: filter) } + devices.filter { !matches($0, filter: filter) }
    }

    static func matches(_ d: Device, filter: String) -> Bool {
        let f = filter.folding(options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive], locale: nil)
        guard !f.isEmpty else { return false }
        let n = d.name.folding(options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive], locale: nil)
        return f.split(separator: " ").allSatisfy { n.contains($0) } || (f.hasPrefix("airpod") && d.kind == .airpods)
    }

    // MARK: Input mute

    private static let volumeKey = "edge.mic.volumeBeforeMute."

    /// nil: no input device, or it can be neither muted nor turned down.
    static func inputMuted() -> Bool? {
        guard let d = defaultInput() else { return nil }
        if let m = get(d.id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyMute, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput), UInt32(0)), canMute(d.id) { return m != 0 }
        if let v = inputVolume(d.id) { return v <= 0.001 }
        return nil
    }

    static func canMute(_ id: AudioObjectID) -> Bool {
        var a = address(kAudioDevicePropertyMute, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput)
        var settable: DarwinBoolean = false
        return AudioObjectHasProperty(id, &a) && AudioObjectIsPropertySettable(id, &a, &settable) == noErr && settable.boolValue
    }

    private static func volumeElements(_ id: AudioObjectID) -> [AudioObjectPropertyElement] {
        let main = address(kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput)
        var a = main
        var settable: DarwinBoolean = false
        if AudioObjectHasProperty(id, &a), AudioObjectIsPropertySettable(id, &a, &settable) == noErr, settable.boolValue { return [kAudioObjectPropertyElementMain] }
        return (1...max(1, channels(id, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput))).map { AudioObjectPropertyElement($0) }.filter { e in
            var c = address(kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput, e)
            var s: DarwinBoolean = false
            return AudioObjectHasProperty(id, &c) && AudioObjectIsPropertySettable(id, &c, &s) == noErr && s.boolValue
        }
    }

    private static func inputVolume(_ id: AudioObjectID) -> Float32? {
        guard let e = volumeElements(id).first else { return nil }
        return get(id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput, e), Float32(0))
    }

    @discardableResult
    static func setInputMuted(_ muted: Bool) -> Bool {
        guard let d = defaultInput() else { return false }
        if canMute(d.id) {
            return set(d.id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyMute, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput), UInt32(muted ? 1 : 0))
        }
        let elements = volumeElements(d.id)
        guard !elements.isEmpty else { return false }
        let key = volumeKey + d.uid
        if muted {
            if let v = inputVolume(d.id), v > 0.001 { UserDefaults.standard.set(Double(v), forKey: key) }
            return elements.allSatisfy { set(d.id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput, $0), Float32(0)) }
        }
        let restore = Float32(UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: key) as? Double ?? 0.75)
        return elements.allSatisfy { set(d.id, address(kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput, $0), restore) }
    }

    // MARK: Change listening

    /// Calls `changed` on the main queue when devices, defaults, or the input's mute/volume change.
    static func listen(_ changed: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) {
        let system = AudioObjectID(kAudioObjectSystemObject)
        let block: AudioObjectPropertyListenerBlock = { _, _ in changed() }
        for sel in [kAudioHardwarePropertyDevices, kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice, kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultInputDevice] {
            var a = address(sel)
            AudioObjectAddPropertyListenerBlock(system, &a, .main, block)
        }
    }

    static func listenInput(_ id: AudioObjectID, _ changed: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) {
        let block: AudioObjectPropertyListenerBlock = { _, _ in changed() }
        for sel in [kAudioDevicePropertyMute, kAudioDevicePropertyVolumeScalar] {
            var a = address(sel, kAudioObjectPropertyScopeInput)
            if AudioObjectHasProperty(id, &a) { AudioObjectAddPropertyListenerBlock(id, &a, .main, block) }
        }
    }
}

/// What the cards draw from; refreshed by CoreAudio's own change callbacks.
@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeSound {
    static let shared = EdgeSound()

    private(set) var outputs: [EdgeAudio.Device] = []
    private(set) var defaultOutput: AudioObjectID = 0
    private(set) var input: EdgeAudio.Device?
    /// nil: the input can't be muted.
    private(set) var muted: Bool?
    @ObservationIgnored private var listening = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var listenedInputs: Set<AudioObjectID> = []

    private init() {}

    func refresh() {
        if !listening {
            listening = true
            EdgeAudio.listen { Task { @MainActor in EdgeSound.shared.refresh() } }
        }
        outputs = EdgeAudio.outputDevices()
        defaultOutput = EdgeAudio.defaultOutputID()
        input = EdgeAudio.defaultInput()
        muted = EdgeAudio.inputMuted()
        if let id = input?.id, !listenedInputs.contains(id) {
            listenedInputs.insert(id)
            EdgeAudio.listenInput(id) { Task { @MainActor in EdgeSound.shared.refresh() } }
        }
    }

    /// `mute` / `unmute` / `mic`. Returns the new state (nil when it couldn't).
    @discardableResult
    func applyMic(_ request: BarWord.MicRequest, source: String = "bar") -> Bool? {
        refresh()
        guard let current = muted else { return nil }
        let want: Bool = switch request {
        case .mute: true
        case .unmute: false
        case .toggle: !current
        }
        if want != current, !EdgeAudio.setInputMuted(want) { return nil }
        refresh()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("sound.mic", params: ["muted": want ? "1" : "0", "source": source])
        return muted
    }

    @discardableResult
    func switchOutput(to device: EdgeAudio.Device, source: String = "bar") -> Bool {
        let ok = device.id == defaultOutput || EdgeAudio.setDefaultOutput(device.id)
        refresh()
        if ok { InteractionJournal.shared.action("sound.output", params: ["kind": "\(device.kind)", "source": source]) }
        return ok
    }
}
//
//  AppNotifications.swift
//  In-app notification ledger — download/update events and any future app
//  notices funnel through here. A menubar item (NotificationsMenuBar) renders
//  the list and surfaces an unread badge.
//

import SwiftUI
import Observation

struct AppNotification: Identifiable, Hashable {
    enum Kind: String { case download, update, complete, info, error }

    let id = UUID()
    let kind: Kind
    let title: String
    let message: String
    let date: Date
    var read: Bool = false

    var symbol: String { kind.symbol }
    var tint: Color { kind.tint }
}

/// App-wide notification ledger. Single source of truth for the menubar list.
/// Plain `@Observable` (not actor-isolated) so any layer can post; `post` hops
/// to the main thread itself, so callers never have to care.
@Observable
final class AppNotifications {
    static let shared = AppNotifications()

    private(set) var items: [AppNotification] = []
    var unreadCount: Int { items.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.read ? 0 : 1) } }

    func post(_ kind: AppNotification.Kind, _ title: String, _ message: String = "") {
        let note = AppNotification(kind: kind, title: title, message: message, date: Date())
        let apply = {
            self.items.insert(note, at: 0)
            if self.items.count > 80 { self.items.removeLast(self.items.count - 80) }
            self.changed()
            // Every ledger entry also gets its transient moment on screen.
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                ToastCenter.shared.show(kind, title, message)
            }
        }
        if Thread.isMainThread { apply() } else { DispatchQueue.main.async(execute: apply) }
    }

    @MainActor func markAllRead() {
        guard items.contains(where: { !$0.read }) else { return }
        for i in items.indices { items[i].read = true }
        changed()
    }

    @MainActor func clear() {
        items.removeAll()
        changed()
    }

    private func changed() {
        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .appNotificationsChanged, object: nil)
    }
}

extension Notification.Name {
    /// Fired whenever the ledger changes so the AppKit menubar badge can refresh.
    static let appNotificationsChanged = Notification.Name("option.appNotificationsChanged")
}
//
//  EdgeTerminalWindow.swift
//  The terminal off the sheet: its own window, floating or tiled like every other
//  workspace. Caps+W walks it docked → window → tiled → docked.
//
//  Same doctrine as the sheet: your terminal's background, no chrome. The only extra
//  is a thin strip along the top to drag it by (the grid takes every other click).
//

import AppKit

@MainActor final class EdgeTerminalWindow {
    static let shared = EdgeTerminalWindow()
    static let key = "terminal"
    static let dragStrip: CGFloat = 14

    let placement = WorkspacePlacement()
    private(set) var window: EdgeBrowserPanel?
    /// The terminal lives here, not on the sheet (even while the window is hidden).
    private(set) var detached = false
    private(set) var presented = false
    private var restoreAfterToggle = false
    private var generation = 0
    private let slot = EdgeTermSlot()
    private var root: EdgeTermWindowView?

    var isKey: Bool { window?.isKeyWindow == true }

    /// Takes the terminal off the sheet. `from` is where the sheet was on screen: the
    /// window starts exactly there and springs to `to` (its last floating frame).
    func detach(from start: NSRect?, to target: NSRect? = nil) {
        guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        ensureWindow(screen)
        guard let window else { return }
        detached = true
        slot.adopt()
        generation += 1; presented = true
        let end = target ?? placement.presentationFrame(fallback: placement.defaultFloatingFrame())
        if let start {
            window.setFrame(start, display: true)
            placement.present(start, animated: false)
            placement.move(end)
        } else {
            placement.present(end)
        }
        focus()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("terminal.detach")
    }

    /// Back onto the sheet: the window travels to the sheet's rect, then the sheet takes
    /// the terminal over (the caller opens it).
    func dock(into sheet: NSRect?, completion: @escaping () -> Void) {
        guard detached, let window else { completion(); return }
        generation += 1; let token = generation
        presented = false
        let finish = { [weak self, weak window] in
            guard let self, self.generation == token else { return }
            window?.alphaValue = 0; window?.ignoresMouseEvents = true
            self.detached = false
            EdgeTerminalHost.shared.sheetSlot?.adopt()
            completion()
        }
        guard window.isVisible, window.alphaValue > 0, let sheet else { finish(); return }
        placement.move(sheet, transient: true) { finish() }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("terminal.dock")
    }

    func show(focus wantsFocus: Bool = true) {
        guard detached, let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
        ensureWindow(screen)
        generation += 1; presented = true
        placement.present(placement.presentationFrame(fallback: placement.defaultFloatingFrame()))
        if wantsFocus { focus() } else { window?.orderFront(nil) }
    }

    func hide() {
        restoreAfterToggle = false
        presented = false
        slideOut()
    }
    func hideForLayer() {
        // Tiled with every other window: it keeps its tile when the layer goes, like an app's.
        guard !UnifiedTiling.shared.holds(placement.layoutKey) else { return }
        restoreAfterToggle = presented; presented = false; slideOut()
    }
    func restoreForLayer() { if restoreAfterToggle { restoreAfterToggle = false; show(focus: false) } }

    func focus() {
        guard let window else { return }
        window.orderFrontRegardless(); window.makeKey()
        if !NSApp.isActive { NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true) }
        EdgeTerminalHost.shared.focus()
    }

    private func slideOut() {
        guard let window, window.isVisible, window.alphaValue > 0 else { return }
        if window.isKeyWindow { window.resignKey() }
        generation += 1; let token = generation
        placement.collapse { [weak self, weak window] in
            guard let self, self.generation == token else { return }
            window?.alphaValue = 0; window?.ignoresMouseEvents = true
        }
    }

    private func ensureWindow(_ screen: NSScreen) {
        guard window == nil else { return }
        // Activating, like the browser: you type here, and the keyboard follows the active app.
        let panel = EdgeBrowserPanel(contentRect: .zero, styleMask: [.borderless], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded = false
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false; panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear
        panel.title = "Nardo Terminal"; panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 1); panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false
        panel.hasShadow = true
        panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        let root = EdgeTermWindowView(slot: slot, placement: placement)
        panel.contentView = root
        self.root = root
        window = panel
        placement.window = panel
        placement.alwaysFloating = true
        placement.configurePersistence(Self.key)
        placement.onCollapse = { [weak self] in self?.hide() }
        placement.onGeometry = { [weak root] _ in root?.restyle() }
        let resize = WorkspaceResizeFrame(); resize.placement = placement
        resize.frame = root.bounds; resize.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]; root.addSubview(resize)
    }

    /// Where the docked sheet sits on screen (for the window to start or end there).
    static func sheetFrame(on screen: NSScreen) -> NSRect {
        NSRect(x: screen.frame.midX - EdgeTerminalSheet.width / 2, y: screen.frame.minY,
               width: EdgeTerminalSheet.width, height: EdgeTerminalSheet.height)
    }
}

/// The window's whole content: your background, 32pt corners, a drag strip, the grid.
final class EdgeTermWindowView: NSView {
    private let slot: EdgeTermSlot
    private let strip: EdgeTermDragStrip
    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }

    init(slot: EdgeTermSlot, placement: WorkspacePlacement) {
        self.slot = slot
        strip = EdgeTermDragStrip(); strip.placement = placement
        super.init(frame: .zero)
        wantsLayer = true
        layer?.masksToBounds = true
        layer?.cornerRadius = EdgeLayout.outerRadius
        layer?.cornerCurve = .continuous
        layer?.borderWidth = 0.75
        autoresizesSubviews = true
        slot.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
        strip.autoresizingMask = [.width]
        addSubview(slot); addSubview(strip)
        restyle()
    }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { nil }

    func restyle() {
        MainActor.assumeIsolated {
            let look = EdgeTerminalHost.shared.look.config
            layer?.backgroundColor = look.backgroundColor.cgColor
            layer?.borderColor = look.foreground.color.withAlphaComponent(0.1).cgColor
        }
    }

    override func layout() {
        super.layout()
        let s = EdgeTerminalWindow.dragStrip
        strip.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: bounds.width, height: s)
        slot.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: s, width: bounds.width, height: max(0, bounds.height - s))
    }
}

/// Drag the window by its top strip (through the placement, so tiling shows its grid).
final class EdgeTermDragStrip: NSView {
    weak var placement: WorkspacePlacement?
    override func acceptsFirstMouse(for event: NSEvent?) -> Bool { true }
    override func resetCursorRects() { addCursorRect(bounds, cursor: .openHand) }
    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { MainActor.assumeIsolated { placement?.beginDrag() } }
    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
        let point = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        MainActor.assumeIsolated { placement?.queueInteraction { [weak placement] in placement?.updateDrag(at: point) } }
    }
    override func mouseUp(with event: NSEvent) { MainActor.assumeIsolated { placement?.endDrag() } }
}
//
//  EdgeSwipeContext.swift
//  The sentence so far, for the swipe keyboard: the decoder's top readings are rescored
//  by how likely a small local LM (LFM2.5-350M base, llama.cpp) finds each one next.
//  It splits what geometry can't: "turn of" vs "turn off", "or" vs "our".
//
//  tools/swipe-bench/rescore.py, held-out words from real text: 81.0% → 87.3% top-1
//  (his messages 81.1 → 87.6). The query starts when the pointer goes down, so it's
//  back before the swipe ends; a slow answer never holds the word (geometry wins).
//
//  Context is the text before the caret in the focused field (Accessibility), or what
//  the keyboard itself typed when the app doesn't expose its text.
//
//  Punctuation comes from the same model, decided together with the next word: none
//  scores P(w|ctx); a mark scores P(mark|ctx)·P(w|ctx+mark), and must win by a margin.
//  tools/swipe-bench/punct.py, held-out gaps in real text (margin 1): 81% of inserted
//  marks right, ~half of the real ones caught, ~1 wrong insert per 100 gaps.
//

import AppKit
import ApplicationServices

@MainActor final class EdgeSwipeContext {
    static let shared = EdgeSwipeContext()
    static let port = 8097
    static let modelName = "LFM2.5-350M-Base-Q8_0.gguf"
    /// Mix tuned on rescore.py's dev half: geometry + 0.5·prior + 1·LM (a token that only
    /// starts the word counts 2 nats less).
    static let priorWeight = 0.5, lmWeight = 1.0, prefixPenalty = -2.0
    static let marks = [",", ".", "?"]
    static let markMargin = 1.0

    /// What the model said when the pointer went down: the next token after the
    /// context, and after the context plus each mark.
    struct Answer {
        var base: [(String, Double)]
        var afterMark: [String: [(String, Double)]] = [:]
    }

    private var process: Process?
    private var idleTimer: Timer?
    private var typed = ""   // what the keyboard typed, for apps without readable text
    private var pending: Task<Answer?, Never>?
    private var pendingContext: String?
    /// The swipe starts a sentence (empty field, after . ? ! or a new line).
    private(set) var sentenceStart = false

    // MARK: Server

    private var modelURL: URL? {
        let url = FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
            .appendingPathComponent("Nardo/Models/\(Self.modelName)")
        return FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) ? url : nil
    }
    private var serverURL: URL? {
        ["/opt/homebrew/bin/llama-server", "/usr/local/bin/llama-server"]
            .map(URL.init(fileURLWithPath:)).first { FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: $0.path) }
    }

    /// The keyboard came up: have the model ready by the first swipe.
    func warm() {
        idleTimer?.invalidate()
        idleTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 15 * 60, repeats: false) { _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeSwipeContext.shared.stop() }
        }
        guard process?.isRunning != true, let model = modelURL, let server = serverURL else { return }
        Task {
            if await Self.healthy() { return }
            let p = Process()
            p.executableURL = server
            p.arguments = ["-m", model.path, "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", String(Self.port),
                           "-c", "4096", "-ngl", "99", "--parallel", "4"]
            p.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice; p.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
            do { try p.run(); self.process = p } catch { return }
            NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(forName: NSApplication.willTerminateNotification, object: nil, queue: .main) { _ in
                MainActor.assumeIsolated { EdgeSwipeContext.shared.stop() }
            }
        }
    }

    func stop() { idleTimer?.invalidate(); idleTimer = nil; process?.terminate(); process = nil }

    private static func healthy() async -> Bool {
        guard let url = URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:\(port)/health") else { return false }
        var request = URLRequest(url: url); request.timeoutInterval = 0.4
        guard let (data, response) = try? await URLSession.shared.data(for: request),
              (response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode == 200 else { return false }
        return String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self).contains("ok")
    }

    // MARK: Context

    /// Text before the caret (last ~400 characters).
    func before() -> String {
        if let text = Self.focusedTextBeforeCaret() { return String(text.suffix(400)) }
        return String(typed.suffix(400))
    }

    func noteTyped(_ text: String) { typed += text; if typed.count > 2000 { typed = String(typed.suffix(1000)) } }
    func noteDeleted(_ n: Int) { typed = String(typed.dropLast(n)) }
    func noteNewline() { typed += "\n" }

    private static func focusedTextBeforeCaret() -> String? {
        let system = AXUIElementCreateSystemWide()
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(system, 0.05)
        var focused: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(system, kAXFocusedUIElementAttribute as CFString, &focused) == .success,
              let element = focused else { return nil }
        let el = element as! AXUIElement
        AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(el, 0.05)
        var value: CFTypeRef?, range: CFTypeRef?
        guard AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, kAXValueAttribute as CFString, &value) == .success,
              let text = value as? String else { return nil }
        var caret = (text as NSString).length
        if AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(el, kAXSelectedTextRangeAttribute as CFString, &range) == .success,
           let r = range, CFGetTypeID(r) == AXValueGetTypeID() {
            var cf = CFRange()
            if AXValueGetValue(r as! AXValue, .cfRange, &cf) { caret = min(caret, max(0, cf.location)) }
        }
        return (text as NSString).substring(to: caret)
    }

    // MARK: Asking the model

    /// Pointer down: ask now, use it when the swipe ends.
    func prefetch(spaceFirst: Bool) {
        var context = before()
        let trimmed = context.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        sentenceStart = trimmed.isEmpty || trimmed.hasSuffix(".") || trimmed.hasSuffix("?") || trimmed.hasSuffix("!") || context.hasSuffix("\n")
        // A mark can only follow a word (not a space you typed, or another mark).
        let afterWord = trimmed.last.map { $0.isLetter || $0.isNumber } == true && (spaceFirst || !context.hasSuffix(" "))
        if spaceFirst, !context.isEmpty, !context.hasSuffix(" ") { context += " " }
        pendingContext = context
        let prompt = context
        pending = Task {
            async let base = Self.nextTokens(prompt)
            var marks: [String: [(String, Double)]] = [:]
            if afterWord {
                await withTaskGroup(of: (String, [(String, Double)]?).self) { group in
                    for m in Self.marks { group.addTask { (m, await Self.nextTokens(trimmed + m + " ")) } }
                    for await (m, t) in group { if let t { marks[m] = t } }
                }
            }
            guard let b = await base else { return nil }
            return Answer(base: b, afterMark: marks)
        }
    }

    /// The prefetched answer, waiting at most `wait` for it.
    func answer(wait: TimeInterval = 0.12) async -> Answer? {
        guard let pending else { return nil }
        return await withTaskGroup(of: Answer?.self) { group in
            group.addTask { await pending.value }
            group.addTask { try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: UInt64(wait * 1e9)); return nil }
            let first = await group.next() ?? nil
            group.cancelAll()
            return first
        }
    }

    private static func nextTokens(_ context: String) async -> [(String, Double)]? {
        let prompt = context.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: " "))
        guard !prompt.isEmpty, let url = URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:\(port)/completion") else { return nil }
        var request = URLRequest(url: url)
        request.httpMethod = "POST"; request.timeoutInterval = 1
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
        request.httpBody = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: [
            "prompt": prompt, "n_predict": 1, "n_probs": 100, "temperature": 0, "cache_prompt": true])
        guard let (data, _) = try? await URLSession.shared.data(for: request),
              let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any],
              let probs = (json["completion_probabilities"] as? [[String: Any]])?.first,
              let top = probs["top_logprobs"] as? [[String: Any]] else { return nil }
        return top.compactMap { t in (t["token"] as? String).flatMap { tok in (t["logprob"] as? Double).map { (tok, $0) } } }
    }

    /// How likely the model finds `word` next.
    static func score(_ word: String, in top: [(String, Double)]) -> Double {
        let w = word.lowercased()
        var best: Double?
        for (tok, lp) in top {
            let t = tok.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
            if t.isEmpty { continue }
            if t == w { return lp }
            if t.count >= 2, w.hasPrefix(t) { best = max(best ?? -99, lp + prefixPenalty) }
        }
        return best ?? ((top.last?.1 ?? -10) - 1)
    }

    /// The mark (if any) that belongs before `word`.
    static func mark(before word: String, in answer: Answer?) -> String? {
        guard let answer, !answer.afterMark.isEmpty else { return nil }
        let none = score(word, in: answer.base)
        var best: (String, Double)?
        for (m, after) in answer.afterMark {
            let markLP = answer.base.first { $0.0 == m }?.1 ?? ((answer.base.last?.1 ?? -10) - 1)
            let s = markLP + score(word, in: after)
            if s > (best?.1 ?? -.infinity) { best = (m, s) }
        }
        guard let best, best.1 > none + markMargin else { return nil }
        return best.0
    }

    /// The decoder's readings, reordered with the sentence in mind.
    static func rescore(_ candidates: [SwipeDecoder.Candidate], with top: [(String, Double)]?) -> [String] {
        guard let top, !top.isEmpty else { return candidates.map(\.word) }
        return candidates
            .map { c in (c.word, c.geometry + priorWeight * c.prior + lmWeight * score(c.word, in: top)) }
            .sorted { $0.1 > $1.1 }
            .map(\.0)
    }
}
//
//  FileIndexer.swift
//  Nardo's own file index — replaces the external fssearch crawler.
//
//  Names and paths only (no stored file contents), kept fresh by FSEvents.
//  The first launch crawls the home folder once; every later launch replays
//  the FSEvents journal from the last seen event id, so changes made while
//  the app was closed land without a re-crawl.
//
//  Schema matches what FileSearchEngine and GamesStore already query
//  (`files`, `projects`, `file_search`), plus `name_trigram` so substring
//  matches use an index instead of scanning every row.
//

import CoreServices
import Observation
import Foundation
import os
import SQLite3

final class FileIndexer {
    static let shared = FileIndexer()

    static func databaseURL() -> URL {
        if let p = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["SURFACE_FILE_INDEX_DB"], !p.isEmpty {
            return URL(fileURLWithPath: p)
        }
        let support = FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        return support.appendingPathComponent("Nardo/files.db")
    }

    /// Called on the indexer queue once a usable index exists (after the first crawl).
    var onReady: (() -> Void)?

    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.hashawn.nardo.file-indexer", qos: .utility)
    /// FSEvents delivers here and hands off to `queue`. Delivering on `queue` itself meant a
    /// crawl blocked delivery, fseventsd dropped events (MustScanSubDirs at the root), and
    /// every drop started another full crawl: a loop that wrote terabytes a day.
    private let eventQueue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.hashawn.nardo.file-indexer.events", qos: .utility)
    private var db: OpaquePointer?
    private var stream: FSEventStreamRef?
    private let root: String
    private var pendingEventID: FSEventStreamEventId = 0
    private var lastSavedEventID: FSEventStreamEventId = 0

    /// After dropped events, one rescan runs once things are quiet, at most this often.
    static var rescanDelay: TimeInterval = 10
    static var rescanMinInterval: TimeInterval = 300
    private var rescanScheduled = false
    private var lastRescan = Date.distantPast
    /// Full rescans since launch (the offline harness counts them).
    private(set) var rescans = 0

    init(root: String = NSHomeDirectory()) {
        self.root = root
    }

    /// macOS-protected folders this process may not read (no Full Disk Access / folder
    /// consent). A denied folder looks empty, and an empty folder means "everything in
    /// here was deleted": that wiped the index once. Rows under a blocked folder are kept.
    private(set) var blockedFolders: [String] = []
    /// Called (on the indexer queue) when a protected folder is blocked.
    var onBlocked: (([String]) -> Void)?
    private var blockedCheckedAt = Date.distantPast

    private func refreshBlockedFolders(force: Bool = false) {
        guard force || Date().timeIntervalSince(blockedCheckedAt) > 30 else { return }
        blockedCheckedAt = Date()
        let fm = FileManager.default
        // Not allowed to look yet (FolderAccess): count them blocked without listing them,
        // which is what would make macOS prompt.
        let may = FolderAccess.mayTouch
        let now = FolderAccess.protected.map { root + "/" + $0 }
            .filter { fm.fileExists(atPath: $0) && (!may || (try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: $0)) == nil) }
        let changed = now != blockedFolders
        blockedFolders = now
        FolderAccess.lastBlocked.withLock { $0 = now }
        DispatchQueue.main.async { FileIndexProgress.shared.blocked = now }
        setMeta("blocked_folders", now.joined(separator: "\n"))
        if changed, !now.isEmpty { onBlocked?(now) }
    }

    private func isBlocked(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        blockedFolders.contains { path == $0 || path.hasPrefix($0 + "/") }
    }

    /// Settings → Files: folders you told it to leave out.
    private func isExcluded(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        EdgeSettings.filesExcluded.contains { path == $0 || path.hasPrefix($0 + "/") }
    }

    /// The excluded list changed: drop rows under newly excluded folders, index folders
    /// that came back.
    func excludedChanged(from old: [String], to new: [String]) {
        queue.async { [self] in
            guard openDatabase() else { return }
            exec("BEGIN")
            for path in new where !old.contains(path) { remove(path: path, descendants: true) }
            exec("COMMIT")
            for path in old where !new.contains(path) {
                exec("BEGIN"); refresh(path: path, rescanChildren: true); exec("COMMIT")
            }
        }
    }

    /// For Settings → Files.
    func indexedCount() -> Int {
        var n = 0
        queue.sync {
            guard openDatabase() else { return }
            var stmt: OpaquePointer?
            defer { sqlite3_finalize(stmt) }
            if sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "SELECT count(*) FROM files;", -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK, sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_ROW {
                n = Int(sqlite3_column_int64(stmt, 0))
            }
        }
        return n
    }

    /// Settings → Files → Reindex: a fresh crawl in the background.
    func reindex(done: @escaping (Int) -> Void) {
        cancel.withLock { $0 = false }
        queue.async { [self] in
            guard openDatabase() else { DispatchQueue.main.async { done(0) }; return }
            let count = crawl()
            guard lastCrawlFinished else { DispatchQueue.main.async { done(count) }; return }
            setMeta("crawl_complete", "1")
            setMeta("last_event_id", String(FSEventsGetCurrentEventId()))
            DispatchQueue.main.async { done(count) }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Lifecycle

    /// Set by `stop()` from any thread; a running crawl checks it and gives up unfinished
    /// (not marked complete, so the next start crawls again).
    private let cancel = OSAllocatedUnfairLock(initialState: false)
    private var cancelled: Bool { cancel.withLock { $0 } }
    /// Whether the last `crawl()` walked the whole tree (indexer queue only).
    private var lastCrawlFinished = false

    /// Opens the index, crawls if it has never completed, then watches for changes.
    func start() {
        cancel.withLock { $0 = false }
        queue.async { [self] in
            guard stream == nil, openDatabase() else { return }
            let resumeID = metaValue("last_event_id").flatMap(UInt64.init)
            // Folders blocked last time and readable now (access granted since): crawl again.
            let wasBlocked = (metaValue("blocked_folders") ?? "").split(separator: "\n").map(String.init)
            refreshBlockedFolders(force: true)
            let regained = wasBlocked.contains { !blockedFolders.contains($0) }
            if metaValue("crawl_complete") == "1", let resumeID, !regained {
                onReady?()
                startStream(since: resumeID)
            } else {
                // Start watching first so nothing changed during the crawl is lost.
                let crawlStart = FSEventsGetCurrentEventId()
                crawl()
                // Files went off mid-crawl. Asks the crawl itself, not the flag: off and on
                // again between its give-up and here would read "not cancelled" and mark a
                // fraction of the tree complete.
                guard lastCrawlFinished else { return }
                setMeta("crawl_complete", "1")
                setMeta("last_event_id", String(crawlStart))
                onReady?()
                startStream(since: crawlStart)
            }
        }
    }

    /// You allowed file access (FolderAccess opt-in): re-check the protected folders now and
    /// crawl what became readable, instead of waiting for the next launch.
    func accessChanged() {
        queue.async { [self] in
            guard stream != nil, openDatabase() else { return }
            let was = blockedFolders
            refreshBlockedFolders(force: true)
            let regained = was.filter { !blockedFolders.contains($0) }
            guard !regained.isEmpty else { return }
            exec("BEGIN"); for path in regained { refresh(path: path, rescanChildren: true) }; exec("COMMIT")
        }
    }

    /// Settings → Files off: stop watching. The journal position is saved, so `start()`
    /// later replays what changed meanwhile instead of crawling again.
    func stop() {
        cancel.withLock { $0 = true }
        queue.async { [self] in
            guard let stream else { return }
            FSEventStreamStop(stream); FSEventStreamInvalidate(stream); FSEventStreamRelease(stream)
            self.stream = nil
            // Not past a pending rescan (dropped events): quitting before it runs must replay them.
            if pendingEventID > lastSavedEventID, !rescanScheduled {
                setMeta("last_event_id", String(pendingEventID)); lastSavedEventID = pendingEventID
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.async { FileIndexer.crawlProgress = nil }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - First crawl progress

    /// Files seen so far while a crawl runs (nil when none is running), for the Files card
    /// and Settings → Files. Main thread.
    @MainActor static var crawlProgress: Int? {
        get { FileIndexProgress.shared.count }
        set { FileIndexProgress.shared.count = newValue }
    }

    /// One full crawl (a diff against what's indexed); used by tools.
    @discardableResult
    func crawlNow() -> (files: Int, seconds: Double) {
        var result = (0, 0.0)
        queue.sync {
            guard openDatabase() else { return }
            let t0 = Date()
            let count = crawl()
            setMeta("crawl_complete", "1")
            setMeta("last_event_id", String(FSEventsGetCurrentEventId()))
            result = (count, Date().timeIntervalSince(t0))
        }
        return result
    }

    // MARK: - Schema

    private func openDatabase() -> Bool {
        if db != nil { return true }
        let url = Self.databaseURL()
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        guard sqlite3_open_v2(url.path, &db, SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE | SQLITE_OPEN_CREATE | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX, nil) == SQLITE_OK
        else { db = nil; return false }
        exec("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL; PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY;")
        exec("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, name TEXT NOT NULL,
                dir TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER, ext TEXT, mtime REAL, file_type TEXT,
                role TEXT, project_id INTEGER, opens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_name_nocase ON files(name COLLATE NOCASE);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_ext_mtime ON files(ext, mtime);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
            CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_search USING fts5(
                name, dir, content='', contentless_delete=1, tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
            CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS name_trigram USING fts5(
                name, content='', contentless_delete=1, tokenize='trigram');
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT);
            """)
        return true
    }

    // MARK: - Crawl

    /// Folder names that are never personal files (dependency trees, build output, caches).
    private static let skippedDirectories: Set<String> = [
        "node_modules", ".git", "target", ".build", "DerivedData", "__pycache__", "Pods",
        "site-packages", ".venv", "venv", "Caches", "Library", ".Trash", "build",
    ]

    private static func shouldSkip(directoryNamed name: String) -> Bool {
        skippedDirectories.contains(name) || name.hasPrefix(".") || name.hasSuffix("venv") || name.hasSuffix("-venv")
    }

    private static let keys: [URLResourceKey] = [
        .isDirectoryKey, .isPackageKey, .fileSizeKey, .contentModificationDateKey, .isSymbolicLinkKey,
    ]

    /// Walks the whole home folder against what's already indexed: unchanged rows are left
    /// alone (a rescan of an unchanged tree writes nothing), changed ones are rewritten, and
    /// rows that weren't seen are dropped, except under folders we can't read.
    @discardableResult
    private func crawl() -> Int {
        lastCrawlFinished = false
        refreshBlockedFolders(force: true)
        DispatchQueue.main.async { FileIndexer.crawlProgress = 0 }
        var seen = Set<Int64>()
        guard let walker = FileManager.default.enumerator(
            at: URL(fileURLWithPath: root, isDirectory: true),
            includingPropertiesForKeys: Self.keys,
            options: [.skipsPackageDescendants, .skipsHiddenFiles],
            errorHandler: { _, _ in true })
        else { return 0 }

        var count = 0
        var finished = true
        exec("BEGIN")
        for case let url as URL in walker {
            if count % 1000 == 0, cancelled {
                // Gave up part way (Files off): the next start must crawl again, whatever this was.
                exec("COMMIT"); setMeta("crawl_complete", "0"); exec("BEGIN")
                finished = false
                break
            }
            guard let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: Set(Self.keys)) else { continue }
            if values.isSymbolicLink == true { continue }
            if values.isDirectory == true, values.isPackage != true, Self.shouldSkip(directoryNamed: url.lastPathComponent) {
                walker.skipDescendants()
                continue
            }
            if isBlocked(url.path) || isExcluded(url.path) { walker.skipDescendants(); continue }
            if let id = sync(url: url, values: values) { seen.insert(id) }
            count += 1
            if count % 5000 == 0 {
                exec("COMMIT; BEGIN")
                let n = count
                DispatchQueue.main.async { FileIndexer.crawlProgress = n }
            }
        }
        // Only a complete walk may drop what it didn't see: a cancelled one saw a fraction of the tree.
        if finished { removeUnseen(under: root, keeping: seen) }
        exec("COMMIT")
        lastCrawlFinished = finished
        DispatchQueue.main.async { FileIndexer.crawlProgress = nil }
        return count
    }

    // MARK: - Writes

    private var lookupStmt: OpaquePointer?

    /// Indexes one item unless its row already matches (same mtime, size and kind).
    /// Returns the row id either way.
    private func sync(url: URL, values: URLResourceValues) -> Int64? {
        if lookupStmt == nil {
            sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "SELECT id, mtime, size, file_type FROM files WHERE path = ?;", -1, &lookupStmt, nil)
        }
        if let stmt = lookupStmt {
            // Reset after use too: a statement left mid-step pins the WAL and blocks checkpoints.
            defer { sqlite3_reset(stmt) }
            bind(stmt, 1, url.path)
            if sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_ROW {
                let isFolder = values.isDirectory == true && values.isPackage != true
                let kind = isFolder ? "folder" : (values.isPackage == true ? "package" : "file")
                let mtime = values.contentModificationDate?.timeIntervalSince1970 ?? 0
                if sqlite3_column_double(stmt, 1) == mtime, sqlite3_column_int64(stmt, 2) == Int64(values.fileSize ?? 0),
                   sqlite3_column_text(stmt, 3).map({ String(cString: $0) }) == kind {
                    return sqlite3_column_int64(stmt, 0)
                }
            }
        }
        return upsert(url: url, values: values)
    }

    /// Drops rows under `path` (not `path` itself) whose ids weren't seen by a walk.
    /// Rows under blocked folders stay: unreadable is not deleted.
    private func removeUnseen(under path: String, keeping seen: Set<Int64>) {
        var gone: [Int64] = []
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        if sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "SELECT id, path FROM files WHERE path >= ?1 || '/' AND path < ?1 || '0';", -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK {
            bind(stmt, 1, path)
            while sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_ROW {
                let id = sqlite3_column_int64(stmt, 0)
                if seen.contains(id) { continue }
                if let c = sqlite3_column_text(stmt, 1), isBlocked(String(cString: c)) { continue }
                gone.append(id)
            }
        }
        sqlite3_finalize(stmt)
        for id in gone {
            run("DELETE FROM file_search WHERE rowid = ?;", id, [])
            run("DELETE FROM name_trigram WHERE rowid = ?;", id, [])
            run("DELETE FROM files WHERE id = ?;", id, [])
        }
    }

    @discardableResult
    private func upsert(url: URL, values: URLResourceValues) -> Int64? {
        let path = url.path
        let name = url.lastPathComponent
        let isFolder = values.isDirectory == true && values.isPackage != true
        let ext = isFolder ? "" : (url.pathExtension.isEmpty ? "" : "." + url.pathExtension.lowercased())
        let mtime = values.contentModificationDate?.timeIntervalSince1970 ?? 0

        // Replace any prior row so both FTS tables stay in step with `files`.
        remove(path: path, descendants: false)
        let sql = "INSERT INTO files (path, name, dir, size, ext, mtime, file_type) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?);"
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(stmt) }
        guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return nil }
        bind(stmt, 1, path)
        bind(stmt, 2, name)
        bind(stmt, 3, url.deletingLastPathComponent().path)
        sqlite3_bind_int64(stmt, 4, Int64(values.fileSize ?? 0))
        bind(stmt, 5, ext)
        sqlite3_bind_double(stmt, 6, mtime)
        bind(stmt, 7, isFolder ? "folder" : (values.isPackage == true ? "package" : "file"))
        guard sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_DONE else { return nil }
        let id = sqlite3_last_insert_rowid(db)
        // Index the folder path as words relative to home, so "school chemie" matches.
        let relDir = String(url.deletingLastPathComponent().path.dropFirst(root.count))
        run("INSERT INTO file_search (rowid, name, dir) VALUES (?,?,?);", id, [name, relDir])
        run("INSERT INTO name_trigram (rowid, name) VALUES (?,?);", id, [name])
        return id
    }

    private func remove(path: String, descendants: Bool) {
        var ids: [Int64] = []
        let sql = descendants
            ? "SELECT id FROM files WHERE path = ?1 OR (path >= ?1 || '/' AND path < ?1 || '0');"
            : "SELECT id FROM files WHERE path = ?1;"
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        if sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK {
            bind(stmt, 1, path)
            while sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_ROW { ids.append(sqlite3_column_int64(stmt, 0)) }
        }
        sqlite3_finalize(stmt)
        for id in ids {
            run("DELETE FROM file_search WHERE rowid = ?;", id, [])
            run("DELETE FROM name_trigram WHERE rowid = ?;", id, [])
            run("DELETE FROM files WHERE id = ?;", id, [])
        }
    }

    /// Re-reads one path after an FSEvent: insert/refresh if it exists, drop it (and
    /// anything below it) if it's gone. New folders are walked so moved-in trees appear.
    private func refresh(path: String, rescanChildren: Bool) {
        guard path.hasPrefix(root), !isInsideSkippedArea(path) else { return }
        refreshBlockedFolders()
        if isBlocked(path) { return }   // unreadable is not deleted
        if isExcluded(path) { return }
        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        guard let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: Set(Self.keys)) else {
            remove(path: path, descendants: true)
            return
        }
        if values.isSymbolicLink == true { return }
        let id = sync(url: url, values: values)
        guard values.isDirectory == true, values.isPackage != true, rescanChildren else { return }
        var seen = Set<Int64>()
        if let id { seen.insert(id) }
        guard let walker = FileManager.default.enumerator(
            at: url, includingPropertiesForKeys: Self.keys,
            options: [.skipsPackageDescendants, .skipsHiddenFiles], errorHandler: { _, _ in true })
        else { return }
        for case let child as URL in walker {
            guard let v = try? child.resourceValues(forKeys: Set(Self.keys)), v.isSymbolicLink != true else { continue }
            if isBlocked(child.path) || isExcluded(child.path) { walker.skipDescendants(); continue }
            if v.isDirectory == true, v.isPackage != true, Self.shouldSkip(directoryNamed: child.lastPathComponent) {
                walker.skipDescendants()
                continue
            }
            if let cid = sync(url: child, values: v) { seen.insert(cid) }
        }
        removeUnseen(under: path, keeping: seen)
    }

    private func isInsideSkippedArea(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        let rel = path.dropFirst(root.count).split(separator: "/")
        // Package contents (Foo.app/Contents/...) and skipped folders never enter the index.
        for (i, part) in rel.enumerated() {
            let s = String(part)
            if i < rel.count - 1, Self.shouldSkip(directoryNamed: s) { return true }
            if i < rel.count - 1, s.hasSuffix(".app") || s.hasSuffix(".bundle") || s.hasSuffix(".framework") { return true }
        }
        if let last = rel.last, last.hasPrefix(".") { return true }
        return false
    }

    // MARK: - FSEvents

    private func startStream(since eventID: FSEventStreamEventId) {
        var context = FSEventStreamContext(
            version: 0, info: Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque(),
            retain: nil, release: nil, copyDescription: nil)
        let flags = UInt32(kFSEventStreamCreateFlagFileEvents | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagUseCFTypes
                           | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagWatchRoot)
        let callback: FSEventStreamCallback = { _, info, count, paths, eventFlags, eventIDs in
            guard let info else { return }
            let indexer = Unmanaged<FileIndexer>.fromOpaque(info).takeUnretainedValue()
            let list = Unmanaged<CFArray>.fromOpaque(paths).takeUnretainedValue() as? [String] ?? []
            var events: [(String, FSEventStreamEventFlags)] = []
            for i in 0..<min(count, list.count) { events.append((list[i], eventFlags[i])) }
            let lastID = count > 0 ? eventIDs[count - 1] : 0
            indexer.queue.async { indexer.handle(events: events, lastID: lastID) }
        }
        guard let stream = FSEventStreamCreate(
            nil, callback, &context, [root] as CFArray, eventID, 1.0, flags)
        else { return }
        self.stream = stream
        // ~/Library is never indexed and is where most writes land (caches, app data, this index).
        FSEventStreamSetExclusionPaths(stream, [root + "/Library"] as CFArray)
        FSEventStreamSetDispatchQueue(stream, eventQueue)
        FSEventStreamStart(stream)
    }

    /// Offline harness entry (tools/file-indexer-test): feeds events as FSEvents would.
    func inject(events: [(String, FSEventStreamEventFlags)], lastID: FSEventStreamEventId = 0) {
        queue.async { [self] in handle(events: events, lastID: lastID) }
    }

    /// Waits for work queued so far (harness only).
    func drain() { queue.sync {} }

    /// Dropped events mean "something under here changed, rescan". Drops come in bursts
    /// (39 for one blocked second in a probe), so they collapse into one rescan that waits
    /// `rescanDelay` and runs at most every `rescanMinInterval`.
    private func scheduleRescan() {
        guard !rescanScheduled else { return }
        rescanScheduled = true
        let wait = max(Self.rescanDelay, Self.rescanMinInterval - Date().timeIntervalSince(lastRescan))
        queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + wait) { [self] in
            rescanScheduled = false
            lastRescan = Date()
            rescans += 1
            crawl()
            setMeta("last_event_id", String(pendingEventID))
            lastSavedEventID = pendingEventID
        }
    }

    private func handle(events: [(String, FSEventStreamEventFlags)], lastID: FSEventStreamEventId) {
        let mustRescanAll = events.contains { e in
            let f = Int(e.1)
            return f & (kFSEventStreamEventFlagRootChanged | kFSEventStreamEventFlagUserDropped
                        | kFSEventStreamEventFlagKernelDropped) != 0
                || (f & kFSEventStreamEventFlagMustScanSubDirs != 0 && e.0.hasSuffix(root))
        }
        if mustRescanAll {
            scheduleRescan()
        } else {
            exec("BEGIN")
            // Collapse repeats: one refresh per path per batch.
            var seen: [String: Bool] = [:]
            for (path, flags) in events {
                let f = Int(flags)
                let dirLike = f & (kFSEventStreamEventFlagItemIsDir | kFSEventStreamEventFlagMustScanSubDirs) != 0
                let structural = f & (kFSEventStreamEventFlagItemCreated | kFSEventStreamEventFlagItemRenamed
                                      | kFSEventStreamEventFlagMustScanSubDirs) != 0
                seen[path] = (seen[path] ?? false) || (dirLike && structural)
            }
            for (path, rescan) in seen { refresh(path: path, rescanChildren: rescan) }
            exec("COMMIT")
        }
        if lastID > 0 { pendingEventID = lastID }
        // Persist the journal position at most every ~200 events. Not while a rescan is
        // pending: quitting before it runs must replay the dropped span next launch.
        if pendingEventID > lastSavedEventID + 200, !rescanScheduled {
            setMeta("last_event_id", String(pendingEventID))
            lastSavedEventID = pendingEventID
        }
    }

    // MARK: - SQLite helpers

    private func exec(_ sql: String) { sqlite3_exec(db, sql, nil, nil, nil) }

    private func run(_ sql: String, _ id: Int64, _ texts: [String]) {
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(stmt) }
        guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return }
        sqlite3_bind_int64(stmt, 1, id)
        for (i, t) in texts.enumerated() { bind(stmt, Int32(i + 2), t) }
        sqlite3_step(stmt)
    }

    private func bind(_ stmt: OpaquePointer?, _ idx: Int32, _ value: String) {
        let transient = unsafeBitCast(OpaquePointer(bitPattern: -1), to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self)
        sqlite3_bind_text(stmt, idx, value, -1, transient)
    }

    private func metaValue(_ key: String) -> String? {
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(stmt) }
        guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = ?;", -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return nil }
        bind(stmt, 1, key)
        guard sqlite3_step(stmt) == SQLITE_ROW, let c = sqlite3_column_text(stmt, 0) else { return nil }
        return String(cString: c)
    }

    private func setMeta(_ key: String, _ value: String) {
        var stmt: OpaquePointer?
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(stmt) }
        guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?);", -1, &stmt, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return }
        bind(stmt, 1, key)
        bind(stmt, 2, value)
        sqlite3_step(stmt)
    }
}

/// The crawl's running count, observable (SwiftUI) on the main thread.
@MainActor @Observable final class FileIndexProgress {
    static let shared = FileIndexProgress()
    var count: Int?
    /// Protected folders the index can't read (no Full Disk Access yet).
    var blocked: [String] = []
}
//
//  Toasts.swift
//  The one transient-notice surface for the whole app. Anything ephemeral and
//  user-facing — backend errors, download/game/update notices — shows as a
//  liquid-glass blob that grows out of the page card's bottom-left border
//  (the same organic notch emergence as the URL bar at the top edge) and
//  dismisses itself. One blob at a time; the rest queue behind it, and the
//  menubar bell keeps the persistent ledger.
//

import SwiftUI

enum ErrorSeverity {
    case warning, error
}

@MainActor
@Observable
final class ToastCenter {
    static let shared = ToastCenter()

    struct Toast: Identifiable, Equatable {
        let id = UUID()
        let kind: AppNotification.Kind
        let title: String
        let message: String
        let actionLabel: String?
        let action: (() -> Void)?
        let duration: TimeInterval
        /// Set when the toast is on its way back into the border; the card
        /// animates progress→0, then the entry is removed.
        var leaving = false

        static func == (lhs: Toast, rhs: Toast) -> Bool {
            lhs.id == rhs.id && lhs.leaving == rhs.leaving
        }
    }

    private(set) var toasts: [Toast] = []

    /// Queue a toast. Errors linger longer; everything auto-dismisses. The
    /// visible card owns its own countdown (a queued toast's clock starts
    /// when it surfaces, not when it's posted).
    func show(_ kind: AppNotification.Kind, _ title: String, _ message: String = "",
              actionLabel: String? = nil, action: (() -> Void)? = nil) {
        let toast = Toast(kind: kind, title: title, message: message,
                          actionLabel: action == nil ? nil : (actionLabel ?? "Retry"),
                          action: action,
                          duration: kind == .error ? 8 : 4.5)
        toasts.append(toast)
        // Never queue more than four; the ledger keeps the rest.
        if toasts.count > 4 { toasts.removeFirst(toasts.count - 4) }
        DesignTokens.playHaptic(.alert)
    }

    /// Two-phase dismissal: melt back into the border, then drop the entry
    /// (which lets the next queued toast surface).
    func dismiss(_ id: UUID) {
        guard let i = toasts.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }), !toasts[i].leaving else { return }
        toasts[i].leaving = true
        Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.4))
            toasts.removeAll { $0.id == id }
        }
    }
}

/// Mounts on the page card. Shows the front of the queue as a blob growing
/// out of the card's bottom border.
struct ToastStack: View {
    @State private var center = ToastCenter.shared

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let toast = center.toasts.first {
                ToastCard(toast: toast)
                    .id(toast.id)
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Glued to BOTH the left and bottom borders of the page card: flat along
/// each, a flare melting up the left border, a flare melting along the bottom
/// border on the right, one rounded corner at the top-right, and a rounded
/// cut at the bottom-left that follows the card's own corner curve. Progress
/// grows it out of the corner (unclamped above 1 for springy overshoot).
struct CornerNotchShape: Shape {
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 15
    var flare: CGFloat = 14
    /// Matches the page card's corner radius so the toast silhouette follows
    /// the card silhouette at the corner.
    var cornerCut: CGFloat = 10
    var progress: CGFloat = 1
    var animatableData: CGFloat {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        let pr = max(0, progress)
        let w = rect.width * min(pr, 2)
        let h = rect.height * min(pr, 2)
        guard w > 0.5, h > 0.5 else { return Path() }
        let f = min(flare, w / 4, h / 4)
        let r = min(cornerRadius, h / 2, w / 2)
        let cc = min(cornerCut, h / 2, w / 2)
