        let top = rect.height - h        // hugs the bottom-left corner
        // Bleed beneath the card rim so its antialiased left/bottom strokes do
        // not show through as a hairline where the toast becomes the border.
        let seam: CGFloat = 1.25
        let left = -seam
        let bottom = rect.height + seam
        var p = Path()
        // Melt down from the left border…
        p.move(to: CGPoint(x: left, y: top))
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: f, y: top + f), control: CGPoint(x: left, y: top + f))
        p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: w - f - r, y: top + f))
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: w - f, y: top + f + r), control: CGPoint(x: w - f, y: top + f))
        p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: w - f, y: bottom - f))
        // …and melt into the bottom border, everything inside the rect.
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: w, y: bottom), control: CGPoint(x: w - f, y: bottom))
        p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: cc, y: bottom))
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: left, y: bottom - cc), control: CGPoint(x: left, y: bottom))
        p.closeSubpath()
        return p
    }
}

private struct ToastCard: View {
    let toast: ToastCenter.Toast
    @State private var emerged = false
    @State private var hovering = false

    private var shown: Bool { emerged && !toast.leaving }
    private var progress: CGFloat { shown ? 1 : 0 }

    var body: some View {
        // All-vector blob: fill, outline and content share the shape layer so
        // the growth stays flush with both borders through the animation.
        // No colored border — the card hairline tone runs the outline and the
        // icon carries the tint.
        content
            .opacity(shown ? 1 : 0)
            .animation(shown ? .easeOut(duration: 0.16).delay(0.10)
                             : .easeIn(duration: 0.08), value: shown)
            .padding(.leading, 16)
            .padding(.trailing, 28)
            .padding(.top, 20)
            .padding(.bottom, 12)
            .frame(minWidth: 240, maxWidth: 360, alignment: .leading)
            .background {
                ChromeGlassSurface(kind: .cornerToast)
                    .scaleEffect(x: shown ? 1 : 0.01,
                                 y: shown ? 1 : 0.01,
                                 anchor: .bottomLeading)
                    .opacity(shown ? 1 : 0)
            }
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.42, dampingFraction: 0.58), value: progress)
            .allowsHitTesting(shown)
            .onHover { hovering = $0 }
            .onAppear {
                emerged = true
                Task {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(toast.duration))
                    ToastCenter.shared.dismiss(toast.id)
                }
            }
    }

    private var content: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: toast.kind.symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(tint)
                .frame(width: 24, height: 24)
                .background(Circle().fill(tint.opacity(0.16)))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(toast.title)
                    .font(.pp(12.5, .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .lineLimit(2)
                if !toast.message.isEmpty {
                    Text(toast.message)
                        .font(.pp(11))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .lineLimit(3)
                        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                }
                if let label = toast.actionLabel, let action = toast.action {
                    Button(label) {
                        action()
                        ToastCenter.shared.dismiss(toast.id)
                    }
                    .font(.pp(11, .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(tint)
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .padding(.top, 3)
                }
            }

            if hovering {
                Button { ToastCenter.shared.dismiss(toast.id) } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                        .font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
    }

    private var tint: Color { toast.kind.tint }
}

extension AppNotification.Kind {
    var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .download: "arrow.down.circle.fill"
        case .update: "sparkles"
        case .complete: "checkmark.circle.fill"
        case .info: "info.circle.fill"
        case .error: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        }
    }

    var tint: Color {
        switch self {
        case .download: .blue
        case .update: .orange
        case .complete: .green
        case .info: .secondary
        case .error: .red
        }
    }
}
//
//  FaviconStore.swift
//  Real favicons + brand-accurate accent colors.
//
//  For each host we fetch the favicon (from the page's <link>, then the site's
//  /favicon.ico), cache the image, and
//  extract its dominant *vibrant* color. That color — not a random hash — is the
//  card accent, so YouTube reads red, Spotify green, etc. Everything is observed,
//  so cards repaint the moment an icon resolves.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

@MainActor
@Observable
final class FaviconStore {
    struct Entry: Equatable {
        var image: NSImage?
        var accent: Color?
    }

    private var entries: [String: Entry] = [:]
    private var inFlight: Set<String> = []
    /// The source list that produced a miss. A page can finish after the first
    /// fallback attempt, so a new declared icon must be allowed to retry the
    /// host instead of leaving its monogram in place for the whole app run.
    private var failedCandidateSignatures: [String: String] = [:]

    func entry(_ host: String?) -> Entry? {
        host.flatMap { entries[$0] }
    }

    /// The card accent for a tab: favicon dominant color → theme-color → a
    /// stable host hue as a last resort so nothing is ever colorless. All
    /// branches route through `calmedAccent` so no site can go neon.
    func accent(for tab: Tab) -> Color {
        if let accent = entries[tab.host ?? ""]?.accent { return accent.calmedAccent }
        if let hex = tab.themeColor, let color = Color(hexString: hex) { return color.calmedAccent }
        let key = tab.host ?? tab.url
        return Color(hue: BentoPalette.hue(for: key), saturation: 0.42, brightness: 0.78)
    }

    /// Kick off a fetch for a host if we haven't already.
    func ensure(host: String?, faviconURL: String?) {
        guard let host, !host.isEmpty, !inFlight.contains(host) else { return }
        // Essentials aren't on the network: their "host" is a catalog slug
        // (option://notes → "notes"). Synthesize the icon locally instead of
        // hitting favicon endpoints with a bare word.
        if let essential = Essential.find(slug: host) {
            // Already made: writing it again would redraw every tab card.
            guard entries[host] == nil else { return }
            entries[host] = Entry(
                image: Self.essentialIcon(essential),
                accent: Color(hexString: essential.accentHex)
            )
            return
        }
        let urls = Self.candidates(host: host, explicit: faviconURL)
        let signature = urls.map(\.absoluteString).joined(separator: "\n")

        // A successfully decoded icon is final for this process. A failed
        // fallback is not: retry when WebKit later reports a page-declared
        // icon (often a CDN URL, as used by ChatGPT and many other sites).
        if entries[host]?.image != nil || failedCandidateSignatures[host] == signature { return }

        inFlight.insert(host)
        Task { [weak self] in await self?.load(host: host, urls: urls) }
    }

    /// Tinted heroicon on a rounded accent field, sized like a fetched favicon.
    private static func essentialIcon(_ essential: Essential) -> NSImage? {
        guard let glyph = NSImage(named: "hero-\(essential.icon)") else { return nil }
        let side: CGFloat = 64
        let image = NSImage(size: NSSize(width: side, height: side))
        image.lockFocus()
        defer { image.unlockFocus() }

        let accent = Color(hexString: essential.accentHex).map(NSColor.init) ?? .systemPurple
        let field = NSBezierPath(
            roundedRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: side, height: side),
            xRadius: side * 0.22, yRadius: side * 0.22
        )
        accent.withAlphaComponent(0.28).setFill()
        field.fill()

        let inset = side * 0.24
        let glyphRect = NSRect(x: inset, y: inset, width: side - 2 * inset, height: side - 2 * inset)
        tint(glyph, with: accent).draw(
            in: glyphRect, from: .zero, operation: .sourceOver, fraction: 1
        )
        return image
    }

    /// Heroicons ship as template images; recolor by compositing the accent
    /// atop the glyph's alpha.
    private static func tint(_ template: NSImage, with color: NSColor) -> NSImage {
        let out = NSImage(size: template.size)
        out.lockFocus()
        let rect = NSRect(origin: .zero, size: template.size)
        template.draw(in: rect)
        color.set()
        rect.fill(using: .sourceAtop)
        out.unlockFocus()
        return out
    }

    private static func candidates(host: String, explicit: String?) -> [URL] {
        var out: [URL] = []

        func append(_ url: URL?) {
            guard let url,
                  let scheme = url.scheme?.lowercased(),
                  (scheme == "https" || scheme == "http"),
                  url.host != nil,
                  url.user == nil,
                  url.password == nil,
                  !out.contains(url)
            else { return }
            out.append(url)
        }

        // Modern sites commonly keep icons on a static-asset CDN. This URL is
        // collected from the currently loaded document, not guessed from page
        // title/host, so accepting a validated HTTP(S) icon here is both more
        // accurate and fixes CDN-backed sites such as ChatGPT.
        if let explicit { append(URL(string: explicit)) }

        // The root ICO remains the broadest fallback. Touch icons cover sites
        // that deliberately omit it, and the www/non-www counterpart handles
        // hosts whose static assets only live on one canonical origin.
        let hosts = host.hasPrefix("www.")
            ? [host, String(host.dropFirst("www.".count))]
            : [host, "www.\(host)"]
        for candidateHost in hosts {
            append(URL(string: "https://\(candidateHost)/favicon.ico"))
            append(URL(string: "https://\(candidateHost)/apple-touch-icon.png"))
        }
        return out
    }

    private func load(host: String, urls: [URL]) async {
        // Fetch, decode, and color-extract off the main actor; only the final
        // entries-write (which repaints cards) happens back here.
        if let (image, accent) = await Self.fetch(urls: urls) {
            entries[host] = Entry(image: image, accent: accent)
            failedCandidateSignatures.removeValue(forKey: host)
        } else {
            entries[host] = Entry(image: nil, accent: nil) // negative cache
            failedCandidateSignatures[host] = urls.map(\.absoluteString).joined(separator: "\n")
        }
        inFlight.remove(host)
    }

    nonisolated private static func fetch(urls: [URL]) async -> (NSImage, Color?)? {
        for url in urls {
            guard let (data, _) = try? await URLSession.shared.data(from: url),
                  let image = NSImage(data: data), image.size.width > 1
            else { continue }
            return (image, dominantColor(image))
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Dominant vibrant color

    nonisolated static func dominantColor(_ image: NSImage) -> Color? {
        guard let cg = image.cgImage(forProposedRect: nil, context: nil, hints: nil) else { return nil }
        let side = 24
        var px = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: side * side * 4)
        guard let ctx = CGContext(
            data: &px, width: side, height: side, bitsPerComponent: 8, bytesPerRow: side * 4,
            space: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),
            bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue
        ) else { return nil }
        ctx.draw(cg, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: side, height: side))

        // Bucket vibrant pixels by hue, weight by saturation², take the heaviest.
        let buckets = 18
        var weight = [Double](repeating: 0, count: buckets)
        var sumR = [Double](repeating: 0, count: buckets)
        var sumG = [Double](repeating: 0, count: buckets)
        var sumB = [Double](repeating: 0, count: buckets)

        var i = 0
        while i < px.count {
            let a = Double(px[i + 3]) / 255
            if a > 0.5 {
                let r = Double(px[i]) / 255, g = Double(px[i + 1]) / 255, b = Double(px[i + 2]) / 255
                let (h, s, v) = rgbToHSB(r, g, b)
                if s > 0.18, v > 0.12, v < 0.98 {
                    let bi = min(buckets - 1, Int(h * Double(buckets)))
                    let w = s * s
                    weight[bi] += w
                    sumR[bi] += r * w; sumG[bi] += g * w; sumB[bi] += b * w
                }
            }
            i += 4
        }

        guard let best = weight.indices.max(by: { weight[$0] < weight[$1] }),
              weight[best] > 0 else { return nil }
        let w = weight[best]
        return Color(.sRGB, red: sumR[best] / w, green: sumG[best] / w, blue: sumB[best] / w, opacity: 1)
    }

    nonisolated static func rgbToHSB(_ r: Double, _ g: Double, _ b: Double) -> (Double, Double, Double) {
        let mx = max(r, g, b), mn = min(r, g, b), d = mx - mn
        var h = 0.0
        if d != 0 {
            if mx == r { h = ((g - b) / d).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 6) }
            else if mx == g { h = (b - r) / d + 2 }
            else { h = (r - g) / d + 4 }
            h /= 6
            if h < 0 { h += 1 }
        }
        return (h, mx == 0 ? 0 : d / mx, mx)
    }
}

/// A favicon image with a monogram fallback while (or if) the icon never loads.
struct FaviconView: View {
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    let host: String?
    let accent: Color
    var size: CGFloat = 18

    var body: some View {
        if let image = favicons.entry(host)?.image {
            Image(nsImage: image)
                .resizable()
                .interpolation(.high)
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size * 0.22, style: .continuous))
        } else {
            Text(monogram(forHost: host))
                .font(.pp(size * 0.5, .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
                .background(Circle().fill(accent.opacity(0.6)))
        }
    }
}

/// Wrapping row layout for favicon strips (no clipping, no jitter).
struct FlowLayout: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 5

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let maxWidth = proposal.width ?? .infinity
        var x: CGFloat = 0, y: CGFloat = 0, rowHeight: CGFloat = 0
        for view in subviews {
            let size = view.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            if x + size.width > maxWidth, x > 0 {
                x = 0; y += rowHeight + spacing; rowHeight = 0
            }
            x += size.width + spacing
            rowHeight = max(rowHeight, size.height)
        }
        return CGSize(width: maxWidth.isFinite ? maxWidth : x, height: y + rowHeight)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        var x: CGFloat = 0, y: CGFloat = 0, rowHeight: CGFloat = 0
        for view in subviews {
            let size = view.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            if x + size.width > bounds.width, x > 0 {
                x = 0; y += rowHeight + spacing; rowHeight = 0
            }
            view.place(at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + x, y: bounds.minY + y), proposal: ProposedViewSize(size))
            x += size.width + spacing
            rowHeight = max(rowHeight, size.height)
        }
    }
}
//
//  GooEngine.swift
//  Procedural liquid UI: bodies + morphological closing → a SwiftUI Shape.
//
//  Describe a surface as bodies (rounded boxes, circles) and a fillet radius; the
//  engine takes their union and "closes" it — rolls a disc of that radius around the
//  outside — so every concave corner and narrow gap fills with a true circular
//  fillet, while straight edges and convex corners stay exactly as drawn. Necks,
//  indents and the moment a strand snaps fall out of the geometry. Animate by moving
//  bodies from an Animatable value; the shape is rebuilt per frame.
//

import SwiftUI

struct GooBody: Equatable {
    var center: CGPoint
    var halfSize: CGSize
    var radiusTop: CGFloat
    var radiusBottom: CGFloat
    /// Apple's continuous ("squircle") corners, as SwiftUI's `.continuous` style draws them.
    var continuous = false

    static func box(_ rect: CGRect, radius: CGFloat) -> GooBody { box(rect, top: radius, bottom: radius) }
    static func box(_ rect: CGRect, top: CGFloat, bottom: CGFloat) -> GooBody {
        let cap = min(rect.width / 2, rect.height / 2)
        return GooBody(center: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.midY),
                       halfSize: CGSize(width: rect.width / 2, height: rect.height / 2),
                       radiusTop: max(0, min(top, cap)), radiusBottom: max(0, min(bottom, cap)))
    }
    static func continuousBox(_ rect: CGRect, radius: CGFloat) -> GooBody {
        var b = box(rect, radius: radius); b.continuous = true; return b
    }
    static func circle(_ center: CGPoint, radius: CGFloat) -> GooBody {
        GooBody(center: center, halfSize: CGSize(width: radius, height: radius), radiusTop: radius, radiusBottom: radius)
    }
}

enum Goo {
    /// Exact signed distance to a box with separate top/bottom corner radii (y down).
    static func roundBox(_ p: CGPoint, _ b: GooBody) -> CGFloat {
        if b.continuous { return continuousBox(p, b) }
        let r = p.y < b.center.y ? b.radiusTop : b.radiusBottom
        let qx = abs(p.x - b.center.x) - b.halfSize.width + r
        let qy = abs(p.y - b.center.y) - b.halfSize.height + r
        return hypot(max(qx, 0), max(qy, 0)) + min(max(qx, qy), 0) - r
    }
    /// SwiftUI's continuous corner, measured: it leaves the edge 1.528·r from the corner
    /// and follows a superellipse of exponent ~3.3 (matches to <0.1pt at r = 32).
    static func continuousBox(_ p: CGPoint, _ b: GooBody) -> CGFloat {
        let r = p.y < b.center.y ? b.radiusTop : b.radiusBottom
        let l = min(r * 1.528, b.halfSize.width, b.halfSize.height)
        guard l > 0.01 else { return max(abs(p.x - b.center.x) - b.halfSize.width, abs(p.y - b.center.y) - b.halfSize.height) }
        let qx = abs(p.x - b.center.x) - b.halfSize.width + l
        let qy = abs(p.y - b.center.y) - b.halfSize.height + l
        if qx > 0, qy > 0 {
            let n: CGFloat = 3.3
            return l * pow(pow(qx / l, n) + pow(qy / l, n), 1 / n) - l
        }
        return max(qx, qy) - l
    }
    /// Hard union: exact distance outside the bodies.
    static func union(_ p: CGPoint, _ bodies: [GooBody]) -> CGFloat {
        var d: CGFloat = 1e6
        for b in bodies { d = min(d, roundBox(p, b)) }
        return d
    }
}

/// The closed union of the bodies as a Shape: marching squares over the closing
/// field, smoothed with midpoint quads.
struct GooShape: Shape {
    var bodies: [GooBody]
    /// Fillet radius of the closing (the disc rolled around the outside).
    var blend: CGFloat
    var resolution: CGFloat = 3

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        let cell = resolution, rho = max(0, blend)
        // Margin in whole cells, so the grid stays aligned to `rect` whatever the fillet.
        let margin = ((rho + 3 * cell) / cell).rounded(.up) * cell
        let region = rect.insetBy(dx: -margin, dy: -margin)
        let nx = Int(ceil(region.width / cell)), ny = Int(ceil(region.height / cell))
        guard nx > 1, ny > 1, nx * ny < 400_000 else { return Path(rect) }
        let stride = nx + 1
        func corner(_ i: Int, _ j: Int) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: region.minX + CGFloat(i) * cell, y: region.minY + CGFloat(j) * cell) }

        // 1. Union distance at grid corners (outside the region counts as far away).
        var u = [CGFloat](repeating: 1e6, count: stride * (ny + 1))
        for j in 1..<ny { for i in 1..<nx { u[j * stride + i] = Goo.union(corner(i, j), bodies) } }

        // 2. Closing field f = rho - (signed distance to the outside of the dilation
        //    {u <= rho}). Outside the dilation that is just u; deep inside it is < u.
        //    In the band near the shape, measure to the dilation's boundary points.
        var f = u
        if rho > 0.01 {
            var pts: [CGPoint] = []
            func crossing(_ a: Int, _ b: Int, _ pa: CGPoint, _ pb: CGPoint) {
                let va = u[a] - rho, vb = u[b] - rho
                guard (va <= 0) != (vb <= 0) else { return }
                let t = va / (va - vb)
                pts.append(CGPoint(x: pa.x + (pb.x - pa.x) * t, y: pa.y + (pb.y - pa.y) * t))
            }
            for j in 0...ny { for i in 0...nx {
                let k = j * stride + i
                if i < nx { crossing(k, k + 1, corner(i, j), corner(i + 1, j)) }
                if j < ny { crossing(k, k + stride, corner(i, j), corner(i, j + 1)) }
            }}
            // Bucket the boundary points so each lookup only scans its neighbourhood.
            let reach = rho + 3 * cell, bs = reach
            let bx = Int(ceil(region.width / bs)) + 1, by = Int(ceil(region.height / bs)) + 1
            var buckets = [[CGPoint]](repeating: [], count: bx * by)
            for q in pts {
                let ix = min(bx - 1, max(0, Int((q.x - region.minX) / bs)))
                let iy = min(by - 1, max(0, Int((q.y - region.minY) / bs)))
                buckets[iy * bx + ix].append(q)
            }
            for j in 1..<ny { for i in 1..<nx {
                let k = j * stride + i, uk = u[k]
                guard uk <= rho, uk > -2 * cell else { continue }   // band only
                let p = corner(i, j)
                let ix = Int((p.x - region.minX) / bs), iy = Int((p.y - region.minY) / bs)
                var best = reach * reach
                for yy in max(0, iy - 1)...min(by - 1, iy + 1) { for xx in max(0, ix - 1)...min(bx - 1, ix + 1) {
                    for q in buckets[yy * bx + xx] {
                        let dx = q.x - p.x, dy = q.y - p.y
                        best = min(best, dx * dx + dy * dy)
                    }
                }}
                f[k] = min(rho - sqrt(best), uk > 0 ? uk : 0)
            }}
        }
        func val(_ i: Int, _ j: Int) -> CGFloat { f[j * stride + i] }

        // 3. Marching squares on f. Edge ids: horizontal (i,j)→(i+1,j) = 2k, vertical = 2k+1.
        func hEdge(_ i: Int, _ j: Int) -> Int { (j * stride + i) * 2 }
        func vEdge(_ i: Int, _ j: Int) -> Int { (j * stride + i) * 2 + 1 }
        func point(_ e: Int) -> CGPoint {
            let k = e / 2, i = k % stride, j = k / stride
            let (a, b) = e % 2 == 0 ? ((i, j), (i + 1, j)) : ((i, j), (i, j + 1))
            let va = val(a.0, a.1), vb = val(b.0, b.1)
            let t = va == vb ? 0.5 : min(1, max(0, va / (va - vb)))
            let pa = corner(a.0, a.1), pb = corner(b.0, b.1)
            return CGPoint(x: pa.x + (pb.x - pa.x) * t, y: pa.y + (pb.y - pa.y) * t)
        }
        var links: [Int: [Int]] = [:]
        func link(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) { links[a, default: []].append(b); links[b, default: []].append(a) }
        for j in 0..<ny { for i in 0..<nx {
            let tl = val(i, j) < 0, tr = val(i + 1, j) < 0, br = val(i + 1, j + 1) < 0, bl = val(i, j + 1) < 0
            let top = hEdge(i, j), bottom = hEdge(i, j + 1), left = vEdge(i, j), right = vEdge(i + 1, j)
            switch (tl ? 8 : 0) | (tr ? 4 : 0) | (br ? 2 : 0) | (bl ? 1 : 0) {
            case 1, 14: link(left, bottom)
            case 2, 13: link(bottom, right)
            case 3, 12: link(left, right)
            case 4, 11: link(top, right)
            case 6, 9: link(top, bottom)
            case 7, 8: link(left, top)
            case 5, 10:   // saddle: decide by the cell average
                let center = (val(i, j) + val(i + 1, j) + val(i + 1, j + 1) + val(i, j + 1)) < 0
                if (center && tl) || (!center && !tl) { link(left, top); link(bottom, right) }
                else { link(left, bottom); link(top, right) }
            default: break
            }
        }}
        // 4. Walk the links into closed loops, smoothing with midpoint quad curves.
        var path = Path()
        var visited = Set<Int>()
        for startEdge in links.keys where !visited.contains(startEdge) {
            var loop: [CGPoint] = []
            var previous = -1, current = startEdge
            while !visited.contains(current) {
                visited.insert(current)
                loop.append(point(current))
                guard let next = links[current]?.first(where: { $0 != previous && !visited.contains($0) })
                        ?? links[current]?.first(where: { $0 != previous }) else { break }
                previous = current; current = next
            }
            guard loop.count > 2 else { continue }
            func mid(_ a: CGPoint, _ b: CGPoint) -> CGPoint { CGPoint(x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2) }
            path.move(to: mid(loop[loop.count - 1], loop[0]))
            for k in 0..<loop.count {
                path.addQuadCurve(to: mid(loop[k], loop[(k + 1) % loop.count]), control: loop[k])
            }
            path.closeSubpath()
        }
        return path
    }
}

/// A goo surface drawn like Nardo's sheets: Liquid Glass in the goo's shape
/// and a hairline outline on its edge. Bodies are in this view's coordinates.
struct GooSurface: View {
    var bodies: [GooBody]
    var blend: CGFloat
    var outline: Color = .white.opacity(0.24)
    var lineWidth: CGFloat = 0.75
    var tint: Color? = nil

    var body: some View {
        let shape = GooShape(bodies: bodies, blend: blend)
        ZStack {
            Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape)
            if let tint { shape.fill(tint).padding(1) }
            shape.stroke(outline, lineWidth: lineWidth)
        }
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}

/// Tearing a card out of a sheet, with the outline held to the layout's rules: the
/// card part always wraps its cards at `gap` with 32pt continuous corners, the base
/// part always wraps the input bar at `rimInset` with 32pt continuous corners (26+6),
/// and only the neck between them is goo. Corners never animate; the neck opens from
/// the sides, thins to a strand, pinches, and each half's nub springs back.
enum GooTear {
    static func smoothstep(_ a: CGFloat, _ b: CGFloat, _ x: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let t = min(1, max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
    }
    static let corner: CGFloat = 32
    static let fillet: CGFloat = 6
    static let maxLift: CGFloat = 32
    static let strand: CGFloat = 8
    /// The rim sits this far above the bar; at rest the card part overlaps it by this much.
    static let rimOverlap: CGFloat = 6

    static func lift(pull: CGFloat, threshold: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { maxLift * min(1, max(0, pull / threshold)) }

    /// Neck bodies in sheet coordinates (y down). `cardBottom` is the card part's
    /// bottom edge, `baseTop` the base part's top edge (they overlap at rest).
    /// `nub` (0...1) replaces the neck after the tear: the base's half-strand, retracting.
    static func neckBodies(width w: CGFloat, centerX cx: CGFloat, cardBottom: CGFloat, baseTop: CGFloat, lift: CGFloat, nub: CGFloat?) -> [GooBody] {
        let r = corner
        let base = GooBody.continuousBox(CGRect(x: 0, y: baseTop, width: w, height: 4 * r), radius: r)
        if let nub {
            // The base's half of the parted strand, springing back in (nub 1 → 0).
            let h = max(0, nub) * nubLength
            guard h > 0.25 else { return [base] }
            return [base, .box(CGRect(x: cx - strand / 2, y: baseTop + 1 - h, width: strand, height: h), top: strand / 2, bottom: 0)]
        }
        let card = GooBody.continuousBox(CGRect(x: 0, y: cardBottom - 4 * r, width: w, height: 4 * r), radius: r)
        let f = min(1, lift / maxLift)
        // The band fills between the parts: full width at rest (straight sides), narrowing
        // to a strand whose halves then pull back into their own sides — it pinches and parts.
        // Both sides close in on the grab point at the same rate, so they meet under it.
        let k = 1 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.78, f)
        let bandLeft = cx - strand / 2 - (cx - strand / 2) * k
        let bandRight = cx + strand / 2 + (w - cx - strand / 2) * k
        let tipHalf = (bandRight - bandLeft) / 2
        let retract = smoothstep(0.78, 1, f)
        let top = cardBottom - 1.6 * r, bottom = baseTop + 1.6 * r, mid = (cardBottom + baseTop) / 2
        let upperEnd = mid + strand / 2 + 1 + (cardBottom - strand - (mid + strand / 2 + 1)) * retract
        let lowerStart = mid - strand / 2 - 1 + (baseTop + strand - (mid - strand / 2 - 1)) * retract
        let tip = min(tipHalf, strand / 2)
        var out = [card, base]
        if upperEnd - top > 0.25 { out.append(.box(CGRect(x: bandLeft, y: top, width: bandRight - bandLeft, height: upperEnd - top), top: 0, bottom: tip)) }
        if bottom - lowerStart > 0.25 { out.append(.box(CGRect(x: bandLeft, y: lowerStart, width: bandRight - bandLeft, height: bottom - lowerStart), top: tip, bottom: 0)) }
        return out
    }
    /// Fillet for a given gap between the parts. Two fillets take 70% of the gap: enough
    /// margin that grid sampling can't flip the slot between open and refilled frame to
    /// frame (0.48 left 4% and the neck flickered; Tests/GooMonotonic checks this).
    static func fillet(gap: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { min(fillet, max(3, gap * 0.35)) }

    /// The goo neck as drawn: bodies closed with the gap's fillet, inside the band
    /// between the two parts. Shared by the shape and the parted test so they agree exactly.
    static func neckPath(width w: CGFloat, centerX: CGFloat, cardBottom: CGFloat, baseTop: CGFloat, lift: CGFloat, nub: CGFloat?) -> (path: Path, zone: CGRect) {
        let bodies = neckBodies(width: w, centerX: centerX, cardBottom: cardBottom, baseTop: baseTop, lift: lift, nub: nub)
        // The sampling grid is pinned to the sheet (zone origin snapped to the grid), so
        // edges that aren't moving can't shimmer as the zone follows the pull.
        let res: CGFloat = 1.5
        let zoneTop = ((nub != nil ? baseTop - maxLift : cardBottom - 1.6 * corner) / res).rounded(.down) * res
        let zone = CGRect(x: 0, y: zoneTop, width: w, height: baseTop + 1.6 * corner - zoneTop)
        let blend = nub != nil ? fillet : fillet(gap: baseTop - cardBottom)
        return (GooShape(bodies: bodies, blend: blend, resolution: res).path(in: zone), zone)
    }

    /// Whether the drawn neck is two pieces at this lift: a clear break down the middle
    /// of the strand. The tear fires on the first frame this is true.
    static func isParted(width w: CGFloat, centerX: CGFloat, cardBottom: CGFloat, baseTop: CGFloat, lift: CGFloat) -> Bool {
        isParted(neck: neckPath(width: w, centerX: centerX, cardBottom: cardBottom, baseTop: baseTop, lift: lift, nub: nil).path,
                 centerX: centerX, cardBottom: cardBottom, baseTop: baseTop)
    }
    static func isParted(neck path: Path, centerX: CGFloat, cardBottom: CGFloat, baseTop: CGFloat) -> Bool {
        let mid = (cardBottom + baseTop) / 2
        return stride(from: -1.0, through: 1.0, by: 0.5).allSatisfy { dy in
            stride(from: -1.0, through: 1.0, by: 0.5).allSatisfy { dx in !path.contains(CGPoint(x: centerX + dx, y: mid + dy)) } }
    }

    /// Roughly where the strand parts (for sizing the nub and skipping the parted test
    /// early in the pull); the exact moment comes from `isParted`.
    static let snapLift: CGFloat = {
        var lift = maxLift * 0.6
        while lift < maxLift, !isParted(width: 600, centerX: 300, cardBottom: 100, baseTop: 100 + lift - rimOverlap, lift: lift) { lift += 0.25 }
        return lift
    }()
    /// Keep the grab point clear of the corners.
    static func clampGrab(_ x: CGFloat, width w: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let m = corner * 1.6 + grabRadius
        return w > 2 * m ? min(max(x, m), w - m) : w / 2
    }
    /// The bulge under the cursor on the top edge: a rounded bump of this radius that
    /// rises `grabRise` on hover and stretches with the pull.
    static let grabRadius: CGFloat = 16
    static let grabRise: CGFloat = 4
    static func grabHeight(bulge: CGFloat, lift: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { grabRise * bulge + min(lift * 0.22, 6) }

    /// How far the base's nub sticks out right after the snap.
    static var nubLength: CGFloat { (snapLift - rimOverlap) / 2 + 2 }
}

/// The tear's outline: exact continuous-cornered card and base parts, merged with the
/// goo neck (computed only in the band between them).
struct GooTearShape: Shape {
    var lift: CGFloat
    var nub: CGFloat
    var grabX: CGFloat
    var bulge: CGFloat
    var torn: Bool
    var cardBottom: CGFloat
    var rimInset: CGFloat
    var baseBottomInset: CGFloat   // distance from the sheet's bottom to the bar's top
    /// Called (async, main) when a frame being drawn has the neck in two pieces — so the
    /// tear fires on exactly the frame it visibly parts, however the lift is smoothed.
    var onParted: (() -> Void)? = nil
    var animatableData: AnimatablePair<AnimatablePair<CGFloat, CGFloat>, AnimatablePair<CGFloat, CGFloat>> {
        get { AnimatablePair(AnimatablePair(lift, nub), AnimatablePair(grabX, bulge)) }
        set { lift = newValue.first.first; nub = newValue.first.second; grabX = newValue.second.first; bulge = newValue.second.second }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        let w = rect.width, r = GooTear.corner
        let baseTop = rect.height - baseBottomInset - rimInset
        // At rest (no pull, no bulge, not torn) the sheet is one rounded rectangle, top to
        // past the bottom edge. Built from its card and base pieces instead, a sheet only a
        // few points tall (rising, or a short card) got a thin card slab whose 32pt corners
        // couldn't round, and the corners went square while typing.
        if !torn, lift < 0.5, bulge < 0.01 {
            return RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: r, style: .continuous)
                .path(in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: w, height: rect.height + r))
        }
        let baseRect = CGRect(x: 0, y: baseTop, width: w, height: rect.height - baseTop + r)
        var shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: r, style: .continuous).path(in: baseRect)
        let cx = GooTear.clampGrab(grabX, width: w)
        if !torn {
            let cardRect = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: w, height: cardBottom)
            shape = shape.union(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: r, style: .continuous).path(in: cardRect))
            // The grab bulge on the top edge, filleted into it.
            let h = GooTear.grabHeight(bulge: bulge, lift: lift)
            if h > 0.3 {
                let gr = GooTear.grabRadius
                let bodies = [GooBody.continuousBox(cardRect, radius: r), .circle(CGPoint(x: cx, y: gr - h), radius: gr)]
                let topZone = CGRect(x: cx - 4 * gr, y: -h - 6, width: 8 * gr, height: h + 6 + 2 * gr)
                let bump = GooShape(bodies: bodies, blend: 6, resolution: 1).path(in: topZone)
                shape = shape.union(bump.intersection(Path(topZone)))
            }
        }
        let (neck, zone) = GooTear.neckPath(width: w, centerX: cx, cardBottom: cardBottom, baseTop: baseTop, lift: lift, nub: torn ? nub : nil)
        if !torn, let onParted, lift > GooTear.snapLift - 3,
           GooTear.isParted(neck: neck, centerX: cx, cardBottom: cardBottom, baseTop: baseTop) {
            DispatchQueue.main.async(execute: onParted)
        }
        return shape.union(neck.intersection(Path(zone)))
    }
}

/// The Spotlight sheet's background as a tear-able goo surface.
struct GooTearBackground: View {
    var pull: CGFloat
    var threshold: CGFloat
    var cardBottom: CGFloat
    var rimInset: CGFloat
    var baseBottomInset: CGFloat
    var nub: CGFloat
    var grabX: CGFloat
    var bulge: CGFloat
    var torn: Bool
    var tint: Color?
    var onParted: (() -> Void)? = nil

    var body: some View {
        let shape = GooTearShape(lift: GooTear.lift(pull: pull, threshold: threshold), nub: nub, grabX: grabX, bulge: bulge, torn: torn,
                                 cardBottom: cardBottom, rimInset: rimInset, baseBottomInset: baseBottomInset,
                                 onParted: onParted)
        ZStack {
            Color.white.opacity(0.001).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape)
            if let tint { shape.fill(tint).padding(1) }
            shape.stroke(.white.opacity(0.24), lineWidth: 0.75)
        }
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}

/// A window's outline with the torn strand's nub hanging from its bottom edge at `x`
/// (window coordinates, y down): exact 32pt continuous corners, goo only at the nub.
struct GooEdgeNubShape: InsettableShape {
    var nub: CGFloat   // 1 → 0 as it springs home
    var x: CGFloat
    var inset: CGFloat = 0

    func inset(by amount: CGFloat) -> GooEdgeNubShape { var s = self; s.inset += amount; return s }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        let r = rect.insetBy(dx: inset, dy: inset), radius = max(0, GooTear.corner - inset)
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: radius, style: .continuous).path(in: r)
        let h = max(0, nub) * GooTear.nubLength
        guard h > 0.25 else { return shape }
        let s = GooTear.strand, cx = GooTear.clampGrab(x, width: rect.width)
        let bodies = [GooBody.continuousBox(r, radius: radius),
                      .box(CGRect(x: cx - s / 2, y: r.maxY - 1, width: s, height: h + 1), top: 0, bottom: s / 2)]
        let zone = CGRect(x: (cx - 48).rounded(.down), y: (r.maxY - 2 * GooTear.corner).rounded(.down),
                          width: 96, height: 2 * GooTear.corner + h + 12)
        let bump = GooShape(bodies: bodies, blend: GooTear.fillet, resolution: 1).path(in: zone)
        return shape.union(bump.intersection(Path(zone)))
    }
}

/// The shelf's goo, for the left edge (x = 0 is the screen edge, y down; mirror it for
/// the right). A round cap swells out of the edge toward a drag, a droplet reaches for
/// the pointer and merges into it, the cap opens into the panel, and at rest it's a lens.
enum ShelfGoo {
    static let panelWidth: CGFloat = 248
    static let fillet: CGFloat = 10
    static let hidden: CGFloat = 48   // panel body tucked past the edge

    struct State {
        var reach: CGFloat = 0     // 0…1 drag proximity
        var open: CGFloat = 0      // 0…1 panel
        var resting: CGFloat = 0   // 0/1 items on the shelf, no drag
        var centerY: CGFloat = 0
        var panelHeight: CGFloat = 200
        var panelWidth: CGFloat = ShelfGoo.panelWidth
        var pointer: CGPoint?      // while dragging: pointer (x = distance from the edge)
    }

    static func capDepth(_ s: State) -> CGFloat { max(10 * s.resting, s.reach > 0.01 ? 6 + 28 * s.reach : 0) }
    static func capRadius(_ s: State) -> CGFloat { s.reach > 0.01 ? 64 : 44 }

    static func bodies(_ s: State) -> [GooBody] {
        var out: [GooBody] = []
        let depth = capDepth(s), R = capRadius(s)
        if depth > 0.3 { out.append(.circle(CGPoint(x: depth - R, y: s.centerY), radius: R)) }
        if s.open > 0.01 {
            let chord = 2 * (2 * R * depth - depth * depth).squareRoot()
            let h = chord + (s.panelHeight - chord) * s.open
            let w = s.panelWidth * s.open
            out.append(.continuousBox(CGRect(x: -hidden, y: s.centerY - h / 2, width: hidden + w, height: h), radius: min(GooTear.corner, h / 2)))
        }
        // A short tongue leaning toward the pointer: always attached (it never leaves the
        // fillet's reach of the cap), growing with reach.
        if let p = s.pointer, s.reach > 0.15, s.open < 0.3 {
            let k = min(1, (s.reach - 0.15) / 0.5) * (1 - s.open / 0.3)
            let r = 4 + 6 * k
            let lean = min(max(0, p.x - depth), 10) * k
            let dy = max(-R * 0.6, min(R * 0.6, p.y - s.centerY))
            out.append(.circle(CGPoint(x: depth - r * 0.4 + lean, y: s.centerY + dy), radius: r))
        }
        return out
    }

    /// Everything the goo can occupy in this state, for sizing the window around it.
    static func extent(_ s: State) -> CGRect {
        bodies(s).reduce(CGRect.null) { box, b in
            box.union(CGRect(x: b.center.x - b.halfSize.width, y: b.center.y - b.halfSize.height, width: 2 * b.halfSize.width, height: 2 * b.halfSize.height))
        }
    }
}

/// Springs stepped on display frames, for goo values. SwiftUI's animation of a custom
/// Shape isn't applied evenly (the system glass draws the target while the stroke and
/// layout draw in-between frames, so the surface flickered between two states). These
/// write plain values each frame instead, so every consumer sees the same number.
@MainActor @Observable final class GooSpring {
    private(set) var value: CGFloat
    @ObservationIgnored private var target: CGFloat
    @ObservationIgnored private var velocity: CGFloat = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var response: CGFloat = 0.3
    @ObservationIgnored private var damping: CGFloat = 0.8
    @ObservationIgnored private var driver: MotionDriver?
    @ObservationIgnored private var last: CFTimeInterval?
    /// Called once when a `go` comes to rest.
    @ObservationIgnored var onSettled: (() -> Void)?

    init(_ value: CGFloat) { self.value = value; target = value }

    /// Jump straight to `value`, stopping any motion.
    func set(_ value: CGFloat) {
        driver?.invalidate(); driver = nil; last = nil
        velocity = 0; target = value
        if self.value != value { self.value = value }
    }

    /// Spring toward `target`, keeping the current velocity (retargetable mid-flight).
    func go(_ target: CGFloat, response: CGFloat, damping: CGFloat) {
        self.target = target; self.response = response; self.damping = damping
        guard driver == nil else { return }
        guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { set(target); return }
        driver = MotionDriver(screen: screen) { [weak self] time in
            guard let self else { return true }
            return self.step(time)
        }
    }

    private func step(_ time: CFTimeInterval) -> Bool {
        let dt = min(1.0 / 30, max(0, time - (last ?? time - 1.0 / 120)))
        last = time
        let k = pow(2 * .pi / response, 2), c = 4 * .pi * damping / response
        var x = value, v = velocity
        let n = 4, h = CGFloat(dt) / CGFloat(n)
        for _ in 0..<n { v += (-k * (x - target) - c * v) * h; x += v * h }
        velocity = v
        if abs(x - target) < 0.01, abs(v) < 0.05 {
            value = target; velocity = 0; driver = nil; last = nil
            let done = onSettled; onSettled = nil; done?()
            return true
        }
        value = x
        return false
    }
}

/// The tear's moving parts.
@MainActor @Observable final class GooTearMotion {
    let pull = GooSpring(0)       // upward pull on the sheet's top edge
    let nub = GooSpring(0)        // the rim's half of the parted strand (1 → 0)
    let grabX = GooSpring(366)    // where the top edge is held
    let bulge = GooSpring(0)      // the top edge's bulge toward the cursor (0 → 1)
}
//
//  Permissions.swift
//  Centralized macOS permission handling for local voice input and paste.
//

import AppKit
import ApplicationServices
import AVFoundation
import Observation

enum OptionPermissionStatus: Equatable {
    case allowed
    case needsApproval
    case blocked

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .allowed: "Allowed"
        case .needsApproval: "Needs approval"
        case .blocked: "Blocked"
        }
    }
}

@MainActor
@Observable
final class PermissionModel {
    private(set) var microphone: OptionPermissionStatus = .needsApproval
    private(set) var accessibility: OptionPermissionStatus = .needsApproval
    private(set) var lastPromptedAccessibility = Date.distantPast

    @ObservationIgnored private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?

    func start() {
        refresh()
        observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
            forName: NSApplication.didBecomeActiveNotification,
            object: nil,
            queue: .main
        ) { [weak self] _ in
            Task { @MainActor in self?.refresh() }
        }
    }

    func refresh() {
        microphone = Self.microphoneStatus()
        accessibility = AXIsProcessTrusted() ? .allowed : .needsApproval
    }

    func requestMicrophoneIfNeeded() async {
        switch AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: .audio) {
        case .authorized:
            microphone = .allowed
        case .notDetermined:
            microphone = .needsApproval
            let granted = await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
                AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .audio) { granted in
                    continuation.resume(returning: granted)
                }
            }
            microphone = granted ? .allowed : .blocked
        case .denied, .restricted:
            microphone = .blocked
        @unknown default:
            microphone = .blocked
        }
    }

    func promptAccessibilityIfNeeded(force: Bool = false) {
        guard !AXIsProcessTrusted() else {
            accessibility = .allowed
            return
        }
        let now = Date()
        guard force || now.timeIntervalSince(lastPromptedAccessibility) > 20 else {
            accessibility = .needsApproval
            return
        }
        lastPromptedAccessibility = now
        let options = [kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt.takeUnretainedValue() as String: true] as CFDictionary
        AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions(options)
        accessibility = AXIsProcessTrusted() ? .allowed : .needsApproval
    }

    func openMicrophoneSettings() {
        openSettings("x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Microphone")
    }

    func openAccessibilitySettings() {
        openSettings("x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Accessibility")
    }

    private func openSettings(_ urlString: String) {
        guard let url = URL(string: urlString) else { return }
        NSWorkspace.shared.open(url)
    }

    private static func microphoneStatus() -> OptionPermissionStatus {
        switch AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: .audio) {
        case .authorized: .allowed
        case .notDetermined: .needsApproval
        case .denied, .restricted: .blocked
        @unknown default: .blocked
        }
    }
}
//
//  SemanticFileIndex.swift
//  EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors of indexed file names, searched by meaning: "chemistry folder"
//  finds Chemie, "stress hormone presentation" finds Cortisol.pptx. Vectors live in
//  Nardo/semantic-files.bin ("EG2F", count, dim, Int64 file ids, Float16 rows, unit length);
//  the query is embedded in-process (EG2.swift; first `dim` dims, renormalized). Either missing
//  (or EG2 still loading) → no-op, and file search stays purely lexical.
//

import Foundation

final class SemanticFileIndex: @unchecked Sendable {
    static let shared = SemanticFileIndex()

    private var ids: [Int64] = []
    private var vectors: [Float16] = []
    private var dim = 0
    var isAvailable: Bool { !ids.isEmpty }

    static func url() -> URL {
        if let p = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["SURFACE_SEMANTIC_INDEX"], !p.isEmpty { return URL(fileURLWithPath: p) }
        return FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
            .appendingPathComponent("Nardo/semantic-files.bin")
    }

    private init() {
        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: Self.url(), options: .alwaysMapped), data.count > 12,
              data.prefix(4) == Data("EG2F".utf8) else { return }
        data.withUnsafeBytes { raw in
            let n = Int(raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: 4, as: UInt32.self))
            let d = Int(raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: 8, as: UInt32.self))
            guard d % 16 == 0, raw.count == 12 + n * 8 + n * d * 2 else { return }
            ids = (0..<n).map { raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: 12 + $0 * 8, as: Int64.self) }
            let base = 12 + n * 8
            vectors = (0..<(n * d)).map { raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: base + $0 * 2, as: Float16.self) }
            dim = d
        }
    }

    /// The `k` file ids closest in meaning to `text`, best first. Empty when unavailable.
    func nearest(_ text: String, k: Int) -> [Int64] {
        guard isAvailable, let q = queryVector(text), q.count == dim else { return [] }
        let chunks = dim / 16
        let qv: [SIMD16<Float>] = (0..<chunks).map { c in SIMD16<Float>(q[(c * 16)..<(c * 16 + 16)]) }
        var best: [(score: Float, index: Int)] = []
        best.reserveCapacity(k + 1)
        var floor = -Float.infinity
        vectors.withUnsafeBufferPointer { v in
            v.baseAddress!.withMemoryRebound(to: SIMD16<Float16>.self, capacity: v.count / 16) { rows in
                for i in 0..<ids.count {
                    var acc = SIMD16<Float>()
                    for c in 0..<chunks { acc += SIMD16<Float>(rows[i * chunks + c]) * qv[c] }
                    let s = acc.sum()
                    guard s > floor || best.count < k else { continue }
                    let at = best.firstIndex { $0.score < s } ?? best.count
                    best.insert((s, i), at: at)
                    if best.count > k { best.removeLast() }
                    if best.count == k { floor = best[k - 1].score }
                }
            }
        }
        return best.map { ids[$0.index] }
    }

    /// Matryoshka-truncated query vector: EG2's first `dim` dims, back to unit length.
    private func queryVector(_ text: String) -> [Float]? {
        guard dim > 0, let e = EG2.shared.embed(EG2.queryPrefix + text), e.count >= dim else { return nil }
        let v = Array(e.prefix(dim))
        let n = sqrt(v.reduce(0) { $0 + $1 * $1 })
        return n > 0 ? v.map { $0 / n } : nil
    }
}

enum EdgePinnedAction: String, CaseIterable {
    case surface, browser, clipboard, games, navigator
    var title: String { rawValue.capitalized }
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .surface: "square.on.circle"
        case .browser: "globe"
        case .clipboard: "clipboard"
        case .games: "gamecontroller"
        case .navigator: "square.stack.3d.down.right"
        }
    }
    var workspaceIndex: Int? {
        switch self { case .surface: 0; case .browser: 1; default: nil }
    }
    var seed: String {
        switch self { case .games: "@games "; default: " " }
    }

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeFolderShelfState {
    static let shared = EdgeFolderShelfState()
    var titles = ["Surface", "Browser"]
    var focused = -1
    var pending: Int?
    var switcherVisible = false
    var workspace: String { focused == 1 ? "Browser" : focused == 0 ? "Surface" : "" }
    var actions: [EdgePinnedAction] = {
        let saved = UserDefaults.standard.stringArray(forKey: "edge.pinnedActions.v1") ?? []
        let actions = saved.compactMap(EdgePinnedAction.init(rawValue:))
        return actions.count == 3 ? actions : [.surface, .browser, .clipboard]
    }()
    @ObservationIgnored var toggleInput: (() -> Void)?
    @ObservationIgnored var activate: ((Int) -> Void)?
    func assign(_ action: EdgePinnedAction, to index: Int) {
        guard actions.indices.contains(index) else { return }
        if let existing = actions.firstIndex(of: action) { actions.swapAt(existing, index) }
        else { actions[index] = action }
        UserDefaults.standard.set(actions.map(\.rawValue), forKey: "edge.pinnedActions.v1")
    }
}

//
//  EdgeMail.swift
//  Mail as a layer, not an inbox. With nothing typed, the bar shows the threads where a
//  person is waiting on you (and only then). "mail" shows them on purpose, "mail ramen"
//  searches. Return pulls the card off into a window: thread list + reader. ⌘E archives,
//  ⌘S snoozes to tomorrow morning, ⌘Z undoes. Sync is Option/Mail (Gmail over IMAP).
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI
import WebKit

@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeMailStore {
    static let shared = EdgeMailStore()

    private(set) var revision = 0
    private(set) var state: MailSyncState = .idle
    private(set) var account: MailAccount?
    /// Threads waiting on you, most urgent first.
    private(set) var needsYou: [MailThread] = []
    /// The rest of the inbox (newest first), for the window's list.
    private(set) var inbox: [MailThread] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var searchCache: (term: String, revision: Int, hits: [MailThread])?
    /// A thread the window should open on (set when Return pops the card out).
    var focusThread: String?

    @ObservationIgnored let store = MailStore.shared
    @ObservationIgnored private var sync: MailSync?
    @ObservationIgnored private var undo: [(change: MailSync.Change, uids: [UInt32], thrid: String, snooze: Bool)] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var refreshPending = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var markReadTask: Task<Void, Never>?

    private static let accountKey = "edge.mail.account"

    var connected: Bool { account != nil }
    var canUndo: Bool { !undo.isEmpty }

    private init() {}

    func start() {
        guard sync == nil, let email = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: Self.accountKey),
              let password = MailKeychain.load(email) else { refresh(); return }
        let account = MailAccount(email: email)
        self.account = account
        // Lite sends but has no inbox: the account is known, nothing syncs.
        if Edition.lite { refresh(); return }
        let sync = MailSync(account: account, password: password, store: store) { state in
            Task { @MainActor in EdgeMailStore.shared.stateChanged(state) }
        }
        self.sync = sync
        Task { await sync.start() }
        refresh()
    }

    private func stateChanged(_ s: MailSyncState) {
        if state != s { state = s }
        // Coalesce store reads: many progress callbacks arrive during a first sync.
        guard !refreshPending else { return }
        refreshPending = true
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.25) { [weak self] in
            self?.refreshPending = false
            self?.refresh()
        }
    }

    func refresh() {
        let me: Set<String> = account.map { [$0.email.lowercased()] } ?? []
        let ctx = MailNeedsYou.Context(correspondents: store.correspondents(), snoozes: store.snoozes(), me: me)
        let all = store.threads(where: "instr(labels, '\\Inbox') > 0", limit: 400)
        needsYou = all
            .compactMap { t in MailNeedsYou.score(t, ctx).map { var t = t; t.score = $0; return t } }
            .sorted { $0.score > $1.score }
        let waiting = Set(needsYou.map(\.thrid))
        inbox = all.filter { !waiting.contains($0.thrid) }
        revision += 1
    }

    /// What a card shows for an intent: search hits, or needs-you (then the rest of the
    /// inbox when there's room for a list).
    func threads(for intent: EdgeMailIntent, tall: Bool) -> [MailThread] {
        if let term = intent.search, !term.isEmpty {
            if let c = searchCache, c.term == term, c.revision == revision { return tall ? c.hits : Array(c.hits.prefix(20)) }
            let hits = store.search(term, limit: 80)
            searchCache = (term, revision, hits)
            return tall ? hits : Array(hits.prefix(20))
        }
        return tall ? needsYou + inbox : needsYou
    }

    // MARK: Account

    func presentSetup() {
        NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
        let alert = NSAlert()
        alert.messageText = "Gmail"
        alert.informativeText = "Your address and an app password (Google Account → Security → App passwords)."
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Connect")
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Create app password")
        let email = NSTextField(frame: NSRect(x: 0, y: 30, width: 280, height: 24))
        email.placeholderString = "you@gmail.com"
        email.stringValue = account?.email ?? ""
        let password = NSSecureTextField(frame: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 280, height: 24))
        password.placeholderString = "app password"
        let box = NSView(frame: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 280, height: 54))
        box.addSubview(email); box.addSubview(password)
        alert.accessoryView = box
        alert.window.initialFirstResponder = email
        switch alert.runModal() {
        case .alertFirstButtonReturn:
            let address = email.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
            // Google shows app passwords in groups of four; spaces don't matter.
            let secret = password.stringValue.replacingOccurrences(of: " ", with: "")
            guard address.contains("@"), !secret.isEmpty else { return }
            connect(email: address, password: secret)
        case .alertThirdButtonReturn:
            if Edition.lite { NSWorkspace.shared.open(URL(string: "https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords")!) }
            else { BrowserWindow.shared.open("https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords") }
        default: break
        }
    }

    func connect(email: String, password: String) {
        state = .connecting
        Task {
            if let problem = await MailSync.verify(MailAccount(email: email), password: password) {
                state = .failed(problem)
                let alert = NSAlert()
                alert.messageText = "Couldn't connect"
                alert.informativeText = problem
                alert.runModal()
                return
            }
            await disconnect(keepKeychain: false)
            guard MailKeychain.save(password, for: email) else { state = .failed("Keychain refused the password."); return }
            UserDefaults.standard.set(email, forKey: Self.accountKey)
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.connect", params: ["host": "imap.gmail.com"])
            start()
        }
    }

    func disconnect(keepKeychain: Bool = false) async {
        if let sync { await sync.stop() }
        sync = nil
        if let email = account?.email, !keepKeychain { MailKeychain.delete(email) }
        account = nil
        UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: Self.accountKey)
        store.reset()
        state = .idle
        refresh()
    }

    // MARK: Triage

    func archive(_ t: MailThread, source: String) {
        let uids = store.thread(t.thrid).filter(\.inInbox).map(\.uid)
        guard !uids.isEmpty else { return }
        setInbox(uids, false)
        undo.append((.archive, uids, t.thrid, false))
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.archive", params: journalParams(t, source: source))
        remote(.archive, uids)
    }

    func snooze(_ t: MailThread, source: String) {
        let cal = Calendar.current
        let morning = cal.date(bySettingHour: 8, minute: 0, second: 0, of: cal.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: Date())!)!
        store.snooze(t.thrid, until: morning)
        undo.append((.archive, [], t.thrid, true))
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.snooze", params: journalParams(t, source: source).merging(["until": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: morning)]) { $1 })
        refresh()
    }

    func undoLast() {
        guard let last = undo.popLast() else { return }
        if last.snooze {
            store.snooze(last.thrid, until: nil)
        } else {
            setInbox(last.uids, true)
            remote(.unarchive, last.uids)
        }
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.undo", params: ["thread": last.thrid, "kind": last.snooze ? "snooze" : "archive"])
        refresh()
    }

    /// Shown in the reader for a moment: it's read.
    func shown(_ t: MailThread) {
        markReadTask?.cancel()
        guard t.unread else { return }
        markReadTask = Task { @MainActor in
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 1_200_000_000)
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            let uids = store.thread(t.thrid).filter(\.unread).map(\.uid)
            store.updateFlags(store.thread(t.thrid).filter(\.unread).map { ($0.uid, $0.labels, false) })
            InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.read", params: journalParams(t, source: "reader"))
            remote(.markRead, uids)
            refresh()
        }
    }

    /// Bodies for archived/sent messages in a thread the background pass skipped.
    func ensureBodies(_ thrid: String) {
        let missing = store.thread(thrid).filter { !$0.hasBody }.map(\.uid)
        guard !missing.isEmpty, let sync else { return }
        Task {
            try? await sync.fetchBody(uids: missing)
            refresh()
        }
    }

    func openInGmail(_ t: MailThread) {
        let hex = UInt64(t.thrid).map { String($0, radix: 16) } ?? ""
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.open_gmail", params: journalParams(t, source: "window"))
        BrowserWindow.shared.open("https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#all/" + hex)
    }

    func journalOpen(_ t: MailThread, source: String) {
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("mail.open", params: journalParams(t, source: source))
    }

    private func journalParams(_ t: MailThread, source: String) -> [String: String] {
        ["thread": t.thrid, "from": t.latestIncoming?.from.email ?? t.latest.from.email,
         "score": String(format: "%.2f", t.score), "unread": t.unread ? "1" : "0", "source": source]
    }

    private func setInbox(_ uids: [UInt32], _ inbox: Bool) {
        let set = Set(uids)
        let msgs = store.messages(where: "1", limit: 20_000).filter { set.contains($0.uid) }
        store.updateFlags(msgs.map { m in
            var labels = m.labels.filter { $0 != "\\Inbox" }
            if inbox { labels.append("\\Inbox") }
            return (m.uid, labels, m.unread)
        })
        refresh()
    }

    private func remote(_ change: MailSync.Change, _ uids: [UInt32]) {
        guard let sync, !uids.isEmpty else { return }
        Task {
            do { try await sync.apply(change, uids: uids) }
            catch { await MainActor.run { self.state = .failed(MailSync.friendly(error)) } }
        }
    }
}

/// What a query means for mail: the needs-you list, or a search.
struct EdgeMailIntent: Equatable {
    var search: String?

    private static let words = ["mail", "email", "inbox", "gmail"]

    /// In the mail window every query is mail: "mail" alone, or a search.
    static func scoped(_ raw: String) -> EdgeMailIntent {
        let q = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        return parse(q) ?? EdgeMailIntent(search: q.isEmpty ? nil : q.lowercased())
    }

    static func parse(_ raw: String) -> EdgeMailIntent? {
        let lower = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
        for word in words where lower == word || lower.hasPrefix(word + " ") {
            let term = String(lower.dropFirst(word.count)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            return EdgeMailIntent(search: term.isEmpty ? nil : term)
        }
        return nil
    }
}

struct EdgeMailCard: View {
    let intent: EdgeMailIntent
    let selection: Int
    let tall: Bool
    let onSelect: (Int) -> Void

    private var mail: EdgeMailStore { .shared }
    private static let accent = Color(hexString: ToolKind.mail.accentHex) ?? .blue

    static func tileCount(_ intent: EdgeMailIntent, tall: Bool) -> Int {
        EdgeMailStore.shared.connected ? EdgeMailStore.shared.threads(for: intent, tall: tall).count : 1
    }

    @MainActor static func thread(_ intent: EdgeMailIntent, tall: Bool, selection: Int) -> MailThread? {
        let list = EdgeMailStore.shared.threads(for: intent, tall: tall)
        return list.indices.contains(selection) ? list[selection] : nil
    }

    var body: some View {
        let _ = mail.revision
        Group {
            if !mail.connected {
                setupTile.padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
            } else if tall {
                window
            } else {
                strip.padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxHeight: tall ? .infinity : nil, alignment: .top)
    }

    // MARK: Setup

    private var setupTile: some View {
        Button { mail.presentSetup() } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Image(systemName: mail.state == .connecting ? "arrow.triangle.2.circlepath" : "envelope.badge.person.crop")
                    .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .semibold)).foregroundStyle(Self.accent)
                if case .failed(let why) = mail.state {
                    Text(why).font(.pp(11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.6)).lineLimit(2).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity).frame(height: 84)
            .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.08)))
        }.buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    // MARK: Strip (the sheet)

    private var strip: some View {
        let threads = mail.threads(for: intent, tall: false)
        return FollowingScroll(selection: selection, horizontal: true, resetKey: intent.search ?? "") {
            LazyHStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
                ForEach(Array(threads.enumerated()), id: \.element.thrid) { i, t in
                    tile(t, index: i)
                }
                if threads.isEmpty { emptyTile }
            }
        }
        .frame(height: 96)
        .horizontalScrollFade(width: 46)
    }

    private var emptyTile: some View {
        Image(systemName: intent.search == nil ? "checkmark" : "magnifyingglass")
            .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35))
            .frame(width: 236, height: 96)
            .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.04)))
    }

    private func tile(_ t: MailThread, index: Int) -> some View {
        let m = t.latestIncoming ?? t.latest
        let chosen = index == selection
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
            HStack(spacing: 5) {
                if t.unread { Circle().fill(Self.accent).frame(width: 6, height: 6) }
                Text(m.from.display).font(.pp(13, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
                Spacer(minLength: 4)
                Text(Self.age(m.date)).font(.pp(11, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
            }
            Text(t.subject.isEmpty ? " " : t.subject).font(.pp(12.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85)).lineLimit(1)
            Text(m.snippet).font(.pp(11.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55)).lineLimit(2)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
        .frame(width: 236, height: 96, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius - EdgeLayout.gap, style: .continuous)
            .fill(chosen ? .white.opacity(0.16) : .white.opacity(0.06)))
        .overlay(alignment: .bottomTrailing) { if chosen { triageButtons(t).padding(6) } }
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .id(index)
        .onTapGesture { onSelect(index) }
    }

    private func triageButtons(_ t: MailThread) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 4) {
            iconButton("moon.zzz") { mail.snooze(t, source: "button") }
            iconButton("archivebox") { mail.archive(t, source: "button") }
        }
    }

    private func iconButton(_ symbol: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
                .frame(width: 24, height: 22)
                .background(Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.12)))
        }.buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    static func age(_ d: Date) -> String {
        let s = Date().timeIntervalSince(d)
        if s < 3600 { return "\(max(1, Int(s / 60)))m" }
        if s < 86400 { return "\(Int(s / 3600))h" }
        if s < 7 * 86400 { return "\(Int(s / 86400))d" }
        return d.formatted(.dateTime.month(.abbreviated).day())
    }

    // MARK: Window (list + reader)

    private var window: some View {
        let threads = mail.threads(for: intent, tall: true)
        let waiting = mail.needsYou.count
        let current = threads.indices.contains(selection) ? threads[selection] : nil
        return HStack(spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
            FollowingScroll(selection: selection) {
                LazyVStack(spacing: 3) {
                    ForEach(Array(threads.enumerated()), id: \.element.thrid) { i, t in
                        if i == waiting, intent.search == nil, waiting > 0 {
                            Rectangle().fill(.white.opacity(0.08)).frame(height: 1).padding(.vertical, 5)
                        }
                        row(t, index: i)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.vertical, EdgeLayout.gap)
            }
            .frame(width: 270)
            Group {
                if let current { MailReader(thread: current).id(current.thrid) }
                else { Color.clear }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        }
        .padding(EdgeLayout.gap)
        .onAppear { focus(threads) }
        .onChange(of: mail.focusThread) { _, _ in focus(threads) }
    }

    private func focus(_ threads: [MailThread]) {
        guard let id = mail.focusThread, let i = threads.firstIndex(where: { $0.thrid == id }) else { return }
        mail.focusThread = nil
        onSelect(i)
        ToolWindowManager.shared.query(.mail).selection = i
    }

    private func row(_ t: MailThread, index: Int) -> some View {
        let m = t.latestIncoming ?? t.latest
        let chosen = index == selection
        return HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 6) {
            Circle().fill(t.unread ? Self.accent : .clear).frame(width: 6, height: 6).padding(.top, 5)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                HStack {
                    Text(m.from.display).font(.pp(12.5, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
                    if t.count > 1 { Text("\(t.count)").font(.pp(10.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4)) }
                    Spacer(minLength: 2)
                    Text(Self.age(t.latest.date)).font(.pp(10.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4))
                }
                Text(t.subject).font(.pp(12)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8)).lineLimit(1)
                Text(m.snippet).font(.pp(11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45)).lineLimit(1)
            }
        }
        .padding(7)
        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9, style: .continuous).fill(chosen ? .white.opacity(0.14) : .clear))
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .id(index)
        .onTapGesture { onSelect(index); ToolWindowManager.shared.query(.mail).selection = index }
    }
}

/// One thread: earlier messages as one-line rows, the open one rendered in full.
private struct MailReader: View {
    let thread: MailThread
    @State private var open: UInt32?

    private var mail: EdgeMailStore { .shared }

    var body: some View {
        let _ = mail.revision
        let messages = mail.store.thread(thread.thrid)
        let shown = messages.first { $0.uid == open } ?? messages.last
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack {
                Text(thread.subject).font(.pp(16, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(2)
                Spacer()
                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    readerButton("moon.zzz") { mail.snooze(thread, source: "window") }
                    readerButton("archivebox") { mail.archive(thread, source: "window") }
                    readerButton("arrow.up.right") { mail.openInGmail(thread) }
                }
            }
            ForEach(messages.filter { $0.uid != shown?.uid }) { m in
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text(m.fromMe ? "You" : m.from.display).font(.pp(11.5, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75)).lineLimit(1)
                    Text(m.snippet).font(.pp(11.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45)).lineLimit(1)
                    Spacer(minLength: 4)
                    Text(EdgeMailCard.age(m.date)).font(.pp(10.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35))
                }
                .padding(.vertical, 3)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
                .onTapGesture { open = m.uid }
            }
            if let shown {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text(shown.fromMe ? "You" : shown.from.display).font(.pp(12.5, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white)
                    Text(shown.from.email).font(.pp(11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4)).lineLimit(1)
                    Spacer()
                    Text(shown.date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)).font(.pp(11)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.4))
                }
                if !shown.attachments.isEmpty {
                    HStack(spacing: 4) {
                        ForEach(shown.attachments, id: \.self) { a in
                            Label(a.filename, systemImage: "paperclip").font(.pp(10.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
                                .lineLimit(1).padding(.horizontal, 7).padding(.vertical, 3)
                                .background(Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.08)))
                        }
                    }
                }
                MailHTMLView(document: MailHTMLView.document(for: shown))
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous))
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            mail.ensureBodies(thread.thrid)
            mail.shown(thread)
        }
    }

    private func readerButton(_ symbol: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: 12, weight: .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
                .frame(width: 28, height: 24).background(Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.1)))
        }.buttonStyle(.plain)
    }
}

/// Mail HTML, sealed: no JavaScript, no network (CSP + a content rule that blocks every
/// http(s) load, so tracking pixels never fire), no cookies. Links open in the browser.
struct MailHTMLView: NSViewRepresentable {
    let document: String

    static func document(for m: MailMessage) -> String {
        let csp = "<meta http-equiv=\"Content-Security-Policy\" content=\"default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:\">"
        let base = """
        <style>
        html { background: #ffffff; }
        body { margin: 14px; font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1f; word-wrap: break-word; }
        .gmail_quote, blockquote[type=cite], .yahoo_quoted, #appendonsend ~ * { display: none !important; }
        pre.plain { white-space: pre-wrap; font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; }
        img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
        </style>
        """
        if let html = m.html, !html.isEmpty {
            return "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf-8>" + csp + base + "</head><body>" + html + "</body></html>"
        }
        let text = (m.text ?? m.snippet)
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "&", with: "&amp;").replacingOccurrences(of: "<", with: "&lt;").replacingOccurrences(of: ">", with: "&gt;")
        let linked = text.replacingOccurrences(of: #"(https?://[^\s<>"]+)"#, with: "<a href=\"$1\">$1</a>", options: .regularExpression)
        // Quoted reply lines fold away like Gmail's.
        let lines = linked.components(separatedBy: "\n").filter { !$0.hasPrefix("&gt;") }.joined(separator: "\n")
        return "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf-8>" + csp + base + "</head><body><pre class=plain>" + lines + "</pre></body></html>"
    }

    final class Coordinator: NSObject, WKNavigationDelegate {
        var loaded: String?
        func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, decidePolicyFor action: WKNavigationAction, decisionHandler: @escaping @MainActor (WKNavigationActionPolicy) -> Void) {
            if action.navigationType == .linkActivated, let url = action.request.url {
                if url.scheme == "http" || url.scheme == "https" { BrowserWindow.shared.open(url.absoluteString) }
                else if url.scheme == "mailto" { NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) }
                decisionHandler(.cancel); return
            }
            // Only our own document; nothing navigates the frame anywhere else.
            decisionHandler(action.request.url?.absoluteString == "about:blank" ? .allow : .cancel)
        }
    }

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator { Coordinator() }

    @MainActor private static var rules: WKContentRuleList?
    @MainActor private static var compiling: [(WKContentRuleList?) -> Void]?

    @MainActor private static func withRules(_ done: @escaping (WKContentRuleList?) -> Void) {
        if let rules { done(rules); return }
        if compiling != nil { compiling?.append(done); return }
        compiling = [done]
        let json = #"[{"trigger":{"url-filter":"^(https?|wss?|ftp)://"},"action":{"type":"block"}}]"#
        WKContentRuleListStore.default().compileContentRuleList(forIdentifier: "com.hashawn.nardo.mail.offline", encodedContentRuleList: json) { list, _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                rules = list
                let waiting = compiling ?? []
                compiling = nil
                waiting.forEach { $0(list) }
            }
        }
    }

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> WKWebView {
        let config = WKWebViewConfiguration()
        config.websiteDataStore = .nonPersistent()
        config.defaultWebpagePreferences.allowsContentJavaScript = false
        config.preferences.javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically = false
        let view = WKWebView(frame: .zero, configuration: config)
        view.navigationDelegate = context.coordinator
        view.setValue(false, forKey: "drawsBackground")
        return view
    }

    func updateNSView(_ view: WKWebView, context: Context) {
        guard context.coordinator.loaded != document else { return }
        context.coordinator.loaded = document
        let doc = document
        Self.withRules { list in
            if let list {
