                view.configuration.userContentController.removeAllContentRuleLists()
                view.configuration.userContentController.add(list)
                view.loadHTMLString(doc, baseURL: nil)
            } else {
                // Without the rule list, CSP alone still blocks remote loads.
                view.loadHTMLString(doc, baseURL: nil)
            }
        }
    }
}
//
//  Shelf.swift
//  Park files, text, links and images at the screen's side edge. While anything is being
//  dragged, the nearest side edge swells toward the pointer as goo; drop on it to shelve.
//  With items on it the shelf rests as a small tab; hover to open, drag items back out.
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI
import UniformTypeIdentifiers
import QuickLookThumbnailing

// MARK: - Store

struct ShelfItem: Codable, Identifiable, Equatable {
    enum Kind: String, Codable { case file, link, text, image }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    var path: String?     // file / image (image files live in the shelf folder)
    var string: String?   // link URL / text
    var added: Date
    var cut: Bool? = nil  // staged by ⌘X in Finder: ⌘V there moves it

    var url: URL? { path.map { URL(fileURLWithPath: $0) } ?? string.flatMap(URL.init(string:)) }
    var isPicture: Bool {
        if kind == .image { return true }
        guard kind == .file, let ext = path.map({ ($0 as NSString).pathExtension }), let type = UTType(filenameExtension: ext) else { return false }
        return type.conforms(to: .image)
    }
    var title: String {
        switch kind {
        case .file, .image: return url?.lastPathComponent ?? "Item"
        case .link: return url?.host() ?? string ?? "Link"
        case .text: return (string ?? "").trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? ""
        }
    }
}

@MainActor @Observable final class ShelfStore {
    static let shared = ShelfStore()
    private(set) var items: [ShelfItem] = []

    private let folder: URL = {
        let base = FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        let dir = base.appendingPathComponent("Nardo/Shelf", isDirectory: true)
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        return dir
    }()
    private var indexURL: URL { folder.appendingPathComponent("index.json") }

    private init() {
        if let data = try? Data(contentsOf: indexURL), let saved = try? JSONDecoder().decode([ShelfItem].self, from: data) {
            items = saved.filter { $0.kind == .text || $0.kind == .link || FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: $0.path ?? "") }
        }
    }

    private func save() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(items) { try? data.write(to: indexURL, options: .atomic) }
    }

    private func insert(_ item: ShelfItem) {
        // Same file/link/text again just moves to the top.
        items.removeAll { $0.kind == item.kind && $0.path == item.path && $0.string == item.string }
        items.insert(item, at: 0)
        save()
        ShelfEdge.shared.layoutWindow()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("shelf.add", params: ["kind": item.kind.rawValue])
    }

    func add(file url: URL) { insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .file, path: url.path, added: Date())) }
    /// Finder ⌘X: stage files to be moved by the next ⌘V in Finder.
    func addCut(_ urls: [URL]) {
        for url in urls.reversed() { insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .file, path: url.path, added: Date(), cut: true)) }
        ShelfEdge.shared.showResting()
    }
    func add(link url: URL) { insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .link, string: url.absoluteString, added: Date())) }
    func add(text: String) {
        guard !text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else { return }
        insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .text, string: text, added: Date()))
    }
    func add(imageData data: Data) {
        guard let rep = NSBitmapImageRep(data: data), let png = rep.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]) else { return }
        let url = folder.appendingPathComponent("Image \(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000)).png")
        guard (try? png.write(to: url)) != nil else { return }
        insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .image, path: url.path, added: Date()))
    }
    func add(capture: CaptureResult) {
        guard let url = capture.writePNG(to: folder) else { return }
        insert(ShelfItem(id: UUID(), kind: .image, path: url.path, string: capture.text.isEmpty ? nil : capture.text, added: Date()))
        ShelfEdge.shared.showResting()
    }

    func remove(_ item: ShelfItem) {
        items.removeAll { $0.id == item.id }
        defer { ShelfEdge.shared.layoutWindow() }
        if item.kind == .image, let path = item.path, path.hasPrefix(folder.path) { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: path) }
        save()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("shelf.remove", params: ["kind": item.kind.rawValue])
        if items.isEmpty { ShelfEdge.shared.hideIfIdle() }
        FinderCut.shared.refresh()
    }

    func clear() {
        for item in items where item.kind == .image { if let p = item.path, p.hasPrefix(folder.path) { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: p) } }
        items.removeAll(); save()
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("shelf.clear")
        ShelfEdge.shared.hideIfIdle()
    }

    /// What dragging an item out hands to the destination.
    func provider(for item: ShelfItem) -> NSItemProvider {
        switch item.kind {
        case .file, .image: return item.url.flatMap { NSItemProvider(contentsOf: $0) } ?? NSItemProvider()
        case .link: return item.url.map { NSItemProvider(object: $0 as NSURL) } ?? NSItemProvider()
        case .text: return NSItemProvider(object: (item.string ?? "") as NSString)
        }
    }

    /// Takes whatever was dropped: files, links, images, text.
    func accept(_ providers: [NSItemProvider]) -> Bool {
        var took = false
        for p in providers {
            if p.hasItemConformingToTypeIdentifier(UTType.fileURL.identifier) {
                took = true
                _ = p.loadObject(ofClass: URL.self) { url, _ in
                    guard let url else { return }
                    Task { @MainActor in ShelfStore.shared.add(file: url) }
                }
            } else if p.hasItemConformingToTypeIdentifier(UTType.url.identifier) {
                took = true
                _ = p.loadObject(ofClass: URL.self) { url, _ in
                    guard let url else { return }
                    Task { @MainActor in ShelfStore.shared.add(link: url) }
                }
            } else if p.hasItemConformingToTypeIdentifier(UTType.image.identifier) {
                took = true
                p.loadDataRepresentation(forTypeIdentifier: UTType.image.identifier) { data, _ in
                    guard let data else { return }
                    Task { @MainActor in ShelfStore.shared.add(imageData: data) }
                }
            } else if p.canLoadObject(ofClass: String.self) {
                took = true
                _ = p.loadObject(ofClass: String.self) { text, _ in
                    guard let text else { return }
                    Task { @MainActor in
                        if let url = URL(string: text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)), url.scheme?.hasPrefix("http") == true {
                            ShelfStore.shared.add(link: url)
                        } else { ShelfStore.shared.add(text: text) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return took
    }
}

// MARK: - Edge

/// Watches drags system-wide and runs the shelf's edge surface. Geometry is in
/// "edge-local" coordinates: x = distance from the screen edge, y = down from the top of
/// the screen's visible frame. The window is only ever as big as the goo (plus margin),
/// so it never blocks drops or clicks meant for what's behind it.
@MainActor @Observable final class ShelfEdge {
    static let shared = ShelfEdge()

    enum Side: String { case left, right }
    enum Mode { case hidden, reaching, resting }

    private(set) var side: Side = .right
    private(set) var mode: Mode = .hidden
    let reach = GooSpring(0)      // 0…1: a drag's proximity to the edge
    let open = GooSpring(0)       // 0…1: the panel
    let centerY = GooSpring(300)  // where the cap/panel sits (follows the drag, then holds)
    let height = GooSpring(ShelfLayout.square)   // the panel's size (grid opening/closing)
    let width = GooSpring(ShelfLayout.square)
    private(set) var pointer: CGPoint?   // edge-local, while dragging
    /// The window's frame in edge-local coordinates (the view offsets the goo by its origin).
    private(set) var window = CGRect.zero

    var targeted = false { didSet { if targeted != oldValue { updateOpen() } } }
    var hovered = false { didSet { if hovered != oldValue { updateOpen() } } }
    /// The grid under the pile is showing.
    var expanded = false { didSet { if expanded != oldValue { layoutWindow() } } }

    static let reachDistance: CGFloat = 160

    @ObservationIgnored private var panel: NSPanel?
    @ObservationIgnored private var monitors: [Any] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var dragBaseline = NSPasteboard(name: .drag).changeCount
    @ObservationIgnored private(set) var dragging = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var screen: NSScreen?

    func start() {
        guard monitors.isEmpty else { return }
        side = Side(rawValue: UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "edge.shelf.side") ?? "") ?? .right
        // A real drag writes the drag pasteboard. Baseline it when the mouse comes back up
        // (not at mouse-down: some apps write it during their own mouse-down handling).
        let drag: (NSEvent) -> Void = { [weak self] _ in self?.dragMoved() }
        let up: (NSEvent) -> Void = { [weak self] _ in self?.dragEnded() }
        if let m = NSEvent.addGlobalMonitorForEvents(matching: .leftMouseDragged, handler: drag) { monitors.append(m) }
        if let m = NSEvent.addGlobalMonitorForEvents(matching: .leftMouseUp, handler: up) { monitors.append(m) }
        if let m = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .leftMouseDragged, handler: { drag($0); return $0 }) { monitors.append(m) }
        if let m = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: .leftMouseUp, handler: { up($0); return $0 }) { monitors.append(m) }
        if !ShelfStore.shared.items.isEmpty { showResting() }
        // Hover is decided from exact rects, not the window: at rest only the nub opens it,
        // once open the whole panel keeps it open, and leaving the panel closes it.
        hoverTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1.0 / 30, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.pollHover() }
        }
    }
    @ObservationIgnored private var hoverTimer: Timer?

    /// Settings → Shelf off: no drag watching, no hover poll, nothing at the edge. What's on
    /// the shelf stays in its store for when it comes back.
    func stop() {
        monitors.forEach { NSEvent.removeMonitor($0) }
        monitors.removeAll()
        hoverTimer?.invalidate(); hoverTimer = nil
        ownDragTimer?.invalidate(); ownDragTimer = nil; ownDrag = false
        dragging = false; hovered = false; targeted = false
        mode = .hidden
        panel?.orderOut(nil)
    }


    private func pollHover() {
        guard mode == .resting, !dragging, let screen else { if hovered && !dragging { hovered = false }; return }
        let f = screen.visibleFrame, m = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        let local = CGPoint(x: side == .left ? m.x - f.minX : f.maxX - m.x, y: f.maxY - m.y)
        let inside = (hovered ? panelRect : nubRect).insetBy(dx: -4, dy: -4).contains(local)
        if inside != hovered {
            hovered = inside
            if !inside { expanded = false }
        }
    }

    /// Edge-local rects: the resting nub, and the open panel.
    var nubRect: CGRect { CGRect(x: 0, y: centerY.value - 36, width: 16, height: 72) }
    var panelRect: CGRect {
        let h = panelHeight
        return CGRect(x: 0, y: centerY.value - h / 2, width: panelWidth, height: h)
    }
    /// Where the window takes clicks/drops right now (everything else passes through).
    var hitRect: CGRect {
        if mode == .reaching { return window }
        return hovered || targeted ? panelRect : nubRect
    }

    var panelWidth: CGFloat { expanded && !ShelfStore.shared.items.isEmpty ? ShelfGoo.panelWidth : ShelfLayout.square }
    var panelHeight: CGFloat {
        let n = ShelfStore.shared.items.count
        var h = ShelfLayout.square
        if expanded, n > 0 {
            let rows = CGFloat((n + ShelfLayout.columns - 1) / ShelfLayout.columns)
            h += rows * ShelfLayout.card + rows * EdgeLayout.gap
        }
        return min((screen?.visibleFrame.height ?? 800) - 48, h)
    }

    var state: ShelfGoo.State {
        ShelfGoo.State(reach: reach.value, open: open.value,
                       resting: mode == .resting && !ShelfStore.shared.items.isEmpty ? 1 : 0,
                       centerY: centerY.value, panelHeight: height.value, panelWidth: width.value, pointer: dragging ? pointer : nil)
    }

    /// Drags that start in this process never reach our own global monitors, and the drag
    /// session swallows the local ones: our drag sources call this, and the shelf follows
    /// the pointer itself until the button comes up.
    func ownDragBegan() {
        guard EdgeModule.isOn(.shelf) else { return }   // Shelf off: a card drag doesn't bring it out
        ownDragTimer?.invalidate()
        ownDrag = true
        ownDragTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1.0 / 120, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                guard let self else { return }
                if NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons & 1 == 0 {
                    self.ownDragTimer?.invalidate(); self.ownDragTimer = nil
                    self.ownDrag = false
                    self.dragEnded()
                } else { self.dragMoved() }
            }
        }
        RunLoop.main.add(ownDragTimer!, forMode: .common)
    }
    @ObservationIgnored private var ownDrag = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var ownDragTimer: Timer?
    private func dragMoved() {
        guard ownDrag || NSPasteboard(name: .drag).changeCount != dragBaseline else { return }
        let mouse = NSEvent.mouseLocation
        guard let screen = NSScreen.screens.first(where: { $0.frame.contains(mouse) }) else { return }
        let f = screen.visibleFrame
        let dLeft = mouse.x - f.minX, dRight = f.maxX - mouse.x
        let nearest: Side = dLeft < dRight ? .left : .right
        let d = min(dLeft, dRight)
        if !dragging || mode != .reaching || (nearest != side && open.value < 0.5) {
            guard d < Self.reachDistance else {
                if dragging, mode == .reaching, open.value < 0.5 { reach.go(0, response: 0.2, damping: 0.85) }
                return
            }
            dragging = true
            enter(.reaching, side: nearest, screen: screen)
        }
        let local = CGPoint(x: side == .left ? dLeft : dRight, y: f.maxY - mouse.y)
        pointer = local
        reach.go(max(0, min(1, 1 - local.x / Self.reachDistance)), response: 0.18, damping: 0.8)
        if !targeted { centerY.go(local.y, response: 0.22, damping: 0.72) }
        layoutWindow()
    }

    private func dragEnded() {
        dragBaseline = NSPasteboard(name: .drag).changeCount
        guard dragging else { return }
        dragging = false; pointer = nil
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in
            guard let self, !self.dragging else { return }
            self.targeted = false
            if ShelfStore.shared.items.isEmpty { self.hideIfIdle() } else { self.showResting() }
        }
    }

    func showResting() {
        // Shelf off (`stop()` took its hover poll): a nub now couldn't open or go away.
        guard EdgeModule.isOn(.shelf), let screen = screen ?? NSScreen.main else { return }
        enter(.resting, side: side, screen: screen)
        reach.go(0, response: 0.3, damping: 0.8)
        layoutWindow()
    }

    func hideIfIdle() {
        guard !dragging, !hovered else { return }
        mode = .hidden
        reach.go(0, response: 0.25, damping: 0.9)
        open.go(0, response: 0.25, damping: 0.9)
        open.onSettled = { [weak self] in if self?.mode == .hidden { self?.panel?.orderOut(nil) } }
    }

    private func updateOpen() {
        open.go(targeted || hovered ? 1 : 0, response: 0.32, damping: 0.72)
        // Shrink the window back to the tab once it has closed, so it stops covering the edge.
        open.onSettled = { [weak self] in self?.layoutWindow() }
        layoutWindow()
    }

    private func enter(_ mode: Mode, side: Side, screen: NSScreen) {
        self.mode = mode
        if side != self.side { self.side = side; UserDefaults.standard.set(side.rawValue, forKey: "edge.shelf.side") }
        if self.screen != screen { self.screen = screen; centerY.set(screen.visibleFrame.height / 2) }
        let panel = self.panel ?? makePanel()
        panel.orderFrontRegardless()
    }

    /// Size the window around what the goo can reach in its current mode.
    func layoutWindow() {
        guard let screen, let panel else { return }
        if abs(height.value - panelHeight) > 0.5 {
            height.go(panelHeight, response: 0.32, damping: 0.8)
            height.onSettled = { [weak self] in self?.layoutWindow() }
        }
        if abs(width.value - panelWidth) > 0.5 { width.go(panelWidth, response: 0.32, damping: 0.8) }
        let f = screen.visibleFrame
        let cy = centerY.value
        let pad: CGFloat = 24
        var local: CGRect
        if targeted || hovered || open.value > 0.05 {
            // Big enough for both where the height is and where it's going.
            let h = max(panelHeight, height.value)
            local = CGRect(x: 0, y: cy - h / 2 - pad, width: ShelfGoo.panelWidth + pad, height: h + 2 * pad)   // widest it gets
        } else if mode == .reaching {
            let y = pointer?.y ?? cy
            local = CGRect(x: 0, y: min(y, cy) - 100, width: 34 + 28 + pad, height: abs(y - cy) + 200)
        } else {
            local = nubRect.insetBy(dx: 0, dy: -pad); local.size.width += pad
        }
        local = local.intersection(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: f.width, height: f.height))
        guard !local.isNull else { return }
        window = local
        let x = side == .left ? f.minX : f.maxX - local.width
        let screenFrame = NSRect(x: x, y: f.maxY - local.maxY, width: local.width, height: local.height)
        if panel.frame != screenFrame { panel.setFrame(screenFrame, display: true) }
    }

    private func makePanel() -> NSPanel {
        let panel = ShelfPanel(contentRect: .zero, styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        panel.isOpaque = false; panel.backgroundColor = .clear; panel.hasShadow = false
        panel.level = NSWindow.Level(rawValue: NSWindow.Level.floating.rawValue + 1)
        panel.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]
        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false; panel.becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded = true
        panel.appearance = NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua)
        // The hosting view is the drop target itself: SwiftUI registers it for drags, so a
        // separate view underneath never got them (that's where drops were vanishing).
        let host = ShelfHostingView(rootView: ShelfEdgeView(edge: self, store: .shared))
        host.sizingOptions = []
        panel.contentView = host
        self.panel = panel
        return panel
    }
}

private final class ShelfPanel: NSPanel {
    override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
}

/// The drop target: the shelf's hosting view, with AppKit dragging overridden so drops
/// can't be lost to SwiftUI.
private final class ShelfHostingView: NSHostingView<ShelfEdgeView> {
    required init(rootView: ShelfEdgeView) {
        super.init(rootView: rootView)
        registerForDraggedTypes([.fileURL, .URL, .png, .tiff, .string])
    }
    @MainActor required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError() }

    override func draggingEntered(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo) -> NSDragOperation {
        // Don't take our own rows back while they're being dragged out.
        if sender.draggingSource is NSView, (sender.draggingSource as? NSView)?.window === window { return [] }
        ShelfEdge.shared.targeted = true
        return .copy
    }
    override func draggingUpdated(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo) -> NSDragOperation {
        if (sender.draggingSource as? NSView)?.window === window { return [] }
        return .copy
    }
    override func draggingExited(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo?) { ShelfEdge.shared.targeted = false }
    override func prepareForDragOperation(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo) -> Bool { true }
    override func wantsPeriodicDraggingUpdates() -> Bool { false }
    override func performDragOperation(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo) -> Bool {
        let pb = sender.draggingPasteboard
        var took = false
        let store = ShelfStore.shared
        if let urls = pb.readObjects(forClasses: [NSURL.self], options: [.urlReadingFileURLsOnly: true]) as? [URL], !urls.isEmpty {
            urls.forEach(store.add(file:)); took = true
        } else if let urls = pb.readObjects(forClasses: [NSURL.self]) as? [URL], !urls.isEmpty {
            urls.forEach(store.add(link:)); took = true
        } else if let data = pb.data(forType: .png) ?? pb.data(forType: .tiff) {
            store.add(imageData: data); took = true
        } else if let text = pb.string(forType: .string) {
            if let url = URL(string: text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)), url.scheme?.hasPrefix("http") == true {
                store.add(link: url)
            } else { store.add(text: text) }
            took = true
        }
        return took
    }
    override func concludeDragOperation(_ sender: NSDraggingInfo?) {
        // Keep it open a beat so you see what landed.
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.6) { ShelfEdge.shared.targeted = false }
    }
}

// MARK: - View

enum ShelfLayout {
    static let columns = 3
    static let card: CGFloat = (ShelfGoo.panelWidth - CGFloat(columns + 1) * EdgeLayout.gap) / CGFloat(columns)
    /// The collapsed card: a square with the pile in the middle, controls in the corners.
    static let square: CGFloat = 184
    static let pill: CGFloat = 28
}

struct ShelfEdgeView: View {
    let edge: ShelfEdge
    let store: ShelfStore

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let st = edge.state
            // Edge-local → this window: shift by the window's origin, mirror on the right.
            let bodies = ShelfGoo.bodies(st).map { place($0, in: geo.size) }
            ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
                // The window server passes events through zero-alpha pixels; give only the
                // live hit area (nub, or panel when open) a just-visible floor.
                hitFloor(geo.size)
                if !bodies.isEmpty {
                    // Liquid glass, no hairline; an accent ring only while something is over it.
                    GooSurface(bodies: bodies, blend: ShelfGoo.fillet,
                               outline: edge.targeted ? Color.accentColor.opacity(0.9) : .clear,
                               lineWidth: edge.targeted ? 2 : 0)
                }
                if st.open > 0.6 {
                    ShelfPanelContent(edge: edge, store: store)
                        .frame(width: st.panelWidth, height: st.panelHeight, alignment: .top)
                        .clipped()
                        .offset(x: panelOrigin(st, geo.size).x, y: panelOrigin(st, geo.size).y)
                        .opacity(Double((st.open - 0.6) / 0.4))
                } else if st.resting > 0, st.reach < 0.05 {
                    Text("\(store.items.count)")
                        .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                        .frame(width: 12, height: 20)
                        .position(place(point: CGPoint(x: 6, y: st.centerY), in: geo.size))
                        .allowsHitTesting(false)
                }
            }
            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height, alignment: .topLeading)
        }
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }

    private func hitFloor(_ size: CGSize) -> some View {
        let r = edge.hitRect
        let a = place(point: CGPoint(x: r.minX, y: r.minY), in: size), b = place(point: CGPoint(x: r.maxX, y: r.maxY), in: size)
        return Color.black.opacity(0.012)
            .frame(width: abs(b.x - a.x), height: abs(b.y - a.y))
            .offset(x: min(a.x, b.x), y: min(a.y, b.y))
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }

    private func panelOrigin(_ st: ShelfGoo.State, _ size: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        place(point: CGPoint(x: edge.side == .left ? 0 : st.panelWidth, y: st.centerY - st.panelHeight / 2), in: size)
    }
    private func place(point p: CGPoint, in size: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        let x = p.x - edge.window.minX, y = p.y - edge.window.minY
        return CGPoint(x: edge.side == .left ? x : size.width - x, y: y)
    }
    private func place(_ b: GooBody, in size: CGSize) -> GooBody {
        var out = b
        out.center = place(point: b.center, in: size)
        return out
    }
}

/// The open shelf: glass controls, the pile, a count capsule that opens the grid.
private struct ShelfPanelContent: View {
    let edge: ShelfEdge
    let store: ShelfStore

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            // The card: pile in the middle, controls tucked in the corners.
            ShelfPile(store: store, targeted: edge.targeted)
                .frame(height: ShelfLayout.square)
                .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                    GlassIconButton(symbol: "xmark", help: "Clear shelf") { store.clear() }.padding(EdgeLayout.gap + 2)
                }
                .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                    if store.items.contains(where: { $0.kind == .file || $0.kind == .image }) {
                        ShareLink(items: store.items.compactMap { $0.kind == .file || $0.kind == .image ? $0.url : nil }) {
                            Image(systemName: "square.and.arrow.up").font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                                .frame(width: 28, height: 28).glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: Circle())
                        }.buttonStyle(.plain).help("Share").padding(EdgeLayout.gap + 2)
                    }
                }
                .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                    Button { edge.expanded.toggle() } label: {
                        HStack(spacing: 4) {
                            Text(store.items.isEmpty ? "Drop here" : "\(store.items.count)")
                                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold, design: .rounded))
                            if !store.items.isEmpty {
                                Image(systemName: "chevron.right").font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold))
                                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(edge.expanded ? 90 : 0))
                            }
                        }
                        .padding(.horizontal, 12).frame(height: ShelfLayout.pill)
                        .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: Capsule())
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain).disabled(store.items.isEmpty)
                    .padding(.bottom, EdgeLayout.gap + 2)
                    .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.7), value: edge.expanded)
                }
            if edge.expanded, !store.items.isEmpty {
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.fixed(ShelfLayout.card), spacing: EdgeLayout.gap), count: ShelfLayout.columns),
                              spacing: EdgeLayout.gap) {
                        ForEach(store.items) { item in ShelfCard(item: item, store: store) }
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, EdgeLayout.gap)
                }
                .scrollIndicators(.never)
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.92))
    }
}

private struct GlassIconButton: View {
    let symbol: String
    let help: String
    let action: () -> Void
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                .frame(width: 28, height: 28).glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: Circle())
        }.buttonStyle(.plain).help(help)
    }
}

/// The newest items as a layered stack; drag it to move everything at once.
private struct ShelfPile: View {
    let store: ShelfStore
    let targeted: Bool
    @State private var hover = false

    var body: some View {
        let top = Array(store.items.prefix(3))
        ZStack {
            if top.isEmpty {
                Image(systemName: "tray.and.arrow.down").font(.system(size: 30, weight: .light))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(targeted ? 0.95 : 0.5))
                    .scaleEffect(targeted ? 1.12 : 1)
            }
            ForEach(stride(from: top.count - 1, through: 0, by: -1).map { $0 }, id: \.self) { index in
                let item = top[index]
                let spread: CGFloat = hover || targeted ? 1.6 : 1
                let tilt: CGFloat = index % 2 == 0 ? 7 : -7
                let angle = Double(CGFloat(index) * tilt * spread)
                let dx: CGFloat = CGFloat(index) * 6 * spread
                let dy: CGFloat = -CGFloat(index) * 3 * spread
                ShelfThumb(item: item, size: 92, bare: true)
                    .frame(width: 92, height: 92)
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.4), radius: 7, y: 4)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(angle))
                    .offset(x: dx, y: dy)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .scaleEffect(targeted ? 1.06 : 1)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.55), value: hover)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.6), value: targeted)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onHover { hover = $0 }
        .overlay { if !store.items.isEmpty { PileDragSource(store: store) } }
    }
}

/// Starts one AppKit drag carrying every item on the shelf.
private struct PileDragSource: NSViewRepresentable {
    let store: ShelfStore
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> PileDragView { PileDragView(store: store) }
    func updateNSView(_ view: PileDragView, context: Context) {}
}

final class PileDragView: NSView, NSDraggingSource {
    let store: ShelfStore
    private var downAt: NSPoint?
    init(store: ShelfStore) { self.store = store; super.init(frame: .zero) }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError() }

    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) { downAt = event.locationInWindow }
    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
        guard let downAt, hypot(event.locationInWindow.x - downAt.x, event.locationInWindow.y - downAt.y) > 3 else { return }
        self.downAt = nil
        let items: [NSDraggingItem] = store.items.enumerated().compactMap { i, item in
            let writer: NSPasteboardWriting?
            switch item.kind {
            case .file, .image: writer = item.url as NSURL?
            case .link: writer = item.url as NSURL?
            case .text: writer = (item.string ?? "") as NSString
            }
            guard let writer else { return nil }
            let d = NSDraggingItem(pasteboardWriter: writer)
            let icon = ShelfThumbnails.shared.image(for: item) ?? NSWorkspace.shared.icon(for: .data)
            let r = NSRect(x: bounds.midX - 32 + CGFloat(i) * 4, y: bounds.midY - 32 - CGFloat(i) * 4, width: 64, height: 64)
            d.setDraggingFrame(r, contents: icon)
            return d
        }
        guard !items.isEmpty else { return }
        beginDraggingSession(with: items, event: event, source: self)
    }
    func draggingSession(_ session: NSDraggingSession, sourceOperationMaskFor context: NSDraggingContext) -> NSDragOperation {
        context == .outsideApplication ? [.copy, .move, .link, .generic] : []
    }
}

/// One square card in the grid: the thumbnail fills it, the name shows on hover.
private struct ShelfCard: View {
    let item: ShelfItem
    let store: ShelfStore
    @State private var hover = false

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: EdgeLayout.innerRadius, style: .continuous)
        ShelfThumb(item: item, size: ShelfLayout.card)
            .frame(width: ShelfLayout.card, height: ShelfLayout.card)
            .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                if hover {
                    Text(item.title).font(.system(size: 9, weight: .medium)).lineLimit(1)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 6).padding(.vertical, 3)
                        .background(.black.opacity(0.55), in: Capsule())
                        .padding(5).transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                if hover {
                    Button { withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.7)) { store.remove(item) } } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "xmark").font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold)).frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                            .background(.black.opacity(0.55), in: Circle())
                    }.buttonStyle(.plain).padding(5).transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                if item.cut == true {
                    Image(systemName: "scissors").font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold)).frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                        .background(Color.orange.opacity(0.9), in: Circle()).padding(5)
                        .help("Cut — ⌘V in Finder moves it here")
                }
            }
            .scaleEffect(hover ? 1.04 : 1)
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.6), value: hover)
            .contentShape(shape)
            .onHover { hover = $0 }
            .onDrag { store.provider(for: item) }
            .onTapGesture(count: 2) { if let url = item.url { NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) } }
            .contextMenu {
                if let url = item.url { Button("Open") { NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) } }
                if item.kind == .file || item.kind == .image, let url = item.url {
                    Button("Show in Finder") { NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([url]) }
                }
                Button("Copy") {
                    NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
                    if let url = item.url, item.kind != .text { NSPasteboard.general.writeObjects([url as NSURL]) }
                    else { NSPasteboard.general.setString(item.string ?? "", forType: .string) }
                }
                Button("Remove", role: .destructive) { store.remove(item) }
            }
            .help(item.title)
    }
}

/// A shelf item's picture: Quick Look thumbnail for files, the image for images, the
/// first lines for text, a link glyph and host for links.
private struct ShelfThumb: View {
    let item: ShelfItem
    let size: CGFloat
    /// In the pile: the thing in its own shape (a page, a photo), no card behind it.
    var bare = false
    @State private var thumbs = ShelfThumbnails.shared

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size >= 70 ? EdgeLayout.innerRadius - 4 : 12, style: .continuous)
        Group {
            switch item.kind {
            case .text:
                Text(item.string ?? "").font(.system(size: 8.5)).lineLimit(7).multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                    .padding(8).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
                    .background(Color(white: 0.2))
            case .link:
                VStack(spacing: 4) {
                    Image(systemName: "link").font(.system(size: 18, weight: .medium))
                    Text(item.title).font(.system(size: 9, weight: .medium)).lineLimit(1)
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                .background(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.45))
            case .file, .image where bare:
                let image = thumbs.image(for: item) ?? NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: item.path ?? "")
                Image(nsImage: image).resizable().aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: item.isPicture ? 10 : 3, style: .continuous))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .task { thumbs.load(item) }
            case .file, .image:
                // Pictures fill the card; documents and folders sit on a faint tint at their own shape.
                let photo = item.isPicture
                if let image = thumbs.image(for: item) {
                    Image(nsImage: image).resizable().aspectRatio(contentMode: photo ? .fill : .fit)
                        .padding(photo ? 0 : 8)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                        .background(.white.opacity(photo ? 0 : 0.07))
                } else {
                    Image(nsImage: NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: item.path ?? "")).resizable().aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)
                        .padding(8).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity).background(.white.opacity(0.07))
                        .task { thumbs.load(item) }
                }
            }
        }
        .clipShape(bare && item.kind != .text && item.kind != .link ? AnyShape(Rectangle()) : AnyShape(shape))
    }
}

/// Quick Look thumbnails, cached per item.
@MainActor @Observable final class ShelfThumbnails {
    static let shared = ShelfThumbnails()
    private var cache: [UUID: NSImage] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var pending: Set<UUID> = []

    func image(for item: ShelfItem) -> NSImage? { cache[item.id] }

    func load(_ item: ShelfItem) {
        guard cache[item.id] == nil, !pending.contains(item.id), let url = item.url, url.isFileURL else { return }
        pending.insert(item.id)
        let request = QLThumbnailGenerator.Request(fileAt: url, size: CGSize(width: 160, height: 160),
                                                   scale: NSScreen.main?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2, representationTypes: .thumbnail)
        QLThumbnailGenerator.shared.generateBestRepresentation(for: request) { rep, _ in
            let image = rep?.nsImage
            Task { @MainActor in
                self.pending.remove(item.id)
                if let image { self.cache[item.id] = image }
            }
        }
    }
}
//
//  EdgeIslandView.swift
//  The notch island, drawn: one black goo body that melts into the notch, an ear each
//  side of it (what's live, and its readout), and below, when expanded, the live things
//  as small cards in the sheet's card style. Values in, closures out: what it shows is
//  read by EdgeIslandController from Surface's own models (docs/features/notch.md).
//

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// What the view draws. The controller fills it; the offscreen checks fill it by hand.
@MainActor @Observable final class EdgeIslandState {
    var geometry: IslandGeometry?
    /// Shown items, priority order (kept through the fold-away so the ears don't blank).
    var items: [IslandItem] = []
    /// What the silhouette is sized for (set only when they change: the level ticks the
    /// items at 24Hz while dictating, and the goo shouldn't be rebuilt for that).
    var cards = 1
    var extras = 0
    var look = IslandTermLook()

    /// Sets items and, only if they changed, the counts the silhouette depends on.
    func show(_ shown: [IslandItem]) {
        items = shown
        let c = max(1, shown.count), e = max(0, shown.count - 1)
        if cards != c { cards = c }
        if extras != e { extras = e }
    }
}

/// The terminal's font and colors, so its card is one line of your terminal like the peek.
struct IslandTermLook: Equatable {
    var font = NSFont.monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 12, weight: .regular)
    var foreground = NSColor(white: 0.9, alpha: 1)
    var background = NSColor(red: 0.07, green: 0.07, blue: 0.09, alpha: 1)
    var done = NSColor(red: 181 / 255, green: 189 / 255, blue: 104 / 255, alpha: 1)
    var failed = NSColor(red: 204 / 255, green: 102 / 255, blue: 102 / 255, alpha: 1)
    var attention = NSColor(red: 240 / 255, green: 198 / 255, blue: 116 / 255, alpha: 1)

    func tint(_ kind: IslandNoticeKind) -> NSColor {
        switch kind { case .done: done; case .failed: failed; case .attention: attention }
    }
    static func mark(_ kind: IslandNoticeKind) -> String {
        switch kind { case .done: "✓"; case .failed: "✗"; case .attention: "•" }
    }
    static func duration(_ d: TimeInterval) -> String {
        let s = Int(d.rounded())
        if s < 60 { return "\(s)s" }
        if s < 3600 { return "\(s / 60)m \(s % 60)s" }
        return "\(s / 3600)h \(s % 3600 / 60)m"
    }
}

/// Where the island's buttons go: each one is an existing Surface action.
struct IslandActions {
    var band: () -> Void = {}
    var media: (String) -> Void = { _ in }          // "toggle" | "next" | "previous"
    var stopDictation: () -> Void = {}
    var open: (IslandItem) -> Void = { _ in }       // a terminal notice: its session
}

extension IslandBody {
    var goo: GooBody { .box(rect, top: top, bottom: bottom) }
}

/// A bundled template icon (solar-*) by name.
private func islandIcon(_ name: String) -> Image {
    Image(nsImage: NSImage(named: name) ?? NSImage()).renderingMode(.template)
}

private func clamp01(_ x: CGFloat) -> CGFloat { min(1, max(0, x)) }

struct EdgeIslandView: View {
    let state: EdgeIslandState
    var open: CGFloat
    var presence: CGFloat
    var actions = IslandActions()

    var body: some View {
        if let g = state.geometry {
            // Reads only geometry, counts and the springs: the goo is rebuilt per frame of
            // motion, not per level tick. Items are read by the band and the stack below.
            let size = IslandLayout.panelSize(g)
            let shape = IslandPath(path: IslandLayout.silhouette(g, extras: state.extras, cards: state.cards, open: open, presence: presence))
            ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
                shape.fill(Color.black)
                IslandBand(state: state, actions: actions, open: open).opacity(clamp01(presence * 1.6 - 0.3))
                IslandStack(state: state, actions: actions, reveal: IslandLayout.smoothstep(0.35, 0.92, open))
                    .allowsHitTesting(open > 0.6)
            }
            .frame(width: size.width, height: size.height, alignment: .topLeading)
            .mask(alignment: .topLeading) { shape.frame(width: size.width, height: size.height) }
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                shape.stroke(Color.white.opacity(0.1 * clamp01(open)), lineWidth: 0.75)
                    .frame(width: size.width, height: size.height).allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
        }
    }
}

/// A path computed once, drawn as fill, mask and outline.
struct IslandPath: Shape {
    let path: Path
    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path { path }
}

extension IslandLayout {
    /// The island's outline in panel coordinates: the goo closing of its bodies.
    static func silhouette(_ g: IslandGeometry, extras: Int, cards: Int, open: CGFloat, presence: CGFloat) -> Path {
        let bodies = bodies(g, extras: extras, cards: cards, open: open, presence: presence)
        guard !bodies.isEmpty else { return Path() }
        // Only the region the body can reach (the closing grid scales with its area).
        let reach = bodies.reduce(CGRect.null) { $0.union($1.rect) }.insetBy(dx: -shoulder, dy: 0)
        return GooShape(bodies: bodies.map(\.goo), blend: shoulder).path(in: reach)
    }
}

/// The notch-tall band: the ears either side of the notch; a click toggles the island.
private struct IslandBand: View {
    let state: EdgeIslandState
    let actions: IslandActions
    let open: CGFloat
    var body: some View {
        if let g = state.geometry, let top = state.items.first {
            let ear = IslandLayout.ear(g), rightEar = IslandLayout.rightEar(g, extras: state.extras)
            let x = IslandLayout.earPositions(g, extras: state.extras, cards: state.cards, open: open)
            let body = IslandLayout.bodyRect(g, extras: state.extras, cards: state.cards, open: open, presence: 1)
            ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
                Rectangle().fill(Color.clear)
                    .frame(width: max(1, body.width), height: g.band)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onTapGesture(perform: actions.band)
                    .offset(x: body.minX)
                IslandLeftEar(item: top)
                    .frame(width: ear, height: g.band)
                    .offset(x: x.left)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
                IslandRightEar(item: top, extras: Array(state.items.dropFirst()), look: state.look, readoutWidth: ear - 8)
                    .frame(width: rightEar, height: g.band)
                    .offset(x: x.right)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Below the band, revealed as the body drops: every shown item as a card.
private struct IslandStack: View {
    let state: EdgeIslandState
    let actions: IslandActions
    let reveal: CGFloat
    var body: some View {
        if let g = state.geometry {
            let expanded = IslandLayout.expandedRect(g, cards: state.cards)
            VStack(spacing: IslandLayout.gap) {
                ForEach(state.items) { IslandCard(item: $0, look: state.look, actions: actions) }
            }
            .frame(width: expanded.width - 2 * IslandLayout.gap)
            .offset(x: expanded.minX + IslandLayout.gap, y: g.band + IslandLayout.gap - 6 * (1 - reveal))
            .opacity(reveal)
        }
    }
}

extension IslandLayout {
    static func smoothstep(_ a: CGFloat, _ b: CGFloat, _ x: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let t = min(1, max(0, (x - a) / (b - a)))
        return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
    }
}

// MARK: - Ears

/// Left of the notch: what's live (its icon in its color, or the track's artwork).
private struct IslandLeftEar: View {
    let item: IslandItem
    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if case .media(_, _, _, _, let art) = item.payload, let image = art?.base as? NSImage {
                Image(nsImage: image).resizable().scaledToFill()
                    .frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous))
            } else {
                islandIcon(item.icon).resizable().scaledToFit()
                    .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(hexString: item.accentHex) ?? .white)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

/// Right of the notch: the live readout, after a dot per other live thing.
private struct IslandRightEar: View {
    let item: IslandItem
    let extras: [IslandItem]
    let look: IslandTermLook
    let readoutWidth: CGFloat

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 3) {
            ForEach(extras.prefix(IslandLayout.maxDots)) { e in
                Circle().fill(Color(hexString: e.accentHex) ?? .white).frame(width: IslandLayout.dot, height: IslandLayout.dot)
            }
            readout.frame(width: readoutWidth)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var readout: some View {
        switch item.payload {
        case .caps(let letter):
            Text("⇪" + letter).font(.pp(11, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                .padding(.horizontal, 4).padding(.vertical, 1.5)
                .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.14)))
                .fixedSize()
        case .dictation(let voice, let level, _):
            switch voice {
            case .listening:
                VoiceWaveformView(level: level, active: true, barCount: 4, span: 13).frame(width: 22, height: 20)
            case .working:
                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini).tint(.white)
            case .inserted:
                islandIcon("solar-check-circle").resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 16, height: 16)
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(hexString: IslandSnapshot.dictationAccent) ?? .green)
            case .failed:
                islandIcon("solar-danger-triangle").resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 16, height: 16).foregroundStyle(.orange)
            }
        case .terminal(let kind, _, _, _):
            Text(IslandTermLook.mark(kind)).font(Font(look.font.withSize(14))).foregroundStyle(Color(nsColor: look.tint(kind)))
        case .timer(let remaining, _):
            Text(IslandClock.short(remaining)).font(.pp(11, .bold)).monospacedDigit()
                .foregroundStyle(Color(hexString: item.accentHex) ?? .orange).fixedSize()
        case .media(let playing, let elapsed, let duration, let asOf, _):
            IslandProgressRing(playing: playing, elapsed: elapsed, duration: duration, asOf: asOf,
                               accent: Color(hexString: item.accentHex) ?? .pink)
                .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
        }
    }
}

enum IslandClock {
    static func short(_ s: TimeInterval) -> String {
        let t = Int(max(0, s).rounded(.up))
        return t >= 3600 ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", t / 3600, t / 60 % 60, t % 60) : String(format: "%d:%02d", t / 60, t % 60)
    }
    /// Elapsed now, from a reading at `asOf` that advances while playing.
    static func elapsed(_ e: Double, duration: Double, playing: Bool, asOf: Date, now: Date) -> Double {
        let v = e + (playing ? now.timeIntervalSince(asOf) : 0)
        return duration > 0 ? min(max(0, v), duration) : max(0, v)
    }
}

/// The track's position as a ring in the media color (paused: dimmer).
private struct IslandProgressRing: View {
    let playing: Bool, elapsed: Double, duration: Double, asOf: Date
    let accent: Color
    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
            let e = IslandClock.elapsed(elapsed, duration: duration, playing: playing, asOf: asOf, now: context.date)
            let f = duration > 0 ? e / duration : 0
            ZStack {
                Circle().stroke(.white.opacity(0.16), lineWidth: 2.5)
                Circle().trim(from: 0, to: f).stroke(accent.opacity(playing ? 1 : 0.5), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2.5, lineCap: .round))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Cards

/// One live thing as a card on the island: the sheet's inner-card look (white 6% on the
/// black, hairline), 16pt corners concentric with the island's 24.
private struct IslandCard: View {
    let item: IslandItem
    let look: IslandTermLook
    let actions: IslandActions

    var body: some View {
        switch item.payload {
        case .terminal(let kind, _, _, let duration):
            IslandTerminalCard(item: item, kind: kind, duration: duration, look: look) { actions.open(item) }
        default:
            HStack(spacing: IslandLayout.gap) { row }
                .padding(.horizontal, IslandLayout.gap)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .frame(height: IslandLayout.cardHeight)
                .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: IslandLayout.cardRadius, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.06)))
                .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: IslandLayout.cardRadius, style: .continuous).strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 0.75))
        }
    }

    private var accent: Color { Color(hexString: item.accentHex) ?? .white }

    @ViewBuilder private var row: some View {
        switch item.payload {
        case .caps(let letter):
            IslandTile(icon: item.icon, accent: accent)
            Text("⇪" + letter).font(.pp(12, .bold)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
                .padding(.horizontal, 6).padding(.vertical, 2)
                .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(0.1)))
            Text(item.title).font(.pp(13.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        case .dictation(let voice, let level, let transcript):
            IslandTile(icon: item.icon, accent: accent)
            if voice == .listening {
                VoiceWaveformView(level: level, active: true, barCount: 9, span: 22).frame(width: 64, height: 36)
            }
            if case .failed(let message) = voice {
                Text(message).font(.pp(12.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.orange).lineLimit(1)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            } else {
                TranscriptTicker(text: transcript, placeholder: voice == .listening ? "Listening…" : item.title)
            }
            switch voice {
            case .listening:
                IslandRoundButton(icon: "solar-stop", primary: true, action: actions.stopDictation)
            case .working:
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(.white).frame(width: 32)
            case .inserted:
                islandIcon("solar-check-circle").resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 20, height: 20).foregroundStyle(accent).frame(width: 32)
            case .failed:
                islandIcon("solar-danger-triangle").resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 20, height: 20).foregroundStyle(.orange).frame(width: 32)
            }
        case .timer(let remaining, let total):
            IslandTile(icon: item.icon, accent: accent)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 5) {
                Text(item.title).font(.pp(13, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
                IslandBar(fraction: total > 0 ? 1 - remaining / total : 0, accent: accent)
            }
            Text(IslandClock.short(remaining)).font(.pp(15, .bold)).monospacedDigit().foregroundStyle(accent)
        case .media(let playing, let elapsed, let duration, let asOf, let art):
            if let image = art?.base as? NSImage {
                Image(nsImage: image).resizable().scaledToFill().frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous))
            } else {
                IslandTile(icon: item.icon, accent: accent)
            }
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(item.title).font(.pp(13, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.white).lineLimit(1)
                if !item.detail.isEmpty { Text(item.detail).font(.pp(11, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55)).lineLimit(1) }
                TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
                    let e = IslandClock.elapsed(elapsed, duration: duration, playing: playing, asOf: asOf, now: context.date)
                    IslandBar(fraction: duration > 0 ? e / duration : 0, accent: accent)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            HStack(spacing: 2) {
                IslandRoundButton(icon: "solar-skip-previous") { actions.media("previous") }
                IslandRoundButton(icon: playing ? "solar-pause" : "solar-play", primary: true) { actions.media("toggle") }
                IslandRoundButton(icon: "solar-skip-next") { actions.media("next") }
            }
        case .terminal:
            EmptyView()
        }
    }
}

/// The modules grid's colored tile, at card scale.
private struct IslandTile: View {
    let icon: String
    let accent: Color
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous).fill(accent)
            islandIcon(icon).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 20, height: 20).foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .frame(width: IslandLayout.tile, height: IslandLayout.tile)
    }
}

private struct IslandBar: View {
    let fraction: Double
    let accent: Color
    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.14))
                Capsule().fill(accent).frame(width: max(3, geo.size.width * CGFloat(min(1, max(0, fraction)))))
            }
        }
        .frame(height: 3)
    }
}

/// The media card's round controls, smaller: white primary, glass-gray others; wobble on press.
private struct IslandRoundButton: View {
    let icon: String
    var primary = false
    let action: () -> Void
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            islandIcon(icon).resizable().scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: primary ? 15 : 13, height: primary ? 15 : 13)
                .foregroundStyle(primary ? .black : .white)
                .frame(width: primary ? 34 : 28, height: primary ? 34 : 28)
                .background(Circle().fill(primary ? .white : .white.opacity(0.08)))
                .contentShape(Circle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressWobble())
    }
}

/// The needs-you peek's line, as a card: your terminal's font and colors, mark, command,
/// last line, how long it took, after a tile in the mark's color like the other cards. Click to open the session (it sinks 2pt like the peek).
private struct IslandTerminalCard: View {
    let item: IslandItem
    let kind: IslandNoticeKind
    let duration: TimeInterval?
    let look: IslandTermLook
    let onOpen: () -> Void
    @State private var pressed = false

    var body: some View {
        let fg = Color(nsColor: look.foreground)
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: IslandLayout.cardRadius, style: .continuous)
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            IslandTile(icon: item.icon, accent: Color(nsColor: look.tint(kind))).padding(.trailing, IslandLayout.gap)
            Text(IslandTermLook.mark(kind)).foregroundStyle(Color(nsColor: look.tint(kind)))
            Text(" " + item.title).foregroundStyle(fg)
            if !item.detail.isEmpty { Text("  " + item.detail).foregroundStyle(fg.opacity(0.5)) }
            Spacer(minLength: 12)
            if let duration { Text(IslandTermLook.duration(duration)).foregroundStyle(fg.opacity(0.5)) }
        }
        .font(Font(look.font))
        .lineLimit(1)
        .truncationMode(.middle)
        .padding(.leading, IslandLayout.gap).padding(.trailing, 14)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .frame(height: IslandLayout.cardHeight)
        .background(Color(nsColor: look.background), in: shape)
        .overlay(shape.strokeBorder(fg.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .offset(y: pressed ? 2 : 0)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.16, dampingFraction: 0.6), value: pressed)
        .contentShape(shape)
        .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0, pressing: { pressed = $0 }, perform: onOpen)
    }
}
//
//  RootView.swift
//  The window: bento sidebar + the page card. ALL browser chrome (nav, URL,
//  split, extensions, tools) lives in the hover notch on the page card's top
//  border; the traffic lights belong to the sidebar and hide with it.
//
//  Everything here is a pure function of `engine.snapshot`; user actions are
//  just Commands sent back to the core. This is the layer meant to be torn down
//  and rebuilt freely — none of the robustness lives here. The tab UI itself
//  lives in BentoSidebar.swift.
//

import AppKit
import ImageIO
import QuartzCore
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Snapshot view helpers

extension Snapshot {
    /// The active tab in the active space, resolved from the tree.
    func activeTab() -> Tab? {
        guard let space = activeSpaceSnapshot, let activeId = space.space.activeTab else { return nil }
        return Snapshot.findTab(activeId, in: space.tabs)
    }

    static func findTab(_ id: String, in nodes: [TabNode]) -> Tab? {
        for node in nodes {
            if node.tab.id == id { return node.tab }
            if let found = findTab(id, in: node.children) { return found }
        }
        return nil
    }
}

// MARK: - Root

struct RootView: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(FaviconStore.self) private var favicons
    @Environment(ImportModel.self) private var importModel
    @Environment(ShortcutsModel.self) private var shortcuts
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glanceModel
    @Environment(SubTabSwitcher.self) private var switcherModel
    let web: WebContentManager
    @Environment(SidebarModel.self) private var sidebar
    @State private var splitState = SplitState.none
    @State private var sidebarPeek = false
    @State private var historyModel = HistoryModel.shared

    /// Sessions pinned to specific tabs die with them: a glance peeking a
    /// closed tab would orphan its webview, a switcher session would cycle
    /// ghosts.
    private func syncSplit(_ activeId: String?) {
        guard let activeId else { return }
        if let l = SplitStore.shared.layout(containing: activeId) {
            let want = SplitState(layout: l)
            if splitState != want { splitState = want }
        } else if !splitState.isEmpty, !splitState.contains(activeId) {
            splitState = .none
        }
    }

    private func pruneTabSessions() {
        guard let snapshot = engine.snapshot else { return }
        var ids = Set<String>()
        for space in snapshot.spaces {
            for tab in flattenTabs(space.tabs) { ids.insert(tab.id) }
        }
        if let glanced = glanceModel.tabId, !ids.contains(glanced) {
            glanceModel.close()
        }
        switcherModel.prune(existing: ids)
    }

    var body: some View {
        let sidebarBinding = Binding(get: { sidebar.visible }, set: { sidebar.visible = $0 })
        // The page card's leading gutter is visually part of the sidebar. Give
        // that space to the sidebar's layout too, so tab cards are centered in
        // the column people actually see, while the page itself stays put.
        let sidebarColumnWidth = sidebar.width + BentoMetrics.gutter
        return ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
            HStack(spacing: 0) {
                // The sidebar stays mounted and slides under a clip when
                // collapsed, so panel, content, and the detail edge all move
                // as one animated unit (conditional insertion popped the
                // background and jittered the detail's right side).
                BentoSidebar(web: web, splitState: $splitState, sidebarVisible: sidebarBinding, downloads: web.downloads)
                    .frame(width: sidebarColumnWidth)
                    .frame(width: sidebar.visible ? sidebarColumnWidth : 0, alignment: .trailing)
                    .clipped()
                    .overlay(alignment: .trailing) {
                        // Keep the edge mounted through the width transition;
                        // conditionally inserting it made a one-frame vertical
                        // artifact at the end of every collapse/expand.
                        SidebarResizeHandle()
                            .opacity(sidebar.visible ? 1 : 0)
                            .allowsHitTesting(sidebar.visible)
                    }
                DetailView(web: web, splitState: $splitState)
            }

            // Closed sidebar: hovering the left edge peeks it back. The peek
            // IS the sidebar — full height, traffic lights riding its top,
            // nothing rendered above it; the whole panel moves as one unit.
            if !sidebar.visible {
                Color.clear.frame(width: 6).frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onHover { if $0 { sidebarPeek = true } }
                if sidebarPeek {
                    BentoSidebar(web: web, splitState: $splitState, sidebarVisible: sidebarBinding, downloads: web.downloads)
                        .frame(width: sidebarColumnWidth)
                        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                        .background(GlassPanel(material: .sidebar))
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.45), radius: 30, x: 10)
                        .transition(.move(edge: .leading))
                        .onHover { if !$0 { sidebarPeek = false } }
                        .zIndex(2)
                }
            }
        }
        .animation(DesignTokens.sidebarAnimation, value: sidebar.visible)
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: sidebarPeek)
        .preferredColorScheme(.dark)
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
        .onChange(of: engine.snapshot?.rev) { pruneTabSessions() }
        .overlay {
            if importModel.isOpen {
                BrowserPickerView(web: web, model: importModel).transition(.move(edge: .bottom))
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            if shortcuts.isOpen {
                ShortcutsOverlay().transition(.move(edge: .bottom))
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            if historyModel.isOpen {
                HistoryOverlay().transition(.move(edge: .bottom))
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.14), value: importModel.isOpen)
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.16), value: shortcuts.isOpen)
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.16), value: historyModel.isOpen)
        .onChange(of: engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.id) { _, _ in
            // A split is scoped to one workspace; retaining its old tab ids
            // after ⌘1–⌘9 would render tabs from the workspace just left.
            splitState = .none
            syncSplit(engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.activeTab)
        }
        // Splits are persistent layouts: going to a tab that's in one brings the split
        // back; going to any other tab shows just that tab (the split stays as its card).
        .onChange(of: engine.snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.activeTab) { _, id in syncSplit(id) }
        .onChange(of: engine.snapshot?.rev) { _, _ in
            guard let snapshot = engine.snapshot else { return }
            let ids = Set(snapshot.spaces.flatMap { flattenTabs($0.tabs).map(\.id) })
            SplitStore.shared.prune(validTabIds: ids)
            if !splitState.isEmpty, !splitState.tabs.allSatisfy(ids.contains) {
                splitState = SplitStore.shared.layout(containing: splitState.tabs.first(where: ids.contains) ?? "").map(SplitState.init(layout:)) ?? .none
            }
        }
        // The hover peek brings the traffic lights back with it — a sidebar
        // you can see must also be a sidebar you can close the window from.
        .modifier(WindowControlsTransition(
            progress: (sidebar.visible || sidebarPeek) ? 1 : 0,
            sidebarWidth: sidebarColumnWidth
        ))
        .animation(DesignTokens.sidebarAnimation, value: sidebar.visible)
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: sidebarPeek)
    }
}

/// Bridges the sidebar's animated width into the native traffic-light buttons.
/// Native controls live outside SwiftUI layout, so they need the same movement
/// applied explicitly or page content visibly slides underneath stationary,
/// fading buttons.
private struct WindowControlsTransition: AnimatableModifier {
    var progress: CGFloat
    let sidebarWidth: CGFloat

    var animatableData: CGFloat {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content.background(
            WindowControlsPosition(progress: progress, sidebarWidth: sidebarWidth)
                .frame(width: 0, height: 0)
        )
    }
}

private struct WindowControlsPosition: NSViewRepresentable {
    let progress: CGFloat
    let sidebarWidth: CGFloat

    final class ControlsView: NSView {
        var progress: CGFloat = 1
        var sidebarWidth: CGFloat = BentoMetrics.sidebarWidth
        private var observers: [NSObjectProtocol] = []

        override func viewDidMoveToWindow() {
            super.viewDidMoveToWindow()
            observers.forEach(NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver)
            observers.removeAll()
            if let window {
                let names: [Notification.Name] = [
                    NSWindow.didResizeNotification,
                    NSWindow.didBecomeKeyNotification,
                    NSWindow.didEnterFullScreenNotification,
                    NSWindow.didExitFullScreenNotification,
                ]
                observers = names.map { name in
                    NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
                        forName: name, object: window, queue: .main
                    ) { [weak self] _ in self?.apply() }
                }
            }
            apply()
        }

        deinit {
            observers.forEach(NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver)
        }

        func apply() {
            guard let window else { return }
            let value = min(1, max(0, progress))
            let buttons = [NSWindow.ButtonType.closeButton, .miniaturizeButton, .zoomButton]
                .compactMap { window.standardWindowButton($0) }
            guard let titlebar = buttons.first?.superview else { return }

            // These values align the native centers with the 46pt sidebar
            // chrome row. AppKit's default placement sits visibly too high.
            let leftInset: CGFloat = 13
            let horizontalStep: CGFloat = 20
            let downwardNudge: CGFloat = 6
            // The sidebar's fixed-width contents are trailing-aligned inside
            // an animated-width clip. Moving by this exact same distance
            // keeps the native controls on the same presentation frame as
            // every SwiftUI element beside them.
            let collapsedOffset = -sidebarWidth * (1 - value)
            let centeredY = (titlebar.bounds.height - (buttons.first?.frame.height ?? 14)) / 2
            let y = titlebar.isFlipped ? centeredY + downwardNudge : centeredY - downwardNudge

            for (index, button) in buttons.enumerated() {
                if value > 0.001 { button.isHidden = false }
                button.alphaValue = 1
                let target = NSPoint(
                    x: leftInset + CGFloat(index) * horizontalStep + collapsedOffset,
                    y: y
                )
                if button.frame.origin != target { button.setFrameOrigin(target) }
                if value <= 0.001 { button.isHidden = true }
            }
        }
    }

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> ControlsView {
        let view = ControlsView(frame: .zero)
        view.progress = progress
        view.sidebarWidth = sidebarWidth
        return view
    }

    func updateNSView(_ view: ControlsView, context: Context) {
        view.progress = progress
        view.sidebarWidth = sidebarWidth
        view.apply()
    }
}

/// Invisible grab strip on the sidebar's trailing edge — drag to resize,
/// double-click to snap back to the default width.
private struct SidebarResizeHandle: View {
    @Environment(SidebarModel.self) private var sidebar
    @State private var startWidth: CGFloat?
    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        // Straddles the sidebar/detail seam instead of lying over the pills'
        // trailing edge — the visible line must never overlap (or appear to
        // displace) sidebar content.
        Rectangle()
            .fill(Color.white.opacity(hovering ? 0.10 : 0))
            .frame(width: 3)
            .offset(x: 1.5)
            .contentShape(Rectangle().inset(by: -3))
            .onHover { h in
                hovering = h
                if h { NSCursor.resizeLeftRight.push() } else { NSCursor.pop() }
            }
            .gesture(
                DragGesture(minimumDistance: 1, coordinateSpace: .global)
                    .onChanged { value in
                        let base = startWidth ?? sidebar.width
                        if startWidth == nil { startWidth = base }
                        sidebar.width = base + value.translation.width
                    }
                    .onEnded { _ in startWidth = nil }
            )
            .onTapGesture(count: 2) { sidebar.width = BentoMetrics.sidebarWidth }
    }
}

// MARK: - Detail (toolbar + web content)

struct DetailView: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    @Environment(FindModel.self) private var find
    let web: WebContentManager
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState

    init(web: WebContentManager, splitState: Binding<SplitState>) {
        self.web = web
        self._splitState = splitState
    }

    var isSplit: Bool { !splitState.isEmpty }

    var body: some View {
        let snapshot = engine.snapshot
        let activeTab = snapshot?.activeTab()

        // No standing toolbar: the page owns the whole detail area as a
        // rounded card. The surrounding gutter and the emerging chrome use
        // the same behind-window material; the webpage never becomes the
        // notch's blur source.
        GeometryReader { geo in
            // Upper bound only: the capsule hugs its content and never
            // outgrows the detail column's 8pt gutters.
            let notchMaxW = max(0, min(760, geo.size.width - 16))
            Group {
                if isSplit {
                    SplitContentView(
                        web: web,
                        snapshot: snapshot,
                        splitState: $splitState,
                        glance: glance,
                        find: find,
                        activeTab: activeTab
                    )
                } else {
                    SinglePaneView(
                        web: web,
                        snapshot: snapshot,
                        activeTab: activeTab
                    )
                    .onChange(of: activeTab?.host) { _, host in
                        web.passwords.refreshFillable(forHost: host)
                    }
                    // Drag a sidebar tab onto the page: the half it would take lights up,
                    // and dropping starts a split with the tab you're on.
                    .overlay {
                        if let activeTab {
                            GeometryReader { g in
                                SplitDropLayer(panes: [SplitPaneFrame(tabId: activeTab.id, rect: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: g.size))],
                                               full: false, splitState: $splitState)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))   // 24pt shell − 8pt gap
            .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                ToastStack()
            }
            // The leading gutter belongs to the sidebar column so its cards
            // and the page border share one visual centerline.
            .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 48, leading: 0, bottom: 8, trailing: 8))   // 8 + 32pt capsule + 8
            // Mounted OUTSIDE the card padding: the hover sensor must live on
            // the SwiftUI-owned gutter strip, not over the WKWebView — the
            // webview owns its own tracking areas and eats hover, which made
            // the notch unreachable. The notch itself still hangs down over
            // the card's top border.
            .overlay(alignment: .top) {
                HoverChrome(activeTab: activeTab, web: web, splitState: $splitState,
                            maxWidth: notchMaxW)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

// MARK: - Continuous window glass

/// Both chrome blobs use the exact same NSVisualEffectView material and
/// behind-window blend as the root gutter. Masking that view to the organic
/// silhouette keeps the web page out of the blur sample, so there is no colour
/// discontinuity at the join and the result remains real liquid glass.
enum ChromeGlassKind: Equatable {
    case topNotch
    case cornerToast
}

struct ChromeGlassSurface: View {
    let kind: ChromeGlassKind
    var progress: CGFloat = 1
    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch kind {
            case .topNotch:
                Color.clear.glassEffect(.regular, in: NotchShape(cornerRadius: 14, flare: 14, edge: .top, progress: progress))
            case .cornerToast:
                Color.clear.glassEffect(.regular, in: CornerNotchShape(cornerRadius: 15, flare: 14, progress: progress))
            }
        }.environment(\.appearsActive, true).allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}

/// The MacBook-notch silhouette: a slab hanging off a border whose outer
/// corners flare OUTWARD (opposing curvature), so the glass melts into the
/// card edge instead of floating in front of it.
///
/// `progress` is animatable: at 0 the slab is fully absorbed into the border,
/// at 1 fully emerged. Animating it grows the shape organically out of the
/// edge — flares first, then the body extends — rather than sliding a
/// pre-formed notch into place. Clip the content to the same shape so the
/// growth reveals it.
struct NotchShape: Shape {
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 14
    var flare: CGFloat = 14
    var edge: VerticalEdge = .top
    var progress: CGFloat = 1
    var animatableData: CGFloat {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        // Two-phase emergence: vertical leads, width joins in — the slab
        // pushes straight out of the border first, then swells diagonally to
        // its full footprint. Progress is deliberately not clamped above 1 so
        // a springy animation overshoots and settles back.
        let pr = max(0, progress)
        let h = rect.height * pr
        guard h > 0.5 else { return Path() }
        let widthPhase = min(max((pr - 0.35) / 0.65, 0), 2)
        let w = rect.width * (0.55 + 0.45 * widthPhase)
        let x0 = (rect.width - w) / 2
        let f = min(flare, w / 4, h)
        let r = min(cornerRadius, h / 2)
        // Overdraw the host card's one-point rim. Ending exactly on y=0 left
        // two independently antialiased edges fighting at the join, producing
        // a pale thread/fray at each flare.
        let seamY: CGFloat = -1.25
        var p = Path()
        p.move(to: CGPoint(x: x0, y: seamY))
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + f, y: f), control: CGPoint(x: x0 + f, y: seamY))
        if h - r > f { p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + f, y: h - r)) }
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + f + r, y: h), control: CGPoint(x: x0 + f, y: h))
        p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + w - f - r, y: h))
