        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + w - f, y: h - r), control: CGPoint(x: x0 + w - f, y: h))
        if h - r > f { p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + w - f, y: f)) }
        p.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: x0 + w, y: seamY), control: CGPoint(x: x0 + w - f, y: seamY))
        p.closeSubpath()
        if edge == .bottom {
            p = p.applying(CGAffineTransform(a: 1, b: 0, c: 0, d: -1, tx: 0, ty: rect.height))
        }
        return p
    }
}

/// The one browser chrome surface: a liquid-glass notch that grows out of
/// the page card's top border when the top strip is hovered, in both sidebar
/// states. Nav, the URL (click to edit in the palette), split, extensions
/// and tools all live here.
private struct HoverChrome: View {
    @Environment(CoreEngine.self) private var engine
    @Environment(SpotlightModel.self) private var spotlight
    @Environment(\.openSettings) private var openSettingsAction
    let activeTab: Tab?
    let web: WebContentManager
    @Binding var splitState: SplitState
    let maxWidth: CGFloat
    var body: some View {
        // The glass wraps the HStack's own size (not a fixed width), and the
        // outer frame only caps it, so narrow windows compress the URL slot
        // instead of clipping buttons off the capsule's ends.
        notchContent
            .padding(.horizontal, 8)
            .frame(height: 32)
            .glassEffect(.regular, in: Capsule())
            .overlay(Capsule().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.16), lineWidth: 0.75))
            .frame(maxWidth: maxWidth)
            .padding(.top, 8)
    }

    private var notchContent: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 4) {
            ToolbarButton(icon: "arrow-left", label: "Back", disabled: !web.canGoBack) { web.goBack() }
            ToolbarButton(icon: "arrow-right", label: "Forward", disabled: !web.canGoForward) { web.goForward() }
            if activeTab?.loadState == .loading {
                ToolbarButton(icon: "x-mark", label: "Stop loading") { web.stopLoading() }
            } else {
                ToolbarButton(icon: "arrow-path", label: "Reload", disabled: activeTab == nil) { web.reload() }
            }
            if let tab = activeTab {
                HStack(spacing: 0) {
                    SiteProtectionButton(
                        web: web, activeTab: tab,
                        openSettings: { openSettingsAction() })
                    Rectangle().fill(.white.opacity(0.08)).frame(width: 1, height: 14)
                    Button {
                        spotlight.requestNavigate(tabId: tab.id,
                                                   text: OptionDeepLink.canonicalURLString(tab.url))
                    } label: {
                        HStack(spacing: 6) {
                            if tab.loadState == .loading {
                                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini)
                            }
                            Text(tab.host ?? chromeDisplayURL(tab))
                                .font(.pp(12.5))
                                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                                .lineLimit(1)
                                .truncationMode(.middle)
                        }
                        .padding(.leading, 8).padding(.trailing, 12)
                        .frame(height: 26)
                        .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .help("\(OptionDeepLink.canonicalURLString(tab.url)) · Edit in the command bar (⌘L)")
                    .accessibilityLabel("Edit address")
                }
                .frame(minWidth: 120, maxWidth: 460)
                .layoutPriority(-1)
                .background(Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.07)))
            } else {
                Text("New tab")
                    .font(.pp(12.5))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                    .frame(minWidth: 120)
            }
            if !splitState.isEmpty {
                ToolbarButton(icon: "x-mark", label: "Unsplit") {
                    if let l = SplitStore.shared.layout(containing: splitState.left) { SplitStore.shared.remove(l.id) }
                    splitState = .none
                }
            }
            PasswordKeyButton(web: web, activeHost: activeTab?.host)
            // Two at most in the capsule; the rest live in the Tools popover.
            ExtensionsToolbarButton(maxVisible: 2)
            ToolsButton(web: web, activeTab: activeTab, openSettings: { openSettingsAction() })
        }
    }
}

private struct SiteProtectionButton: View {
    let web: WebContentManager
    let activeTab: Tab
    let openSettings: () -> Void
    @State private var shield = Shield.shared
    @State private var open = false
    @State private var enabled = true
    @State private var siteCookieCount: Int?

    private var host: String { activeTab.host?.lowercased() ?? "this site" }
    private var isYouTube: Bool { AdBlockCompatibility.isYouTubeDocumentHost(host) }
    private var summary: ShieldSiteSummary { shield.summary(tabId: activeTab.id, host: host) }
    private let green = Color(red: 0.42, green: 0.86, blue: 0.62)

    var body: some View {
        Button { open.toggle() } label: {
            ZStack {
                Icon("shield-check", size: 12)
                    .foregroundStyle(enabled ? green : .white.opacity(0.35))
                if !enabled {
                    Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.55)).frame(width: 14, height: 1.2)
                        .rotationEffect(.degrees(-45))
                }
            }
            .frame(width: 28, height: 26)
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle(active: open))
        .help(enabled ? "Protection is on for \(host)" : "Protection is off for \(host)")
        .accessibilityLabel("Site protection")
        .onAppear { sync() }
        .onChange(of: activeTab.id) { _, _ in sync() }
        .onChange(of: activeTab.host) { _, _ in sync() }
        .popover(isPresented: $open, arrowEdge: .bottom) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                HStack(spacing: 11) {
                    ZStack {
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 11)
                            .fill(enabled ? green.opacity(0.13) : .white.opacity(0.06))
                        Icon("shield-check", size: 17)
                            .foregroundStyle(enabled ? green : .secondary)
                    }
                    .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                        Text(host).font(.pp(13.5, .semibold)).lineLimit(1)
                        Text(enabled ? "Protection active" : "Protection paused")
                            .font(.pp(10.5, .medium))
                            .foregroundStyle(enabled ? green.opacity(0.9) : .secondary)
                    }
                    Spacer()
                    Toggle("", isOn: $enabled)
                        .labelsHidden()
                        .toggleStyle(.switch)
                        .controlSize(.mini)
                        .onChange(of: enabled) { _, value in
                            guard value != web.protectionEnabled(for: activeTab) else { return }
                            web.setSiteProtection(value, for: activeTab)
                        }
                }
                .padding(15)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Label(activeTab.url.hasPrefix("https://") ? "Encrypted connection" : "Connection is not HTTPS",
                          systemImage: activeTab.url.hasPrefix("https://") ? "lock" : "lock.open")
                    if let count = siteCookieCount { Text("\(count) cookies for this site · current profile") }
                    Text("Saved passwords use this app’s macOS Keychain vault.")
                }.font(.pp(10.5)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).padding(.horizontal, 15).padding(.bottom, 12)
                    .onAppear {
                        siteCookieCount = nil
                        web.liveWebView(for: activeTab.id)?.configuration.websiteDataStore.httpCookieStore.getAllCookies { cookies in
                            siteCookieCount = cookies.filter { cookie in
                                let domain = cookie.domain.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: ".")).lowercased()
                                return host == domain || host.hasSuffix("." + domain)
                            }.count
                        }
                    }

                Divider()

                HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 0) {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                        Text("\(summary.pageBlocked)")
                            .font(.pp(30, .semibold))
                            .contentTransition(.numericText())
                        Text("blocked on this page")
                            .font(.pp(10.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    Spacer()
                    VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 2) {
                        Text("\(summary.siteSessionBlocked)").font(.pp(16, .semibold))
                        Text("this site · session").font(.pp(10)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 15).padding(.vertical, 13)
                .opacity(enabled ? 1 : 0.42)

                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    actionButton("Block element", systemIcon: "scope") {
                        open = false
                        _ = web.startElementPicker(for: activeTab)
                    }
                    .disabled(!enabled)
                    if summary.userRuleCount > 0 {
                        actionButton("Undo", systemIcon: "arrow.uturn.backward") {
                            _ = web.undoLastElementBlock(for: activeTab)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 15).padding(.bottom, 13)

                Divider()

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 9) {
                    HStack {
                        Text("RECENT ACTIVITY").font(.pp(10, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        Spacer()
                        if !summary.recent.isEmpty {
                            Button("Clear") { shield.clearActivity(tabId: activeTab.id, host: host) }
                                .buttonStyle(.plain).font(.pp(10, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                    if summary.recent.isEmpty {
                        HStack(spacing: 8) {
                            Image(systemName: enabled ? "checkmark.shield" : "pause.circle")
                                .foregroundStyle(enabled ? green.opacity(0.8) : .secondary)
                            Text(enabled ? "Quiet so far. Activity appears here as Nardo removes page clutter or stops script-driven requests." : "Turn protection on to see activity.")
                                .font(.pp(10.5)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                        }
                        .padding(.vertical, 3)
                    } else {
                        ForEach(summary.recent.prefix(5)) { item in activityRow(item) }
                    }
                }
                .padding(15)

                Divider()

                VStack(spacing: 7) {
                    protectionRow("Network filters", detail: isYouTube ? "YouTube-safe" : "EasyList · uBO · AdGuard")
                    protectionRow("Page cleanup", detail: "Cosmetic + procedural")
                    protectionRow(isYouTube ? "Player-safe pruning" : "Anti-adblock", detail: isYouTube ? "Metadata only" : "Maintained scriptlets")
                    if summary.userRuleCount > 0 {
                        protectionRow("Your element rules", detail: "\(summary.userRuleCount) for this site")
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 15).padding(.vertical, 12)
                .opacity(enabled ? 1 : 0.42)

                Divider()
                Button {
                    open = false
                    openSettings()
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Icon("cog-6-tooth", size: 12)
                        Text("Privacy settings…").font(.pp(11.5, .medium))
                        Spacer()
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, 15).padding(.vertical, 11)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
            }
            .frame(width: 340)
        }
    }

    private func sync() {
        enabled = web.protectionEnabled(for: activeTab)
    }

    private func protectionRow(_ title: String, detail: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Circle().fill(enabled ? Color.green.opacity(0.75) : .secondary.opacity(0.45))
                .frame(width: 5, height: 5)
            Text(title).font(.pp(11.2, .medium))
            Spacer()
            Text(detail).font(.pp(9.5)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).lineLimit(1)
        }
    }

    private func actionButton(_ title: String, systemIcon: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Image(systemName: systemIcon).font(.system(size: 10.5, weight: .semibold))
                Text(title).font(.pp(10.5, .semibold))
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity).padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8).fill(.white.opacity(0.065)))
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func activityRow(_ item: ShieldActivity) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 9) {
            Image(systemName: activityIcon(item.kind))
                .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(activityColor(item.kind))
                .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                .background(Circle().fill(activityColor(item.kind).opacity(0.12)))
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                Text(activityTitle(item.kind)).font(.pp(10.5, .medium))
                Text(item.detail).font(.pp(9)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).lineLimit(1)
            }
            Spacer()
            Text(item.count > 1 ? "×\(item.count)" : "")
                .font(.pp(9.5, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    private func activityTitle(_ kind: ShieldActivity.Kind) -> String {
        switch kind {
        case .cosmetic: "Page clutter removed"
        case .scriptlet: "Anti-adblock neutralized"
        case .network: "Script request stopped"
        case .popup: "Popup stopped"
        case .manual: "Element blocked"
        }
    }

    private func activityIcon(_ kind: ShieldActivity.Kind) -> String {
        switch kind {
        case .cosmetic: "eye.slash"
        case .scriptlet: "wand.and.stars"
        case .network: "network.slash"
        case .popup: "macwindow.badge.xmark"
        case .manual: "scope"
        }
    }

    private func activityColor(_ kind: ShieldActivity.Kind) -> Color {
        switch kind {
        case .manual: .orange
        case .popup: .pink
        default: green
        }
    }
}

/// Host-first URL text for chrome surfaces; the palette holds the full string.
func chromeDisplayURL(_ tab: Tab) -> String {
    OptionDeepLink.canonicalURLString(tab.url)
        .replacingOccurrences(of: "https://", with: "")
        .replacingOccurrences(of: "http://", with: "")
}

/// Single-tab content with card styling and overlays.
private struct SinglePaneView: View {
    let web: WebContentManager
    let snapshot: Snapshot?
    let activeTab: Tab?
    @Environment(GlanceModel.self) private var glance
    @Environment(FindModel.self) private var find

    var body: some View {
        let isBlank = (activeTab?.url.isEmpty ?? true) || activeTab?.url == "about:blank"
        let isNative = activeTab.map { NativeSurfaceRegistry.shared.isNative($0.url) } ?? false
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if isBlank {
                NewTabPage()
            } else if isNative, let tab = activeTab {
                NativeSurfaceHost(tab: tab)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .clipped()
            } else {
	                WebHostView(
	                    manager: web,
	                    snapshot: snapshot,
	                    activeTabId: snapshot?.activeSpaceSnapshot?.space.activeTab
                    )
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
	                .clipped()
                .overlay {
                    GlanceOverlay(web: web, glance: glance)
                        .animation(DesignTokens.glancePop, value: glance.tabId)
                }
                .overlay(alignment: .top) {
                    SavePasswordBanner(web: web)
                        .animation(.spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.85),
                                   value: web.passwords.pendingSave)
                }
                // Find bar and store banner share the top-trailing corner:
                // stacked, so the banner slides below an open find bar
                // instead of rendering underneath it.
                .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                    VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 8) {
                        if find.isOpen {
                            FindBar(web: web)
                                .transition(.move(edge: .top).combined(with: .opacity))
                        }
                        StoreInstallBanner(activeUrl: activeTab?.url)
                    }
                    .padding(.top, 8).padding(.trailing, 8)
                    .animation(.spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: activeTab?.url)
                }
                .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                    ZoomHUD(web: web)
                }
                .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.8), value: find.isOpen)
	            }
	        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        // Over the page, not above it: inserting it into the stack moved the page 1.5pt
        // down at the start of every load and back at the end.
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            if !isBlank && !isNative {
                ProgressHairline(progress: web.progress.value(for: activeTab?.id)).allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
        }
	    }
	}

/// Split-view content: two webviews side-by-side with a draggable divider.
/// The hairline under the toolbar, doubling as the page-load progress bar:
/// a bright segment sweeps across it while the active tab loads, then fades.
struct ProgressHairline: View {
    let progress: Double?

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let progress {
                GeometryReader { geo in
                    ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                        Rectangle()
                            .fill(.white.opacity(0.65))
                            .frame(width: geo.size.width * min(1, max(0.06, progress)))
                            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3), value: progress)
                    }
                }
                .frame(height: 1.5)
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25), value: progress == nil)
    }
}

/// A toolbar icon button — matte icon with a hover/active chip behind it.
struct ToolbarButton: View {
    let icon: String
    let label: String
    var active: Bool = false
    var disabled: Bool = false
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Icon(icon, size: 13)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(disabled ? 0.25 : (active ? 1.0 : 0.7)))
                .frame(width: BentoMetrics.iconChip, height: 26)
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle(active: active))
        .disabled(disabled)
        .help(label)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }
}

// MARK: - Clipboard card (raycastish clipboard, reused inside Spotlight)

/// One clipboard card — header (type/time/source, accent) over a content preview.
/// Double-click copies (then `onCopy`); drag pulls the item out; right-click =
/// pin/copy/delete. Used by the Spotlight clipboard feed.
struct ClipCard: View {
    let item: ClipboardStore.Item
    let store: ClipboardStore
    let onCopy: () -> Void
    var onHoverChange: (Bool) -> Void = { _ in }
    var compact = false
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 12
    /// Card side; tool workspaces size cards so their 8pt gutters stay exact.
    var side: CGFloat = 180
    @State private var hovering = false

    private static var thumbCache: [String: NSImage?] = [:]

    private var accent: Color {
        Color(hue: BentoPalette.hue(for: item.sourceBundleID ?? item.sourceName ?? item.kind.rawValue),
              saturation: 0.55, brightness: 0.82)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            preview
            metadataPill
        }
        .background(Color(white: 0.10))
	        .frame(width: side, height: compact ? 120 : side)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius, style: .continuous))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius, style: .continuous)
            .strokeBorder(hovering ? accent.opacity(0.9) : .white.opacity(0.10),
                          lineWidth: hovering ? 2 : 1))
        // No hover scale, no accent glow — just a flat, static drop shadow.
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 3, y: 2)
        .onHover { h in
            onHoverChange(h)
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.16)) { hovering = h }
        }
        .onDisappear { if hovering { onHoverChange(false) } }
        .onTapGesture(count: 2) { store.putOnPasteboard(item); onCopy() }
        .onDrag { ShelfEdge.shared.ownDragBegan(); return dragProvider() }
        .contextMenu {
            Button(item.pinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin") {
                store.setPinned(id: item.id, pinned: !item.pinned)
            }
            Button("Copy") { store.putOnPasteboard(item); onCopy() }
            if item.kind != .image {
                Button("Copy as Plain Text") { store.putOnPasteboardAsPlainText(item); onCopy() }
            } else if let hash = item.blobHash {
                Button("Copy Text") { copyImageText(hash: hash) }
            }
            Divider()
            Button("Delete", role: .destructive) { store.delete(id: item.id) }
            if let bundle = item.sourceBundleID {
                Button("Never Record from \(item.sourceName ?? "This App")", role: .destructive) {
                    ClipboardPrivacy.setIgnored(bundle, true)
                    store.deleteAll(fromBundle: bundle)
                }
            }
        }
        .help("Double-click to copy")
    }

    private var metadataPill: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 5) {
            if let icon = sourceIcon { Image(nsImage: icon).resizable().frame(width: 14, height: 14) }
            Text(typeLabel).font(.pp(10.5, .semibold)).lineLimit(1)
            if item.pinned { Image(systemName: "pin.fill").font(.system(size: 8)) }
            Spacer(minLength: 2)
            Text(timeAgo).font(.pp(9)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75)).lineLimit(1)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 32, maxHeight: 32)
        .background(accent.opacity(0.3), in: Capsule())
        .overlay(Capsule().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 0.75))
        .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.bottom, 8)
    }

    private var preview: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color(white: 0.10)
            content
                .padding(.horizontal, item.kind == .text ? 18 : 10).padding(.vertical, item.kind == .text ? 14 : 8)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var content: some View {
        switch item.kind {
        case .image:
            if let img = Self.thumbnail(item, store: store) {
                Image(nsImage: img).resizable().interpolation(.low)
                    .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: max(4, cornerRadius - 10), style: .continuous))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    // Found by the text inside it: show where.
                    .overlay(alignment: .bottom) { if let match = item.imageMatch { imageMatchLabel(match) } }
            } else {
                Image(systemName: "photo").font(.system(size: 22))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.25))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            }
        case .color:
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(Color(hexString: item.text) ?? .gray)
                    .frame(height: 56)
                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8, style: .continuous)
                        .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.15)))
                Text(item.text).font(.system(size: 11, design: .monospaced))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
            }
        case .url:
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(URL(string: item.text)?.host ?? item.text)
                    .font(.pp(11, .semibold)).foregroundStyle(.cyan.opacity(0.95)).lineLimit(1)
                Text(item.text).font(.pp(10)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
                    .lineLimit(4).truncationMode(.middle)
            }
        default:
            let snippet = item.text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            let short = snippet.count <= 48 && !snippet.contains("\n")
            Text(snippet)
                .font(.system(size: short ? 17 : 12, weight: short ? .medium : .regular))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.92))
                .lineSpacing(short ? 2 : 3)
                .lineLimit(compact ? 3 : 6).truncationMode(.tail)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: short ? .leading : .topLeading)
        }
    }

    /// The matched line of the image's text, the match itself in Clipboard's color.
    private func imageMatchLabel(_ match: ClipboardStore.ImageMatch) -> some View {
        var text = AttributedString(match.line)
        text.foregroundColor = .white.opacity(0.78)
        let chars = text.characters
        if match.start >= 0, match.start + match.length <= chars.count {
            let lo = chars.index(chars.startIndex, offsetBy: match.start)
            let hi = chars.index(lo, offsetBy: match.length)
            text[lo..<hi].foregroundColor = EdgeModule.clipboard.accent
            text[lo..<hi].font = .system(size: 11, weight: .bold)
        }
        return Text(text)
            .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .medium))
            .lineLimit(2).truncationMode(.tail)
            .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 6)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.black.opacity(0.78), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: max(4, cornerRadius - 10), style: .continuous))
    }

    /// The text inside an image clip onto the clipboard (as its own text clip); read now
    /// when the background reader hasn't reached it yet.
    private func copyImageText(hash: String) {
        InteractionJournal.shared.action("clipboard.copy_image_text", params: ["item_id": item.id])
        let source = (item.sourceBundleID, item.sourceName)
        if let text = store.imageText(hash: hash), !text.isEmpty {
            store.copyAndRecord(text, source: source); onCopy(); return
        }
        let url = store.blobURL(hash: hash)
        Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
            let text = EdgeOCR.recognize(fileAt: url) ?? ""
            await MainActor.run {
                guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
                store.setImageText(hash: hash, text: text, read: true, version: EdgeOCR.version)
                store.copyAndRecord(text, source: source)
                onCopy()
            }
        }
    }

    private var typeLabel: String {
        switch item.kind {
        case .image: "Image"; case .url: "Link"; case .text: "Text"
        case .file: "File"; case .color: "Color"
        }
    }

    private static let rel: RelativeDateTimeFormatter = {
        let f = RelativeDateTimeFormatter(); f.unitsStyle = .abbreviated; return f
    }()
    private var timeAgo: String { Self.rel.localizedString(for: item.capturedAt, relativeTo: Date()) }

    private var sourceIcon: NSImage? {
        guard let bid = item.sourceBundleID else { return nil }
        // Looked up once per app: resolving and loading an app icon inside every card's
        // body was ~30ms of the first search after launch.
        if let cached = Self.sourceIconCache[bid] { return cached }
        let icon = NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier: bid).map { NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: $0.path) }
        Self.sourceIconCache[bid] = icon
        return icon
    }
    private static var sourceIconCache: [String: NSImage?] = [:]

    private static func thumbnail(_ item: ClipboardStore.Item, store: ClipboardStore) -> NSImage? {
        guard let hash = item.blobHash else { return nil }
        if let c = thumbCache[hash] { return c }
        // A card-sized decode, once. The full image (often a 5K screenshot) was decoded at
        // draw time, and a blob that failed to load was retried on every render.
        let options = [kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true, kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
                       kCGImageSourceShouldCacheImmediately: true, kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: 640] as CFDictionary
        let img = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(store.blobURL(hash: hash) as CFURL, nil)
            .flatMap { CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex($0, 0, options) }
            .map { NSImage(cgImage: $0, size: NSSize(width: $0.width, height: $0.height)) }
        thumbCache[hash] = img
        return img
    }

    private func dragProvider() -> NSItemProvider {
        switch item.kind {
        case .image:
            if let hash = item.blobHash {
                let url = store.blobURL(hash: hash)
                let p = NSItemProvider(object: url as NSURL)
                if let image = NSImage(contentsOf: url) {
                    p.suggestedName = url.lastPathComponent
                    p.registerObject(image, visibility: .all)
                }
                return p
            }
            return NSItemProvider(object: item.text as NSString)
        case .url:
            if let u = URL(string: item.text) {
                let p = NSItemProvider(object: u as NSURL)
                p.registerObject(item.text as NSString, visibility: .all)
                return p
            }
            return NSItemProvider(object: item.text as NSString)
        default:
            // Large clips keep only a preview in `text`; drag the full value.
            return NSItemProvider(object: store.fullText(item) as NSString)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Tools panel (the per-site "mini settings")

/// The single right-side panel button. Clicking opens a popover that shows the
/// site's tools (reader, find) and every installed extension in one neat list —
/// this is the home for everything that used to clutter the toolbar.
struct ToolsButton: View {
    let web: WebContentManager
    let activeTab: Tab?
    let openSettings: () -> Void
    @State private var open = false

    var body: some View {
        Button { open.toggle() } label: {
            Icon("ellipsis-horizontal", size: 15)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(open ? 1 : 0.7))
                .frame(width: BentoMetrics.iconChip, height: 26)
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle(active: open))
        .help("Tools for this site")
        .accessibilityLabel("Tools for this site")
        .popover(isPresented: $open, arrowEdge: .bottom) {
            ToolsPopover(web: web, activeTab: activeTab, openSettings: openSettings)
                .frame(width: 300)
        }
    }
}

private struct ToolsPopover: View {
    @Environment(ExtensionManager.self) private var manager
    @Environment(FindModel.self) private var find
    let web: WebContentManager
    let activeTab: Tab?
    let openSettings: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            header("Site tools")
            toolRow(icon: "book-open", title: "Reader mode",
                    active: web.reader.isActive(activeTab?.id), disabled: activeTab == nil) {
                web.toggleReader()
            }
            toolRow(icon: "magnifying-glass", title: "Find on page",
                    active: false, disabled: activeTab == nil) {
                find.open()
            }
            toolRow(icon: "printer", title: "Print or Save as PDF",
                    active: false, disabled: !web.canPrintCurrentPage) {
                web.printCurrentPage()
            }
            toolRow(icon: "camera", title: "Copy page screenshot",
                    active: false, disabled: !web.canPrintCurrentPage) {
                web.copyCurrentPageScreenshot()
            }
            toolRow(icon: "clock", title: "History",
                    active: false, disabled: false) {
                HistoryModel.shared.isOpen = true
            }

            Divider().padding(.vertical, 6)
            header("Extensions")
            if manager.extensions.isEmpty {
                Text("No extensions installed")
                    .font(.pp(11.5)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.vertical, 8)
            } else {
                ForEach(manager.extensions) { ext in
                    ExtensionToolRow(ext: ext)
                }
            }

            Divider().padding(.vertical, 6)
            Button { openSettings() } label: {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Icon("cog-6-tooth", size: 13).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
                    Text("Settings…").font(.pp(12.5, .medium)).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                    Spacer()
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 8).contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
            .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle(pressScale: 0.97))
            .padding(.horizontal, 4)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 8)
    }

    private func header(_ t: String) -> some View {
        Text(t.uppercased()).font(.pp(10, .semibold)).tracking(0.6)
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.55))
            .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.top, 2).padding(.bottom, 4)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func toolRow(icon: String, title: String, active: Bool,
                                      disabled: Bool, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Icon(icon, size: 13).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(active ? 1 : 0.7))
                Text(title).font(.pp(12.5, .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(disabled ? 0.3 : 0.85))
                Spacer()
                if active {
                    Icon("check", size: 13).foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 8).contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(EdgePressStyle(pressScale: 0.97)).disabled(disabled)
        .padding(.horizontal, 4)
    }
}

/// One extension in the Tools panel: icon + name + an enable switch. Clicking
/// the row runs the extension's action (no nested popover).
private struct ExtensionToolRow: View {
    @Environment(ExtensionManager.self) private var manager
    let ext: InstalledExtension
    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ExtensionIcon(ext: ext, size: 15).opacity(ext.enabled ? 1 : 0.4)
            Text(ext.displayName).font(.pp(12.5, .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(ext.enabled ? 0.9 : 0.45))
                .lineLimit(1).truncationMode(.tail)
            Spacer(minLength: 8)
            Toggle("", isOn: Binding(get: { ext.enabled }, set: { manager.setEnabled(ext.id, $0) }))
                .toggleStyle(.switch).controlSize(.mini).labelsHidden()
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(Capsule(style: .continuous).fill(.white.opacity(hovering ? 0.10 : 0)))
        .padding(.horizontal, 4)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture { if ext.enabled { manager.fireActionClicked(ext) } }
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
    }
}
